abstract.text: Empirical evidence for quantity-quality trade-off is hardly ubiquitous, especially when quality is measured by child health outcomes. The paper offers a new explanation to this puzzle. It shows that the quantity-quality relationships are subject to occupational variation when quality is given by nutritional status, and occupations differ in their physical labor intensity. It embeds, in a simple household optimization model, a minimum consumption requirement that rises with physical work intensity of occupation. The occupational differences in subsistence consumption requirement generate variation in child nutritional status, and hence, in the shadow price of children. The nature of the quantity-quality relationship, therefore, varies with work intensity of occupations. The model yields an equilibrium relationship between the number and nutritional status of children that is positive for households in strenuous occupations and ambiguous for other households. These results help reconcile some inconsistent findings on quantity-quality trade-off, which may partly be explained by the omission of occupational variation in nutritional status.

10.1002/hec.3954.abstractZh: 关于数量与质量之间权衡的实证证据并不普遍，尤其是当质量以儿童健康结果为衡量标准时。本文提出了一种新的解释。研究表明，当质量以营养状况为衡量标准时，数量与质量之间的关系会受到职业差异的影响，不同职业的体力劳动强度也有所不同。在一个简单的家庭优化模型中，我们引入了一个随职业体力劳动强度增加而上升的最低消费需求。不同职业在生存消费需求上的差异导致了儿童营养状况的变化，进而影响了儿童的影子价格。因此，数量与质量之间的关系会因职业的体力劳动强度而发生变化。该模型揭示了儿童数量和营养状况之间的均衡关系，这种关系在从事高强度职业的家庭中呈正相关，而在其他家庭中则存在不确定性。这些结果有助于解释一些关于数量与质量权衡的不一致现象，这部分现象可能是由于忽略了营养状况的职业差异所导致的。

abstract.text: Conditional cash transfer programs have become instrumental in encouraging the use of formal health services in developing countries, but little is known about their effect on the use of low-quality informal care. Using a large survey of Peruvian rural households and a regression discontinuity design, we find a sizeable reduction in the use of informal health care providers not only by targeted but also by nontargeted members of households that qualify for the program. This indicates the existence of spillover effects within the household. We also provide evidence that beyond the direct increase in income, the availability of better information about institutional services is a potential mechanism that drives these effects.

10.1002/hec.3956.abstractZh: 条件性现金转移计划在鼓励发展中国家使用正规医疗服务方面发挥了重要作用，但对其对低质量非正式医疗服务使用的影响知之甚少。通过一项针对秘鲁农村家庭的大规模调查以及回归断点设计，我们发现，不仅符合项目条件的家庭中的目标群体，非目标群体在寻求非正式医疗服务时的使用率也显著下降。这表明存在家庭内部的溢出效应。我们还发现，除了直接增加收入之外，关于机构服务的更好信息也是推动这些效应的潜在机制。

abstract.text: We evaluate how doctors in an emergency department react to the number of patients waiting for treatment. Our outcomes reflect the time spent with the patient, the intensity of treatment, and discharge destination. Using visit-level data in a Lisbon-area hospital, we use a fixed effects model to exploit variation in the queue size while addressing endogeneity using the number of arrivals to the hospital in the previous 60 min as an instrumental variable. Furthermore, we estimate doctors' reactions separately for patients with different degrees of urgency, as measured by the Manchester triage system. Results show that doctors discharge patients more rapidly as queues become longer, and this effect is stronger for patients that do not have life-threatening conditions. We also find that the intensity of diagnosis/treatment procedures decreases when patients face longer queues, driven by the extensive margin. Finally, doctors are less likely to admit patients to inpatient care. We interpret the results in the light of the doctors' incentives literature, explaining how these agents behave in the context of a National Health Service, with no financial incentives.

10.1002/hec.3957.abstractZh: 我们评估了急诊科的医生对等待治疗的患者数量的反应。我们的研究结果反映了医生与患者相处的时间、治疗的强度以及患者的出院去向。我们采用了里斯本地区一家医院的就诊数据，并使用固定效应模型来捕捉排队长度的变化，同时通过将过去60分钟内到达医院的人数作为工具变量来处理内生性问题。此外，我们分别针对不同紧急程度的患者评估医生的反应，这些紧急程度是根据曼彻斯特分类系统来衡量的。结果显示，随着排队时间的延长，医生会更快地出院，这一效应在病情不危及生命的患者中更为明显。我们还发现，当患者面临更长的排队时间时，诊断/治疗程序的强度会下降，这是由边际效应所驱动的。最后，医生不太可能将患者收治为住院患者。我们将这些结果与医生激励理论的文献相结合进行解释，以说明在没有经济激励的情况下，这些医生在国民健康服务体系中的行为表现。

abstract.text: Starting from December 2012, insurers in the European Union were prohibited from charging gender-discriminatory prices. We examine the effect of this unisex mandate on risk segmentation in the German health insurance market. Although gender used to be a pricing factor in Germany's private health insurance (PHI) sector, it was never used as a pricing factor in the social health insurance (SHI) sector. The unisex mandate makes PHI relatively more attractive for women and less attractive for men. Based on data from the German socio-economic panel, we analyze how the unisex mandate affects the difference between women and men in switching rates between SHI and PHI. We find that the unisex mandate increases the probability of switching from SHI to PHI for women relative to men. On the other hand, the unisex mandate has no effect on the gender difference in switching rates from PHI to SHI. Because women have on average higher health care expenditures than men, our results imply a worsening of the PHI risk pool and an improvement of the SHI risk pool. Our results demonstrate that regulatory measures such as the unisex mandate can affect risk selection between public and private health insurance sectors.

10.1002/hec.3958.abstractZh: 自2012年12月起，欧盟的保险公司被禁止收取性别歧视性价格。我们研究了这一“无性别规定”对德国健康保险市场风险划分的影响。尽管性别曾经是德国私人健康保险领域的定价因素，但在社会健康保险领域，性别从未被用作定价因素。这一“无性别规定”使得私人健康保险对女性相对更具吸引力，而对男性则相对缺乏吸引力。基于德国社会经济面板数据，我们分析了这一规定如何影响男女在转换社会健康保险和私人健康保险之间的比例。研究发现，与男性相比，这一规定增加了女性从社会健康保险转换到私人健康保险的可能性。另一方面，这一规定对男女在从私人健康保险转换到社会健康保险的比例差异没有影响。由于女性平均医疗保健支出高于男性，我们的研究结果意味着私人健康保险的风险池会恶化，而社会健康保险的风险池则会改善。我们的研究表明，诸如“无性别规定”这样的监管措施能够影响公共和私人健康保险领域的风险选择。

abstract.text: Near the end of life, health declines, mortality risk increases, and curative care is replaced by uninsured long-term care, accelerating the fall in wealth. Whereas standard explanations emphasize inevitable aging processes, we propose a complementary closing down the shop justification where agents' decisions affect their health and the timing of death. Despite preferring to live, individuals optimally deplete their health and wealth towards levels associated with high death risk and gradual indifference between life and death. Reinstating exogenous aging processes reinforces the relevance of closing down. Using Health and Retirement Study-Consumption and Activities Mail Survey data for elders, a structural estimation of the closed-form decisions identifies, tests, and confirms the relevance of closing down.

10.1002/hec.3960.abstractZh: 在生命即将结束之际，健康状况会下降，死亡风险会增加，治疗性护理会被无保障的长期护理所取代，这进一步加速了财富的减少。虽然标准解释强调不可避免的衰老过程，但我们提出了一种补充性的解释，即代理人的决策会影响他们的健康状况和死亡时间。尽管人们倾向于继续生活，但个体最终会消耗自己的健康和财富，以达到高死亡风险的水平，并对生与死逐渐失去兴趣。重新引入外生的衰老过程进一步强化了这种解释的重要性。通过健康与退休研究——针对老年人的消费与活动邮件调查数据，对封闭形式决策的结构性估计表明，这种解释是合理且有效的。

abstract.text: Although unemployment likely entails various externalities, research examining its spillover effects on spouses is scarce. This is the first paper to estimate effects of unemployment on the smoking behavior of both spouses. Using German Socio-Economic Panel data, we combine matching and difference-in-differences estimation, employing the post-double-selection method for control variable selection via Lasso regressions. One spouse's unemployment increases both spouses' smoking probability and intensity. Smoking relapses and decreased smoking cessation drive the effects. Effects are stronger if the partner already smokes and if the male partner becomes unemployed. Of several mechanisms discussed, we identify smoking to cope with stress as relevant.

10.1002/hec.3961.abstractZh: 尽管失业可能带来各种外部影响，但关于失业对配偶影响的实证研究却很少。本文首次尝试评估失业对配偶吸烟行为的影响。利用德国社会经济面板数据，我们采用了匹配方法和差异估计方法，并通过Lasso回归选择控制变量。配偶中的一方失业会增加双方的吸烟概率和强度。吸烟复发和戒烟失败是这些影响的驱动因素。如果伴侣本身已经吸烟，或者男性伴侣失业，这些影响会更为显著。在讨论的几种机制中，我们认为吸烟作为一种应对压力的方式具有相关性。

abstract.text: Significant limitations and rapid declines in financial capacity are a hallmark of patients with early-stage Alzheimer's disease (AD). We use linked Health and Retirement Study and Medicare claims data spanning 1992-2014 to examine the effect of early-stage AD, from the start of first symptoms to diagnosis, on household financial outcomes. We estimate household fixed-effects models and examine continuous measures of liquid assets and net wealth, as well as dichotomous indicators for a large change in either outcome. We find robust evidence that early-stage AD places households at significant risk for large adverse changes in liquid assets. Further, we find some, but more limited, evidence that early-stage AD reduces net wealth. Our findings are consequential because financial vulnerability during the disease's early-stage impacts the ability of afflicted individuals and their families to pay for care in the disease's later stage. Additionally, the findings speak to the value that earlier diagnosis may provide by helping avert adverse financial outcomes that occur before the disease is currently diagnosable with available tools. These results also point to a potentially important role for financial institutions in helping reduce exposure of vulnerable elderly to poor outcomes.

10.1002/hec.3962.abstractZh: 早期阿尔茨海默病患者的显著限制和财务能力的迅速下降是其特征之一。我们利用1992年至2014年的健康与退休研究数据以及医疗保险索赔数据，来研究从首次症状出现到确诊这段时间内，早期阿尔茨海默病对家庭财务结果的影响。我们建立了家庭固定效应模型，并考察了流动资产和净资产等连续指标的变化情况，以及这些指标发生显著变化的二元指标。研究发现，早期阿尔茨海默病确实会增加家庭面临流动资产大幅不利变化的风险。此外，我们还发现，早期阿尔茨海默病可能会减少净资产。我们的研究结果具有重要意义，因为疾病早期阶段的财务脆弱性会影响患者及其家庭在疾病后期支付护理费用的能力。此外，这些研究结果还表明，早期诊断有助于避免那些在现有诊断工具出现之前可能发生的不良财务后果。这些结果也表明，金融机构在帮助减少脆弱老年人面临不良后果方面可能发挥着重要作用。

abstract.text: Missing data are a common issue in cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) alongside randomised trials and are often addressed assuming the data are 'missing at random'. However, this assumption is often questionable, and sensitivity analyses are required to assess the implications of departures from missing at random. Reference-based multiple imputation provides an attractive approach for conducting such sensitivity analyses, because missing data assumptions are framed in an intuitive way by making reference to other trial arms. For example, a plausible not at random mechanism in a placebo-controlled trial would be to assume that participants in the experimental arm who dropped out stop taking their treatment and have similar outcomes to those in the placebo arm. Drawing on the increasing use of this approach in other areas, this paper aims to extend and illustrate the reference-based multiple imputation approach in CEA. It introduces the principles of reference-based imputation and proposes an extension to the CEA context. The method is illustrated in the CEA of the CoBalT trial evaluating cognitive behavioural therapy for treatment-resistant depression. Stata code is provided. We find that reference-based multiple imputation provides a relevant and accessible framework for assessing the robustness of CEA conclusions to different missing data assumptions.

10.1002/hec.3963.abstractZh: 缺失数据在成本效益分析（CEA）中是一个常见的问题，与随机试验一样，通常假设数据“随机缺失”。然而，这一假设往往存在疑问，需要进行敏感性分析来评估偏离随机缺失情况的影响。基于参考值的多重插补为进行此类敏感性分析提供了一种有吸引力的方法，因为通过引用其他试验组，可以以直观的方式处理缺失数据的假设。例如，在安慰剂对照试验中，一个合理的非随机机制可能是假设退出实验组的参与者停止接受治疗，并且其结果与安慰剂组的参与者相似。鉴于这种方法在其他领域中的日益广泛应用，本文旨在扩展并说明其在CEA中的应用。文章介绍了基于参考值的插补原则，并提出了一种适用于CEA环境的扩展方法。该方法在CoBalT试验的CEA中得到了验证，该试验评估了认知行为疗法对难治性抑郁症的治疗效果。文中提供了Stata代码。我们发现，基于参考值的多重插补为评估CEA结论对不同缺失数据假设的稳健性提供了一个相关且易于使用的框架。

abstract.text: In developed nations, public health agencies typically use data from randomized controlled trials to evaluate new drugs. However, these trials routinely exclude populations to which clinicians prescribe approved drugs, meaning some patients are treated with drugs, which were approved on the basis of another group's treatment response. Despite having opportunities to change, some health agencies have not mandated greater inclusion in drug trials and appear to prefer remaining ignorant of some populations' treatment effects when approving a drug. To explore this decision, I introduce a novel mechanism by which a health agency would choose to be intentionally agnostic regarding a population's treatment response. The main contribution of this paper is in showing how ambiguity about on-label and off-label prescription rates could possibly encourage population exclusion in drug approval trials even in the absence of concerns about trial necessity or cost.

10.1002/hec.3964.abstractZh: 在发达国家，公共卫生机构通常利用随机对照试验的数据来评估新药物。然而，这些试验通常会排除那些接受医生处方的已批准药物的人群，这意味着一些患者使用的是基于另一组人群治疗反应而获得批准的药物。尽管有改变的机会，一些卫生机构并未强制要求在药物试验中更广泛地纳入这些人群，并且在批准药物时似乎更倾向于对某些人群的治疗效果保持无知。为了探讨这一决策，我提出了一种新颖的机制，即卫生机构可以选择故意对某个人群的治疗反应持不可知态度。本文的主要贡献在于揭示了，即使在没有关于试验必要性或成本的担忧的情况下，关于药物使用标签内和标签外使用率的模糊性，也可能促使在药物审批试验中排除某些人群。

abstract.text: Tax-preferred health savings devices such as Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) and Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) offer employees potentially valuable financial instruments for directing pre-tax earnings to eligible medical expenses. Despite their increasing popularity as an employee benefit, however, there is little causal evidence around individual demand for these accounts. This paper seeks to address this gap in the literature, reporting on a randomized controlled field experiment conducted with over 11,000 U. S federal employees in 2017 in order to evaluate the effectiveness of targeted messages designed to increase FSA contributions. Our results suggest that the provision of basic information about FSAs delivered via an emailed employee newsletter did not affect the likelihood of contribution or the contribution level. The addition of statements about the absolute returns or relative returns offered by the accounts similarly had no significant effects, and these null effects are observed despite relatively high email open rates. We discuss explanations for the null results and the policy implications of findings from what appears to be the first health economics experiment analyzing tax incentives around health care savings.

10.1002/hec.3965.abstractZh: 税收优惠的健康储蓄工具，如灵活支出账户和健康储蓄账户，为员工提供了将税前收入用于符合条件的医疗开支的宝贵金融工具。尽管这些工具作为员工福利越来越受欢迎，但关于个人对这些账户需求的因果证据却很少。本文旨在填补这一文献空白，报告了2017年一项针对超过11,000名美国联邦员工的随机对照实地实验，以评估旨在增加灵活支出账户贡献度的定向信息的效果。我们的研究结果表明，通过电子邮件员工通讯提供关于灵活支出账户的基本信息，并未影响贡献的可能性或贡献水平。此外，添加关于这些账户所提供的绝对回报或相对回报的声明，同样没有显著效果。这些无效结果在电子邮件的开放率相对较高的情况下仍然被观察到。我们讨论了这些无效结果的解释，以及这项看似首次针对医疗储蓄税收优惠的健康经济学实验的发现所带来的政策意义。

abstract.text: In this paper, we study the effect of readmission treatment payment in a dynamic framework characterised by competition among hospitals and sluggish beliefs of patients concerning the service quality. We find that the effect of readmission treatment payment depends on the interplay between the effect of quality in lowering readmissions and its effect on future demand. When the readmission occurrence strongly depends on the service quality, the higher the readmission treatment payment for hospitals, the lower the incentive to provide quality. Instead, when readmission depends barely on quality, the readmission payment acts as the treatment price for first admissions, and thus it reinforces the incentive to provide quality. We also show that the detrimental effect of readmission payments on quality are fed by a high degree of demand sluggishness, that is, by situation where current quality has modest effect on future demand changes. Our findings are robust to different equilibrium concepts of the differential game (i.e., open-loop and state-feedback). The results suggest that a discounted regulated price for readmission can be an effective (and cost-free) policy tool to improve health care quality, especially when the market is characterised by sluggish beliefs about quality.

10.1002/hec.3966.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了在医院竞争激烈且患者对服务质量持消极信念的动态框架下，再入院治疗支付对服务质量的影响。我们发现，再入院治疗支付的效果取决于服务质量降低再入院率的效应与其对未来需求的影响之间的相互作用。当再入院的发生严重依赖于服务质量时，医院对再入院治疗的支付越高，提供高质量服务的动机就越低。相反，当再入院几乎不依赖于服务质量时，再入院支付就相当于首次入院的治疗费用，从而增强了提供高质量服务的动机。我们还指出，再入院支付对质量的负面影响是由需求停滞程度较高所引发的，即当前的质量对未来需求变化的影响较小。我们的发现不受差分博弈不同均衡概念的影响（即开环和状态反馈）。结果表明，对于市场中存在对服务质量消极信念的情况，采用贴现后的再入院管制价格可以作为一种有效的（且无需成本）政策工具来提高医疗保健质量。

abstract.text: Health insurance is a primary driver of rising medical expenditures. Economic theory suggests that insurance induces an increase in risky behaviors, but previous empirical evidence is mixed. I use a mandate in the Affordable Care Act in which contraceptives were covered at zero cost to consumers to test for unintended effects of insurance on risky sex. Leveraging mandated zero cost-sharing for contraception and pre-policy insured rates as a measure of treatment intensity, I provide evidence that this 2012 policy reduced fertility but caused unintended consequences: a decline in condom use and a subsequent increase in sexually transmitted infections (STIs). I discuss shortcomings of controlling for nonparallel pre-trends using state-trends, and I suggest an alternative to control for pre-trends directly in the context of dose-response difference-in-differences. Finally, estimates based on the 2010 dependent coverage mandate indicate health insurance provides an overall net positive effect on insurance and STI prevention.

10.1002/hec.3967.abstractZh: 健康保险是医疗支出增加的主要驱动力。经济理论表明，保险会促使人们采取更多冒险行为，但之前的实证研究结果并不一致。我利用《平价医疗法案》中的强制保险条款，该条款规定避孕措施对消费者免费，以此来测试保险对性冒险行为的影响。通过利用强制避孕措施和保险前政策费率作为治疗强度的衡量标准，我发现2012年的这项政策降低了生育率，但产生了意想不到的后果：避孕套使用率下降，性传播感染率随之上升。我讨论了使用州级趋势来控制非平行趋势的局限性，并提出了一种替代方法，即在剂量-反应差异模型中直接控制政策前趋势。最后，基于2010年强制保险覆盖率的估计表明，健康保险总体上对保险和性传播感染预防具有积极的影响。

abstract.text: Neonatal units in the UK are organised into three levels, from highest Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU), to Local Neonatal Unit (LNU) to lowest Special Care Unit (SCU). We model the endogenous treatment selection of neonatal care unit of birth to estimate the average and marginal treatment effects of different neonatal designations on infant mortality, length of stay and hospital costs. We use prognostic factors, survival and hospital care use data on all preterm births in England for 2014-2015, supplemented by national reimbursement tariffs and instrumental variables of travel time from a geographic information system. The data were consistent with a model of demand for preterm birth care driven by physical access. In-hospital mortality of infants born before 32 weeks was 8.5% overall, and 1.2 (95% CI: -0.7, 3.2) percentage points lower for live births in hospitals with NICU or SCU compared to those with an LNU according to instrumental variable estimates. We find imprecise differences in average total hospital costs by unit designation, with positive unobserved selection of those with higher unexplained absolute and incremental costs into NICU. Our results suggest a limited scope for improvement in infant mortality by increasing in-utero transfers based on unit designation alone.

10.1002/hec.3970.abstractZh: 英国的新生儿护理机构分为三个级别：最高级别的是新生儿重症监护室（NICU），其次是地方新生儿病房（LNU），最低级别的是特殊护理单元（SCU）。我们通过对新生儿护理机构内治疗选择的模型分析，来估算不同护理级别对婴儿死亡率、住院时间和医院成本的平均和边际影响。我们使用了2014-2015年英格兰所有早产儿的预后因素、生存数据以及医院护理使用数据，并参考了国家报销标准以及地理信息系统中的出行时间等工具变量。数据表明，早产儿的护理需求是由物理可及性所驱动的。在32周之前出生的婴儿中，医院内的死亡率总体为8.5%，而在拥有NICU或SCU的医院中，这一比例比在LNU医院中低1.2个百分点（95%置信区间：-0.7, 3.2）。我们发现，不同护理级别之间的平均总医院成本差异并不明显，而那些具有较高未解释绝对成本和增量成本的婴儿更有可能被分配到NICU。我们的研究结果表明，仅通过护理级别来增加子宫内转院的机会，对降低婴儿死亡率的改善效果有限。

abstract.text: Hoynes, Miller, and Simon (2015), henceforth HMS, report that the national expansion of the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) is associated with decreases in low birth weight. We question their findings. HMS's difference-in-differences estimates are unidentified in some comparisons, while failed placebo tests undermine others. Their effects lack a plausible mechanism as the association between the EITC and prenatal smoking also fails placebo tests. We contend that the waning of the crack epidemic is a possible confound, but we show that any number of policies directed at poor women also eliminate the effect of the EITC when aggregated to the national level. Identifying small, causal effects of a national policy at a single point in time is exceedingly challenging.

10.1002/hec.3972.abstractZh: Hoynes、Miller和Simon（2015年）的研究表明，全国范围内扩大劳动收入税收抵免政策的实施与低出生体重率的下降有关。我们对他们的研究结果提出了质疑。HMS的研究在部分比较中未能识别出差异效应，而失败的安慰剂测试也削弱了其他结果的可靠性。他们研究中的效应缺乏合理的机制解释，因为劳动收入税收抵免与产前吸烟之间的关联同样未能通过安慰剂测试得到验证。我们认为，毒品泛滥的减少可能是一个混杂因素，但我们发现，任何针对贫困女性的政策，在汇总到全国层面时，都会消除劳动收入税收抵免的效果。在单一时间点识别国家政策的微小因果效应是非常具有挑战性的。

abstract.text: Regulated prices are common in markets for medical care. We estimate the effect of changes in regulated reimbursement prices on volume of hospital care based on a reform of hospital financing in Germany. Uniquely, this reform changed the overall level of reimbursement-with increasing prices for some hospitals and decreasing prices for others-without directly affecting the relative prices for different groups of patients or types of treatment. Based on administrative data, we find that hospitals react to increasing prices by decreasing the service supply and to decreasing prices by increasing the service supply. Moreover, we find some evidence that volume changes for hospitals with different price changes are nonlinear. We interpret our findings as evidence for a negative income effect of prices on volume of care.

10.1002/hec.3973.abstractZh: 在医疗市场上，管制价格是很常见的现象。我们基于德国医院融资改革，估算了管制报销价格变化对医院护理服务量的影响。值得注意的是，这一改革改变了整体的报销水平——某些医院的报销金额增加，而另一些医院的报销金额减少，但并未直接影响不同患者群体或治疗类型的相对价格。根据行政数据，我们发现医院对价格上涨的反应是减少服务供应，而对价格下降的反应则是增加服务供应。此外，我们还发现，对于价格变化不同的医院来说，服务量的变化并非线性。我们将这些发现解释为价格对护理服务量产生负面影响的证据。

abstract.text: Evaluation of future social welfare may not only depend on the aggregate of individual prospects, but also on how the prospects are distributed across individuals. The latter in turn would depend on how people perceive inequality and risk at the collective level (or "social risk"). This paper examines distributional preferences regarding inequality in outcomes and social risk for health and income in the context of losses. Specifically, four kinds of aversions are compared, (a) outcome-inequality aversion in health, (b) outcome-inequality aversion in income, (c) social-risk aversion in health, (d) and social-risk aversion in income. Face-to-face interviews of a representative general public sample in Spain are undertaken using hypothetical scenarios involving losses in health or income across otherwise equal groups. Aversion parameters are compared assuming social welfare functions with constant relative or constant absolute aversion. We find that in both domains, outcome-inequality aversion and social-risk aversion are not the same; and that neither aversion is the same across the two domains. Outcome-inequality aversion in income is the strongest, followed by social-risk aversion in income and social-risk aversion in health, and outcome-inequality aversion in health coming last, where most of these are statistically significantly different from each other.

10.1002/hec.3974.abstractZh: 对未来社会福利的评估不仅取决于个体前景的总和，还取决于这些前景在个体之间的分配情况。后者又取决于人们如何感知集体层面的不平等和风险。本文探讨了在损失情境下，人们对结果不平等以及健康与收入方面的社会风险的偏好。具体来说，比较了四种类型的厌恶情绪：(a) 健康结果不平等的厌恶；(b) 收入结果不平等的厌恶；(c) 健康方面的社会风险厌恶；(d) 收入方面的社会风险厌恶。通过对西班牙代表性普通公众样本进行面对面访谈，并采用涉及健康或收入损失的假设情景，比较了厌恶情绪参数。在假设社会福利函数具有恒定相对厌恶或恒定绝对厌恶的情况下，我们发现，在这两个领域，结果不平等厌恶和社会风险厌恶并不相同；而且，这两种厌恶情绪在不同领域之间也存在差异。其中，收入结果不平等厌恶最为强烈，其次是收入方面的社会风险厌恶和健康方面的社会风险厌恶，而健康结果不平等厌恶则排在最后，这些厌恶情绪在统计上彼此存在显著差异。

abstract.text: This paper provides new empirical evidence on the employment and earning effects of the recent Medicaid expansion. Unlike most existing studies that use a conventional state and year fixed effects approach, our main identification strategy is based on the comparison of employment and wages in contiguous county-pairs in neighboring states (i.e., border counties) with different Medicaid expansion status. Using the 2008-2016 Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages, we estimate a set of distributed lag models in order to examine the dynamic effects of Medicaid expansion. Results from our preferred specification suggest a statistically significant decrease in total employment of 1.2% 1 year after the expansion of Medicaid. This translates into a 37% decrease in employment among newly eligible Medicaid enrollees under the strong assumption that Medicaid coverage did not crowd out private insurance coverage. We also find that this disemployment effect is transitory: 2 years after the Medicaid expansion employment returns to preexpansion levels. We do not find any statistically significant effect of the Medicaid expansion on wages at any point.

10.1002/hec.3976.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于近期医疗补助扩展对就业和收入影响的新的实证证据。与大多数采用传统州和年份固定效应方法的研究不同，我们的主要识别策略基于比较邻近州中不同医疗补助扩展状况下的相邻县对之间的就业和工资情况。利用2008-2016年的《就业与工资季度普查数据》，我们建立了一系列分布式滞后模型，以研究医疗补助扩展的动态影响。我们首选的模型结果显示，在医疗补助扩展后1年内，总就业人数减少了1.2%。这一变化意味着，在假设医疗补助覆盖并未挤占私人保险覆盖的情况下，新获得医疗补助资格的人数减少了37%。我们还发现，这种就业减少效应是暂时的：在医疗补助扩展后2年内，就业人数已恢复到扩展前的水平。我们并未发现医疗补助扩展在任何时间点对工资产生显著的负面影响。

abstract.text: Little evidence exists on the effect of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) on criminal behavior, a gap in the literature that this paper seeks to address. Using a simple model, we argue we should anticipate a decrease in time devoted to criminal activities in response to the expansion, because the availability of the ACA Medicaid coverage raises the opportunity cost of crime. This prediction is particularly relevant for the ACA expansion because it primarily affects childless adults, a population likely to contain individuals who engage in criminal behavior. We validate this forecast empirically using a difference-in-differences framework, estimating the expansion's effects on panel datasets of state- and county-level crime rates. Our estimates suggest that the ACA Medicaid expansion was negatively associated with burglary, vehicle theft, homicide, robbery, and assault. These crime-reduction spillover effects represent an important offset to the government's cost burden for the ACA Medicaid expansion.

10.1002/hec.3977.abstractZh: 关于《平价医疗法案》对犯罪行为影响的证据很少，本文试图填补这一文献空白。通过一个简单的模型，我们认为由于《平价医疗法案》带来的医疗补助覆盖范围的扩大，用于犯罪活动的时间将会减少，因为医疗补助的可用性提高了犯罪的机会成本。这一预测对于《平价医疗法案》的扩展尤其重要，因为该法案主要影响无子女成年人，而这部分人群中可能包含有犯罪行为的个体。我们通过差异-差异框架对这一预测进行了实证验证，估计了该法案扩展对州级和县级犯罪率的影响。我们的估计结果显示，《平价医疗法案》的医疗补助扩展与入室盗窃、车辆盗窃、凶杀、抢劫和袭击等犯罪行为的减少存在负相关关系。这些犯罪减少的溢出效应在一定程度上抵消了政府在实施《平价医疗法案》医疗补助扩展时所承担的成本负担。

abstract.text: To address exposure to secondhand smoke, which is highly prevalent in Korea, local governments have implemented smoking bans at open public places (parks, bus stops, and school zones) since 2011. Exploiting temporal and spatial variation in the implementation dates of these bans, this study estimates their causal effects on individual smoking behavior. The individual-level longitudinal data from the 2009-2017 Korean Labor and Income Panel Study are linked to the smoking ban legislation information from the National Law Information Center. I find robust evidence that outdoor smoking bans increased the probability of making a quit attempt by 16%. This effect appears immediately after a ban goes into effect and lasts for three or more years. People who spend more time outdoors are more likely to change smoking behavior. I also find heterogeneity in effects across the amount of monetary penalty. Whereas the policy change did not affect the prevalence of smoking overall, higher penalties had stronger impacts on reducing the intensity of smoking and increasing the propensity to try to quit.

10.1002/hec.3979.abstractZh: 为了应对在韩国普遍存在的二手烟问题，地方政府自2011年起在公共场所实施了禁烟措施，包括公园、公交车站和学校区域。本研究利用这些禁烟措施实施时间上的时空差异，估算其对个人吸烟行为的因果效应。通过2009-2017年韩国劳动与收入面板研究提供的个人级纵向数据，并与国家法律信息中心提供的禁烟立法信息相结合，我发现室外禁烟措施使戒烟尝试的概率增加了16%。这一效应在禁烟措施生效后立即显现，并持续了三年或更长时间。在户外活动时间较长的人群中，改变吸烟行为的可能性更高。我还发现，不同金额的罚款对禁烟措施的效果有不同的影响。虽然政策变化并未整体影响吸烟的普遍性，但更高的罚款对减少吸烟强度和提高戒烟意愿有更强的促进作用。

abstract.text: This paper focuses on the effects of a 2005 health insurance reform in Vietnam. Through this reform, public health insurance was newly offered to nonpoor children under 6 years old, but it required the use of community health facilities. This requirement potentially limited the value of the insurance. Employing difference-in-discontinuities and triple-difference methods and using data from 2002, 2004, and 2006, I show that, despite health coverage among nonpoor children increasing by nearly three times, there is little or no evidence that the reform significantly increased health care utilization, changed care locations from private to public sites, lowered out-of-pocket costs, or improved health status for nonpoor young children. My results suggest a "bypassing" phenomenon whereby nonpoor families skipped free health care at low-quality facilities.

10.1002/hec.3980.abstractZh: 本文聚焦于2005年越南健康保险改革的影响。通过这一改革，为6岁以下的非贫困儿童提供了新的公共健康保险，但要求他们使用社区医疗设施。这一要求可能限制了保险的价值。本文采用差异不连续性和三重差异方法，并基于2002年、2004年和2006年的数据进行分析，结果显示，尽管非贫困儿童的健康保险覆盖率增加了近三倍，但几乎没有证据表明该改革显著提高了医疗服务的利用率，改变了医疗服务的地点（从私人机构转向公共机构），降低了自付费用，或改善了非贫困幼儿的健康状况。我的研究结果表明，存在一种“绕行”现象，即非贫困家庭选择不去那些质量较低的医疗机构接受免费医疗服务。

abstract.text: The timing of an abortion (often measured as gestational age) can have important effects on the woman's physical health and on the cost of the procedure. To the authors' knowledge, there has been only one national analysis of the factors associated with the gestational age at abortion, but it employed data from over 20 years ago. The state-specific studies that have explored abortion timing have typically examined the effects of a specific change in abortion regulations. In this study, we employ annual, state-level data covering the 1991-2014 period that measure the frequency of abortions by gestational age. We regress these measures of abortion utilization on policy, economic, demographic, and health care infrastructure characteristics. The estimates indicate that the introduction of state restrictions on Medicaid funding of abortions is associated with a 13% increase in the rate of abortions after the first trimester. We do not find a statistically significant association between parental involvement laws and the rate or percentage of post-first-trimester abortions.

10.1002/hec.3981.abstractZh: 堕胎的时间（通常以妊娠周数来衡量）会对女性的身体健康以及手术费用产生重要影响。据作者所知，目前仅有一次针对与妊娠周数相关的堕胎因素进行的全国性分析，但该研究使用的是超过20年前的数据。那些探讨堕胎时间的研究通常只关注堕胎法规的具体变化所带来的影响。在本研究中，我们使用了1991年至2014年间的年度、州级数据，这些数据记录了不同妊娠周数的堕胎频率。我们将这些堕胎使用频率指标与政策、经济、人口统计以及医疗保健基础设施特征进行了回归分析。分析结果表明，州政府对堕胎的Medicaid资金实施限制后，妊娠第一孕期之后的堕胎率增加了13%。我们没有发现父母参与法律与妊娠第一孕期之后堕胎率之间存在统计学上的显著关联。

abstract.text: Access to care is an important issue in public health care systems. Unlike private systems, in which price equilibrates supply and demand, public systems often ration medical services through wait times. Access that is given on a first come, first served basis might not yield an allocation of resources that maximizes the health of a population, potentially creating suboptimal heterogeneity in wait times. In this study, we examine an access disparity between two groups of patients-established patients and new patients. We exploit an exogenous policy change-implemented by the U.S. Veterans Health Administration-that removed the disparity and homogenized the wait time. We find strong evidence that without such a policy, established patients have priority access over new patients. We discuss whether this is a suboptimal allocation of resources. We additionally find that established patient priority access is an important determinant of access for new patients; accounting for it increased the explanatory power of our statistical model of new patient wait times by a factor of five. The findings imply that policy and management decisions may be more effective in achieving the optimal distribution of access if access heterogeneity is recognized and accounted for explicitly.

10.1002/hec.3982.abstractZh: 获得医疗服务是公共卫生体系中的一个重要问题。与私人医疗体系不同，在私人体系中，价格能够平衡供需关系，而公共医疗体系通常通过等待时间来分配医疗服务。按照先来先服务的原则进行资源分配可能无法实现最大化人群健康的目标，反而可能导致等待时间的差异。本研究考察了两组患者之间的资源分配差异：既有患者与新患者。我们利用美国退伍军人健康管理局实施的一项政策变化，消除了这种差异，使等待时间变得均匀。我们发现，如果没有这项政策，既有患者会优先获得医疗服务，而新患者则面临较低的优先权。我们探讨了这种资源分配是否是最优的。此外，我们发现既有患者的优先权对新患者的资源分配具有重要影响；考虑到这一点，我们的统计模型对新患者等待时间的解释能力提高了五倍。这些发现表明，如果能够明确认识到并考虑等待时间的差异，政策和管理决策在实现资源分配的最优化方面可能会更加有效。

abstract.text: Stated preferences methods are extensively applied in health economics to elicit preferences. Although mailed surveys were commonly used to collect data, internet panel (IP) surveys are being increasingly used. This raises questions about the validity of responses and estimated willingness-to-pay (WTP) values generated from IP surveys. We conduct the first study in health to compare a contingent valuation IP survey with a mailed survey using the electoral roll. Our IP has a higher response rate and lower item missing response rate. The difference is reduced but remains when restricting comparisons with valid WTPs. Sample characteristics differ, with significant differences between modes for gender, age, income, and attitudes and knowledge. Although difference in WTP values exist, with the IP resulting in higher values, we find limited evidence that such differences are statistically significant. The mail survey has lower initial cost per response; however, once restricting samples to valid WTP responses with nonmissing respondent information, the cost per response across modes is similar. Our results, suggesting that IPs generate valid and cost-effective values, are encouraging as researchers move increasingly to IPs to collect preference data.

10.1002/hec.3983.abstractZh: 陈述偏好方法在健康经济学中被广泛用于收集偏好信息。虽然传统的邮寄调查常用于数据收集，但互联网面板调查正逐渐得到应用。这引发了关于这些调查所生成的回答有效性和支付意愿估计值的问题。我们首次在健康经济学领域开展研究，比较了使用选民名单的互联网面板调查与邮寄调查的效果。我们的研究发现，互联网面板调查的回应率更高，缺失项的比例更低。尽管这种差异有所减少，但在仅限有效支付意愿数据的比较中，差异仍然存在。样本特征存在差异，性别、年龄、收入以及态度和知识等方面，两种调查方式之间存在显著差异。虽然支付意愿值存在差异，且互联网面板调查得出的数值更高，但我们发现这种差异在统计上并不显著。邮寄调查的初始成本较低；然而，一旦将样本限制为包含有效支付意愿信息且受访者信息未缺失的样本，两种调查方式之间的每响应成本趋于一致。我们的研究结果表明，互联网面板调查能够生成有效且成本效益高的数据，这对于研究人员越来越多地采用这种方法来收集偏好数据来说是一个积极的进展。

abstract.text: Unlike in the production of most goods, changes in capacity for labor-intensive services only affect outcomes of interest insofar as service providers change the way they allocate their time in response to those capacity changes. In this paper, we examine how public sector service providers respond to unexpected capacity constraints in the specific context of public health clinics. We exploit an exogenous reduction in public health clinic capacity to quantify the trade-off between patients treated and time spent with each patient, which we treat as a proxy for a quality versus quantity decision. We provide evidence that these small and generally insignificant effects on nurse time favor public sector employees prioritizing quality of each interaction over clearing the patient queue.

10.1002/hec.3984.abstractZh: 与大多数商品的生产不同，劳动密集型服务的产能变化仅会在服务提供者根据产能变化调整时间分配时，对结果产生影响。本文研究公共部门服务提供者如何应对公共健康诊所特定情境下的意外产能限制。我们通过引入公共健康诊所产能的外生减少来量化患者治疗数量与每位患者相处时间之间的权衡，将这一权衡视为质量与数量之间的决策问题。我们的证据表明，这些对护士时间的影响虽然微小且通常并不显著，但有利于公共部门员工将每次互动的质量置于清理患者队列之前。

abstract.text: This study evaluates the welfare benefits of the New Cooperative Medical Scheme (NCMS), the main public health insurance plan for the rural population in China. The findings show that the value of the NCMS to recipients is slightly lower than the government's costs of implementation, ranging from 0.79 to 0.97 per RMB of the resource cost of the NCMS. The estimated moral hazard costs are low compared with the total benefits. It is also estimated that the benefits originating from the NCMS's insurance function only constitute 20% of the total benefits, suggesting a need for higher generosity levels among rural households. Our results shed new light on the welfare effects of access health insurance among low- and middle-income households.

10.1002/hec.3985.abstractZh: 本研究评估了新型合作医疗计划（NCMS）对农村人口的福利影响，该计划是中国主要的公共健康保险计划。研究结果表明，NCMS对受益人的价值略低于政府实施该计划的成本，大约为每人民币资源成本的0.79至0.97。与总收益相比，估计的道德风险成本较低。此外，研究还估计，NCMS的保险功能所带来的收益仅占总收益的20%，这表明农村家庭需要更高的福利水平。我们的研究结果为低收入和中等收入家庭获得健康保险所带来的福利效应提供了新的见解。

abstract.text: We analyze how a sales tax levied on all food products impacts the consumption of healthy food, unhealthy food, and obesity. The sales tax can stimulate the consumption of healthy meals by lowering the time costs of food preparation. Moreover, the sales tax lowers obesity under more general conditions than a tax on unhealthy food (fat tax) and a subsidy on healthy food (thin subsidy). We calibrate the model using recent consumption and time use data from the US. The thin subsidy is counterproductive and increases weight. While both the sales tax and the fat tax mitigate obesity, the former imposes a lower excess burden on consumers.

10.1002/hec.3987.abstractZh: 我们分析了对所有食品征收销售税对健康食品、不健康食品以及肥胖的影响。销售税可以通过降低食品准备的时间成本来刺激健康食品的消费。此外，与针对不健康食品征税（脂肪税）和对健康食品提供补贴（瘦补贴）相比，销售税在更广泛的条件下能够降低肥胖率。我们使用美国最新的消费和时间使用数据对模型进行了校准。瘦补贴反而适得其反，会导致体重增加。虽然销售税和脂肪税都能缓解肥胖问题，但前者对消费者的额外负担较小。

abstract.text: Social scientists have long documented that many components of socioeconomic status such as income and education have strong ties across generations. However, health status, arguably a more critical component of welfare, has largely been ignored. We fill this void by providing the first estimates of the Intergenerational Health Association (IHA) that are explicitly based on a nonlinear latent variable model. We develop an estimation procedure for a nonlinear model with categorical outcomes in which the latent index is a mixed linear model and contains covariates that might not vary within cross-sectional units. Adjusting for only age and gender, we estimate an IHA of 0.3 indicating that about one third of a parent's health status gets transmitted to their children. Once we add additional mediators to the model, we show that education, and particularly children's education, is an important transmission channel in that it reduces the IHA by one third. Finally, we show that estimates of the IHA from nonlinear models are only moderately higher than those from linear models, whereas rank-based mobility estimates are identical.

10.1002/hec.3988.abstractZh: 社会科学家长期以来一直记录到，诸如收入和教育等社会经济地位的许多组成部分在不同世代之间存在着紧密的联系。然而，健康状况作为福利中更为关键的组成部分，却很大程度上被忽视了。我们通过提供基于非线性潜在变量模型的代际健康关联度估计，填补了这一空白。我们开发了一种用于非线性模型的估计方法，该模型具有分类结果，其中潜在指标是一个混合线性模型，并包含可能在横截面单位内不变化的协变量。仅调整年龄和性别因素后，我们估计出代际健康关联度为0.3，这意味着父母健康状况的约三分之一会传递给子女。一旦我们在模型中加入额外的中介因素，我们发现教育，尤其是儿童的教育，是一个重要的传递渠道，它可以将代际健康关联度降低三分之一。最后，我们表明，从非线性模型得到的代际健康关联度估计值仅比从线性模型得到的估计值略高一些，而基于排名的流动性估计值则完全相同。

abstract.text: This study provides evidence on the impact of physical education on child body weight, cognitive, and noncognitive achievement using data from the Early Child Longitudinal Survey Kindergarten Class of 2010-2011 (ECLS-K: 2011). Students in the 2011 cohort were exposed to increased accountability pressures by No Child Left Behind, yet average weekly physical education time has not decreased from that reported in studies using the original ECLS-K class of 1998-1999. We instrument for teacher-reported weekly PE time using state physical education laws and exploit the panel design of the data to estimate individual fixed effects models to address concerns of endogeneity. We find time spent in physical education has essentially no effect on child body weight or human capital outcomes of U.S. elementary school children.

10.1002/hec.3990.abstractZh: 本研究通过2010-2011年幼儿纵向调查幼儿园班级的数据，探讨了体育教育对儿童体重、认知能力及非认知能力的影响。2011年的研究对象面临《不让一个孩子掉队》法案带来的更高问责压力，但每周的体育教育时间并未如1998-1999年原始调查所报告的那样减少。我们通过州级体育教育法规来量化教师报告的每周体育教育时间，并利用数据组的设计来估计个体固定效应模型，以解决内生性问题。研究发现，参与体育教育的时间对美国小学生的体重或人力资本成果几乎没有影响。

abstract.text: Facing steadily rising health care costs, Switzerland introduced a system of diagnosis-related groups (DRGs) for hospital payment in 2012 (SwissDRG) along with cost-efficiency benchmarking between hospitals. On the one hand, SwissDRG puts hospitals at financial risk and strengthens incentives for efficiency by setting a fixed price per case. On the other hand, hospitals are incentivized to game the system and exploit adverse incentives. We investigate hospitals' behavioral response to financial incentives in Swiss neonatology. First, we provide strong evidence for manipulations of reported birth weight among low-birth-weight newborns. Using a difference-in-difference-in-difference design, we find that 14-27% of birth weights are manipulated around specific birth weight cutoffs. Second, we find evidence of an upward-sloping supply curve of cheating, indicating that hospitals increasingly engage in fraudulent behavior as financial incentives increase. Our estimates indicate a supply-sided price elasticity of cheating between 0.16 and 0.52.

10.1002/hec.3991.abstractZh: 面对不断上升的医疗保健成本，瑞士在2012年引入了诊断相关组系统（SwissDRG）来规范医院支付，同时建立了医院之间的成本效率对比机制。一方面，SwissDRG使医院面临财务风险，并通过设定每例病例的固定价格来强化效率提升的激励措施。另一方面，医院被激励去操纵这一系统，利用不正当的激励措施谋取利益。我们研究了瑞士新生儿科医院对财务激励的行为反应。首先，我们有强有力的证据表明，低出生体重新生儿的出生体重数据被人为操纵。通过差异-差异-差异设计，我们发现有14-27%的出生体重数据在特定阈值附近被操纵。其次，我们发现作弊行为的供应曲线呈上升趋势，表明随着财务激励的增加，医院越来越倾向于采取欺诈行为。我们的估计表明，作弊行为的价格弹性在0.16到0.52之间。

abstract.text: We study the effect of state medical marijuana laws (MMLs) on workers' compensation (WC) claiming among adults. Medical marijuana is plausibly related to WC claiming by allowing improved symptom management, and thus reduced need for the benefit, among injured or ill workers. We use data on claiming drawn from the Annual Social and Economic supplement to the Current Population Survey over the period 1989 to 2012, coupled with a differences-in-differences design to provide the first evidence on this relationship. Our estimates show that, post MML, WC claiming declines, both the propensity to claim and the level of income from WC. These findings suggest that medical marijuana can allow workers to better manage symptoms associated with workplace injuries and illnesses and, in turn, reduce need for WC. However, the reductions in WC claiming post MML are very modest in size.

10.1002/hec.3992.abstractZh: 我们研究了州级医用大麻法律对成年人工伤赔偿索赔的影响。医用大麻能够通过改善症状管理，从而减少工伤或疾病工人的福利需求，因此与工伤赔偿索赔之间存在关联。我们利用了1989年至2012年间《当前人口调查》年度社会与经济补充数据，并结合差异差异设计方法，首次证实了这种关系。我们的估计结果显示，在实行医用大麻法律后，工伤赔偿的索赔数量有所下降，无论是索赔的倾向还是获得的赔偿金额都有所减少。这些发现表明，医用大麻可以帮助工人更好地管理与工作场所受伤和疾病相关的症状，从而减少工伤赔偿的需求。然而，医用大麻法律实施后的工伤赔偿索赔减少幅度非常有限。

abstract.text: Policymakers in the U.S. have expressed the hope that reducing payments from pharmaceutical companies to physicians will result in lower drug expenditures by reducing branded prescribing. This paper analyzes how the overall use and charges for generic and branded prescriptions change in an inpatient setting after a physician has had a payment from a pharmaceutical company reduced or cut off entirely. This research analyzes the impact of a pharmaceutical company cutting speaking payments to physicians in order to use fewer physicians more often, so the removal of payments is unrelated to a change in the company's product offering. Using hospital discharge data from New Jersey, this research employs a within-physician differences-in-differences design and finds that physicians who have payments reduced do not alter the number of or charges for prescriptions relative to unpaid physicians, neither do physicians who have their payments cut off but are still being paid by other pharmaceutical companies. Physicians who have their payments cut but who are not being paid by other companies, however, increase in the charges for and number of prescriptions written (both branded and generic) relative to their unpaid peers.

10.1002/hec.3993.abstractZh: 美国的政策制定者希望，通过减少制药公司向医生支付的费用，可以降低药品支出，从而减少品牌药物的处方使用。本文分析了在医生从制药公司获得支付减少或完全被切断后，住院环境中非品牌药物和品牌药物的整体使用情况和费用变化。本研究探讨了制药公司减少向医生支付费用以更频繁地利用较少的医生所带来的影响，这种支付方式的改变与公司的产品供应变化无关。利用新泽西州的医院出院数据，本研究采用了“医生内部差异-差异设计”，发现支付减少的医生与非支付医生的处方数量和费用没有变化，而被切断支付但仍由其他制药公司支付的医生也是如此。然而，被削减支付但不再由其他公司支付的医生，其开具的品牌和非品牌药物的处方数量和费用却有所增加。

abstract.text: The Netherlands is one of the few countries that offer generous universal public coverage of long-term care (LTC). Does this ensure that the Dutch elderly with similar care needs receive similar LTC, irrespective of their income? In contrast with previous studies of inequity in care use that relied on a statistically derived variable of needs, our paper exploits a readily available, administrative measure of LTC needs stemming from the eligibility assessment organized by the Dutch LTC assessment agency. Using exhaustive administrative register data on 616,934 individuals aged 60 and older eligible for public LTC, we find a substantial pro-poor concentration of LTC use that is only partially explained by poorer individuals' greater needs. Among those eligible for institutional care, higher-income individuals are more likely to use-less costly-home care. This pattern may be explained by differences in preferences, but also by their higher copayments for nursing homes and by greater feasibility of home-based LTC arrangements for richer elderly. At face value, our findings suggest that the Dutch LTC insurance "overshoots" its target to ensure that LTC is accessible to poorer elderly. Yet, the implications depend on the origins of the difference and one's normative stance.

10.1002/hec.3994.abstractZh: 荷兰是少数几个提供广泛全民长期护理保障的国家之一。这是否意味着，无论收入如何，荷兰的老年人都能获得类似的长期护理服务？与以往基于统计需求变量研究的不平等护理使用问题不同，我们的论文利用了荷兰长期护理评估机构组织的资格评估中获得的易于获取的行政数据来衡量长期护理需求。通过对616,934名60岁及以上有资格享受公共长期护理服务的个体进行详尽分析，我们发现长期护理使用的分布明显偏向贫困人群，这一现象部分可以通过贫困人群的需求更强烈来解释。在那些有资格接受机构护理的人群中，高收入者更可能选择成本较低的居家护理。这种模式可能由偏好差异解释，也可能由他们为养老院支付更高的费用以及富裕老年人更易于实施居家长期护理安排等因素导致。从表面上看，我们的研究结果表明，荷兰的长期护理保险确实在保障贫困老年人获得护理服务方面做得更为充分。然而，这一结论的含义取决于差异的来源以及个人的规范立场。

abstract.text: Child health is increasingly understood to be a critical form of human capital, but only recently have we begun to understand how valuable it is and how its development could be better supported. This article provides an overview of recent work that demonstrates the key role of public insurance in supporting longer term human capital development and points to improvements in child mental health as an especially important mechanism.

10.1002/hec.3995.abstractZh: 儿童健康越来越被理解为一种关键的人力资本形式，但直到最近我们才开始认识到它的价值以及如何更好地支持其发展。本文概述了最近的研究成果，这些研究表明公共保险在支持长期人力资本发展方面发挥着关键作用，并指出儿童心理健康方面的改善是一个尤为重要的机制。

abstract.text: The use of tertiary health care by socially proximate peers helps individuals learn about program and treatment procedures, signals that using such care is socially appropriate, and could support the use of formal health care, all of which could increase program utilization. Using complete administrative claims data from a publicly financed tertiary care program in India, we estimate that the elasticity of first-time claims with respect to claims by members of caste groups within the village is 0.046, with smaller effects of more socially distant individuals. The point elasticity of inpatient care expenditure with respect to claims filed by the same group in village peers in the previous quarter is - 0.035. We find support for an information channel as peers increase awareness of the program and its features. Our findings have implications for the development of network-based models to determine health-care demand, as well as in use of network-based targeting to boost tertiary health-care utilization.

10.1002/hec.3996.abstractZh: 社会亲近的同伴使用三级医疗保健，有助于个人了解相关程序和治疗方法，表明使用这种护理在社会上是合适的，并且可能促进正式医疗保健的使用，所有这些都可能增加项目的利用率。利用印度一项公共资助的三级护理项目的完整行政索赔数据，我们估计，首次索赔对村内同一种姓群体成员索赔的弹性为0.046，而距离较远个体的影响则较小。住院护理支出对前一季度村内同一群体同伴索赔的弹性为-0.035。我们发现，随着同伴对项目的了解加深，信息渠道起到了重要作用。我们的研究结果对开发基于网络的模型以确定医疗保健需求，以及利用基于网络的定位策略来提高三级医疗保健利用率具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Equipping health systems with suitable incentives for efficient resource allocation remains a major health policy challenge. This study examines the impacts of 2015 regulatory changes in Danish dental care which aimed at effectuating a transition from six-to-twelve-monthly dental recall intervals, for every patient, towards a model where patients with higher need receive dental recalls systematically more frequently than patients with lower need. Exploiting administrative data from the years 2012-2016 from the Danish National Health Insurance database containing 72,155,539 treatment claims for 3,759,721 unique patients, we estimated a series of interrupted time-series regression models with patient-level fixed-effects. In comparison to the pre-reform period, the proportion of patients with recall intervals of up to 6 months was by 1.2%-points larger post-implementation; that of patients with 6-12-monthly recalls increased by 0.7%-points; that of patients with more than 12-monthly dental recalls decreased by 1.9%-points. The composition of care shifted more substantially: the proportion of treatment sessions including preventive care increased by 31.5%-points (95%-CI: 31.4;31.6); that of sessions including scaling increased by 24.1%-points (24.0;24.2); that of sessions including diagnostics decreased by 34.5%-points (34.4;34.6). These findings suggest that dental care providers may have responded differently to regulatory changes than intended by the health policy.

10.1002/hec.3997.abstractZh: 为卫生系统配备合适的激励机制以实现资源的有效分配，仍然是卫生政策面临的主要挑战之一。本研究探讨了2015年丹麦牙科护理法规变更的影响，这些变更旨在将每位患者的牙科复查间隔从六个月改为十二个月，从而让需求较高的患者比需求较低的患者更频繁地接受牙科复查。我们利用丹麦国家健康保险数据库在2012年至2016年间收集的行政数据，该数据库包含72,155,539次治疗记录，涉及3,759,721名患者，建立了多个以患者为变量的时间序列回归模型。与改革前相比，实施改革后，复查间隔不超过6个月的患者比例增加了1.2个百分点；6至12个月复查的患者比例增加了0.7个百分点；而超过12个月复查的患者比例减少了1.9个百分点。护理服务的构成也发生了显著变化：包含预防保健的治疗次数比例增加了31.5个百分点（95%置信区间：31.4-31.6）；包含洁牙的治疗次数比例增加了24.1个百分点（24.0-24.2）；而包含诊断治疗的治疗次数比例减少了34.5个百分点（34.4-34.6）。这些发现表明，牙科护理提供者对法规变化的反应可能与卫生政策预期的不同。

abstract.text: Self-tests offer one approach for reducing frictions underlying low demand for preventive health inputs, yet there is little evidence on demand for self-tests. We used the Becker-DeGroot-Marschak mechanism-an incentive-compatible approach-to elicit exact willingness to pay (WTP) for HIV self-tests in a field experiment with 822 participants at 66 health clinics/pharmacies in Kenya. Our analysis reveals substantial demand at low prices and highly elastic demand at a wide range of prices above this range. We find few participants with nonpositive WTP. We examine correlates of WTP and discuss policy and research implications of our findings.

10.1002/hec.3998.abstractZh: 自我检测是一种减少预防性健康投入需求不足问题的途径，但关于自我检测需求的相关证据却很少。我们采用了Becker-DeGroot-Marschak机制——一种激励相容的方法——在肯尼亚的66个健康诊所/药店进行了一项实验，共有822名参与者参与。分析结果显示，在较低价格下存在较大的需求，而在高于该范围的多种价格下，需求则表现出高度弹性。我们发现很少有参与者对自我检测持负面态度。我们还研究了影响参与者对自我检测意愿的因素，并讨论了这些发现对政策和研究的启示。

abstract.text: The aim of this study was to document the extent to which diabetic patients who adhered to required medical follow-ups in France experienced reduced hospital admissions over time. The main assumption was that enhanced monitoring and follow-up of diabetic patients in the primary care setting could be a substitute for hospital use. Using longitudinal claim data of diabetic patients between 2010 and 2015 from MGEN, a leading mutuelle insurance company in France, we estimated a dynamic logit model with lagged measures of the quality of adherence to eight medical follow-up recommendations. This model allowed us to disentangle follow-up care in hospitals from other forms of inpatient care that could occur simultaneously. We found that a higher adherence to medical guidance is associated with a lower probability of hospitalization and that the take-up of each of the eight recommendations may help reduce the rates of hospital admission. The reasons for the variation in patient adherence and implications for health policy are discussed.

10.1002/hec.3999.abstractZh: 本研究旨在记录在法国，坚持接受必要医疗随访的糖尿病患者随时间推移住院次数的减少程度。主要假设是，在初级保健环境中加强对糖尿病患者的监测与随访，可以替代住院治疗。我们利用法国主要医疗保险公司MGEN在2010至2015年间收集的糖尿病患者的纵向数据，建立了一个动态逻辑模型，该模型考虑了八个医疗随访建议的遵守质量指标。该模型使我们能够区分医院中的随访护理与其他同时发生的住院护理。研究发现，更高的医疗指导遵守率与较低的住院概率相关，而八个建议中的每一项遵守都可能有助于降低住院率。研究还探讨了患者遵守程度差异的原因以及这对卫生政策的影响。

abstract.text: We study how demand for health insurance responds to family formation using a unique panel of young Australian women. Our data allow us to simultaneously control for the influence of state dependence and unobserved heterogeneity and detailed information on children and child aspirations. We find evidence that women purchase insurance in preparation for pregnancy but then transition out of insurance once they have finished family building. Children have a large, negative impact on demand for insurance, although this effect is smaller for those on higher incomes. We also find that state dependence has a large impact on insurance demand. Our results are robust to a variety of alternative modelling strategies.

10.1002/hec.4000.abstractZh: 我们研究了健康保险需求如何随着家庭形成而变化，使用了澳大利亚年轻女性的独特面板数据。我们的数据使我们能够同时控制州级依赖性和未观察到的异质性，以及关于子女和子女期望的详细信息。我们发现，女性会在怀孕前购买保险，但在完成家庭组建后就会退出保险市场。子女对保险需求有显著的负面影响，不过对于收入较高的人群来说，这种影响较小。我们还发现，州级依赖性对保险需求有较大的影响。我们的研究结果在采用多种不同的建模策略后仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of the accessibility of an older individual's house on her use of nursing home care. We link administrative data on the accessibility of all houses in the Netherlands to data on long-term care use of all older persons from 2011 to 2014. We find that older people living in more accessible houses are less likely to use nursing home care. The effects increase with age and are largest for individuals aged 90 or older. The effects are stronger for people with physical limitations than for persons with cognitive problems. We also provide suggestive evidence that older people living in more accessible houses substitute nursing home care by home care.

10.1002/hec.4001.abstractZh: 我们研究了老年个体住宅的可达性对其是否使用养老院护理的影响。我们将荷兰所有住宅的可达性行政数据与2011至2014年间所有老年人的长期护理使用数据进行了关联分析。研究发现，居住在更便利住宅的老年人使用养老院护理的可能性较低。这种影响随年龄增长而增强，且对于90岁及以上的个体影响最为显著。对于身体有障碍的人而言，这种影响比认知问题较多的人更为明显。此外，我们的研究还提供了一些线索，表明居住在更便利住宅的老年人可能会通过家庭护理来替代养老院护理。

abstract.text: To keep elder employees in the labour force, introducing age-dependent job conditions can be a policy measure. However, we know little about the effect of such initiatives. We investigate the effects of a particular programme in Norway that reduces the workload of teachers at age 55 but maintains the same wage. Evaluation of this programme is well suited to a difference-in-difference analysis, where the control group is teachers slightly too young to be eligible for the workload reduction. Using full population register data for the period 2006-2013, we analyse the effects of the programme on health as indicated by sickness absence and health care utilization. We find that whereas there is no effect among women, the workload reduction causes a decrease in sickness absence and an improvement in mental health among males. These results, which are robust to a placebo test, to extending the pretreatment period, and to dropping single birth cohorts, are driven by a subgroup of men whose prior health status is poor.

10.1002/hec.4002.abstractZh: 为了留住老年员工，引入基于年龄的Job条件可能是一种政策措施。然而，我们对这类举措的效果知之甚少。我们研究了挪威一项特定计划的效果，该计划减少了55岁教师的 workload，但保持相同的工资水平。对该计划的评估非常适合使用差异-差异分析，其中对照组是那些年龄稍小、不符合减少 workload条件的教师。利用2006-2013年的完整人口登记数据，我们分析了该计划对健康的影響，具体表现为病假天数和医疗保健使用率的变化。我们发现，虽然对女性没有影响，但workload的减少导致了男性病假天数的减少和心理健康状况的改善。这些结果在安慰剂测试、延长预处理期以及排除单胎出生队列的情况下仍然成立，这些结果主要源于那些先前健康状况较差的男性群体。

abstract.text: Alternative strategies can reduce road vehicle emissions, with differential effects on exposure across population groups. We compare alternative strategies in West Yorkshire using a framework for economic evaluation that considers multiple perspectives and that takes account of the distribution of health outcomes. Exposure to pollutants by area is converted, via dose response relationships, into disease averted. Health benefits and National Health Service costs from diseases are estimated conditional on population demographics and index of multiple deprivation. The net health benefits from alternative strategies are expressed as distributions of quality-adjusted life expectancy (QALE), which are compared using dominance criteria and societal aversion to health inequality. Net production is estimated from intervention costs and the effects of health improvement on production and consumption. Social care outcomes are estimated from health improvement among care recipients and changes in care expenditure. A switch to less polluting private vehicles is dominant in terms of the distribution of QALE and social care outcomes but not consumption. Inclusion of health inequality aversion alters the rank order compared with prioritisation on health maximisation. The results were sensitive to the magnitude of health opportunity costs, the level of inequality aversion, and the proportion of intervention cost that generates health opportunity cost.

10.1002/hec.4003.abstractZh: 替代策略可以减少道路车辆的排放，但对不同人群的影响各不相同。我们采用一种经济评估框架来比较西约克郡的替代策略，该框架考虑了多个角度，并考虑了健康结果的分布。通过剂量-反应关系，将各地区污染物暴露量转化为避免的疾病数量。健康效益和英国国民医疗服务体系因疾病而产生的成本，是根据人口统计数据和多重贫困指数来估算的。替代策略带来的净健康效益以质量调整预期寿命的分布形式表示，并通过优势标准和社会对健康不平等的厌恶程度来进行比较。净生产量是从干预成本以及健康改善对生产和消费的影响中估算出来的。社会护理结果则是根据护理接受者的健康改善情况以及护理支出的变化来估算的。在质量调整预期寿命和社会护理结果的分布方面，转向污染较少的私人车辆是占主导地位的策略，但在消费方面并非如此。考虑到健康不平等的厌恶程度，与优先考虑健康最大化相比，排名顺序发生了变化。研究结果受到健康机会成本的大小、不平等厌恶程度以及干预成本中用于产生健康机会成本的部分比例的影响。

abstract.text: Cost-effectiveness is traditionally treated as a static estimate driven by clinical trial efficacy and drug price at launch. Prior studies suggest that cost-effectiveness varies over the drug's lifetime. We examined the impact of "learning by doing," one of the least studied drivers of changes in cost-effectiveness across the product life cycle. We combined time-series trends in effectiveness over time by cancer regimen using the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results-Medicare database. We estimated the time-varying effects of treatments in colorectal and pancreatic cancer over their life cycle, including FOLFOX (leucovorin, 5-fluorouracil, and oxaliplatin) and gemcitabine, on survival of patients. Mean prices over time by strength and dosage form were calculated using historical wholesale acquisition costs. We found consistent downward trends in the mortality hazard ratios, which suggest that effectiveness improves over time. In the case of first-line FOLFOX for colorectal cancer, the implied incremental cost-effectiveness ratio based on the observational data fell from $610,000 per life year gained in 2004 to $27,000 per life year gained in 2011. Cost-effectiveness estimated at launch is unlikely to be representative of cost-effectiveness over the drug's lifetime. In the drugs studied, the impact of time-varying clinical effectiveness dominated the impact of changing prices overtime.

10.1002/hec.4004.abstractZh: 成本效益传统上被视为由临床试验效果和药物上市时的价格驱动的静态估计值。先前的研究表明，成本效益在药物整个生命周期内会发生变化。我们研究了“边做边学”这一在产品生命周期中变化成本效益的驱动因素，尽管这一因素研究较少。我们利用 Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results-Medicare数据库，通过癌症治疗方案的时间序列趋势来综合分析效果变化。我们估算了结直肠癌和胰腺癌治疗中随时间变化的疗效，包括FOLFOX（ leucovorin、5-氟尿嘧啶和奥沙利铂）和吉西他滨对病人生存期的效果。我们使用历史批发采购成本计算了不同规格和剂型的药物平均价格随时间的变化情况。我们发现死亡率风险比呈现出一致的下降趋势，这表明治疗效果随时间有所改善。以FOLFOX作为结直肠癌的一线治疗方案为例，基于观察数据得出的增量成本效益比率从2004年的每生命年增益610,000美元降至2011年的每生命年增益27,000美元。药物上市时的成本效益估计值不太可能代表药物整个生命周期内的成本效益。在所研究的药物中，随时间变化的临床效果对成本效益的影响超过了价格变化的影响。

abstract.text: Children starting school older consistently exhibit better educational outcomes. In this paper, we underscore child development as a mechanism driving this effect. Using unique administrative data on health examinations, we study the causal effect of school starting age (SSA) on a child's probability of being diagnosed with special educational needs in early grades. Results show that children with higher SSA are less likely to develop behavioral problems and speech impediments, whereas learning disabilities, ADHD, and dyslexia/dyscalculia remain unaffected. Importantly, these effects only arise after primary school entry and are not due to preexisting health conditions. We also find that teachers tend to over-refer relatively young children to special needs services, but this over-referring behavior is not driving the results, which are based on psychologists' diagnoses. The SSA effect persists throughout compulsory schooling, resulting in higher test scores and better quality vocational training contracts. However, SSA does not affect employment, earnings, or disability insurance benefits at labor market entry.

10.1002/hec.4005.abstractZh: 较早开始上学的儿童通常会有更好的教育成果。在本文中，我们强调儿童发展作为推动这一效应的机制。利用关于健康检查的独特行政数据，我们研究了入学年龄对儿童在小学阶段被诊断出有特殊教育需求的概率的影响。结果显示，入学年龄较高的儿童出现行为问题和言语障碍的可能性较低，而学习障碍、注意力缺陷多动障碍以及阅读障碍/计算障碍则不受影响。重要的是，这些效应仅在进入小学之后才出现，并非由先前的健康状况引起。我们还发现，教师倾向于将相对年幼的儿童过度推荐给特殊需求服务，但这种过度推荐行为并不是导致这些结果的因素，这些结果基于心理学家的诊断。入学年龄的效应在整个义务教育期间持续存在，导致测试成绩更高，职业培训合同的质量也更好。然而，入学年龄并不会影响劳动力市场的就业、收入或残疾保险福利。

abstract.text: When the Medicare Part D prescription drug benefit was implemented in 2006, six drug classes were designated "protected classes." Because responsibility for obtaining favorable drug prices depends on private insurers' abilities to negotiate with pharmaceutical manufacturers using the threat of formulary exclusion, the protected class designation could undermine the insurers' ability to control spending and utilization of drugs in these six classes. I estimate the effect of the protected class policy on U.S. national drug sales, utilization, and price using 2001-2010 IMS Health National Sales Perspectives data and Verispan Vector One: National data and controlling for drug and year fixed effects. I find that protected status beginning in 2006 led to $112-121 million per drug per year higher U.S. sales for drugs in protected classes relative to unprotected drugs. Greater sales were driven by the antidepressant, antipsychotic, anticonvulsant, and antineoplastic classes. Subsequent analyses on a subset of drugs reveal that increases in both price and quantity are responsible for the growth of sales in protected class drugs. These results are important for informing the recent and ongoing deliberation by the Medicare program over whether to remove several classes from protection.

10.1002/hec.4006.abstractZh: 当2006年Medicare Part D处方药福利实施时，有六类药物被指定为“受保护类别”。由于获得优惠药价的责任取决于私人保险公司能否通过威胁将药品排除在处方目录中来与制药商谈判，因此受保护类别的指定可能会削弱保险公司控制这些六类药品的使用和支出的能力。我利用2001-2010年IMS Health全国销售数据以及Verispan Vector One: 全国数据，并控制药品和年份的固定效应，估算了受保护类别政策对美国全国药品销售、使用量和价格的影响。研究发现，自2006年起，受保护类别的药品每年比未受保护的药品多销售1.12亿至1.21亿美元。销售额的增加主要出现在抗抑郁药、抗精神病药、抗惊厥药和抗肿瘤药类别中。后续对部分药品的分析表明，价格和数量的增加是受保护类别药品销售额增长的原因。这些结果对于了解Medicare计划近期及持续讨论中是否取消某些类别药品的保护措施具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper is the first to use the method of instrumental variables to estimate the impact of obesity and severe obesity in youth. on U.S. medical care costs. We examine data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey for 2001-2015 and instrument for child BMI using the BMI of the child's biological mother. Instrumental variables estimates indicate that obesity in youth raises annual medical care costs by $907 (in 2015 dollars) or 92%, which is considerably higher than previous estimates of the association of youth obesity with medical costs. We find that obesity in youth significantly raises costs in all major categories of medical care: outpatient doctor visits, inpatient hospital stays, and prescription drugs. The costs of youth obesity are borne almost entirely by third-party payers, which is consistent with substantial externalities of youth obesity, which in turn represents an economic rationale for government intervention.

10.1002/hec.4007.abstractZh: 本文首次采用工具变量方法，来估算青少年肥胖和严重肥胖对美国医疗费用的影响。我们采用了2001-2015年的医疗支出面板调查数据，并以儿童生母的体质指数作为工具变量。工具变量估计结果显示，青少年肥胖每年会导致907美元的医疗费用（以2015年美元计算），或增加92%的费用，这一数值远高于以往关于青少年肥胖与医疗费用关系的估计。我们发现，青少年肥胖显著增加了所有主要医疗类别的费用：门诊就诊、住院治疗和处方药费用。青少年肥胖带来的费用几乎完全由第三方支付机构承担，这与青少年肥胖带来的显著外部性相一致，这也为政府干预提供了经济上的依据。

abstract.text: This study compares the five-level EuroQol five-dimension questionnaire (EQ-5D-5L) crosswalks and the 5L value sets for England, the Netherlands, and Spain and explores the implication of using one or the other for the results of cost-utility analyses. Data from two randomized controlled trials in depression and diabetes were used. Utility value distributions were compared, and mean differences in utility values between the EQ-5D-5L crosswalk and the 5L value set were described by country. Quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) were calculated using the area-under-the-curve method. Incremental cost-effectiveness ratios (ICERs) were calculated, and uncertainty around ICERs was estimated using bootstrapping and graphically shown in cost-effectiveness acceptability curves. For all countries investigated, utility value distributions differed between the EQ-5D-5L crosswalk and 5L value set. In both case studies, mean utility values were lower for the EQ-5D-5L crosswalk compared with the 5L value set in England and Spain, but higher in the Netherlands. However, these differences in utility values did not translate into relevant differences across utility estimation methods in incremental QALYs and the interventions' probability of cost-effectiveness. Thus, our results suggest that EQ-5D-5L crosswalks and 5L value sets can be used interchangeably in patients affected by mild or moderate conditions. Further research is needed to establish whether these findings are generalizable to economic evaluations among severely ill patients.

10.1002/hec.4008.abstractZh: 本研究比较了英格兰、荷兰和西班牙的五种层次的EuroQol五维度问卷（EQ-5D-5L）交叉对照表以及5L价值集，探讨了使用其中一种对成本效用分析结果的影响。研究采用了两项针对抑郁症和糖尿病的随机对照试验的数据。比较了效用价值分布，并描述了EQ-5D-5L交叉对照表与5L价值集之间平均效用值的差异，以及这些差异在不同国家的情况。使用曲线下面积方法计算了质量调整生命年（QALYs）。同时计算了增量成本效益比（ICERs），并通过自举法估计了ICERs的不确定性，并以成本效益可接受性曲线形式进行图形展示。在所有被研究的国家中，EQ-5D-5L交叉对照表与5L价值集之间的效用价值分布存在差异。在两个案例研究中，英格兰和西班牙的EQ-5D-5L交叉对照表的平均效用值低于5L价值集，而在荷兰则较高。然而，这些效用值的差异并未转化为增量QALYs和干预措施成本效益概率方面的显著差异。因此，我们的结果表明，对于患有轻度或中度疾病的患者来说，EQ-5D-5L交叉对照表与5L价值集可以互换使用。需要进一步的研究来确定这些发现是否适用于重症患者的经济评估。

abstract.text: Skilled nursing facility (SNF) spending has been one of the fastest growing categories of Medicare spending over the past few decades, and reductions in SNF payments are often recommended as part of Medicare cost containment efforts. Using a quasi-experiment resulting from a policy-driven and facility-specific Medicare payment change, we provide new evidence on how Medicare payment changes affect the amount of SNF care provided to Medicare patients. Specifically, we examine a one-time, plausibly exogenous change in the hospital wage index, an area-level adjustment to SNF payments that affected the majority of SNFs nationwide. Using a panel dataset of SNFs, we model the effects of these payment changes on more than 12,000 SNFs across the United States. We find that increases in Medicare payment rates to SNFs increased the total number of Medicare resident days at SNFs. Specifically, a 5% payment increase raised Medicare resident days by 2.33% at facilities with a 10% Medicare share relative to 0%. Further, the effects were asymmetric: Although Medicare payment increases affected Medicare days, payment decreases did not. Our results have important implications for policies that alter the Medicare base payment rates to SNFs and other health care providers.

10.1002/hec.4009.abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，专业护理机构的支出一直是医疗保险支出中增长最快的类别之一，因此，减少专业护理机构的支付通常被推荐作为控制医疗保险成本的措施之一。通过一项由政策驱动且针对特定机构进行的医疗保险支付调整所引发的准实验研究，我们提供了新的证据，以了解医疗保险支付的变化如何影响为医疗保险患者提供的专业护理服务的数量。具体来说，我们研究了一个一次性、可能由外部因素引起的医院工资指数变化，这一对专业护理机构支付的影响较大的地区级调整，影响了全国大多数专业护理机构。利用一个包含美国超过12,000家专业护理机构的面板数据集，我们模拟了这些支付变化对它们的影响。我们发现，提高医疗保险对专业护理机构的支付率，增加了患者在这些机构中的总住院天数。具体而言，支付增加5%会使那些在医疗保险中占10%份额的机构的住院天数增加2.33%。此外，这种影响是 asymmetric的：虽然支付增加会影响住院天数，但支付减少则不会。我们的研究结果对于调整医疗保险对专业护理机构及其他医疗保健提供者的基础支付率的政策具有重要意义。

abstract.text: There is growing interest in using predictive analytics to drive interventions that reduce avoidable healthcare utilization. This study evaluates the impact of such an intervention utilizing claims from 2013 to 2017 for high-risk Medicare Advantage patients with congestive heart failure. A predictive algorithm using clinical and nonclinical information produced a risk score ranking for health plan members in 10 separate waves between July 2013 and May 2015. Each wave was followed by an outreach intervention. The varying capacity for outreach across waves created a set of arbitrary intervention treatment cutoff points, separating treated and untreated members with very similar predicted risk scores. We estimate a difference-in-differences model to identify the effects of the intervention program among patients with a high score on care utilization. We find that enrollment in the intervention decreased the probability and number of hospitalizations (by 43% and 50%, respectively) and emergency room visits (10% and 14%, respectively), reduced the time until a primary care visit (8.2 days), and reduced total medical cost by $716 per month in the first 6 months following outreach.

10.1002/hec.4010.abstractZh: 目前，人们越来越关注利用预测分析来推动减少可避免的医疗使用的干预措施。本研究评估了利用2013年至2017年的数据，针对患有充血性心力衰竭的高风险Medicare Advantage患者实施的此类干预措施的影响。一种结合临床与非临床信息的预测算法，在2013年7月至2015年5月期间，分10次为健康计划成员生成风险评分。每次评分后都进行了推广性干预。不同阶段的推广能力导致了一些人为的干预治疗截止点的出现，使得具有非常相似预测风险评分的受干预成员与未受干预成员之间产生了差异。我们通过差异-差异模型来识别干预计划对高风险患者的影响。研究发现，参与干预措施的患者住院概率和次数分别减少了43%和50%，急诊就诊次数分别减少了10%和14%。此外，患者到初级保健医生就诊的时间缩短了8.2天，在推广后的前6个月内，总医疗费用每月减少了716美元。

abstract.text: Variations in medical resource usage, both across and within geographical regions, have been widely documented. In this paper, we explore physician practice styles as a possible determinant of these variations. In particular, we exploit patient mobility between physicians to identify practice styles among general practitioners (GPs) in Austria. We use a large administrative data set containing detailed information on a battery of different health-care services and implement a model with additive patient and GP fixed effects that allows flexibly for systematic differences in patients' health states. We find that, although GPs explain only a small part of the overall variation in medical expenses, heterogeneities in spending patterns among GPs are substantial. Conditional on patient characteristics, we document a difference of € 751.47 per patient per year in total medical expenses (which amounts to roughly 45% of the sample mean) between high- and low-spending GPs.

10.1002/hec.4011.abstractZh: 关于医疗资源使用情况的差异，无论是在不同地理区域之间还是区域内，已有大量研究记录。本文探讨了医生执业风格作为这些差异的潜在决定因素。特别是，我们利用患者在不同医生之间的流动情况，来识别奥地利全科医生之间的执业风格差异。我们使用了包含各种医疗服务详细信息的庞大行政数据集，并构建了一个模型，该模型包含了患者和全科医生的固定效应，能够灵活地处理患者健康状况的系统差异。研究发现，尽管全科医生对整体医疗费用变化的解释力度较小，但全科医生之间的支出模式存在显著差异。在考虑患者特征的情况下，我们发现高支出与低支出全科医生之间的总医疗费用差异为每患者每年751.47欧元（约占样本平均值的45%）。

abstract.text: There is growing evidence on positive human capital impacts of large, poverty-focused cash transfer programs. However, evidence is inconclusive on whether cash transfer programs affect maternal health outcomes, and if so, through which pathways. We use a regression discontinuity design with an implicit threshold to evaluate the impact of Comunidades Solidarias Rurales in El Salvador on four maternal health service utilization outcomes: (a) prenatal care; (b) skilled attendance at birth; (c) birth in health facilities; and (d) postnatal care. We find robust impacts on outcomes at the time of birth but not on prenatal and postnatal care. In addition to income effects, supply-side health service improvements and gains in women's agency may have played a role in realizing these gains. With growing inequalities in maternal health outcomes globally, results contribute to an understanding of how financial incentives can address health systems and financial barriers that prevent poor women from seeking and receiving care at critical periods for both maternal and infant health.

10.1002/hec.4012.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，大规模、以减贫为目标的现金转移计划对人类资本有积极影响。然而，关于现金转移计划是否会影响孕产妇健康结果，以及如果影响，是通过哪些途径，目前尚无定论。我们采用回归不连续设计，并设定一个隐含的阈值，来评估萨尔瓦多“互助农村社区”计划对孕产妇健康服务利用的四个方面的影响：(a)产前护理；(b)熟练的助产服务；(c)在医疗机构分娩；(d)产后护理。我们发现，该计划对分娩时的健康结果产生了显著影响，但对产前和产后护理的影响并不明显。除了收入效应外，医疗服务供应的改善以及女性能力的提升也可能在实现这些成果中起到了作用。鉴于全球孕产妇健康结果的不平等现象日益严重，这些研究结果有助于理解如何通过经济激励措施来解决阻碍贫困妇女在孕产妇和婴儿健康关键时期寻求和获得护理的卫生系统和经济障碍。

abstract.text: In August 2012, the Arizona Department of Health Services conducted a lottery to allocate licenses for the state's first medical marijuana dispensaries. The lottery randomly selected an applicant within each of 69 contested Community Health Analysis Areas to open a dispensary. By comparing 36 zip codes with winning applications to 48 zip codes with losing applications and weighting using propensity scores based on the true probability of winning, we estimate the causal effect of the allocation of a dispensary on the emergency room visits of residents of that zip code. Outcomes of interest are emergency room visits for acute symptoms caused by cannabis, opioids, alcohol, and cocaine. Using emergency room discharge data from 2010 to 2016, we find evidence of an increase in visits for acute cannabis-related causes for the winning set of zip codes and weak evidence of an increase in visits for opioid-related causes. The results indicate that in the four years following the lottery, emergency room visits for acute cannabis causes rose by approximately 45% in allocated zip codes relative to non-allocated zip codes. Because of the high likelihood of spillovers to neighboring zip codes, these effects are likely underestimates.

10.1002/hec.4013.abstractZh: 2012年8月，亚利桑那州卫生服务部通过抽签方式分配了该州首批医用大麻诊所的许可证。抽签结果在69个有争议的社区健康分析区域中各随机选出一名申请人来开设诊所。通过对比36个获得许可的邮政编码区域与48个未获得许可的邮政编码区域，并基于获胜的真实概率使用倾向评分进行加权分析，我们估算了诊所分配对该邮政编码区域居民急诊就诊次数的因果效应。研究关注的指标是由大麻、阿片类药物、酒精和可卡因引起的急性症状的急诊就诊次数。利用2010至2016年的急诊出院数据，我们发现获得许可的邮政编码区域的急性大麻相关原因的就诊次数有所增加，而阿片类药物相关原因的就诊次数则增长不明显。结果表明，在抽签后的四年里，获得许可的邮政编码区域的急性大麻相关原因的急诊就诊次数增加了约45%，而非获得许可的邮政编码区域则没有这样的增长。由于这些效应很可能会扩散到邻近的邮政编码区域，因此这些结果可能低估了实际效应。

abstract.text: Open enrollment periods are pervasively used in insurance markets to limit adverse selection risks resulting when enrollees can switch plans at will. We exploit a change in the open enrollment rules of Medicare Advantage to analyze how beneficiaries responded to the option of switching to a 5-star-rated plan at anytime, in a setting where insurers adjusted premiums and benefit design to counterbalance the increased selection risk. We present three findings: Within-year switches to 5-star plans increase by 7-16%; demand for 5-star plans across the years does not decline; and the enrollees who switch to a 5-star plan during the year are in better health status than those who do not switch.

10.1002/hec.4014.abstractZh: 在保险市场中，开放注册期被广泛使用，以限制因参保人可随意更换计划而产生的逆向选择风险。我们分析了Medicare Advantage的开放注册规则变化，研究了受益人对于随时更换为5星级计划的反应。在这一过程中，保险公司调整了保费和福利设计，以平衡增加的筛选风险。我们的研究发现有三点：年内更换为5星级计划的比例增加了7-16%；5星级计划的需求在多年间并未下降；在年内更换为5星级计划的参保人的健康状况优于未更换的参保人。

abstract.text: Policies aiming to spur quality competition among health care providers are ubiquitous, but their impact on quality is ex ante ambiguous, and credible empirical evidence is lacking in many contexts. This study contributes to the sparse literature on competition and primary care quality by examining recent competition enhancing reforms in Sweden. The reforms aimed to stimulate patient choice and entry of private providers across the country but affected markets differently depending on the initial market structure. We exploit the heterogeneous impact of the reforms in a difference-in-differences strategy, contrasting more and less exposed markets over the period 2005-2013. Although the reforms led to substantially more entry of new providers in more exposed markets, the effects on primary care quality were modest: We find small improvements of patients' overall satisfaction with care, but no consistently significant effects on avoidable hospitalisation rates or satisfaction with access to care. We find no evidence of economically meaningful quality reductions on any outcome measure.

10.1002/hec.4015.abstractZh: 旨在促进医疗服务提供者之间质量竞争的政策普遍存在，但这些政策对质量的影响在事前是模糊的，许多情况下缺乏可靠的实证证据。本研究通过考察瑞典最近实施的促进竞争的改革，为关于竞争与初级医疗质量关系的稀少文献做出了贡献。这些改革旨在刺激患者选择并增加私人提供者的进入，但不同初始市场结构对改革的影响各不相同。我们采用差异-差异策略，对比2005-2013年期间更多暴露市场和较少暴露市场的情况，以分析改革的异质影响。尽管改革导致更多暴露市场出现更多新提供者，但对初级医疗质量的影响较为有限：我们发现患者整体满意度略有提升，但并未对可避免的住院率或就医满意度产生显著影响。我们没有发现任何具有经济意义的质量下降证据。

abstract.text: This study exploits a natural experiment in Scotland where the legal blood alcohol content (BAC) limit was reduced from 0.8 to 0.5 mg per 100 ml of blood while staying constant in all other parts of the United Kingdom. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that this change in the BAC level had no impact on either traffic accident or fatality rates.

10.1002/hec.4016.abstractZh: 本研究利用了苏格兰的一项自然实验，该实验中将法定血液酒精含量限制从0.8毫克/100毫升降低到0.5毫克/100毫升，而在英国其他地区的限制保持不变。通过差异-差异设计，我们发现这一酒精含量限制的变化对交通事故发生率或死亡率都没有影响。

abstract.text: This paper offers an approach to assessing quality of life, based on Sen's (1985) theory, which it uses to understand loss in quality of life due to mobility impairment. Specifically, it provides a novel theoretical analysis that is able to account for the possibility that some functionings may increase when a person's capabilities decrease, if substitution effects are large enough. We then develop new data consistent with our theoretical framework that permits comparison of quality of life between those with a disability (mobility impairment) and those without. Empirical results show that mobility impairment has widespread rather than concentrated impacts on capabilities and is associated with high psychological costs. We also find evidence that a small number of functionings are higher for those with a disability, as our theory allows. The paper concludes by discussing possible implications for policy and health assessment methods.

10.1002/hec.4017.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于Sen（1985年）理论来评估生活质量的方法，该理论用于理解由于行动能力受损而导致的生活质量下降。具体而言，本文提出了一种新颖的理论分析，能够解释当一个人的能力下降时，某些功能可能会增强的情况，前提是替代效应足够显著。随后，我们开发了新的数据，这些数据与我们的理论框架一致，可以用来比较有残疾者（行动能力受损者）与无残疾者之间的生活质量。实证结果表明，行动能力受损对能力的影响较为广泛，而非集中在某些方面，并且与较高的心理成本相关。我们还发现，根据我们的理论，有残疾者的某些功能确实会高于无残疾者。本文最后讨论了这些发现对政策及健康评估方法的可能影响。

abstract.text: Quality report cards addressing information asymmetry in the health care market have become a popular strategy used by policymakers to improve the quality of care for older people. Using individual level data from the largest German sickness fund merged with institutional level data, we examine the relationship between reported nursing home quality, as measured by recently introduced report cards, nursing home prices, nursing home's location, and the individual choice of nursing homes. Report cards were stepwise introduced as of 2009, and we use a sample of 2010 that includes both homes that had been evaluated at that time and that had not yet been. Thus, we can distinguish between institutions with above and below average ratings as well as nonrated nursing homes. We find that the probability of choosing a nursing home decreases in distance and price. However, we find no economically significant effect of reported quality on individuals' choice of nursing homes.

10.1002/hec.4018.abstractZh: 关于医疗保健市场中的信息不对称问题的质量报告卡已成为政策制定者用来提高老年人护理质量的一种常用策略。我们利用德国最大疾病基金提供的个人层面数据，并结合机构层面的数据，研究由最新推出的报告卡所衡量的养老院质量、养老院价格、养老院的位置以及个人对养老院的选择之间的关系。自2009年起，报告卡逐步开始使用，我们选取了2010年的样本数据，其中包括当时已经接受评估的养老院和尚未接受评估的养老院。因此，我们可以区分那些评分高于或低于平均水平的养老院以及未获得评分的养老院。研究发现，选择养老院的概率随着距离和价格的增加而降低。然而，我们发现报告的质量对个人的养老院选择并没有显著的经济影响。

abstract.text: In social insurance systems that grant workers paid sick leave, physicians act as gatekeepers, supposedly granting sickness certificates to the sick and not to shirkers. Previous research has emphasized the physician's superior ability to judge patients' need of treatment and potential collusion with the patient vis-á-vis an insurer. What is less well understood is the role of patients' private information. We explore the case where patients have private information about the presence of nonverifiable symptoms. Anyone can then claim to experience such symptoms, reducing physicians' ability to distinguish between sick patients and shirkers. Doubting a patients' reported symptoms may prevent good medical treatment of the truly sick. We show that for all parameter values, the Bayesian Nash equilibrium is that some physicians trust all claims of nonverifiable symptoms, sicklisting shirkers as well as sick; for many values, every physician is trusting. In particular, if physician strategies are observable by patients, extremely strong gatekeeping preferences are required to make physicians mistrust. To limit unwarranted sicklisting, policies reducing the benefits of shirking for healthy workers may be better suited than attempts to convince physicians to be strict.
