10.1002/hec.4019.abstractZh: 在提供带薪病假的社会保险体系中，医生扮演着把关者的角色，他们通常只向患病者发放病假证明，而不会给予不遵守规定的人员。先前的研究强调了医生在判断患者治疗需求以及可能与患者勾结方面所具有的优势。然而，患者私人信息的作用却尚未得到充分理解。我们探讨了患者拥有关于不可验证症状私人信息的情况，在这种情况下，任何人都可以声称自己有此类症状，从而削弱了医生区分患病患者与不遵守规定的人员的能力。对病人报告的症状持怀疑态度可能会阻碍对真正患病者的有效治疗。我们证明，在所有参数取值下，贝叶斯纳什均衡状态是部分医生相信所有关于不可验证症状的声明，从而将不遵守规定的人员以及患病者都列入病假名单；对于许多参数值，每位医生都持有这种信任态度。特别是，如果医生的策略可以被患者观察到，那么需要极其强烈的把关偏好才能让医生产生不信任。为了限制不必要的病假申请，减少健康工人因不遵守规定而获得的福利的政策，可能比试图说服医生严格执行规定更为有效。

abstract.text: Many opioid control policies target the prescribing behavior of health care providers. In this paper, we study the first comprehensive state-level policy requiring providers to access patients' opioid history before making prescribing decisions. We compare prescribers in Kentucky, which implemented this policy in 2012, to those in a control state, Indiana. Our main difference-in-differences analysis uses the universe of prescriptions filled in the two states to assess how the information provided affected prescribing behavior. We find that a significant share of low-volume providers stopped prescribing opioids altogether after the policy was implemented, though this change accounted for a small share of the reduction in total volume. The most important margin of response was to prescribe opioids to fewer patients. Although providers disproportionately discontinued treating patients whose opioid histories showed the use of multiple providers, there were also economically meaningful reductions for patients without multiple providers and single-use acute patients.

10.1002/hec.4020.abstractZh: 许多阿片类药物控制政策都针对医疗保健提供者的处方行为。在本文中，我们研究了首个要求提供者在做出处方决策前了解患者阿片类药物历史的综合性州级政策。我们将肯塔基州（该州于2012年实施该政策）的处方者与印第安纳州的控制组进行了比较。我们的主要差异分析使用了两个州中完成的处方数量来评估所提供信息对处方行为的影响。我们发现，在实施该政策后，相当一部分低处方量提供者完全停止了阿片类药物的处方，尽管这一变化仅减少了总处方量的一小部分。最重要的变化是减少了阿片类药物的处方对象。虽然提供者中有很大一部分人停止了对那些有多次处方者患者的治疗，但对于没有多次处方者和单次急性发病的患者来说，也出现了具有经济意义的减少。

abstract.text: To date most studies of the impact of school-based sex education have focused either on specific, local interventions or experiences at a national level. In this paper, we use a new cross-country dataset to explore the extent to which laws on sex education affect teenage pregnancy rates in developed countries. We find some evidence that laws mandating sex education in schools are associated with higher rates of teenage fertility. Parental opt out laws may minimise adverse effects of sex education mandates for younger teens. The estimated effects of mandatory sex education are robust to some but not all of our specifications designed to tease out causality. Taken together, changes in national laws relating to sexual health are unable to explain the significant declines in teenage pregnancy rates, which have been observed in many developed countries in recent years.

10.1002/hec.4021.abstractZh: 迄今为止，关于学校性教育影响的研究大多集中在特定的地方性干预措施或国家层面的经验上。在本文中，我们使用一个新的跨国数据集来探讨性教育法律对发达国家青少年怀孕率的影响程度。我们发现，一些证据表明，要求学校进行性教育的法律与较高的青少年生育率有关。家长选择不参加性教育的情况可能会减轻对年轻青少年实施性教育规定的负面影响。尽管我们采用了一些但并非所有旨在明确因果关系的模型，但强制性性教育的影响仍然较为稳定。综合来看，与性健康相关的国家法律的变化无法解释近年来许多发达国家青少年怀孕率显著下降的现象。

abstract.text: We adopt an empirical approach to analyse, measure and decompose inequality of opportunity (IOp) in health, based on a latent class model. This addresses some of the limitations that affect earlier work in this literature concerning the definition of types, such as partial observability, the ad hoc selection of circumstances, the curse of dimensionality and unobserved type-specific heterogeneity that may lead to biased estimates of IOp. We apply our latent class approach to measure IOp in allostatic load, a composite measure of biomarker data. Using data from Understanding Society: The UK Household Longitudinal Study (UKHLS), we find that a latent class model with three latent types best fits the data, with the corresponding types characterised in terms of differences in their observed circumstances. Decomposition analysis shows that about two thirds of the total inequalities in allostatic load can be attributed to the direct and indirect contribution of circumstances and that the direct contribution of effort is small. Further analysis conditional on age-sex groups reveals that the relative (percentage) contribution of circumstances to the total inequalities remains mostly unaffected and the direct contribution of effort remains small.

10.1002/hec.4022.abstractZh: 我们采用实证方法，基于潜在类模型来分析、测量并分解健康领域的机会不平等（IOp）。这解决了早期研究在定义类型时遇到的某些限制，例如部分可观测性、情境的临时选择、维度诅咒以及未观察到的类型特异性异质性，这些因素可能导致IOp估计的偏差。我们应用潜在类模型来测量全态负荷中的机会不平等，全态负荷是一种基于生物标志物数据的综合衡量指标。利用《理解社会：英国家庭纵向研究》的数据，我们发现一个包含三种潜在类型的潜在类模型最适合数据，这些类型在观察到的情境上存在差异。分解分析显示，全态负荷中约三分之二的不平等可以归因于情境的直接和间接影响，而努力的直接贡献较小。进一步分析年龄-性别分组的结果表明，情境对总不平等的相对（百分比）贡献基本保持不变，而努力的直接贡献仍然较小。

abstract.text: Cost-sharing is regarded as an important tool to reduce moral hazard in health insurance. Contrary to standard prediction, however, such requirements are found to decrease utilization both of efficient and of inefficient care. I employ a simple model that incorporates two possible explanations-consumer mistakes and limited access-to assess the welfare implications of different insurance designs. I find cost-sharing never to be an optimal solution as it produces two novel inefficiencies by limiting access. An alternative design, relying on bonuses, has no such side effects and achieves the same incentivization. I show how the optimal design can be deduced empirically and discuss possible impediments to its implementation.

10.1002/hec.4023.abstractZh: 费用分担被视为减少健康保险中道德风险的重要工具。然而，与标准预测相反，这种要求反而会降低对高效和低效医疗服务的利用。我采用了一个简单的模型，该模型考虑了两种可能的解释——消费者错误和有限的可及性，以评估不同保险设计下的福利影响。我发现，费用分担从来都不是最优解决方案，因为它通过限制可及性而产生了两种新的低效现象。另一种依赖奖金的设计则没有这些副作用，并且能够实现相同的激励效果。我展示了如何通过实证方法推导出最优设计方案，并讨论了其实施可能遇到的障碍。

abstract.text: This study examines whether taxes on unhealthy food are suitable for internalizing intergenerational externalities inflicted by parents when they decide on their children's diet. In an overlapping generations (OLG) model with an imperfectly altruistic parent, the optimal steady-state tax rate on unhealthy food is strictly positive. However, it is only second-best because, in addition to reducing unhealthy consumption by the child, it distorts the parent's unhealthy consumption. Surprisingly, the optimal tax may underinternalize or overinternalize the marginal damage.

10.1002/hec.4024.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了对不健康食品征税是否适合内部化父母在决定子女饮食时所造成的代际外部性。在一个存在不完全利他行为的父母的重叠世代模型中，对健康食品征收的最优稳态税率严格为正。然而，这种征税只是次优的，因为除了减少子女的不健康消费外，它还会扭曲父母自身的不健康消费行为。令人惊讶的是，最优税率可能会低估或高估边际损害。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of raising the State Pension age on women's health. Exploiting a UK pension reform that increased women's State Pension age for up to 6 years since 2010, we show that raising the State Pension age leads to an increase of up to 12 percentage points in the probability of depressive symptoms, alongside an increase in self-reported medically diagnosed depression among women in a lower occupational grade. Our results suggest that these effects are driven by prolonged exposure to high-strain jobs characterised by high demands and low control. Effects are consistent across multiple subcomponents of the General Health Question and Short-Form-12 (SF-12) scores, and robust to alternative empirical specifications, including "placebo" analyses for women who never worked and for men.

10.1002/hec.4025.abstractZh: 本文探讨了提高国家养老金领取年龄对女性健康的影响。通过分析英国自2010年以来实施的养老金改革，该改革将女性的国家养老金领取年龄提高了6年，我们发现提高国家养老金领取年龄会导致女性抑郁症状发生的概率增加12个百分点，同时低职业等级女性的自我诊断抑郁症比例也有所上升。研究结果表明，这些影响是由长期从事高压力工作所引发的，这类工作的要求高但控制力低。这些影响在一般健康状况问卷和简短健康问卷（SF-12）的多个子指标中均得到体现，并且即使采用其他实证分析方法，这些结果依然稳定，包括对从未工作过的女性和男性的“安慰剂”分析。

abstract.text: Self-assessed health is one of the most commonly used health measures by economists. However, changes in self-assessed health are not always accompanied by changes in physical health as measured by clinical outcomes. This study provides suggestive evidence that this discrepancy arises because self-assessed health is significantly influenced by psychological factors. Specifically, when the perceived risk of Affordable Care Act (ACA) repeal increased, as documented by Google Trends data, self-assessed health declined among low-income childless adults living in states that expanded Medicaid under the ACA.

10.1002/hec.4026.abstractZh: 自我评估的健康状况是经济学家最常使用的健康指标之一。然而，自我评估的健康状况变化并不总是伴随着通过临床结果衡量的身体健康状况的变化。本研究提供了一些线索，表明这种差异的出现是因为自我评估的健康状况受到心理因素的显著影响。具体来说，当根据谷歌趋势数据记录的《平价医疗法案》废除风险增加时，生活在根据《平价医疗法案》扩大医疗补助计划的州的低收入无子女成年人的自我评估健康状况会下降。

abstract.text: Integration of behavioral and general medical care can improve outcomes for individuals with behavioral health conditions-serious mental illness (SMI) and substance use disorder (SUD). However, behavioral health care has historically been segregated from general medical care in many countries. We provide the first population-level evidence on the effects of Medicaid health homes (HH) on behavioral health care service use. Medicaid, a public insurance program in the United States, HHs were created under the 2010 Affordable Care Act to coordinate behavioral and general medical care for enrollees with behavioral health conditions. As of 2016, 16 states had adopted an HH for enrollees with SMI and/or SUD. We use data from the National Survey on Drug Use and Health over the period 2010 to 2016 coupled with a two-way fixed-effects model to estimate HH effects on behavioral health care utilization. We find that HH adoption increases service use among enrollees, although mental health care treatment findings are sensitive to specification. Further, enrollee self-reported health improves post-HH.

10.1002/hec.4027.abstractZh: 将行为医疗与常规医疗相结合可以改善患有行为健康问题的个体——包括严重精神疾病和物质使用障碍患者——的预后。然而，在许多国家，行为医疗与常规医疗历来是分开的。我们首次提供了关于医疗补助健康之家对行为医疗服务使用影响的群体级证据。医疗补助是美国的一项公共保险计划，而健康之家则是在2010年《平价医疗法案》下设立的，旨在为患有行为健康问题的参保者协调行为医疗与常规医疗服务。截至2016年，已有16个州为患有严重精神疾病和/或物质使用障碍的参保者设立了健康之家。我们利用了2010至2016年的《全国药物使用与健康调查》数据，并结合双向固定效应模型来估算健康之家对行为医疗服务利用的影响。研究发现，设立健康之家的做法确实增加了参保者的服务使用，不过心理健康治疗的结果对模型参数设定较为敏感。此外，参保者在入住健康之家后的健康状况也有所改善。

abstract.text: We examine how patient numerical ratings and specific words in written reviews of family physicians and internists in the states of California and Florida differ based upon concierge doctor status. Data are drawn from Healthgrades.com, one of the largest providers of online reviews, and a machine-learning sentiment analysis is used to determine the predictors of concierge status and numerical patient ratings. We find that reviews of concierge doctors are more likely to contain technical words associated with health care, such as "staff" and "office," compared with traditional physicians. In contrast, interpersonal bedside-manner words, like "listen" or "concerns," are most likely in reviews for nonconcierge doctors. We further determine that, whereas interpersonal words exhibit both positive and negative effects on numerical ratings, technical terms seem to primarily correlate negatively with patient scores for all doctors. The present work represents a first step towards understanding the measures of quality of care that relate with the patient experience, and in particular with respect to the growing field of concierge medicine. It is also the first attempt we are aware of that employs sentiment analysis in this context.

10.1002/hec.4028.abstractZh: 我们研究了加利福尼亚州和佛罗里达州的家庭医生和内科医生在书面评价中的患者数值评分以及特定词汇，这些差异与顾问医生身份有关。数据来自Healthgrades.com，这是最大的在线评价提供商之一，我们使用机器学习情感分析来确定顾问身份和患者数值评分的预测因素。我们发现，顾问医生的评价更可能包含与医疗保健相关的技术词汇，如“员工”和“办公室”，而传统医生的评价则更可能包含人际互动的词汇，如“倾听”或“关心”。此外，我们发现，虽然人际词汇对数值评分既有正面影响也有负面影响，但技术术语似乎主要与所有医生的患者评分呈负相关。本研究是理解与患者体验相关的护理质量衡量标准的第一步，特别是在不断发展的顾问医学领域。这也是我们所知首次在这一背景下使用情感分析的研究。

abstract.text: As economic evaluation becomes increasingly essential to support universal health coverage (UHC), we aim to understand the growth, characteristics, and quality of cost-effectiveness analyses (CEA) conducted for Africa and to assess institutional capacity and relationship patterns among authors. We searched the Tufts Medical Center CEA Registries and four databases to identify CEAs for Africa. After extracting relevant information, we examined study characteristics, cost-effectiveness ratios, individual and institutional contribution to the literature, and network dyads at the author, institution, and country levels. The 358 identified CEAs for Africa primarily focused on sub-Saharan Africa (96%) and interventions for communicable diseases (77%). Of 2,121 intervention-specific ratios, 8% were deemed cost-saving, and most evaluated immunizations strategies. As 64% of studies included at least one African author, we observed widespread collaboration among international researchers and institutions. However, only 23% of first authors were affiliated with African institutions. The top producers of CEAs among African institutions are more adherent to methodological and reporting guidelines. Although economic evidence in Africa has grown substantially, the capacity for generating such evidence remains limited. Increasing the ability of regional institutions to produce high-quality evidence and facilitate knowledge transfer among African institutions has the potential to inform prioritization decisions for designing UHC.

10.1002/hec.4029.abstractZh: 随着经济评估在支持全民健康覆盖方面变得越来越重要，我们旨在了解为非洲进行的成本效益分析的发展、特点和质量，并评估机构能力以及作者之间的关系模式。我们搜索了塔夫茨医学中心的成本效益分析登记册和四个数据库，以识别非洲的相关分析。在提取相关信息后，我们研究了研究特点、成本效益比率、个人和机构对文献的贡献，以及作者、机构和国家层面的网络关系。在识别出的358项非洲成本效益分析中，大部分集中在撒哈拉以南非洲（96%）和传染病干预措施上（77%）。在2,121项特定干预措施的成本效益比率中，有8%被认为具有成本节约效果，大多数分析集中在免疫策略上。由于64%的研究至少有一位非洲作者参与，我们观察到国际研究人员和机构之间的广泛合作。然而，只有23%的第一作者隶属于非洲机构。在非洲机构中，那些遵循方法和报告指南最多的机构是成本效益分析的主要提供者。尽管非洲的经济证据已经大幅增长，但生成此类证据的能力仍然有限。提高区域机构产生高质量证据的能力，并促进非洲机构之间的知识转移，有助于为设计全民健康覆盖计划做出优先决策。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the relation between adherence to prescribed medication and reduction of cholesterol in Italy, taking into account the possible sorting of patients into treatment and the heterogeneity of the effect. As predicted by a theoretical model, I find that patients who benefit most from medication are more likely to adhere to prescribed regime than those who benefit least. These results are used to study the effects of three hypothetical policies that aim at increasing the share of patients adherent to prescribed medication: one policy is directed toward patients, one toward physicians, and one toward both patients and physicians. For each policy, I describe the observable characteristics of patients induced into treatment. Although the policy with the highest return is directed toward patients, the policies differ substantially with respect to the population affected. Therefore, a policy with lower return that targets better the desired population may be preferred to the policy with the highest return.

10.1002/hec.4030.abstractZh: 本文研究了意大利患者遵循处方用药与胆固醇降低之间的关系，同时考虑了患者可能被分类到不同治疗组的可能性以及治疗效果的异质性。根据理论模型的预测，我发现从药物治疗中获益最大的患者更有可能遵循处方用药方案，而那些获益最小的患者则不太可能如此。这些结果被用来研究三种旨在提高患者遵循处方用药比例的政策的效果：一种政策针对患者，一种针对医生，还有一种则同时针对患者和医生。对于每种政策，我描述了被诱导接受治疗的患者可观测的特征。尽管回报最高的政策是针对患者的，但不同政策对受影响人群的影响却大相径庭。因此，相比回报最高的政策，针对目标人群更精准、回报较低的策略可能更受青睐。

abstract.text: This paper studies whether geographic barriers can influence nonadherence to prescription drugs and its effect on patients' health. We used a multivariate probit model estimated by maximum simulated likelihood that considers individual unobserved heterogeneity, which may characterize the relationship between adherence, medical care utilization, and health outcome. We used administrative data from Liguria, Italy, the region with the highest rate of individuals over the age of 65 in Europe. Our sample included older individuals affected by cardiovascular diseases, which remain one of the leading causes of death in most OECD countries. Our results showed that geographic barriers to pharmacies negatively influence patients' adherence. According to our results, patients' nonadherence to pharmacological therapy is responsible for an increased probability of patients' mortality and the overuse of other medical services, namely, hospitalizations and emergency department visits. Nonadherence may thus represent a potential source of waste for the health care system.

10.1002/hec.4031.abstractZh: 本文研究地理障碍是否会影响患者对处方药的依从性，以及这种不依从性对患者健康的影响。我们采用了一种多变量Probit模型，该模型通过最大模拟似然法进行估计，考虑了个体未观察到的异质性，这些异质性可能表征了依从性、医疗服务利用与健康结果之间的关系。我们使用的数据来自意大利利古里亚地区，该地区是欧洲65岁以上人口比例最高的地区。我们的样本包括患有心血管疾病的高龄人群，而心血管疾病仍然是大多数经合组织国家的主要死因之一。研究结果表明，地理障碍对药店的访问产生了负面影响，从而降低了患者的依从性。根据我们的研究结果，患者不遵守药物治疗规定会导致患者死亡率增加，并导致其他医疗服务的过度使用，如住院和急诊就诊。因此，不依从性可能成为医疗系统的潜在浪费来源。

abstract.text: We use a simple model to study the static and dynamic efficiency of alternative regulation regimes for the reimbursement of medical innovations when responses to a new treatment (effectiveness) are heterogeneous across the eligible population. When the rational behavior of profit-maximizing firms is taken into account, only average value-based prices can ensure both static and dynamic efficiency, but they imply higher expenditure and lower consumer surplus. Ignoring dynamic efficiency, if patients' responses are sufficiently homogeneous, marginal value-based prices may dominate from the payer's perspective. We also present a refinement of average value-based prices that could reverse this result. Overall, the cost of ensuring static and dynamic efficiency is increasing in the degree of heterogeneity. A real-world example is used to illustrate these results.

10.1002/hec.4033.abstractZh: 我们使用一个简单的模型来研究在患者对新型治疗的反应（有效性）在不同人群中存在异质性时，不同监管机制在静态和动态效率方面的表现。当考虑到追求利润最大化的企业的理性行为时，只有基于平均价值的定价才能同时保证静态和动态效率，但这会导致更高的支出和更低的消费者剩余。如果忽略动态效率，且患者的反应足够同质，那么从支付方的角度来看，基于边际价值的定价可能会占据主导地位。我们还提出了一种改进的平均价值定价方法，该方法可能能够逆转这一结果。总体而言，确保静态和动态效率的成本随着异质性的增加而增加。文中通过一个现实世界的例子来说明这些结果。

abstract.text: While earned income tax credit (EITC) expansions are typically associated with improvements in maternal mental health, little is known about the mechanisms through which the program affects this outcome. The EITC could primarily affect mental health through changes in family financial resources, changes in labor supply or changes in health insurance coverage of participants. We attempt to disentangle these mechanisms by assessing the effects of state and federal EITC expansion on mental health, employment, and health insurance by maternal marital status. We find that federal EITC expansions are associated with improved self-reported mental health for all mothers and large positive effects on employment for unmarried mothers. State EITC expansions are associated with improvements in mental health for married mothers only and have no effect on employment for married or unmarried mothers. Overall and for most subgroups of mothers, we find little association between EITC expansions and changes in health insurance coverage. These findings suggest that while EITC expansions improved mental health for unmarried mothers through a combination of the credit and employment effects, for married mothers, improved mental health is driven through the direct credit alone.

10.1002/hec.4034.abstractZh: 虽然收入所得税抵免政策的扩大通常与母亲心理健康状况的改善有关，但关于该政策如何影响这一结果的机制，目前了解甚少。收入所得税抵免政策可能主要通过改变家庭财务资源、劳动力供应或参与者的健康保险覆盖情况来影响心理健康。我们试图通过评估州和联邦层面收入所得税抵免政策扩大对母亲心理健康、就业状况以及健康保险的影响，来梳理这些机制。研究发现，联邦层面的收入所得税抵免政策扩大与所有母亲的自我报告心理健康状况改善有关，并对未婚母亲的就业状况产生显著积极影响。而州级层面的收入所得税抵免政策扩大则仅对已婚母亲的心理健康状况有所改善，对已婚或未婚母亲的就业状况没有影响。总体而言，对于大多数母亲群体而言，收入所得税抵免政策扩大与健康保险覆盖变化之间几乎没有关联。这些发现表明，虽然收入所得税抵免政策扩大通过抵免政策和就业效应的结合改善了未婚母亲的心理健康状况，但对于已婚母亲来说，心理健康的改善主要依赖于抵免政策本身的效果。

abstract.text: We study the effect of ageing, defined as an extra year of life, on health care utilisation. We disentangle the direct effect of ageing, from other alternative explanations such as the presence of comorbidities and endogenous time to death (TTD) that are argued to absorb the effect of ageing (so-called 'red herring' hypothesis). We exploit individual level end of life data from several European countries that record the use of medicine, outpatient and inpatient care and long-term care. Consistently with the 'red herring hypothesis', we find that corrected TTD estimates are significantly different from uncorrected ones, and their effect size exceeds that of an extra year of life, which in turn is moderated by individual comorbidities. Corrected estimates suggest an overall attenuated effect of ageing, which does not influence outpatient care utilisation. These results suggest the presence of 'more than one red herring' depending on the type of health care examined.

10.1002/hec.4035.abstractZh: 我们研究了老龄化对医疗保健利用的影响，老龄化被定义为每多活一年。我们区分了老龄化的直接效应与其他可能的解释，例如合并症的存在和内生性死亡时间（TTD），这些因素被认为会抵消老龄化的影响（所谓的“红鲱鱼假说”）。我们利用几个欧洲国家的个人死亡末期数据，这些数据记录了药物使用、门诊和住院护理以及长期护理的情况。与“红鲱鱼假说”一致，我们发现修正后的死亡时间估计值与未修正值有显著不同，其效应大小超过了每多活一年的效应，而后者又受到个体合并症的调节。修正后的估计表明，老龄化的整体影响有所减弱，这并不影响门诊护理的利用。这些结果表明，根据所研究的医疗保健类型，可能存在“不止一个红鲱鱼因素”。

abstract.text: Payers are increasingly calling for the value of new drugs to be measured explicitly. We analyze how the availability of drug quality ratings by health technology assessment (HTA) agencies affects the adoption of new drugs by physicians in Germany. We combine data from drug quality ratings, promotional spending, and a physician panel. In a latent utility model, time to adoption is specified as a function of quality rating, promotional spending by manufacturers, and physician-specific variables. As expected, drugs with a positive rating were adopted faster (p < 0.001) than those without. However, our results suggest that it was the publication of the quality rating itself that affected adoption. Indeed, before a quality rating was published, drugs that went on to receive a positive quality rating were not adopted significantly faster than drugs that went on to receive a negative quality rating. In contrast, after the publication of the HTA quality rating, drugs with a positive rating were adopted significantly faster than those without (p < 0.05). The per physician value of a positive quality rating was EUR 393.50. Our results suggest that there are returns from HTAs beyond their use in price negotiations.

10.1002/hec.4108.abstractZh: 越来越多的支付方要求明确衡量新药的价值。我们分析了德国健康技术评估机构提供的药品质量评级对医生采用新药的影响。我们结合了药品质量评级数据、宣传支出数据以及医生样本数据。在潜在效用模型中，采用时间被确定为质量评级、制造商宣传支出以及医生特定变量的函数。正如预期的那样，获得正面评级的药物比没有正面评级的药物采用得更快（p < 0.001）。然而，我们的研究结果表明，影响采用的是质量评级本身的发布。实际上，在质量评级发布之前，获得正面评级的药物与获得负面评级的药物相比，采用速度并没有显著加快。相反，在HTA质量评级发布之后，获得正面评级的药物比没有正面评级的药物采用得更快（p < 0.05）。每位医生因获得正面质量评级而获得的收益为393.50欧元。我们的研究结果表明，HTA的作用不仅限于价格谈判，还带来了其他方面的回报。

abstract.text: In the last two decades, many European countries allowed the sale of over-the-counter (OTC) drugs outside pharmacies. This was expected to lower retail prices through increased competition. Evidence of such price reductions is scarce. We assess the impact of supermarket and outlet entry in the OTC drug market on OTC prices charged by incumbent pharmacies using a difference-in-differences strategy. We use price data on five popular OTC drugs for all retailers located in Lisbon for three distinct points in time (2006, 2010, and 2015). Our results suggest that competitive pressure in the market is mainly exerted by supermarkets, which charge, on average, 20% lower prices than pharmacies. The entry of a supermarket among the main competitors of an incumbent pharmacy is associated with an average 4% to 6% decrease in prices relative to the control group. These price reductions are long-lasting but fairly localized. We find no evidence of price reductions following OTC outlet entry. Additional results from a reduced-form entry model and a propensity score matching difference-in-differences approach support the view that these effects are causal.

10.1002/hec.4109.abstractZh: 在过去的二十年里，许多欧洲国家允许非处方药在药店外销售。人们预期这种竞争方式会降低零售价格。然而，关于价格下降的实际证据却很少。我们采用差异-差异策略，评估了超市和零售店进入非处方药市场对现有药店收费的影响。我们收集了里斯本地区五种常见非处方药的零售价格数据，并选取了三个不同的时间点（2006年、2010年和2015年）进行分析。研究结果表明，市场上的竞争压力主要来自超市，超市的收费平均比药店低20%。超市进入现有药店的主要竞争对手后，价格平均下降4%至6%。这些价格下降是长期存在的，且范围较为局限。我们没有发现非处方药零售店进入后价格下降的证据。此外，通过简化进入模型以及倾向得分匹配差异-差异策略得出的额外结果也支持这些效应具有因果关系的观点。

abstract.text: We evaluate the relationship between hospital ownership and responses to a policy providing large financial incentives for vaginal deliveries and financial disincentives for C-sections. We compare for-profit, nonprofit, and public hospitals operating in a public health care system organized according to the quasi-market model. We first theoretically show that hospital ownership matters insofar different hospitals are characterized by different ethical preferences. We also show that competition makes ownership less important. We then consider the case study of Lombardy in Italy. We exploit spatial variation in hospital ownership and in market concentration at the local level to evaluate the relationship between ownership and the probability of C-section. According to theory, empirical results strongly suggest that competitive pressures from alternative providers tend to homogenize behaviors. However, in local monopolies, in presence of a strong monetary incentive toward vaginal deliveries, we do observe less C-section from private for-profit hospitals than from public and private nonprofit hospitals, especially when C-sections are medically appropriate.

10.1002/hec.4110.abstractZh: 我们评估了医院所有权与政策反应之间的关系，该政策为阴道分娩提供大量经济激励，而对剖宫产则施加经济抑制。我们对比了在准市场模式下运营的营利性、非营利性和公立医院。首先，我们从理论上表明，医院所有权确实起作用，因为不同医院具有不同的伦理偏好。我们还指出，竞争使得所有权的重要性降低。随后，我们以意大利伦巴第大区为例进行研究。我们利用医院所有权和当地市场集中度的空间差异，来评估所有权与剖宫产概率之间的关系。根据理论预测，实证结果强烈表明，来自其他提供者的竞争压力倾向于使行为趋同。然而，在存在强烈经济激励促进阴道分娩的地方，我们确实观察到，在医学上适宜的情况下，私立营利性医院所实施的剖宫产数量少于公立和私立非营利性医院。

abstract.text: Our article deals with pricing strategies in Swiss health insurance markets and focuses on the relationship between basic and supplementary insurance. We analyzed how firms' pricing strategies (i.e., pricing of basic and supplementary products) can create switching costs in basic health insurance markets, thereby preventing competition in basic insurance from working properly. More specifically, using unique market and survey data, we investigated whether firms use bundling strategies or supplementary products as low-price products to attract and retain basic insurance consumers. To our knowledge, this is the first paper to analyze these pricing strategies in the context of insurance/health insurance. We found no evidence of bundling in the Swiss setting. We did however observe that firms used low-price supplementary products that contributed to lock in consumers. A majority of firms offered at least one of such product at a low price. None offered low-price products in both basic and supplementary markets. Low-price insurance products differed across firms. When buying a low-price supplementary product, consumers always bought their basic contract from the same firm. Furthermore, those who opted for low-price supplementary products were less likely to declare an intention to switch basic insurance firms in the near future. This result was true for all risk category levels.

10.1002/hec.4111.abstractZh: 我们的文章探讨了瑞士健康保险市场的定价策略，重点关注基础保险与补充保险之间的关系。我们分析了企业的定价策略（即基础产品和补充产品的定价方式）如何在基础健康保险市场中产生转换成本，从而阻碍基础保险市场的正常竞争。更具体地说，我们利用独特的市场数据和调查数据，研究了企业是否通过捆绑策略或提供低价补充产品来吸引和留住基础保险消费者。据我们所知，这是第一篇从保险/健康保险的角度分析这些定价策略的论文。我们在瑞士的案例中并未发现捆绑行为的证据。不过，我们观察到企业确实使用了低价补充产品来锁定消费者。大多数企业至少提供了一种低价产品。但在基础市场和补充市场，没有企业同时提供低价产品。不同企业的低价保险产品也有所不同。当消费者购买低价补充产品时，他们总是从同一家企业购买基础保险合约。此外，选择低价补充产品的消费者在未来短期内转换基础保险公司的意愿较低。这一结果适用于所有风险等级。

abstract.text: Managed entry agreements (MEAs) have been used for several years, with the aim of curbing the growth of pharmaceutical expenditure and enhancing patient access to innovation. Yet, much remains to be understood about their economic implications. This paper studies the impact of MEAs on list prices, that is, prices before the deduction of any discount. Using a theoretical model, we show that, under most price setting regimes, the introduction of an MEA leads to a higher list price. This is confirmed by our empirical analysis of a sample of 156 medicines in six countries, providing a conservative estimate of the increase in price due to the MEA of 5.9%. A relevant policy implication is that payers may overestimate the financial gains that can be achieved through this tool.

10.1002/hec.4112.abstractZh: 管理性进入协议（MEAs）已使用多年，其目的是控制药品支出的增长并提升患者获得创新产品的机会。然而，关于这些协议的经济影响仍有许多需要了解的地方。本文研究了MEAs对标价的影响，即扣除任何折扣前的价格。通过理论模型分析，我们发现，在大多数定价机制下，引入MEAs会导致标价上升。我们对六个国家中156种药品的样本进行的实证分析也证实了这一点，估计由于MEAs导致的价格上涨为5.9%。一个相关的政策启示是，支付方可能会高估通过这一工具可以获得的财务收益。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the negotiation process, which leads to basic research funding and price setting for new drugs in regulated health insurance markets. Its results bring answers to the following questions: Should basic research be privately funded, publicly funded, or produced by an independent lab? Under which conditions is public integration of basic research efficient? How do pharmaceutical prices respond to different organizations of basic research? We show that efficiency and prices are higher when basic research is integrated in the firm that commercializes the drug as compared with independent basic research. In both organizations, the higher the negotiation power of the research labs relative to the one of the public health authority is, the higher the prices and the efficiency are. We thereby confirm the traditional trade-off between price containment and dynamic efficiency. We identify one important exception to this trade-off. Indeed, public integration of basic research can result in lowest prices and highest efficiency, as compared with the other possible organizations, in particular when basic and applied research are highly complementary.

10.1002/hec.4113.abstractZh: 本文分析了在受监管的健康保险市场中，导致新药基础研究资金分配和定价过程的谈判过程。研究结果回答了以下问题：基础研究应该由私人机构、公共机构还是独立实验室来资助？在何种条件下，公共机构整合基础研究更为有效？药品价格如何因基础研究的组织方式而不同？研究表明，当基础研究整合到药品商业化企业中时，效率与价格均高于独立进行基础研究的情况。在两种组织中，研究实验室相对于公共健康管理部门的谈判能力越强，价格与效率就越高。这进一步证实了价格控制与动态效率之间的传统权衡关系。不过，我们发现了一种重要的例外情况：当基础研究与应用研究高度互补时，公共机构整合基础研究能够带来最低的价格和最高的效率。

abstract.text: The number of undocumented migrants in high-income countries has increased in recent decades, imposing considerable political, fiscal, and social pressures on governments. This has fostered discussions on whether and to what extent undocumented migrants should get access to public programs and public benefits. Looking at the 2012 Spanish health reform, this is the first paper to document the impacts of a restriction on access to the health-care system for undocumented migrants on health-care utilization, health-care system perceptions, and self-reported health in a high-income country. We show that such restrictions may significantly reduce planned care for undocumented migrants and result in sharp fall in positive opinions about the health-care services still left available to them. We also exploit the heterogeneity in implementing the policy across regions and report stronger effects in regions that enforced the national ban more fully. Furthermore, in the first 3 years since the implementation of the reform, we find suggestive evidence of a worsening in self-assessed health. This study is relevant for policymakers in the developed world, especially in countries that have recently implemented initiatives aimed at reducing the health-care coverage for targeted groups, such as the United Kingdom and the United States.

10.1002/hec.4115.abstractZh: 近年来，高收入国家的无证移民数量有所增加，给政府带来了巨大的政治、财政和社会压力。这引发了关于无证移民是否以及在多大程度上应获得公共项目和公共福利的讨论。以2012年的西班牙医疗改革为例，本文首次记录了在高收入国家中，对无证移民限制其就医权利对医疗利用、医疗系统认知以及他们自我报告的健康状况的影响。研究表明，此类限制可能会显著减少无证移民的就医计划，并导致他们对仍然可用的医疗服务的积极评价大幅下降。此外，我们还发现，在政策实施过程中，不同地区的效果存在差异，在政策执行更为严格的地区，这种影响更为明显。此外，在改革实施后的前三年里，我们发现无证移民的自我评估健康状况有所恶化。这项研究对于发达国家政策制定者具有参考价值，尤其是那些最近实施了旨在减少特定群体医疗覆盖率的政策的国家，如英国和美国。

abstract.text: Low-income pregnant women have been Medicaid eligible since the 1980s, but the Affordable Care Act (ACA)'s expansion of Medicaid to women preconception has the potential to improve pregnancy and birth outcomes by removing delays in Medicaid enrollment. More substantially, the ACA expanded subsidized nongroup maternity coverage. Pre-ACA, nongroup health insurance had generally excluded maternity coverage and was prohibitively expensive for low-income individuals, but the ACA's creation of the Marketplace made maternity coverage mandatory and provides income-based subsidies. I use a simulated eligibility approach to measure how these two aspects of the ACA impacted pregnancy and birth outcomes for first-time mothers, paying special attention to racial-ethnic differences. I find expanding Medicaid to women prior to pregnancy significantly improves the share of women with a prenatal care visit in the first trimester for non-Hispanic Whites and Blacks. Expansions in non-Medicaid subsidized insurance, such as Marketplace insurance, significantly reduce the share of births paid by Medicaid and increased breastfeeding across all racial and ethnic groups. Neither type of subsidized insurance had significant, robust impacts on birth outcomes.

10.1002/hec.4116.abstractZh: 自20世纪80年代以来，低收入孕妇一直有资格享受医疗补助计划。然而，《平价医疗法案》将医疗补助计划扩展到孕前妇女，有可能通过减少医疗补助的注册延迟来改善妊娠和分娩结果。更重要的是，《平价医疗法案》还扩大了非团体孕产妇保险的范围。在《平价医疗法案》之前，非团体健康保险通常不包括孕产妇保险，且对低收入人群来说价格过高。但《平价医疗法案》通过创建市场平台使孕产妇保险成为强制性的，并提供了基于收入的补贴。我采用模拟资格的方法来衡量《平价医疗法案》这两个方面对首次生育的母亲妊娠和分娩结果的影响，特别关注种族和族裔差异。我发现，将医疗补助计划扩展到孕前妇女，显著提高了非西班牙裔白人和黑人在孕早期接受产前护理的比例。而非医疗补助保险方面的扩展，如市场平台保险，则显著降低了由医疗补助支付的分娩比例，并增加了所有种族和族裔群体的母乳喂养率。这两种补贴保险类型对分娩结果的影响并不显著。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between changes in income inequality and the provision of resources in a health care system (the public-private mix). Specifically, we investigate whether increases in income inequality, as separate from overall income levels and growth, have changed the availability of both private clinics and privately financed physicians in a context where the dominant market player is the public system. Our findings provide reasonable evidence that increases in income inequality have led to substantial increases in both. We find that moving from median level of inequality across neighborhoods to the top 1% level of inequality increases the probably of a private clinic by 40% and the probability of having physicians who have opted out of the public system by 170%.

10.1002/hec.4117.abstractZh: 本文探讨了收入不平等的变化与医疗保健系统资源配置之间的关系，特别是公共与私人部门混合模式下的情况。具体而言，我们研究了收入不平等的加剧——与整体收入水平和增长无关——是否改变了私人诊所和私人执业医生的可用性，尤其是在主要市场参与者为公共系统的背景下。我们的研究提供了合理的证据，表明收入不平等的加剧确实导致了这两种资源的显著增加。研究发现，从社区层面的中位数不平等水平到1%最高收入群体的不平等水平，私人诊所的可用性增加了40%，而选择脱离公共系统的医生的比例则增加了170%。

abstract.text: We estimate the short-term effects of paid sick leave on worker absenteeism and health care utilization in the United States using data from the 2000-2013 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey. We use both parametric and matching-based difference-in-differences methods to account for nonrandom selection into jobs that offer paid sick leave and estimate the treatment effect separately for workers who gained and lost sick leave benefits. We find consistent evidence of increased absenteeism among female workers who gained paid sick leave but not for other groups. Estimates for office-based visits are mostly statistically insignificant and may not have a causal interpretation due to preexisting trends.

10.1002/hec.4118.abstractZh: 我们利用2000-2013年医疗支出调查的数据，估算了带薪病假对美国工人缺勤率和医疗利用率的短期影响。我们采用了参数方法和基于匹配的差异中差异方法，以解释获得带薪病假工作的非随机性，并分别估算了获得和失去病假福利的工人的治疗效果。研究发现，获得带薪病假的女性工人缺勤率确实有所增加，而其他群体则没有这种趋势。关于门诊就诊的估计结果大多在统计上不显著，且由于先前的趋势影响，可能不具备因果解释意义。

abstract.text: In this paper, we explore the effects of primary care physician (PCP) practice competition on five distinct quality metrics directly tied to screening, follow-up care, and prescribing behavior under Medicare Part B and D. Controlling for physician, practice, and area characteristics as well as zip code fixed effects, we find strong evidence that PCP practices in more concentrated areas provide lower quality of care. More specifically, PCPs in more concentrated areas are less likely to perform screening and follow-up care for high blood pressure, unhealthy bodyweight, and tobacco use. They are also less likely to document current medications. Furthermore, PCPs in more concentrated areas have a higher amount of opioid prescriptions as a fraction of total prescriptions.

10.1002/hec.4119.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了初级保健医生执业竞争对五个与筛查、随访护理和处方行为直接相关的质量指标的影响，这些指标均受Medicare Part B和D的约束。在控制医生、执业地点和地区特征以及邮政编码固定效应后，我们发现，在更为集中的地区，初级保健医生的服务质量较低。具体而言，这些地区的初级保健医生不太可能进行高血压、不健康体重和烟草使用的筛查和随访护理，也不太可能记录患者当前的用药情况。此外，这些地区的初级保健医生所开的阿片类药物处方占总处方数量的比例较高。

abstract.text: Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a highly inheritable condition with a rather stable prevalence over time and geography, and it is associated with a broad range of negative life outcomes. Increasing knowledge on the condition has led to a growing trend of dampening ADHD symptoms through medication. Although this development has led to many positive outcomes, the broader societal implications are still poorly understood. In particular, person-level studies suggest that ADHD-like behavior may possess some advantages for engaging in entrepreneurship and the initiation of new businesses, which is considered a key activity for economic development. Using recent panel data from 11 countries and one special administrative region (SAR), we investigate if the increasing use of ADHD medication in adults is associated with an unintended outcome of reducing entrepreneurship. We find that a roughly one unit increase in the prevalence of adult ADHD medication is associated with a one unit decrease in limited liability company registrations per working age population. In practical terms, the effect of a one within-country/SAR standard deviation increase of adult ADHD medication prevalence corresponds to a decrease in new business formation of 20% of its mean in the sample.

10.1002/hec.4120.abstractZh: 注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）是一种具有高度遗传性的疾病，其患病率的地理分布随时间保持稳定，并且与多种负面生活结果相关。随着对该疾病了解的增加，越来越多的研究开始尝试通过药物来减轻ADHD症状。虽然这一发展带来了许多积极的影响，但其对社会的更广泛影响仍不清楚。特别是，个体层面的研究表明，类似ADHD的行为可能有助于创业和新企业的创立，而创业被认为是经济发展的重要活动。我们利用来自11个国家和一个特别行政区的最新面板数据，研究成人ADHD药物使用增加是否会导致创业能力的下降。研究发现，成人ADHD药物使用增加约一个单位，会导致工作年龄人口中有限责任公司注册数量减少一个单位。实际上，一个国家/特别行政区范围内成人ADHD药物使用增加一个标准差，会导致新企业成立数量减少20%。

abstract.text: It is often argued that the increased labor market participation of seniors threatens family support provided to dependent elderly people. The purpose of this paper is to assess the causal effect of retirement on the frequency of care provided by individuals aged 55-69 years to their elderly parent. Using data from the Survey of Health, Aging and Retirement in Europe (SHARE), we estimate an endogenous switching model that allows the retirement effect to be heterogeneous with respect to observed and unobserved characteristics. To tackle the possible endogeneity of selection into retirement, we use the heterogeneity of retirement rules between and within European countries. On average, being retired does not significantly impact the probability of providing care but significantly increases the frequency of care conditional on being caregiver. The same pattern is observed regardless of the individual observed characteristics, even if the provision of informal care appears to be less sensitive to the retirement status when the child cannot rely on the other parent to provide care or when both parents are in poor health. These results suggest that pension system reforms should not affect the number of caregivers. Some adverse effects on the intensity of involvement among caregivers are nevertheless expected.

10.1002/hec.4121.abstractZh: 人们常常认为，老年人劳动力市场的参与度增加会威胁到对老年父母提供的家庭支持。本文旨在评估退休对55-69岁个体对其老年父母提供护理频率的因果效应。利用欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查的数据，我们建立了一个内生转换模型，该模型允许退休效应在观察到的和未观察到的特征方面具有异质性。为了解决退休选择的内生性问题，我们利用了欧洲国家之间及国家内部的退休规则异质性。平均而言，退休并不会显著影响提供护理的概率，但显著增加了作为护理者的频率。无论个体观察到的特征如何，这一模式都保持不变，即使在非正式护理方面，当子女无法依赖另一方父母提供护理或当双方父母健康状况不佳时，退休状态对护理提供的敏感性似乎较低。这些结果表明，养老金制度改革不应影响护理者的数量。不过，预计会对护理者的参与强度产生一些负面影响。

abstract.text: Since the ratification of the World Health Organization Framework Convention on Tobacco Control in 2004, Pakistan has made modest but continued progress in implementing various tobacco control measures. By 2014, substantial progress was achieved in areas of monitoring, mass media antitobacco campaigns, and advertising bans. However, the findings from the 2014 Global Adult Tobacco Survey of Pakistan show significant differences in antitobacco campaign exposure among individuals of different educational attainment. Given this large variation in noticing antitobacco information, this paper analyzes how heterogeneity in treatment exposure may differentially impact tobacco-use prevalence across household groups. Household-level tobacco-use prevalence in 2014 was, respectively, 56% and 48% for the low- and high-education households. The gap in tobacco-use prevalence between the two educational groups further widens post 2014. We find that, on average, individuals with higher than primary education are 14 percentage points and 6 percentage points more likely to notice anticigarette and antismokeless tobacco information in 2014, respectively. Subsequently, in 2016, high-education households experienced a 3.6 percentage point higher reduction in tobacco-use prevalence compared to the low-education households. These findings motivate policies to enhance the outreach of tobacco control measures across different educational groups.

10.1002/hec.4122.abstractZh: 自2004年《世界卫生组织烟草控制框架公约》获得批准以来，巴基斯坦在实施各种烟草控制措施方面取得了一些进展。到2014年，在监测、大众媒体反烟草宣传以及广告禁令等方面取得了显著进展。然而，2014年巴基斯坦全球成人烟草调查的结果显示，不同教育水平的个体在接触反烟草信息方面存在显著差异。鉴于这种在注意反烟草信息方面的巨大差异，本文分析了处理暴露的异质性如何不同地影响不同家庭群体的烟草使用率。2014年，低教育水平家庭和高教育水平家庭的烟草使用率分别为56%和48%。2014年之后，这两个教育群体之间的烟草使用率差距进一步扩大。我们发现，平均而言，受过高等教育的个体在2014年分别比受过初等教育的个体更有可能注意到反香烟和反无烟烟草的信息，其概率分别高出14个百分点和6个百分点。随后在2016年，高教育水平家庭的烟草使用率比低教育水平家庭降低了3.6个百分点。这些发现促使政策需要加强针对不同教育群体的烟草控制措施。

abstract.text: Taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) are in place in many countries to combat obesity with emerging evidence that these are effective in reducing purchases of SSBs. In this study, we tested whether signalling and framing the price increase from an SSB tax explicitly as a health-related, earmarked measure reduces the demand for SSBs more than an equivalent price increase. We measured the demand for non-alcoholic beverages with a discrete choice experiment (DCE) administered online to a randomly selected group of n = 603 households with children in Great Britain (GB) who regularly purchase SSBs. We find a suggestive evidence that a price increase leads to a larger reduction in the probability of choosing SSBs when it is signalled as a tax and framed as a health-related and earmarked policy. Respondents who did not support a tax on SSBs, who were also more likely to choose SSBs in the first place, were on average more responsive to a price increase framed as an earmarked tax than those who supported the tax. The predictive validity of the DCE, to capture preferences for beverages, was confirmed using actual purchase data. The findings imply that a well-signalled and earmarked tax on SSBs could improve its effectiveness at reducing the demand.

10.1002/hec.4123.abstractZh: 许多国家都实施了针对含糖饮料的税收措施，以对抗肥胖问题，有证据表明这些措施在减少含糖饮料的购买方面是有效的。在这项研究中，我们测试了将含糖饮料税收的增加明确标示为与健康相关的专项措施，是否比同等程度的价格上涨更能降低对含糖饮料的需求。我们通过在线离散选择实验，对英国有儿童的家庭进行随机抽样，共603户家庭，测量了他们对非酒精饮料的需求。研究发现，当税收的增加被明确标示为与健康相关的专项政策时，选择含糖饮料的概率会显著降低。那些不支持含糖饮料税收、且原本就更有可能选择含糖饮料的受访者，对作为专项税收的价格上涨反应更为积极。使用实际购买数据进一步验证了该实验在捕捉消费者偏好方面的预测有效性。研究结果表明，明确标示为与健康相关的专项税收措施，可能会提高减少含糖饮料需求的效力。

abstract.text: Health researchers design discrete choice experiments (DCEs) to elicit preferences over attributes that define treatments. A DCE can accommodate a limited number of attributes selected by researchers based on numerous factors (e.g., respondent comprehension, cognitive burden, and sample size). For situations where researchers want information about the possible impact of an attribute excluded from the DCE, we propose a method to use a question after the DCE. This follow-up question includes the attributes in the DCE with fixed levels and an additional attribute originally excluded from the DCE. The DCE data can be used to predict the probability that respondents would select one treatment profile over another without the additional attribute. Comparing the prediction to the percentage of the sample who selected each profile when it includes the additional attribute provides information on the potential impact of the additional attribute. We provide an example using data from a DCE on treatments for chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Cost was excluded from the DCE, but the survey included a follow-up question with two fixed treatment profiles, similar to two treatments currently on the market, and a cost for each. Preferences were sensitive to modest changes in cost, highlighting the importance of gathering this information.

10.1002/hec.4124.abstractZh: 健康研究人员设计离散选择实验（DCEs），以了解受访者对定义不同治疗方案的属性的偏好。DCE可以容纳研究人员根据多种因素选择的有限数量的属性（例如，受访者的理解能力、认知负担和样本大小）。当研究人员需要了解从DCE中排除的某个属性可能产生的影響时，我们提出了一种在DCE之后提出问题的方法。这个后续问题包含了DCE中已有的固定水平的属性，以及原本被排除在DCE之外的另一个属性。利用DCE数据，可以预测受访者在没有该额外属性的情况下，选择某个治疗方案的概率。将预测结果与包含该额外属性的情况下样本中选择每个治疗方案的比例进行比较，可以了解该额外属性的潜在影响。我们以一个关于慢性淋巴细胞白血病治疗方案的DCE数据为例进行说明。在DCE中排除了成本因素，但调查中包含了一个后续问题，其中有两个固定的治疗方案，类似于市场上现有的两种治疗方案，并且每种方案都有相应的成本。偏好对成本的微小变化非常敏感，这凸显了收集此类信息的重要性。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between cannabis use and early labor market experiences of young men, focusing on the time it takes them to find their first job, and the wage rate they receive at that job. We find that early cannabis users accept job offers more quickly and at a lower wage rate compared with otherwise similar males who did not use cannabis. These differences are present only for those who use cannabis for longer than a year before starting their job search. We also find that early cannabis users are less likely to return to education and, as a consequence, will have a lower educational attainment. Overall, our findings provide new insights into the direct and indirect relationships between cannabis use and early labor market experiences.

10.1002/hec.4125.abstractZh: 我们研究了大麻使用与年轻男性早期劳动力市场经历之间的关系，重点关注他们找到第一份工作所需的时间以及在该工作中获得的工资水平。研究发现，与未使用大麻的类似男性相比，早期使用大麻的男性更快接受工作机会，并且获得的工资水平更低。这些差异仅存在于那些在开始求职前使用大麻超过一年的群体中。我们还发现，早期使用大麻的男性更不可能重返教育领域，因此他们的教育水平也较低。总体而言，我们的研究结果为大麻使用与早期劳动力市场经历之间的直接和间接关系提供了新的见解。

abstract.text: We study horizontal inequity in home care use in the Netherlands, where a social insurance scheme aims to allocate long-term care according to care needs. Whether the system reaches its goal depends not only on whether eligible individuals have equal access to care but also on whether entitlements for care reflect needs, irrespective of socioeconomic status and other characteristics. We assess and decompose total inequity into inequity in (i) entitlements for home care and (ii) the conversion of these entitlements into actual use. This distinction is original and important, because inequity calls for different policy responses depending on the stage at which it arises. Linking survey and administrative data on the 65 and older, we find higher income elderly to receive less home care than poorer elderly with similar needs. Although lower income elderly tend to make greater use of their entitlements, need-standardized entitlements are similar across income, education, and wealth levels. However, both use and entitlements vary by origin and place of residence. The Dutch need assessment seems effective at restricting socioeconomic inequity in home care use but may not fully prevent inequity along other dimensions. Low financial barriers and universal eligibility rules may help achieve equity in access but are not sufficient conditions.

10.1002/hec.4126.abstractZh: 我们研究了荷兰家庭护理使用中的横向不平等问题，该国的社会保障制度旨在根据护理需求分配长期护理服务。该制度是否达到其目标不仅取决于符合条件的个人是否享有平等的护理机会，还取决于护理权益是否反映了需求，而不考虑社会经济地位和其他特征。我们评估并将总不平等分解为两个方面：(i) 家庭护理的权益；(ii) 这些权益转化为实际使用的程度。这种区分是原创且重要的，因为不平等需要根据其出现的阶段采取不同的政策应对措施。通过结合65岁及以上人群的调查和行政数据，我们发现收入较高的老年人获得的家庭护理服务较少，而需求相似的贫困老年人则相反。尽管低收入老年人往往更充分利用其权益，但按需求标准化的权益在不同收入、教育和财富水平下是相似的。然而，使用量和权益都受到出身和居住地的差异影响。荷兰的权益评估在限制家庭护理使用中的社会经济不平等方面似乎有效，但可能无法完全防止其他维度的不平等。较低的财务障碍和普遍性的资格规则可能有助于实现平等的获取机会，但这些并不是充分条件。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of a value-based insurance design (VBID) program implemented at a large public employer in the state of Oregon. The program substantially increased cost-sharing for several healthcare services likely to be of low value for most patients: diagnostic services (e.g., imaging services) and surgeries (e.g., spinal surgeries for pain). Using a difference-in-differences design coupled with granular, administrative health insurance claims data over the period 2008-2012, we estimate the change in low-value service use among beneficiaries before and after program implementation relative to a comparison group not exposed to the VBID. Our findings suggest that the VBID significantly reduced the use of targeted services, with an implied elasticity of demand of -0.22. We find no evidence that the VBID led to substitution to non-targeted services or increased overall healthcare costs. However, we also observe no evidence that the program led to cost-savings.

10.1002/hec.4127.abstractZh: 我们研究了在俄勒冈州一家大型公共雇主机构实施的基于价值的保险设计计划的影响。该计划显著增加了几项对大多数患者来说价值较低的医疗服务的费用分担：诊断服务（如影像服务）和手术（如用于缓解疼痛的脊柱手术）。通过2008-2012年期间详细的行政健康保险索赔数据，我们使用差异-差异设计方法，估计了在计划实施前后，相对于未接触VBID的对照组，受益人使用低价值服务的变化情况。我们的研究结果表明，VBID显著减少了目标服务的使用，需求的弹性为-0.22。我们没有发现VBID导致非目标服务替代或整体医疗成本增加的证据。然而，我们也未观察到该计划带来成本节约的证据。

abstract.text: The Journal of Health Economics and Health Economics are arguably the top two journals in the field of health economics. Together, they published 1,679 empirical research articles in the past decade (2010-2019). In line with analyses based on earlier periods, the empirical evidence in top health economics journals continues to be dominated by the United States (37% of all empirical articles), whereas studies based on low-income countries remain rare (2%). Countries with higher disease burdens receive generally less attention from health economists publishing at the top of their field. Reflecting this, more research was published based on data from the Nordic countries (27 million people) than from sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia regions combined (2.9 billion people). Finally, one-third of the empirical articles did not indicate the country of evidence in the title or the abstract, possibly to signal external validity of the findings. This practice was particularly common for articles based on data from North America with more than half of the articles omitting the country of evidence from the title and the abstract. The study concludes by exploring some hypotheses that may explain these findings.

10.1002/hec.4128.abstractZh: 《健康经济学杂志》和《健康经济学》可以说是健康经济学领域的两大权威期刊。在过去十年（2010-2019年）中，这两份期刊共发表了1,679篇实证研究文章。与早期的分析结果一致，顶级健康经济学期刊中的实证研究仍然以美国的研究为主（占所有实证文章的37%），而基于低收入国家的研究则较为罕见（仅占2%）。疾病负担较重的国家通常得不到该领域顶尖学者的足够关注。例如，基于北欧国家数据的研究比来自撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚地区的综合研究更为常见（北欧国家人口为2700万，而撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚地区的人口总和为29亿）。此外，三分之一的实证文章在标题或摘要中并未注明证据来源，这可能是为了表明研究的外部有效性。这种情况在基于北美数据的文章中尤为普遍，超过一半的文章在标题和摘要中均未注明证据来源。研究最后探讨了可能解释这些现象的一些假设。

abstract.text: Childhood vaccination has lagged in countries like India, despite its demonstrated positive effects on health outcomes like infant mortality. At the same time, many conditional cash transfer programs have been effective in improving health outcomes. We estimate the effect of the world's largest maternal health program, Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY, maternal protection scheme), on childhood vaccination in India. We exploit exogenous variations in the expansion of the policy around the country and the fact that some key vaccines are given at or near birth to identify the effects of cash-based maternal health policy on infant immunization. We find that JSY increased the probability of Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) and diphtheria, pertussis, and tetanus toxoid (DPT) vaccination among newborns and infants. However, we find almost no significant effects on the measles vaccine, which is administered several months after birth.

10.1002/hec.4129.abstractZh: 在印度等國家，兒童接種疫苗的工作一直滞后，儘管有證據表明這對健康結果有積極的影響，比如降低嬰兒死亡率。同時，許多以現金為激勵的計劃在改善健康結果方面取得了成效。我們估算了世界上最大的母親健康計劃——Janani Suraksha Yojana（JSY，母親保護計劃）對印度兒童接種疫苗效果的影響。我們利用全國範圍內該計劃實施情況的外生變化，以及某些重要疫苗在出生時或接近出生時接種的特點，來確定以現金為激勵的母親健康政策對嬰兒免疫接種的影響。我們發現，JSY增加了新生兒和嬰兒接種卡介苗以及白喉、百日咳和破傷風類毒素疫苗的概率。然而，我們發現，對於在出生幾個月後接種的麻疹疫苗，幾乎沒有顯著的影響。

abstract.text: This study estimates the effect of county-level public health expenditures in reducing county-level public assistance medical care benefits (public assistance medical care benefits is a measure compiled by the US Bureau of Economic Analysis and includes Medicaid and other medical vendor payments). The effect is modeled using a static panel model and estimated using two-stage limited information maximum likelihood and a valid instrumental variable. For every $1 invested in county-level public health expenditures, public assistance medical care benefits are reduced by an average of $3.12 (95% confidence interval: -$5.62, -$0.94). Because Medicaid in California is financed via an approximate 50% match of federal dollars with state dollars, savings to the state are approximately one-half of this, or $1.56 for every $1 invested in county-level public health expenditures.

10.1002/hec.4130.abstractZh: 本研究估计了县级公共卫生支出在减少县级公共援助医疗福利方面的效果。县级公共援助医疗福利是由美国经济分析局编制的一项指标，包括医疗补助和其他医疗供应商的支付。该效应通过静态面板模型进行建模，并使用两阶段有限信息最大似然法和有效的工具变量进行估计。每投入1美元于县级公共卫生支出，县级公共援助医疗福利平均减少3.12美元（95%置信区间：-5.62美元，-0.94美元）。由于加利福尼亚州的医疗补助资金约50%由联邦资金与州资金共同提供，因此州政府的节省金额约为此数额的一半，即每投入1美元于县级公共卫生支出，州政府可节省1.56美元。

abstract.text: Standard gamble (SG) typically yields higher health state valuations than time trade-off (TTO), which may be caused by biases affecting both methods. It has been suggested that TTO yields more accurate health state valuations, because TTO is subject to both upward and downward biases that may cancel out. Verifying this claim, however, would require a golden standard to test validity against. In this study, we attempted to provide a first direct test of the validity of health state valuation. A total of 119 students completed five TTO and SG tasks. Afterwards, their health state valuations elicited with TTO and SG were shown to them in an interactive graph. Respondents were asked to indicate which of the methods represented their valuation of a health state best. They could also adjust their valuation. Overall, we found that respondents indicated that TTO valuations better reflected health state valuations, a result that was more pronounced for more severe health states. When offered the opportunity, on average, respondents adjusted health state valuations downwards. These findings may have implications for future work on (bias correction in) health state valuations.

10.1002/hec.4131.abstractZh: 标准赌博法（SG）通常比时间权衡法（TTO）能得出更高的健康状态估值，这可能是由于两种方法都受到偏差的影响。有研究表明，时间权衡法能提供更准确的健康状态估值，因为该方法同时受到向上和向下的偏差影响，这些偏差可能会相互抵消。然而，要验证这一说法，需要有一个黄金标准来测试其有效性。在本研究中，我们试图首次直接验证健康状态估值的准确性。共有119名学生完成了五项时间权衡法和标准赌博法的任务。之后，他们通过交互式图表了解了用时间权衡法和标准赌博法得出的健康状态估值。受访者被要求指出哪种方法最能代表他们对健康状态的估值。他们还可以调整自己的估值。总体而言，我们发现受访者认为时间权衡法的估值更能反映健康状态，这一结果在健康状况更为严重的个体中更为明显。当有机会时，受访者平均将健康状态估值向下调整。这些发现可能对未来关于健康状态估值偏差修正的研究具有重要意义。

abstract.text: In March 2015, the State of Hawaii stopped covering the majority of migrants from countries belonging to the Compact of Free Association (COFA) in its Medicaid program. COFA migrants were required to obtain private insurance in the exchanges established under the Affordable Care Act. Using statewide hospital discharge data, we show that Medicaid-funded hospitalizations and emergency room visits declined in this population by 31% and 19%, respectively. Utilization funded by private insurance did increase but not enough to offset the declines in Medicaid-funded utilization. We show that the expiration of benefits increased uninsured ER visits. Finally, we exploit a feature of the policy change to provide evidence that the declines in utilization are due to higher rates of uninsured migrants rather than higher levels of cost sharing on private plans.

10.1002/hec.4132.abstractZh: 2015年3月，夏威夷州停止在其医疗补助计划中为来自自由联系协定国家的移民提供医疗保障。根据《平价医疗法案》的规定，这些移民必须通过私人保险计划获得医疗服务。通过全州医院出院数据分析发现，这些移民在医疗补助资助下的住院率和急诊就诊率分别下降了31%和19%。虽然私人保险资助的医疗服务使用量有所上升，但不足以抵消医疗补助资助服务的下降。研究还表明，保险福利的终止导致了无保险移民的急诊就诊率上升。最后，我们利用这一政策变化的特点，证明了服务使用量的下降是由于无保险移民的比例增加，而非私人保险计划中的费用分担比例提高所致。

abstract.text: This article investigates the impact of the 2010 Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA) on the healthfulness of non-alcoholic beverage (NAB) choices of low-income households. A theoretical analysis proposes an income effect that increases unhealthy beverage purchases after Medicaid expansion and a nutrition education effect that decreases them. To empirically test these effects, we utilize household-level data for NAB purchases in 52 U.S. metropolitan areas. Our identification strategy is based on eligible households following the 2012 Supreme Court ruling that allowed states to opt out of Medicaid expansion. We examine changes in purchases across NAB categories and in purchases at the product-brand level. Empirical results indicate that Medicaid expansion resulted in eligible households buying more diet carbonated soft drinks (CSDs) and bottled water, with no effect on regular CSDs, fruit juice, fruit drinks, milk, or tea. Moreover, the expansion led to decreases in sugar purchases and increases in purchases of NAB products with lower sugar content, highlighting the benefits of supplementing the medical benefits of Medicaid with diet quality programs, such as nutrition education.

10.1002/hec.4133.abstractZh: 本文探讨了2010年《患者保护与平价医疗法案》对低收入家庭非酒精饮料选择健康性的影响。理论分析提出，医疗补助计划的扩展会增加不健康饮料的购买，而营养教育则有助于减少这类饮料的购买。为了实证验证这些效应，我们使用了52个美国大都市地区的家庭层面非酒精饮料购买数据。我们的识别策略基于2012年最高法院裁决后选择退出医疗补助计划的符合条件的家庭。我们研究了非酒精饮料各类别的购买变化，以及产品品牌层面的购买情况。实证结果表明，医疗补助计划的扩展导致符合条件的家庭购买了更多的无糖碳酸软饮料和瓶装水，而对普通无糖碳酸软饮料、果汁、水果饮料、牛奶和茶的影响不大。此外，该政策还导致无糖非酒精饮料的购买增加，这表明通过营养教育等饮食质量项目来补充医疗补助计划带来的医疗福利是有益的。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether the voluntary deductible in the Dutch health insurance system reduces moral hazard or acts only as a cost reduction tool for low-risk individuals. We use a sample of 14,089 observations, comprising 2,939 individuals over seven waves from the Longitudinal Internet Studies for the Social sciences panel for the analysis. We employ bivariate models that jointly model the choice of a deductible and health care utilization and supplement the identification with an instrumental variable strategy. The results show that the voluntary deductible reduces moral hazard, especially in the decision to visit a doctor (extensive margin) compared with the number of visits (intensive margin). In addition, a robustness test shows that selection on moral hazard is not present in this context.

10.1002/hec.4134.abstractZh: 本文研究荷兰健康保险系统中的自愿免赔额是否减少了道德风险，或者它仅作为低风险个体的成本降低工具发挥作用。我们采用了来自“社会科学纵向互联网研究”小组的14,089个观测数据，涵盖了7个调查周期中的2,939名个体。我们采用了双变量模型来同时模拟免赔额的选择和医疗服务的利用情况，并通过工具变量策略来补充识别过程。研究结果表明，自愿免赔额确实减少了道德风险，尤其是在选择看医生这一行为上（即“广泛边际”），相对于就诊次数而言（即“密集边际”）。此外，一项稳健性测试表明，在这种情况下不存在道德风险的选择效应。

abstract.text: While politics can determine what public goods are available, elected officials must decide on the method of allocation. Commonly, governments provide public health insurance directly or pay private parties to administer it on their behalf. Such contracting can leverage private sector expertise but also raises agency concerns. In particular, little is known about how private provision of public health insurance impacts medical decision-making and treatment flows for low-income populations. An example comes from the Medicaid program, which has increasingly relied on outside insurers to deliver health services to enrollees. We exploit a large legislative intervention in Florida to show that Medicaid managed care (MMC) organizations generally do not skimp on short-run treatment delivery in the inpatient setting. In fact, patients with severe and chronic illnesses receive more inpatient services under these contracts, especially in relation to managing care transitions. We also document increased competition in the MMC market following the state's policy intervention.

10.1002/hec.4135.abstractZh: 虽然政治可以决定哪些公共物品可供使用，但当选官员必须决定分配方式。通常，政府直接提供公共健康保险，或者委托私人机构来实施。这种委托方式可以利用私营部门的专业知识，但也引发了代理问题。特别是，关于私人提供公共健康保险如何影响低收入人群的医疗决策和治疗流程，目前知之甚少。以医疗补助计划为例，该计划越来越依赖外部保险公司为参保者提供医疗服务。我们通过佛罗里达州的一项重大立法干预案例发现，医疗补助管理护理组织通常不会在住院治疗的短期交付方面有所削减。事实上，患有严重和慢性疾病的患者在这些合同下获得了更多的住院服务，尤其是在护理过渡管理方面。我们还发现，在该州的政策干预之后，医疗补助管理护理市场出现了更多的竞争。

abstract.text: Electronic cigarettes are a less harmful alternative to combustible cigarettes. We analyze data on e-cigarette choices in an online experimental market. Our data and mixed logit model capture two sources of consumer optimization errors: overestimates of the relative risks of e-cigarettes and present bias. Our novel data and policy analysis make three contributions. First, our predictions about e-cigarette use under counterfactual policy scenarios provide new information about current regulatory tradeoffs. Second, we provide empirical evidence about the role consumer optimization errors play in tobacco product choices. Third, we contribute to behavioral welfare analysis of policies that address individual optimization errors. Compared with standard cost-benefit analysis, our behavioral welfare economics analysis leads to much larger estimates of the costs of policies that discourage e-cigarette use or the benefits of policies that encourage e-cigarette use.

10.1002/hec.4136.abstractZh: 电子香烟是燃烧型香烟的一种危害较小的替代品。我们分析了在线实验市场中关于电子香烟选择的数据。我们的数据和混合逻辑模型揭示了两种消费者优化误差的来源：对电子香烟相对风险的高估以及当前偏见的影响。我们的新颖数据和政策分析做出了三项贡献。首先，我们对反事实政策情景下电子香烟使用的预测提供了关于当前监管权衡的新信息。其次，我们提供了关于消费者优化误差在烟草产品选择中作用的实证证据。第三，我们对解决个体优化误差的政策的行为福利分析做出了贡献。与标准成本效益分析相比，我们的行为福利经济学分析得出的政策成本估计更为准确，同时也更清晰地展现了鼓励或抑制电子香烟使用的政策所带来的收益。

abstract.text: In July 2002, a global budgeting system was imposed on hospitals in Taiwan. This system set a fixed budget for all hospitals within a region but included special provisions that sheltered reimbursements for drug expenditures. We study the size and nature of changes in hospital physicians' use of drugs for outpatient care following this budgetary change and find that drug expenditures for outpatient care increased by 11.7%. Our results suggest that physicians began prescribing more expensive drugs, more drugs, and drugs for longer periods but that these different responses did not all occur at the same time. The overall response was strongest in for-profit hospitals, but drug-related decisions changed in all hospital types.

10.1002/hec.4137.abstractZh: 2002年7月，台湾的医院被强制实施了一项全球预算制度。该制度为某一区域内的所有医院设定了固定的预算，但包含了一些特殊条款，用于补贴药品费用的报销。我们研究了这一预算制度实施后，医院医生在门诊护理中用药情况的变化规模和性质，发现门诊护理中的药品支出增加了11.7%。我们的研究结果表明，医生开始开具更昂贵的药品、更多的药品，并且用药时间也延长了，但这些变化并非同时发生。在营利性医院中，这种反应最为明显，但所有类型的医院在药品相关决策上都有所变化。

abstract.text: Since 2007, Italian regions running large deficits underwent recovery plans (Piani di Rientro) imposed by the central government. The goal was twofold: regions were asked (i) to restore a balanced budget and (ii) to continue supply the set of services defined by the constitution. We investigate whether recovery plans have reached their objectives. Our evidence suggests that recovery plans have proved to be an effective mechanism to eliminate subnational governments deficits. We also do not find any significant effects on health care utilization and on citizens' health. Overall, spending efficiency has likely improved.

10.1002/hec.4138.abstractZh: 自2007年以来，意大利存在较大赤字的地区实施了由中央政府制定的恢复计划。这些计划有两个目标：一是要求这些地区恢复平衡预算，二是继续提供宪法所规定的各项服务。我们研究了这些恢复计划是否达到了预期目标。我们的证据表明，恢复计划确实是一种有效的机制，能够消除地方政府的赤字。此外，我们并未发现这些计划对医疗保健服务利用或公民健康产生显著影响。总体而言，支出效率可能有所提高。

abstract.text: The study seeks to analyze the impact of macroeconomic conditions on weight measures, such as BMI, overweight, obesity, and severe obesity in Brazil. We examine this relationship in the specific context of a middle-income country that differs in many aspects from the high-income countries usually considered in the literature. The study uses the microdata of VIGITEL in the period from 2006 to 2014 and the state unemployment rate as a proxy for macroeconomic conditions. The results showed that the relationship is robust and presents a procyclical pattern-increases in the unemployment rate reduce BMI, and this reduction is observed throughout the entire distribution, with statistically significant effects for measures of overweight, obesity, and severe obesity. These results agree with the findings for the United States but contradict the results found for Finland and Canada.

10.1002/hec.4139.abstractZh: 本研究旨在分析宏观经济状况对巴西体重测量指标的影响，如体质指数、超重、肥胖和严重肥胖。我们在一个中等收入国家的特定背景下考察这种关系，该国的许多方面与文献中通常考虑的高收入国家有所不同。研究使用了2006至2014年期间VIGITEL项目的微观数据，并将州失业率作为宏观经济状况的代理指标。研究结果表明，这种关系具有稳健性，并呈现出顺周期性特征——失业率上升会导致体质指数下降，且这种下降在整个人群中均存在，对超重、肥胖和严重肥胖的测量指标也有显著影响。这些结果与美国的发现一致，但与芬兰和加拿大的研究结果相矛盾。

abstract.text: Laws mandating that individuals wear a seat belt have the presumed goal of reducing motor vehicle accident fatalities, but the prevailing view is that they may reduce the number of organs available. I provide a conceptual model identifying mechanisms whereby the law could either increase or decrease organ donation. Exploiting variation across states and time in the adoption of primary seat belt enforcement, I investigate these mechanisms and estimate the effect of the law on the supply of organs. The law increases seat belt usage and decreases motor vehicle accident fatalities, which translates to a sizeable reduction in the number of motor vehicle accident-based organ donors. In contrast, the law is not associated with changes in the number of organ donors from nonmotor vehicle accident-based sources and is robust to controlling for hospital-specific effects. The effects are concentrated within organs expected to be most negatively impacted by the seat belt. Although primary enforcement represents a net-gain to society in terms of lives saved, the negative impact on organ donation suggests further emphasis be placed on policies aimed at increasing the availability of organs.

10.1002/hec.4140.abstractZh: 要求个人佩戴安全带的法规，其目的被认为是减少机动车事故死亡人数。然而，普遍的观点认为，这些法规可能会减少可供移植的器官数量。我提出了一个概念模型，用以分析该法规可能通过何种机制增加或减少器官捐赠。通过研究各州及时间在不同阶段对安全带强制佩戴政策的采纳情况，我评估了该法规对器官供应量的影响。该法规增加了安全带的使用率，并减少了机动车事故死亡人数，这意味着基于机动车事故的器官捐赠者数量显著减少。相比之下，该法规并未改变非机动车事故来源的器官捐赠者数量，且控制医院特定因素后，该法规的影响仍然稳定。这些影响主要集中在那些最受安全带政策负面影响的器官类别上。尽管强制佩戴安全带在挽救生命方面对社会有积极影响，但其对器官捐赠的负面影响表明，应进一步重视旨在增加器官可用性的政策。

abstract.text: Since 2017, many US cities have implemented taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages to decrease consumption of sugary beverages and raise revenue. We analyze household receipt data to examine the impact of taxes on households' beverage purchases in the four largest US cities with such taxes: Philadelphia, PA; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; and Oakland, CA. We compare changes in monthly household purchases in the treatment cities with changes in two comparison groups: (1) areas adjacent to the treatment cities or (2) a matched set of households nationally. An increase in the tax rate of 1 cent per ounce decreases household purchases of taxed beverages by 53.0 ounces per month (12.2%). This impact is consistent with a reduction in individual consumption of 5 calories per day per household member and eventual reduction in weight of 0.5 pounds. However, the decline was concentrated in Philadelphia, where the tax decreased purchases by 27.7%. There was no change in purchases of taxed beverages in the other three cities combined.

10.1002/hec.4141.abstractZh: 自2017年以来，许多美国城市开始对含糖饮料征税，以减少含糖饮料的消费并提高税收收入。我们通过分析家庭收据数据，来研究这些税收对四个实施此类税收的美国最大城市的家庭饮料购买行为的影响：宾夕法尼亚州的费城、加利福尼亚州的旧金山、华盛顿州的西雅图以及加利福尼亚州的奥克兰。我们将这些城市中的家庭月购买量变化与两个对照组的变化进行了比较：（1）与这些城市相邻的地区；（2）全国范围内的一组匹配家庭。每盎司税收增加1美分会导致家庭每月购买含糖饮料的数量减少53.0盎司（12.2%）。这一影响与每户家庭成员每天减少5卡路里的消费以及最终体重减少0.5磅的情况一致。然而，这种下降主要集中在费城，那里的税收使购买量减少了27.7%。其他三个城市的含糖饮料购买量没有变化。

abstract.text: Intake of added sugars is high in the US adolescent population, with sugar-sweetened beverages being the primary source. We contribute to the literature by providing the first estimates of the impacts of soda sales taxes, which are commonly levied in the US states, on the total daily sugar intake and blood sugar of adolescents aged 12-19 years. Using a restricted-use version of the 1999-2014 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) and exploiting within-state variation in soda sales tax rates over time, our results indicate that adolescent soft drink demand is tax-sensitive. Consistent with prior research using NHANES data, we find that adolescents reduce calories consumed from soft drinks when faced with a rise in soda sales taxes, but they offset this reduction with an increase in calorie intake from milk drinks. In accordance with this substitution behavior, we find that soda sales taxes cause small and insignificant changes in the total daily calorie intake, total daily sugar intake, or blood sugar levels of adolescents.

10.1002/hec.4142.abstractZh: 美国青少年群体的添加糖摄入量较高，含糖饮料是主要来源。我们通过首次估算美国各州普遍征收的苏打水销售税对12-19岁青少年每日总糖摄入量和血糖水平的影响，为相关文献做出了贡献。利用1999-2014年国民健康与营养调查的数据，并考虑到各州之间苏打水销售税率的差异，我们的研究结果表明，青少年对软饮料的需求对税收敏感。与之前使用NHANES数据的研究一致，我们发现当苏打水销售税增加时，青少年会减少软饮料的摄入量，但会通过增加牛奶饮料的摄入量来弥补这一减少。根据这种替代行为，我们发现苏打水销售税对青少年每日总热量摄入、总糖摄入量和血糖水平的影响较小且不显著。

abstract.text: Mass media routinely present data on coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) diffusion with graphs that use either a log scale or a linear scale. We show that the choice of the scale adopted on these graphs has important consequences on how people understand and react to the information conveyed. In particular, we find that when we show the number of COVID-19 related deaths on a logarithmic scale, people have a less accurate understanding of how the pandemic has developed, make less accurate predictions on its evolution, and have different policy preferences than when they are exposed to a linear scale. Consequently, merely changing the scale the data is presented on can alter public policy preferences and the level of worry about the pandemic, despite the fact that people are routinely exposed to COVID-19 related information. Providing the public with information in ways they understand better can help improving the response to COVID-19, thus, mass media and policymakers communicating to the general public should always describe the evolution of the pandemic using a graph on a linear scale, at least as a default option. Our results suggest that framing matters when communicating to the public.

10.1002/hec.4143.abstractZh: 大众媒体在报道2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）传播数据时，通常使用对数刻度或线性刻度的图表。我们发现，这些图表中刻度选择对人们理解和反应信息的方式有着重要影响。具体而言，当我们使用对数刻度展示与COVID-19相关的死亡人数时，人们对疫情发展的理解不够准确，对疫情演变的预测也不够准确，并且与线性刻度相比，他们的政策偏好也有所不同。因此，仅仅改变数据呈现的刻度就能改变公众的偏好和对疫情的担忧程度，尽管人们通常都会接触到与COVID-19相关的信息。以公众更容易理解的方式提供信息，有助于改善对COVID-19的应对。因此，大众媒体和决策者在向公众传达信息时，应始终使用线性刻度的图表来描述疫情的发展，至少应作为默认选项。我们的研究结果表明，在向公众传达信息时，框架的选择非常重要。

abstract.text: In Canada's most populous province, Ontario, family physicians may choose between the blended fee-for-service (Family Health Group [FHG]) and blended capitation (Family Health Organization [FHO] payment models). Both models incentivize physicians to provide after-hours (AH) and comprehensive care, but FHO physicians receive a capitation payment per enrolled patient adjusted for age and sex, plus a reduced fee-for-service while FHG physicians are paid by fee-for-service. We develop a theoretical model of physician labor supply with multitasking to predict their behavior under FHG and FHO, and estimable equations are derived to test the predictions empirically. Using health administrative data from 2006 to 2014 and a two-stage estimation strategy, we study the impact of switching from FHG to FHO on the production of a capitated basket of services, after-hours services and nonincentivized services. Our results reveal that switching from the FHG to FHO reduces the production of capitated services to enrolled patients and services to nonenrolled patients by 15% and 5% per annum and increases the production of after-hours and nonincentivized services by 8% and 15% per annum.

10.1002/hec.4145.abstractZh: 在加拿大人口最多的省份安大略省，家庭医生可以在混合式收费模式（家庭健康小组[FHG]）和混合式按人头付费模式（家庭健康组织[FHO]）之间进行选择。这两种模式都激励医生提供夜诊和全面护理服务，但采用FHO模式的医生会根据患者年龄和性别获得按人头支付的报酬，同时享受较低的常规收费；而采用FHG模式的医生则按常规收费获得报酬。我们建立了一个理论模型，模拟医生在多重任务下的劳动力供给行为，以预测他们在FHG和FHO模式下的行为。通过推导可估算的方程，我们对这些预测进行了实证检验。利用2006至2014年的健康行政数据，并采用两阶段估计策略，我们研究了从FHG模式转向FHO模式对按人头付费服务、夜诊服务和非激励性服务的影响。研究结果表明，从FHG模式转向FHO模式会使按人头付费服务的提供量减少15%，非激励性服务的提供量减少5%；同时，夜诊和非激励性服务的提供量分别增加8%和15%。

abstract.text: This study evaluates the impact of the 1990–1994 conflict in northern Mali on child health at different timings of exposure (in utero and after birth). Two anthropometric variables (height‐for‐age and weight‐for‐height Z ‐scores) are used as indicators of child health. The empirical strategy relies on the difference‐in‐difference approach based on birth cohort, GIS residence information, and conflict intensity. The intensity of conflict exposure is measured by the number of deaths resulting from a conflict that broke out within a 10‐km radius of each community. The estimation results show that the more severe the exposure to children and their mothers, the greater is the negative impact on the height, but not on the weight, of children. Additionally, the timing of conflict exposure plays a critical role in the outcome of a child's health: exposure to conflict in utero, rather than after birth, negatively affects health. Placebo test as well as tests of selective migration, fertility, and mortality are conducted and confirmed the robustness of the main results. The differential effects of the timing of exposure in utero suggest that the heightened maternal stress is the main mechanism.

10.1002/hec.4146.abstractZh: 本研究评估了1990年至1994年马里北部冲突对儿童健康在不同暴露时间点（子宫内和出生后）的影响。采用两个人体测量变量（身高年龄比和体重身高Z分数）作为儿童健康的指标。实证方法基于出生队列、地理信息系统居住信息和冲突强度差异分析。冲突暴露的强度通过每社区10公里半径范围内因冲突导致的死亡人数来衡量。研究结果表明，儿童和母亲所遭受的冲突越严重，对儿童身高的负面影响越大，但对体重的影响则较小。此外，冲突暴露的时间点对儿童健康结果起着关键作用：子宫内而非出生后的冲突暴露会对健康产生负面影响。研究还进行了安慰剂测试以及选择性迁移、生育率和死亡率的测试，这些测试进一步证实了主要结果的稳健性。子宫内暴露时间点的差异效应表明，母亲承受的更高压力是主要机制。

abstract.text: Does austerity in health care affect health and healthcare outcomes? We examine the intended and unintended effects of the Italian austerity policy Piano di Rientro aimed at containing the cost of the healthcare sector. Using an instrumental variable strategy that exploits the temporal and geographical variation induced by the policy rollout, we find that the policy was successful in alleviating deficits by reducing expenditure, mainly in the southern regions, but also resulted in a 3% rise in avoidable deaths among both men and women, a reduction in hospital capacity and a rise in south-to-north patient migration. These findings suggest that-even in a high-income country with relatively low avoidable mortality like Italy-spending cuts can hurt survival.

10.1002/hec.4147.abstractZh: 医疗领域的紧缩政策是否会影响健康与医疗结果？我们研究了意大利紧缩政策“Piano di Rientro”的意图与非意图影响，该政策旨在控制医疗领域的成本。通过利用政策实施带来的时间和地理变化，我们发现该政策在减少支出方面取得了成功，主要缓解了南部地区的赤字问题。然而，该政策也导致了男女可避免死亡人数的增加3%，医院容量减少，以及从南部到北部地区的病人迁移现象。这些发现表明，即使在像意大利这样拥有相对较低可避免死亡率的高收入国家，削减开支也可能对生存能力产生负面影响。

abstract.text: It is unclear to what extent self-employed choose to become self-employed. This study aimed to compare the health care expenditures-as a proxy for health-of self-employed individuals in the year before they started their business, to that of employees. Differences by sex, age, and industry were studied. In total, 5,741,457 individuals aged 25-65 years who were listed in the tax data between 2010 and 2015 with data on their health insurance claims were included. Self-employed and employees were stratified according to sex, age, household position, personal income, region, and industry for each of the years covered. Weighted linear regression was used to compare health care expenditures in the preceding (year x-1) between self-employed and employees (in year x). Compared with employees, expenditures for hospital care, pharmaceutical care and mental health care were lower among self-employed in the year before they started their business. Differences were most pronounced for men, individuals ≥40 years and those working in the industry and energy sector, construction, financial institutions, and government and care. We conclude that healthy individuals are overrepresented among the self-employed, which is more pronounced in certain subgroups. Further qualitative research is needed to investigate the reasons why these subgroups are more likely to choose to become self-employed.

10.1002/hec.4149.abstractZh: 目前尚不清楚个体经营者选择成为个体经营者的程度。本研究旨在比较个体经营者在开始创业前的年度中，作为健康指标的医疗保健支出与雇员之间的差异。研究考察了性别、年龄和行业方面的差异。总共纳入了2010年至2015年间税务数据中包含医疗保险报销信息的5,741,457名25-65岁个体经营者。对于所涵盖的每一年，个体经营者和雇员根据性别、年龄、家庭状况、个人收入、地区和行业进行了分层分析。采用加权线性回归方法，比较了个体经营者和雇员在创业前一年（即x-1年）的医疗保健支出。与雇员相比，个体经营者在开始创业前的年度中，医院护理、药品护理和心理健康护理的支出较低。这些差异在男性、40岁及以上的人群以及从事能源行业、建筑行业、金融机构以及政府和护理行业的人群中最为明显。我们得出结论，健康个体在个体经营者中占比较高，这一趋势在某些子群体中更为明显。需要进一步进行定性研究，以探究这些子群体更可能选择成为个体经营者的原因。

abstract.text: This study assesses the impact of Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak on individual and total welfare in Liberia during 2014/15. By combining mortality and household consumption data, it estimates how much individuals would be hypothetically willing to pay to avoid the EVD-induced increase in age- and sex-specific mortality rates. The results suggest that the total welfare loss associated with EVD-related mortality ranges from $90 to $190 million, which is comparable to estimates based on the economic costs of EVD alone. In addition, the estimates lie between those derived from the cost-of-illness and value of statistical life approaches applied in previous works. This suggests that incorporating additional information on age- and sex-specific mortality, as well as individual consumption levels, provides a more accurate estimation of the welfare loss due to EVD-related mortality.

10.1002/hec.4150.abstractZh: 本研究评估了2014/15年度埃博拉病毒病疫情对利比里亚个人及整体福利的影响。通过结合死亡率和家庭消费数据，本文估算了个体为避免埃博拉病毒病导致的年龄和性别特异性死亡率上升而愿意支付的价格。研究结果表明，与埃博拉病毒病相关的死亡所造成的整体福利损失在9000万至1.9亿美元之间，这一数值与仅基于埃博拉病毒病经济成本的估算相当。此外，这些估算值介于以往研究中采用的疾病成本法和生命价值法得出的估算值之间。这表明，纳入关于年龄和性别特异性死亡率以及个人消费水平的额外信息，能够更准确地估算因埃博拉病毒病相关死亡所造成的福利损失。

abstract.text: We study the health consequences of one of the largest environmental disasters of the world mining industry, which largely stemmed from regulatory failure. Exploiting the timing and location of the Mariana mine tailings dam collapse in Brazil, we show that in utero exposure to the tragedy significantly reduced birth weight and increased infant mortality. The adverse effects were stronger for infants born to less educated and nonmarried mothers. These findings indicate that poorly enforced environmental regulation may have long-term welfare impacts on local communities.

10.1002/hec.4151.abstractZh: 我们研究了世界矿业史上最严重的环境灾难之一对健康的影响，该灾难主要源于监管失效。通过利用巴西马里亚纳矿尾矿坝溃坝事件的时间和地点，我们发现，在胎儿时期接触这一悲剧事件会导致出生体重下降和婴儿死亡率上升。对于受教育程度较低且未婚的母亲所生的婴儿来说，这种不良影响更为显著。这些发现表明，执行不力的环境监管可能会对当地社区造成长期的福利影响。

abstract.text: In complex health systems with growing healthcare spending, combining reimbursement systems that incentivize cost-efficient healthcare provision within and across care sectors is key. This study investigates whether dual reimbursement systems lead hospitals to offset financial pressures in one care sector by inducing demand in another. We find that hospital imaging units induced demand for costly and unnecessary ambulatory imaging examinations reimbursed under fee-for-service, following a reform that introduced prospective payment and increased competition in the inpatient sector in Switzerland in 2012. Market structure, competitive pressures, and price regulations also influence demand inducement by varying the response to the reform. Reimbursement systems can influence supplier-induced demand in other care sectors within hospitals where revenue is tied to the intensity of care provision. In particular, the possibility to self-refer patients to high-margin diagnostic examinations bears negative consequences on healthcare expenditures and potentially patient health.
