10.1002/hec.4152.abstractZh: 在医疗支出不断增长的复杂医疗体系中，整合能够激励成本效益高的医疗服务提供方式的报销体系至关重要。本研究探讨了双重报销体系是否会通过促使其他医疗领域的需求增长，帮助医院缓解某一医疗领域的财务压力。研究发现，在瑞士于2012年引入预期支付制度并增加住院部门竞争后，医院影像部门在按服务收费的报销制度下，引发了昂贵且不必要的门诊影像检查需求。市场结构、竞争压力以及价格监管等因素也会影响需求的产生，它们对改革的响应各不相同。报销体系可以影响医院内其他医疗领域的供应商需求，因为这些领域的收入与医疗服务提供的强度相关。特别是，允许患者自行选择高利润的诊断检查项目，可能会对医疗支出以及患者的健康产生负面影响。

abstract.text: This study explores possible associations of the Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA) with child access to behavioral health (BH) services (preimplementation = 2008-2009, transition = 2010, and post = 2011-2013). The study sample included children aged 4-17 years in self-insured "carve-in" plans from large employers. In "carve-ins," BH and medical care are covered through the same insurance plan. The unit of analysis is the person-month (N = 61,823,533). This study employs an interrupted time series model allowing for intercept and slope changes for the transition and postparity periods. Outcomes included total, plan and patient out-of-pocket (OOP) expenditures, and several categories of service utilization. Generalized estimating equations were used to account for clustering. There were significant increases in total and plan expenditures postparity. To illustrate, in July 2012, mean per-member-per-month total expenditures were predicted to be $5.65 without parity but $8.72 with parity. Patient OOP costs did not change significantly. Significant overall increases were seen for utilization of most outpatient services but not intermediate or inpatient services. Our findings suggest that the introduction of MHPAEA was associated with an increase in specialty BH service access for children without a commensurate increase in financial burden for families.

10.1002/hec.4153.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了《心理健康平等与成瘾公平法案》与儿童获得行为健康服务之间的可能关联（实施前为2008-2009年，过渡期为2010年，实施后为2011-2013年）。研究样本包括来自大型雇主的自保“划入计划”中的4-17岁儿童。在“划入计划”中，行为健康服务和医疗护理通过同一保险计划覆盖。分析单位是人月（N = 61,823,533）。本研究采用中断时间序列模型，能够分析过渡期和实施后的斜率变化。研究结果包括总支出、计划内支出以及患者自付费用，还包括多项服务利用情况。采用广义估计方程模型来处理聚类问题。实施后，总支出和计划内支出均显著增加。例如，在2012年7月，没有实施该法案时，人均月总支出为5.65美元，而实施该法案后则上升至8.72美元。患者自付费用没有显著变化。大多数门诊服务的利用量显著增加，但中间或住院服务的利用量并未出现显著变化。我们的研究结果表明，《心理健康平等与成瘾公平法案》的引入确实增加了儿童获得专业行为健康服务的机会，但并未导致家庭的经济负担相应增加。

abstract.text: The health shocks literature typically does not take into account the temporal patterns of loss since the time of the shock. This limits understanding of the long-run impact of health shocks and the capacity of individuals to cope over time. This study estimates the dynamic effects of a noncommunicable disease shock on the economic well-being of working-age individuals in China up to 6 years after onset. We find that after a period of temporal loss, individuals and their families can insure consumption against the average noncommunicable disease shock over the long-run. We observe significant heterogeneity according to the persistence of the disease, value of household wealth, and health insurance status. Individuals with consistent onset, with below median wealth, and without health insurance are least equipped to smooth consumption over the long-term.

10.1002/hec.4154.abstractZh: 关于健康冲击的文献通常不考虑冲击发生后的损失时间模式。这限制了人们对健康冲击长期影响的了解，以及个体随时间应对能力的研究。本研究估计了非传染性疾病冲击对中国劳动年龄人口经济福祉的动态影响，时间跨度达6年。研究发现，在经历一段损失期后，个体及其家庭可以在长期内通过保险来抵御非传染性疾病的冲击。我们观察到，根据疾病的持续性、家庭财富价值以及健康保险状况，不同个体的应对能力存在显著差异。那些发病时间一致、财富低于平均水平且没有健康保险的个体，在长期内最难以平滑消费。

abstract.text: This study examines the longer term relationship between public health insurance expansions and health behaviors. I leverage geographic and temporal variation in the implementation of the Affordable Care Act-facilitated Medicaid expansions and provide the first estimates of the expansions' behavioral impacts during their first 5 years. Using national survey data from the 2010 to 2018 Behavioral Risk Factors Surveillance System and a difference-in-differences regression design, I show that the Medicaid expansions increase utilization of certain forms of preventive care, while reducing heavy drinking. I also find suggestive evidence that the expansions reduce smoking and increase the probability of exercise. These results stand in contrast with earlier studies that used only 2 or 3 years of postexpansion data and found no detectable effect of the Medicaid expansions on health behaviors in the short run. My results, combined with evidence from previous studies, suggest that public insurance expansions may not prompt an immediate change in health behaviors, but newly eligible populations do increase investments in healthy behaviors over time. In the long run, Medicaid expansions may help reduce engagement in risky behaviors like drinking and smoking among low-income people.

10.1002/hec.4155.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了公共健康保险扩展与健康行为之间的长期关系。我利用《平价医疗法案》推动的医疗补助扩展在地理和时间上的差异，首次估算了这些扩展在最初5年内的行为影响。通过2010至2018年行为风险因素监测系统的全国调查数据，并采用差异-差异回归设计，我发现医疗补助扩展增加了某些形式的预防性护理的利用，同时减少了酗酒行为。我还发现了一些有启发性的证据，表明这些扩展减少了吸烟行为，并增加了运动的可能性。这些结果与早期仅使用扩展后2至3年数据的研究结果形成对比，后者并未发现医疗补助扩展对短期健康行为有显著影响。我的研究结果，结合先前研究的证据，表明公共保险扩展可能不会立即促使健康行为的改变，但新纳入保险的人群确实会随着时间的推移增加对健康行为的投入。从长远来看，医疗补助扩展可能有助于降低低收入人群参与饮酒和吸烟等风险行为的可能性。

abstract.text: In May 2018, Scotland became the first country in the world to enforce a minimum unit pricing (MUP) of 50 pence ($0.65; €0.55) on alcoholic beverages as a measure to control alcohol consumption and alcohol-related harms. This study presents early estimates of the impact of MUP on three outcomes: average price per unit (8 gr/10 ml) of alcohol, liters of alcohol sold per adult, and liters of alcohol sold per adult drinker, in three different settings: off-premise, on-premise, and both combined. Using yearly alcohol price and sales data from 2011 to 2019, I find that the average price per unit of alcohol has significantly risen post-MUP across all beverage categories (beer, spirits, wine, cider, and alcohol-all types), whereas liters of alcohol sold per adult and per adult drinker have significantly reduced for beer, spirits, cider, and alcohol-all types. For all outcomes, the impact of MUP on off-premise alcohol prices and sales is more pronounced than under the combined case, while no significant effects are found on-premise. These results are robust to model specification and to the addition of various control variables. Falsification tests changing the timing of the policy were performed and no significant results were found.

10.1002/hec.4156.abstractZh: 2018年5月，苏格兰成为世界上第一个对酒精饮料实施最低单价政策的国家，该政策规定酒精饮料的最低单价为50便士（约合0.65美元或0.55欧元），旨在控制酒精消费及与酒精相关的危害。本研究对最低单价政策对以下三个指标的影响进行了初步估算：每单位酒精的平均价格（8克/10毫升）、每位成年人购买的酒精饮料数量，以及每位饮酒者消耗的酒精饮料数量。研究采用了2011年至2019年的年度酒精价格和销售数据，发现自实施最低单价政策后，所有饮料类别的每单位酒精价格均显著上升，而每位成年人及每位饮酒者购买的酒精饮料数量则有所下降，尤其是在啤酒、烈酒、苹果酒以及各类酒精饮料方面。在所有指标上，最低单价政策对线下酒精饮料的价格和销售影响更为显著，而在线上销售方面则未发现明显影响。这些结果在模型设定调整以及各种控制变量加入的情况下依然保持稳定。针对政策实施时间的调整进行的验证性测试并未发现显著结果。

abstract.text: Prior research has found that in states which expanded Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act, hospital Medicaid revenue rose sharply, and uncompensated care costs fell sharply, relative to hospitals in nonexpansion states. This suggests that Medicaid expansion may have been a boon for hospital revenue. We conduct a difference-in-differences analysis covering the first four expansion years (2014-2017) and confirm prior results for Medicaid revenue and uncompensated care cost, over this longer period. However, we find that hospitals in expansion states showed no significant relative gains in either total patient revenue or operating margins. Instead, the relative rise in Medicaid revenue was offset by relative declines in commercial insurance revenue. In subsample analyses, we find higher revenue and margins for rural hospitals in expansion states, little change for small urban hospitals, and a revenue decline for large urban hospitals.

10.1002/hec.4157.abstractZh: 先前的研究发现，在根据《平价医疗法案》扩大医疗补助政策的州，医院从医疗补助中获得的收入显著上升，而无补偿护理成本则显著下降，这一情况与未扩大医疗补助政策的州相比更为明显。这表明医疗补助政策的扩大可能对医院收入有所促进。我们进行了差异-差异分析，涵盖了最初四年的扩大政策实施期（2014-2017年），并确认了之前关于医疗补助收入和无补偿护理成本的研究结果。然而，我们发现，在扩大医疗补助政策的州，医院在总患者收入或运营利润率方面并没有显著的增长。相反，医疗补助收入的增加被商业保险收入的增加所抵消。在子样本分析中，我们发现扩大医疗补助政策的州农村医院的收入和利润率有所提高，小型城市医院的变化不大，而大型城市医院则出现了收入下降的情况。

abstract.text: Formal home care is an appropriate substitute for acute hospital care for many older people. However, limited empirical evidence exists on the extent of substitution between the supply of home care and hospital use. This study examines whether patients from areas with a better supply of home care have lower inpatient length of stay (LOS). We link administrative data on over 300,000 public hospital inpatient admissions in Ireland between 2012 and 2015 to region-year panel data on public home care supply. In addition to modeling average LOS, we estimate unconditional quantile regressions to examine whether home care supply has a disproportionately strong impact on long LOS. We find that inpatients from areas with higher per capita home care supply have lower average LOS; a 10% increase in home care is associated with a 1.2%-2.1% reduction in LOS. This result is driven by the subset of patients with the longest LOS, likely delayed discharges. Stronger results were found for stroke and hip fracture patients, who might be expected to have higher than average propensity to use home care services, and for patients from a region that experienced an unusually large increase in home care supply.

10.1002/hec.4158.abstractZh: 正式的居家护理对于许多老年人来说，是急性医院护理的合适替代方案。然而，关于居家护理与医院服务之间的替代程度，现有的实证证据有限。本研究旨在探讨在居家护理供应较好的地区，患者的住院时间是否较短。我们将2012年至2015年间爱尔兰超过30万例公立医院住院患者的行政数据与地区-年份面板数据相结合，以分析居家护理供应对住院时间的影响。除了对平均住院时间进行建模外，我们还通过无条件分位数回归来检验居家护理供应对长期住院时间的显著影响程度。研究发现，在人均居家护理供应较高的地区，患者的平均住院时间较短；居家护理供应增加10%，住院时间相应减少1.2%至2.1%。这一结果主要源于那些住院时间最长的患者群体，这些患者可能因延迟出院而面临较长的住院时间。对于中风和髋部骨折患者，以及那些居家护理供应显著增加地区的患者，我们发现居家护理的效用更为明显。

abstract.text: This study analyzes the relationship between the number of clinical trials in a disease area, the health losses from that disease, and the average income of people suffering from it. Average patient income appears strongly predictive of the number of clinical trials, whether funded by industry or not. We are able to precisely estimate the relationship between income and the number of trials and to identify both (a) the specific diseases that appear to be underfunded relative to their harm to human health and (b) the amount of additional funding required to bring innovation investment up to the present average.

10.1002/hec.4160.abstractZh: 本研究分析了某一疾病领域临床试验数量、该疾病造成的健康损失以及患者平均收入之间的关系。无论这些临床试验是否由企业资助，患者平均收入似乎都能强烈预测临床试验的数量。我们能够精确估计收入与临床试验数量之间的关系，并识别出以下两点：(a)那些相对于对人类健康的危害而言，资金不足的具体疾病；(b)将创新投资提升到当前平均水平所需的额外资金数额。

abstract.text: This study estimated the impact of reducing a capped low coinsurance rate for outpatient medicines to nil for low-income pensioners and disabled individuals in the Valencian Community (Spain). This reduction was implemented in January 2016 as a regional reform which modified the national cost-sharing reform adopted in July 2012. The impact of this intervention on the number of monthly prescriptions dispensed between July 2012 and December 2018 was estimated using two different approaches of the synthetic control method, the classical method and the method based on Bayesian structural time series. The estimates from both methods were similar, showing significant overall increases of 6.34% and 6.70% [95% credible interval: 4.05, 9.47], respectively in the number of prescriptions dispensed in this region. These results are similar to those of the previous studies indicating that reducing price from a small amount to zero discontinuously boosts demand. This evidence indicates that the impact of this intervention on the budget of the regional health service is far greater than the amount of the subsidy in the public budget. These results are useful for making accurate budgetary projections for similar eliminations of charges for low-income pensioners in the Spanish National Health Service.

10.1002/hec.4161.abstractZh: 本研究评估了将门诊药品的低比例共付率上限降至零对西班牙瓦伦西亚地区的低收入退休人员及残疾人士的影响。这一改革于2016年1月实施，是对2012年7月实施的全国费用分担改革的补充。研究采用两种不同方法——合成控制法、传统方法和基于贝叶斯结构时间序列的方法，来估算2012年7月至2018年12月期间该地区处方数量的变化情况。两种方法的估计结果相似，表明该地区的处方数量分别显著增加了6.34%和6.70% [95%可信区间：4.05, 9.47]。这些结果与先前的研究结果一致，表明将价格从较低水平突然降至零会显著增加需求。这一证据表明，该干预措施对地区卫生服务预算的影响远大于公共预算中补贴的金额。这些结果有助于为西班牙国家卫生服务系统中对低收入退休人员实施类似费用减免措施时做出准确的预算预测。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of a major earthquake that unexpectedly affected the Canterbury region of New Zealand on a wide-range of birth outcomes, including birth weight, gestational age, and an indicator of general newborn health. We control for observed and unobserved differences between pregnant women in the area affected by the earthquake and other pregnant women by including mother fixed effects in all of our regression models. We extend the previous literature by comparing the impact of the initial unexpected earthquake to the impacts of thousands of aftershocks that occurred in the same region over the 18 months following the initial earthquake. We find that exposure to these earthquakes reduced gestational age, increased the likelihood of having a late birth, and negatively affected newborn health-with the largest effects for earthquakes that occurred in the first and third trimesters of pregnancy. Our estimates are similar when we focus on just the impact of the initial earthquake or, in contrast, on all earthquakes controlling for endogenous location decisions using an instrumental variables approach. This suggests that the previous estimates in the literature that use this approach are likely unbiased and that treatment effects are homogenous in the population. We present supporting evidence that the likely channel for these adverse effects is maternal stress.

10.1002/hec.4162.abstractZh: 我们研究了新西兰坎特伯雷地区遭遇的重大地震对多种出生结果的影响，包括出生体重、妊娠年龄以及新生儿的整体健康状况。我们通过在所有回归模型中加入母亲固定效应，来控制受地震影响的地区与其他地区孕妇之间的差异。我们将最初发生的地震的影响与随后18个月内同一地区发生的数千次余震的影响进行了比较，从而扩展了相关文献的研究。研究发现，这些地震导致妊娠年龄缩短，早产的可能性增加，并对新生儿健康产生负面影响——其中在妊娠的第一和第三孕期发生的地震影响最为显著。当我们仅关注最初地震的影响，或者采用工具变量方法控制内生性位置决策后，我们的估计结果仍然相似。这表明，使用这种方法得到的文献中的估计值可能是无偏的，且治疗效果在人群中是均匀的。我们还提供了支持性证据，表明这些负面影响的潜在途径是母体压力。

abstract.text: In publicly funded health systems, waiting times act as a rationing mechanism that should be based on need rather than socioeconomic status. However, several studies suggest that individuals with higher socioeconomic status wait less. Using individual-level data from administrative registers, we estimate and explain socioeconomic inequalities in access to publicly funded care for seven planned hospital procedures in Denmark. For each procedure, we first estimate the association between patients' waiting time for health care and their socioeconomic status as measured by income and education, controlling for patient severity. Then, we investigate how much of the association remains after controlling for (i) other individual characteristics (patients' family status, labor market status, and country of origin) that may be correlated with income and education, (ii) possible selection due to patients' use of a waiting time guarantee, and (iii) hospital factors which allow us to disentangle whether inequalities in waiting times arise across hospitals or within the hospital. Only for a few procedures, we find inequalities in waiting times related to income and education. These inequalities can be explained mostly by geographical and institutional factors across hospitals. But we also find inequalities for some procedures in relation to non-Western immigrants within hospitals.

10.1002/hec.4163.abstractZh: 在公共资助的卫生系统中，等待时间作为一种配给机制，应该基于需求而非社会经济地位来分配。然而，多项研究表明，社会经济地位较高的个体等待时间较短。利用丹麦行政登记系统中的个体数据，我们估算并解释了在丹麦七项计划中的医院手术中，公共资助医疗服务的获取所存在的社会经济不平等现象。对于每项手术，我们首先估计了患者等待时间与其社会经济地位（通过收入和教育水平衡量）之间的关联，同时控制了患者的病情严重程度。然后，我们研究了在控制以下因素后，这种关联仍然存在多少：(i) 可能与收入和教育水平相关的其他个体特征（如患者的家庭状况、劳动力市场状况及原籍国)； (ii) 由于患者使用等待时间保障机制而导致的选择性；以及 (iii) 医院因素，这些因素有助于我们区分等待时间的不平等是发生在不同医院之间还是同一医院内部。只有少数几项手术，我们发现等待时间的不平等与收入和教育水平有关。这些不平等主要可以由医院之间的地理和制度因素来解释。但我们也发现，对于某些手术，医院内部非西方移民群体也存在等待时间的不平等现象。

abstract.text: Paid maternity leave is an essential component of a progressive society. It can enhance postnatal health, improve mother and child wellbeing, and deliver better labor market outcomes for mothers. We evaluate the impact of the introduction of Australia's national Paid Parental Leave (PPL) scheme in 2011 and complementary Dad and Partner Pay (DAPP) in 2013 on maternal mental health. Using a sample of 1480 births to eligible, partnered women between 2004 and 2016 and examining a range of mental health outcomes from the Household, Income, andLabour Dynamics in Australia survey, we find depression likelihood reduced significantly in post-reform years. When focusing on post-DAPP years and women whose partners had concurrent access to DAPP, significant mental health improvements were found across a wider range of measures including the Mental Component Summary score and specific Short Form-36 items with a high sensitivity for detecting major depression. Subgroup analysis suggests significant improvements applied specifically to first-time mothers and mothers with employer-paid maternity leave and unpaid leave entitlements. These results suggest that an increase in PPL and DAPP entitlements for mothers without access to employer-paid and unpaid leave entitlements, particularly those in less secure employment, may further reduce postnatal depression and improve health equity in Australia.

10.1002/hec.4164.abstractZh: 带薪产假是进步社会的重要组成部分。它能够提升产后健康，改善母亲和孩子的福祉，并为母亲带来更好的劳动力市场结果。我们评估了2011年澳大利亚全国带薪育儿假计划以及2013年补充性的父亲和伴侣薪酬政策的实施对母亲心理健康的影响。通过2004至2016年间1480例符合条件的伴侣女性分娩数据的分析，并结合《澳大利亚家庭、收入和劳动力动态调查》中的一系列心理健康指标，我们发现改革后的几年中，抑郁症的发生几率显著下降。当重点关注DAPP实施后的年份以及伴侣同时享有DAPP福利的女性时，我们发现包括心理健康综合评分和在检测重度抑郁症方面具有高度敏感性的特定简短量表36项指标在内的多个心理健康指标都显示出显著改善。子组分析表明，对于首次生育的母亲以及拥有雇主支付产假和无薪休假福利的母亲来说，这些改善尤为显著。这些结果表明，为那些没有获得雇主支付和无薪休假福利的母亲，尤其是那些就业不稳定的人群，增加带薪育儿假和伴侣薪酬福利的额度，可能会进一步减少产后抑郁症的发生，并改善澳大利亚的卫生公平状况。

abstract.text: Pharmacy acquisition costs for prescription (R x ) drugs have been trending below levels implied by the Bureau of Labor Statistics' (BLS) Consumer Price Index for R x drugs, with the divergence higher when generic approvals are high. Dropping the first 6 months of generic sales from price indices calculated from pharmacy acquisition costs eliminates most of the difference between such indices and BLS indices.

10.1002/hec.4165.abstractZh: 处方药（R x）的药品采购成本趋势低于劳工统计局（BLS）公布的处方药消费者价格指数所暗示的水平，而当仿制药获批数量较多时，这种差异更为明显。将仿制药销售的前6个月从基于药品采购成本计算的价格指数中剔除，就能消除这些指数与BLS指数之间的大部分差异。

abstract.text: This study analyzes the complexity of female longevity improvements. As socioeconomic status is found to influence health and mortality, we partition all individuals, at each age in every year, into five socioeconomic groups based on an affluence measure that combine an individual's income and wealth. We identify the particular socioeconomic groups that have been driving the standstill for Danish females at older ages. Within each socioeconomic group, we further analyze the cause of death patterns. The decline in life expectancy for Danish females is present for four out of five subgroups, however, with particular large decreases for the low-middle and middle-affluence groups. Cancers, smoking-related lung and bronchus causes, and other diseases particularly contribute to the stagnation. For four of the five socioeconomic groups only small cardiovascular improvement are experienced during the period of stagnating life expectancy compared to an equally long and subsequent period.

10.1002/hec.4166.abstractZh: 本研究分析了女性寿命延长的复杂性。由于社会经济状况会影响健康和死亡率，我们根据一个综合个人收入和财富的指标，将每个年龄段的个体划分为五个社会经济群体。我们确定了那些导致丹麦女性在老年阶段停滞不前的特定社会经济群体。在每个社会经济群体中，我们进一步分析了死亡模式的原因。在五个子群体中，有四个子群体的预期寿命下降，其中低中收入群体和中高收入群体的下降尤为明显。癌症、与吸烟相关的肺部和支气管疾病以及其他疾病对寿命停滞的贡献尤为显著。在五个社会经济群体中，有四个群体的预期寿命下降期间，心血管健康方面的改善幅度很小，与随后同样长的时期相比，情况并无改善。

abstract.text: Crowding in emergency departments (EDs) is increasing in many health systems. Previous studies of the relationship between crowding and care quality are limited by the use of data from single hospitals, a focus on particular patient groups, a focus on a narrow set of quality measures, and use of crowding measures which induce bias from unobserved hospital and patient characteristics. Using data from 139 hospitals covering all major EDss in England, we measure crowding using quasi-exogenous variation in the volume of EDs attendances and examine its impacts on indicators of performance across the entire EDs care pathway. We exploit variations from expected volume estimated using high-dimensional fixed effects capturing hospital-specific variation in attendances by combinations of month and hour-of-the-week. Unexpected increases in attendance volume result in substantially longer waiting times, lower quantity and complexity of care, more patients choosing to leave without treatment, changes in referral and discharge decisions, but only small increases in reattendances and no increase in mortality. Causal bounds under potential omitted variable bias are narrow and exclude zero for the majority of outcomes. Results suggest that physician and patient responses may largely mitigate the impacts of demand increases on patient outcomes in the short-run.

10.1002/hec.4167.abstractZh: 许多医疗系统的急诊科就诊人数正在增加。以往关于就诊人数与护理质量关系的研究受到以下因素的限制：使用单一医院的数据、仅关注特定患者群体、仅关注少数质量指标，以及使用可能导致医院和患者特征未被观察到的偏差的就诊人数指标。我们利用来自英格兰139家医院的数据，这些数据涵盖了所有主要的急诊科，通过急诊科就诊量的准外生变化来衡量就诊人数，并考察其对整个急诊科护理路径中各项指标的影响。我们通过使用高维固定效应来估计预期就诊量，这些固定效应能够捕捉到医院在月份和每周时间上的就诊量差异。意外的就诊量增加会导致等待时间显著延长、护理的数量和复杂性降低、更多患者选择不接受治疗而离开、转诊和出院决策发生变化，但再次就诊的人数仅略有增加，死亡率也没有上升。在潜在遗漏变量偏差的情况下，因果界限较窄，大多数结果的零值被排除在外。结果表明，医生和患者的反应可能在短期内大大减轻需求增加对患者结果的影响。

abstract.text: This paper assesses the economic efficiency of Brazilian general hospitals that provide inpatient care for the Unified Health System (SUS). We combined data envelopment analysis (DEA) and spatial analysis to identify predominant clusters, measure hospital inefficiency and analyze the spatial pattern of inefficiency throughout the country. Our findings pointed to a high level of hospital inefficiency, mostly associated with small size and distributed across all Brazilian states. Many of these hospitals could increase production and reduce inputs to achieve higher efficiency standards. These findings suggest room for optimization, but inequalities in access and the matching of demand and supply must be carefully considered in any attempt to reorganize the hospital system in Brazil.

10.1007/s10729-020-09505-5.abstractZh: 本文评估了为统一卫生系统提供住院服务的巴西综合医院的经济效率。我们结合数据包络分析（DEA）和空间分析，以确定主要集群、衡量医院效率低下的情况，并分析全国范围内效率低下的空间分布。研究发现，医院效率低下的情况较为普遍，主要与医院规模较小有关，且这种低效现象遍布巴西所有州。许多医院可以通过提高生产效率和减少投入来实现更高的效率标准。这些发现表明存在优化的空间，但在重新组织巴西医院体系的过程中，必须仔细考虑获取机会以及供需匹配方面的不平等问题。

abstract.text: This article proposes doubly robust estimators for the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) in difference-in-differences (DID) research designs. In contrast to alternative DID estimators, the proposed estimators are consistent if either (but not necessarily both) a propensity score or outcome regression working models are correctly specified. We also derive the semiparametric efficiency bound for the ATT in DID designs when either panel or repeated cross-section data are available, and show that our proposed estimators attain the semiparametric efficiency bound when the working models are correctly specified. Furthermore, we quantify the potential efficiency gains of having access to panel data instead of repeated cross-section data. Finally, by paying particular attention to the estimation method used to estimate the nuisance parameters, we show that one can sometimes construct doubly robust DID estimators for the ATT that are also doubly robust for inference. Simulation studies and an empirical application illustrate the desirable finite-sample performance of the proposed estimators. Open-source software for implementing the proposed policy evaluation tools is available.

10.1016/j.jeconom.2020.06.003.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种用于差分进化差分（DID）研究设计中平均处理效应估计的双稳健估计器。与其它DID估计器相比，所提出的估计器在 propensity score或结果回归工作模型正确指定的情况下是一致的（但不一定同时正确）。我们还推导了在存在面板数据或重复横截面数据时，DID设计中平均处理效应的半参数效率界限，并表明当工作模型正确指定时，所提出的估计器能够达到半参数效率界限。此外，我们量化了使用面板数据而非重复横截面数据的潜在效率提升。最后，通过特别关注用于估计干扰参数的估计方法，我们展示了有时可以构建出既具有双稳健性又具有双稳健推断能力的DID平均处理效应估计器。模拟研究和实证应用证明了所提出估计器的良好有限样本性能。实现所提出政策评估工具的开放源代码软件也已提供。

abstract.text: Blood donations are increasingly important for medical procedures, while meeting demand is challenging. This paper studies the role of spillovers arising from social interactions in the context of voluntary blood donations. We analyze a large-scale intervention among pairs of blood donors who live at the same street address. A quasi-random phone call provides the instrument for identifying the extent to which the propensity to donate spills over within these pairs. Spillovers transmit 41% to 46% of the behavioral impulse from one donor to the peer. This creates a significant social multiplier, ranging between 1.7 and 1.85. There is no evidence that these spillovers lead to intertemporal substitution. Taken together, our findings indicate that policy interventions have a substantially larger effect when targeted towards pairs instead of isolated individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102244.abstractZh: 献血对于医疗程序来说越来越重要，但满足需求却充满挑战。本文研究了社会互动所带来的溢出效应在自愿献血中的作用。我们分析了同一街道地址的献血者之间的大规模干预措施。通过随机电话联系的方式，我们评估了献血倾向在献血者之间的传播程度。研究发现，行为冲动有41%到46%的传播是通过这种溢出效应实现的。这产生了显著的社交乘数效应，介于1.7到1.85之间。没有证据表明这些溢出效应会导致时间上的替代行为。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，针对献血者配对进行政策干预比针对单个个体具有更大的效果。

abstract.text: This paper provides evidence that daily fluctuations in the stock market have important - and hitherto neglected - spillover effects on fatal car accidents. Using the universe of fatal car accidents in the United States from 1990 to 2015, we find that a one standard deviation reduction in daily stock market returns is associated with a 0.6% increase in fatal car accidents that happen after the stock market opening. A battery of falsification tests supports a causal interpretation of this finding. Our results are consistent with immediate emotions stirred by a negative stock market performance influencing the number of fatal accidents, in particular among inexperienced investors.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102245.abstractZh: 本文提供了证据，表明股市的日波动对致命车祸有着重要且被忽视的溢出效应。通过研究1990年至2015年美国致命车祸的数据，我们发现，股市日收益率下降一个标准差，与股市开盘后发生的致命车祸数量增加0.6%之间存在关联。一系列验证测试支持这一发现的因果解释。我们的结果与股市表现不佳引发的即时情绪对致命事故数量的影响一致，尤其是在缺乏经验的投资者中。

abstract.text: Economic theory predicts that a reduction in background risk should induce financial risk-taking, particularly for individuals with low stock market participation costs. Hence, health insurance coverage could affect financial risk-taking by offsetting health-related background risk. We use a regression discontinuity design to examine whether Medicare eligibility at age 65 increases stockholding in the US and find that it does so for those with college education, but not for their less-educated counterparts who face higher stock market participation costs. Our results are unlikely due to the reduction of medical expenses associated with Medicare coverage because the latter does not affect bondholding.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102246.abstractZh: 经济理论预测，背景风险的降低应该会刺激金融风险承担，尤其是对于那些股票市场参与成本较低的个体而言。因此，健康保险覆盖可能会通过抵消与健康相关的背景风险来影响金融风险承担。我们采用回归不连续设计来研究65岁时获得医疗保险资格是否会增加美国的股票持有量，结果发现，这一效应主要出现在受过大学教育的人群中，而在那些受教育程度较低、面临更高股票市场参与成本的人群中则没有这种效应。我们的研究结果不太可能是由于医疗保险覆盖减少了医疗费用，因为后者并不会影响债券持有量。

abstract.text: It is well-established that neonatal health is a strong predictor of socioeconomic outcomes later in life, but does neonatal health also predict key outcomes of the next generation? This paper documents a surprisingly strong relationship between birth weight of parents and school test scores of their children. The association between maternal birth weight and child test scores corresponds to 50-80 percent of the association between the child's own birth weight and test scores across various empirical specifications, for example including grandmother fixed effects that isolate within-family differences between mothers. Paternal and maternal birth weights are equally important in predicting child test scores. Our intergenerational results suggest that inequality in neonatal health is important for inequality in key outcomes of the next generation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102247.abstractZh: 已有充分证据表明，新生儿健康是日后社会经济状况的重要预测因素，但新生儿健康是否也能预测下一代的关键结果呢？本文发现，父母的新生儿体重与其子女的学校考试成绩之间存在显著的相关性。母亲的新生儿体重与子女考试成绩之间的关联，在多种实证分析中占到了50-80%的比例，这些分析包括使用祖母固定效应来消除家庭内部母亲之间的差异。父亲和母亲的新生儿体重在预测子女考试成绩方面同样重要。我们的代际研究表明，新生儿健康的不平等对于下一代关键结果的不平等具有重要影响。

abstract.text: While the main insurance sources for individuals with disability are understood, less is known about how family support interacts with federal disability benefits. Using the Health and Retirement Study matched to administrative records, I examine how disability benefits affect family support by comparing accepted and rejected disability applicants before and after benefit receipt. Receipt of disability insurance increases the probability of receiving any assistance from children by 18 percent and more than doubles the amount of in-kind assistance. Disability insurance also increases the probability that children are paid for their help and reduces children's labor supply. These findings are largest for low-income beneficiaries and those who recently lost a spouse, suggesting that child assistance complements income provided by disability insurance, and substitutes for other family assistance. Receipt of disability benefits allows the family to re-optimize how they provide support, and disability insurance is shared within the family in complementary ways.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102248.abstractZh: 虽然对于残疾人士的主要保险来源已有了解，但关于家庭支持与联邦残疾福利之间的相互作用却知之甚少。通过结合健康与退休研究的数据与行政记录，我研究了残疾福利如何影响家庭支持，通过比较领取福利前后的接受和拒绝的残疾申请人。获得残疾保险后，子女获得援助的概率增加了18%，实物援助的金额则增加了两倍以上。残疾保险还增加了子女获得报酬的可能性，并减少了子女的劳动力供给。这些发现对低收入受益人以及最近失去配偶的人尤为显著，这表明儿童援助补充了残疾保险提供的收入，并替代了其他家庭援助方式。获得残疾福利使家庭能够重新优化其提供支持的方式，而残疾保险则在家庭内部以互补的方式被共享。

abstract.text: Maternity leave policies are designed to safeguard the health of pregnant workers and their unborn children. We evaluate a maternity leave extension in Austria which increased mandatory prenatal leave from 6 to 8 weeks. We exploit that the assignment to the extended leave was determined by a cutoff date. We find no evidence for significant effects of this extension on children's health at birth or long-term health and labor market outcomes. Subsequent maternal health and fertility are also unaffected. We conclude that employment during the 33rd and 34th week of gestation is not harmful for expecting mothers (without major problems in pregnancy) and their unborn children.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102250.abstractZh: 产假政策旨在保障孕妇及其未出生孩子的健康。我们评估了奥地利的一项产假延长政策，该政策将强制产前休假时间从6周延长至8周。我们发现，休假时间的确定是基于一个截止日期。我们没有发现该政策对婴儿出生时的健康状况或长期健康及劳动力市场结果产生显著影响。后续的研究也表明，孕妇的健康状况和生育能力并未受到该政策的影响。因此，我们得出结论：在妊娠第33周和第34周期间继续工作，对于孕妇（且不存在严重的妊娠问题）及其未出生的孩子来说并无害处。

abstract.text: We use a set of biomarkers to measure inequality of opportunity (IOp) in the risk of major chronic conditions in the UK. Applying a direct ex ante IOp approach, we find that inequalities in biomarkers attributed to circumstances account for a non-trivial part of the total variation. For example, observed circumstances account for 20 % of the total inequalities in our composite measure of multi-system health risk, allostatic load. We propose an extension to the decomposition of ex ante IOp to complement the mean-based approach, analysing the contribution of circumstances across the quantiles of the biomarker distributions. Shapley decompositions show that, for most of the biomarkers, the percentage contribution of socioeconomic circumstances (education and childhood socioeconomic status), relative to differences attributable to age and gender, increase towards the right tail of the biomarker distribution, where health risks are more pronounced.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102251.abstractZh: 我们采用一组生物标志物来衡量英国在重大慢性疾病风险方面的机会不平等性。通过直接的事前机会不平等性分析方法，我们发现由环境因素导致的生物标志物差异在总变异中占有不可忽视的比例。例如，观察到的环境因素在我们综合的多系统健康风险指标——全稳态负荷中，占到了总不平等性的20%。我们提出了一种对事前机会不平等性分解方法的扩展，以补充基于均值的方法，分析环境因素在生物标志物分布各分位数上的贡献。Shapley分解结果显示，对于大多数生物标志物而言，社会经济环境因素（如教育和童年社会经济地位）对健康风险的贡献比例，相对于年龄和性别导致的差异而言，在生物标志物分布的右侧尾部会增加，而这一区域的健康风险更为显著。

abstract.text: We study the causal impact of education on chronic health conditions by exploitng two UK education policy reforms. The first reform raised the minimum school leaving age in 1972 and affected the lower end of the educational attainment distribution. The second reform is a combination of several policy changes that affected the broader educational attainment distribution in the early 1990s. Results are consistent across both reforms: an extra year of schooling has no statistically identifiable impact on the prevalence of most chronic health conditions. The exception is that both reforms led to a statistically significant reduction in the probability of having diabetes, and this result is robust across model specifications. However, even with the largest survey samples available in the UK, we are unable to statistically rule out moderate size educational effects for many of the other health conditions, although we generally find considerably smaller effects than OLS associations suggest.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102252.abstractZh: 我们研究了教育对慢性健康状况的因果影响，通过分析英国的两项教育政策改革。第一项改革在1972年提高了最低离校年龄，影响了教育成就分布的下限。第二项改革是多项政策变化的组合，影响了20世纪90年代初更广泛的教育成就分布。两项改革的结果是一致的：多学一年对大多数慢性健康状况的患病率没有统计学上可识别的影响。例外的是，这两项改革都显著降低了患糖尿病的概率，这一结果在不同模型设定下都是稳健的。然而，即使使用英国最大的调查样本，我们也无法在统计学上排除其他许多健康状况的中等规模教育效应，尽管我们通常发现的效应比OLS分析所提示的要小得多。

abstract.text: Medical treatment reduces diagnostic risk, increases therapeutic risk and lowers the probability of death. This paper analyzes the effects of initial health, wealth and the probability of death on the propensity to treat under diagnostic and therapeutic risk. It shows that treatment propensity increases with the probability of death, but can decrease with the severity of illness. The effect of wealth depends on the cross-derivative of the utility function with respect to health and wealth. These results have implications for treatment decisions at the end of life.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102253.abstractZh: 医疗治疗可以降低诊断风险，增加治疗风险，并降低死亡概率。本文分析了初始健康状况、财富水平以及死亡概率对在诊断和治疗风险下治疗倾向的影响。研究表明，治疗倾向随着死亡概率的增加而增加，但随着疾病严重程度的增加而减少。财富的影响取决于效用函数与健康和财富相关的交叉导数。这些结果对临终时的治疗决策具有启示意义。

abstract.text: Geographic variation in health care utilization has raised concerns of possible inefficiencies in health care supply, as differences are often not reflected in health outcomes. Using comprehensive Norwegian microdata, we exploit cross-region migration to analyze regional variation in health care utilization. Our results indicate that place factors account for half of the difference in utilization between high and low utilization regions, while the rest reflects patient demand. We further document heterogeneous impacts of place across socioeconomic groups. Place factors account for 75% of the regional utilization difference for high school dropouts, and 40% for high school graduates; for patients with a college degree, the impact of place is negligible. We find no statistically significant association between the estimated place effects and overall mortality. However, we document a negative association between place effects and utilization-intensive causes of death such as cancer, suggesting high-supply regions may achieve modestly improved health outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102254.abstractZh: 地理差异对医疗利用的影响引发了人们对医疗供应可能效率低下问题的担忧，因为这些差异往往不会反映在健康结果上。我们利用挪威的综合性微观数据，通过跨地区迁移来分析医疗利用的区域差异。研究结果表明，地点因素占高利用区与低利用区之间利用差异的一半，其余部分则反映了患者需求的影响。我们还发现，不同社会经济群体对地点因素的影响存在差异。对于高中辍学者，地点因素占区域利用差异的75%，而对于高中毕业生则占40%；对于拥有大学学位的患者，地点因素的影响可以忽略不计。我们没有发现估计出的地点效应与总体死亡率之间存在统计学上的显著关联。然而，我们发现地点效应与癌症等高利用度死亡原因之间存在负相关关系，这表明高供应地区可能能够实现较为改善的健康结果。

abstract.text: I provide plausibly causal estimates of the effect of birth weight using data from the universe of twins, triplets, and quadruplets born between 1995 and 2000 in the United States. Infants from higher-order multiple births have lower birth weights, but experience smaller reductions in infant health when they are low birth weight. OLS estimates using a rich set of controls show that this result holds when comparing singletons to multiples and when analyzing historical data from before the widespread use of in vitro fertilization. These results suggest that the paradox of low birth weight remains even after controlling for unobserved maternal heterogeneity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102255.abstractZh: 我利用1995年至2000年间在美国出生的双胞胎、三胞胎和四胞胎的数据，得出了关于出生体重影响的合理因果估计。多胞胎婴儿的出生体重较低，但在低出生体重的情况下，他们的婴儿健康状况的下降幅度较小。通过丰富的控制变量进行的OLS估计表明，这一结果在比较单胎和多胎婴儿时仍然成立，并且在分析体外受精技术广泛应用之前的历史数据时同样适用。这些结果表明，即使在控制了未观察到的母体异质性之后，低出生体重的悖论仍然存在。

abstract.text: While several studies suggest that stress-related mental health problems among school children are related to specific elements of schooling, empirical evidence on this causal relationship is scarce. We examine a German schooling reform that increased weekly instruction time and study its effects on stress-related outpatient diagnoses from the universe of health claims data of the German Social Health Insurance. Exploiting the differential timing in the reform implementation across states, we show that the reform slightly increased stress-related health problems among school children. While increasing instruction time might increase student performance, it might have adverse effects in terms of additional stress.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102256.abstractZh: 虽然多项研究表明，学龄儿童中的压力相关心理健康问题与学校的某些因素有关，但关于这种因果关系的实证证据却十分有限。我们研究了一项德国教育改革，该改革增加了每周的教学时间，并探讨了这一变化对压力相关门诊诊断的影响。通过利用各州改革实施时间的差异，我们发现这项改革略微增加了学龄儿童的压力相关健康问题。虽然增加教学时间可能会提高学生的成绩，但也可能带来额外的压力，从而产生不利影响。

abstract.text: We investigate whether social interactions among pregnant women can lead to increased Medicaid participation within this population. Using geographically fine vital statistics data, we exploit variation in Medicaid use among recently pregnant mothers, within small neighborhoods, to study the impact on participation among currently pregnant women. Women are more likely to use Medicaid benefits while pregnant including prenatal care, when previously pregnant women on their census block also received similar benefits. Network effects are relatively larger for young first-time mothers as well as for women within neighborhoods with lower initial levels of welfare program knowledge.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102257.abstractZh: 我们研究孕妇之间的社会互动是否会导致该群体中的医疗补助使用率增加。利用地理上精细的统计数据，我们分析了近期怀孕的母亲在小型社区内的医疗补助使用差异，以研究这对当前怀孕妇女的影响。当所在街区内的先前怀孕妇女也享受过类似的医疗补助福利时，怀孕妇女在怀孕期间更有可能使用医疗补助福利，包括产前护理。对于首次成为母亲的女性以及那些在福利项目知识方面初始水平较低的社区内的女性来说，网络效应相对更为显著。

abstract.text: We show that sleep deprivation exerts strong negative effects on mothers' labour market performance. To isolate variations in maternal sleep, we exploit unique variations in child sleep disruption using a UK panel dataset that follows mother-child pairs through time. We find that sleeping one hour less per night on average significantly decreases maternal labour force participation, the number of hours worked and household income. We identify one mechanism driving the effects, namely the influence of maternal sleep on selection into full-time versus part-time work. Increased schedule flexibility for mothers with sufficient tenure mitigates the negative effects of sleep deprivation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102258.abstractZh: 我们表明，睡眠不足对母亲的劳动力市场表现有强烈的负面影响。为了分离出母亲睡眠状况的变化，我们利用了一个英国面板数据集，该数据集记录了母子关系随时间的变化情况，从而捕捉到儿童睡眠中断的独特变化。研究发现，每晚平均少睡一小时会显著降低母亲的劳动力参与率、工作小时数以及家庭收入。我们确定了一种影响这种效应的机制，即母亲睡眠状况对选择全职或兼职工作的影响。对于拥有足够工作年限的母亲来说，增加工作安排的灵活性可以减轻睡眠不足带来的负面影响。

abstract.text: The Great Recession in Europe sparked concerns that the crisis would lead to increased income related health inequalities (IRHI). Did this come to pass, and what role, if any, did government transfers play in the evolution of these inequalities? Motivated by these questions, this paper seeks to (i) study the evolution of IRHI during the crisis, and (ii) decompose these evolutions to examine the separate roles of government versus market transfers. Using panel data for 7 EU countries from 2004 to 2013, we find no evidence that IRHI persistently rose after 2008, even in countries most affected by the crisis. Our decomposition reveals that, while the health of the poorest did indeed worsen during the crisis, IRHI were prevented from increasing by the relative stickiness of old age pension benefits compared to the market incomes of younger groups. Austerity measures weakened the IRHI reducing effect of government transfers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102259.abstractZh: 欧洲的大衰退引发了人们对危机会导致收入相关健康不平等加剧的担忧。这种情况是否真的发生了？如果有的话，政府转移支付在这些不平等的演变中扮演了什么角色？基于这些问题，本文旨在：(i)研究危机期间收入相关健康不平等的演变情况；(ii)通过分解数据来考察政府转移支付与市场转移支付各自的作用。利用2004至2013年间7个欧盟国家的面板数据，我们发现即使在受危机影响最严重的国家，2008年之后收入相关健康不平等也没有持续上升。我们的分析还显示，虽然最贫困群体的健康状况在危机期间确实恶化，但由于老年养老金福利相对于年轻群体的市场收入具有相对粘性，收入相关健康不平等的加剧得到了抑制。紧缩政策削弱了政府转移支付对收入相关健康不平等的缓解作用。

abstract.text: We experimentally evaluated the effects of in-kind team incentives on health worker performance in El Salvador, with 38 out of 75 community health teams randomly assigned to performance incentives over a 12-month period. All teams received monitoring, performance feedback and recognition for their achievements allowing us to isolate the effect of the incentive. While both treatment and control groups exhibit improvements in performance measures over time, the in-kind incentives generated significant improvements in community outreach, quality of care, timeliness of care, and utilization of maternal and child health services after 12 months. Gains were largest for teams at the bottom and top of the baseline performance distribution. We find no evidence of results being driven by changes in reporting or by shifting away effort from non-contracted outcomes. These results suggest that in-kind team incentives may be a viable alternative to monetary or individual incentives in certain contexts.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102267.abstractZh: 我们通过实验评估了实物团队激励对萨尔瓦多卫生工作者绩效的影响。在12个月的时间里，75个社区卫生团队中被随机分配了38个团队接受绩效激励。所有团队都获得了监测、绩效反馈以及对其成就的认可，这使我们能够分离出激励的效果。虽然实验组和对照组在绩效指标上随时间都有所改善，但实物激励在12个月后显著提高了社区宣传、护理质量、护理及时性以及母婴健康服务利用率。在基线绩效分布中处于最低和最高位置的团队获益最大。我们没有发现结果是由报告方式的变化或努力从非合同目标转移所驱动的。这些结果表明，在某些情境下，实物团队激励可能是货币或个人激励的一种可行替代方案。

abstract.text: While less-educated women are more likely to give birth as teenagers, there is scant evidence the relationship is causal. We investigate this possibility using variation in compulsory schooling laws (CSLs) to identify the impact of formal education on teen fertility at specific ages for a large sample of women drawn from multiple waves of the Canadian Census. We find large negative impacts of education on births for young women aged seventeen and eighteen, but less systematic evidence of an effect after these ages. While our findings are consistent with an "incarceration effect", where school enrollment deters fertility in a contemporaneous manner, we cannot rule out longer-run effects of education on fertility.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102268.abstractZh: 虽然受教育程度较低的女性更可能在青少年时期生育，但几乎没有证据表明这种关系是因果关系。我们通过研究不同地区的义务教育法差异，来探讨正规教育对青少年生育率的影响。我们选取了加拿大人口普查的多轮数据，对大量女性的生育情况进行了分析。研究发现，对于17岁和18岁的年轻女性来说，教育对生育有显著的负面影响，但超过这个年龄后，这种影响就不那么明显了。虽然我们的研究结果与“学校入学抑制生育”的观点一致，但我们无法排除教育对生育的长期影响。

abstract.text: We revisit the causal effect of birthweight. Because variation in birthweight in developed countries primarily stems from variation in gestational age rather than intrauterine growth restriction, we depart from the widely-used twin fixed-effects estimator and employ an instrumental variable - the diagnosis of placenta previa, which provides exogenous variation in gestation length. We find protective effects of additional birthweight against infant mortality and health capital loss, such as cerebral palsy, but in contrast to sibling and twin studies, no strong evidence for non-health long-run outcomes, such as test scores. We also find that short-run birthweight effects have diminished significantly over the decades.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102269.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了出生体重的因果效应。由于发达国家出生体重的差异主要源于妊娠年龄的差异，而非宫内生长受限，因此我们采用了一种不同于传统双生子固定效应估计方法的工具变量方法——胎盘前置的诊断，这一诊断可以人为地引入妊娠长度的变化。我们发现，额外的出生体重对婴儿死亡率以及健康资本的损失（如脑瘫）具有保护作用。但与兄弟姐妹和双生子研究不同的是，我们没有发现长期影响，如考试成绩方面的显著证据。此外，我们还发现，近几十年来，出生体重的短期影响显著减弱。

abstract.text: We examine sources of regional variation in ambulatory care utilization in Germany. We exploit patient migration to examine which share of regional variation in ambulatory care utilization can be attributed to demand factors and to supply factors, respectively. Based on administrative claim-level data we find that regional variation can be overwhelmingly explained by patient characteristics. Our results contrast with previous results for other countries, and they suggest that institutional rules in Germany successfully constrain supply-side variation in ambulatory care use between German regions for most patients. Furthermore, we find that both demographics and other patient characteristics substantially contribute to regional variation and that causes of regional variation vary when comparing different regions within Germany.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102271.abstractZh: 我们研究了德国地区间门诊护理利用差异的来源。通过利用患者迁移数据，我们分析了门诊护理利用的地区差异中，有多少可以归因于需求因素，又有多少可以归因于供应因素。基于行政索赔级别的数据，我们发现地区间的差异在很大程度上可以由患者特征来解释。我们的结果与其他国家的研究结果不同，这表明德国的制度规则成功地限制了大多数患者在不同地区之间的门诊护理利用的供应侧差异。此外，我们发现人口统计特征和其他患者特征都对地区间的差异有显著贡献，而且在不同地区之间比较时，导致地区差异的原因也有所不同。

abstract.text: We explore whether the composition of the physician workforce is impacted by the clinical standards imposed on physicians under medical liability rules. Specifically, we explore whether the proportion of non-surgeons practicing in a region decreases-and thus whether the proportion of surgeons increases-when liability standards are modified so as to expect that physicians practice more intensively. For these purposes, we draw on a quasi-experiment made possible by states shifting from local to national customs as the basis for setting liability standards. Using data from the Area Health Resource File from 1977 to 2005, we find that the rate of non-surgeons among practicing physicians decreases by 2-2.4 log points (or by 1.4-1.7 percentage points) following the adoption of national-standard laws in initially low surgery-rate regions-i.e., following a change in the law that effectively expects physicians to increase their use of surgical approaches.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102272.abstractZh: 我们探讨医生队伍的组成是否受到医疗责任规则对医生临床标准的限制。具体来说，我们研究当责任标准被修改，以期望医生更加密集地执业时，某一地区非外科医生的比例是否会下降，从而外科医生的比例是否会上升。为此，我们采用了一种基于州从地方标准转向国家标准来制定责任标准的准实验方法。利用1977年至2005年的地区健康资源文件数据，我们发现，在最初手术率较低的地区，随着采用国家标准法律，执业医生中非外科医生的比例下降了2-2.4个对数点（即1.4-1.7个百分点），这意味着法律的变化实际上期望医生更多地使用手术方法。

abstract.text: While recent research has shown that cannabis access laws can reduce the use of prescription opioids, the effect of these laws on opioid use is not well understood for all dimensions of use and for the general United States population. Analyzing a dataset of over 1.5 billion individual opioid prescriptions between 2011 and 2018, which were aggregated to the individual provider-year level, we find that recreational and medical cannabis access laws reduce the number of morphine milligram equivalents prescribed each year by 11.8 and 4.2 percent, respectively. These laws also reduce the total days' supply of opioids prescribed, the total number of patients receiving opioids, and the probability a provider prescribes any opioids net of any offsetting effects. Additionally, we find consistent evidence that cannabis access laws have different effects across types of providers, physician specialties, and payers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102273.abstractZh: 虽然最近的研究表明，大麻获取法律可以减少处方阿片类药物的使用，但这些法律对阿片类药物使用的效果在各个方面以及对于整个美国人口来说仍不甚明了。通过对2011年至2018年间超过15亿份个人阿片类药物处方的分析，这些数据被汇总到每个提供者的年度水平，我们发现，娱乐性和医疗性大麻获取法律分别使每年开具的吗啡毫克当量减少了11.8%和4.2%。这些法律还减少了阿片类药物的总使用天数、接受阿片类药物的患者总数，以及提供者开具任何阿片类药物的概率，同时考虑到其他可能的抵消因素。此外，我们发现大麻获取法律在不同类型的提供者、医生专业领域以及支付者之间具有不同的影响。

abstract.text: Late childhood and adolescence is a critical time for social and emotional development. Over the past two decades, this life stage has been hugely affected by the almost universal adoption of the internet as a source of information, communication, and entertainment. We use a large representative sample of over 6300 children in England over the period 2012-2017, to estimate the effect of neighbourhood broadband speed, as a proxy for internet use, on a number of wellbeing outcomes, which reflect how these children feel about different aspects of their life. We find that internet use is negatively associated with wellbeing across a number of domains. The strongest effect is for how children feel about their appearance, and the effects are worse for girls than boys. We test a number of potential causal mechanisms, and find support both for the 'crowding out' hypothesis, whereby internet use reduces the time spent on other beneficial activities, and for the adverse effect of social media use. Our evidence adds weight to the already strident calls for interventions that can reduce the adverse effects of internet use on children's emotional health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102274.abstractZh: 童年晚期和青春期是社会和情感发展的关键时期。在过去二十年里，这一生命阶段受到了互联网作为信息、通信和娱乐来源的普遍采用的巨大影响。我们选取了2012至2017年间英格兰超过6300名儿童的样本，来研究社区宽带速度这一互联网使用指标对多个健康结果的影响，这些结果反映了这些儿童对生活不同方面的感受。研究发现，互联网使用与多个领域的健康状况呈负相关。其中，对儿童外貌的感受最为显著，且这种影响在女孩身上比男孩更为严重。我们测试了多种潜在的因果机制，并发现支持“挤出假说”以及社交媒体使用的负面影响。我们的研究结果进一步强调了需要采取干预措施，以减少互联网使用对儿童情绪健康的负面影响。

abstract.text: Unexpected negative health shocks of a parent may reduce adult children's labour supply via informal caregiving and stress-induced mental health problems. We link administrative data on labour market outcomes, hospitalisations and family relations for the full Dutch working age population for the years 1999-2008 to evaluate the effect of an unexpected parental hospitalisation on the probability of employment and on conditional earnings. Using an event study difference-in-differences model combined with coarsened exact matching and individual fixed effects, we find no effect of an unexpected parental hospitalisation on either employment or earnings for Dutch men and women, and neither for the full population nor for the subpopulations most likely to become caregivers. These findings suggest that the extensive public coverage of formal long-term care in the Netherlands combined with widespread acceptance of part-time work provides sufficient opportunities to deal with adverse health events of family members without having to compromise one's labour supply.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102275.abstractZh: 父母意外的健康危机可能会通过非正式的照顾工作和压力引起的心理健康问题，降低成年子女的劳动供给。我们利用了1999至2008年间荷兰全体劳动年龄人口的劳动力市场结果、住院情况以及家庭关系等行政数据，来评估父母意外住院对就业概率和条件收入的影响。通过事件研究差异-差异模型结合粗略的精确匹配和个体固定效应分析，我们发现意外的父母住院对荷兰男女的就业或收入都没有影响，对全体人口以及最有可能承担照顾责任的子群体也是如此。这些发现表明，荷兰广泛的正式长期护理公共覆盖政策，加上对兼职工作的广泛接受，为家庭成员应对健康危机提供了足够的机会，而无需牺牲劳动供给。

abstract.text: Based on a survey of a sample of the general public, we estimate inequality aversion across income, health, and bivariate income-health. Inequality aversion is domain specific: mean inequality aversion is greater for income than for health, but the underlying distributions of aversion attitudes differ, with a highly bi-modal distribution of inequality-aversion values for health in which nearly half the participants display very low aversion and nearly half display very high aversion. Aversion to income-related health inequality is greater than that to income or health alone. Consistent with previous literature, we find only weak associations between aversion attitudes and individual characteristics. The magnitude of the estimates implies potentially large gains in welfare from reducing inequality in these domains.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102276.abstractZh: 通过对普通公众样本的调查，我们估计了收入、健康以及收入-健康双变量方面的不平等厌恶程度。不平等厌恶具有领域特异性：与健康相比，收入方面的不平等厌恶均值更高，但厌恶态度的分布有所不同，健康方面的不平等厌恶值呈现出高度双峰分布，近一半的参与者表现出非常低的厌恶程度，而另一半则表现出非常高的厌恶程度。对收入相关健康不平等的厌恶程度高于对收入或健康本身的厌恶程度。与以往的研究一致，我们发现厌恶态度与个人特征之间仅存在较弱的关联。估计值的大小表明，减少这些领域的不平等可能会带来巨大的福利收益。

abstract.text: We derive optimal rules for paying hospitals for non-emergency care when providers choose quality and capacity, and patient demand is rationed by waiting time. Waiting for treatment is costly for patients, so that hospital payment rules should take account of their effect on waiting time as well as on quality. Since deterministic waiting time models imply that profit maximising hospitals will never choose to have both positive quality and positive waiting time, we develop a stochastic model of rationing by waiting in which both quality and expected waiting are positive in equilibrium. We use it to show that, although a prospective output price gives hospitals an incentive to attract patients by raising quality and reducing waiting times, it must be supplemented by a price attached to hospital decisions on quality or capacity or to a performance indicator which depends on those decisions (such as average waiting time, or average length of stay). A prospective output price by itself can support the optimal quality and waiting time distribution only if the welfare function respects patient preferences over quality and waiting time, if patients' marginal rates of substitution between quality and waiting time are independent of income, and if waiting for treatment does not reduce the productivity of patients. If these conditions do not hold, supplementing the output price with a reward linked to the hospital's cost can increase welfare, though it is possible that costs should be taxed rather than subsidised.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102277.abstractZh: 我们推导出了在医疗服务提供者选择质量和容量，而患者需求通过等待时间进行配给的情况下，对非紧急护理支付医院费用的最优规则。等待治疗对患者来说成本很高，因此医院支付规则应考虑到其对等待时间和质量的影响。由于确定性等待时间模型表明，追求利润最大化的医院永远不会选择同时拥有积极的质量和积极的等待时间，我们开发了一个随机模型，用于通过等待进行配给，在均衡状态下质量和预期等待时间都是正的。我们利用该模型表明，尽管预期产出价格能够激励医院通过提高质量和减少等待时间来吸引患者，但还必须加上与医院对质量或容量的决策相关的价格，或者与这些决策相关的绩效指标（如平均等待时间或平均住院时间）。只有在这些条件下，预期产出价格才能支持最优的质量和等待时间分布：福利函数尊重患者对质量和等待时间的偏好，患者对质量和等待时间的边际替代率与收入无关，以及等待治疗不会降低患者的生产力。如果这些条件不成立，那么用与医院成本相关的奖励来补充产出价格可以提高福利，尽管可能需要对成本征税而不是补贴。

abstract.text: Despite a vast literature on the determinants of prescription opioid use, the role of health insurance plans has received little attention. We study how the form of Medicare beneficiaries' drug coverage affects the volume of opioids they consume. We find that enrollment in Medicare Advantage, which integrates drug coverage with other medical benefits, significantly reduces beneficiaries' likelihood of filling an opioid prescription, as compared to enrollment in a stand-alone drug plan. Approximately half of this effect was due to fewer fills from prescribers who write a very large number of opioid prescriptions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102278.abstractZh: 尽管关于处方阿片类药物使用决定因素的文献非常丰富，但健康保险计划的作用却鲜被关注。我们研究了Medicare受益人的药物覆盖形式对其阿片类药物消费量的影响。研究发现，与单独的药物计划相比，参加Medicare Advantage计划（该计划将药物覆盖与其他医疗福利相结合）显著降低了受益人填写阿片类药物处方的可能性。大约一半的这种效果是由于开具大量阿片类处方的医生减少了受益人的处方数量所致。

abstract.text: U.S. emergency departments are experiencing extreme levels of crowding. This study estimates the impact of emergency department crowding on patient mortality. Identification relies on the abrupt crowding shocks felt by "old" emergency departments at the time a new emergency department opens nearby. Using death records linked to hospital administrative records, I find that a 10% alleviation of emergency department patient volume significantly lowers the average patient's chance of mortality. Improvements appear to be realized both inside the hospital and after the patient has left.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102279.abstractZh: 美国的急诊部门正面临严重的拥挤问题。本研究估计了急诊部门拥挤对患者死亡率的影响。研究基于“老”急诊部门在附近新急诊部门开业时感受到的突然拥挤冲击来进行分析。通过结合医院行政记录与死亡记录，我发现急诊部门患者数量的减少10%，可以显著降低平均患者的死亡风险。这种改善不仅发生在医院内部，也在患者离开医院后持续显现。

abstract.text: Between 1980 and 2015, Mexican immigration to the United States and the share of Mexican immigrants in the labor force quintupled. We provide the first evidence examining whether this impacted one element of the work environment for native workers: workplace safety. To account for endogeneity and ensure that the change in Mexican immigration arose from supply shifts, we use 2SLS and instrumental variables. We show Mexican immigration over this period led natives to work in safer jobs; resulted in fewer workplace injuries for natives; and reduced WC benefit claims overall, which had a meaningful impact on employer costs for WC.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102280.abstractZh: 在1980年至2015年间，墨西哥移民到美国的数量以及墨西哥移民在劳动力中的比例增加了五倍。我们首次提供了证据，探讨这一现象是否影响了本土工人的工作环境中的一个要素：工作场所的安全。为了考虑内生性问题，并确保墨西哥移民数量的变化是由供给变化引起的，我们采用了2SLS方法和工具变量分析。研究表明，在此期间，墨西哥移民的涌入使得本土工人从事更安全的工作；本土工人的工作场所受伤人数减少；整体上，工伤赔偿的索赔数量也有所减少，这对雇主的工伤成本产生了显著影响。

abstract.text: We investigate when and how health shocks reverberate across the life cycle and down to descendants in a manual labor economy by examining the association of war wounds with the socioeconomic status and older age mortality of US Civil War (1861-5) veterans and of their adult children. Younger veterans who had been severely wounded in the war left the farm sector, becoming laborers. Consistent with human capital and job matching models, older severely wounded men were unlikely to switch sectors and their wealth declined by 37-46%. War wounds were correlated with children's socioeconomic and mortality outcomes in ways dependent on sex and paternal age group.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102281.abstractZh: 我们研究了在手工劳动经济中，健康冲击何时以及如何影响整个生命周期及后代，通过研究战争伤势与美国内战（1861-5年）退伍军人及其成年子女的社会经济地位和老年死亡率之间的关联。在战争中遭受严重伤势的年轻退伍军人离开了农业部门，成为了劳动者。与人力资本和就业匹配模型一致，年长的严重受伤男性不太可能转换行业，他们的财富减少了37-46%。战争伤势与儿童的社会经济状况和死亡率结果之间存在相关性，这种相关性取决于性别和父辈的年龄组。

abstract.text: Universal Health Coverage (UHC) has become a key goal of health policy in many developing countries. However, implementing UHC poses tough policy choices about: what treatments to provide (the depth of coverage); to what proportion of the population (the breadth of coverage); at what price to patients (the height of coverage). This paper uses a theoretical mathematical programming model to derive analytically the optimal balance between the range of services provided and the proportion of the population covered under UHC, using the general principles of cost-effectiveness analysis. In contrast to most CEA, the model allows for variations in both the costs of provision and the social benefits of treatments, depending on the deprivation level of the population. We illustrate empirically the optimal trade-off between the size of the benefits package and the proportion of the population securing access to each treatment for a hypothetical East African country, based on WHO data on the costs and benefits of treatments at different coverage levels. We begin with a scenario allowing coverage levels to vary, then apply differential equity weights to the benefits of coverage, and finally illustrate a scenario where interventions are either provided at 95% coverage or not at all (as is usually done in health benefits package design) for comparison. The results present the optimal trade-off between the social benefits of pursuing full population coverage, at the expense of expanding the benefits package for 'easier to reach' populations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102282.abstractZh: 全民健康覆盖已成为许多发展中国家卫生政策的关键目标。然而，实施全民健康覆盖需要做出艰难的政策选择，包括：提供哪些治疗服务（覆盖的深度）；覆盖多少人口（覆盖的广度）；患者需支付多少费用（覆盖的性价比）。本文采用理论数学规划模型，通过分析推导出在成本效益分析的一般原则下，提供服务的范围与全民健康覆盖覆盖人口比例之间的最佳平衡。与大多数成本效益分析不同，该模型允许根据人口的贫困程度，调整提供服务的成本和治疗的社会效益。我们基于世界卫生组织关于不同覆盖水平下治疗成本和效益的数据，对一个假设的东非国家进行了实证分析，探讨福利套餐规模与获得每种治疗服务的人口比例之间的最佳权衡。我们首先设定覆盖水平可以变化的情景，然后对覆盖带来的福利应用不同的公平权重，最后模拟了干预措施在95%覆盖水平下是否实施的情况，以作比较。研究结果展示了在追求全民覆盖的社会效益与为“更容易接触”的人群扩大福利套餐之间的最佳权衡。

abstract.text: We study the behavioral changes caused by marijuana use on sexual activity, contraception, and birth counts by applying a differences-in-differences approach that exploits the variation in timing of the introduction of medical marijuana laws (MMLs) among states. We find that MMLs cause an increase in sexual activity, a reduction in contraceptive use conditional on having sex, and an increase in number of births. There is also suggestive evidence on temporary increases in the state-year gonorrhea rate. These changes may be attributed to behavioral responses including increased attention to the immediate hedonic effects of sexual contact, increased sexual frequency, as well as delayed discounting and ignoring the future costs associated with sex. Our findings on births suggest that behavioral factors can counteract the physiological changes from marijuana use that tend to decrease fertility. Our findings are robust to a broad set of tests.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102283.abstractZh: 我们研究了大麻使用对性行为、避孕措施和出生数量的影响，采用了差异差异法来分析各州在医疗大麻法律实施时间上的差异。研究发现，医疗大麻法律的实施会导致性行为增加、有性行为时避孕措施的减少，以及出生数量的增加。此外，还有迹象表明该法律可能导致州级年度淋病发病率的暂时上升。这些变化可能是由于行为反应导致的，包括更加关注性接触带来的即时愉悦感、性行为的频率增加，以及延迟对性行为未来成本的考虑。关于出生数量的研究结果表明，行为因素可以抵消大麻使用导致的生理变化对生育能力的影响。我们的研究结果在一系列测试中均具有稳健性。

abstract.text: Since Wakefield et al. (1998), the public was exposed to mixed information surrounding the claim that measles-mumps-rubella vaccine causes autism. A persistent trend to delay the vaccination during 1998-2011 in the US was driven by children of college-educated mothers, suggesting that these mothers held biases against the vaccine influenced by the early unfounded claim. Consistent with confirmatory bias, exposures to negative information about the vaccine strengthened their biases more than exposures to positive information attenuated them. Positive online information, however, had strong impacts on vaccination decisions, suggesting that online dissemination of vaccine-safety information may help tackle the sticky misinformation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102284.abstractZh: 自Wakefield等人（1998年）的研究以来，公众对于麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹疫苗导致自闭症的说法产生了混合性的信息认知。在1998年至2011年期间，美国出现了一个持续的趋势，即儿童在大学教育背景的母亲家庭中推迟接种疫苗。这表明这些母亲由于早期无根据的说法而持有对疫苗的偏见。与确认性偏见一致的是，关于疫苗的负面信息会强化她们的偏见，而正面信息则有助于减轻这些偏见。然而，正面的在线信息对疫苗接种决策有着显著的影响，这表明在线传播疫苗安全信息可能有助于解决这些复杂的错误信息问题。

abstract.text: A rich experimental literature demonstrates positive effects of pay-per-visit fitness incentives. However, most insurance plans that provide fitness incentives follow a different structure, offering membership reimbursements conditional on meeting a specific attendance threshold. We provide the first evidence in the literature on gym incentives of this structure, exploiting the introduction and subsequent discontinuation of a large-scale wellness program at a major American university. Our analysis leverages individual-level administrative data on gym attendance for the universe of students over a five-year period: the three years that the policy was in place, one year before implementation, and one year after termination. This provides us with 100,000 student-year observations and 1.5 million gym visits. Using bunching methods and difference-in-difference designs, we provide four empirical results. First, we document that the policy led to significant bunching at the attendance threshold. Second, we show that the program increased average gym visits by almost five visits per semester, a 20% increase from the mean. Third, we find that the policy not only motivated students who were previously near the threshold, but rather increased attendance across the entire visit distribution. Finally, we show that approximately 50% of the effect persists a year after program termination. Taken together, these results suggest that rebate-framed incentives with a high attendance threshold can induce healthy behaviors in the short-term, and that these positive behaviors persist even after the incentives have been removed.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102285.abstractZh: 丰富的实验文献表明，按访问次数计费的健身激励措施具有积极效果。然而，大多数提供健身激励的保险计划采用不同的结构，即提供会员费报销，但前提是必须满足特定的出勤门槛。我们首次在文献中提供了关于健身房激励措施这种结构的证据，通过利用美国一所主要大学大规模健康计划的引入和随后终止这一案例进行分析。我们的分析利用了五年期间学生群体的健身房出勤记录的个人级行政数据：政策实施的三年时间、实施前的一年以及终止后的一年。这些数据为我们提供了100,000学生年观测值和150万次健身房访问记录。通过捆绑方法和差异分解设计，我们得出了四个实证结果。首先，我们发现该政策导致出勤门槛处出现了显著的捆绑效应。其次，我们显示该计划使平均每周健身房访问次数增加了近五次，比平均水平高出20%。第三，我们发现该政策不仅激励了原本接近门槛的学生，反而提高了整个访问期间的出勤率。最后，我们表明，该计划的效应在终止后一年内仍持续存在，大约占50%。综合这些结果，我们认为，以返利为框架的激励措施，通过设定较高的出勤门槛，可以在短期内诱导健康行为，而这些积极行为即使在激励措施取消后仍然持续存在。

abstract.text: Drug overdoses involving opioid analgesics have increased dramatically since 1999, representing one of the United States' top public health crises. Opioids have legitimate medical functions, but they are often diverted, suggesting a tradeoff between improving medical access and nonmedical abuse. We provide causal estimates of the relationship between the medical opioid supply and drug overdoses using Medicare Part D as a differential shock to the geographic distribution of opioids. Our estimates imply that a 10% increase in opioid medical supply leads to a 7.1% increase in opioid-related deaths among the Medicare-ineligible population, suggesting substantial diversion from medical markets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2019.102286.abstractZh: 自1999年以来，涉及阿片类镇痛药的药物过量事件急剧增加，这已成为美国最严重的公共卫生危机之一。阿片类药物具有合法的医疗用途，但它们经常被用于非医疗目的，这表明在改善医疗服务的同时，也存在非医疗滥用的问题。我们通过使用Medicare Part D作为地理分布差异的模拟工具，对阿片类药物供应与药物过量之间的关系进行了因果分析。我们的估计表明，阿片类药物医疗供应的增加10%，会导致Medicare未覆盖人群中的阿片类药物相关死亡人数增加7.1%，这表明有相当数量的阿片类药物被用于非医疗目的。

abstract.text: I look at three debates in the health economics literature in the context of cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA): 1) inclusion of future costs, 2) discounting, and 3) consistency with a welfare-economic perspective. These debates thus far have been studied in isolation leading to confusion and lingering questions. I look at these three debates holistically and present a welfare theoretic model that is consistent with the practice of CEA and can help inform all of these three debates. It shows rationales for the recommendations of the Second Panel and clarifies some nuanced implications for the practice of CEA when taking a societal perspective in the context of distributional CEA and multi-sectorial budgets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102287.abstractZh: 我从成本效益分析的角度，探讨了健康经济学文献中的三个重要争论：1）未来成本的纳入，2）折现问题，3）与福利经济视角的契合性。迄今为止，这些争论往往被孤立地研究，导致混乱和遗留问题。我试图将这些争论作为一个整体来审视，并提出一个与成本效益分析实践相一致的福利理论模型，该模型能够为这三个争论提供指导。该模型阐明了第二小组建议的合理性，并澄清了在分配性成本效益分析和多部门预算背景下，从社会视角出发时成本效益分析实践中的一些细微影响。

abstract.text: A central question in human development is what causes health inequalities over the life cycle. This paper links adversity in the teen years to individuals' long-term health outcomes. We examine a mandatory rustication program, the "send-down" policy during China's Cultural Revolution, and employ a regression discontinuity design to estimate the impact on individuals' physical and mental health outcomes 40 years later. Our results suggest that rusticated youths were more likely to develop mental disorders but not to have worse physical outcomes. Further assessing distributional effects through marginal treatment effect (MTE), we find strong heterogeneous treatment effects and selection on gains.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102288.abstractZh: 人类发展中的一个核心问题是，是什么导致了生命周期中的健康不平等。本文将青少年时期的逆境与个体的长期健康结果联系起来。我们研究了中国文化大革命期间的一项强制性隔离政策——“下放”政策，并采用回归不连续设计来估计该政策在40年后对个体身心健康结果的影响。我们的研究结果表明，被隔离的年轻人更容易出现精神障碍，但身体状况并未恶化。通过边际处理效应进一步评估分布效应后，我们发现存在强烈的异质性处理效应以及选择对收益的影响。

abstract.text: Estimates of the marginal effect of measures of adiposity such as body mass index (BMI) on healthcare costs are important for the formulation and evaluation of policies targeting adverse weight profiles. Most estimates of this association are affected by endogeneity bias. We use a novel identification strategy exploiting Mendelian Randomization - random germline genetic variation modelled using instrumental variables - to identify the causal effect of BMI on inpatient hospital costs. Using data on over 300,000 individuals, the effect size per person per marginal unit of BMI per year varied according to specification, including £21.22 (95% confidence interval (CI): £14.35-£28.07) for conventional inverse variance weighted models to £18.85 (95% CI: £9.05-£28.65) for penalized weighted median models. Effect sizes from Mendelian Randomization models were larger in most cases than non-instrumental variable multivariable adjusted estimates (£13.47, 95% CI: £12.51-£14.43). There was little evidence of non-linearity. Within-family estimates, intended to address dynastic biases, were imprecise.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102300.abstractZh: 关于体质量指数（BMI）等肥胖指标对医疗成本边际效应的估计，对于制定和评估针对不良体重状况的政策至关重要。大多数关于这种关联的估计都受到内生性偏差的影响。我们采用了一种新颖的识别策略，利用孟德尔随机化——通过工具变量模型模拟的随机生殖系遗传变异——来识别BMI对住院成本的因果效应。基于超过300,000名个体的数据，每个人每年每单位BMI的效应大小因模型规格而异，传统逆方差加权模型的效应大小为£21.22（95%置信区间：£14.35-£28.07），而惩罚加权中位数模型的效应大小为£18.85（95%置信区间：£9.05-£28.65）。在大多数情况下，孟德尔随机化模型的效应大小大于非工具变量多变量调整估计的效应大小（£13.47，95%置信区间：£12.51-£14.43）。几乎没有非线性效应的证据。用于解决家族偏见的家族内估计结果并不精确。

abstract.text: We assess the causal effect of the National Kidney Registry (NKR), the largest national kidney-exchange network in the U.S., on kidney-exchange outcomes. Analyzing a unique database hosted by the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients (SRTR) that contains information on all kidney donors, wait-listed candidates, and transplant recipients in the U.S., we find that patients in an NKR hospital are 2.5-3 times more likely than their counterparts in a non-NKR hospital to receive a transplant from a living donor, conditional on wait-time. At the same time, NKR participation does not have a significant effect on the desirability of donors and the health status of recipients. We employ various approaches to ensure our finding is robust in addressing the non-random sorting of patients and donors. As far as the outcomes we study, the expansion of the NKR brings about an overall positive impact on the kidney exchange market.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102301.abstractZh: 我们评估了美国国家肾脏登记系统（NKR）这一美国最大的全国肾脏交换网络对肾脏交换结果的因果效应。通过分析由移植受者科学登记处（SRTR）提供的独特数据库，该数据库包含了美国所有肾脏捐赠者、等待名单上的候选者和移植受者的信息，我们发现，在等待时间相同的情况下，NKR医院的患者从活体捐赠者那里接受肾脏移植的可能性是非NKR医院患者的2.5到3倍。同时，NKR的参与对捐赠者的意愿和受者的健康状况并没有显著影响。我们采用了多种方法来确保我们的研究结果在应对患者和捐赠者非随机排序的情况下仍然具有可靠性。就我们研究的结果而言，NKR的扩展对肾脏交换市场整体产生了积极的影响。

abstract.text: We compile data on the locations of abortion providers and enforcement of parental involvement laws to document dramatic increases in the distances minors must travel if they wish to obtain an abortion without involving a parent or judge: from 58 miles in 1992 to 454 in 2016. Using both double and triple-difference estimation strategies, we estimate the effects of parental involvement laws, allowing them to vary with the distances minors might travel to avoid them. Our results confirm previous findings that parental involvement laws did not increase teen births in the 1980s, and provide new evidence that in more recent decades they have increased teen birth by an average of 3 percent. The estimated effects are increasing in avoidance distance to the point that a confidential abortion is more than a day's drive away, and also are substantially larger in the poorest quartile of counties.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102302.abstractZh: 我们收集了堕胎服务提供者所在位置的数据，以及关于家长参与法律实施情况的数据，以记录未成年人若希望在不涉及父母或法官的情况下进行堕胎所需行驶距离的显著增长：从1992年的58英里增加到2016年的454英里。通过双重差分估计策略和三重差分估计策略，我们评估了家长参与法律的影响，并允许这些影响随着未成年人为规避法律而需行驶的距离而变化。我们的研究结果证实，先前的研究发现表明，家长参与法律在20世纪80年代并未增加青少年生育率，同时提供了新的证据，表明在最近几十年中，这些法律使青少年生育率平均增加了3%。估计的影响随着规避距离的增加而加剧，以至于保密堕胎服务距离超过一天的路程，并且在最贫困的四分位县中，这种影响更为显著。

abstract.text: The oft-applied assumption in the use of Quality Adjusted Life Years (QALYs) in economic evaluation, that all QALYs are valued equally, has been questioned from the outset. The literature has focused on differential values of a QALY based on equity considerations such as the characteristics of the beneficiaries of the QALYs. However, a key characteristic which may affect the value of a QALY is the type of QALY itself. QALY gains can be generated purely by gains in survival, purely by improvements in quality of life, or by changes in both. Using a discrete choice experiment and a new methodological approach to the derivation of relative weights, we undertake the first direct and systematic exploration of the relative weight accorded different QALY types and do so in the presence of equity considerations; age and severity. Results provide new evidence against the normative starting point that all QALYs are valued equally.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102303.abstractZh: 在经济学评估中，人们常假设所有质量调整生命年（QALYs）的价值都是相同的，但这一假设从一开始就受到了质疑。相关文献主要探讨了基于公平考虑因素（如QALYs受益人的特征）对QALY价值的差异影响。然而，可能影响QALY价值的一个关键因素是QALY本身的类型。QALY的增益可能完全来自生存时间的延长，也可能完全来自生活质量的改善，或者两者兼有。通过采用离散选择实验和新的方法学手段来推导相对权重，我们首次直接且系统地研究了不同QALY类型所受到的相对权重分配情况，并且是在考虑公平因素（如年龄和疾病严重程度）的情况下进行的。研究结果提供了新的证据，反驳了所有QALYs价值相同的这一规范假设。

abstract.text: Primary care physicians (PCPs) provide frontline health care to patients in the U.S.; however, it is unclear how their practice styles affect patient care. In this paper, we estimate the long-lasting effects of PCP practice styles on patient health care utilization by focusing on Medicare patients affected by PCP relocations or retirements, which we refer to as "exits." Observing where patients receive care after these exits, we estimate event studies to compare patients who switch to PCPs with different practice style intensities. We find that PCPs have large effects on a range of aggregate utilization measures, including physician and outpatient spending and the number of diagnosed conditions. Moreover, we find that PCPs have large effects on the quality of care that patients receive, and that all of these effects persist for several years. Our results suggest that switching to higher-quality PCPs could significantly affect patients' longer-run health outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102304.abstractZh: 在美国，初级保健医生为患者提供一线医疗服务。然而，他们的执业风格如何影响患者护理效果尚不清楚。本文通过研究因初级保健医生调任或退休而受到影响的患者，即所谓的“离职”患者，来估计其执业风格对患者医疗利用的长期影响。通过观察患者在离职后接受护理的地点，我们进行了事件研究，比较了转向不同执业风格强度初级保健医生的患者情况。研究发现，初级保健医生对一系列综合利用指标有显著影响，包括医生和门诊支出以及诊断出的疾病数量。此外，我们发现初级保健医生对患者所接受护理的质量也有显著影响，而这些影响会持续数年。我们的结果表明，转向更高质量的初级保健医生可能会显著影响患者的长期健康结果。

abstract.text: This paper examines the extensive margin of selection into employer-sponsored health insurance (ESHI) using data from the Medical Expenditures Panel Survey 2001-2010 and 2014-2016 and the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth'97 in 2010. Controlling for a large set of firm and job characteristics, I find that before the implementation of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) in 2014, workers aged 25-40 who declined ESHI and remained privately uninsured had significantly higher health risk than those who enrolled. No correlation between health and insurance take-up is found in the 41-64 age group. These results are partly explained by differences in income and Medicaid crowding out ESHI for high risk workers. The paper sheds light on the characteristics of uninsured workers, their incentives for declining insurance and the interaction between private and public health insurance. The allocation of ESHI remained unchanged after the ACA was introduced due to the provisions' counteracting effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102305.abstractZh: 本文利用2001-2010年和2014-2016年的医疗支出面板调查数据，以及2010年的《1997年青年纵向调查》数据，研究了工人通过雇主赞助的健康保险（ESHI）获得广泛选择权的现象。在控制了大量公司和工作特征因素后，我发现，在2014年《平价医疗法案》实施之前，25-40岁的工人如果选择不购买ESHI而保持私人保险状态，其健康风险显著高于那些选择购买保险的人。在41-64岁年龄组中，未发现健康状况与保险购买行为之间的关联。这些结果部分可以归因于收入差异以及医疗补助政策对高风险工人购买ESHI的挤出效应。本文还揭示了未投保工人的特征、他们放弃保险的动力，以及私人保险与公共保险之间的相互作用。由于《平价医疗法案》的相关规定，ESHI的分配在法案实施后并未发生变化。

abstract.text: This paper measures the cyclicality of an important input into elderly health: informal care. Using independent survey measures of informal caregiving and care receipt over the past two decades, we find that informal care from adult children to their elderly parents is countercyclical. By contrast, informal care from spouses is procyclical among individuals in their sixties. We find little corresponding change in the use of formal care, highlighting the potential for unmet care needs across the business cycle. These findings suggest that informal health inputs may play an important role in the interpretation of the cyclicality of elderly mortality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102306.abstractZh: 本文测量了老年健康的重要投入——非正式护理的周期性变化。通过过去二十年中关于非正式护理和护理接收情况的独立调查数据，我们发现成年子女对老年父母提供的非正式护理具有反周期性特征。相比之下，配偶提供的非正式护理在六十多岁的个体中则具有顺周期性。我们发现正式护理的使用情况几乎没有相应的变化，这凸显了整个经济周期中未得到满足的护理需求的潜在性。这些发现表明，非正式健康投入可能在解释老年人口死亡率的周期性变化中发挥着重要作用。

abstract.text: This project uses quasi-random assignment of SNAP receipt dates linked to Medicaid healthcare records to examine whether ER use is affected by the timing of benefits. We find an increase in ER usage at the end of the benefit month, but only among older recipients. The estimated effect is much larger when the end of the benefit cycle coincides with the end of the calendar month, which is when other transfer payments are also depleted. This suggests that within this older group, increased food insecurity leads to increased ER utilization. Further, we find that the share of ER visitors that received SNAP benefits on the day of their ER visit is 3.1% lower than in the SNAP population. This is consistent with benefit receipt altering household behaviors and routines (notably, we observe, by increasing shopping), which may crowd out healthcare utilization. This particular effect is present across all age groups, although the magnitude is smallest for children.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102313.abstractZh: 本项目通过随机分配与医疗记录相关的SNAP领取日期，来研究福利发放时间是否会影响急诊室的就诊情况。研究发现，在福利发放月份末，急诊室的就诊次数有所增加，但这一现象主要出现在年龄较大的领取者中。当福利发放周期与日历月份结束时重合时，这种影响更为显著，此时其他转移支付也会耗尽。这表明，在这一年龄组中，食品不安全的增加会导致急诊室就诊次数的增加。此外，我们发现，在急诊就诊当天领取SNAP福利的受访者比例，比普通SNAP领取者低3.1%。这与福利领取会改变家庭行为和习惯有关（尤其是购物行为的增加），这可能会抑制医疗服务的利用。这种特定效应存在于所有年龄组，不过儿童群体的影响最小。

abstract.text: We use a difference in differences approach to show that the adoption of High Yielding Varieties (HYV) reduced infant mortality in India. This holds even comparing children of the same mother. The effects of HVY adoption on mortality are larger for rural children, boys, and low-caste children. While we are not able to explore mechanisms in depth, our evidence points to a limited role played by increased investments in early childhood health or selection into childbearing in response to HYV adoption.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102314.abstractZh: 我们采用差异差异的方法表明，采用高产品种减少了印度的婴儿死亡率。即使比较同一母亲所生的孩子，这一效应仍然存在。高产品种对农村儿童、男孩以及低种姓儿童的死亡率影响更大。虽然我们无法深入探究其机制，但我们的证据表明，对早期儿童健康的投资增加或因高产品种而选择生育子女，在降低死亡率方面的作用有限。

abstract.text: In a two-country (home and foreign) model in which the home producer of a branded pharmaceutical product faces generic competition in each market, we analyze home's optimal policy choices regarding two major types of price regulations: external reference pricing (ERP) and direct price controls. Home's nationally optimal ERP policy lowers domestic price while maintaining the firm's export incentive. This ERP policy results in a negative international price spillover that the foreign country can (partly) offset via a local price control. Generic competition in either market reduces home's welfare gain from instituting an ERP policy. Weaker competition abroad or a greater weight on firm profits relative to consumer surplus in home's welfare function makes it more likely that home prefers an ERP policy to a price control. While international integration of national generic markets can improve welfare, such is not the case if it causes home to relax its ERP policy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102315.abstractZh: 在一个双国模型中（本国与国外），本国生产品牌药品的企业在每个市场中都面临仿制药的竞争。我们分析了本国在两种主要价格管制政策下的最优选择：外部参考定价和直接价格控制。本国的最优ERP政策能够降低国内价格，同时维持企业的出口激励。然而，这种ERP政策会导致国际价格的负向溢出效应，而国外可以通过本地价格控制来部分抵消这一影响。无论是在哪个市场中，仿制药的竞争都会减少本国通过实施ERP政策获得的福利收益。如果国外的竞争较弱，或者在本国的福利函数中，企业利润相对于消费者剩余的重要性更高，那么本国更可能倾向于选择ERP政策而非价格控制。虽然国家仿制药市场的国际整合可以提高福利，但如果这种整合导致本国放松ERP政策，则情况并非如此。

abstract.text: China's coal-fired winter heating systems generate large amounts of hazardous emissions that significantly deteriorate air quality. Exploiting regression discontinuity designs based on the exact starting dates of winter heating across different cities, we estimate the contemporaneous impact of winter heating on air pollution and health. We find that turning on the winter heating system increased the weekly Air Quality Index by 36% and caused 14% increase in mortality rate. This implies that a 10-point increase in the weekly Air Quality Index causes a 2.2% increase in overall mortality.
