People in poor and rural areas are particularly affected by the rapid deterioration in air quality; this implies that the health impact of air pollution may be mitigated by improved socio-economic conditions. Exploratory cost-benefit analysis suggests that replacing coal with natural gas for heating can improve social welfare.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102316.abstractZh: 中国的燃煤冬季供暖系统会产生大量有害排放物，严重恶化空气质量。通过基于不同城市冬季供暖开始时间的具体回归断点设计，我们估算了冬季供暖对空气污染和健康的同期影响。研究发现，开启冬季供暖系统会使每周空气质量指数上升36%，并导致死亡率增加14%。这意味着每周空气质量指数每上升10个点，整体死亡率将增加2.2%。贫困和农村地区的居民受到空气质量急剧恶化的影响尤为严重；这表明，改善社会经济条件可能有助于减轻空气污染对健康的危害。探索性成本效益分析表明，用天然气替代煤炭进行供暖可以提高社会福利。

abstract.text: The relationship between social capital and health has received extensive attention in fields such as public health, medicine, epidemiology, gerontology and other health-related disciplines. In contrast, the economics literature on this subject is relatively small. To address this research gap, we investigate the cross-disciplinary empirical literature using meta-analysis. We analyze 12,778 estimates from 470 studies. Our analysis finds that social capital is significantly related to a variety of positive health outcomes. However, the effect sizes are consistently very small. This finding is robust across different types of social capital (e.g., cognitive, structural, bonding, bridging, linking), and for many different measures of health outcomes (e.g., mortality, disease/illnesses, depression). The small effects that we estimate cast doubt on recent initiatives to promote health through social capital such as those by the WHO, the OECD, and US Healthy People 2020.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102317.abstractZh: 社会资本与健康之间的关系在公共卫生、医学、流行病学、老年学等健康相关领域受到了广泛关注。相比之下，关于这一主题的经济学文献相对较少。为了填补这一研究空白，我们通过元分析对跨学科的实证文献进行了研究。我们分析了470项研究中的12,778个估计值。研究发现，社会资本与多种积极的健康结果显著相关。然而，这些效应的大小始终非常微小。这一发现在不同类型的社会资本（如认知型、结构型、联结型、桥梁型、链接型）以及多种健康结果指标（如死亡率、疾病/病症、抑郁）上都是成立的。我们估计出的这些微小效应使得通过社会资本促进健康的近期举措（如世界卫生组织、经合组织以及美国“健康人民2020”计划所提出的举措）显得缺乏说服力。

abstract.text: Earlier work suggested that subjective life expectancy (SLE) functions as reference point in time trade-off (TTO), but has not tested or modelled this explicitly. In this paper we construct a model based on prospect theory to investigate these predictions more thoroughly. We report the first experimental test of reference-dependence with respect to SLE for TTO and extend this approach to standard gamble (SG). In two experiments, subjects' SLEs were used to construct different versions of 10-year TTO and SG tasks, with the gauge duration either described as occurring above or below life expectation. Our analyses suggest that both TTO and SG weights were affected by SLE as predicted by prospect theory with SLE as reference point. Subjects gave up fewer years in TTO and were less risk-tolerant in SG below SLE, implying that weights derived from these health state valuation methods for durations below SLE will be biased upwards.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102318.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，主观预期寿命在时间权衡中起着参考点的作用，但并未对此进行明确测试或建模。在本文中，我们基于前景理论构建了一个模型，以更全面地研究这些预测结果。我们首次对时间权衡中的参考依赖性进行了实验测试，并将这种方法扩展到标准赌博任务中。在两项实验中，使用受试者的主观预期寿命来构建不同版本的10年时间权衡和标准赌博任务，其中持续时间被描述为高于或低于预期寿命。我们的分析表明，时间权衡和标准赌博的权重都受到了主观预期寿命的影响，这与前景理论预测的结果一致。在主观预期寿命较低的情况下，受试者在时间权衡中放弃的年份较少，且在标准赌博任务中的风险容忍度也较低，这意味着基于这种健康状态评估方法得出的权重对于低于主观预期寿命的持续时间来说会存在向上偏差。

abstract.text: In 2007, the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid restructured the diagnosis related group (DRG) system by expanding the number of categories within a DRG to account for complications present within certain conditions. This change allows for differential reimbursement depending on the severity of the case. We examine whether this change incentivized hospitals to upcode patients as sicker to increase their reimbursements. Using the National Inpatient Survey data from HCUP from 2005 to 2010 and three methods to detect the presence of upcoding, our most conservative estimate is an additional three percent of reimbursement is attributable to upcoding. We find evidence of upcoding in government, non-profit, and for-profit hospitals. We find spillover effects of upcoding impacting not only Medicare payers, but also private insurance companies as well.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102319.abstractZh: 2007年，医疗保险和医疗补助中心通过扩大DRG分类中的类别数量，以反映某些疾病中的并发症，对诊断相关分组系统进行了重组。这一变化使得根据病例的严重程度进行不同的报销成为可能。我们研究这一变化是否促使医院将患者诊断为更严重的疾病，从而增加其报销金额。利用2005至2010年来自HCUP的全国住院调查数据，并采用三种方法来检测过度编码的存在情况，我们最保守的估计是，有额外3%的报销金额归因于过度编码。我们发现，在公立医院、非营利医院和营利医院中都有过度编码的现象。我们还发现，过度编码不仅影响医疗保险支付方，也影响私人保险公司。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effects of the 2012 Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) initiative on health insurance coverage, access to care, health care use, and health outcomes. We exploit a difference-in-differences setup that relies on the discontinuities in the program eligibility criteria. We find that DACA increased insurance coverage. In states that granted access to Medicaid, the increase was driven by an increase in public insurance take-up. Where public coverage was not available, DACA eligibility increased individually purchased insurance. Despite the increase in insurance coverage, we find small or non-significant increases in health care use. There is some evidence that DACA increased demand for mental health services. After 2012, DACA-eligible individuals were also more likely to report a usual place of care and less likely to delay care because of financial restrictions. Finally, we find some evidence that DACA improved self-reported health and reduced depression symptoms, indicators of stress and anxiety, and hypertension. These improvements are concentrated among individuals with income below the federal poverty level.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102320.abstractZh: 本文研究了2012年“儿童移民暂缓执行令”对健康保险覆盖、就医机会、医疗使用以及健康结果的影响。我们采用差异-差异模型进行分析，该模型基于该计划资格标准的变动。研究发现，“儿童移民暂缓执行令”确实增加了保险覆盖。在授予医疗补助的州，保险覆盖的增加主要源于公共保险的普及率上升。而在没有公共保险覆盖的地区，符合条件的个体则增加了个人购买的保险。尽管保险覆盖有所增加，但医疗使用的增加幅度较小或并不显著。有一些证据表明，“儿童移民暂缓执行令”增加了对心理健康服务的需求。2012年之后，符合条件的个体更有可能报告常去的就医地点，并且由于经济限制而减少就医延迟的情况。最后，我们发现“儿童移民暂缓执行令”有助于改善自我报告的健康状况，减轻抑郁症状、压力和焦虑指标，以及高血压问题。这些改善主要集中在收入低于联邦贫困线的个体中。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of the U.S. fracking boom on local STI transmission rates and prostitution activity as measured by online prostitution review counts. We first document significant and robust positive effects on gonorrhea rates in fracking counties at the national level. But we find no evidence that fracking increases prostitution when using our national data, suggesting sex work may not be the principal mechanism linking fracking to gonorrhea growth. To explore mechanisms, we then focus on remote, high-fracking production areas that experienced large increases in sex ratios due to male in-migration. For this restricted sample we find enhanced gonorrhea transmission effects and moderate evidence of extensive margin effects on prostitution markets. This study highlights public health concerns relating to economic shocks and occupational conditions that alter the local demographic composition.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102322.abstractZh: 本文探讨了美国水力压裂技术发展的繁荣对当地性传播疾病传播率以及通过在线卖淫统计数据所反映的卖淫活动的影响。我们首先发现，在全国范围内，水力压裂技术发展显著且积极地影响了淋病发病率。然而，我们的数据分析并未发现水力压裂技术发展与卖淫活动之间存在关联，这表明性工作可能不是将水力压裂技术与淋病增长联系起来的主要机制。为了进一步探究相关机制，我们重点关注那些因男性移民而性比发生显著变化的偏远地区。在这一有限样本上，我们发现淋病传播效应有所增强，并且有证据表明水力压裂技术发展对卖淫市场产生了一定影响。本研究强调了与经济冲击和职业条件相关的公共卫生问题，这些问题会改变当地的人口结构。

abstract.text: Individuals with mental health problems smoke at far higher rates than their peers, and have done for decades. This paper explores a potential explanation: smoking as a means to cope with distress. The proposed "coping response" framework is assessed by analyzing how adolescents respond to two events known to trigger acute mental distress: violent crime victimization and death of a non-family member the respondent felt close to. Consistent with a coping response, these shocks yield statistically significant increases in first cigarette use, recent smoking, and daily smoking, with greater initiation responses among those who are depressed at baseline, and dampened responsiveness among those facing higher cigarette taxes. Back-of-the-envelope estimates suggest that differential responsiveness to adverse events by baseline depression explains 5% of first cigarette use in this sample, and almost a third of the gap in adolescent smoking initiation between those in the highest and lowest terciles of depression scores.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102323.abstractZh: 有心理健康问题的个体吸烟的比例远高于他们的同龄人，这种情况已经持续了几十年。本文探讨了一种可能的解释：吸烟作为一种应对压力的方式。通过分析青少年对两种已知会引发急性心理困扰的事件的反应，来评估这一“应对反应”框架的合理性。这两种事件分别是暴力犯罪受害和与非家庭成员的死亡，而这些人通常被认为关系密切。与应对反应一致的是，这些冲击会导致首次吸烟、近期吸烟频率和每日吸烟频率的显著增加。在基线时处于抑郁状态的个体，其首次吸烟的起始频率更高；而面临更高香烟税的个体，其反应则较为迟钝。初步估计表明，基线抑郁状态对不良事件的不同反应解释了该样本中首次吸烟行为的5%，并且几乎三分之一的青少年吸烟起始频率差异可以归因于抑郁评分处于最高和最低三分位数的个体之间的差异。

abstract.text: Umbrella branding is a marketing practice whereby multi-product firms leverage their reputation across different product categories. The paper investigates how advertising in the market for non-prescription drugs affects the decision to buy prescription drugs from the same firm. To estimate the effects of umbrella branding, I exploit the fact that consumer-directed advertising of prescription drugs is prohibited in Germany and identify advertising spillovers with an instrumental variable that builds on exogenous seasonality in the non-prescription drug industry. Umbrella branding results in market expansion, particularly for generic firms, and can have a positive effect on consumer welfare in under-treated therapeutic areas.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102324.abstractZh: 伞形品牌营销是一种营销手段，通过这种手段，多产品企业可以利用其在不同产品类别中的声誉来推广自己的品牌。本文研究了非处方药市场中的广告如何影响消费者购买同一企业生产的处方药的决定。为了评估伞形品牌营销的效果，我利用了德国对处方药消费者导向广告的禁止这一事实，并通过一个基于非处方药行业外部季节性的工具变量来识别广告的溢出效应。伞形品牌营销能够推动市场扩张，尤其是对于 generic企业而言，并且可以在治疗需求不足的领域对消费者福利产生积极影响。

abstract.text: Despite the growing incidence of cesarean deliveries (CDs), procedure costs and benefits continue to be controversially discussed. In this study, we identify the effects of CDs on subsequent fertility and maternal labor supply by exploiting the fact that obstetricians are less likely to undertake CDs on weekends and public holidays and have a greater incentive to perform them on Fridays and days preceding public holidays. To do so, we adopt high-quality administrative data from Austria. Women giving birth on different days of the week are pre-treatment observationally identical. Our instrumental variable estimates show that a non-planned CD at parity 0 decreases lifecycle fertility by almost 13.6%. This reduction in fertility translates into a temporary increase in maternal employment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102325.abstractZh: 尽管剖宫产手术的发生率不断增加，但其成本和收益仍存在争议。本研究通过利用产科医生在周末和公共假日较少进行剖宫产手术，而在周五及公共假日前更倾向于进行剖宫产手术这一事实，来探讨剖宫产对后续生育能力和孕产妇劳动力供应的影响。为此，我们采用了来自奥地利的高质量行政数据。在每周不同日期分娩的女性在预处理阶段具有相同的特征。我们的工具变量估计结果显示，在生育第0胎时进行非计划性剖宫产手术会使生命周期生育率下降近13.6%。这种生育率的下降会导致孕产妇就业率的暂时上升。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates a UK policy that aimed to improve dietary information provision by introducing nutrition labelling on retailers' store-brand products. Exploiting the differential timing of the introduction of Front-of-Pack nutrition labels as a quasi-experiment, our findings suggest that labelling led to a reduction in the quantity purchased of labelled store-brand foods, and an improvement in their nutritional composition. More specifically, we find that households reduced the total monthly calories from labelled store-brand foods by 588 kcal, saturated fats by 14 g, sugars by 7 g, and sodium by 0.8 mg.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102326.abstractZh: 本文评估了一项英国政策，该政策旨在通过在零售商自有品牌产品上引入营养标签来改善饮食信息提供。通过一项准实验，研究考察了包装正面营养标签引入时间的差异，发现标签的引入导致消费者购买自有品牌食品的数量减少，同时其营养成分也有所改善。具体而言，我们发现家庭每月从自有品牌食品中获取的总热量减少了588千卡，饱和脂肪减少了14克，糖分减少了7克，钠减少了0.8毫克。

abstract.text: I study the evolution of the quality of grocery purchases among migrants to learn how changes in the environment affect dietary choice. Using detailed household level panel data on food purchases I find that healthfulness of grocery purchases is very persistent in the short-run. Three to four decades after moving, however, households have closed about half of the gap in healthfulness between the origin and destination area. The results suggest that dietary habits are highly persistent, but may eventually shift in the face of different local environments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102327.abstractZh: 我研究了移民在食品购买质量方面的变化，以了解环境变化如何影响饮食选择。通过详细的家庭层面食品购买数据，我发现食品购买的质量在短期内非常稳定。然而，在迁移三到四十年后，家庭在来源地和目的地地区之间的食品购买质量差距大约缩小了一半。这些结果表明，饮食习惯具有高度持久性，但在面对不同的当地环境时，这些习惯可能会发生变化。

abstract.text: Regulators may be hesitant to permit price competition in healthcare markets because of its potential to damage quality. We assess whether this fear is well founded by examining a reform that permitted Dutch health insurers to freely negotiate prices with hospitals. Unlike previous research on hospital competition that has relied on quality indicators for urgent treatments, we take advantage of a plausible absence of selection bias to identify the effect on the quality of elective procedures that should be more price responsive. Using data on all admissions for hip replacements to Dutch hospitals and a difference-in-differences comparison between more and less concentrated markets, we find no evidence that price deregulation in a competitive environment reduces quality measured by hip replacement readmission rates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102328.abstractZh: 监管机构可能不愿允许医疗市场的价格竞争，因为这种行为有可能损害医疗质量。我们通过考察一项允许荷兰健康保险公司与医院自由协商价格的改革措施，来评估这种担忧是否合理。与以往依赖质量指标来研究医院竞争的研究不同，我们利用了潜在的选择偏差缺失这一优势，来识别那些应该对价格更加敏感的择期手术的质量影响。利用荷兰医院髋关节置换手术的所有入院数据，并通过比较更集中和不太集中的市场之间的差异，我们发现，在竞争环境下实施价格放开政策并不会降低髋关节置换手术再次入院率这一质量指标。

abstract.text: We present a model in which health insurance allows liquidity-constrained patients access to otherwise unaffordable treatments. A monopolist's profit-maximizing price for an insured treatment is greater (for any cost sharing) than it would be if the treatment was not covered. Consumer surplus may also be less. These results are based on a different mechanism than would operate in a standard moral hazard model. Our model also provides an economic rationale for the common claim that pharmaceutical firms set prices that exceed the value their products create. We show this problem is exacerbated when health insurance covers additional monopoly-provided services.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102329.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，其中健康保险使流动性受限的患者能够获得原本无法负担的治疗。垄断者为受保险治疗所设定的最大化利润价格（无论是否包含成本分担）都会高于治疗未被覆盖时的价格。消费者的剩余也可能减少。这些结果基于一种与标准道德风险模型不同的机制。我们的模型还为制药公司定价高于其产品创造价值的这一常见说法提供了经济依据。我们指出，当健康保险还涵盖垄断提供的额外服务时，这一问题会进一步加剧。

abstract.text: This study exploits the introduction of high subsidies for anti-malaria products in Senegal in 2009 to investigate whether malaria prevents parents from investing in child health. A simple model of health investments under competing mortality risks predicts that private expenses to fight malaria and other diseases should increase in response to anti-malaria public interventions. We test and validate this prediction using original panel data from a household expenditure survey combined with geographical information on malaria prevalence. We find that health expenditures in malarious regions catch up with non-malarious regions. The same result holds for parental health-seeking behavior against other diseases like diarrhea. These patterns cannot be explained by differential trends between regions. Our results suggest that behavioral responses to anti-malaria campaigns magnify their impact on all-cause mortality for children.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102330.abstractZh: 本研究利用2009年塞内加尔对抗疟疾产品实施高额补贴的政策，探讨疟疾是否阻碍了父母对儿童健康的投资。通过构建一个在竞争性死亡风险下的健康投资模型，我们预测私人用于抗击疟疾及其他疾病的支出应因抗疟疾公共干预措施而增加。我们结合家庭支出调查的原始面板数据以及疟疾流行地区的地理信息来验证这一预测。研究发现，疟疾流行地区的健康支出已赶上非疟疾流行地区。对于其他疾病如腹泻的家长健康寻求行为也呈现出类似趋势。这些现象无法用地区间的差异来解释。我们的研究结果表明，对疟疾防治活动的行为反应会加剧其对儿童全因死亡率的影响。

abstract.text: We elicit time and risk preferences for kidney transplantation from the entire population of patients of the largest Italian transplant centre using a discrete choice experiment (DCE). We measure patients' willingness-to-wait (WTW) for receiving a kidney with one-year longer expected graft survival, or a low risk of complication. Using a mixed logit in WTW-space model, we find heterogeneity in patients' preferences. Our model allows WTW to vary with patients' age and duration of dialysis. The results suggest that WTW correlates with age and duration of dialysis, and that accounting for patients' preferences in the design of kidney allocation protocols could increase their welfare. The implication for transplant practice is that eliciting patients' preferences could help in the allocation of "non-ideal" kidneys.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102331.abstractZh: 我们通过离散选择实验，从意大利最大移植中心的全体患者群体中收集了关于肾脏移植的时间和风险偏好信息。我们测量了患者对于接受预期移植存活时间延长一年或并发症风险较低的肾脏的等待意愿。利用混合逻辑模型，我们发现患者偏好存在异质性。我们的模型允许等待意愿随着患者的年龄和透析时间的不同而变化。研究结果表明，等待意愿与年龄和透析时间相关，而在肾脏分配方案的设计中考虑患者的偏好可以提高他们的福利。这对移植实践的意义在于，了解患者的偏好有助于分配“非理想”的肾脏。

abstract.text: For branded drug manufacturers, maintaining market power by managing product lifecycle - evergreening - is an important tool to navigate pharmaceutical markets. For generic manufacturers, the key decision is to enter the market at all. Expansion of drug insurance may lead firms to change their behavior because of increased demand-side market power - due to consolidation of buyers into a small number of insurers - and because of increased drug utilization. We analyze manufacturer responses to such changes through the introduction of Medicare Part D, which expanded drug coverage among seniors, in a difference-in-differences design comparing drugs used frequently by those over age 65 to those used infrequently by this population. The results show that Part D reduced generic entry, and suggest that it increased evergreening. Furthermore, while these effects are associated with higher drug prices, they are more than offset by the consolidation of demand, reducing prices overall.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102332.abstractZh: 对于品牌药品制造商而言，通过管理产品生命周期——即“常绿化”——来维持市场力量是应对药品市场的重要手段。对于仿制药制造商来说，能否进入市场是一个关键决策。药品保险范围的扩大可能导致企业因需求方市场力量的增强而改变行为——这是由于购买者集中到少数几家保险公司，以及药品使用率的上升。我们通过比较65岁以上人群常用药品与较少使用的药品，利用差异-差异设计来分析制造商对这类变化的反应。结果显示，Medicare Part D的推出减少了仿制药的进入，并促进了“常绿化”现象。此外，尽管这些效应与药品价格的上涨有关，但它们被需求方的集中化所抵消，总体上降低了药品价格。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of the Affordable Care Act Medicaid expansion on county-level mortality in the first four years following expansion using restricted-access microdata covering all deaths in the United States. To adjust for pre-expansion differences in mortality rates between treatment and control, we use a propensity-score weighting model together with techniques from machine learning to match counties in expansion and non-expansion states. We find a reduction in all-cause mortality in ages 20 to 64 equaling 11.36 deaths per 100,000 individuals, a 3.6 percent decrease. This estimate is largely driven by reductions in mortality in counties with higher pre-expansion uninsured rates and for causes of death likely to be influenced by access to healthcare. A cost-benefit analysis shows that the improvement in welfare due to mortality responses may offset the entire net-of-transfers expenditure associated with the expansion.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102333.abstractZh: 我们利用受限访问的微观数据，涵盖了美国所有死亡案例，估算了《平价医疗法案》医疗补助扩展政策在扩展后的前四年对县级死亡率的影响。为了调整扩展前后治疗组和对照组之间的死亡率差异，我们采用了倾向评分加权模型，并结合机器学习技术，将扩展州与非扩展州的县进行匹配。研究发现，20至64岁年龄段的全因死亡率下降了11.36例/10万人口，即减少了3.6%。这一下降主要出现在扩展前无保险率较高的县，以及那些可能受医疗可及性影响的死亡原因上。成本效益分析表明，由于死亡率的改善所带来的福利提升，可能足以抵消扩展政策相关的全部净支出。

abstract.text: Policies that improve health and longevity are often valued by combining expected gains in quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) with a constant willingness-to-pay (WTP) per QALY. This constant is derived by dividing value per statistical life (VSL) estimates by expected future QALYs. We explore the theoretical validity of this practice by studying the properties of WTP for improved health and longevity in a framework that makes minimal assumptions about the shape of an agent's utility function. We find that dividing VSL by expected QALYs results in an upper bound on the WTP for a marginal improvement in the quality of life, as measured by gains in health status or longevity. Calibration results suggest that analysts using this approach to monetize health benefits overestimate the value of a program or policy by a factor of two on average. We also derive a lower bound on the WTP for improved health and longevity that permits a novel empirical test for the descriptive validity of the QALY model. Our calibrations suggest that this lower bound is on average 20% smaller than the actual WTP.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102341.abstractZh: 改善健康和寿命的政策通常是通过将预期的质量调整生命年（QALYs）与每QALY的恒定支付意愿（WTP）相结合来评估的。这个恒定值是通过将每统计生命值（VSL）的估计值除以预期的未来QALYs得到的。我们通过研究在对代理人的效用函数形状做出最小假设的情况下，改善健康和寿命的WTP的性质，来探讨这种做法的理论有效性。我们发现，将VSL除以预期QALYs可以得到对生活质量边际改善的WTP的上限，这种改善可以通过健康状况或寿命的改善来衡量。校准结果表明，使用这种方法对健康效益进行货币化的分析师平均高估了某个项目或政策的价值两倍。我们还推导出了改善健康和寿命的WTP的下限，这为验证QALY模型的描述性有效性提供了新的实证途径。我们的校准表明，这个下限平均比实际的WTP小20%。

abstract.text: Parental leave policies across the globe have become much more generous than they used to be. This is also true for prenatal maternal leave. While this may be costly in the short run, little is known about the effect of maternal employment during pregnancy on newborn health. In this paper, I exploit three sharp policy changes on the duration of paid parental leave in Austria that strongly affected the share of mothers who work up to the 32nd week of pregnancy. I use administrative data from Austria on the working history of women linked to the full Austrian birth register and coupled with a regression discontinuity framework to identify the effect of prenatal employment on their offspring. Maternal employment during pregnancy with the second child reacts strongly to these policy changes. The share of employed mothers sharply declined in 1990 by 19.1 percentage points, increased in 1996 by 6.9 percentage points and declined again by 6.4 percentage points in 2000. None of these changes in prenatal employment translated into effects on newborn health measured via birth weight, gestational length, and Apgar scores. This result holds true for mothers of different socioeconomic backgrounds and across industries. The effect is precisely estimated, which suggests that prenatal employment prior to the 32nd week of pregnancy does not causally affect the fetus for measures visible at birth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102342.abstractZh: 全球各地的育儿休假政策已经变得比以前更加宽松。产前母亲休假也是如此。虽然短期内这可能会带来成本，但关于怀孕期间母亲就业对新生儿健康的影响，目前了解甚少。在本文中，我研究了奥地利带薪育儿休假期限的三个重大政策变化，这些变化对怀孕32周以上继续工作的母亲比例产生了显著影响。我使用了奥地利出生登记系统中的女性工作历史数据，并结合回归不连续框架，来研究产前就业对其后代的影响。当第二个孩子出生时，怀孕期间的母亲就业情况对这些政策变化反应强烈。1990年，就业母亲的比例下降了19.1个百分点，1996年又上升了6.9个百分点，然后在2000年再次下降了6.4个百分点。然而，这些产前就业的变化并未体现在通过出生体重、妊娠长度和Apgar评分等指标衡量的新生儿健康方面。这一结果适用于不同社会经济背景和不同行业的母亲。这种影响被精确估计，表明怀孕32周之前的产前就业并不会对出生时的胎儿产生因果影响。

abstract.text: We study the effect of a physician-targeted nudge letter on opioid prescribing. In May 2017, the Social Insurance Institution of Finland sent a personal information letter to all physicians who had issued a prescription containing at least 100 tablets of paracetamol-codeine combination to a new patient. The aim of the letter was to draw the physicians' attention to their prescribing practices and to decrease the size of the first codeine prescription. Using individual level register data and a difference-in-differences strategy, we estimate that the letter decreased the average number of tablets purchased by new patients by 12.5 percent and the probability of a first purchase being at least 100 tablets by six percentage points. We also find that these effects were larger among consistent high prescribers. However, we do not find similar effects on other mild or strong opioids.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102344.abstractZh: 我们研究了针对医生的劝导信对阿片类药物处方的影响。2017年5月，芬兰社会保险机构向所有向新患者开具至少包含100片扑热息痛-可待因组合药物的医生发送了个人信息信。该信的目的是提醒医生注意他们的处方行为，并减少首次开具可待因处方的数量。通过个体层面的登记数据和差异-差异策略，我们估计该信使新患者每次购买的药物片数平均减少了12.5%，首次购买至少100片药物的概率降低了6个百分点。我们还发现，这些效应在持续高处方量的医生中更为明显。然而，我们没有发现对其他轻度或强效阿片类药物有类似的效应。

abstract.text: Militaries around the world perform training exercises in preparation for war. We study the relationship between in utero exposure to military exercises (bombing) and early-life health outcomes, combining data on naval bombing exercises in Vieques, Puerto Rico, and the universe of births from 1990 to 2003. Using a differences-in-differences design, we find that the sudden end of bombing practices is associated with a 56-79% decrease in the incidence of congenital anomalies. The evidence is generally consistent with the channel of environmental pollution through increases in contaminant levels in waters surrounding the live impact area.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102345.abstractZh: 世界各地的军队进行训练演习以准备战争。我们研究了在子宫内接触军事演习（如轰炸）与早期健康结果之间的关系，结合了波多黎各维克斯岛的海军轰炸演习数据以及1990至2003年的出生数据。通过差异比较设计，我们发现轰炸活动的突然停止与先天性异常的发生率减少了56-79%有关。这些证据总体上与环境污染通过增加生活影响区域周围水域的污染物水平这一途径有关。

abstract.text: Standard cost-effectiveness models compare incremental cost increases to incremental average gains in health, commonly expressed in Quality-Adjusted Life Years (QALYs). Our research generalizes earlier models in several ways. We introduce risk aversion in Quality of Life (QoL), which leads to "willingness-to-pay" thresholds that rise with illness severity, potentially by an order of magnitude. Unlike traditional CEA analyses, which discriminate against persons with disabilities, our analysis implies that the marginal value of improving QoL rises for disabled individuals. Our model can also value the uncertain benefits of medical interventions by employing well-established analytic methods from finance. Finally, we show that traditional QALYs no longer serve as a single index of health, when consumers are risk-averse. To address this problem, we derive a generalized single-index of health outcomes-the Generalized Risk-Adjusted QALY (GRA-QALY). Earlier models of CEA that abstract from risk-aversion nest as special cases of our more general model.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102346.abstractZh: 标准成本效益模型将成本的增加与健康方面的平均收益进行比较，通常以质量调整生命年（QALYs）来表示。我们的研究在多个方面对早期模型进行了扩展。我们在生活质量（QoL）中引入了风险厌恶因素，这导致“支付意愿”阈值随着疾病严重程度的增加而上升，可能上升一个数量级。与传统的CEA分析不同，后者会对残疾人士产生歧视，我们的分析表明，改善QoL对残疾人士的边际价值更高。我们的模型还可以利用金融领域成熟的分析方法，来评估医疗干预措施的不确定收益。最后，我们表明，当消费者具有风险厌恶倾向时，传统的QALYs不再能作为衡量健康的单一指标。为了解决这个问题，我们推导出了一种广义的健康结果单一指标——广义风险调整QALY（GRA-QALY）。早期基于风险厌恶的CEA模型可以视为我们更通用模型的特例。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the health effects of a large-scale subsidizing program of prescription drugs introduced in Brazil, the Aqui Tem Farmácia Popular program (ATFP). We exploit features of the program to identify its effects on mortality and hospitalization rates by diabetes for individuals aged 40 years or more. We find weak evidence for a decline in mortality, but a robust reduction in hospitalization rates. According to our preferred specification, an additional ATFP pharmacy per 100,000 inhabitants is associated with a decrease in hospitalization rates by diabetes of 8.2, which corresponds to 3.6% of its baseline rate. Effects are larger for Type II diabetes in comparison to Type I, and among patients with relatively lower socioeconomic status. Overall, the results are consistent with insulin-dependent patients being relatively less responsive to subsidies because of higher immediate life-threatening risks; and with lower-SES individuals being more responsive because of liquidity constraints. These results support the view that the optimal design of health systems and cost-sharing mechanisms should take into account equity concerns, heterogeneous impacts by health condition, and their potential offsetting effects on the utilization of downstream health services.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102347.abstractZh: 本文评估了巴西一项大规模处方药补贴计划——Aqui Tem Farmácia Popular计划（ATFP）对健康的影响。我们利用该计划的特点，分析其对40岁及以上人群糖尿病相关死亡率和住院率的影響。研究发现，虽然死亡率的下降证据不足，但住院率确实有所降低。根据我们的分析，每10万居民增加一家ATFP药店，糖尿病相关住院率可下降8.2%，相当于基线水平的3.6%。与1型糖尿病相比，2型糖尿病的疗效更为显著，且低社会经济地位的患者对此计划的响应更为积极，因为他们在资金方面存在限制。这些结果支持了这样的观点：卫生系统和费用分担机制的最佳设计应考虑到公平问题、不同健康状况带来的差异影响，以及它们对下游健康服务利用的潜在抵消效应。

abstract.text: Public policies aimed at improving health may have indirect effects on outcomes such as education and employment. We study the labor market effects of the US Food and Drug Administration's 2007 expanded black box warning on antidepressants. Our difference-in-differences estimates imply that the warning reduced employment by 6.1 percent among women aged 35-49 with a history of depression. We explore potential mechanisms and find that antidepressant and psychotherapy use among women aged 35-49 decreased after the warning. Our analysis suggests that the 2007 warning reduced US labor force participation by 0.23 percentage points, leading to $11.8 billion in lost wages.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102348.abstractZh: 旨在改善健康的公共政策可能对教育和就业等结果产生间接影响。我们研究了美国食品药品监督管理局在2007年对抗抑郁药增加黑框警告对劳动力市场的影响。我们的差异-差异估计表明，这一警告导致有抑郁症病史的35-49岁女性就业率下降了6.1%。我们探讨了潜在的机制，发现警告发布后，35-49岁女性使用抗抑郁药和心理治疗的情况有所减少。我们的分析表明，2007年的警告使美国劳动力参与率下降了0.23个百分点，导致经济损失达118亿美元。

abstract.text: We use data from three waves of Add Health to study the short- and long-run effects of high school peers' genetic predisposition to high BMI-measured by grade-mates' average BMI polygenic scores-on adolescent and adult obesity in the U.S. We find that, in the short-run, a one standard deviation increase in peers' average BMI polygenic scores raises the probability of obesity for females by 2.8% points, about half the size of the effect induced by a one standard deviation increase in one's own polygenic score. No significant effect is found for males. In the long-run, however, the social-genetic effect fades away, while the effect of one's own genetic risk for BMI increases substantially. We suggest that mechanisms explaining the short-run effect for females include changes in nutrition habits and a distorted perception of body size.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102349.abstractZh: 我们利用Add Health研究的三次数据，研究了高中同学遗传倾向对青少年和成人肥胖的短期和长期影响。这些遗传倾向通过同学的平均BMI多基因评分来衡量。研究发现，短期内，同学平均BMI多基因评分增加一个标准差，会使女性肥胖的概率增加2.8%，这一效应约为个人自身多基因评分增加一个标准差时效应的一半。对于男性来说，并未发现显著效应。然而，从长期来看，这种社会遗传效应逐渐消失，而个人自身BMI遗传风险的影响则显著增强。我们认为，解释女性短期效应的机制包括营养习惯的变化以及对身体尺寸的扭曲认知。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the impact of women's retirement on their informal care provision. Using SOEP data, we address fundamental endogeneity problems by exploiting variation in the German pension system in two complementary ways. We find a significant effect of retirement on informal care provision, when using early retirement age thresholds as instruments. Heterogeneity analyses confirm the underlying behavioral mechanism, a time conflict between labor supply and informal care. We further exploit a sizable increase in the early retirement age for German women and find that affected women provide less non-intensive care. High intensity care is not impacted, which leads to a double burden and potentially negative health effects for caregivers. Exploiting the policy reform, we find evidence supporting the notion that formal care is no substitute for informal care. This implies that less overall care is received, which can be damaging to the health of the recipients of care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102350.abstractZh: 本文分析了女性退休对其非正式照顾提供的影响。利用SOEP数据，我们通过两种互补的方式利用德国养老金制度的差异来解决根本的内生性问题。研究发现，当使用提前退休年龄作为工具变量时，退休对非正式照顾提供有显著影响。异质性分析证实了潜在的行为机制，即劳动力供给与非正式照顾之间的时间冲突。我们进一步发现，德国女性的提前退休年龄有所上升，受此影响的女性提供的非密集型照顾减少。高强度的照顾并未受到影响，这导致照顾者面临双重负担，并可能对其健康产生负面影响。通过利用政策改革，我们发现有证据表明正式照顾并不能替代非正式照顾。这意味着整体照顾水平下降，这可能对照顾者的健康造成损害。

abstract.text: There is considerable ambiguity in the literature on the effect of health insurance on health. While the majority of previous analyses have examined physical health outcomes, analyses of the broader dimensions of health such as psychological health and wellbeing have been less frequent. Using data from the Irish Longitudinal Study on Ageing (TILDA) and a difference-in-differences research design, we examine the impact of free general practitioner (GP) care on psychological health among the older population and explore potential mechanisms. While we find no impact of public health insurance expansions on quality of life, life satisfaction, depression, and worry, the removal of GP fees for all those 70+ leads to a significantly lower level of perceived stress. The impact is mainly driven by poorer, sicker and single individuals. Further analyses show that removing GP fees leads to greater access to GP services and lower levels of financial stress.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102351.abstractZh: 关于健康保险对健康影响的文献中存在相当大的模糊性。虽然大多数先前的研究都关注身体健康状况，但对心理健康和福祉等更广泛健康维度的研究则较少。我们利用爱尔兰老龄化纵向研究（TILDA）的数据，采用差异-差异研究设计，探讨了免费全科医生服务对老年人群心理健康的影响，并探索了潜在机制。我们发现，公共健康保险扩展对生活质量、生活满意度、抑郁和担忧没有影响，而取消70岁以上人群的全科医生费用则显著降低了感知压力水平。这种影响主要出现在较贫困、患病和单身人群中。进一步分析表明，取消全科医生费用能够增加获得全科医生服务的机会，并降低财务压力。

abstract.text: This paper utilizes census records, inpatient records, comprehensive surveys, and mortality records from England to trace out the effect of reaching retirement age on retirement status and health outcomes. Applying a regression discontinuity design leveraging the pension age, I find that retirement substantially improves well-being and reported health. I find no immediate effect of retirement on behavioral outcomes and no evidence of changes to cognitive ability, utilization, or mortality. While prior literature has considered the effects of retirement on specific outcomes, this paper systematically examines the full range of health-related outcomes with administrative and survey data in a unified context.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102352.abstractZh: 本文利用英格兰的普查记录、住院记录、综合调查以及死亡记录，来追踪达到退休年龄对退休状态和健康结果的影响。通过采用基于退休年龄的回归不连续设计，我发现退休显著提升了幸福感及健康状况。研究未发现退休对行为结果的直接影响，也没有证据表明认知能力、医疗利用或死亡率发生了变化。虽然先前的研究已经探讨了退休对特定结果的影响，但本文通过行政数据和调查数据，在统一的背景下系统地考察了所有与健康相关的结果。

abstract.text: This paper examines reforms that enabled private hospitals to compete with public hospitals for elective patients in England. Studying hip replacements, we compare changes in outcomes across areas differentially exposed to private hospital entry, instrumenting hospital entry with the pre-reform location of private hospitals. We find private hospital entry increased the number of publicly funded hip replacements by 12% but did not reduce volumes at incumbent public hospitals, and had no impact on readmission rates. This suggests new entrants exerted little competitive pressure on incumbents. Instead, the market expanded with more marginal patients receiving treatment at an earlier point in time, resulting in a fall in average patient severity. Additional publicly funded volumes were not associated with reduced privately funded volumes, while impacts of provider entry did not vary by local deprivation. These findings indicate the reform increased publicly funded capacity but did not improve quality at existing public hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102353.abstractZh: 本文研究了英格兰促使私立医院与公立医院在择期手术患者中竞争的改革措施。以髋关节置换手术为例，我们对比了不同地区在私立医院进入政策实施前后的治疗效果，并将医院进入情况与改革前的私立医院位置联系起来进行量化分析。研究发现，私立医院的进入使公立医院的髋关节置换手术数量增加了12%，但并未减少现有公立医院的手术量，对再住院率也没有影响。这表明新进入者对现有医院的竞争压力较小。相反，市场随着更多边缘患者更早接受治疗而扩大，导致患者平均病情有所减轻。额外的公共资金投入并未导致私立资金投入的减少，而医疗服务提供者的进入对当地经济状况的影响也不明显。这些发现表明，改革虽然增加了公共资金的投入，但并未提升现有公立医院的医疗质量。

abstract.text: Encouraging and helping elderly to postpone a nursing home admission appears to be a win-win that keeps long-term care spending in check and is in line with the target population's preferences, but there is little evidence about its effects. We study the causal impact of nursing home admission eligibility using Dutch administrative data and exploiting variation between randomly assigned assessors in their tendency to grant eligibility for a nursing home admission. We find a drop in medical care use when eligibility is granted, especially in hospital admissions, while total healthcare spending is unaffected. This suggests that postponing an admission may not always be a win-win after all.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102354.abstractZh: 鼓励并帮助老年人推迟入住养老院似乎是一种双赢策略，既能控制长期护理支出，又能符合目标人群的需求。不过，关于这一策略的实际效果，目前缺乏足够的证据。我们通过荷兰的行政数据研究了获得养老院入住资格所带来的因果影响，并分析了随机分配的评估员在授予资格时的倾向性差异。研究发现，一旦获得资格，医疗服务的使用量会下降，尤其是在住院方面；而总的医疗保健支出则没有受到影响。这表明，推迟入住养老院并不总是能带来双赢的结果。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effects of Jamaica's elimination of user fees in public health facilities on the health and labor supply of working-age individuals. The policy change affected about 83 percent of the population, that is, those who lack health insurance and mainly rely on the public health system. The analysis finds no effects among individuals younger than 40 years old. However, for individuals within the 40-64 age range, the analysis finds that the policy reduced the number of lost days due to illness by 44.3 percent. No effects were found on employment or labor formality at the extensive margin. However, consistent with a reduced number of lost days, the analysis identified a positive effect on labor supply at the intensive margin equivalent to 3.04 weekly hours. Finally, overall benefits are relatively stronger for women, thereby reducing the observed baseline disadvantages relative to men.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102355.abstractZh: 本文估计了牙买加取消公共健康设施用户费用政策对劳动年龄人口健康和劳动力供应的影响。该政策影响了约83%的人口，即那些缺乏健康保险且主要依赖公共健康系统的人群。分析发现，40岁以下的人群并未受到该政策的影响。然而，对于40-64岁年龄段的人群，分析显示该政策使因疾病导致的缺勤天数减少了44.3%。在就业或劳动力形式方面，该政策并未产生明显影响。不过，与减少缺勤天数一致的是，分析发现该政策对劳动力供应产生了积极影响，相当于每周增加了3.04小时的劳动力供给。总体而言，该政策对女性的益处相对较大，从而减少了与男性相比所观察到的劣势。

abstract.text: We investigate the extent to which healthcare service utilisation and costs can be predicted from biomarkers, using the UK Understanding Society panel. We use a sample of 2314 adults who reported no history of diagnosed long-lasting health conditions at baseline (2010/11), when biomarkers were collected. Five years later, their GP, outpatient (OP) and inpatient (IP) utilisation was observed. We develop an econometric technique for count data observed within ranges and a method of combining administrative reference cost data with the survey data without exact individual-level matching. Our composite biomarker index (allostatic load) is a powerful predictor of costs: for those with a baseline allostatic load of at least one standard deviation (1-s.d.) above mean, a 1-s.d. reduction reduces GP, OP and IP costs by around 18%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102356.abstractZh: 我们研究了利用生物标志物能否预测医疗服务的使用情况和成本，研究样本为2314名在2010/11年度基线时未出现过长期健康问题的成年人。五年后，我们观察了这些人的全科医生就诊、门诊和住院使用情况。我们开发了一种用于计数数据的计量经济技术，并提出了一种方法，可以将行政参考成本数据与调查数据结合起来，而无需进行精确的个体层面匹配。我们的综合生物标志物指数（稳态负荷）是成本的有力预测指标：对于基线稳态负荷至少比平均值高一个标准差的人，稳态负荷降低一个标准差，全科医生就诊、门诊和住院费用将分别减少约18%。

abstract.text: Distance to health centers can represent a significant healthcare cost for poor households. Community-based health interventions and community health workers can be an alternative to deficient formal health care provision among remote populations. We analyze the effects on fertility outcomes of a large-scale community-based health worker program that aims to reach remote areas distant from health facilities in Madagascar. We use a triple difference model that exploits time and geographic variation in the program rollout and the geocoded household distance to the closest health facility. Our findings indicate that the program decreased the probability of conception among women in treated areas but did not have a differential effect among women living in remote areas. A potential mechanism underlying this fertility reduction is that the program increased women's modern contraceptive use.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102365.abstractZh: 距离医疗中心的距离对于贫困家庭来说可能代表着巨大的医疗成本。基于社区的医疗干预和社区健康工作者可以成为解决偏远地区正式医疗服务不足问题的替代方案。我们分析了一项大规模基于社区的医疗工作者计划对生育结果的影响，该计划旨在覆盖马达加斯加远离医疗设施的偏远地区。我们使用了一个三重差异模型，该模型利用了项目推广时间和地理上的差异，以及家庭到最近医疗设施的距离。我们的研究结果表明，该计划降低了治疗地区妇女受孕的概率，但在偏远地区生活的妇女中并没有出现差异效应。这种生育率下降的潜在机制可能是该计划增加了妇女使用现代避孕方法的情况。

abstract.text: We examined the role of billing processes in health care utilization by exploiting a shift in provider payment from fee-for-service reimbursement towards fee-for-service direct disbursement for outpatient services in Thailand. Specifically, prior to October 2006, affected patients had to pay the full cost of outpatient treatment and subsequently received reimbursement; thereafter, these payments can be sent directly to the providers, without patients having to pay anything upfront. By using nationally representative micro-data and a difference-in-difference methodology, we show that the direct disbursement policy leads to an increase in outpatient utilization among the sick. This non-price change has long-lasting impacts and particularly increases the health care utilization of sick individuals who are living in rural areas, are less educated and earn low incomes. These findings suggest that direct disbursement helps to increase liquidity constraint individuals' health care utilization. The results emphasize the effectiveness of behavioural interventions in health policy making.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102366.abstractZh: 我们研究了计费流程在医疗保健利用中的作用，通过分析泰国医疗服务提供者支付方式的转变来探讨这一现象。具体而言，在2006年10月之前，患者必须支付门诊治疗的全部费用，之后才能获得报销；此后，这些费用可以直接支付给医疗服务提供者，患者无需预先支付任何费用。利用具有全国代表性的微观数据以及差异-差异分析法，我们发现直接支付政策导致患病患者的门诊利用量增加。这种非价格变化具有长期影响，尤其增加了生活在农村地区、受教育程度较低且收入较低的患病个体的医疗保健利用。这些发现表明，直接支付有助于增加流动性受限个体的医疗保健利用。研究结果强调了行为干预在卫生政策制定中的有效性。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the price variability of standardized medical devices purchased by Italian Public Buyers (PBs). A semiparametric approach is used to recover the marginal cost of each device. Average prices vary substantially between PBs; we show that most of the difference between the purchase prices and estimated costs is associated with a PB fixed effect, which, in turn, is related to the institutional characteristics and size of the PB. Repeating the main estimation using device fixed effects yields similar results. Finally, an exogenous policy change, i.e. the termination of the mandatory reference price regime, is used to assess how discretion affects medical device procurement given the skills of each PB. Our results show that less PB discretion - i.e. when mandatory reference prices apply - determines efficiency gains and losses for low- and high-skilled PBs, respectively.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102370.abstractZh: 本文研究了意大利公共采购方购买的标准化医疗器械的价格变动情况。采用半参数方法来估算每台设备的边际成本。不同公共采购方之间的平均价格存在显著差异；我们发现，购买价格与估算成本之间的大部分差异与公共采购方的固定效应有关，而这一固定效应又与公共采购方的机构特征和规模相关。再次使用设备固定效应进行主要估计，得到了类似的结果。最后，通过引入一个外生政策变化——即终止强制参考价格制度——来评估在公共采购方具备相应能力的情况下，自由裁量权对医疗器械采购的影响。我们的研究结果表明，在强制参考价格制度实施的情况下，较少的自由裁量权会导致低技能和高技能公共采购方的效率收益和损失有所不同。

abstract.text: Governments worldwide are increasingly concerned about the booming use of CBD (cannabidiol) products. However, we know little about the impact of their liberalization. We study a unique case of unintended liberalization of a CBD-based product (light cannabis) that occurred in Italy in 2017. Using unique and high-frequency data on prescription drug sales and by exploiting the staggered local availability of the new product in each Italian province, we document a significant substitution effect between light cannabis and anxiolytics, sedatives, opioids, anti-depressants and anti-psychotics. Results are informative for regulators and suggest that bans on light cannabis use would disregard the needs of patients to seek effective reliefs of their symptoms.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102371.abstractZh: 全球各国政府越来越关注CBD产品使用的激增。然而，我们对这些产品自由化的影响知之甚少。本研究以2017年意大利发生的CBD产品（轻大麻）非预期自由化为例进行探讨。通过独特的、高频的处方药销售数据，并结合意大利各省份新产品上市时间的差异，我们发现轻大麻与抗焦虑药、镇静剂、阿片类药物、抗抑郁药和抗精神病药之间存在显著的替代效应。研究结果对监管机构具有参考价值，并表明禁止轻大麻的使用可能会忽视患者寻求有效缓解症状的需求。

abstract.text: Do minimum wages and the earned income tax credit (EITC) mitigate rising "deaths of despair?" We leverage state variation in these policies over time to estimate event study and difference-in-differences models of deaths due to drug overdose, suicide, and alcohol-related causes. Our causal models find no significant effects on drug or alcohol-related mortality, but do find significant reductions in non-drug suicides. A 10 percent minimum wage increase reduces non-drug suicides among low-educated adults by 2.7 percent, and the comparable EITC figure is 3.0 percent. Placebo tests and event-study models support our causal research design. Increasing both policies by 10 percent would likely prevent a combined total of more than 700 suicides each year.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102372.abstractZh: 最低工资和劳动所得税抵免政策是否能缓解“绝望死亡”现象的增加？我们通过分析这些政策在不同州的实施情况，运用事件研究和差异差异模型来研究因药物过量、自杀和酒精相关原因导致的死亡情况。我们的因果模型发现，这些政策对药物或酒精相关的死亡率没有显著影响，但确实显著降低了非药物相关自杀事件。最低工资提高10%可使低教育水平成年人的非药物相关自杀率降低2.7%，相应的劳动所得税抵免政策则能将这一比例降低3.0%。安慰剂测试和事件研究模型也支持我们的因果研究设计。如果这两项政策都提高10%，每年可能总共预防超过700起自杀事件。

abstract.text: What is the contribution of the 'Green Revolution' to improvements in child health during the 20 th century? We provide global scale estimates of this relationship by constructing a novel, spatially-precise indicator of modern crop variety (MV) diffusion and leveraging child-level data from over 600,000 children across 21,604 sampling locations in 37 developing countries between 1961-2000. Results indicate that the diffusion of MVs reduced infant mortality by 2.4-5.3 percentage points (from a baseline of 18%), with stronger effects for male infants and among poor households. The sizable contribution of agricultural technology to improved welfare should inform global food and development policy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102373.abstractZh: “绿色革命”在20世纪对儿童健康的改善中起到了什么作用？我们通过构建一种空间上精确的现代作物品种传播指标，并利用1961年至2000年间37个发展中国家21,604个采样点中超过60万儿童的数据，对这种关系进行了全球范围的估算。研究结果表明，作物品种的传播使婴儿死亡率降低了2.4%至5.3个百分点（基线值为18%），且这一效应在男婴和贫困家庭中更为显著。农业技术对改善福利的显著贡献应能为全球粮食和发展政策提供参考。

abstract.text: We study a population-based influenza vaccination program in the Netherlands, and the spillovers it has within families. Individuals aged 65 years and over qualify for the program and receive a personal invitation for a free flu shot, while ineligible individuals have to pay out-of-pocket and face additional barriers to getting vaccinated. The quasi-random variation at age 65 is exploited to analyse program impact on vaccination behavior of cohabiting partners and adult children. We find that the program induced a 10 percentage points increase in vaccination coverage among individuals at age 65. The program further led to a similar effect on vaccination take-up by cohabiting younger partners, but spillovers on children were negative. These asymmetric patterns of vaccination uptake are consistent with partners and children learning about influenza mortality risk, target group membership, and cost and benefits of vaccination, as well as salience. We conclude that public health campaigns should pay attention to the effects on voluntary preventive care participation as within-family spillovers impact the program's overall public health impact.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102386.abstractZh: 我们研究了荷兰一项基于人口的流感疫苗接种计划及其对家庭的影响。65岁及以上的个体有资格参加该计划，并会收到免费接种流感疫苗的邀请，而不符合条件的个体则必须自付费用，并且面临额外的接种障碍。通过利用65岁这一年龄段的准随机差异，我们分析了该计划对同居伴侣和成年子女接种行为的影响。研究发现，该计划使65岁及以上个体的疫苗接种覆盖率提高了10个百分点。该计划还对同居年轻伴侣的疫苗接种率产生了类似的影响，但对儿童的接种效果则呈负面影响。这些不对称的疫苗接种模式与伴侣和儿童对流感死亡风险的认识、目标群体成员身份以及疫苗接种的成本和收益有关。我们得出结论，公共卫生宣传活动应关注对自愿预防性护理参与的影响，因为家庭内部的溢出效应会影响该计划的整体公共卫生效果。

abstract.text: A positive demand shock for coltan, a mineral whose bulky output cannot be concealed, leads armed actors to create illicit customs and provide protection at coltan mines, where they settle as “stationary bandits.” A similar shock for gold, easy to conceal, leads to stationary bandits in the villages where income from gold is spent, where they introduce illicit mining visas, taxes, and administrations. Having a stationary bandit from a militia or the Congolese army increases welfare. These findings suggest that armed actors may create “essential functions of a state” to better expropriate, which, depending on their goals, can increase welfare.

10.1086/703989.abstractZh: 对于coltan这种体积较大的矿物，其需求冲击是积极的，因为这种矿物的产量难以隐藏。因此，武装分子会在coltan矿场设立非法关卡并提供保护，他们以“固定匪徒”的身份在矿场定居。对于黄金而言，虽然更容易隐藏，但同样会导致固定匪徒出现在黄金开采的村庄中，他们会引入非法采矿签证、税收和行政制度。从民兵或刚果军队中招募固定匪徒可以提高社会福利。这些发现表明，武装分子可能会创造“国家的必要职能”，以便更好地进行剥削，而根据他们的目标，这可能会提高社会福利。

abstract.text: In online procurement markets, projects are often allocated through a mechanism that allows buyers to take into account a seller’s nonprice characteristics as well as his bid. We design a methodology to recover primitives of the environment in the presence of unobserved seller heterogeneity while accommodating two important features of such markets: buyer-specific choice sets and the high turnover of sellers. We apply our method to data from an online market for programming services, to assess buyers’ welfare gains associated with the globalization enabled by the internet. We find that the internet enables buyers to substantially improve on their outside (local) option; many of the gains arise from access to the international markets.

10.1086/703990.abstractZh: 在在线采购市场中，项目通常通过一种机制进行分配，这种机制允许买家考虑卖方的非价格特征以及其报价。我们设计了一种方法，可以在卖方存在未观察到的异质性时，恢复环境中的原始数据，同时兼顾此类市场的两个重要特征：买家特定的选择集以及卖方的频繁更换。我们将该方法应用于一个在线编程服务市场的数据，以评估买家因互联网带来的全球化而获得的福利收益。我们发现，互联网使买家能够显著改善其外部（本地）选择；许多收益来自对国际市场的访问。

abstract.text: We study merger policy in a dynamic computational model in which firms can reduce costs through investment or through mergers. Firms invest or propose mergers according to the profitability of these strategies. An antitrust authority can block mergers at some cost. We examine the optimal policy for an antitrust authority that cannot commit to its future policy and approves mergers as they are proposed. We find that the optimal policy can differ substantially from a policy based on static welfare. In general, antitrust policy can greatly affect firms’ investment behavior, and firms’ investment behavior can greatly affect the optimal antitrust policy.

10.1086/704069.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个动态计算模型中的合并政策，在该模型中，企业可以通过投资或合并来降低成本。企业根据这些策略的盈利能力来决定是否进行投资或提议合并。反垄断机构可以以一定的成本阻止合并。我们研究了在无法承诺未来政策并且只能批准已提出的合并情况下的反垄断机构的最优政策。我们发现，最优政策与基于静态福利的政策有很大差异。总体而言，反垄断政策会极大地影响企业的投资行为，而企业的投资行为又会极大地影响最优反垄断政策。

abstract.text: The absence of a trend in hours worked in the postwar United States is an exception: across countries and historically, hours fall steadily by a little below 0.5% per year. Are steadily falling hours consistent with a stable utility function over consumption and leisure under balanced growth of the macroeconomic aggregates? Yes. We fully characterize the class of such functions and thus generalize the well-known “balanced-growth preferences” that demand constant (as opposed to falling) long-run hours. Key to falling hours is an income effect (of steady productivity growth on hours) that slightly outweighs the substitution effect.

10.1086/704071.abstractZh: 战后美国工作时间没有呈现下降趋势，这是一个例外：从各国情况来看，历史上工作时间每年稳步下降，降幅略低于0.5%。工作时间稳步下降是否与消费和休闲的效用函数稳定相关，以及宏观经济总量是否保持平衡？答案是肯定的。我们完全描述了这类函数的类别，从而推广了众所周知的“平衡增长偏好”，这种偏好要求长期工作时间保持恒定（而非下降）。工作时间下降的关键在于收入效应（即稳定的生产率增长对工作时间的影响）略微超过了替代效应。

abstract.text: I analytically characterize the long-run behavior of an economy with two types of agents who differ in their beliefs and are endowed with homothetic recursive preferences. Agents with more incorrect beliefs dominate, or agents with different accuracy of their beliefs coexist in the long run, for broad ranges of plausible parameterizations when risk aversion is greater than the inverse of the intertemporal elasticity of substitution. The results highlight a crucial interaction between risk sharing, speculative behavior and consumption-saving choice of agents with heterogeneous beliefs, and the role of equilibrium prices in shaping long-run outcomes.

10.1086/704072.abstractZh: 本文从分析角度描述了经济体的长期行为，该经济体内存在两种类型的代理人，这两种代理人的信念存在差异，并且他们都拥有同质递归偏好。在风险厌恶程度大于跨期替代弹性倒数的情况下，对于广泛的参数化范围而言，信念更不正确的代理人会占据主导地位，或者信念准确性不同的代理人会在长期内共存。研究结果强调了风险共享、投机行为以及具有异质信念的代理人的消费-储蓄选择之间的关键互动关系，同时也揭示了均衡价格在塑造长期结果中的作用。

abstract.text: Social insurance is often linked to marriage. Existing evidence suggests small marital responses to financial incentives and stems from settings where benefits are realized in the near future. I analyze how linking survivors insurance to marriage affects the marriage market. Exploiting Sweden’s elimination of survivors insurance, I demonstrate that severing this link (1) affected entry into marriage up to 50 years before expected payout, (2) raised the divorce rate by 10%, and (3) raised the assortativeness of matching. This suggests that marital behavior is a key component of couples’ strategies to plan for financial security in old age.

10.1086/704073.abstractZh: 社会保险通常与婚姻相关联。现有证据表明，婚姻对财务激励的反应较小，这源于福利在不久的将来才能兑现的情况。我分析了将生存保险与婚姻联系起来的做法如何影响婚姻市场。通过利用瑞典取消生存保险的政策，我证明，切断这种联系会导致（1）进入婚姻的时间比预期支付时间提前多达50年；（2）离婚率上升10%；（3）匹配性降低。这表明，婚姻行为是夫妻规划老年财务安全策略中的一个关键要素。

abstract.text: We study the class of multiround, multiproduct clock procurement auctions that reduce offered prices at each round. When prices stop declining, the remaining bidders become the winning sellers. For single-minded bidders, each such auction has five properties not shared by Vickrey auctions: each is obviously strategy-proof and group-strategy-proof, sets prices that are Nash equilibrium winning bids in the related first-price auction, preserves winner privacy about values, and can be extended to satisfy a budget constraint. In simulations of the US incentive auction, a heuristic clock auction from this class achieves quick computations, high efficiency, and low prices.

10.1086/704074.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种多轮、多产品时钟采购拍卖类，这类拍卖在每一轮都会降低出价。当价格不再下降时，剩下的竞买者将成为中标卖家。对于一心一意的竞买者来说，这种拍卖具有五个与Vickrey拍卖不同的特性：每个出价显然都是策略免疫的，并且符合群体策略免疫原则；出价符合相关第一价格拍卖中的纳什均衡中标价；能够保护中标者关于价值的隐私；并且可以扩展以满足预算限制。在对美国激励拍卖的模拟实验中，这类拍卖类实现了快速计算、高效率和低价格。

abstract.text: Exploiting admission thresholds to the Bologna day care system, we show using a regression discontinuity (RD) design that one additional day care month at age 0–2 reduces intelligence quotient by 0.5% (4.7% of a standard deviation) at age 8–14 in a relatively affluent population. The magnitude of this negative effect increases with family income. Similar negative impacts are found for personality traits. These findings are consistent with the hypothesis from psychology that children in day care experience fewer one-to-one interactions with adults, with negative effects in families where such interactions are of higher quality. We embed this hypothesis in a model that lends structure to our RD design.

10.1086/704075.abstractZh: 通过利用博洛尼亚日托系统的录取门槛数据，我们使用回归不连续设计发现，在0-2岁期间增加一个月的日托服务，会使8-14岁儿童的智商降低0.5%（相当于标准偏差的4.7%）。这种负面影响的程度随着家庭收入的增加而加剧。对于性格特征也发现了类似的负面影响。这些发现与心理学中的假设一致，即日托中的儿童与成人的一对一互动较少，而在这种互动质量较高的家庭中，负面影响更为明显。我们将这一假设纳入了一个模型，为我们的回归不连续设计提供了结构支持。

abstract.text: Consider a decision maker who selects between paired random draws from two unconditional distributions, always selecting the larger draw in the pair. When will the resulting selection-conditioned distributions be ordered by first-order stochastic or monotone likelihood ratio dominance? In various guises, this question arises in many economic contexts—tournaments, contests, auctions, cheap-talk games, announcement returns, qualitative choice models, and treatment effects under self-selection. This paper develops simple, applicable characterizations of the properties of unconditional distributions that result in dominance conditioned on selection and uses these characterizations to analyze a number of economic selection problems.

10.1086/704076.abstractZh: 设想一个决策者，他从两个无条件分布中每次随机抽取一个组合，并且总是选择其中较大的一个。那么，最终的选择条件分布何时会遵循一阶随机或单调似然比优势？这个问题在许多经济场景中都会出现——如锦标赛、竞赛、拍卖、廉价谈话游戏、公告回报、定性选择模型以及自我选择下的处理效应等。本文提出了一些简单且适用的无条件分布性质描述，这些描述能够揭示在选择条件下的优势现象，并借助这些描述来分析多种经济选择问题。

abstract.text: We study the theoretical properties and counterfactual predictions of a large class of general equilibrium trade and economic geography models. By combining aggregate factor supply and demand functions with market-clearing conditions, we prove that existence, uniqueness, and—given observed trade flows—the counterfactual predictions of any model within this class depend only on the demand and supply elasticities (“gravity constants”). Using a new “model-implied” instrumental variables approach, we estimate these gravity constants and use these estimates to compute the impact of a trade war between the United States and China.

10.1086/704385.abstractZh: 我们研究了一大类一般均衡贸易与经济地理模型的理论特性以及反事实预测。通过结合总要素供给和需求函数与市场清算条件，我们证明了这类模型中任何模型的存在性、唯一性，以及——在观察到的贸易流量给定的情况下——反事实预测仅依赖于需求和供给弹性（“重力常数”）。采用一种新的“模型蕴含”工具变量方法，我们估计了这些重力常数，并利用这些估计值来计算美国与中国之间贸易战的影响。

abstract.text: This study presents evidence on the role of social environment for the formation of prosociality. We show that socioeconomic status (SES) as well as intensity of mother-child interaction and mothers’ prosocial attitudes are related to elementary school children’s prosociality. We also present evidence on a randomly assigned variation of the social environment, providing children with a mentor for 1 year. Our data reveal a significant and persistent increase in prosociality in the treatment relative to the control group. Moreover, enriching the social environment closes the prosociality gap between low- and high-SES children. A mediation analysis suggests that prosociality develops in response to prosocial role models and intense social interactions.

10.1086/704386.abstractZh: 本研究提供了关于社会环境对亲社会行为形成影响的证据。我们发现，社会经济地位、母子互动的频繁程度以及母亲的亲社会态度与小学生亲社会行为之间存在关联。此外，我们还研究了在随机分配的社会环境中为儿童提供一年导师指导的效果，数据显示，在实验组中，儿童的亲社会行为显著且持续地增加。而且，丰富社会环境有助于缩小低社会经济地位儿童与高社会经济地位儿童之间的亲社会行为差距。中介分析表明，亲社会行为的发展是响应亲社会榜样和频繁的社会互动而发生的。

abstract.text: We study information as an incentive device in a dynamic moral hazard framework. An agent works on a task of uncertain difficulty, modeled as the duration of required effort. The principal knows the task difficulty and provides information over time. The optimal mechanism features moving goalposts: an initial disclosure makes the agent sufficiently optimistic that the task is easy. If the task is indeed difficult, the agent is told this only after working long enough to put the difficult task within reach. The agent then completes the difficult task even though he never would have chosen to at the outset.

10.1086/704387.abstractZh: 我们研究信息作为动态道德风险框架中的激励手段。一个代理人从事一项难度不确定的任务，该任务的难度通过所需努力的时间来模拟。委托人了解任务的难度，并随时间提供相关信息。最优机制具有动态变化的特点：最初的披露会让代理人对任务过于乐观，认为任务很容易完成。如果任务确实很困难，代理人只有在付出足够努力后，才能得知这一点。这样，代理人即使一开始并不愿意，最终也会完成这个困难的任务。

abstract.text: Political booms, measured by the rise in governments’ popularity, predict financial crises above and beyond better known early warning indicators, such as credit booms. This predictive power, however, only holds in emerging economies. We argue that governments in developing countries have stronger incentives to “ride” unsound credit booms in order to boost their popularity, rather than implementing corrective policies that could prevent crises but are politically costly. We provide evidence of the relevance of this mechanism, partly by constructing a new cross-country data set on government popularity based on opinion polls.

10.1086/704544.abstractZh: 政治繁荣，通过政府受欢迎程度的上升来衡量，能够预测金融危机，这超出了一些更为人熟知的早期预警指标，比如信贷繁荣。然而，这种预测能力仅存在于新兴经济体中。我们认为，发展中国家的政府有更强的动机去利用不稳固的信贷繁荣来提升自身的受欢迎程度，而不是实施可能预防危机但政治成本较高的纠正政策。我们通过构建基于民意调查的新跨国政府受欢迎程度数据集，为这一机制的相关性提供了证据。

abstract.text: We document an important consequence of bride price, a payment made by the groom to the bride’s family at marriage. Revisiting Indonesia’s school construction program, we find that among ethnic groups without the custom, it had no effect on girls’ schooling. Among ethnic groups with the custom, it had large positive effects. We show (theoretically and empirically) that this is because a daughter’s education, by increasing the amount of money parents receive at marriage, generates an additional incentive for parents to educate their daughters. We replicate these findings in Zambia, a country that had a similar large-scale school construction program.

10.1086/704572.abstractZh: 我们记录了嫁妆这一习俗的一个重要后果，即新郎在婚礼时向新娘家庭支付的款项。通过重新审视印度尼西亚的学校建设计划，我们发现，在没有这一习俗的族群中，嫁妆对女孩的受教育程度没有产生影响。而在有这一习俗的族群中，嫁妆则产生了显著的正面影响。我们从理论和实证角度表明，这是因为女儿的教育水平提高了父母在婚礼时获得的收入，从而进一步激励了父母教育女儿。我们在赞比亚也发现了类似的发现，该国的学校建设计划规模与印度尼西亚相当。

abstract.text: We model household choice of schools under the Boston mechanism (BM) and develop a new method, applicable to a broad class of mechanisms, to fully solve the choice problem even if it is infeasible via the traditional method. We estimate the joint distribution of household preferences and sophistication types, using administrative data from Barcelona. Counterfactual policy analyses show that a change from BM in Barcelona to the deferred-acceptance mechanism would decrease average welfare by €1,020, while a change to the top-trading-cycles mechanism would increase average welfare by €460.

10.1086/704573.abstractZh: 我们基于波士顿机制对家庭选择学校的行为进行了建模，并开发了一种适用于多种机制的新方法，能够完全解决选择问题，即使传统方法无法解决该问题。我们利用了巴塞罗那的行政数据，估计了家庭偏好与复杂程度类型的联合分布。反事实政策分析表明，从巴塞罗那的波士顿机制转变为延迟接受机制，平均福利将减少1,020欧元；而转向顶级交易周期机制，平均福利则会增加460欧元。

abstract.text: We analyze a bilateral trade model where the buyer chooses the distribution of her valuation for the good. The seller, after observing the buyer’s distribution but not the realized valuation, makes a take-it-or-leave-it offer. If distributions are costless, the price and the payoffs of both the buyer and the seller are shown to be 1/e in the unique equilibrium outcome. The buyer’s equilibrium distribution generates a unit-elastic demand, and trade is ex post efficient. These properties are shown to be preserved even when different distributions are differentially costly as long as the cost is monotone in the dispersion of the distribution.

10.1086/704574.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个双边贸易模型，其中买方选择其对商品的估值分布。卖方在观察到买方的分布但未得知实际估值后，会提出一个接受或放弃的报价。如果分布的成本为零，那么买方和卖方的价格和收益都将在唯一均衡结果中表现为1/e。买方的均衡分布会产生单位弹性需求，且交易在事后是有效的。这些特性即使在分布的成本不同且差异递增的情况下也能保持不变，只要成本与分布的分散程度是单调的。

abstract.text: When is financial repression—namely, policies that force banks to hold government debt—optimal? With commitment, such policies are never optimal because they crowd out banks’ productive investments. Without commitment, they are optimal when governments need to issue unusually large amounts of debt, such as during wartime. In such times, repression allows governments to credibly issue more debt. Repression increases credibility because when banks hold government debt, defaults dilute net worth, reduce investment, and are thus costly ex post. Forcing banks to hold debt endogenously increases these ex post costs but has ex ante costs because doing so crowds out investments.

10.1086/704575.abstractZh: 金融压制——即迫使银行持有政府债务的政策——何时才是最优选择？在承诺机制下，这种政策从来都不是最优的，因为它们会排挤银行的可投资资产。而在没有承诺机制的情况下，当政府需要发行大量债务时，比如战争期间，这种政策才是最优的。在这种时候，金融压制使得政府能够可信地发行更多债务。金融压制之所以能提高可信度，是因为当银行持有政府债务时，违约会导致净资产稀释，投资减少，从而带来高昂的后期成本。迫使银行内生性地持有债务会增加这些后期成本，但也会带来前期成本，因为这样做会排挤投资。

abstract.text: In recent decades, democratic countries have negotiated hundreds of international treaties and agreements. This paper analyzes the equilibrium design of treaties negotiated by political incumbents seeking reelection. We show that incumbents are prone to negotiate treaties that are “weak,” in that they may or may not be complied with: this makes it possible to differentiate the alternative candidates in a way that favors the incumbent. We also show that political economy considerations lead to overambitious treaties that rely too much on technology instead of sanctions to motivate compliance. Our theory can rationalize several puzzles associated with treaties.

10.1086/704610.abstractZh: 近几十年来，民主国家已经谈判了数百项国际条约和协议。本文分析了由寻求连任的政治人物所谈判的条约的均衡设计。我们发现，这些政治家倾向于谈判那些“弱”的条约，即这些条约可能得到遵守，也可能不被遵守：这种特性使得可以以一种有利于现任政治人物的方式区分不同的候选人。此外，我们还发现，政治经济因素导致了一些过于雄心勃勃的条约，这些条约过于依赖技术而非制裁来促使各方遵守。我们的理论能够解释与条约相关的几个谜题。

abstract.text: In this paper, we extend Gary Becker’s empirical analysis of the marriage market to same-sex couples. We build an equilibrium model of the same-sex marriage market that allows for straightforward identification of the gains of marriage. We estimate the model with 2008–12 American Community Survey data on California and find that positive assortative mating is weaker for same-sex couples than for different-sex couples with respect to age and race. Positive assortative mating on education is stronger among female same-sex couples but comparable for male same-sex and different-sex couples. As regards labor market outcomes, our results suggest that specialization within the household mainly applies to different-sex couples.

10.1086/704611.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们将Gary Becker对婚姻市场的实证分析扩展到同性伴侣。我们构建了一个同性婚姻市场的均衡模型，该模型能够直接识别婚姻带来的收益。我们使用2008-2012年加州美国社区调查数据对模型进行了估计，发现与异性伴侣相比，同性伴侣在年龄和种族方面的正向同配效应较弱。在教育方面，女性同性伴侣之间的正向同配效应较强，而男性同性伴侣与异性伴侣之间的正向同配效应则相当。就劳动力市场结果而言，我们的研究结果表明，家庭内部的专业化主要适用于异性伴侣。

abstract.text: Women’s reluctance to negotiate is often used to explain the gender wage gap, popularizing the push for women to “lean in” and negotiate more. Examining an environment in which women achieve positive profits when they choose to negotiate, we find that increased negotiations are not helpful. Women know when to ask: they enter negotiations resulting in positive profits and avoid negotiations resulting in negative profits. While the findings are similar for men, we find no evidence that men are more adept than women at knowing when to ask. Thus, our results caution against a greater push for women to negotiate.

10.1086/704616.abstractZh: 女性不愿谈判的现象常被用来解释性别工资差距，这促使人们呼吁女性“主动参与”并更多地进行谈判。然而，当我们观察女性在选择谈判时能够获得积极收益的情况时，我们发现增加谈判次数并没有带来帮助。女性知道何时开口：她们会选择能够带来积极收益的谈判方式，而避免那些可能导致负面收益的谈判。虽然对于男性来说，研究结果类似，但我们没有发现男性在判断何时开口方面比女性更擅长。因此，我们的研究结果提醒人们，不要过度推动女性进行谈判。

abstract.text: We develop a general equilibrium model of asset prices in which benefits of technological innovation are distributed asymmetrically. Financial market participants do not capture all economic gains from innovation even when they own shares in innovating firms. Such gains accrue partly to the innovators, who cannot sell claims on proceeds from their future ideas. We show how the resulting inequality among agents can give rise to a high risk premium on the aggregate stock market, return comovement and average return differences among firms, and the failure of traditional representative agent asset pricing models to account for cross-sectional differences in risk premia.

10.1086/704619.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个资产价格的一般均衡模型，其中技术创新的收益分配是不对称的。金融市场参与者即使拥有创新企业的股份，也无法获得技术创新带来的全部经济收益。这些收益部分归创新者所有，而创新者无法出售其未来创意所产生的收益。我们展示了这种代理之间的不平等如何导致整体股市的高风险溢价、回报的联动性以及企业之间的平均回报差异，并揭示了传统代表性代理人资产定价模型无法解释风险溢价在横截面上的差异。

abstract.text: This article proposes definitions of lying, deception, and damage in strategic settings. Lying depends on the existence of accepted meanings for messages but does not require a model of how the audience responds to messages. Deception does require a model of how the audience interprets messages but does not directly refer to consequences. Damage requires consideration of the consequences of messages. Lies need not be deceptive. Deception does not require lying. Lying and deception are compatible with equilibrium. I give conditions under which deception must be damaging.

10.1086/704754.abstractZh: 本文提出了在战略环境中关于谎言、欺骗和损害的定义。谎言的成立依赖于信息所具备的被接受的含义，但并不需要模拟受众对信息的反应方式。欺骗则需要模拟受众对信息的解读方式，但并不直接涉及后果。损害则需要考虑信息的后果。谎言不一定具有欺骗性，而欺骗并不一定需要谎言。谎言和欺骗与均衡状态是相容的。我提出了欺骗必须造成损害的条件。

abstract.text: We provide a new estimator for a broad class of equilibrium models of metropolitan housing markets with housing differentiated by quality. Quality is a latent variable that captures all features of a dwelling and its environment. We estimate the model for Chicago and New York, obtaining hedonic housing price functions for each quality level for each metropolitan area, stocks of each quality, and compensating variations required for a household of a given income in Chicago to be equally well off in New York.

10.1086/704755.abstractZh: 我们为一类广泛的都市住房市场均衡模型提供了新的估计方法，这些市场中的住房按质量进行区分。质量是一个潜在变量，它涵盖了住宅及其环境的所有特征。我们对芝加哥和纽约的模型进行了估计，得出了每个质量等级下每个都市区域的住房价格函数、各质量等级的存量，以及芝加哥某一收入水平的家庭在纽约能够保持同等生活水平所需的补偿差异。

abstract.text: In most US health insurance markets, plans face strong incentives to "upcode" the patient diagnoses they report to the regulator, as these affect the risk-adjusted payments plans receive. We show that enrollees in private Medicare plans generate 6% to 16% higher diagnosis-based risk scores than they would under fee-for-service Medicare, where diagnoses do not affect most provider payments. Our estimates imply that upcoding generates billions in excess public spending and significant distortions to firm and consumer behavior. We show that coding intensity increases with vertical integration, suggesting a principal-agent problem faced by insurers, who desire more intense coding from the providers with whom they contract.

10.1086/704756.abstractZh: 在美国大多数健康保险市场中，保险计划面临着强烈的动机，倾向于向监管机构报告更严重的患者诊断，因为这些诊断会影响保险计划所获得的风险调整支付。我们的研究表明，私人Medicare计划的参保者所生成的基于诊断的风险评分比按服务收费的Medicare计划高出6%到16%，在后者中，诊断并不影响大多数提供者的支付。我们的估计表明，过度编码会导致公共支出增加数十亿美元，并对企业和消费者的行为造成显著扭曲。我们还发现，编码强度随着垂直整合程度的增加而增加，这表明保险公司面临着一个委托-代理问题，他们希望从与其合作的提供者那里获得更严格的编码。

abstract.text: We study optimal policy in a business-cycle setting in which firms hold dispersed private information about, or are rationally inattentive to, the state of the economy. The informational friction is the source of both nominal and real rigidity. Because of the latter, the optimal monetary policy does not target price stability. Instead, it targets a negative relation between the nominal price level and real economic activity. Such leaning against the wind helps maximize production efficiency. An additional contribution is the adaptation of the primal approach of the Ramsey literature to a flexible form of informational friction.

10.1086/704758.abstractZh: 我们研究了在商业周期背景下的最优政策问题，其中企业持有分散的私人信息，或者出于理性原因对经济状况缺乏关注。信息摩擦是名义刚性和实际刚性产生的根源。由于后者的存在，最优货币政策并非以价格稳定为目标，而是以名义价格水平与实际经济活动之间的负相关性为目标。这种逆风而行的方式有助于最大化生产效率。另一个贡献是，将拉姆齐文献中的原始方法适应于一种灵活的信息摩擦形式。

abstract.text: We develop a dynastic human capital investment framework to study the importance of family borrowing constraints and uninsured labor market risk, as well as the process of intergenerational ability transmission, in determining human capital investments in children at different ages. We calibrate our model to data from the Children of the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth. While the effects of relaxing any borrowing limit at a single stage are modest, eliminating all life-cycle borrowing limits dramatically increases investments, earnings, and intergenerational mobility. The impacts of policy changes at college-going ages are greater when anticipated earlier, and shifting subsidies to earlier ages increases aggregate welfare and human capital.

10.1086/704759.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个王朝式人力资本投资框架，以研究家庭借贷限制和未保险劳动力市场风险的重要性，以及代际能力传递过程对不同年龄儿童人力资本投资的影响。我们根据《全国青年纵向调查》的数据对模型进行了校准。虽然放宽某一阶段的借贷限制效果有限，但完全消除生命周期内的借贷限制会显著增加投资、收益和代际流动性。政策在大学入学年龄的变化影响越大，且预期时间越早，将补贴转向更早的年龄阶段则能提升整体福利和人力资本水平。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic limit pricing model where an incumbent repeatedly signals information relevant to a potential entrant’s expected profitability. The model is tractable, with a unique equilibrium under refinement, and dynamics contribute to large equilibrium price changes. We show that the model can explain why incumbent airlines cut prices dramatically on routes threatened with entry by Southwest, presenting new reduced-form evidence and a calibration that predicts a pattern of price changes across markets similar to the one observed in the data. We use our calibrated model to quantify the welfare effects of asymmetric information and subsidies designed to encourage Southwest’s entry.

10.1086/704760.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态限价模型，其中现有企业会反复向潜在进入者传递与预期盈利能力相关的信息。该模型具有可解性，经过改进后存在唯一均衡状态，且动态因素会导致均衡价格发生较大变化。我们证明该模型能够解释为什么现有航空公司会在受到西南航空进入威胁的航线大幅降价，并提供了新的简化形式证据以及一种校准方法，该方法能够预测市场间价格变化的模式，这与实际观测到的数据相似。我们利用校准后的模型来量化信息不对称以及旨在鼓励西南航空进入的补贴对福利的影响。

abstract.text: We introduce a simple model of dynamic matching in networked markets, where agents arrive and depart stochastically and the composition of the trade network depends endogenously on the matching algorithm. If the planner can identify agents who are about to depart, then waiting to thicken the market substantially reduces the fraction of unmatched agents. If not, then matching agents greedily is close to optimal. We specify conditions under which local algorithms that choose the right time to match agents, but do not exploit the global network structure, are close to optimal. Finally, we consider a setting where agents have private information about their departure times and design a mechanism to elicit this information.

10.1086/704761.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个简单的动态匹配模型，该模型适用于网络市场环境。在这种模型中，参与者以随机方式到达和离开，而交易网络的构成则内生地取决于匹配算法。如果规划者能够识别出即将离开的参与者，那么等待时间以显著扩大市场规模可以减少未匹配参与者的比例。反之，如果无法识别这些参与者，那么贪婪地进行匹配几乎可以达到最优效果。我们指出了一些条件，在这些条件下，选择适当时机进行匹配的局部算法，同时不利用全局网络结构，其效果也接近最优。最后，我们考虑了一个场景，其中参与者拥有关于自己离开时间的私人信息，并设计了一种机制来收集这些信息。

abstract.text: Using data on hospitals’ purchases across a large number of important product categories, we find that access to information on purchasing by peer hospitals leads to reductions in the prices hospitals negotiate for supplies. These effects are concentrated among hospitals previously paying relatively high prices for brands purchased in large volumes. Evidence from coronary stents suggests that transparency allows hospitals to resolve asymmetric information problems, but savings are limited in part by the stickiness of contracts in business-to-business settings. Savings are largest for physician preference items, where high-price, high-quantity hospital-brand combinations average 3.9% savings, versus 1.6% for commodities.

10.1086/705329.abstractZh: 通过大量重要产品类别的医院采购数据，我们发现，获取同行医院采购信息的透明度能够降低医院在采购物资时协商的价格。这些效应主要出现在那些过去在大量采购品牌产品时支付较高价格的医院。关于冠状动脉支架的证据表明，透明度有助于医院解决信息不对称问题，但节省的成本受到企业间合同粘性的限制。在医生偏好的商品上，节省的成本最大，其中高价、大批量采购的医院品牌组合平均可节省3.9%的成本，而商品类的节省成本仅为1.6%。

abstract.text: Using a random judge design and panel data from Norway, we estimate that imprisonment discourages further criminal behavior, with reoffense probabilities falling by 29 percentage points and criminal charges dropping by 11 over a 5-year period. Ordinary least squares mistakenly reaches the opposite conclusion. The decline is driven by individuals not working prior to incarceration; these individuals increase participation in employment programs and raise their future employment and earnings. Previously employed individuals experience lasting negative employment effects. These findings demonstrate that time spent in prison with a focus on rehabilitation can be preventive for a large segment of the criminal population.

10.1086/705330.abstractZh: 通过采用随机法官设计和挪威的面板数据，我们估计监禁行为会抑制进一步的犯罪行为，在5年期间，再犯概率下降了29个百分点，刑事指控数量减少了11%。普通最小二乘法却得出了相反的结论。这种下降是由于在入狱前个体不再工作，这些个体增加了对就业项目的参与，从而提高了未来的就业和收入。而之前有工作的个体则经历了长期的负面就业影响。这些研究结果表明，专注于改造的监禁时间对大部分犯罪人群具有预防作用。

abstract.text: We develop a new method to measure CEO behavior in large samples via a survey that collects high-frequency, high-dimensional diary data and a machine learning algorithm that estimates behavioral types. Applying this method to 1,114 CEOs in six countries reveals two types: “leaders,” who do multifunction, high-level meetings, and “managers,” who do individual meetings with core functions. Firms that hire leaders perform better, and it takes three years for a new CEO to make a difference. Structural estimates indicate that productivity differentials are due to mismatches rather than to leaders being better for all firms.

10.1086/705331.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种新的方法，通过调查收集高频、高维度的日记数据，并利用机器学习算法来估计行为类型，从而在大样本中测量CEO的行为。将这种方法应用于6个国家的1,114名CEO，发现他们分为两类：“领导者”，他们负责多功能的、高层次的会议；“管理者”，他们负责具有核心职能的个别会议。雇佣领导者的企业表现更好，而且新任CEO需要三年时间才能产生明显影响。结构估计表明，生产力差异是由于不匹配造成的，而不是因为领导者对所有企业都更有优势。

abstract.text: Information provision in games influences behavior by affecting agents’ beliefs about the state as well as their higher-order beliefs. We first characterize the extent to which a designer can manipulate agents’ beliefs by disclosing information. We then describe the structure of optimal belief distributions, including a concave-envelope representation that subsumes the single-agent result of Kamenica and Gentzkow. This result holds under various solution concepts and outcome selection rules. Finally, we use our approach to compute an optimal information structure in an investment game under adversarial equilibrium selection.

10.1086/705332.abstractZh: 在博弈中，信息提供通过影响代理人对状态的认知以及他们的更高层次认知来影响行为。我们首先描述了设计者通过披露信息能够操纵代理人认知的程度。然后，我们描述了最优信念分布的结构，包括一个凹包表示法，该表示法包含了Kamenica和Gentzkow关于单一代理人的研究结果。这一结果在各种解决概念和结果选择规则下都成立。最后，我们使用我们的方法计算了一个在对抗性均衡选择下的投资博弈中的最优信息结构。

abstract.text: We provide microfoundations for dynamic skill formation with a model of investment in multiple skills, when jobs place different weights on skills. We show that credit constraints may affect investment even when workers do not exhaust their credit. Firms may invest in their workers’ skills even when there are many similar competitors. Firm and worker incentives can lead to overinvestment. Optimal skill accumulation resembles—but is not—learning by doing. An example shows that shocks to skill productivity benefiting new workers but lowering one skill’s value may adversely affect even relatively young workers, and adjustment may be discontinuous in age.

10.1086/705373.abstractZh: 我们为动态技能形成提供了微观基础，通过一种针对多种技能的投资模型来研究，此时不同工作对技能的重视程度各不相同。我们指出，即使工人并未耗尽其信用额度，信用约束仍可能影响投资行为。企业即使在存在众多相似竞争对手的情况下，仍可能投资于工人的技能。企业和工人的激励因素可能导致过度投资。最优的技能积累类似于“边做边学”，但并不完全相同。一个例子表明，对技能生产力的冲击可能会让新工人受益，但同时会降低某一技能的价值，这可能对即使是相对年轻的工人产生不利影响，且调整过程可能在年龄上是不连续的。

abstract.text: We use the Becker-DeGroot-Marschak (BDM) mechanism to estimate willingness to pay (WTP) for and heterogeneous impacts of clean water technology through a field experiment in Ghana. Although WTP is low relative to cost, demand is inelastic at low prices. Short-run treatment effects are positive throughout the WTP distribution. After 1 year, use and benefits are both increasing in WTP, with negative effects on low-WTP households. Combining estimated treatment effects with households’ WTP implies valuations of health benefits much smaller than typically used by policy makers. We explore differences between BDM and take-it-or-leave-it valuations and make recommendations for implementing BDM in the field.

10.1086/705374.abstractZh: 我们采用Becker-DeGroot-Marschak（BDM）机制，通过加纳的实地实验来估算人们对清洁水技术的不同影响的支付意愿。尽管相对于成本而言支付意愿较低，但在价格较低时需求仍然缺乏弹性。短期内的处理效应在支付意愿的不同范围内都是积极的。一年后，使用量和收益都与支付意愿成正比，但对支付意愿较低的家庭则产生了负面影响。将估算出的处理效应与家庭的支付意愿相结合，得出的健康效益评估结果比政策制定者通常使用的评估结果要小得多。我们探讨了BDM与“接受或放弃”评估方法之间的差异，并提出了在实地实施BDM的建议。

abstract.text: Increasing evidence indicates the importance of management in determining firms' productivity. Yet causal evidence regarding the effectiveness of management practices is scarce, especially for skilled labor in the developed world. In a field experiment measuring commercial airline captains’ productivity, we test four distinct management practices: performance monitoring, performance feedback, target setting, and prosocial incentives. These practices—particularly monitoring and target setting—significantly increase captains' productivity on the targeted fuel-saving dimensions, with positive spillovers on job satisfaction and CO2 emissions. The study reveals an uncharted research opportunity to delve into the black box of firms to examine the determinants of productivity among skilled labor.

10.1086/705375.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，管理在决定企业生产力方面起着重要作用。然而，关于管理实践有效性的因果证据却十分匮乏，尤其是在发达国家，对于熟练劳动力的管理实践更是如此。在一项针对商业航空公司机长生产力的实地实验中，我们测试了四种不同的管理实践：绩效监控、绩效反馈、目标设定以及亲社会激励措施。这些实践——尤其是监控和目标设定——显著提高了机长在节约燃料方面的生产力，同时带来了对工作满意度和二氧化碳排放量的积极影响。这项研究揭示了一个尚未探索的研究机会，即可以深入企业内部的“黑箱”，来研究熟练劳动力生产力的决定因素。

abstract.text: We show that genetic endowments linked to educational attainment strongly and robustly predict wealth at retirement. The estimated relationship is not fully explained by flexibly controlling for education and labor income. We therefore investigate a host of additional mechanisms that could account for the gene-wealth gradient, including inheritances, mortality, risk preferences, portfolio decisions, beliefs about the probabilities of macroeconomic events, and planning horizons.
