Compared to the rational model, (i) there is no forward guidance puzzle; (ii) the Taylor principle changes: with passive monetary policy but enough myopia equilibria are determinate and economies stable; (iii) the zero lower bound is much less costly; (iv) price-level targeting is not optimal; (v) fiscal stimulus is effective; (vi) the model is “ neo-Fisherian” in the long run, Keynesian in the short run. (JEL E12, E31, E43, E52, E62, E70)

10.1257/aer.20162005.abstractZh: 本文分析了有限理性如何通过对新凯恩斯模型进行实证相关的补充，影响货币和财政政策。模型使用一种新的微观基础“认知折扣”参数，来描述代理人对遥远的非典型事件的局部近视性。与理性模型相比，具有以下特点：(i) 不存在前瞻性指导的难题；(ii) 泰勒原则发生变化：在被动的货币政策下，足够程度的近视均衡是确定的，经济是稳定的；(iii) 零下限约束的成本大大降低；(iv) 价格水平目标设定并非最优选择；(v) 财政刺激是有效的；(vi) 该模型在长期具有“新菲歇尔式”特征，在短期内具有凯恩斯式特征。(JEL E12, E31, E43, E52, E62, E70)

abstract.text: Has rising import competition contributed to the polarization of US politics? Analyzing multiple measures of political expression and results of congressional and presidential elections spanning the period 2000 through 2016, we find strong though not definitive evidence of an ideological realignment in trade-exposed local labor markets that commences prior to the divisive 2016 US presidential election. Exploiting the exogenous component of rising import competition by China, we find that trade exposed electoral districts simultaneously exhibit growing ideological polarization in some domains, meaning expanding support for both strong-left and strong-right views, and pure rightward shifts in others. Specifically, trade-impacted commuting zones or districts saw an increasing market share for the Fox News channel (a rightward shift), stronger ideological polarization in campaign contributions (a polarized shift), and a relative rise in the likelihood of electing a Republican to Congress (a rightward shift). Trade-exposed counties with an initial majority White population became more likely to elect a GOP conservative, while trade-exposed counties with an initial majority-minority population became more likely to elect a liberal Democrat, where in both sets of counties, these gains came at the expense of moderate Democrats (a polarized shift). In presidential elections, counties with greater trade exposure shifted toward the Republican candidate (a rightward shift). These results broadly support an emerging political economy literature that connects adverse economic shocks to sharp ideological realignments that cleave along racial and ethnic lines and induce discrete shifts in political preferences and economic policy. (JEL D72, F14, J15, L82, R23)

10.1257/aer.20170011.abstractZh: 日益加剧的进口竞争是否加剧了美国政治的两极分化？通过对2000年至2016年期间多项政治表达指标以及国会和总统选举结果的分析，我们发现，在受贸易影响的当地劳动力市场，意识形态的重新调整已经开始，这一趋势在2016年美国总统大选之前就已经出现。通过利用中国对进口竞争的外生影响，我们发现，受贸易影响的选区在某些领域表现出日益严重的意识形态两极分化，即同时支持极左和极右观点的人数增加，而在其他领域则出现明显的右倾趋势。具体而言，受贸易影响的通勤区或选区中，福克斯新闻频道的市场份额增加（右倾趋势），竞选捐款中的意识形态两极分化加剧（两极分化趋势），以及选举共和党人进入国会的可能性上升（右倾趋势）。最初以白人为主的受贸易影响的县更有可能选出共和党保守派，而最初以少数族裔为主的受贸易影响的县则更有可能选出自由派民主党人，在这两类县中，这些变化都是以牺牲温和派民主党人为代价实现的（两极分化趋势）。在总统选举中，受贸易影响较大的县更倾向于支持共和党候选人（右倾趋势）。这些结果广泛支持了新兴的政治经济文献的观点，即不利的经济冲击会导致意识形态的急剧调整，这种调整会沿着种族和族裔界限进行，并引发政治偏好和经济政策的明显变化。（JEL D72, F14, J15, L82, R23）

abstract.text: We provide empirical evidence of a novel liquidity-based transmission mechanism through which monetary policy influences asset markets, develop a model of this mechanism, and assess the ability of the quantitative theory to match the evidence. (JEL E44, E52, G12, G14, G35)

10.1257/aer.20170045.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于一种基于流动性的新型传导机制的实证证据，通过这种机制，货币政策能够影响资产市场。我们还构建了一个关于这种机制的模型，并评估了定量理论与实证证据之间的匹配程度。（JEL E44, E52, G12, G14, G35）

abstract.text: This paper studies how welfare outcomes in centralized school choice depend on the assignment mechanism when participants are not fully informed. Using a survey of school choice participants in a strategic setting, we show that beliefs about admissions chances differ from rational expectations values and predict choice behavior. To quantify the welfare costs of belief errors, we estimate a model of school choice that incorporates subjective beliefs. We evaluate the equilibrium effects of switching to a strategy-proof deferred acceptance algorithm, and of improving households’ belief accuracy. We find that a switch to truthful reporting in the DA mechanism offers welfare improvements over the baseline given the belief errors we observe in the data, but that an analyst who assumed families had accurate beliefs would have reached the opposite conclusion. (JEL D83, H75, I21, I28)

10.1257/aer.20170129.abstractZh: 本文研究了在参与者信息不完全的情况下，集中式学校选择中的福利结果如何依赖于分配机制。通过对战略环境下的学校选择参与者进行调查，我们发现人们对录取机会的信念与理性预期值存在差异，并据此预测了选择行为。为了量化信念错误的福利成本，我们建立了一个包含主观信念的学校选择模型。我们评估了转向一种策略证明的延迟接受算法以及提高家庭信念准确性所带来的均衡效应。研究发现，在观察到的信念错误情况下，采用真实报告机制相比基线方案能够提升福利水平，但假设家庭信念准确性的分析师则会得出相反的结论。（JEL D83, H75, I21, I28）

abstract.text: We show that labor market frictions are first-order for understanding credit markets. Wage growth and labor share forecast aggregate credit spreads and debt growth as well as or better than alternative predictors. They also predict credit risk and debt growth in a cross section of international firms. Finally, high labor share firms choose lower financial leverage. A model with labor market frictions and risky long-term debt can explain these findings, and produce large credit spreads despite realistically low default probabilities. This is because precommitted payments to labor make other committed payments (i.e., interest) riskier. (JEL D33, E23, E24, E25, E44, F23, G32)

10.1257/aer.20170156.abstractZh: 我们表明，劳动力市场摩擦对于理解信贷市场至关重要。工资增长和劳动力占比能够预测总体信贷利差和债务增长，其预测效果优于其他预测指标。这些指标还能预测国际企业的信贷风险和债务增长。此外，高劳动力占比的企业更倾向于采用较低的财务杠杆。一个包含劳动力市场摩擦和高风险长期债务的模型可以解释这些发现，并且能够在违约概率较低的情况下产生较大的信贷利差。这是因为对劳动力的预先承诺使得其他承诺的支付（即利息）变得更加风险高。（JEL D33, E23, E24, E25, E44, F23, G32）

abstract.text: Using a rich panel of owner-operated New York dairy farms, we provide new evidence on entrepreneurial behavior. We formulate a dynamic model of farms facing uninsured risks and financial constraints. Farmers derive nonpecuniary benefits from operating their businesses. We estimate the model via simulated minimum distance, matching both production and financial data. We find that financial factors and nonpecuniary benefits are of first-order importance. Collateral constraints and liquidity restrictions inhibit borrowing and the accumulation of capital, especially among high-productivity firms seeking to expand. The nonpecuniary benefits to farming are large and keep small, low-productivity farms in business. Although farmers are risk averse, eliminating uninsured production risk has only modest effects on capital and output. (JEL C51, D24, G32, Q12, Q14)

10.1257/aer.20170370.abstractZh: 通过研究纽约众多由业主经营的奶牛场，我们为企业家行为提供了新的证据。我们构建了一个动态模型，模拟了这些农场面临的无保险风险与财务约束。农民在经营业务过程中获得了非金钱性的收益。我们通过模拟最小距离法对模型进行估计，同时结合生产和财务数据进行分析。研究发现，财务因素和非金钱性收益具有首要重要性。抵押限制和流动性限制阻碍了借款和资本积累，尤其是在那些寻求扩张的高生产力企业中。农业的非金钱性收益巨大，能够维持小型、低生产力农场继续运营。尽管农民具有风险厌恶倾向，但消除无保险生产风险对资本和产出的影响却十分有限。（JEL C51, D24, G32, Q12, Q14）

abstract.text: We introduce a model where social norms of voting participation are strategically chosen by competing political parties and determine voters’ turnout. Social norms must be enforced through costly peer monitoring and punishment. When the cost of enforcement of social norms is low, the larger party is always advantaged. Otherwise, in the spirit of Olson (1965), the smaller party may be advantaged. Our model shares features of the ethical voter model and it delivers novel and empirically relevant comparative statics results. (JEL D72, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20170476.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，其中投票参与的社交规范由竞争中的政党策略性地选择，并决定选民的投票率。这些社交规范必须通过昂贵的同伴监督和惩罚来强制执行。当执行社交规范的成本较低时，较大的政党总是处于优势地位。否则，按照奥尔森（1965年）的理论，较小的政党可能会处于优势地位。我们的模型具有伦理选民模型的特点，并提供了新颖且具有实证意义的比较静态结果。（JEL D72, Z13）

abstract.text: We show that the equilibrium policy rule in beauty contest models is equivalent to that of a single agent’s forecast of the economic fundamental. This forecast is conditional on a modified information process, which simply discounts the precision of idiosyncratic shocks by the degree of strategic complementarity. The result holds for any linear Gaussian signal process (static or persistent, stationary or nonstationary, exogenous or endogenous), and also extends to network games. Theoretically, this result provides a sharp characterization of the equilibrium and its properties under dynamic information. Practically, it provides a straightforward method to solve models with complicated information structures. (JEL C72, D82, D83, D84)

10.1257/aer.20170519.abstractZh: 我们证明了在美容竞赛模型中，均衡政策规则等同于单个代理人对经济基本面的预测。这一预测基于一种修改后的信息过程，该过程仅通过战略互补性程度来折扣特异性冲击的精确度。这一结果适用于任何线性高斯信号过程（静态或持续性、平稳或非平稳、外生或内生），并且也适用于网络博弈。从理论上讲，这一结果对动态信息下的均衡及其特性进行了精确的描述。实际上，它提供了一种解决具有复杂信息结构的模型的直接方法。（JEL C72, D82, D83, D84）

abstract.text: We study the design of child care subsidies in an optimal welfare problem with heterogeneous private market productivities. The optimal subsidy schedule is qualitatively similar to the existing US scheme. Efficiency mandates a subsidy on formal child care costs, with higher subsidies paid to lower income earners and a kink as a function of child care expenditure. Marginal labor income tax rates are set lower than the labor wedges, with the potential to generate negative marginal tax rates. We calibrate our simple model to features of the US labor market and focus on single mothers with children aged below 6. The optimal program provides stronger participation but milder intensive margin incentives for low-income earners with subsidy rates starting very high and decreasing with income more steeply than those in the United States. (JEL D82, H21, H24, J13, J16, J32)

10.1257/aer.20170581.abstractZh: 我们研究了在具有异质私人市场生产率的优化福利问题中，儿童保育补贴的设计问题。最优补贴方案在质量上与现有的美国方案相似。效率要求对正式儿童保育成本进行补贴，对低收入者给予更高的补贴，并且补贴水平随着儿童保育支出的增加而有所变化。边际劳动所得税率低于劳动工资区间，这有可能导致边际税率出现负值。我们针对美国劳动力市场的特征对模型进行了调整，重点关注有6岁以下儿童的单亲母亲。最优方案能够提供更强的参与激励，但对低收入者的激励较为温和，补贴率起点很高，并且随着收入的增加下降幅度比美国更为陡峭。（JEL D82, H21, H24, J13, J16, J32）

abstract.text: A seller bargains with a rationally inattentive buyer (Sims 2003) over a good of random quality. After observing quality, the seller makes a take-it-or-leave-it offer. The buyer pays attention to the seller’s product and offer at a cost proportional to expected entropy reduction. Because attention is free off-path, multiple equilibria emerge, many of which are efficient. A trembling-hand-like refinement (Selten 1975) rules out efficiency, delivering complete disagreement when attention is expensive and a unique equilibrium with trade when attention is cheap. In this equilibrium, the buyer overpays for low-quality goods, underpays for high-quality goods, and earns a strictly positive payoff. (JEL C78, D82, D83, D86, L15)

10.1257/aer.20170620.abstractZh: 在一个随机质量的商品上，卖家与一个理性但不加注意的买家进行讨价还价（Sims 2003）。在观察了商品质量后，卖家会提出接受或放弃的报价。买家会关注卖家的商品，并支付与预期熵减少量成正比的费用。由于注意力是免费的，因此会出现多个均衡，其中许多是有效的。一种类似“颤抖之手”的改进机制（Selten 1975）会排除效率，在注意力昂贵时导致完全的不一致，而在注意力便宜时则产生一个独特的均衡。在这种均衡中，买家会为低质量商品支付过高的价格，为高质量商品支付过低的价格，从而获得严格正的收益。（JEL C78, D82, D83, D86, L15）

abstract.text: We investigate wealth returns on an administrative panel containing the disaggregated balance sheets of Swedish residents. The expected return on household net wealth is strongly persistent, determined primarily by systematic risk, and increasing in net worth, exceeding the risk-free rate by the size of the equity premium for households in the top 0.01 percent. Idiosyncratic risk is transitory but generates substantial long-term dispersion in returns in top brackets. Systematic and idiosyncratic risk both drive the cross-sectional distribution of the geometric average return over a generation. Furthermore, wealth returns explain most of the historical increase in top wealth shares. (JEL D31, G11, G51)

10.1257/aer.20170666.abstractZh: 我们研究了包含瑞典居民分项资产负债表的数据面板中的财富回报。家庭净财富的预期回报具有强烈的持续性，主要由系统性风险决定，并且随着净资产的增加而上升，其超过无风险利率的程度相当于最富有的0.01%人群所拥有的股权溢价。特异性风险虽然短暂，但在顶层人群中产生了显著的长期回报差异。系统性风险和特异性风险共同决定了代际间几何平均回报的横向分布。此外，财富回报解释了历史上顶层财富份额增长的大部分原因。（JEL D31, G11, G51）

abstract.text: We study information acquisition in dealer markets. We first identify a one-sided strategic complementarity in information acquisition: the more informed traders are, the larger market makers’ gain from becoming informed. When quotes are observable, this effect in turn induces a strategic complementarity in information acquisition amongst market makers. We then derive the equilibrium pattern of information acquisition and examine the implications of our analysis for market liquidity and price discovery. We show that increasing the cost of information can decrease market liquidity and improve price discovery. (JEL O82, O83, G14)

10.1257/aer.20170690.abstractZh: 我们研究了庄家市场中的信息获取问题。首先，我们发现了信息获取方面的单边战略互补性：信息越丰富的交易者，市场做市商因获得更多信息而获得的收益就越大。当报价是可观察的时，这种效应反过来又促使市场做市商在信息获取方面形成战略互补性。接着，我们推导出了信息获取的平衡模式，并探讨了我们的分析对市场流动性和价格发现的影响。我们发现，增加信息获取的成本可以降低市场流动性，同时改善价格发现的效果。（JEL O82, O83, G14）

abstract.text: Using a quantitative heterogeneous agents macro-housing model and detailed microdata, this paper studies the drivers of the 2006–2011 housing bust, its spillovers to consumption and the credit market, and the ability of mortgage rate interventions to accelerate the recovery. The model features tenure choice between owning and renting, rich portfolio choice, long-term defaultable mortgages, and endogenously illiquid housing from search frictions. The equilibrium analysis and empirical evidence suggest that the deterioration in house prices and liquidity, transmitted to consumption via balance sheets that vary in composition and depth, is central to explaining the observed aggregate and cross-sectional patterns. (JEL E23, E32, E44, G21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20170772.abstractZh: 本文采用定量异质代理人宏观住房模型与详细微观数据，研究2006至2011年住房危机的驱动因素、其对消费和信贷市场的溢出效应，以及抵押利率干预能否加速经济复苏。该模型包含房屋所有权与租赁的选择、资产组合选择、长期可违约的抵押贷款，以及由于搜索摩擦导致的住房内生性流动性不足。均衡分析和实证证据表明，房价和流动性的恶化，通过资产负债表在组成和深度上的差异传递至消费，是解释观察到的总体和横截面现象的核心因素。（JEL E23, E32, E44, G21, R31）

abstract.text: Social network data are often prohibitively expensive to collect, limiting empirical network research. We propose an inexpensive and feasible strategy for network elicitation using Aggregated Relational Data (ARD): responses to questions of the form "how many of your links have trait k ?" Our method uses ARD to recover parameters of a network formation model, which permits sampling from a distribution over node- or graph-level statistics. We replicate the results of two field experiments that used network data and draw similar conclusions with ARD alone.

10.1257/aer.20170861.abstractZh: 社交网络数据的收集往往成本极高，这限制了网络研究的开展。我们提出了一种成本低廉且可行的网络数据收集策略，即使用聚合关系数据（ARD）：针对“你有多少条链接具有特征k？”这类问题的回答。我们的方法利用ARD来恢复网络形成模型的参数，从而可以从节点或图级统计数据的分布中进行抽样。我们重复了两项使用网络数据的实地实验，结果表明，仅使用ARD也能得出类似的结论。

abstract.text: Over the last 15 years, kidney exchange has become a mainstream paradigm to increase transplants. However, compatible pairs do not participate, and full benefits from exchange can be realized only if they do. We propose incentivizing compatible pairs to participate in exchange by insuring their patients against future renal failure via increased priority in deceased-donor queue. We analyze equity and welfare benefits of this scheme through a new dynamic continuum model. We calibrate the model with US data and quantify substantial gains from adopting incentivized exchange, both in terms of access to living-donor transplants and reduced competition for deceased-donor transplants. (JEL D47, I11, I12, I18)

10.1257/aer.20170950.abstractZh: 在过去的15年里，肾脏交换已成为增加移植手术数量的主流模式。然而，并非所有兼容的配对都能参与交换，只有那些参与交换的配对才能真正享受到交换带来的好处。我们建议通过提高死亡捐赠者名单中的优先级，为参与交换的兼容配对提供保障，以激励他们参与交换。我们通过一个新的动态连续模型分析了这一方案的公平性和福利效益。我们使用美国数据对模型进行了校准，并量化了采用激励性交换方案所带来的显著收益，包括获得活体捐赠者的机会以及减少对死亡捐赠者移植器官的竞争。（JEL D47, I11, I12, I18）

abstract.text: In a regime change game, privately informed agents sequentially decide whether to attack without observing others’ previous actions. To dissuade them from attacking, a principal adopts a dynamic information disclosure policy, frequent viability tests. A viability test publicly discloses whether the regime has survived the previous attacks. When such tests are sufficiently frequent, in the unique cutoff equilibrium, agents never attack if the regime passes the latest test, regardless of their private signals. We apply this theory to demonstrate that a borrower can eliminate panic-based runs by sufficiently diffusing the rollover choices across different maturity dates. (JEL C72, D82, G21)

10.1257/aer.20171034.abstractZh: 在政权更迭的博弈中，私人知情代理人依次决定是否发动攻击，而不观察其他代理人的先前行动。为了阻止他们发动攻击，委托人采用动态信息披露策略，即频繁进行生存能力测试。生存能力测试公开披露政权是否成功抵御了之前的攻击。当这些测试的频率足够高时，在独特的截止均衡中，如果政权通过了最新的测试，代理人就不会发动攻击，无论他们持有何种私人信号。我们将这一理论应用于证明，借款人可以通过在不同到期日之间分散贷款续期选择，从而消除基于恐慌的挤兑行为。（JEL C72, D82, G21）

abstract.text: Social norms, usually persistent, can change quickly when new public information arrives, such as a surprising election outcome. People may become more inclined to express views or take actions previously perceived as stigmatized and may judge others less negatively for doing so. We examine this possibility using two experiments. We first show via revealed preference experiments that Donald Trump’s rise in popularity and eventual victory increased individuals’ willingness to publicly express xenophobic views. We then show that individuals are sanctioned less negatively if they publicly expressed a xenophobic view in an environment where that view is more popular. (JEL D72, D85, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20171175.abstractZh: 社会规范通常具有持久性，但当新的公共信息出现时，例如令人惊讶的选举结果，这些规范可能会迅速改变。人们可能会更倾向于表达以前被认为是有污名的观点，并且对他人的这种行为评价也会变得不那么负面。我们通过两项实验来探讨这种可能性。首先，通过显示偏好实验表明，唐纳德·特朗普的受欢迎程度上升以及最终的胜利，增加了人们公开表达排外观点的意愿。其次，我们发现，如果在一个排外观点更流行的环境中，人们公开表达这种观点时，受到的负面制裁也会减少。（JEL D72, D85, Z13）

abstract.text: We propose a “dominant currency paradigm” with three key features: dominant currency pricing, pricing complementarities, and imported inputs in production. We test this paradigm using a new dataset of bilateral price and volume indices for more than 2,500 country pairs that covers 91 percent of world trade, as well as detailed firm-product-country data for Colombian exports and imports. In strong support of the paradigm we find that (i) noncommodities terms-of-trade are uncorrelated with exchange rates; (ii) the dollar exchange rate quantitatively dominates the bilateral exchange rate in price pass-through and trade elasticity regressions, and this effect is increasing in the share of imports invoiced in dollars; (iii) US import volumes are significantly less sensitive to bilateral exchange rates, compared to other countries’ imports; (iv) a 1 percent US dollar appreciation against all other currencies predicts a 0.6 percent decline within a year in the volume of total trade between countries in the rest of the world, controlling for the global business cycle. We characterize the transmission of, and spillovers from, monetary policy shocks in this environment. (JEL E52, F14, F31, F44)

10.1257/aer.20171201.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种“主导货币范式”，该范式具有三个关键特征：主导货币定价、定价互补性以及生产中的进口投入。我们使用一个新的数据集来测试这一范式，该数据集包含了超过2,500个国家对的双边价格和数量指数，涵盖了91%的世界贸易，同时还提供了哥伦比亚出口和进口的详细企业-产品-国家数据。这一范式得到了强有力的支持：我们发现（i）非商品贸易条件与汇率无关；（ii）美元汇率在价格传递和贸易弹性回归中占据主导地位，且这一效应随着以美元计价的进口份额的增加而增强；（iii）与其他国家的进口相比，美国的进口量对双边汇率的敏感度明显较低；（iv）美元对其他所有货币升值1%，在控制全球商业周期的情况下，全球其他国家之间的总贸易量将在一年内下降0.6%。我们还研究了在这种环境下货币政策冲击的传递和溢出效应。（JEL E52, F14, F31, F44）

abstract.text: “Big data” financial technology raises concerns about market inefficiency. A common concern is that the technology might induce traders to extract others’ information, rather than to produce information themselves. We allow agents to choose how much they learn about future asset values or about others’ demands, and we explore how improvements in data processing shape these information choices, trading strategies and market outcomes. Our main insight is that unbiased technological change can explain a market-wide shift in data collection and trading strategies. However, in the long run, as data processing technology becomes increasingly advanced, both types of data continue to be processed. Two competing forces keep the data economy in balance: data resolve investment risk, but future data create risk. The efficiency results that follow from these competing forces upend two pieces of common wisdom: our results offer a new take on what makes prices informative and whether trades typically deemed liquidity-providing actually make markets more resilient. (JEL C55, D83, G12, G14, O33)

10.1257/aer.20171349.abstractZh: “大数据”金融技术引发了关于市场效率问题的担忧。一个普遍的担忧是，这项技术可能会促使交易者获取他人的信息，而不是自己生成信息。我们允许代理人选择他们学习未来资产价值或他人需求的程度，并探讨数据处理能力的改进如何影响这些信息选择、交易策略和市场结果。我们的主要发现是，无偏的技术变革可以解释市场范围内数据收集和交易策略的变化。然而，从长远来看，随着数据处理技术的不断进步，这两种类型的数据都会继续被处理。两种相互竞争的力量维持着数据经济的平衡：数据可以化解投资风险，但未来的数据也会带来风险。这些竞争力量带来的效率结果颠覆了两种常见的观念：我们的研究结果为理解价格的信息性以及那些通常被认为能提供流动性的交易是否实际上提升了市场的韧性提供了新的视角。（JEL C55, D83, G12, G14, O33）

abstract.text: African agricultural markets are characterized by low farmer revenues and high consumer food prices. Many have worried that this wedge is partially driven by imperfect competition among intermediaries. This paper provides experimental evidence from Kenya on intermediary market structure. Randomized cost shocks and demand subsidies are used to identify a structural model of market competition. Estimates reveal that traders act consistently with joint profit maximization and earn median markups of 39 percent. Exogenously induced firm entry has negligible effects on prices, and low take-up of subsidized entry offers implies large fixed costs. We estimate that traders capture 82 percent of total surplus. (JEL L13, O13, Q11, Q12, Q13)

10.1257/aer.20171397.abstractZh: 非洲农业市场的特点是农民收入低，消费者食品价格高。许多人担心这种价格差距部分是由中间商之间的不完美竞争所导致。本文从肯尼亚提供了关于中间商市场结构的实验性证据。通过随机成本冲击和需求补贴的方法，我们确定了一个市场竞争的结构模型。估计结果显示，交易商的行为符合联合利润最大化原则，其平均加价率为39%。外部诱导的企业进入对价格几乎没有影响，而接受补贴进入的企业数量很少，这表明这些企业的固定成本很高。我们估计，交易商占据了总剩余收益的82%。（JEL L13, O13, Q11, Q12, Q13）

abstract.text: We study the drivers of financial distress using a large-scale field experiment that offered randomly selected borrowers a combination of (i) immediate payment reductions to target short-run liquidity write-downs to target long-run debt constraints. We identify the separate effects of the payment reductions and interest write-downs using both the experiment and cross-sectional variation in treatment intensity. We find that the interest write-downs significantly improved both financial and labor market outcomes, despite not taking effect for three to five years. In sharp contrast, there were no positive effects of the more immediate payment reductions. These results run counter to the widespread view that financial distress is largely the result of short-run constraints. (JEL G56, K35)

10.1257/aer.20171541.abstractZh: 我们通过一项大规模实地实验来研究财务困境的驱动因素。该实验让随机选择的借款人同时接受两种措施：(i) 立即减少还款金额，以缓解短期流动性问题；(ii) 进行债务减免，以缓解长期债务约束。我们通过实验数据以及处理强度在不同样本间的差异，分别分析了这两种措施的效果。研究发现，尽管债务减免措施需要三到五年的时间才能见效，但它显著改善了金融市场和劳动力市场的表现。相比之下，更直接的还款减免措施则没有产生积极效果。这些结果与普遍的观点相悖，后者认为财务困境主要是由短期约束引起的。(JEL G56, K35)

abstract.text: We model uncertain social prospects as acts mapping states of nature to (social ) outcomes. A social choice function (or SCF ) assigns an act to each profile of subjective expected utility preferences over acts. An SCF is strategyproof if no agent ever has an incentive to misrepresent her beliefs about the states of nature or her valuation of the outcomes. It is unanimous if it picks the feasible act that all agents find best whenever such an act exists. We offer a characterization of the class of strategyproof and unanimous SCFs in two settings. In the setting where all acts are feasible, the chosen act must yield the favorite outcome of some ( possibly different) agent in every state of nature. The set of states in which an agent’s favorite outcome is selected may vary with the reported belief profile; it is the union of all states assigned to her by a collection of constant, bilaterally dictatorial, or bilaterally consensual assignment rules. In a setting where each state of nature defines a possibly different subset of available outcomes, bilaterally dictatorial or consensual rules can only be used to assign control rights over states characterized by identical sets of available outcomes. (JEL D71, D81, R53)

10.1257/aer.20171553.abstractZh: 我们将不确定的社会前景建模为将自然状态映射到（社会）结果的行动。社会选择函数（或SCF）为每个关于行动的主观期望效用偏好配置一个行动。如果一个社会选择函数没有代理人有动机歪曲她对自然状态的信念或对结果的估值，那么它是策略防备的。如果它选择了所有代理人都认为最佳的可行行动，那么它是一致的。我们在两种情况下对策略防备和一致的社会选择函数类进行了描述。在所有行动都可行的环境中，选定的行动必须在每个自然状态下产生某个（可能不同的）代理人最喜欢的结果。代理人最喜欢的结果被选中的状态集合可能会随着报告的信念配置而变化；它是所有由一系列恒定、双边独裁或双边共识分配规则分配给她的状态的并集。在每种自然状态都定义了可能不同的可用结果子集的环境中，双边独裁或共识规则只能用于分配对具有相同可用结果集的状态的控制权。（JEL D71, D81, R53）

abstract.text: This paper studies the problem of experiment design by an ambiguity-averse decision-maker who trades off subjective expected performance against robust performance guarantees. This framework accounts for real-world experimenters’ preference for randomization. It also clarifies the circumstances in which randomization is optimal: when the available sample size is large and robustness is an important concern. We apply our model to shed light on the practice of rerandomization, used to improve balance across treatment and control groups. We show that rerandomization creates a trade-off between subjective performance and robust performance guarantees. However, robust performance guarantees diminish very slowly with the number of rerandomizations. This suggests that moderate levels of rerandomization usefully expand the set of acceptable compromises between subjective performance and robustness. Targeting a fixed quantile of balance is safer than targeting an absolute balance objective. (JEL C90, D81)

10.1257/aer.20171634.abstractZh: 本文研究了由厌恶模糊性决策者进行实验设计的问题，该决策者需要在主观预期表现与稳健性能保证之间做出权衡。该框架考虑到了现实世界中实验者对随机化的偏好。同时，本文明确了随机化最优化的条件：当可用样本量较大且稳健性是一个重要考虑因素时。我们将模型应用于分析重新随机化的实践，这种重新随机化用于改善治疗组和对照组之间的平衡。研究表明，重新随机化会在主观表现与稳健性能保证之间产生权衡。然而，随着重新随机化的次数增加，稳健性能保证的下降速度非常缓慢。这表明，适度的重新随机化有助于扩大主观表现与稳健性之间可接受妥协的范围。针对固定的平衡分位数进行优化比针对绝对平衡目标更为安全。（JEL C90, D81）

abstract.text: The spatial layout of cities is an important feature of urban form, highlighted by urban planners but overlooked by economists. This paper investigates the causal economic implications of city shape in India. I measure cities’ geometric properties over time using satellite imagery and historical maps. I develop an instrument for urban shape based on geographic obstacles encountered by expanding cities. Compact city shape is associated with faster population growth and households display positive willingness to pay for more compact layouts. Transit accessibility is an important channel. Land use regulations can contribute to deteriorating city shape. (JEL O18, R14, R23, R52, R58)

10.1257/aer.20171673.abstractZh: 城市的空间布局是城市形态的一个重要特征，这一特点受到城市规划者的重视，但经济学家却常常忽视。本文研究了印度城市形态对经济的因果影响。我通过卫星图像和历史地图来测量城市几何特性随时间的变化。我基于城市扩张过程中遇到的地理障碍，开发了一种城市形态评估工具。紧凑的城市形态与更快的人口增长相关，家庭也表现出对更紧凑布局的积极支付意愿。交通可达性是影响城市形态的重要因素。土地使用法规可能会加剧城市形态的恶化。（JEL O18, R14, R23, R52, R58）

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the economic returns to industrial espionage. We show that the flow of information provided by East German informants in the West over the period 1970–1989 led to a significant narrowing of sectoral TFP gaps between West and East Germany. These economic returns were primarily driven by relatively few high-quality pieces of information and particularly large in sectors closer to the West German technological frontier. Our findings suggest that the East-to-West German TFP ratio would have been 13.3 percent lower at the end of the Cold War had East Germany not engaged in industrial espionage in the West. (JEL L16, N44, O33, O38, O47, P24)

10.1257/aer.20171732.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了工业间谍活动所带来的经济回报。我们发现，1970至1989年间，东德情報人员向西德提供的信息流显著缩小了西德与东德之间的部门全要素生产率差距。这些经济回报主要源于相对较少的高质量信息，尤其是在与西德技术前沿较为接近的行业中。我们的研究结果表明，如果东德没有在西方进行工业间谍活动，冷战结束时东德与西德的全要素生产率比率将降低13.3%。（JEL L16, N44, O33, O38, O47, P24）

abstract.text: Macro-finance theory implies that trend inflation and the equilibrium real interest rate are fundamental determinants of the yield curve. However, empirical models of the term structure of interest rates generally assume that these fundamentals are constant. We show that accounting for time variation in these underlying long-run trends is crucial for understanding the dynamics of Treasury yields and predicting excess bond returns. We introduce a new arbitrage-free model that captures the key role that long-run trends play in determining interest rates. The model also provides new, more plausible estimates of the term premium and accurate out-of-sample yield forecasts. (JEL E31, E43, E47)

10.1257/aer.20171822.abstractZh: 宏观金融理论认为，趋势通胀和均衡实际利率是收益率曲线的基本决定因素。然而，利率期限结构的实证模型通常假设这些基本因素是不变的。我们指出，考虑这些长期趋势的时间变化对于理解国债收益率的动态以及预测债券超额回报至关重要。我们引入了一个新的无套利模型，该模型能够捕捉长期趋势在决定利率中的关键作用。该模型还提供了关于期限溢价的新、更合理的估计值，并能够准确预测样本外的收益率。（JEL E31, E43, E47）

abstract.text: Soda taxes aim to reduce excessive sugar consumption. We assess who is most impacted by soda taxes. We estimate demand using micro longitudinal data covering on-the-go purchases, and exploit the panel dimension to estimate individual-specific preferences. We relate these preferences and counterfactual predictions to individual characteristics and show that soda taxes are relatively effective at targeting the sugar intake of the young, are less successful at targeting the intake of those with high total dietary sugar, and are unlikely to be strongly regressive especially if consumers benefit from averted internalities. (JEL D12, H22, H25, H71)

10.1257/aer.20171898.abstractZh: 苏打水税旨在减少过度的糖分摄入。我们评估了哪些人群最受苏打水税的影响。我们使用涵盖即时购物的微观纵向数据来估算需求，并利用面板数据来估计个体特定的偏好。我们将这些偏好与反事实预测联系起来，并发现苏打水税在针对年轻人的糖分摄入方面相对有效，但在针对总膳食糖分摄入量较高的人群方面效果较差，而且如果消费者能够从避免的内部性中获益，这种税不太可能具有强烈的递减效应。（JEL D12, H22, H25, H71）

abstract.text: School choice may lead to improvements in school productivity if parents’ choices reward effective schools and punish ineffective ones. This mechanism requires parents to choose schools based on causal effectiveness rather than peer characteristics. We study relationships among parent preferences, peer quality, and causal effects on outcomes for applicants to New York City’s centralized high school assignment mechanism. We use applicants’ rank-ordered choice lists to measure preferences and to construct selection-corrected estimates of treatment effects on test scores, high school graduation, college attendance, and college quality. Parents prefer schools that enroll high-achieving peers, and these schools generate larger improvements in short- and long-run student outcomes. Preferences are unrelated to school effectiveness and academic match quality after controlling for peer quality. (JEL D12, H75, I21, I26, I28)

10.1257/aer.20172040.abstractZh: 学校选择如果能让家长选择那些表现良好的学校，并淘汰表现不佳的学校，那么可能会提升学校的办学效率。这一机制要求家长根据学校的实际效果而非同校间的相似性来选择学校。我们研究了家长偏好、学校质量以及这些因素对纽约市集中式高中分配机制下学生结果的影响关系。我们通过家长的排序选择清单来衡量他们的偏好，并构建出经过选择校正后的治疗效果估计值，以评估测试成绩、高中毕业率、大学入学率以及大学质量等方面的影响。家长更倾向于选择能够培养高成就学生的学校，而这些学校在短期和长期内都能带来更大的学生成绩改善。在控制了学校质量和学术匹配质量后，家长偏好与学校效果和学术匹配质量并无关联。（JEL D12, H75, I21, I26, I28）

abstract.text: We study the impact of vertical integration on pricing incentives in multiproduct industries. To do so, we exploit recent variation in vertical structure in the US carbonated-beverage industry. While the elimination of double marginalization with vertical integration is normally characterized as procompetitive, economic theory predicts that it may cause anticompetitive price increases in multiproduct industries. We indeed find that vertical integration causes price decreases in products with eliminated double margins but price increases in the other products sold by the integrated firm. These results provide new evidence of anticompetitive effects of vertical mergers. (JEL D22, D43, G34, L13, L22, L66)

10.1257/aer.20180071.abstractZh: 我们研究了垂直整合对多产品行业定价激励的影响。为此，我们利用了美国碳酸饮料行业垂直结构的最新变化。虽然通过垂直整合消除双重边际化通常被视为促进竞争的行为，但经济理论预测，这种行为可能会导致多产品行业的反竞争性价格上涨。事实上，我们发现，垂直整合导致消除了双重边际的产品价格下降，而整合企业销售的其他产品的价格却上升了。这些结果提供了垂直合并反竞争效应的新证据。（JEL D22, D43, G34, L13, L22, L66）

abstract.text: This paper proposes a flexible-price theory of the role of money in an economy with incomplete idiosyncratic risk sharing. When the risk premium goes up, money provides a safe store of value that prevents interest rates from falling, reducing investment. Investment is too high during booms when risk is low, and too low during slumps when risk is high. Monetary policy cannot correct this: money is superneutral and Ricardian equivalence holds. The optimal allocation requires the Friedman rule and a tax/subsidy on capital. The real effects of money survive even in the cashless limit. (JEL E32, E41, E43, E44, E52)

10.1257/aer.20180203.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种灵活价格理论，用于解释在不完全异质风险共享的经济体中货币的作用。当风险溢价上升时，货币作为一种价值储存手段，能够防止利率下降，从而减少投资。在繁荣时期，由于风险较低，投资过高；而在萧条时期，由于风险较高，投资过低。货币政策无法纠正这一现象：货币具有超中性特性，且遵循李嘉图等价原则。最优的货币分配需要遵循弗里德曼法则，并对资本征收税收或补贴。即使在没有现金交易的情况下，货币的实际作用仍然得以维持。（JEL E32, E41, E43, E44, E52）

abstract.text: We develop a nonparametric method, called Generalized Restriction of Infinite Domains (GRID), for testing the consistency of budgetary choice data with models of choice under risk and under uncertainty. Our test can allow for risk-loving and elation-seeking attitudes, or it can require risk aversion. It can also be used to calculate, via Afriat’s efficiency index, the magnitude of violations from a particular model. We evaluate the performance of various models under risk (expected utility, disappointment aversion, rank-dependent utility, and stochastically monotone utility) using data collected from several recent portfolio choice experiments. (JEL C14, D11, D12, D81)

10.1257/aer.20180210.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种非参数方法，称为广义无限域限制（GRID），用于测试在风险和不确定性下的预算选择数据与模型的一致性。我们的测试可以允许风险偏好和追求享乐的态度，或者要求风险厌恶。该方法还可以利用Afriat的效率指数来计算特定模型下的违规程度。我们通过从多个近期投资组合选择实验中收集的数据，评估了各种风险模型的表现（期望效用、失望厌恶、依赖排名的效用以及随机单调效用）。（JEL C14, D11, D12, D81）

abstract.text: Nearly one billion people worldwide live in rural areas without access to national paved road networks. We estimate the impacts of India’s $40 billion national rural road construction program using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design and comprehensive household and firm census microdata. Four years after road construction, the main effect of new feeder roads is to facilitate the movement of workers out of agriculture. However, there are no major changes in agricultural outcomes, income, or assets. Employment in village firms expands only slightly. Even with better market connections, remote areas may continue to lack economic opportunities. (JEL J43, O13, O18, R23, R42)

10.1257/aer.20180268.abstractZh: 全球约有十亿人生活在无法接入国家铺装道路网络的农村地区。我们采用模糊回归断点设计，结合全面的家庭和企业普查微观数据，对印度耗资400亿美元的国家农村道路建设计划的影响进行了评估。道路建设四年后，新建的支线道路的主要作用在于促进农民离开农业领域。然而，农业产出、收入或资产方面并未出现重大变化。乡村企业的就业情况也仅略有改善。即便市场联系有所改善，偏远地区仍可能缺乏经济机会。（JEL J43, O13, O18, R23, R42）

abstract.text: We embed a field experiment in a nationwide recruitment drive for a new health care position in Zambia to test whether career benefits attract talent at the expense of prosocial motivation. In line with common wisdom, offering career opportunities attracts less prosocial applicants. However, the trade-off exists only at low levels of talent; the marginal applicants in treatment are more talented and equally prosocial. These are hired, and perform better at every step of the causal chain: they provide more inputs, increase facility utilization, and improve health outcomes including a 25 percent decrease in child malnutrition.

10.1257/aer.20180326.abstractZh: 我们在赞比亚的一项全国性招聘活动中嵌入了一个实地实验，以测试职业福利是否以牺牲亲社会动机为代价来吸引人才。根据普遍观点，提供职业机会会吸引较少的亲社会型求职者。然而，这种权衡仅存在于人才水平较低的情况下；接受实验处理的求职者更具天赋，且同样具有亲社会动机。这些被录用的人员在整个过程中表现更好：他们提供了更多的投入，提高了设施利用率，并改善了健康结果，包括儿童营养不良率降低了25%。

abstract.text: Long-run growth in many models is the product of two terms: the effective number of researchers and their research productivity. We present evidence from various industries, products, and firms showing that research effort is rising substantially while research productivity is declining sharply. A good example is Moore’s Law. The number of researchers required today to achieve the famous doubling of computer chip density is more than 18 times larger than the number required in the early 1970s. More generally, everywhere we look we find that ideas, and the exponential growth they imply, are getting harder to find. (JEL D24, E23, O31, O47)

10.1257/aer.20180338.abstractZh: 在许多模型中，长期增长是由两个因素共同决定的：研究人员的有效数量以及他们的研究生产力。我们从各个行业、产品和公司中收集到的证据表明，研究投入正在大幅增加，而研究生产力却急剧下降。一个典型的例子就是摩尔定律。如今，要实现计算机芯片密度的翻倍，所需的研究人员数量比1970年代初所需的要多18倍以上。更普遍地说，无论我们关注哪个领域，都发现创意及其带来的指数级增长变得越来越难以获得。（JEL D24, E23, O31, O47）

abstract.text: Tariffs are generally assumed to depend on the product, not the identity of the importer. However, special economic zones are a common, economically important policy used worldwide to lower tariffs on selected goods for selected manufacturers. I show this is motivated by policymakers’ desire to discriminate across buyers when a tax is intended to raise prices for sellers, through a mechanism distinct from existing theories of optimal taxation. Using a new dataset compiled from public records and exogenous changes in imports of intermediate goods, I find the form, composition, and size of US zones are consistent with the theory. (JEL F13, F14, L60, R32)

10.1257/aer.20180384.abstractZh: 通常认为，关税取决于产品而非进口商的身份。然而，特殊经济区是一种在全球范围内被广泛使用的政策，旨在为特定制造商降低某些商品的关税。我发现，这一政策的实施源于政策制定者在征税时希望对不同买家进行区别对待，这种机制与现有的最优税收理论有所不同。通过利用从公共记录中整理出的新数据集以及中间商品进口量的变化数据，我发现美国的特殊经济区的形式、构成和规模与这一理论是一致的。（JEL F13, F14, L60, R32）

abstract.text: We study relational contracting and renegotiation in environments with external enforcement of long-term contractual arrangements. A long-term contract governs the stage games that the contracting parties will play in the future (depending on verifiable stage-game outcomes) until they renegotiate. In a contractual equilibrium, the parties choose their individual actions rationally, jointly optimize when selecting a contract, and exercise their relative bargaining power. Our main result is that in a wide variety of settings, the optimal contract is semi-stationary, with stationary terms for all future periods but special terms for the current period. In each period the parties renegotiate to this same contract. For example, in a simple principal-agent model with a choice of costly monitoring technology, the optimal contract specifies mild monitoring for the current period but intense monitoring for future periods. Because the parties renegotiate in each new period, intense monitoring arises only off the equilibrium path after a failed renegotiation. (JEL C73, C78, D23, D86)

10.1257/aer.20180427.abstractZh: 我们研究了在外部力量强制执行长期合同安排的环境下的关系契约与重新谈判问题。长期合同决定了合同双方未来将进行的博弈行为（取决于可验证的博弈结果），直到双方进行重新谈判。在契约均衡状态下，各方会理性地选择各自的行动，在签订合同时进行联合优化，并行使各自的相对议价能力。我们的主要发现是，在多种情况下，最优合同是半静态的：所有未来时期的条款都是固定的，但当前时期的条款则有所不同。在每个时期，各方都会重新谈判以达成相同的合同。例如，在一个简单的委托-代理模型中，如果选择成本较高的监控技术，最优合同会规定当前时期采用温和的监控方式，而未来时期则采用严格的监控方式。由于各方在每个新的时期都会重新谈判，因此只有在重新谈判失败之后，才会出现偏离均衡路径的严格监控情况。（JEL C73, C78, D23, D86）

abstract.text: Publicizing firms’ socially undesirable actions may enhance firms’ incentives to avoid such actions. In 2009, the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) began issuing press releases about facilities that violated safety and health regulations. Using quasi-random variation arising from a cutoff rule OSHA followed, I find that publicizing a facility’s violations led other facilities to substantially improve their compliance and experience fewer occupational injuries. OSHA would need to conduct 210 additional inspections to achieve the same improvement in compliance as achieved with a single press release. Evidence suggests that employers improve compliance to avoid costly responses from workers. (JEL J28, J81, K32, L51, M54)

10.1257/aer.20180501.abstractZh: 公开企业那些社会不希望的行为可能会激励企业避免此类行为。2009年，职业安全与健康管理局开始发布关于违反安全和健康规定的设施的新闻稿。通过采用一种基于截止规则的准随机变化方法，我发现公开某设施的违规行为能够促使其他设施显著改善其合规性，并减少职业伤害的发生。为了达到与单次新闻发布相同的合规改进效果，职业安全与健康管理局需要额外进行210次检查。证据表明，雇主会改善合规性以避免工人提出昂贵的投诉。（JEL J28, J81, K32, L51, M54）

abstract.text: We evaluate the medium-term impacts of treating maternal depression on women’s mental health, financial empowerment, and parenting decisions. We leverage variation induced by a cluster-randomized controlled trial that provided psychotherapy to 903 prenatally depressed mothers in rural Pakistan. It was one of the world’s largest psych otherapy interventions, and it dramatically reduced postpartum depression. Seven years after psychotherapy concluded, we returned to the study site to find that impacts on women’s mental health had persisted, with a 17 percent reduction in depression rates. The intervention also improved women’s financial empowerment and increased both time- and money-intensive parental investments by between 0.2 and 0.3 standard deviations. (JEL G51, I12, J16, O15)

10.1257/aer.20180511.abstractZh: 我们评估了治疗孕产妇抑郁症对女性心理健康、经济赋权以及育儿决策的中期影响。我们利用了一项群随机对照试验所揭示的变异情况，该试验为903名在巴基斯坦农村地区患有产前抑郁症的母亲提供了心理治疗。这是全球规模最大的心理治疗干预项目之一，显著降低了产后抑郁症的发生率。在心理治疗结束七年后，我们再次回到研究地点，发现对女性心理健康的影响仍然持续存在，抑郁症的发生率降低了17%。该干预措施还提升了女性的经济赋权水平，并使她们在时间和金钱上的育儿投入增加了0.2到0.3个标准差。（JEL G51, I12, J16, O15）

abstract.text: Behaviors and information often spread via person-to-person diffusion. This paper highlights how diffusion processes can facilitate coordination. I study contagion in a discrete network with Bayesian players. In addition to characterizing the extent and rate of adoption, we uncover a new effect: when large cascades are possible in equilibrium, exposure conveys information about a player’s network position. This effect underscores a novel trade-off in the design of marketing campaigns, suggesting conditions under which word-of-mouth is relatively more effective. A generalization of the model to multi-type networks suggests a new approach to targeted seeding. (JEL D83, D85, M31, M37, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20180601.abstractZh: 行为和信息通常通过人际传播的方式扩散。本文重点探讨了扩散过程如何促进协调。我研究了在离散网络中的传染现象，其中的参与者都遵循贝叶斯决策规则。除了描述采纳的广度和速度外，我们还发现了一个新的效应：在均衡状态下，当大规模的传播成为可能时，曝光度能够传递关于玩家网络地位的信息。这一效应揭示了在营销活动设计中的一个新的权衡问题，指出了在哪些条件下口碑传播相对更为有效。将该模型推广到多类型网络，为有针对性的传播提供了新的方法。（JEL D83, D85, M31, M37, Z13）

abstract.text: Rural economies in many developing countries are characterized by a lean season in the months preceding harvest, when farmers have depleted their cash and grain savings from the previous year. To identify the impacts of liquidity during the lean season, we offered subsidized loans in randomly selected villages in rural Zambia. Ninety-eight percent of households took up the loan. Loan eligibility led to increases in on-farm labor and agricultural output, driving up wages in local labor markets. Larger effects for poorer households suggest that liquidity constraints contribute to inequality in rural economies. (JEL O13, O15, O18, Q11, Q12, R23)

10.1257/aer.20180607.abstractZh: 许多发展中国家的农村经济在收获前的几个月会出现淡季，此时农民们已经耗尽了前一年的现金和粮食储备。为了评估淡季流动性对农村经济的影响，我们在赞比亚农村随机选取的村庄提供了补贴贷款。98%的家庭接受了贷款。获得贷款后，农场劳动力数量和农业产量都有所增加，从而提升了当地劳动力市场的工资水平。对于较贫困的家庭来说，这种影响更为显著，这表明流动性限制加剧了农村经济中的不平等现象。（JEL O13, O15, O18, Q11, Q12, R23）

abstract.text: We explore the role of charitable giving as a means of political influence. For philanthropic foundations associated with large US corporations, we present three different identification strategies that consistently point to the use of corporate social responsibility in ways that parallel the strategic use of political action committee (PAC) spending. Our estimates imply that 6.3 percent of corporate charitable giving may be politically motivated, an amount 2.5 times larger than annual PAC contributions and 35 percent of federal lobbying. Absent of disclosure requirements, charitable giving may be a form of corporate political influence undetected by voters and subsidized by taxpayers. (JEL D22, D64, D72, L31)

10.1257/aer.20180615.abstractZh: 我们探讨了慈善捐赠作为政治影响力手段的作用。对于与大型美国企业相关的慈善基金会，我们提出了三种不同的识别策略，这些策略一致表明，慈善捐赠的使用方式与政治行动委员会（PAC）的支出在战略上的使用方式相似。我们的估计表明，6.3%的企业慈善捐赠可能是出于政治动机，这一数字是年度PAC捐款的2.5倍，占联邦游说的35%。在没有披露要求的情况下，慈善捐赠可能是一种企业政治影响力形式，而选民和纳税人可能对此毫无察觉。（JEL D22, D64, D72, L31）

abstract.text: The homes of firm owners are an important source of finance for ongoing businesses. We use UK microdata to show that a £1 increase in the value of the homes of a firm’s directors increases the firm’s investment by £0.03. This effect is concentrated among firms whose directors’ homes are valuable relative to the firm’s assets, that are financially constrained, and that have directors who are personally highly levered. An aggregation exercise shows that directors’ homes are as important as corporate property for collateral driven fluctuations in aggregate investment demand. (JEL D22, D25, E22, G31, G34, R31)

10.1257/aer.20180649.abstractZh: 公司老板的住宅是维持企业运营的重要资金来源。我们利用英国微观数据发现，公司董事的住宅价值每提高1英镑，公司的投资就会增加0.03英镑。这种效应主要出现在那些董事的住宅价值相对于公司资产较高、财务状况受限，且董事个人负债较高的公司中。进一步的分析表明，董事的住宅与公司房产一样，在驱动整体投资需求的变动中起着重要作用。（JEL D22, D25, E22, G31, G34, R31）

abstract.text: We estimate the magnitudes of reduced earnings, work hours, and wage rates of workers displaced during the Great Recession using linked employer-employee panel data from Washington state. Displaced workers’ earnings losses occurred mainly because hourly wage rates dropped at the time of displacement and recovered sluggishly. Lost employer-specific premiums explain only 17 percent of these losses. Fully 70 percent of displaced workers moved to employers paying the same or higher wage premiums than the displacing employers, but these workers nevertheless suffered substantial wage rate losses. Loss of valuable specific worker-employer matches explains more than one-half of the wage losses. (JEL E32, J22, J31, J63, R23)

10.1257/aer.20180652.abstractZh: 我们利用华盛顿州的雇主与雇员联合面板数据，估算了大衰退期间被裁工人收入减少、工作小时数减少以及工资率下降的幅度。被裁工人的收入损失主要因为工资率在裁减时下降，且恢复缓慢。仅雇主特定的补偿金损失能解释这些损失的17%。高达70%的被裁工人转投到支付与裁减雇主相同或更高工资补偿金的雇主处，但这些工人仍然遭受了显著的工资率下降。有价值的特定工人-雇主匹配关系的丧失解释了超过一半的工资损失。（JEL E32, J22, J31, J63, R23）

abstract.text: A key question in the literature on motivated reasoning and self-deception is how motivated beliefs are sustained in the presence of feedback. In this paper, we explore dynamic motivated belief patterns after feedback. We establish that positive feedback has a persistent effect on beliefs. Negative feedback, instead, influences beliefs in the short run, but this effect fades over time. We investigate the mechanisms of this dynamic pattern, and provide evidence for an asymmetry in the recall of feedback. Finally, we establish that, in line with theoretical accounts, incentives for belief accuracy mitigate the role of motivated reasoning. (JEL C91, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20180728.abstractZh: 在动机性推理与自我欺骗的相关文献中，一个关键问题是：在反馈存在的情况下，如何维持动机性信念。本文探讨了反馈后动态动机性信念模式的变化。我们发现，正面反馈对信念有持久的影响；而负面反馈则会在短期内影响信念，但这种影响会随时间逐渐减弱。我们研究了这种动态模式的机制，并提供了关于反馈记忆不对称性的证据。最后，我们证实，与理论预测一致，促使信念准确性的激励因素能够削弱动机性推理的作用。（JEL C91, D83, D91）

abstract.text: We examine whether shared collective experiences help build a national identity, by looking at the impact of national football teams’ victories in sub-Saharan Africa. We find that individuals surveyed in the days after an important victory of their country’s national team are 37 percent less likely to identify primarily with their ethnic group, and 30 percent more likely to trust other ethnicities, than those interviewed just before. Crucially, national team achievements also reduce violence: countries that (barely) qualified to the Africa Cup of Nations experience less civil conflict (9 percent fewer episodes) in the following months than countries that (barely) did not. (JEL D74, J15, L83, O15, O17, Z21)

10.1257/aer.20180805.abstractZh: 我们研究了共享的集体经历是否有助于构建国家认同，通过研究非洲撒哈拉以南地区国家足球队胜利的影响。研究发现，在国家足球队取得重要胜利后的几天内接受调查的人，与之前接受调查的人相比，他们主要认同自己民族群体的可能性降低了37%，而信任其他民族群体的可能性则增加了30%。关键的是，国家足球队的胜利还能减少暴力行为：那些勉强获得非洲国家杯参赛资格的国家，在接下来的几个月里，民事冲突的发生次数减少了9%。（JEL D74, J15, L83, O15, O17, Z21）

abstract.text: Foreign currency debt is considered a source of financial instability in emerging markets. We propose a theory in which liability dollarization arises from an insurance motive of domestic savers. Since financial crises are associated to depreciations, savers ask for a risk premium when saving in local currency. This force makes domestic currency debt expensive, and incentivizes borrowers to issue foreign currency debt. Providing ex post support to borrowers can alleviate the effect of the crisis on savers’ income, lowering their demand for insurance, and, surprisingly, it can reduce ex ante incentives to borrow in foreign currency. (JEL E21, E42, E44, F34, G01)

10.1257/aer.20180830.abstractZh: 外币债务被认为是新兴市场中金融不稳定的一个来源。我们提出了一个理论，其中负债美元化是由国内储蓄者的保险动机所引发的。由于金融危机与货币贬值相关，储蓄者在以本地货币储蓄时会要求风险溢价。这种力量使得本国货币债务变得昂贵，并激励借款人发行外币债务。为借款人提供事后支持可以减轻危机对储蓄者收入的影响，降低他们对保险的需求，并且，令人惊讶的是，这还可以减少借款人借款外币的事前动机。（JEL E21, E42, E44, F34, G01）

abstract.text: We establish that creditor beliefs regarding future borrowing can be self-fulfilling, leading to multiple equilibria with markedly different debt accumulation patterns. We characterize such indeterminacy in the Eaton-Gersovitz sovereign debt model augmented with long maturity bonds. Two necessary conditions for the multiplicity are (i) the government is more impatient than foreign creditors, and (ii) there are deadweight losses from default. The multiplicity is dynamic and stems from the self-fulfilling beliefs of how future creditors will price bonds; long maturity bonds are therefore a crucial component of the multiplicity. We introduce a third party with deep pockets to discuss the policy implications of this source of multiplicity and identify the potentially perverse consequences of traditional “lender of last resort” policies. (JEL E44, E62, F34, H63, G12)

10.1257/aer.20180831.abstractZh: 我们证明了债权人对未来借款的信念可能是自我实现的，从而导致多种不同的债务积累模式。我们在增加了长期债券的爱顿-格索维茨主权债务模型中描述了这种不确定性。导致多重均衡的两个必要条件是：(i) 政府比外国债权人更急躁；(ii) 违约会导致无谓损失。这种多重性具有动态性，源于未来债权人如何对债券进行定价的自我实现信念；因此，长期债券是多重性中的一个关键组成部分。我们引入了一个财力雄厚的第三方来讨论这种多重性的政策含义，并指出了传统“最后贷款人”政策可能带来的反常后果。(JEL E44, E62, F34, H63, G12)

abstract.text: We study how sharing a hometown or college connection with an incumbent member of China’s Politburo affects a candidate’s likelihood of selection as a new member. In specifications that include fixed effects to absorb quality differences across cities and colleges, we find that hometown and college connections are each associated with 5–9 percentage point reductions in selection probability. This “connections penalty” is equally strong for retiring Politburo members, arguing against quota-based explanations, and it is much stronger for junior Politburo members, consistent with a role for intra-factional competition. Our findings differ from earlier work because of our emphasis on within-group variation, and our focus on shared hometown and college, rather than shared workplace, connections. (JEL D72, O17, P26, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20180841.abstractZh: 我们研究了与中国政治局现任成员拥有共同的家乡或大学背景这一因素如何影响一名候选人被选为新成员的可能性。在考虑了固定效应以吸收不同城市和大学之间的质量差异后，我们发现家乡和大学的背景分别与选择概率降低5到9个百分点有关。这种“背景惩罚”对于退休的政治局成员同样显著，这反驳了基于配额的解释；而对于年轻的政治局成员来说，这种惩罚更为明显，这与派系内部竞争的作用一致。我们的研究结果与早期的研究不同，因为我们强调了群体内部的差异，并且关注的是共同的家乡和大学背景，而不是共同的工作地点背景。（JEL D72, O17, P26, Z13）

abstract.text: We build an empirical model to attribute delays in mortgage refinancing to psychological costs inhibiting refinancing until incentives are sufficiently strong; and behavior, potentially attributable to information-gathering costs, lowering the probability of household refinancing per unit time at any incentive. We estimate the model on administrative panel data from Denmark, where mortgage refinancing without cash-out is unconstrained. Middle-aged and wealthy households act as if they have high psychological refinancing costs; but older, poorer, and less-educated households refinance with lower probability irrespective of incentives, thereby achieving lower savings. We use the model to understand frictions in the mortgage channel of monetary policy transmission. (JEL E52, G21, G51, R31)

10.1257/aer.20180865.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个实证模型，用以解释抵押贷款再融资的延迟现象，认为这种延迟是由于心理成本导致的，直到激励措施足够强时，心理成本才会降低，从而促使家庭进行再融资。此外，我们还考虑了可能由信息收集成本引起的行为因素，这些因素会降低家庭在任何激励下每单位时间进行再融资的概率。我们对丹麦的行政面板数据进行了模型估计，在该国，无现金提取的抵押贷款再融资是不受限制的。中年且富裕的家庭表现得好像有较高的心理再融资成本；而年龄较大、经济较贫困且教育程度较低的家庭，无论激励如何，进行再融资的概率都较低，因此他们的储蓄水平也较低。我们利用该模型来理解货币政策传导过程中与抵押贷款相关的摩擦问题。（JEL E52, G21, G51, R31）

abstract.text: We assess whether financing can help private schools, which now account for one-third of primary school enrollment in low- and middle-income countries. Our experiment allocated unconditional cash grants to either one (L) or all (H) private schools in a village. In both arms, enrollment and revenues increased, leading to above-market returns. However, test scores increased only in H schools, accompanied by higher fees, and a greater focus on teachers. We provide a model demonstrating that market forces can provide endogenous incentives to increase quality and increased financial saturation can be used to leverage competition, generating socially desirable outcomes. (JEL I21, I22, I25, I28, L22, L26, N75, O15, O16)

10.1257/aer.20180924.abstractZh: 我们评估融资是否能够帮助私立学校，这些学校目前在低收入和中等收入国家中占小学入学人数的三分之一。我们的实验向一个村庄的私立学校中，一部分（L组）和全部（H组）学校提供了无条件的现金补助。在两组学校中，入学人数和收入都有所增加，从而获得了高于市场的回报。然而，考试成绩仅在H组学校中有所提高，同时学费也上升了，且对教师的重视程度也更高。我们提供了一个模型，表明市场力量可以内生性地激励学校提高质量，而财务上的饱和状态则可以用来促进竞争，从而产生社会期望的结果。（JEL I21, I22, I25, I28, L22, L26, N75, O15, O16）

abstract.text: We study the impact of regulating product entry and quality information requirements on an oligopoly equilibrium and consumer welfare. Product testing can reduce consumer uncertainty, but also increase entry costs and delay entry. Using variation between EU and US medical device regulations, we document patterns consistent with valuable learning from more stringent US requirements. To derive welfare implications, we pair the data with a model of supply, demand, and testing regulation. US policy is indistinguishable from the policy that maximizes total surplus in our estimated model, while the European Union could benefit from more testing. “Post-market surveillance” could further increase surplus. (JEL D43, I18, L13, L51, L64, O31, O38)

10.1257/aer.20180946.abstractZh: 我们研究了产品准入监管和质量信息要求对寡头均衡及消费者福利的影响。产品测试可以降低消费者不确定性，但也会增加进入成本并延缓进入市场的时间。通过对比欧盟和美国医疗器械法规的差异，我们发现从更严格的美国要求中获得的宝贵经验是显而易见的。为了得出福利影响，我们将数据与供应、需求和测试监管模型相结合。在我们计算的模型中，美国的政策与最大化总剩余的政策并无区别，而欧盟则可以从更多的测试中受益。“上市后监管”可能会进一步增加剩余收益。（JEL D43, I18, L13, L51, L64, O31, O38）

abstract.text: We show that the vast majority of young married men in Saudi Arabia privately support women working outside the home (WWOH) and substantially underestimate support by other similar men. Correcting these beliefs increases men’s (costly) willingness to help their wives search for jobs. Months later, wives of men whose beliefs were corrected are more likely to have applied and interviewed for a job outside the home. In a recruitment experiment with a local company, randomly informing women about actual support for WWOH leads them to switch from an at-home temporary enumerator job to a higher-paying, outside-the-home version of the job. (JEL D83, J16, J22, O15, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20180975.abstractZh: 我们表明，沙特阿拉伯绝大多数年轻已婚男性私下支持女性在外工作，并且严重低估了其他类似男性的支持程度。纠正这些观念能够提升男性帮助妻子寻找工作的意愿（尽管这代价高昂）。几个月后，那些信念被纠正的男性的妻子更有可能申请并参加外工作的面试。在一项与当地公司的招聘实验中，随机向女性告知关于实际支持女性在外工作的信息，使她们从在家从事临时统计工作的岗位转向更高薪水的外工作职位。（JEL D83, J16, J22, O15, Z13）

abstract.text: Worsening environmental conditions threaten to undermine progress in reducing rural poverty. Little is known, however, about the prospects for farmer adaptations to mitigate this threat, in particular through opportunities for income diversification presented by recent non-agricultural growth. We study the effects of increasing water scarcity in India using quasi-random, geologically determined differences in access to groundwater. The drying up of wells results in a precipitous and persistent decline in farm income and wealth, with little evidence of agricultural adaptation. However, labor reallocation to off-farm employment appears successful in maintaining overall income, particularly in locations with a more developed manufacturing sector. (JEL O13, O18, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q25, Q28)

10.1257/aer.20180976.abstractZh: 日益恶化的环境条件有可能破坏减少农村贫困的进展。然而，关于农民如何适应这一威胁以缓解这种威胁的情况，我们知之甚少，尤其是通过最近的非农业增长带来的收入多样化机会。我们研究了印度水资源短缺加剧的影响，采用基于地质差异的准随机方法来研究地下水获取情况的变化。井水的干涸导致农场收入和财富急剧且持续下降，几乎没有证据表明农民采取了适应措施。不过，劳动力向非农领域的重新分配在维持整体收入方面似乎取得了成功，尤其是在制造业较为发达的地区。（JEL O13, O18, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q25, Q28）

abstract.text: The US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) uses a dynamic approach to enforcing air pollution regulations, with repeat offenders subject to high fines and designation as high priority violators (HPV). We estimate the value of dynamic enforcement by developing and estimating a dynamic model of a plant and regulator, where plants decide when to invest in pollution abatement technologies. We use a fixed grid approach to estimate random coefficient specifications. Investment, fines, and HPV designation are costly to most plants. Eliminating dynamic enforcement would raise pollution damages by 164 percent with constant fines or raise fines by 519 percent with constant pollution damages. (JEL Q52, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20181012.abstractZh: 美国环境保护署采用动态方式来执行空气污染法规，对屡犯者处以高额罚款，并将其列为高优先级违规者。我们通过构建并估计一个关于企业和监管机构的动态模型来评估动态执法的价值，其中企业自行决定何时投资污染控制技术。我们采用固定网格方法来计算随机系数规格。对于大多数企业而言，投资、罚款以及被列为高优先级违规者都是昂贵的成本。如果取消动态执法，在固定罚款的情况下，污染损害将增加164%；而在固定污染损害的情况下，罚款将增加519%。（JEL Q52, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: We follow Medicare cohorts to estimate Hurricane Katrina's long-run mortality effects on victims initially living in New Orleans. Including the initial shock, the hurricane improved eight-year survival by 2.07 percentage points. Migration to lower-mortality regions explains most of this survival increase. Those migrating to low-versus high-mortality regions look similar at baseline, but their subsequent mortality is 0.83-1.01 percentage points lower per percentage point reduction in local mortality, quantifying causal effects of place on mortality among this population. Migrants' mortality is also lower in destinations with healthier behaviors and higher incomes but is unrelated to local medical spending and quality.

10.1257/aer.20181026.abstractZh: 我们通过追踪Medicare队列的数据，来估算飓风卡特里娜对最初居住在新奥尔良的灾民的长期死亡影响。考虑到最初的冲击，飓风使八年的生存率提高了2.07个百分点。迁移到死亡率较低的地区解释了这一生存率提升的大部分原因。那些迁移到死亡率较低地区的灾民，在基线时的情况相似，但随后他们的死亡率每降低一个百分点，死亡人数就会减少0.83至1.01个百分点，这量化了地点对这类人群死亡率的因果效应。迁移到行为更健康、收入更高的目的地，灾民的平均死亡率也较低，但这与当地的医疗支出和医疗质量无关。

abstract.text: The Bartik instrument is formed by interacting local industry shares and national industry growth rates. We show that the typical use of a Bartik instrument assumes a pooled exposure research design, where the shares measure differential exposure to common shocks, and identification is based on exogeneity of the shares. Next, we show how the Bartik instrument weights each of the exposure designs. Finally, we discuss how to assess the plausibility of the research design. We illustrate our results through two applications: estimating the elasticity of labor supply, and estimating the elasticity of substitution between immigrants and natives. (JEL C51, F14, J15, J22, L60, R23, R32)

10.1257/aer.20181047.abstractZh: Bartik工具是通过结合地方产业份额和国家产业增长率来形成的。我们指出，使用Bartik工具的典型做法需要采用汇总暴露研究设计，其中产业份额衡量对共同冲击的不同暴露程度，而识别过程则基于产业份额的外生性。接下来，我们展示了Bartik工具如何对每种暴露设计进行加权。最后，我们讨论了如何评估该研究设计的合理性。我们通过两个应用案例来说明我们的结果：估计劳动力供给的弹性，以及估计移民与本地居民之间的替代弹性。（JEL C51, F14, J15, J22, L60, R23, R32）

abstract.text: I study the welfare and price implications of consumer privacy. A consumer discloses information to a multiproduct seller, which learns about his preferences, sets prices, and makes product recommendations. Although the consumer benefits from accurate recommendations, the seller may use the information to price discriminate. I show that the seller prefers to commit to not use information for pricing in order to encourage information disclosure. However, this commitment hurts the consumer, who could be better off by precommitting to withhold some information. In contrast to single-product models, total surplus may be lower if the seller can base prices on information. (JEL D11, D83, L81, M31)

10.1257/aer.20181052.abstractZh: 我研究了消费者隐私对福利和价格的影响。消费者向多产品卖家披露信息，卖家通过这些信息了解消费者的偏好，制定价格，并做出产品推荐。虽然消费者能从准确的推荐中受益，但卖家可能会利用这些信息进行价格歧视。研究表明，卖家更倾向于承诺不将信息用于定价，以鼓励消费者披露信息。然而，这种承诺会对消费者造成伤害，因为消费者本可以通过承诺不透露某些信息而获得更好的利益。与单产品模型相比，如果卖家能够基于信息来制定价格，总收益可能会更低。（JEL D11, D83, L81, M31）

abstract.text: This paper documents a large association between individuals’ time discounting in incentivized experiments and their positions in the real-life wealth distribution derived from Danish high-quality administrative data for a large sample of middle-aged individuals. The association is stable over time, exists through the wealth distribution and remains large after controlling for education, income profile, school grades, initial wealth, parental wealth, credit constraints, demographics, risk preferences, and additional behavioral parameters. Our results suggest that savings behavior is a driver of the observed association between patience and wealth inequality as predicted by standard savings theory. (JEL C91, D15, D31, E21)

10.1257/aer.20181096.abstractZh: 本文通过丹麦高质量行政数据，对大量中年个体的激励实验中的时间折扣行为与他们在现实财富分配中的位置进行了研究。研究发现，时间折扣行为与财富分配之间存在稳定的关联，并且这种关联在控制教育水平、收入状况、学校成绩、初始财富、父母财富、信贷限制、人口统计特征、风险偏好以及其他行为参数后依然显著。我们的结果表明，储蓄行为是解释耐心与财富不平等之间关联的关键因素，这与标准储蓄理论预测的结果一致。（JEL C91, D15, D31, E21）

abstract.text: We examine the role of FM radio in mitigating violent conflict. We collect original data on radio broadcasts encouraging defections during the Lord’s Resistance Army (LRA) insurgency. This constitutes the first quantitative evaluation of an active counterinsurgency policy that encourages defections through radio messages. Exploiting random topography-driven variation in radio coverage along with panel variation at the grid-cell level, we identify the causal effect of messaging on violence. Broadcasting defection messages increases defections and reduces fatalities, violence against civilians, and clashes with security forces. Income shocks have opposing effects on both the conflict and the effectiveness of messaging. (JEL D74, L82, O17)

10.1257/aer.20181135.abstractZh: 我们研究了调频广播在缓解暴力冲突中的作用。我们收集了在上帝抵抗军叛乱期间，通过广播鼓励叛逃的原创数据。这是首次对通过广播信息鼓励叛逃的积极反叛乱政策进行定量评估。通过利用随机地形导致的广播覆盖范围变化以及网格单元级别的样本差异，我们确定了信息传达对暴力行为的因果效应。播放叛逃信息会增加叛逃人数，并减少死亡人数、针对平民的暴力行为以及与安全部队的冲突。收入冲击对冲突和信息的有效性有着相反的影响。（JEL D74, L82, O17）

abstract.text: Linear regressions with period and group fixed effects are widely used to estimate treatment effects. We show that they estimate weighted sums of the average treatment effects (ATE ) in each group and period, with weights that may be negative. Due to the negative weights, the linear regression coefficient may for instance be negative while all the ATEs are positive. We propose another estimator that solves this issue. In the two applications we revisit, it is significantly different from the linear regression estimator. (JEL C21, C23, D72, J31, J51, L82)

10.1257/aer.20181169.abstractZh: 带有时间和组固定效应的线性回归被广泛用于估计处理效应。我们发现，它们实际上估计的是每组和每个时期的平均处理效应的加权和，这些权重可能是负的。由于负权重的存在，线性回归的系数可能为负，而所有平均处理效应却都是正的。我们提出了另一种解决这一问题的估计方法。在我们重新研究的两个应用中，这种估计方法与线性回归估计方法有显著的不同。（JEL C21, C23, D72, J31, J51, L82）

abstract.text: We propose a new strategy for dissecting the macroeconomic time series, provide a template for the business-cycle propagation mechanism that best describes the data, and use its properties to appraise models of both the parsimonious and the medium-scale variety. Our findings support the existence of a main business-cycle driver but rule out the following candidates for this role: technology or other shocks that map to TFP movements; news about future productivity; and inflationary demand shocks of the textbook type. Models aimed at accommodating demand-driven cycles without a strict reliance on nominal rigidity appear promising. (JEL C22, E10, E32)

10.1257/aer.20181174.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的策略来解析宏观经济时间序列，为最能描述数据的商业周期传播机制提供了一个模板，并利用其特性来评估简约型和中规模模型的性能。我们的研究结果支持存在一个主要的商业周期驱动因素，但排除了以下候选因素：技术或其他与全要素生产率变动相关的冲击；关于未来生产力的新闻；以及教科书类型的通胀性需求冲击。那些旨在适应需求驱动周期而不严格依赖名义刚性性的模型似乎具有前景。（JEL C22, E10, E32）

abstract.text: We propose a criterion of stability for two-sided markets with asymmetric information. A central idea is to formulate off-path beliefs conditional on counterfactual pairwise deviations and on-path beliefs in the absence of such deviations. A matching-belief configuration is stable if the matching is individually rational with respect to the system of on-path beliefs and is not blocked with respect to the system of off-path beliefs. The formulation provides a language for assessing matching outcomes with respect to their supporting beliefs and opens the door to further belief-based refinements. The main refinement analyzed in the paper requires the Bayesian consistency of on-path and off-path beliefs with prior beliefs. We define concepts of Bayesian efficiency, the rational expectations competitive equilibrium, and the core. Their contrast with pairwise stability manifests the role of information asymmetry in matching formation. (JEL C78, D40, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20181186.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种适用于信息不对称双边市场的稳定性标准。核心思想是将路径外信念建立在反事实的成对偏差之上，并将路径内信念在没有此类偏差的情况下进行表述。如果匹配信念配置在路径内信念系统下是个体理性的，并且在路径外信念系统下不会被阻塞，则该配置是稳定的。这一表述为评估匹配结果提供了语言基础，并为基于信念的进一步改进打开了大门。本文分析的主要改进要求路径内信念与路径外信念与先验信念之间具有贝叶斯一致性。我们定义了贝叶斯效率、理性预期竞争均衡以及核心的概念。它们与成对稳定性的对比揭示了信息不对称在匹配形成中的作用。（JEL C78, D40, D82, D83）

abstract.text: We study the rationality of individual and consensus forecasts of macroeconomic and financial variables using the methodology of Coibion and Gorodnichenko (2015), who examine predictability of forecast errors from forecast revisions. We find that individual forecasters typically overreact to news, while consensus forecasts under-react relative to full-information rational expectations. We reconcile these findings within a diagnostic expectations version of a dispersed information learning model. Structural estimation indicates that departures from Bayesian updating in the form of diagnostic overreaction capture important variation in forecast biases across different series, yielding a belief distortion parameter similar to estimates obtained in other settings. (JEL C53, D83, D84, E13, E17, E27, E47)

10.1257/aer.20181219.abstractZh: 我们研究了个体预测和共识预测在宏观经济和金融变量方面的合理性，采用了Coibion和Gorodnichenko（2015）的方法论，该方法论考察了预测修正对预测误差的可预测性。我们发现，个体预测者通常对新闻反应过激，而共识预测则相对低估了完全信息理性预期下的预测值。我们将这些发现纳入一个分散信息学习模型的诊断预期版本中。结构估计表明，以诊断性过度反应形式出现的贝叶斯更新偏差，能够捕捉不同序列中预测偏差的重要差异，从而得出一个与在其他情境下获得的估计值类似的信念扭曲参数。（JEL C53, D83, D84, E13, E17, E27, E47）

abstract.text: We exploit variation in mortgage modifications to disentangle the impact of reducing long-term obligations with no change in short-term payments (“wealth”), and reducing short-term payments with no change in long-term obligations (“liquidity”). Using regression discontinuity and difference-in-differences research designs with administrative data measuring default and consumption, we find that principal reductions that increase wealth without affecting liquidity have no effect, while maturity extensions that increase only liquidity have large effects. This suggests that liquidity drives default and consumption decisions for borrowers in our sample and that distressed debt restructurings can be redesigned with substantial gains to borrowers, lenders, and taxpayers. (JEL E21, G21, G51, R38)

10.1257/aer.20181243.abstractZh: 我们利用抵押贷款修改的变动来研究减少长期义务而不改变短期支付（“财富”）以及减少短期支付而不改变长期义务（“流动性”）的影响。通过回归断点和差异-差异研究设计，结合测量违约和消费的行政数据，我们发现，在不影响流动性的情况下减少本金对财富没有影响，而仅增加流动性的期限延长则会产生显著效果。这表明，流动性主导了我们样本中借款人的违约和消费决策，而困境中的债务重组可以通过重新设计获得对借款人、贷款人和纳税人的巨大收益。（JEL E21, G21, G51, R38）

abstract.text: We study a bargaining model in which a buyer makes frequent offers to a privately informed seller, while gradually learning about the seller’s type from “news.” We show that the buyer’s ability to leverage this information to extract more surplus from the seller is remarkably limited. In fact, the buyer gains nothing from the ability to negotiate a better price despite the fact that a negotiation must take place in equilibrium. During the negotiation, the buyer engages in a form of costly “experimentation” by making offers that are sure to earn her negative payoffs if accepted, but speed up learning and improve her continuation payoff if rejected. We investigate the effects of market power by comparing our results to a setting with competitive buyers. Both efficiency and the seller’s payoff can decrease by introducing competition among buyers. (JEL C78, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20181316.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个讨价还价模型，其中买家频繁向一个私下来往的卖家提出报价，同时逐渐通过“消息”了解卖家的类型。我们发现，买家利用这些信息从卖家那里获取更多收益的能力非常有限。实际上，尽管在均衡状态下必须进行谈判，但买家通过谈判获得更低价格的能力并没有带来任何收益。在谈判过程中，买家进行一种代价高昂的“实验”，即提出一些如果被接受将带来负面收益的报价，但如果被拒绝则能加快学习过程并提高其持续收益。我们通过将我们的结果与具有竞争性的买家的情况进行比较，来研究市场力量的影响。引入竞争后，不仅效率会下降，卖家的收益也会减少。（JEL C78, D82, D83）

abstract.text: Does public cheap talk by a biased expert benefit voters? The answer depends on the nature of democratic institutions and the extent of communication possibilities. Expert endorsements induce office-seeking parties to serve the expert’s interests, hurting voters. Expert advocacy makes policies respond to information, helping voters. Together, policy advocacy and partisan endorsements are often better than either alone. Their interaction creates a delegation benefit that makes indirect democracy superior to direct democracy and office-seeking parties better than those motivated by public interest. But voter welfare is highest when an expert captured technocratic party competes against an uninformed populist one. (JEL D72, D82)

10.1257/aer.20181396.abstractZh: 偏见的专家公开发表言论是否会对选民有利？答案取决于民主制度的性质以及沟通的可能性。专家的推荐会促使寻求职位的政党服务于专家的利益，从而损害选民的权益。而专家的倡导则会使政策根据信息进行调整，从而帮助选民。政策倡导和党派推荐结合起来往往比单独使用任何一种方式更为有效。它们的相互作用创造了一种委托利益，使得间接民主优于直接民主，并且寻求职位的政党比那些以公共利益为动机的政党更为有效。不过，当由技术专家组成的政党与缺乏信息的民粹主义政党竞争时，选民的福利最高。（JEL D72, D82）

abstract.text: Expectations of transfers by central governments incentivize overborrowing by local governments. In this paper, we ask if fiscal rules can reduce overborrowing if central governments cannot commit to enforce penalties when rules are violated. We study a model in which the central government’s type is unknown and show that fiscal rules increase overborrowing if the central government’s reputation is low. In contrast, fiscal rules are effective in lowering debt if the central government’s reputation is high. Even when the central government’s reputation is low, binding fiscal rules will arise in the equilibrium of a signaling game. (JEL E62, H62, H63, H77, H81)

10.1257/aer.20181432.abstractZh: 中央政府的转移支付预期会激励地方政府过度借贷。本文探讨在中央政府无法承诺对违反规则的行为实施处罚的情况下，财政规则是否能够有效减少过度借贷。我们研究了一个模型，其中中央政府的类型是未知的，并发现如果中央政府的声誉较低，财政规则会加剧过度借贷行为。相反，如果中央政府的声誉较高，财政规则则有助于降低债务。即使中央政府的声誉较低，在信号博弈的均衡中也会出现具有约束力的财政规则。（JEL E62, H62, H63, H77, H81）

abstract.text: Macroeconomic news announcements are elaborate and multidimensional. We consider a framework in which jumps in asset prices around announcements reflect both the response to observed surprises in headline numbers and to latent factors, reflecting other news in the release. Non-headline news, for which there are no expectations surveys, is unobservable to the econometrician but nonetheless elicits a market response. We estimate the model by the Kalman filter, which efficiently combines OLS and heteroskedasticity-based event study estimators in one step. With the inclusion of a single latent surprise factor, essentially all yield curve variance in event windows are explained by news. (JEL C51, E43, E52, G12, G14)

10.1257/aer.20181470.abstractZh: 宏观经济新闻公告内容复杂且多维。我们提出了一个框架，其中公告前后资产价格的波动既反映了对头条数据意外情况的反应，也反映了对潜在因素的响应，这些潜在因素则反映了公告中其他新闻的影响。对于没有预期调查的非头条新闻，经济计量学家无法对其进行观测，但这些信息仍然会引发市场反应。我们通过卡尔曼滤波器来估计模型，该方法能够高效地将OLS估计方法和基于异方差性的事件研究估计方法结合在一个步骤中。通过引入单一的潜在意外因素，事件窗口内的所有收益率曲线变化都可以用新闻来解释。（JEL C51, E43, E52, G12, G14）

abstract.text: In 2016, the Liberian government delegated management of 93 randomly selected public schools to private providers. Providers received US$50 per pupil, on top of US$50 per pupil annual expenditure in control schools. After one academic year, students in outsourced schools scored 0.18 σ higher in English and mathematics. We do not find heterogeneity in learning gains or enrollment by student characteristics, but there is significant heterogeneity across providers. While outsourcing appears to be a cost-effective way to use new resources to improve test scores, some providers engaged in unforeseen and potentially harmful behavior, complicating any assessment of welfare gains. (JEL H41, I21, I28, O15)

10.1257/aer.20181478.abstractZh: 2016年，利比里亚政府将93所随机选取的公立学校的管理权委托给私人机构。这些私人机构每名学生收取50美元的费用，此外还承担控制学校每年每名学生的50美元开支。一个学年后，外包学校的学生在英语和数学方面的成绩提高了0.18σ。我们没有发现学生特征对学习成果或入学率的影响存在差异，但不同提供商的成果存在显著差异。虽然外包似乎是一种利用新资源提高考试成绩的低成本方式，但一些提供商会采取一些未预见且可能有害的行为，这使得对福利收益的任何评估都变得复杂。（JEL H41, I21, I28, O15）

abstract.text: In all modern bureaucracies, politicians retain some discretion in public employment decisions, which may lead to frictions in the selection process if political connections substitute for individual competence. Relying on detailed matched employer-employee data on the universe of public employees in Brazil over 1997–2014, and on a regression discontinuity design in close electoral races, we establish three main findings. First, political connections are a key and quantitatively large determinant of employment in public organizations, for both bureaucrats and frontline providers. Second, patronage is an important mechanism behind this result. Third, political considerations lead to the selection of less competent individuals. (JEL D72, D73, J45, O17)

10.1257/aer.20181491.abstractZh: 在所有现代官僚机构中，政治家在公共就业决策中仍保留一定的自由裁量权，这可能导致选拔过程中出现摩擦，因为政治关系可能取代个人能力成为选拔依据。通过利用1997年至2014年间巴西公共雇员群体的详细匹配雇主-雇员数据，并结合紧密选举竞争中的回归不连续设计方法，我们得出了三个主要结论。首先，政治关系是影响公共机构中雇员就业的关键因素，且影响程度显著。其次，裙带关系是这一现象背后的重要机制。第三，政治考量导致选择了能力较低的个体。（JEL D72, D73, J45, O17）

abstract.text: We consider bargaining environments in which public opinion provides leverage by making compromises costly. Two parties make initial demands, before knowing the public opinion. If deadlocked, they can bargain again after public opinion forms, but suffer reputation costs if they compromise, i.e., scale back their demands. We show that in equilibrium, parties may choose to make incompatible demands initially and gamble over public opinion even though one or both parties must bear a cost later. We characterize when deadlocks arise, and how this affects the welfare of the public in a representative two-party democracy compared to a direct democracy. (JEL C78, D72)

10.1257/aer.20181495.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种讨价还价情境，其中公众舆论通过使妥协变得昂贵来提供影响力。双方在了解公众舆论之前先提出初始要求。如果陷入僵局，他们可以在形成公众舆论后再进行谈判，但如果妥协，即缩减要求，则会遭受声誉成本。我们表明，在均衡状态下，双方可能会最初提出不兼容的要求，并基于公众舆论进行博弈，尽管其中一方或双方之后必须承担成本。我们描述了僵局何时出现，以及这种情况对代表性两党民主与直接民主中的公众福利的影响。（JEL C78, D72）

abstract.text: This paper uses new confidential Census data to revisit the relationship between firm size, cyclicality, and financial frictions. First, we find that large firms (the top 1 percent by size) are less cyclically sensitive than the rest. Second, high and rising concentration implies that the higher cyclicality of the bottom 99 percent of firms only has a modest impact on aggregate fluctuations. Third, differences in cyclicality are not simply explained by financing, and in fact appear largely unrelated to proxies for financial strength. We instead provide evidence for an alternative mechanism based on the industry scope of the very largest firms. (JEL D22, E32, G32, L25)

10.1257/aer.20181499.abstractZh: 本文利用新的机密人口普查数据，重新探讨了企业规模、周期性以及金融摩擦之间的关系。首先，我们发现大型企业（规模排名前1%的企业）的周期性敏感性低于其他企业。其次，企业集中度较高且呈上升趋势，这意味着排名后99%的企业较高的周期性对整体经济波动的影响较为有限。第三，企业周期性的差异并非仅仅由融资因素解释，实际上与财务实力的指标关系不大。我们提供了基于最大型企业行业范围的另一种机制的解释。（JEL D22, E32, G32, L25）

abstract.text: We study the long-run effects of forced migration on investment in education. After World War II, millions of Poles were forcibly uprooted from the Kresy territories of eastern Poland and resettled (primarily) in the newly acquired Western Territories, from which the Germans were expelled. We combine historical censuses with newly collected survey data to show that, while there were no pre-WWII differences in educational attainment, Poles with a family history of forced migration are significantly more educated today than other Poles. These results are driven by a shift in preferences away from material possessions toward investment in human capital. (JEL I25, I26, J24, N34, R23)

10.1257/aer.20181518.abstractZh: 我们研究了强制迁移对教育投资长期影响的研究。第二次世界大战后，数百万波兰人被迫从波兰东部的克雷西地区迁离，并主要重新安置在德国人被驱逐的新获得的西部领土上。我们通过结合历史人口普查和新收集的调查数据发现，尽管在二战之前波兰人在教育水平上没有差异，但具有强制迁移家族史的波兰人如今的教育水平明显高于其他波兰人。这些结果源于人们偏好从物质财富转向人力资本投资。（JEL I25, I26, J24, N34, R23）

abstract.text: We examine the consequences of a sudden increase in household debt burdens by exploiting variation in exposure to household foreign currency debt during Hungary’s late-2008 currency crisis. The revaluation of debt burdens causes higher default rates and a collapse in spending. These responses lead to a worse local recession, driven by a decline in local demand, and negative spillover effects on nearby borrowers without foreign currency debt. The estimates translate into an output multiplier on higher debt service of 1.67. The impact of debt revaluation is particularly severe when foreign currency debt is concentrated on household, rather than firm, balance sheets. (JEL E21, E32, F34, G51)

10.1257/aer.20181585.abstractZh: 我们通过研究匈牙利2008年末货币危机期间家庭外币债务敞口的变化，来探讨家庭债务负担突然增加所带来的后果。债务重估导致更高的违约率以及支出的崩溃。这些反应进一步加剧了当地的经济衰退，其原因是当地需求的下降，同时还会对没有外币债务附近的借款人产生负面溢出效应。估计结果显示，较高的债务偿还额对产出乘数的影响为1.67。当外币债务集中在家庭资产负债表上而非企业资产负债表上时，债务重估的影响尤为严重。（JEL E21, E32, F34, G51）

abstract.text: We study multi-district legislative elections between two office-seeking parties when one party has an initial valence advantage that may shift and even reverse during the campaign; and, each party cares not only about winning a majority, but also about its share of seats. When the initial imbalance favoring one party is small, each party targets the median voter. For moderate imbalances, the advantaged party maintains the centre-ground, but the disadvantaged party retreats to target its core supporters; and for large imbalances, the advantaged party advances toward its opponent, raiding its moderate supporters in pursuit of an outsized majority. (JEL D72)

10.1257/aer.20181606.abstractZh: 我们研究了两个寻求职位的政党之间的多区立法选举，其中一个政党在竞选期间可能拥有初始的投票优势，这种优势可能会发生变化甚至逆转；而且，每个政党不仅关心赢得多数席位，还关心自己获得的席位数量。当初始的偏向某一党的不平衡程度较小时，每个政党都会争取中间选民的支持。对于中等程度的不平衡，处于优势地位的政党会保持中立立场，而处于劣势的政党则会转向争取其核心支持者；对于较大的不平衡，处于优势地位的政党会向对手靠拢，通过争取中间派的支持来追求更大的多数优势。（JEL D72）

abstract.text: I show that the nature of the Federal Open Market Committee’s (FOMC’s) forward guidance language shapes the private sector’s responses to monetary policy statements. From February 2000 to June 2003, the FOMC only gave forward guidance about economic outlook risks, and a decrease in the expected federal funds rate path caused stock prices to fall, GDP growth forecasts to fall, and the unemployment rate to rise. From August 2003 to May 2006, the FOMC added forward guidance about policy inclinations, and a decrease in the expected federal funds rate path had the opposite effects. These results suggest that forward guidance that emphasizes economic outlook risks causes stronger information effects than forward guidance that emphasizes policy inclinations. (JEL D83, E52, E58, E66)

10.1257/aer.20181721.abstractZh: 我表明，联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）的前瞻性指导语言的性质决定了私营部门对货币政策声明的具体反应。从2000年2月到2003年6月，FOMC仅提供了关于经济前景风险的前瞻性指导，而联邦基金利率路径的预期下降导致股价下跌、GDP增长预期下降以及失业率上升。从2003年8月到2006年5月，FOMC增加了关于政策倾向的前瞻性指导，而联邦基金利率路径预期下降则产生了相反的效果。这些结果表明，强调经济前景风险的前瞻性指导比强调政策倾向的前瞻性指导更能产生强烈的信息效应。（JEL D83, E52, E58, E66）

abstract.text: We develop an endogenous network formation model, in which agents form connections to acquire information. Our model features complementarity in actions as agents care not only about accuracy of their decision-making but also about the actions of other agents.
