In equilibrium, the information structure is a hierarchical network, and, under weakly convex cost of forming links, the equilibrium network is core-periphery. Although agents are ex ante identical, there is ex post heterogeneity in payoffs and actions. (JEL D83, D85, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20181798.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个内生网络形成模型，其中代理人通过建立联系来获取信息。我们的模型强调行为的互补性，因为代理人不仅关注决策的准确性，还关注其他代理人的行为。在均衡状态下，信息结构呈现层级网络结构，并且在形成联系的成本较低的情况下，均衡网络表现为核心-边缘结构。尽管代理人事前是相同的，但事后在收益和行为上存在着异质性。（JEL D83, D85, Z13）

abstract.text: People reason about uncertainty with deliberately incomplete models. How do people hampered by different, incomplete views of the world learn from each other? We introduce a model of “ model-based inference.” Model-based reasoners partition an otherwise hopelessly complex state space into a manageable model. Unless the differences in agents’ models are trivial, interactions will often not lead agents to have common beliefs or beliefs near the correct-model belief. If the agents’ models have enough in common, then interacting will lead agents to similar beliefs, even if their models also exhibit some bizarre idiosyncrasies and their information is widely dispersed. (JEL D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20190080.abstractZh: 人们通过故意不完整的模型来推理不确定性。那些受到不同、不完整世界观影响的人们，是如何相互学习的呢？我们引入了一种“基于模型的推理”模型。基于模型的推理者将一个原本极其复杂的状态空间划分为可管理的模型。除非代理模型之间的差异微不足道，否则互动通常不会导致代理们拥有共同的信念或接近正确模型的信念。如果代理们的模型有足够的共同之处，那么互动将使他们拥有相似的信念，即使他们的模型也表现出一些奇怪的特性，且他们的信息分布广泛。（JEL D82, D83）

abstract.text: A firm raises capital from multiple investors to fund a project. The project succeeds only if the capital raised exceeds a stochastic threshold, and the firm offers payments contingent on success. We study the firm’s optimal unique-implementation scheme, namely the scheme that guarantees the firm the maximum payoff. This scheme treats investors differently based on size. We show that if the distribution of the investment threshold is log-concave, larger investors receive higher net returns than smaller investors. Moreover, higher dispersion in investor size increases the firm’s payoff. Our analysis highlights strategic risk as an important potential driver of inequality. (JEL D21, D86, G24, G32)

10.1257/aer.20190234.abstractZh: 一家企业从多个投资者那里筹集资金以资助一个项目。只有当筹集的资金超过一个随机阈值时，该项目才能成功，而企业则根据项目的成功情况来支付报酬。我们研究了企业的最优独特实施方案，即能够确保企业获得最大收益的方案。该方案根据投资者的规模差异来区别对待他们。我们表明，如果投资阈值的分布是log-concave的，那么规模较大的投资者将比规模较小的投资者获得更高的净收益。此外，投资者规模的分散程度越高，企业的收益就越大。我们的分析强调了战略风险作为不平等的重要潜在驱动因素。（JEL D21, D86, G24, G32）

abstract.text: I study a mechanism design problem involving a principal and a single, boundedly rational agent. The agent transitions among belief states by combining current beliefs with up to K pieces of information at a time. By expressing a mechanism as a complex contract—a collection of clauses, each providing limited information about the mechanism—the principal manipulates the agent into believing truthful reporting is optimal. I show that such bounded rationality expands the set of implementable functions and that optimal contracts are robust not only to variation in K, but to several plausible variations on the agent’s cognitive procedure. (JEL D82, D86)

10.1257/aer.20190283.abstractZh: 我研究了一个机制设计问题，涉及一个主体和一个有限理性的代理人。代理人通过结合当前的信念和一次最多K条信息来在信念状态之间转换。通过将机制表达为一个复杂的合同——一系列提供有限信息的条款——主体能够促使代理人相信诚实报告是最优选择。我证明，这种有限理性扩展了可实施函数的集合，并且最优合同不仅对K的变化具有鲁棒性，而且对代理人认知程序的几种合理变体也具有鲁棒性。（JEL D82, D86）

abstract.text: We present a new equilibrium search model where consumers initially search among discount opportunities, but are willing to pay more as a deadline approaches, eventually turning to full-price sellers. The model predicts equilibrium price dispersion and rationalizes discount and full-price sellers coexisting without relying on ex ante heterogeneity. We apply the model to online retail sales via auctions and posted prices, where failed attempts to purchase reveal consumers' reservation prices. We find robust evidence supporting the theory. We quantify dynamic search frictions arising from deadlines and show how, with deadline-constrained buyers, seemingly neutral platform fee increases can cause large market shifts. (JEL D11, D44, D83, L81)

10.1257/aer.20190460.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个新的均衡搜索模型，在该模型中，消费者最初会在折扣机会中进行搜索，但随着截止日期的临近，他们愿意支付更高的价格，最终转向全价卖家。该模型预测了均衡价格的差异，并解释了折扣卖家和全价卖家共存的现象，而无需依赖事前异质性。我们将该模型应用于通过拍卖和标价进行的在线零售销售，其中购买失败的情况会揭示消费者的保留价格。我们发现有强有力的证据支持这一理论。我们量化了由截止日期引起的动态搜索摩擦，并展示了在截止日期约束的买家情况下，看似中立的平台费用增加如何导致市场的大幅变化。（JEL D11, D44, D83, L81）

abstract.text: We estimate the price effect of US import restrictions on washers. The 2012 and 2016 antidumping duties against South Korea and China were accompanied by downward or minor price movements along with production relocation to other export platform countries. With the 2018 tariffs, on nearly all source countries, the price of washers increased nearly 12 percent. Interestingly, the price of dryers—not subject to tariffs—increased by an equivalent amount. Factoring in dryer prices and price increases by domestic brands, the 2018 tariffs on washers imply a tariff elasticity of consumer prices of above one. (JEL F13, F14, F23, L68, 019, P33)

10.1257/aer.20190611.abstractZh: 我们估算了美国对洗衣机进口限制的价格效应。2012年和2016年针对韩国和中国的反倾销关税导致洗衣机价格下降或小幅上涨，同时生产活动转向其他出口平台国家。而2018年对几乎所有来源国的关税使得洗衣机价格上涨了近12%。有趣的是，未受关税影响的烘干机价格也出现了类似的上涨。考虑到烘干机的价格以及国内品牌的价格上涨，2018年对洗衣机的关税意味着消费者价格弹性超过1。（JEL F13, F14, F23, L68, 019, P33）

abstract.text: Increasingly, algorithms are supplanting human decision-makers in pricing goods and services. To analyze the possible consequences, we study experimentally the behavior of algorithms powered by Artificial Intelligence (Q-learning) in a workhorse oligopoly model of repeated price competition. We find that the algorithms consistently learn to charge supracompetitive prices, without communicating with one another. The high prices are sustained by collusive strategies with a finite phase of punishment followed by a gradual return to cooperation. This finding is robust to asymmetries in cost or demand, changes in the number of players, and various forms of uncertainty. (JEL D21, D43, D83, L12, L13)

10.1257/aer.20190623.abstractZh: 越来越多的算法正在取代人类决策者来定价商品和服务。为了分析可能的后果，我们在一个重复价格竞争的寡头垄断模型中，通过实验研究了由人工智能驱动的算法（Q学习算法）的行为。我们发现，这些算法能够持续地收取超竞争性的价格，而无需相互沟通。这些高价格是通过合作策略维持的，在有限阶段的惩罚之后，合作会逐渐恢复。这一发现不受成本或需求的不对称性、玩家数量的变化以及各种形式的不确定性等因素的影响。（JEL D21, D43, D83, L12, L13）

abstract.text: The rise of social media has provoked both optimism about potential societal benefits and concern about harms such as addiction, depression, and political polarization. In a randomized experiment, we find that deactivating Facebook for the four weeks before the 2018 US midterm election (i) reduced online activity, while increasing offline activities such as watching TV alone and socializing with family and friends; (ii) reduced both factual news knowledge and political polarization; (iii) increased subjective well-being; and post-experiment Facebook use. Deactivation reduced post-experiment valuations of Facebook, suggesting that traditional metrics may overstate consumer surplus. (JEL D12, D72, D90, I31, L82, L86, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20190658.abstractZh: 社交媒体的兴起引发了人们对潜在社会利益的乐观态度，同时也引发了关于成瘾、抑郁和政治两极分化等危害的担忧。在一项随机实验中，我们发现，在2018年美国中期选举前的四周内停用Facebook，会：(i) 减少在线活动，同时增加如独自看电视和与家人和朋友社交等线下活动；(ii) 降低事实性新闻知识水平以及政治两极分化程度；(iii) 提升主观幸福感；同时也会增加实验后对Facebook的使用频率。停用Facebook后，人们对Facebook的估值下降，这表明传统的评估指标可能高估了消费者的收益。(JEL D12, D72, D90, I31, L82, L86, Z13)

abstract.text: Using data from a two-year pricing experiment, we study the impact of subsidy policies on weather insurance take-up. Results show that subsidies increase future insurance take-up through their influence on payout experiences. Exploring mechanisms of the payout effect, we find that for households that randomly benefited from financial education, receiving a payout provides a one-time learning experience that improves take-up permanently. In contrast, households with poor insurance knowledge continuously update take-up decisions based on recent experiences with disasters and payouts. Combining subsidy policies with financial education can thus be effective in promoting long-run insurance adoption. (JEL G22, G52, G53, Q54)

10.1257/aer.20190661.abstractZh: 通过一项为期两年的定价实验的数据，我们研究了补贴政策对天气保险普及程度的影响。结果显示，补贴通过影响赔付体验，增加了未来保险的普及率。在探讨赔付效应的机制时，我们发现，对于那些随机获得金融教育帮助的家庭来说，获得一次性的赔付体验能够永久性地提高保险普及率。相比之下，那些保险知识匮乏的家庭则会根据最近的灾害经历和赔付情况不断调整保险决策。因此，将补贴政策与金融教育相结合，可以有效促进长期保险的采用。（JEL G22, G52, G53, Q54）

abstract.text: The pace of job reallocation has declined in the United States in recent decades. We draw insight from canonical models of business dynamics in which reallocation can decline due to (i ) lower dis persion of idiosyncratic shocks faced by businesses, or (ii ) weaker marginal responsiveness of businesses to shocks. We show that shock dispersion has actually risen, while the responsiveness of business-level employment to productivity has weakened. Moreover, declining responsiveness can account for a significant fraction of the decline in the pace of job reallocation, and we find suggestive evidence this has been a drag on aggregate productivity. (JEL D24, E24, E32, J21, J23, J24, L60)

10.1257/aer.20190680.abstractZh: 近几十年来，美国的职位重新分配速度有所放缓。我们从商业动态的经典模型中获得了启示，其中重新分配速度下降的原因可能是：(i)企业面临的特殊冲击分散程度降低，或者(ii)企业对冲击的边际反应减弱。我们发现，实际上冲击的分散程度实际上有所上升，而企业层面就业对生产力的反应则减弱了。此外，这种反应减弱可以解释职位重新分配速度下降的很大一部分原因，我们发现有证据表明这一因素对总体生产力产生了负面影响。(JEL D24, E24, E32, J21, J23, J24, L60)

abstract.text: The credibility revolution in economics has promoted causal identification using randomized control trials (RCT), difference-in-differences (DID), instrumental variables (IV) and regression discontinuity design (RDD). Applying multiple approaches to over 21,000 hypothesis tests published in 25 leading economics journals, we find that the extent of p-hacking and publication bias varies greatly by method. IV (and to a lesser extent DID) are particularly problematic. We find no evidence that (i) papers published in the Top 5 journals are different to others; (ii) the journal “revise and resubmit” process mitigates the problem; (iii) things are improving through time. (JEL A14, C12, C52)

10.1257/aer.20190687.abstractZh: 经济学中的可信度革命促进了使用随机对照试验（RCT）、差异-差异法（DID）、工具变量（IV）和回归不连续设计（RDD）进行因果识别的研究。通过对25种顶尖经济学期刊中发表的超过21,000项假设检验采用多种方法进行分析，我们发现不同方法下p值操纵和发表偏倚的程度存在很大差异。工具变量（以及在较小程度上DID）尤其存在问题。我们没有发现以下证据：(i) 发表在排名前五的期刊上的论文与其他期刊的论文有所不同；(ii) 期刊的“修订并重发”流程能够缓解这一问题；(iii) 情况随着时间的推移有所改善。(JEL A14, C12, C52)

abstract.text: How do geographically concentrated income shocks influence the long-run spatial distribution of poverty within a city? We examine the impact on housing prices of a cholera epidemic in one neighborhood of nineteenth century London. Ten years after the epidemic, housing prices are significantly lower just inside the catchment area of the water pump that transmitted the disease. Moreover, differences in housing prices persist over the following 160 years. We make sense of these patterns by building a model of a rental market with frictions in which poor tenants exert a negative externality on their neighbors. This showcases how a locally concentrated income shock can persistently change the tenant composition of a block. (JEL D62, O18, R21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20190759.abstractZh: 地理上集中的收入冲击如何影响城市内部贫困的长期空间分布？我们研究了19世纪伦敦某个社区发生霍乱疫情对房价的影响。疫情发生十年后，疫情传播的水泵所在区域的房价明显较低。此外，房价差异在接下来的160年里仍然存在。我们通过构建一个包含摩擦因素的租赁市场模型来理解这些现象，其中贫困租户会对邻居产生负面外部性。这展示了局部集中的收入冲击如何持续改变一个街区的租户构成。（JEL D62, O18, R21, R31）

abstract.text: Studying job matching in a Kelso-Crawford framework, we consider arbitrary constraints imposed on sets of doctors that a hospital can hire. We characterize all constraints that preserve the substitutes condition (for all revenue functions that satisfy the substitutes condition), a critical condition on hospitals’ revenue functions for well-behaved competitive equilibria. A constraint preserves the substitutes condition if and only if it is a “generalized interval constraint,” which specifies the minimum and maximum numbers of hired doctors, forces some hires, and forbids others. Additionally, “generalized polyhedral constraints” are precisely those that preserve the substitutes condition for all “group separable” revenue functions. (JEL C78, D47, I11, J23, J41, J44)

10.1257/aer.20190780.abstractZh: 在Kelso-Crawford框架下研究就业匹配问题时，我们考虑了医院可以雇佣的医生群体所受到的任意约束。我们描述了所有保持替代条件约束的约束条件（对于所有满足替代条件的收入函数而言），这是医院收入函数在良好竞争均衡中的关键条件。一个约束条件只有在它是“广义区间约束”时才能保持替代条件，这种约束指定了雇佣医生的最小和最大数量，强制某些雇佣行为，并禁止其他雇佣行为。此外，“广义多面体约束”正是那些对所有“组可分离”收入函数保持替代条件的约束条件。（JEL C78, D47, I11, J23, J41, J44）

abstract.text: Are business cycles mainly a response to persistent exogenous shocks, or do they instead reflect a strong endogenous mechanism which produces recurrent boom-bust phenomena? In this paper we present evidence in favor of the second interpretation and we highlight the set of key elements that influence our answer. The elements that tend to favor this type of interpretation of business cycles are (i) slightly extending the frequency window one associates with business cycle phenomena, (ii) allowing for strategic complementarities across agents that arise due to financial frictions, and (iii) allowing for a locally unstable steady state in estimation. (JEL E22, E24, E23, E44)

10.1257/aer.20190789.abstractZh: 商业周期主要是对持续的外生冲击的响应，还是反映了一种强烈的内生机制，导致反复出现的繁荣与萧条现象？在本文中，我们提供了支持第二种解释的证据，并强调了影响我们结论的关键要素。倾向于支持这种商业周期解释的因素包括：(i) 略微延长人们通常与商业周期现象相关联的频率范围；(ii) 考虑到由于金融摩擦而产生的各主体之间的战略互补性；以及(iii) 在估计中允许存在局部不稳定的稳定状态。(JEL E22, E24, E23, E44)

abstract.text: Natural resources can have a negative impact on the economy through corruption and civil conflict. This paper tests whether information can counteract this political resource curse. We implement a large-scale field experiment following the dissemination of information about a substantial natural gas discovery in Mozambique. We measure outcomes related to the behavior of citizens and local leaders through georeferenced conflict data, behavioral activities, lab-in-the-field experiments, and surveys. We find that information targeting citizens and their involvement in public deliberations increases local mobilization and decreases violence. By contrast, when information reaches only local leaders, it increases elite capture and rent-seeking. (JEL C73, D72, D74, O13, O17, Q33, Q34)

10.1257/aer.20190842.abstractZh: 自然资源可能会通过腐败和民事冲突对经济产生负面影响。本文旨在探讨信息是否能够抵消这种“政治资源诅咒”。我们在莫桑比克发生重大天然气发现后，开展了一项大规模实地实验。我们通过地理参照的冲突数据、行为活动、实地实验和调查来测量与公民和当地领导人行为相关的结果。研究发现，针对公民的信息以及他们参与公共讨论的行为能够增加当地的社会动员能力并减少暴力行为。相反，当信息仅传递给当地领导人时，则会导致精英阶层的攫取和寻租行为增加。（JEL C73, D72, D74, O13, O17, Q33, Q34）

abstract.text: This paper studies when religion can hamper diffusion of knowledge and economic development, and through which mechanism. I examine Catholicism in France during the Second Industrial Revolution (1870–1914). In this period, technology became skill-intensive, leading to the introduction of technical education in primary schools. I find that more religious locations had lower economic development after 1870. Schooling appears to be the key mechanism: more religious areas saw a slower adoption of the technical curriculum and a push for religious education. In turn, religious education was negatively associated with industrial development 10 to 15 years later, when schoolchildren entered the labor market. (JEL D83, I21, I26, N33, Z12)

10.1257/aer.20191054.abstractZh: 本文探讨了宗教何时会阻碍知识的传播和经济发展，以及具体通过何种机制实现这一现象。本文以法国在第二次工业革命时期（1870–1914年）的天主教为例进行研究。这一时期，技术变得更为依赖技能，因此小学中引入了技术教育。研究发现，1870年之后，宗教氛围较强的地区经济发展较为缓慢。学校教育似乎是关键机制：宗教氛围较强的地区技术课程的采用速度较慢，且更重视宗教教育。反过来，10到15年后，当学童进入劳动力市场时，宗教教育与经济发展呈负相关关系。（JEL D83, I21, I26, N33, Z12）

abstract.text: We formalize the argument that political disagreements can be traced to a “clash of narratives.” Drawing on the “Bayesian Networks” literature, we represent a narrative by a causal model that maps actions into consequences, weaving a selection of other random variables into the story. Narratives generate beliefs by interpreting long-run correlations between these variables. An equilibrium is defined as a probability distribution over narrative-policy pairs that maximize a representative agent's anticipatory utility, capturing the idea that people are drawn to hopeful narratives. Our equilibrium analysis sheds light on the structure of prevailing narratives, the variables they involve, the policies they sustain, and their contribution to political polarization. (JEL D72, D83, D85, F52)

10.1257/aer.20191099.abstractZh: 我们将政治分歧归因于“叙事冲突”的论点进行了形式化。借鉴“贝叶斯网络”理论，我们用因果模型来表示一个叙事，该模型将行动映射到后果，并将其他随机变量编织进故事中。叙事通过解释这些变量之间的长期相关性来产生信念。均衡被定义为一种概率分布，它最大化了代表性代理人的预期效用，体现了人们倾向于乐观的叙事这一事实。我们的均衡分析揭示了主流叙事的结构、它们涉及的变量、所支持的政策，以及这些政策对政治两极分化的贡献。（JEL D72, D83, D85, F52）

abstract.text: We analyze selection into screening in the context of recommendations that breast cancer screening start at age 40. Combining medical claims with a clinical oncology model, we document that compliers with the recommendation are less likely to have cancer than younger women who select into screening or women who never screen. We show this selection is quantitatively important: shifting the recommendation from age 40 to 45 results in three times as many deaths if compliers were randomly selected than under the estimated patterns of selection. The results highlight the importance of considering characteristics of compliers when making and designing recommendations.

10.1257/aer.20191191.abstractZh: 我们分析了在乳腺癌筛查建议中，选择进入筛查人群的情况。通过结合医学数据和临床肿瘤学模型，我们发现遵循建议的人群比选择进入筛查的年轻女性或从未进行筛查的女性患癌症的可能性更低。我们的研究表明，这种选择具有显著的统计学意义：如果将建议的年龄从40岁改为45岁，遵循建议的人群的死亡率将是随机选择的群体的三倍。这些结果强调了在制定和设计建议时，考虑遵循建议人群的特征的重要性。

abstract.text: Data is nonrival: a person’s location history, medical records, and driving data can be used by many firms simultaneously. Nonrivalry leads to increasing returns. As a result, there may be social gains to data being used broadly across firms, even in the presence of privacy considerations. Fearing creative destruction, firms may choose to hoard their data, leading to the inefficient use of nonrival data. Giving data property rights to consumers can generate allocations that are close to optimal. Consumers balance their concerns for privacy against the economic gains that come from selling data broadly. (JEL C80, D11, D21, D83, E22, K11, O34)

10.1257/aer.20191330.abstractZh: 数据是非竞争性的：一个人的位置历史、医疗记录以及驾驶数据可以被许多公司同时使用。非竞争性导致了收益的增加。因此，即使考虑到隐私问题，数据在多家公司间被广泛使用也可能带来社会收益。由于担心创造性破坏，公司可能会选择囤积自己的数据，从而导致非竞争性数据的低效使用。将数据产权赋予消费者可以产生接近最优的分配结果。消费者在保护隐私的担忧与从广泛出售数据中获得的经济收益之间进行权衡。（JEL C80, D11, D21, D83, E22, K11, O34）

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effects on rural education of the send-down movement during the Cultural Revolution, when about 16 million urban youth were mandated to resettle in the countryside. Using a county-level dataset compiled from local gazetteers and population censuses, we show that greater exposure to the sent-down youths significantly increased rural children’s educational achievement. This positive effect diminished after the urban youth left the countryside in the late 1970s but never disappeared. Rural children who interacted with the sent-down youths were also more likely to pursue more-skilled occupations, marry later, and have smaller families than those who did not. (JEL I21, J13, J24, N35, O15, P36, R23)

10.1257/aer.20191414.abstractZh: 本文估算了文化大革命期间“下放运动”对农村教育的影响。当时约有1600万城市青年被强制安置到农村。通过利用从地方地志和人口普查中整理出的县级数据集，我们发现，与下放青年接触较多的农村儿童的教育成就显著提高。这一积极效应在20世纪70年代末城市青年离开农村后有所减弱，但从未完全消失。与下放青年有过互动的农村儿童更有可能从事技术含量较高的职业，结婚时间较晚，家庭规模也较小。（JEL I21, J13, J24, N35, O15, P36, R23）

abstract.text: We study the complexity of rules by paying experimental subjects to implement a series of algorithms and then eliciting their willingness-to-pay to avoid implementing them again in the future. The design allows us to examine hypotheses from the theoretical “automata” literature about the characteristics of rules that generate complexity costs. We find substantial aversion to complexity and a number of regularities in the characteristics of rules that make them complex and costly for subjects. Experience with a rule, the way a rule is represented, and the context in which a rule is implemented (mentally versus physically) also influence complexity. (JEL C73, D11, D12, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20191717.abstractZh: 我们研究了规则的复杂性，通过让实验对象执行一系列算法，然后调查他们愿意支付费用以避免在未来再次执行这些算法的意愿。这种设计使我们能够检验理论“自动机”文献中关于产生复杂性成本的规则特征的假设。我们发现，人们对复杂性的厌恶程度相当明显，并且规则的特征中存在一些规律性，这些规律使得规则对实验对象来说既复杂又昂贵。对规则的体验、规则的表现方式以及规则执行的环境（心理层面与物理层面）也会影响复杂性。（JEL C73, D11, D12, D83, D91）

abstract.text: We study anonymous repeated games where players may be “commitment types” who always take the same action. We establish a stark anti-folk theorem: if the distribution of the number of commitment types satisfies a smoothness condition and the game has a “pairwise dominant” action, this action is almost always taken. This implies that cooperation is impossible in the repeated prisoner's dilemma with anonymous random matching. We also bound equilibrium payoffs for general games. Our bound implies that industry profits converge to zero in linear-demand Cournot oligopoly as the number of firms increases. (JEL C72, C73, D83)

10.1257/aer.20200068.abstractZh: 我们研究了匿名重复博弈，其中玩家可能是“承诺类型”，总是采取相同的行动。我们提出了一个明确的反民粹主义定理：如果承诺类型的数量分布满足平滑条件，并且博弈具有“成对支配”行为，那么这种行为几乎总是会被采取。这意味着，在匿名随机匹配的重复囚徒困境中，合作是不可能的。我们还为一般博弈限定了均衡收益。我们的限定表明，在线性需求的库尔诺寡头垄断中，随着企业数量的增加，行业利润会趋于零。（JEL C72, C73, D83）

abstract.text: This paper shows that consumers respond to prices for complex healthcare when they can easily assess out-of-pocket prices. Healthcare cost containment efforts increasingly incentivize price shopping despite a dearth of evidence that this steers consumers toward lower-priced care for major medical services. I show that consumers shift toward lower-priced hospitals in the highly simplified price information environment of insurance plans with tiered hospital networks. Consumers observe a single predictable, well-defined price that applies to a broad range of services within each of at most three hospital tiers. Within three years, expected partial-equilibrium savings reach 8–17 percent of baseline spending. (JEL G22, H75, I11, I13)

10.1257/app.20180422.abstractZh: 本文指出，当消费者能够轻松评估个人承担的医疗费用时，他们对复杂的医疗保健服务会做出价格反应。尽管缺乏证据表明价格比较能促使消费者选择价格较低的医疗服务，但医疗成本控制措施仍不断推动消费者进行价格比较。研究发现在具有分层医院网络的保险计划这种高度简化的价格信息环境下，消费者会倾向于选择价格较低的医院。消费者观察到每个医院层级内的一系列服务都适用一个可预测且明确的价格。在三年内，预期的部分均衡节省金额可达基线支出的8%至17%。（JEL G22, H75, I11, I13）

abstract.text: We study the impact of endogenous longevity on optimal tax progressivity and inequality in an overlapping generations model with skill heterogeneity. Higher tax progressivity decreases both the longevity gap and net income inequality, but at the expense of lower average lifetime and income. We find that the welfare-maximizing income tax is less progressive in our model with endogenous longevity than in our model with exogenous longevity. In a highly stylized calibration of the US economy, we show that optimal tax progressivity is less than what prevails under the current US tax system. Our results are robust to the range of empirical labor supply elasticity and the assumptions of missing annuity markets and stochastic health. Our conclusion for the optimal progressivity of the US tax system can be altered by the adoption of a more egalitarian welfare function or by increases in prevailing levels of wage inequality.

10.2139/ssrn.3731988.abstractZh: 我们研究了内生寿命对最优税收累进性和不平等的影响，研究模型为具有技能异质性的重叠代模型。较高的税收累进性可以降低寿命差距和净收入不平等，但代价是平均寿命和收入降低。我们发现，在具有内生寿命的模型中，实现福利最大化的所得税累进性低于具有外生寿命的模型。在对美国经济进行高度简化的校准中，我们发现最优税收累进性低于当前美国税收制度下的水平。我们的研究结果不受实证劳动供给弹性范围以及缺失年金市场和随机健康假设的影响。对于美国税收制度的最优累进性，可以通过采用更平等的福利函数或提高当前存在的工资不平等程度来加以改变。

abstract.text: We study the effect of ageing, defined as an extra year of life, on health care utilisation. We disentangle the direct effect of ageing, from other alternative explanations such as the presence of comorbidities and endogenous time to death (TTD) that are argued to absorb the effect of ageing (so-called 'red herring' hypothesis). We exploit individual level end of life data from several European countries that record the use of medicine, outpatient and inpatient care and long-term care. Consistently with the 'red herring hypothesis', we find that corrected TTD estimates are significantly different from uncorrected ones, and their effect size exceeds that of an extra year of life, which in turn is moderated by individual comorbidities. Corrected estimates suggest an overall attenuated effect of ageing, which does not influence outpatient care utilisation. These results suggest the presence of 'more than one red herring' depending on the type of health care examined.

10.2139/ssrn.5242399.abstractZh: 我们研究了老龄化对医疗保健利用的影响，老龄化被定义为每多活一年。我们区分了老龄化的直接效应与其他可能的解释，例如合并症的存在和内生性死亡时间（TTD），这些因素被认为会抵消老龄化的影响（所谓的“红鲱鱼假说”）。我们利用几个欧洲国家的个人死亡末期数据，这些数据记录了药物使用、门诊和住院护理以及长期护理的情况。与“红鲱鱼假说”一致，我们发现修正后的死亡时间估计值与未修正值有显著不同，其效应大小超过了每多活一年的效应，而后者又受到个体合并症的调节。修正后的估计表明，老龄化的整体影响有所减弱，这并不影响门诊护理的利用。这些结果表明，根据所研究的医疗保健类型，可能存在“不止一个红鲱鱼因素”。

abstract.text: Some commentators estimate that up to a third of U.S. medical spending may be wasted. This study focuses on the decision to hospitalize elderly Medicare patients who present at the emergency room (ER) with respiratory conditions. Failing to hospitalize sick patients could have dire consequences. However, in addition to generating higher costs, unnecessary hospitalization puts patients at risk of hospital acquired conditions and disrupts their lives. We use variation in the patient’s nearest hospital’s propensity to admit patients with similar observable characteristics as an instrument for the admission decision. While OLS estimates suggest that admitted patients are more likely to die, when we instrument for patient admission we find that the marginal hospital admission increases the number of hospital days by seven days and increases charges by $42,000 but has no effect on the risk of death in the course of the next year. The marginal hospitalization also reduces the risk of another emergency department visit in the next 30 days but increases outpatient visits over the same time horizon with no overall impact on charges. Longer term effects also include increased outpatient visits but effects on patient costs and health outcomes over the next year are minimal. Overall, these results lend support to the argument that in many cases the marginal hospitalization is unnecessary.

10.3386/w26618.abstractZh: 一些评论员估计，美国高达三分之一的医疗支出可能被浪费。本研究重点关注将患有呼吸系统疾病的老年医疗保险患者送往医院的决定。未能将患病患者送入医院可能会带来严重的后果。然而，除了增加成本外，不必要的住院治疗还会使患者面临医院获得性疾病的风险，并扰乱他们的生活。我们采用患者所在医院接纳具有相似特征患者的倾向差异作为决策的工具。虽然普通最小二乘法估计表明，被接纳的患者更有可能死亡，但当我们使用这一工具进行实证研究时，我们发现边际住院会使住院天数增加七天，费用增加42,000美元，但对未来一年内的死亡风险没有影响。边际住院还降低了未来30天内再次前往急诊室的风险，但增加了同一时间段内的门诊就诊次数，总体上对费用没有影响。长期影响还包括增加门诊就诊次数，但对未来一年患者的成本和健康结果的影响很小。总体而言，这些结果支持这样的观点：在许多情况下，边际住院是不必要的。

abstract.text: Most existing evidence on the effectiveness of family leave policies comes from studies focusing on their impacts on affected families - mothers, fathers, and their children - without a clear understanding of the costs and effects on firms and coworkers. We estimate the effect of a female employee giving birth and taking parental leave on small firms and coworkers in Denmark. Using a dynamic difference-in-differences design, we compare small firms in which a female employee is about to give birth to an observationally equivalent sample of small firms with female employees who are not close to giving birth. Identification rests on a parallel trends assumption, which we substantiate through a set of natural validity checks. We find little evidence that parental leave take-up has negative effects on firms and coworkers overall. Specifically, after accounting for wage reimbursements received by firms offering paid leave, there are no measurable effects on firm output, labor costs, profitability or survival. Coworkers of the woman going on leave see temporary increases in their hours, earnings, and likelihood of being employed but experience no significant changes in well-being at work as proxied by sick days. These limited effects of parental leave reflect that most firms are very effective in compensating for the worker on leave by hiring temporary workers and by increasing other employees' hours. In contrast, we do find evidence that parental leave has negative effects on a small subsample of firms that are less able to use their existing employees to compensate for an absent worker.

10.3386/w26622.abstractZh: 目前关于家庭休假政策有效性的大多数证据都来自针对受影响家庭——母亲、父亲及其子女——的研究，但并未明确了解这些政策对企业和同事的成本与影响。我们估算了丹麦女性员工生育并休育儿假对小型企业和同事的影响。通过动态差异比较设计，我们将即将迎来女性员工生育的小型企业与那些女性员工尚未临近生育的小型企业进行了对比。我们的识别基于平行趋势假设，并通过一系列自然有效性检验进行了验证。我们发现，育儿假的实施总体上并未对企业和同事产生负面影响。具体来说，在考虑提供带薪休假的企业所获得的工资补偿后，企业产出、劳动力成本、盈利能力或生存能力均未出现可测量的影响。休假的女性的同事工作时间、收入以及就业可能性有所增加，但以病假天数作为工作幸福感指标时，并未出现显著变化。这些有限的育儿假影响表明，大多数企业在通过雇佣临时工或增加其他员工的工作时间来弥补休假员工的工作空缺方面非常有效。相比之下，我们确实发现，对于那些难以利用现有员工来弥补缺勤员工的小型企业来说，育儿假确实产生了负面影响。

abstract.text: This paper uses several large cross-sectional data sources and a new approach to show that a large and recurring temporary economic shock affecting young adults– entering the labor market in a recession – has dynamic effects on mortality by cause, family outcomes, morbidity, and various measures of economic success throughout the life-cycle until middle age. We find that cohorts coming of age during the deep recession of the early 1980s suffer increases in mortality that appear in their late 30s and further strengthen through age 50, driven by behavior-related causes such as heart disease, lung cancer, and liver disease, as well as drug overdoses. At the same time, unlucky middle-aged labor market entrants earn less and work more while receiving less welfare support and experiencing higher rates of work-related disability. They are also less likely to be married, more likely to be divorced, experience higher rates of childlessness, and have lower income spouses. We show the entire trajectories of these outcomes are affected in a way predicted by economic life-cycle models. This implies long-lasting and costly effects for the large number of individuals graduating in recessions.

10.3386/w26638.abstractZh: 本文利用多个大型横截面数据来源和新的研究方法，表明对年轻成年人而言，经济衰退期间发生的较大且反复出现的暂时性经济冲击，会对死亡率、家庭状况、发病率以及整个生命周期中的各种经济成功指标产生动态影响，直至中年阶段。我们发现，在20世纪80年代初期经济衰退期间成长起来的群体，其死亡率在30多岁时开始上升，并持续至50岁，这一趋势主要由与行为相关的因素驱动，如心脏病、肺癌、肝病以及药物过量等。与此同时，那些不幸进入劳动力市场的中年人，收入较低，工作时间较长，获得的福利支持较少，且工作相关的残疾率较高。他们结婚的可能性较低，离婚的可能性较高，无子女的比例较高，且配偶的收入较低。我们表明，这些结果的变化模式符合经济生命周期模型的预测。这意味着，在经济衰退期间毕业的众多个体将面临长期且昂贵的后果。

abstract.text: There is a well-established association between income and child health. We examine the Supplemental Security Income (SSI) program, which provides cash assistance to low-income children with disabilities, to assess how this relationship arises. We use a large database of Medicaid administrative records to estimate the causal effects of SSI receipt on children’s health, using a regression discontinuity design that exploits the rule that low-income children born below a birthweight threshold are automatically eligible for SSI. We find that children whose birthweights fall below the threshold are significantly more likely to be awarded SSI. Over the first 8 years of their lives, children with birthweights just below the threshold incur Medicaid expenditures 30% lower than do those born just above the threshold. They are less likely to be admitted to hospital, have shorter hospital stays when admitted, and use fewer specialist services. Eligible children experience reduced rates of diagnosis across a range of conditions, with significantly lower rates of both acute (infection, injury) and chronic (malnutrition, developmental delay) conditions in early life. SSI receipt delays the incidence of new chronic conditions by 1.7 months and reduces the number of new chronic conditions recorded through age 3 by 15%. Past health shocks significantly increase current healthcare utilization, but an interaction term between the SSI eligibility and past health shocks is not statistically significant, a pattern that suggests that increased income derived from SSI reduces the incidence of early health shocks but does not change how families respond to these shocks. Children receiving SSI are more likely to live in higher income neighborhoods mainly because their families are less likely to move out of better neighborhoods. However, we do not find evidence that children’s receipt of SSI affects their mother’s health or fertility. Reductions in Medicaid spending associated with SSI eligibility offset increased cash transfer payments by a ratio of 3.3:1.

10.3386/w26639.abstractZh: 收入与儿童健康之间存在明确的关联。我们研究了补充保障收入计划，该计划为低收入残疾儿童提供现金援助，以评估这种关系的形成机制。我们利用一个庞大的医疗补助行政记录数据库，通过回归不连续设计来估算获得补充保障收入对儿童健康的因果效应。这一设计利用了这样一个规则：出生体重低于一定阈值的低收入儿童自动有资格获得补充保障收入。研究发现，出生体重低于阈值的儿童获得补充保障收入的可能性显著更高。在他们生命的前8年里，出生体重略低于阈值的儿童在医疗补助支出方面比出生体重略高于阈值的儿童低30%。这些儿童住院的可能性较低，住院时间较短，且使用的专科服务较少。符合条件的儿童在多种疾病上的诊断率也较低，尤其是在早期生活中，急性疾病（如感染、受伤）和慢性疾病（如营养不良、发育迟缓）的诊断率都显著较低。获得补充保障收入可以推迟新慢性疾病的出现1.7个月，并将3岁前记录的新慢性疾病数量减少15%。过去的健康冲击会显著增加当前的医疗利用，但补充保障收入资格与过去健康冲击之间的交互项在统计上并不显著，这一模式表明，通过获得补充保障收入增加的收入可以降低早期健康冲击的发生，但不会改变家庭对这些冲击的反应。获得补充保障收入的儿童更有可能生活在收入较高的社区，主要是因为他们的家庭不太可能迁移到更好的社区。然而，我们没有发现证据表明儿童获得社会安全补助对母亲的健康或生育能力有影响。与获得社会安全补助相关的医疗补助支出减少，其效果相当于现金转移支付的3.3倍。

abstract.text: Racial differences in exposure to ambient air pollution have declined significantly in the United States over the past 20 years. This project links administrative Census microdata to newly available, spatially continuous high resolution measures of ambient particulate pollution (PM2.5) to examine the underlying causes and consequences of differences in Black-White pollution exposures. We begin by decomposing differences in pollution exposure into components explained by observable population characteristics (e.g., income) versus those that remain unexplained. We then use quantile regression methods to show that a significant portion of the “unexplained” convergence in Black-White pollution exposure can be attributed to differential impacts of the Clean Air Act (CAA) in African American and non-Hispanic White communities. Areas with larger Black populations saw greater CAA-related declines in PM2.5 exposure. We show that the CAA has been the single largest contributor to racial convergence in PM2.5 pollution exposure in the U.S. since 2000 accounting for over 60 percent of the reduction.

10.3386/w26659.abstractZh: 在过去20年里，美国黑人与白人在环境空气污染暴露方面的差异显著减少。本项目将行政人口普查微观数据与最新获得的、空间连续的高分辨率环境颗粒物污染（PM2.5）数据相结合，以研究黑人与白人污染暴露差异的根本原因和后果。我们首先将污染暴露的差异分解为可由可观测的人口特征（如收入）解释的部分，以及那些仍无法解释的部分。然后，我们使用分位数回归方法表明，黑人与白人污染暴露差异的显著部分可以归因于《清洁空气法》在非裔美国人和非西班牙裔白人社区中的不同影响。黑人群体较多的地区，与《清洁空气法》相关的PM2.5暴露水平下降幅度更大。研究表明，自2000年以来，《清洁空气法》是美国种族间PM2.5污染暴露差异减少的最大单一因素，其贡献率超过60%。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the economic consequences of being denied an abortion due to gestational limits. We link credit report data to the Turnaway Study, the first study to collect high-quality, longitudinal data on women receiving or being denied a wanted abortion in the United States. We compare financial outcomes over a ten-year period for women who had pregnancies just above and below a gestational age limit allowing for a wanted abortion. Outcome trajectories are similar for the two groups of women prior to the abortion encounter. Following the encounter, women who were denied an abortion experience a large increase in financial distress that is sustained for several years. There is also some evidence of a short-term reduction in credit access, but no change in measures of borrowing. Our results highlight important financial and economic consequences of restrictions on abortion access.

10.3386/w26662.abstractZh: 本文评估了因妊娠限制而被拒绝堕胎的经济后果。我们将信用报告数据与Turnaway研究相结合，该研究是首个收集关于美国女性接受或被拒绝堕胎的高质量纵向数据的研究。我们对比了在妊娠年龄限制上下，即允许和禁止堕胎的情况下，女性十年间的财务状况。在堕胎前，两组女性的结果轨迹相似。堕胎后，被拒绝堕胎的女性出现严重的财务困境，这种状况持续了数年。此外，也有证据表明短期内信用获取能力有所降低，但借款指标并未发生变化。我们的研究结果凸显了限制堕胎权利所带来的重要财务和经济后果。

abstract.text: This paper examines the role physical activity plays in determining body mass using data from the American Time Use Survey. Our work is the first to address the measurement error that arises when time use during a single day—rather than average daily time use over an extended period—is used as an explanatory variable. We show that failing to account for day-to-day variation in activities results in the effects of time use on a typical day being understated. Furthermore, we account for the possibility that physical activity and body mass are jointly determined by implementing Lewbel’s instrumental variables estimator that exploits first-stage heteroskedasticity rather than traditional exclusion restrictions. Our results suggest that, on average, physical activity reduces body mass by less than would be predicted by simple calorie expenditure-to-weight formulas, implying compensatory behavior such as increased caloric intake.

10.3386/w26670.abstractZh: 本文通过美国时间使用调查的数据，探讨了体力活动在决定体重中的作用。我们的研究首次关注了当仅使用单日时间使用数据——而非长期平均时间使用数据——作为解释变量时所产生的测量误差。我们发现，若不考虑日常活动的变化，时间使用对典型一天的影响会被低估。此外，我们通过采用Lewbel的工具变量估计方法，考虑了体力活动和体重之间的联合决定因素，该方法利用了第一阶段异方差性，而非传统的排除限制。我们的研究结果表明，平均而言，体力活动对体重的减少幅度小于简单的卡路里消耗与体重公式所预测的幅度，这表明存在补偿性行为，如增加卡路里摄入。

abstract.text: We analyze wartime prosthetic device patents to investigate how procurement policy affects the cost, quality, and quantity of medical innovation. Analyzing whether inventions emphasize cost and/or quality requires generating new data. We do this by first hand-coding the economic traits emphasized in 1,200 patent documents. We then train a machine learning algorithm and apply the trained models to a century's worth of medical and mechanical patents that form our analysis sample. In our analysis of these new data, we find that the relatively stingy, fixed-price contracts of the Civil War era led inventors to focus broadly on reducing costs, while the less cost-conscious procurement contracts of World War I did not. We provide a conceptual framework that highlights the economic forces that drive this key finding. We also find that inventors emphasized dimensions of product quality (e.g., a prosthetic's appearance or comfort) that aligned with differences in buyers' preferences across wars. Finally, we find that the Civil War and World War I procurement shocks led to substantial increases in the quantity of prosthetic device patenting relative to patenting in other medical and mechanical technology classes. We conclude that procurement environments can significantly shape the scientific problems with which inventors engage, including the choice to innovate on quality or cost.

10.3386/w26679.abstractZh: 我们分析了战时假肢设备的专利，以研究采购政策如何影响医疗创新的成本、质量和数量。要分析发明是否注重成本和/或质量，需要生成新的数据。我们首先对1,200份专利文件中强调的经济特征进行了手工编码。然后，我们训练了一个机器学习算法，并将这些训练好的模型应用于一个世纪以来形成的医疗和机械专利样本。通过对这些新数据的分析，我们发现，内战时期相对吝啬、固定价格的合同促使发明者广泛关注降低成本，而第一次世界大战中不太注重成本的采购合同则没有这样做。我们提供了一个概念框架，强调了推动这一关键发现的经济力量。我们还发现，发明者强调的产品质量维度（例如假肢的外观或舒适性）与不同战争时期购买者的偏好差异相一致。最后，我们发现，内战和第一次世界大战的采购冲击导致假肢设备专利的数量相对于其他医疗和机械技术领域的专利数量有了显著增长。我们得出结论，采购环境可以显著影响发明者所面临的科学问题，包括选择在质量还是成本上进行创新。

abstract.text: We investigate the relationship between college openings, college attainment, and health behaviors and outcomes later in life. Though a large prior literature attempts to isolate the causal effect of education on health via instrumental variables (IV), most studies use instruments that affect schooling behavior in childhood or adolescence, i.e. before the college enrollment decision. Our paper examines whether an increase in 2 and 4-year institutions per capita (“college accessibility”) in a state contributes to higher college attainment and better health later in life. Using 1980-2015 Census and American Community Survey data, we find consistent evidence that accessibility of public 2-year institutions positively affects schooling attainment and subsequent employment and earnings levels among whites but not among people of color. We then examine how public 2-year accessibility affects twenty health behaviors and outcomes in adulthood by employing restricted-use 1984-2015 National Health Interview Survey data. Only self-reported health is significantly affected by college accessibility among all (white) individuals. Among older men, however, college accessibility has a protective effect on several additional outcomes, including smoking behavior, exercise, the probability of a stroke or heart attack, and mortality.

10.3386/w26685.abstractZh: 我们研究了大学入学机会、大学教育程度与日后健康行为及健康结果之间的关系。尽管大量先前的研究试图通过工具变量来分离教育对健康的因果效应，但大多数研究所使用的工具变量会影响儿童或青少年时期的学校教育行为，即大学入学决策之前的行为。我们的论文探讨了在一个州内，每千人拥有2年和4年制大学的数量增加是否有助于提高大学教育程度以及日后的健康水平。利用1980-2015年的人口普查数据和美国社区调查数据，我们发现公共2年制大学的可及性对白人的教育程度、就业状况及收入水平有积极影响，但对有色人种则没有这种影响。随后，我们利用1984-2015年的全国健康访谈调查数据，研究了公共2年制大学的可及性如何影响成年后的二十种健康行为及健康结果。结果显示，在所有白人个体中，自我报告的健康状况受到大学可及性的显著影响。然而，在年龄较大的男性中，大学可及性对多种健康行为及结果具有保护作用，包括吸烟行为、锻炼、中风或心脏病发作的概率以及死亡率。

abstract.text: China introduced its stringent family planning policies from the early 1970s, known as the "Later, Longer, Fewer" policies, and followed it with the One-Child Policy from 1979. The number of children born to Chinese parents significantly decreased from 5.7 in late 1960s to 2.5 in 1988. In Chen and Fang (2019), we show that family planning policies have drastically different effects on elderly parents' physical and mental well-beings. Whereas parents more exposed to the family planning policies consume more and enjoy slightly better physical health status, they report more severe depression symptoms. In this paper, we present a more complete picture of the difference in mental health among residents in rural and urban areas, between males and females, between different education groups, between those with one child and those with more than one children, and between widowed and non-widowed. We highlight the role of family support (from children and spouse) for the mental health status among the elderly Chinese.

10.3386/w26690.abstractZh: 中国自20世纪70年代初开始实施严格的计划生育政策，被称为“晚婚、晚育、少生”政策，并于1979年推行了一孩政策。中国父母生育子女的数量从20世纪60年代末的5.7人显著减少到1988年的2.5人。陈和方在2019年的研究中指出，计划生育政策对老年父母的身心健康产生了截然不同的影响。那些更频繁受到计划生育政策影响的父母，虽然物质生活状况稍好，但抑郁症状却更为严重。本文进一步揭示了农村与城市地区居民之间、男女之间、不同教育背景群体之间、一孩家庭与多孩家庭之间，以及丧偶与非丧偶家庭之间在心理健康方面的差异。我们强调了家庭支持（来自子女和配偶）对老年中国人心理健康状况的重要性。

abstract.text: Effects of the minimum wage on labor market outcomes have been extensively debated and analyzed. Less studied, however, are other consequences of the minimum wage that stem from changes in a household’s income and labor supply. We examine the effects of the minimum wage on child health. To obtain estimates, we use data from the National Survey of Children’s Health in conjunction with a difference-in-differences research design. We find that an increase in the minimum wage throughout childhood is associated with a significant improvement in child health. A particularly interesting finding is that much of the benefits of a higher minimum wage are associated with the period between birth and age five.

10.3386/w26691.abstractZh: 关于最低工资对劳动力市场结果的影响已经进行了广泛讨论和分析。然而，较少研究的是最低工资对家庭收入和劳动力供应变化所带来的其他影响。我们研究了最低工资对儿童健康的影响。为了获得估计结果，我们使用了《全国儿童健康调查》的数据，并结合了差异-差异研究设计。我们发现，儿童时期最低工资的提高与儿童健康的显著改善有关。一个特别有趣的发现是，较高最低工资带来的诸多好处主要体现在出生到五岁这段时间内。

abstract.text: We provide the first quasi-experimental evidence on the relationship between cigarette taxes and sexual minority adult smoking by studying individuals in same-sex households (a large share of whom are in same-sex romantic relationships) from the 1996-2018 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System. We find that cigarette taxes significantly reduced smoking among men and women in same-sex households, and the effects we find for men in same-sex households are significantly larger than the associated effects for men in different-sex households (the vast majority of whom are heterosexual married/partnered men). This result suggests that the sizable disparities in adult smoking rates between heterosexual and sexual minority men would have been even larger in the absence of stricter tobacco control policy. In line with previous research indicating that cigarette taxes have ‘lost their bite’, we find no significant relationship between cigarette taxes and sexual minority smoking in more recent years.

10.3386/w26692.abstractZh: 我们首次通过准实验方法，研究了香烟税与性少数群体成年人吸烟行为之间的关系。研究对象为1996年至2018年间《行为风险因素监测系统》中的同性家庭中的个体（其中大部分处于同性恋爱关系）。研究发现，香烟税显著降低了同性家庭中男女的吸烟率，且同性家庭中男性吸烟率的降低幅度明显大于异性家庭中男性吸烟率的降低幅度（异性家庭中绝大多数为异性婚姻或伴侣关系中的男性）。这一结果表明，如果没有更严格的烟草控制政策，异性恋者与性少数群体男性之间的吸烟率差异将会更大。与以往研究表明香烟税的效果已减弱相一致，我们发现近年来香烟税与性少数群体吸烟行为之间并没有显著关系。

abstract.text: Anecdotal reports and small-scale studies suggest that elections are stressful, and might lead to a deterioration in voters’ mental well-being. Nonetheless, researchers have yet to establish whether elections actually make people sick, and if so, why. By applying a regression discontinuity design to administrative health care claims from Taiwan, we determine that elections increased health care use and expense only during legally specified campaign periods by as much as 19%. Overall, the treatment cost of illness caused by elections exceeded publicly reported levels of campaign expenditure, and accounted for 2% of total national health care costs during the campaign period.

10.3386/w26697.abstractZh: 一些传闻报道和小规模研究表明，选举过程可能会给选民带来压力，并可能导致他们的心理健康状况恶化。然而，研究人员尚未确定选举是否真的会导致人们生病，如果确实如此，原因何在。通过对台湾的行政医疗报销数据进行回归不连续分析，我们发现选举仅在法律规定的竞选期间增加了医疗服务的使用量和费用，增幅高达19%。总体而言，选举导致的疾病治疗费用超过了公开报道的竞选支出水平，在竞选期间占全国医疗总费用的2%。

abstract.text: Starting in 1982, the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend allows each full-time resident in Alaska, including infants born in the qualifying year, to receive a sizable dividend. This dividend, which represents a form of a Universal Basic Income on a small scale, could alter incentives surrounding fertility. Using synthetic control and difference-in-differences models to account for confounding factors and unobserved heterogeneity, we model the effect of income on fertility by exploiting this income shock around 1982 using Natality files from Vital Statistics and abortion data from the Centers for Disease Control, merged with data from the Census on various state characteristics. Primary results suggest that the dividend increased fertility and reduced the spacing between births, particularly for females in the 20-44 year age group. Our results suggest that policies aimed at increasing income should consider fertility consequences and their implications for economic growth.

10.3386/w26712.abstractZh: 自1982年起，阿拉斯加永久基金股息允许阿拉斯加的每位全职居民，包括在该年出生的婴儿，获得可观的股息。这种股息实际上是一种小型的普遍基本收入，可能会改变与生育相关的激励机制。我们通过合成控制和差异-差异模型来考虑混杂因素和未观察到的异质性，利用1982年左右的收入冲击数据，结合《生命统计》中的出生数据以及疾病控制中心的堕胎数据，以及人口普查中的各种州特征数据，来模拟收入对生育的影响。主要结果表明，股息增加了生育率，并缩短了出生间隔，尤其是在20-44岁年龄段的女性中。我们的研究结果表明，旨在增加收入的政策应当考虑生育后果及其对经济增长的影响。

abstract.text: The last 40 years have seen huge innovations in computing technology and data availability. Data derived from millions of administrative records or by using (as we do) new methods of data generation such as text mining are now common. New data often requires new methods, which in turn can inspire new data collection. If history is any guide, some methods will stick and others will prove to be a flash in the pan. However, the larger trends towards demanding greater credibility and transparency from researchers in applied economics and a “collage” approach to assembling evidence will likely continue.

10.3386/w26715.abstractZh: 过去40年，计算技术和数据获取方式取得了巨大创新。如今，从数百万行政记录中获取数据，或使用文本挖掘等新的数据生成方法，已成为常态。新的数据往往需要新的处理方法，而这些方法反过来又能激发新的数据收集方式。如果以历史为鉴，有些方法会长期沿用，而另一些则可能只是昙花一现。不过，对于应用经济学领域的研究人员来说，对更高可信度和透明度的需求，以及采用“拼贴”方式整合证据的趋势，很可能会持续下去。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of e-cigarette tax rates on e-cigarette prices, e-cigarette sales, and sales of other tobacco products using NielsenIQ Retail Scanner data from 2013 to 2019. We find that 90% of e-cigarette taxes are passed on to consumer retail prices. We then estimate reduced form and instrumental variables regressions to examine the effects of e-cigarette and cigarette taxes and prices on sales. We calculate an e-cigarette own-price elasticity of -2.2 and particularly large elasticity of demand for flavored e-cigarettes. Further, we document a cigarette own-price elasticity of -0.4 and positive cross-price elasticities of demand between e-cigarettes and cigarettes, suggesting economic substitution.

10.3386/w26724.abstractZh: 我们使用NielsenIQ零售扫描仪的数据，从2013年到2019年，对电子烟税税率对电子烟价格、电子烟销售以及其他烟草产品销售的影响进行了估算。研究发现，90%的电子烟税被转嫁到了消费者零售价格上。随后，我们通过减少形式和工具变量回归来研究电子烟和香烟的税税率对销售的影响。我们计算出电子烟的自身价格弹性为-2.2，而调味电子烟的需求弹性尤其大。此外，我们还发现香烟的自身价格弹性为-0.4，并且电子烟和香烟之间存在正向的替代关系，这表明存在经济上的替代现象。

abstract.text: A host of different factors affect health and longevity, ranging from genetic endowments to public policy. Physicians have a substantial influence on patients’ health and health-related costs, but we know little about the extent of this influence beyond clinical decisions such as adequate diagnosis and treatment. This paper demonstrates that the health management styles of primary care physicians significantly affect the health outcomes of their patients. Using data on the population of statin users in Denmark and matching patients to their primary care physicians, we show that the physician’s ability to facilitate adherence with prescription medications has significant positive effects on patient outcomes and health costs even after controlling for observable and unobservable patient characteristics. Policy interventions aimed at improving this aspect of physicians’ health management styles have important implications for patient outcomes and health care costs.

10.3386/w26735.abstractZh: 众多不同的因素影响着健康和寿命，从遗传禀赋到公共政策都有影响。医生对患者的健康和与健康相关的成本有着显著的影响，但我们对这种影响的程度了解甚少，除了临床决策如正确的诊断和治疗之外。本文表明，初级保健医生的健康管理风格对其患者的健康结果有着显著的影响。通过丹麦他汀类药物使用者的人口数据，并将患者与其初级保健医生进行匹配，我们发现，即使在控制了可观察和不可观察的患者特征之后，医生在促进患者遵守处方药物方面的能力仍然对患者的健康和成本有显著的积极影响。旨在改善医生健康管理风格这一方面的政策干预，对患者的结果和医疗保健成本具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Risk-adjustment systems used to pay health plans in individual health insurance markets have evolved towards better “fit” of payments to plan spending, at the individual and group levels, generally achieved by adding variables used for risk adjustment. Adding variables demands further plan and provider-supplied data. Some data called for in the more complex systems may be easily manipulated by providers, leading to unintended “upcoding” or to unnecessary service utilization. While these drawbacks are recognized, they are hard to quantify and are difficult to balance against the concrete, measurable improvements in fit that may be attained by adding variables to the formula. This paper takes a different approach to improving the performance of health plan payment systems. Using the HHS-HHC V0519 model of plan payment in the Marketplaces as a starting point, we constrain fit at the individual and group level to be as good or better than the current payment model while reducing the number of variables called for in the model. Opportunities for simplification are created by the introduction of three elements in design of plan payment: reinsurance (based on high spending or plan losses), constrained regressions, and powerful machine learning methods for variable selection. We first drop all variables relying on drug claims. Further major reductions in the number of diagnostic-based risk adjustors are possible using machine learning integrated with our constrained regressions. The fit performance of our simpler alternatives is as good or better than the current HHS-HHC V0519 formula.

10.3386/w26736.abstractZh: 在个人健康保险市场中，用于支付健康计划费用的风险调整系统已经发展得更加完善，能够更精准地匹配支付与计划支出。这一改进通常是通过增加用于风险调整的各种变量来实现的。然而，增加变量需要计划方和医疗服务提供者提供更多的数据。一些复杂系统中所需的这些数据可能会被医疗服务提供者轻易操纵，从而导致不必要的“过度编码”或不必要的服务利用。尽管这些缺点已被认识到，但它们很难量化，也难以与通过增加变量来提升的、可测量的效果相平衡。本文采用了一种不同的方法来改善健康计划支付系统的性能。以HHS-HHC V0519模型作为起点，我们力求在个人和群体层面实现与当前支付模式相当甚至更好的匹配效果，同时减少模型中所需的变量数量。通过引入三个要素，我们可以简化设计：再保险（基于高支出或计划损失）、受限回归以及强大的机器学习方法用于变量选择。我们首先排除了所有依赖于药物索赔的变量。通过结合机器学习与受限回归技术，可以进一步大幅减少基于诊断的风险调整因素的数量。我们提出的简化方案在性能上至少与当前的HHS-HHC V0519公式相当甚至更好。

abstract.text: The urban poor in developing countries face challenging living environments, which may interfere with good sleep. Using actigraphy to measure sleep objectively, we find that low-income adults in Chennai, India sleep only 5.5 hours per night on average despite spending 8 hours in bed. Their sleep is highly interrupted, with sleep efficiency—sleep per time in bed—comparable to those with disorders such as sleep apnea or insomnia. A randomized three-week treatment providing information, encouragement, and improvements to home sleep environments increased sleep duration by 27 minutes per night by inducing more time in bed. Contrary to expert predictions and a large body of sleep research, increased nighttime sleep had no detectable effects on cognition, productivity, decision-making, or well-being, and led to small decreases in labor supply. In contrast, short afternoon naps at the workplace improved an overall index of outcomes by 0.12 standard deviations, with significant increases in productivity, psychological well-being, and cognition, but a decrease in work time.

10.3386/w26746.abstractZh: 发展中国家的城市贫困人口面临着恶劣的生活环境，这可能会干扰良好的睡眠。通过活动记录法客观测量睡眠情况，我们发现印度钦奈的低收入成年人每晚平均只睡5.5小时，尽管他们躺在床上8小时。他们的睡眠被频繁打断，睡眠效率——即每单位时间内实际的睡眠时间——与患有睡眠呼吸暂停或失眠等疾病的人相当。一项为期三周的随机治疗实验，通过提供信息、鼓励措施以及改善家庭睡眠环境，使每晚的睡眠时间增加了27分钟。与专家预测和大量睡眠研究的结果相反，夜间睡眠时间的增加并未对认知、生产力、决策能力或幸福感产生可检测的影响，反而导致劳动力供应略有减少。相比之下，在工作场所进行短暂的午后小憩，使整体结果指标提高了0.12个标准差，生产力、心理幸福感和认知能力均有显著提升，但工作时间有所减少。

abstract.text: Prescription opioid use among women of reproductive age and pregnant women is relatively common. In this article, we examine whether state opioid control policies affected prescription opioid use and, in turn, infant health and maternal behaviors. We conduct several types of analyses including reduced form analyses of the effect of state policies on infant health and maternal behaviors, and instrumental variables analyses of the effects of prescription opioid use on infant health and maternal behaviors. Results from our analysis suggest that reductions in prescription opioid use because of state prescription opioid control policies have improved infant health modestly at the population level with larger implied effects at the individual level.

10.3386/w26749.abstractZh: 在育龄妇女和孕妇中，处方阿片类药物的使用相对普遍。本文探讨了州级阿片类药物管控政策是否影响了处方阿片类药物的使用，进而影响了婴儿健康和母亲的行为。我们进行了多种类型的分析，包括利用降维分析来研究州级政策对婴儿健康和母亲行为的影响，以及利用工具变量分析来研究处方阿片类药物使用对婴儿健康和母亲行为的影响。分析结果表明，由于州级处方阿片类药物管控政策的实施，处方阿片类药物的使用有所减少，这在人群层面使婴儿健康得到了适度改善，而在个体层面则产生了更大的影响。

abstract.text: In a pervasive but controversial practice, drug firms frequently make monetary or in-kind payments to physicians in the course of promoting prescription drugs. We use a federal database on the universe of such payments between 2013 and 2015 linked to prescribing behavior in Medicare Part D. We account for the targeting of payments with fixed effects for each physician-drug combination. In an event study, we show that physicians increase prescribing of drugs for which they receive payments in the months just after payment receipt, with no evidence of differential trends between paid and unpaid physicians prior to the payment. Next, we examine five case studies of major drugs going off patent. Physicians receiving payments from the firms experiencing the patent expiry transition their patients just as quickly to generics as physicians who do not receive such payments. In addition, using hand-collected efficacy data on three major therapeutic classes, we show that drug quality is largely unaffected by the receipt of payments.

10.3386/w26751.abstractZh: 在一种普遍但存在争议的做法中，制药公司经常在推广处方药的过程中向医生支付金钱或实物。我们利用一个联邦数据库，该数据库记录了2013年至2015年间与Medicare Part D处方行为相关的此类支付情况。我们通过固定效应模型来研究支付对象的针对性问题。在事件研究中，我们发现医生在收到支付后的几个月内会增加相关药物的处方量，而在支付之前，有支付和无支付的医生之间并没有明显的差异。接下来，我们研究了五种主要药物专利到期的案例。接受公司支付的医生将患者迅速转向使用仿制药，这一转变速度与未收到此类支付的医生相同。此外，通过手工收集的三大类治疗药物的疗效数据，我们发现药物的品质在收到支付后基本没有受到影响。

abstract.text: New ideas no longer fuel economic growth the way they once did. A popular explanation for stagnation is that good ideas are harder to find, rendering slowdown inevitable. We present a simple model of the lifecycle of scientific ideas that points to changes in scientist incentives as the cause of scientific stagnation. Over the last five decades, citations have become the dominant way to evaluate scientific contributions and scientists. This emphasis on citations in the measurement of scientific productivity shifted scientist rewards and behavior on the margin toward incremental science and away from exploratory projects that are more likely to fail, but which are the fuel for future breakthroughs. As attention given to new ideas decreased, science stagnated. We also explore ways to broaden how scientific productivity is measured and rewarded, involving both academic search engines such as Google Scholar measuring which contributions explore newer ideas and university administrators and funding agencies utilizing these new metrics in research evaluation. We demonstrate empirically that measures of novelty are correlated with but distinct from measures of scientific impact, which suggests that if also novelty metrics were utilized in scientist evaluation, scientists might pursue more innovative, riskier, projects.

10.3386/w26752.abstractZh: 新的想法不再像过去那样推动经济增长。一个常见的解释是，好的想法越来越难以找到，这使得经济增长放缓成为必然。我们提出了一个关于科学思想生命周期的简单模型，指出科学家激励机制的变化是科学停滞的原因。在过去的五十年里，引用次数已成为评估科学贡献和科学家表现的主要方式。这种对引用次数的重视使得科学家的奖励和行为更倾向于渐进性的科学研究，而远离那些更可能失败但却是未来突破的探索性项目。随着对新想法的关注减少，科学陷入了停滞。我们还探讨了如何改进科学生产力的衡量和奖励方式，包括使用学术搜索引擎如Google Scholar来评估哪些贡献探索了新想法，以及大学管理者和资助机构如何在研究评估中运用这些新指标。我们通过实证数据表明，新颖性指标与科学影响力指标之间存在相关性，但又有区别。这意味着，如果在科学家评估中同时采用新颖性指标，科学家可能会更倾向于开展更具创新性、风险更高的项目。

abstract.text: The objective of this study is to use data from the National Survey of Children with Special Health Care Needs (NS-CSHCN) to test whether Medicaid physician fees are correlated with access to health services and adequacy of insurance coverage among CSHCN. We use a difference-in-differences method, comparing the effects of Medicaid physician fees on outcomes of publicly-insured children in states that raised fees vs. in states that did not. We also consider a triple difference specification using privately-insured children as the comparison group. Our findings indicate that raising the Medicaid primary care fee level close to at least 90 percent of the Medicare level reduces the likelihood that publicly-insured CSHCN lack a usual source of care in a doctor’s office by about 15 percent. Fee increases are also associated with improved access to specialty doctor care, and large improvements in caregivers’ satisfaction with the adequacy of health insurance coverage, among publicly-insured CSHCN. Results for some other access measures, such as global measures of having difficulties and delays accessing services, were mixed.

10.3386/w26769.abstractZh: 本研究旨在利用《全国特殊健康需求儿童调查》的数据，来检验医疗补助医生费用是否与特殊健康需求儿童获得医疗服务的情况以及保险覆盖的充足性有关。我们采用了差异-差异方法，比较了在提高费用水平的州与未提高费用水平的州中，医疗补助医生费用对公共保险儿童结果的影响。我们还考虑了使用私人保险儿童作为对照组的三重差异模型。研究发现，将医疗补助初级保健费用提高到至少达到医疗保险费用的90%，可以将公共保险特殊健康需求儿童在医生办公室缺乏常规就诊机会的可能性降低约15%。费用增加还与获得专科医生服务的改善以及公共保险特殊健康需求儿童对保险覆盖充足性的满意度提高有关。然而，对于其他一些获取服务的衡量指标，如整体获取服务的困难和延迟情况，研究结果则较为复杂。

abstract.text: Since Wakefield et al. (1998), the public was exposed to mixed information surrounding the claim that measles-mumps-rubella vaccine causes autism. A persistent trend to delay the vaccination during 1998–2011 in the US was driven by children of college-educated mothers, suggesting that these mothers held biases against the vaccine influenced by the early unfounded claim. Consistent with confirmatory bias, exposures to negative information about the vaccine strengthened their biases more than exposures to positive information attenuated them. Positive online information, however, had strong impacts on vaccination decisions, suggesting that online dissemination of vaccine-safety information may help tackle the sticky misinformation.

10.3386/w26772.abstractZh: 自Wakefield等人（1998年）的研究以来，公众对于麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹疫苗导致自闭症的说法产生了混合性的信息认知。在1998年至2011年期间，美国出现了一个持续的趋势，即儿童在大学教育背景的母亲家庭中推迟接种疫苗，这表明这些母亲受到早期无根据的说法的影响，对疫苗持有偏见。与确认性偏见一致的是，关于疫苗的负面信息会强化她们的偏见，而正面信息则有助于减轻这些偏见。然而，正面的在线信息对疫苗接种决策有着显著的影响，这表明在线传播疫苗安全信息可能有助于解决这些顽固的错误信息问题。

abstract.text: Ten years ago, donors committed $1.5 billion to a pilot Advance Market Commitment (AMC) to help purchase pneumococcal vaccine for low-income countries. The AMC aimed to encourage the development of such vaccines, ensure distribution to children in low-income countries, and pilot the AMC mechanism for possible future use. Three vaccines have been developed and more than 150 million children immunized, saving an estimated 700,000 lives. This paper reviews the economic logic behind AMCs, the experience with the pilot, and key issues for future AMCs.

10.3386/w26775.abstractZh: 十年前，捐助方承诺投入15亿美元用于一项试点性的市场承诺计划，以帮助低收入国家购买肺炎球菌疫苗。该计划旨在促进此类疫苗的研发，确保这些疫苗能够分发到低收入国家的儿童手中，并为未来可能的市场承诺机制提供试点经验。目前已有三种疫苗被研发出来，超过1.5亿儿童因此获得了免疫接种，估计挽救了70万人的生命。本文回顾了市场承诺计划背后的经济逻辑、试点项目的经验以及未来市场承诺计划面临的关键问题。

abstract.text: The CDC reports that the association between bullying and suicides among teenagers has generated “concern, even panic,” but polices aimed at combatting bullying have received little attention from researchers. Using a difference-in-differences estimation strategy, we find that state-level anti-bullying laws (ABLs) reduce bullying victimization, depression and suicidal ideation, with the largest estimated effects for female teenagers and teenagers who identify as lesbian, gay, bisexual, or questioning. In addition, ABLs are associated with a 13-16 percent reduction in the suicide rate of female 14- through 18-year-olds. Event-study analyses and falsification tests provide evidence that these estimates can be interpreted causally.

10.3386/w26777.abstractZh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心报告称，欺凌行为与青少年自杀之间的关联引发了“担忧，甚至恐慌”，但针对欺凌行为的政策却很少受到研究人员的关注。通过差异-差异估计方法，我们发现州级反欺凌法律能够减少欺凌受害、抑郁情绪以及自杀念头，其中对女性青少年以及自认为是女同性恋、男同性恋、双性恋或性取向不确定的青少年的影响最为显著。此外，反欺凌法律还使14至18岁女性青少年的自杀率降低了13%至16%。事件研究分析和虚假测试表明，这些估计结果可以具有因果关系。

abstract.text: Driving while intoxicated causes many traffic accidents and deaths. Two decisions are closely related, whether to engage in heavy drinking, and to drive, conditional on heavy drinking. This paper reviews the extensive literature on heavy drinking, addiction, and driving after heavy drinking. Relevant public policies involve a combination of deterrence, incapacitation, and treatment. While there is empirical support for the rational addiction model applied to heavy drinking, some attributes of drinker-drivers differ from others (e.g., impulsivity in domains other than alcohol consumption, hyperbolic discounting). Policies most effective in reducing drinking and driving are alcohol excise taxes, minimum drinking age and zero tolerance laws for underage persons, dram shop and social host liability, and criminal sanctions overall. Empirical studies have not determined which specific criminal sanctions are most effective. A major impediment to criminal sanctions as a deterrent is that the probability of being stopped/arrested when driving while intoxicated is extremely low, < 0.01 to 0.02 at most, further reduced by probability of conviction/sentencing following stop/arrest far below 1. Incarceration lengths tend to be too short to incapacitate people from drinking and driving. Alcohol treatment’s effectiveness is limited by low treatment rates among persons for whom treatment is appropriate.

10.3386/w26779.abstractZh: 酒后驾车会导致许多交通事故和死亡事故。两个决定密切相关：是否进行大量饮酒，以及在饮酒条件下是否驾车。本文回顾了关于大量饮酒、成瘾以及饮酒后的驾驶行为的广泛文献。相关的公共政策包括威慑、限制驾驶资格和治疗措施的结合。虽然对于大量饮酒行为适用的理性成瘾模型有实证支持，但饮酒驾驶者的一些特征与其他人不同（例如，在酒精消费之外的领域表现出冲动性，以及 hyperbolic discounting）。在减少酒驾方面最有效的政策包括酒精消费税、最低饮酒年龄规定、针对未成年人的零容忍法律、 dram shop 和社会主办者责任制度，以及整体上的刑事制裁。实证研究尚未确定哪种具体的刑事制裁最为有效。将刑事制裁作为威慑手段的一个主要障碍是，酒后驾车的被拦截/逮捕的概率极低，通常在 0.01% 到 0.02% 之间，而且被捕后被判刑/判刑的概率也远低于 1%。监禁期限通常太短，无法使人们停止酒后驾车。酒精治疗的效力受到治疗对象中治疗率较低的限制。

abstract.text: The spillover effect of cigarette taxes on youth marijuana use has been the subject of intense public debate. Opponents of cigarette taxes warn that tax hikes will cause youths to substitute toward marijuana. On the other hand, public health experts often claim that because tobacco is a “gateway” drug, higher cigarette taxes will deter youth marijuana use. Using data from the National and State Youth Risk Behavior Surveys (YRBS) for the period 1991-2017, we explore the relationship between state excise taxes on cigarettes and teen marijuana use. In general, our results fail to support either of the above hypotheses. Rather, we find little evidence to suggest that teen marijuana use is sensitive to changes in the state cigarette tax. This null result holds for the sample period where cigarette taxes are observed to have the largest effect on teen cigarette use and across a number of demographic groups in the data. Finally, we find preliminary evidence that the recent adoption of state e-cigarette taxes is associated with a reduction in youth marijuana use.

10.3386/w26780.abstractZh: 香烟税对青少年大麻使用的影响一直是公众热议的话题。反对香烟税的人警告说，税收增加会导致青少年转向使用大麻。另一方面，公共卫生专家通常认为，由于烟草是一种“入门毒品”，更高的香烟税可以抑制青少年使用大麻的行为。我们利用1991年至2017年间全国及各州青少年风险行为调查的数据，探讨了各州香烟消费税与青少年大麻使用之间的关系。总体而言，我们的研究结果并不支持上述任何一种假设。相反，我们发现几乎没有证据表明青少年大麻使用对州级香烟税的变化有敏感反应。这一无显著性结果在香烟税对青少年香烟使用影响最大的样本期间以及数据的多个人口统计群体中均得到了验证。最后，我们发现了初步证据，表明最近各州对电子烟征税的采用与青少年大麻使用率的下降有关。

abstract.text: Unlike physical capital, human capital has both embodied and disembodied dimensions. It can be perceived of as skill and acquired knowledge, but also as knowledge spillover effects between overlapping generations and across different skill groups within and across countries. We illustrate the roles these characteristics play in the process of economic development; the relation between income growth and income and fertility distributions; and the relevance of human capital in determining the skill distribution of immigrants in a balanced-growth global equilibrium setting. In all three illustrations, knowledge spillover effects play a key role. The analysis offers new insights for understanding the decline in fertility below population replacement rate in many developed countries; the evolution of income and fertility distributions across developing and developed countries; and the often asymmetric effects that endogenous immigration flows and their skill composition exert on the long-term net benefits from immigration to natives in source and destination countries.

10.3386/w26810.abstractZh: 与物质资本不同，人力资本具有实体化和非实体化的双重特征。它可以被视为技能和获得的知识，同时也可以是不同世代之间以及国家内部不同技能群体之间的知识溢出效应。我们阐述了这些特征在经济发展过程中的作用；收入增长与收入与生育分布之间的关系；以及在均衡的全球化背景下，人力资本对移民技能分布的影响。在这三个例子中，知识溢出效应都起着关键作用。这一分析为理解许多发达国家生育率低于人口替代率的现象、发展中国家和发达国家之间收入和生育分布的演变，以及内生性移民流动及其技能构成对移民对原籍国和目的地国本地人长期净收益的影响提供了新的见解。

abstract.text: Bans on menthol cigarettes have been recommended by the World Health Organization, adopted throughout the European Union, and proposed by the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA), primarily due to concerns that menthol cigarettes enable youth smoking. Yet there is almost no direct evidence on their effects using real-world policy variation. We provide the first comprehensive evaluation of this policy by studying Canada where seven provinces banned menthol cigarettes prior to a nationwide menthol ban in 2018. Using provincial sales data, we show that menthol cigarette sales fell to zero immediately after menthol bans, with no meaningful effect on non-menthol sales. Survey data confirm that provincial menthol bans significantly reduced menthol cigarette smoking among both youths and adults. We also find strong evidence of substitution, however: provincial menthol bans significantly increased non-menthol cigarette smoking among youths, resulting in no overall net change in youth smoking rates. We also document evidence of evasion: provincial menthol bans shifted smokers’ cigarette purchases away from grocery stores and gas stations to First Nations reserves (where the menthol bans do not bind). Our results demonstrate the importance of accounting for substitution and evasion responses in the design of stricter tobacco regulations.

10.3386/w26811.abstractZh: 世界卫生组织建议禁止薄荷香烟，欧盟各国也采纳了这一建议，美国食品药品监督管理局也提出了类似建议，主要出于对薄荷香烟导致青少年吸烟的担忧。然而，关于这些政策实际效果的直接证据几乎不存在。我们通过研究加拿大的情况，首次对这一政策进行了全面评估。在2018年全国范围内禁止薄荷香烟之前，加拿大七个省份已经实施了薄荷香烟禁令。根据省级销售数据，我们发现薄荷香烟的销量在禁令实施后立即降至零，对非薄荷香烟的销量则没有显著影响。调查数据也证实，省级薄荷香烟禁令显著减少了青少年和成年人之间的薄荷香烟使用量。然而，我们还发现了强烈的替代现象：省级薄荷香烟禁令显著增加了青少年对非薄荷香烟的购买量，但总体上并未改变青少年的吸烟率。此外，我们还发现了一种逃避行为：省级薄荷香烟禁令使得吸烟者将香烟购买行为从杂货店和加油站转移到了原住民保留地（这些地方不受薄荷香烟禁令的约束）。我们的研究结果表明，在制定更严格的烟草法规时，必须考虑替代和逃避行为的影响。

abstract.text: Consumer theory is extended to incorporate deviations from the law of one price that are common in markets for prescription and illicitly-manufactured opioids. The extension helps to resolve “puzzling” findings in the literature, such as race and age gaps in mortality rates and a failure of increases in the full price of Rx opioids to reduce opioid fatalities. The theory also identifies characteristics of public policies that are essential for predicting consumer behavior and thereby population life expectancy. Most surprising is that, with heroin and fentanyl relatively cheap of late, any Rx opioid policy could – and likely does – have the opposite total-consumption effect after 2013 than it would before, especially when the more expensive Rx opioid products are differentially affected. The theoretical framework also guides assembly of a dataset of federal opioid policies and assessment of the role of technological change and law enforcement in illicit markets.

10.3386/w26812.abstractZh: 消费者理论被扩展以纳入处方类及非法制造的阿片类药物市场中常见的价格法则偏差。这一扩展有助于解释文献中出现的“令人困惑”的现象，例如不同种族和年龄群体在死亡率上的差异，以及处方阿片类药物价格上升未能有效减少阿片类药物相关死亡事件的情况。该理论还指出了对预测消费者行为以及人口预期寿命至关重要的公共政策特征。最令人惊讶的是，由于海洛因和芬太尼近年来价格相对较低，任何针对处方阿片类药物的政策在2013年之后可能会产生与之前相反的总消费效应，尤其是当价格较高的处方阿片类药物受到不同影响时。这一理论框架还指导了联邦阿片类药物政策的数据库构建，并评估了技术变革和执法在非法市场中的作用。

abstract.text: Using the National Compensation Survey from 2009 to 2022 and difference-in-differences methods, we find that state-level sick pay mandates are effective in broadening access for U.S. workers. Increases in coverage reach 30ppt from a 63% baseline five years post-mandate. Mandates have more bite in jobs with low pre-mandate coverage. Further, mandates reduce inequality in access to paid sick leave substantially, both across and within firms. Covid-19 reinforced existing positive trends in coverage and take-up. Sick leave use increases linearly, whereas costs plateau after five years. Finally, we find crowding-in of non-mandated benefits which we label “job upscaling” by firms to differentiate jobs and attract labor.

10.3386/w26832.abstractZh: 通过利用2009至2022年的国家补偿调查数据以及差异-差异方法，我们发现州级病假规定在扩大美国工人的病假使用范围方面具有积极作用。在实施规定后的五年内，病假覆盖率的提升幅度达到了63%的基线水平的30个百分点。在病假覆盖率较低的工作岗位上，这些规定的影响更为显著。此外，这些规定显著减少了企业内部及企业之间的病假使用不平等现象。新冠疫情进一步巩固了覆盖率和采用率方面的积极趋势。病假使用量呈线性增长，而费用在五年后趋于稳定。最后，我们发现非强制规定的福利得到了企业的“岗位升级”利用，这有助于区分不同岗位并吸引劳动力。

abstract.text: An estimated 40 percent of the world's garbage is burned in open-air fires, which are responsible for as much as half of the global emissions of some pollutants. However, there is little evidence on the health consequences of open-air waste burning. In this paper, we estimate the effect of in utero exposure to open-air waste burning on birth outcomes. We do so by examining the consequences of the Lebanese garbage crisis of 2015, which led to an abrupt, unanticipated increase in waste burning in residential neighborhoods in Beirut and Mount Lebanon. To identify effects, we exploit variation in exposure across neighborhoods before and after the crisis. Results indicate exposure had large impacts on birth outcomes; in utero exposure to at least one open-air waste burn increased premature births by 4 percentage points (50%) and low birth weight by 5 to 8 percentage points (80 - 120%). Given previous research documenting the long-run effects of prenatal shocks on adult health, human capital, and labor market outcomes, this suggests open-air waste burning imposes significant costs on populations worldwide.

10.3386/w26835.abstractZh: 据估计，全球40%的垃圾是通过露天焚烧的方式处理的，这些焚烧活动导致了部分污染物的全球排放量的一半。然而，关于露天焚烧对健康的影响的证据却很少。在本文中，我们评估了在子宫内暴露于露天焚烧垃圾对出生结果的影响。我们通过研究2015年黎巴嫩垃圾危机的影响来进行分析，该危机导致贝鲁特和黎巴嫩山地区的居民区突然出现了未经预料的垃圾焚烧现象。为了识别这些影响，我们利用了危机前后不同社区暴露情况的变化。研究结果表明，暴露对出生结果产生了重大影响：在子宫内至少暴露于一次露天焚烧垃圾的情况下，早产率增加了4个百分点（50%），低出生体重率则增加了5到8个百分点（80-120%）。鉴于先前的研究表明，产前冲击对成年人健康、人力资本和劳动力市场结果有长期影响，这表明露天焚烧垃圾给全球民众带来了显著的代价。

abstract.text: There is little theoretical and empirical research on the effects of education on health over the life cycle. In this article, we extend the Grossman (1972) model of the demand for health and use the extended model to analyze the effect of education on health at different ages. The main conclusion from our model is that it is unlikely that the relationship between education and health will be constant over the life cycle and that education is likely to have little effect on health at younger ages when there is little depreciation of the health stock. We also present an extensive empirical analysis documenting the association between education and health over the life cycle. Results of our analysis suggest that in terms of mortality, education has little effect until age 60, but then lowers the hazard rate of death. For measures of morbidity, education has an effect at most ages between 45 to 60, but after age 60 has apparently little effect most likely due to selective mortality. In addition, most of the apparent beneficial effect of education stems from obtaining a high school degree or more. It is the health and mortality of lowest education group—those with less than a high school degree—that diverges from the health and mortality of other education groups. Finally, we find that the educational differences in health have become larger for more recent birth cohorts.

10.3386/w26836.abstractZh: 关于教育对生命周期内健康影响的理论和实证研究相对较少。在本文中，我们扩展了Grossman（1972）的健康需求模型，并利用该扩展模型来分析教育在不同年龄阶段对健康的影响。我们的主要结论是，教育与健康之间的关系在生命周期内不太可能保持恒定，且在健康存量衰减程度较低时，教育对年轻时期健康的影响较小。我们还进行了广泛的实证分析，以记录教育与健康之间的关联在整个生命周期中的变化。分析结果表明，在死亡率方面，教育在60岁之前的影响较小，但之后会降低死亡风险。在发病率方面，教育在45至60岁之间对大多数年龄都有影响，但60岁以后似乎几乎没有影响，这很可能是由于选择性死亡所致。此外，教育带来的大部分益处主要来自于获得高中及以上学历。最低教育水平群体——那些只有高中学历的人——的健康和死亡率与其他教育水平群体存在显著差异。最后，我们发现，较近出生群体的教育差异在健康方面的表现更为明显。

abstract.text: Nearly 1 in 5 children in the United States lives in a household whose income is below the official federal poverty line, and more than 40% of children live in poor or near-poor households. Research on the effects of poverty on children’s development has been a focus of study for many decades and is now increasing as we accumulate more evidence about the implications of poverty. The American Academy of Pediatrics recently added “Poverty and Child Health” to its Agenda for Children to recognize what has now been established as broad and enduring effects of poverty on child development. A recent addition to the field has been the application of neuroscience-based methods. Various techniques including neuroimaging, neuroendocrinology, cognitive psychophysiology, and epigenetics are beginning to document ways in which early experiences of living in poverty affect infant brain development. We discuss whether there are truly worthwhile reasons for adding neuroscience and related biological methods to study child poverty. And how might these perspectives help guide developmentally-based and targeted interventions and policies for these children and their families.

10.3386/w26842.abstractZh: 在美国，几乎每5个儿童中就有1人生活在收入低于联邦官方贫困线的家庭中，超过40%的儿童生活在贫困或接近贫困的家庭中。关于贫困对儿童发展的影响的研究已经成为了许多年的研究重点，随着我们积累更多关于贫困影响的证据，这一研究领域正在不断扩展。美国儿科学会最近将“贫困与儿童健康”纳入其儿童议程，以承认贫困对儿童发展所产生的影响已经得到了广泛而持久的认识。近年来，基于神经科学的方法在这一领域得到了应用。包括神经成像、神经内分泌学、认知心理生理学以及表观遗传学在内的各种技术开始揭示早期贫困经历如何影响婴儿的大脑发育。我们讨论将神经科学及相关生物学方法应用于研究儿童贫困是否真的具有意义，以及这些视角如何帮助指导针对这些儿童及其家庭的发育导向型干预措施和政策。

abstract.text: Rising list prices are often used to illustrate the burden of prescription drug spending, but payers routinely negotiate rebates from manufacturers that generate differences between list and net prices. List prices are easily available and affect patient cost-sharing, but net prices are confidential and affect innovation incentives. We use novel data on medicines sold in a retail setting to quantify rebate growth, the sensitivity of pharmaceutical price indices to list versus net prices, and contribution of net price growth to revenue growth. From 2012 to 2017, we find average rebates increased from 32% to 48%, owing entirely to growth in rebate-levels over a product lifetime rather than shifts towards high rebate products. Annual inflation of list prices was 12% while that of net prices was 3%, implying that financial rewards to manufacturers per unit sold have not grown proportionally to list prices. This pattern is mirrored in 19 of the 20 top drug classes by revenue including insulins, where list and net price inflation were 16% and 2% annually respectively. Finally, we find price growth explains 76% of revenue growth when measured by list prices but 31% of revenue growth when measured by net prices. Moreover, new product entry is the most important factor affecting pharmaceutical revenue growth. These findings provide a cautionary note on using list prices for policy analysis.

10.3386/w26846.abstractZh: 不断上涨的药品标价常被用来说明处方药支出的负担，但支付方通常会与制造商协商返利，这导致标价与实际价格之间存在差异。标价信息容易获取，且会影响患者的费用分担，而实际价格则属于机密信息，会影响创新的激励措施。我们利用零售环境中销售的药品数据，来量化返利的增长情况、药品价格指数对标价与实际价格的敏感性，以及实际价格增长对收入增长的贡献。从2012年到2017年，我们发现平均返利从32%增加到48%，这完全是由于产品生命周期内返利水平的增长，而非转向高返利产品所致。标价的年度通胀率为12%，而实际价格的年度通胀率为3%，这意味着制造商每销售一单位的收益并没有与标价成比例地增长。这一模式在收入最高的20个药品类别中得到了体现，包括胰岛素，这些药品的标价和实际价格分别出现了16%和2%的通胀。最后，我们发现，当以标价衡量时，价格增长解释了76%的收入增长；而当以实际价格衡量时，价格增长则解释了31%的收入增长。此外，新产品的推出是影响药品收入增长的最重要因素。这些发现为使用标价进行政策分析提供了警示。

abstract.text: We state a sufficient condition under which choice data alone suffices to identify consumer preferences when choices are not fully informed. Suppose that: (i) the data generating process is a search model in which the attribute hidden to consumers is observed by the econometrician; (ii) if a consumer searches good j, she also searches goods which are better than j in terms of the non-hidden component of utility; and (iii) consumers choose the good that maximizes overall utility among searched goods. Canonical models will be biased: the value of the hidden attribute will be understated because consumers will be unresponsive to variation in the attribute for goods that they do not search. Under the conditions above and additional mild restrictions, an alternative method of recovering preferences using cross derivatives of choice probabilities succeeds regardless of the search protocol and is thus robust to whether consumers are informed. The approach nests several standard models, including full information. Our methods suggest natural tests for full information and can be used to forecast how consumers will respond to additional information. We verify in a lab experiment that our approach succeeds in recovering preferences when consumers engage in costly search.

10.3386/w26849.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个充分条件，即仅使用选择数据就足以识别消费者的偏好，前提是消费者的选择并非完全知情。假设：(i) 数据生成过程是一个搜索模型，其中消费者不知道的属性由计量经济学家观察到；(ii) 如果消费者搜索商品j，她也会搜索在效用的非隐藏成分方面优于j的商品；以及(iii) 消费者会在搜索到的商品中选择能最大化总效用的商品。经典模型会存在偏差：隐藏属性的价值会被低估，因为对于不搜索的商品，消费者对属性变化的反应会减弱。在上述条件下，并加上一些温和的限制，一种利用选择概率的跨导数来恢复偏好的方法能够成功，无论采用何种搜索协议，因此无论消费者是否知情，该方法都是稳健的。我们的方法将几种标准模型纳入考虑，包括完全信息模型。我们的方法为完全信息的测试提供了自然的方法，并可用于预测消费者对额外信息的反应。我们在实验室实验中验证了，当消费者进行昂贵的搜索时，我们的方法能够成功恢复偏好。

abstract.text: Medicaid’s federal-state matching system of financing is the nation’s largest example of fiscal federalism. Using generous federal subsidies, the Affordable Care Act incentivized states to expand Medicaid, which became a state option in the aftermath of a 2012 Supreme Court ruling. As of early 2020, 14 states had not yet expanded, with concerns over state budgetary effects described as a key barrier. We use an event-study approach to analyze state budget data from 2010-2018 and assess the effects of state Medicaid expansion decisions. We find that Medicaid expansion increased total spending in expansion states by 6% to 9%, compared to non-expansion states. By source of funds, federal spending via the states increased by 10% in the first year of Medicaid expansion, rising to 27% in 2018.
