Changes in spending from state funding were modest and non-significant, with less than a 1% change from baseline annually in the most recent years, 2017 and 2018. Meanwhile, we find no evidence that increased Medicaid spending from expansion produced any reductions in spending on education, corrections, transportation, or public assistance. Changes in Medicaid spending tracked closely with the baseline pre-ACA (2013) uninsured rate in each states, with expansion leading to roughly $2680 in added annual spending per uninsured adult. As a result, we estimate states that didn’t expand Medicaid passed up $43 billion in federally-subsidized program funds in 2018. Finally, state projections in the aggregate were reasonably accurate, with expansion states projecting average Medicaid spending from 2014-2018 within 2 percent of the actual amounts, and in fact overestimating Medicaid spending in most years.

10.3386/w26862.abstractZh: 医疗补助的联邦与州之间的匹配融资体系是联邦财政制度中规模最大的例子。通过提供慷慨的联邦补贴，《平价医疗法案》激励各州扩大医疗补助的覆盖范围，这一政策在2012年最高法院裁决后成为各州的选项。截至2020年初，仍有14个州尚未扩大医疗补助的覆盖范围，对州预算的影响被视为主要障碍之一。我们采用事件研究法分析2010-2018年的州预算数据，评估各州扩大医疗补助覆盖范围的决策效果。研究发现，与未扩大医疗补助覆盖范围的州相比，扩大医疗补助覆盖范围的州总支出增加了6%至9%。从资金来源来看，通过州政府进行的联邦支出在医疗补助扩大后的第一年增加了10%，到2018年这一比例上升至27%。州政府资金带来的支出变化较为温和，在最近几年（2017年和2018年）每年变化幅度不到1%。同时，我们没有发现扩大医疗补助支出会导致教育、矫正、交通或公共援助方面的支出减少。医疗补助支出的变化与各州在《平价医疗法案》实施前的无保险率密切相关，扩大医疗补助覆盖范围的州每年为每位无保险成年人增加了约2680美元的支出。因此，我们估计2018年未扩大医疗补助覆盖范围的州放弃了430亿美元的联邦补贴资金。最后，各州的预测总体相当准确，扩大医疗补助覆盖范围的州对2014-2018年医疗补助支出的预测与实际数值相差不超过2%，并且在大多数年份都高估了医疗补助支出。

abstract.text: Mortality and economic contraction during the 1918-1920 Great Influenza Pandemic provide plausible upper bounds for outcomes under the coronavirus (COVID-19). Data for 48 countries imply flu-related deaths in 1918-1920 of 40 million, 2.1 percent of world population, implying 150 million deaths when applied to current population. Regressions with annual information on flu deaths 1918-1920 and war deaths during WWI imply flu-generated economic declines for GDP and consumption in the typical country of 6 and 8 percent, respectively. There is also some evidence that higher flu death rates decreased realized real returns on stocks and, especially, on short-term government bills.

10.3386/w26866.abstractZh: 1918-1920年大流感期间的死亡率和经济收缩为冠状病毒（COVID-19）带来的后果提供了合理的上限。48个国家的数据表明，1918-1920年间因流感导致的死亡人数达到4000万，占世界人口的2.1%，如果应用于当前人口，则意味着1.5亿人死亡。对1918-1920年流感死亡人数以及第一次世界大战期间战争死亡人数的年度数据分析表明，流感导致典型国家的GDP和消费分别下降6%和8%。还有一些证据表明，较高的流感死亡率降低了股票的实际回报，尤其是短期政府债券的回报。

abstract.text: The 2010 Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA) introduced a mandate requiring chain restaurants to post calorie counts on menus and menu boards. This paper investigates whether and why calorie posting laws work. To do so, we develop a model of calories consumed that highlights two potential channels through which mandates influence choice and outlines an empirical strategy to disentangle these alternatives. We test the predictions of our model using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System to compare changes in body mass index (BMI), obesity, and consumer well-being in locations that implemented calorie-posting laws between 2008 and 2011 to those in neighboring locations without such laws. We find that calorie mandates lead to a small but statistically significant reduction in average BMI of 0.2 kg/m² (1.5 pounds) and reductions in self-reported measures of life satisfaction. Quantile regressions provide evidence that reductions in BMI and life satisfaction are concentrated among those with healthy weight. Viewed in its totality, the pattern of results is consistent with an economic model in which calorie labels influence consumers both by providing information and by imposing a welfare-reducing moral cost on unhealthy eating.

10.3386/w26869.abstractZh: 2010年《患者保护与平价医疗法案》规定，连锁餐厅必须在菜单和菜单板上标注卡路里含量。本文探讨了卡路里标注法规是否以及为何能够发挥作用。为此，我们建立了一个关于卡路里消耗的模型，该模型强调了法规影响选择的两种潜在途径，并提出了一种实证策略来区分这些影响机制。我们使用行为风险因素监测系统的数据来测试该模型的预测结果，比较了2008年至2011年间实施卡路里标注法规的地区与未实施此类法规的邻近地区的体重指数、肥胖率和消费者福祉的变化。研究发现，卡路里标注法规使得平均体重指数降低了0.2千克/平方米（1.5磅），同时自我报告的满意度也有所下降。分位数回归分析表明，体重指数和满意度的下降主要集中在体重健康的人群中。总体而言，这些结果符合一个经济模型，即卡路里标签通过提供信息以及对不健康饮食施加道德成本，从而影响消费者的行为。

abstract.text: German long-term health insurance (GLTHI) represents the largest market for private long-term health insurance contracts in the world. We show that GLTHI’s contract design coincides with the optimal dynamic contract for individuals with constant lifetime income profiles. After estimating the key ingredients of a life-cycle model, we find that, under a variety of assumptions, GLTHI achieves welfare that is at most 4% lower than for the optimal contract. Relative to the gains of replacing short-term contracts with either long-term contract, this welfare gap is smallest when reclassification risk is high.

10.3386/w26870.abstractZh: 德国长期健康保险（GLTHI）是全球私人长期健康保险合同最大的市场。我们的研究表明，GLTHI的合同设计与具有恒定终身收入特征的个体最优动态合同相一致。在估算了生命周期模型的关键要素后，我们发现，在多种假设条件下，GLTHI带来的福利水平最多比最优合同低4%。与用长期合同替代短期合同所带来的收益相比，当重新分类风险较高时，这种福利差距最小。

abstract.text: We analyze the impact of expanded adult Medicaid eligibility on the Medicaid enrollment of already-eligible children. To do so, we exploit the 2008 Oregon Medicaid lottery, in which some low-income uninsured adults were randomly selected for the chance to apply for Medicaid. Children in these households were eligible for Medicaid irrespective of whether the household won the lottery. We estimate statistically significant but transitory impacts of adult lottery selection on children’s Medicaid enrollment: for every 9 adults who enroll in Medicaid due to the lottery, one additional child also enrolls at the same time. Our results shed light on the existence, magnitude, and nature of so-called “woodwork effects”.

10.3386/w26871.abstractZh: 我们分析了扩大成人医疗补助资格对已有资格儿童医疗补助注册情况的影响。为此，我们利用了2008年俄勒冈州医疗补助抽奖活动，该活动中一些低收入且无保险的成年人被随机选中，有机会申请医疗补助。这些家庭中的儿童无论是否赢得了抽奖，都有资格获得医疗补助。我们估计了成人抽奖对儿童医疗补助注册有显著但短暂的影响：每有9名因抽奖而注册医疗补助的成年人，就有一名儿童同时注册医疗补助。我们的研究结果揭示了所谓“木工作效应”的存在、规模和性质。

abstract.text: Using data from the Health and Retirement Survey, we document the changes in assets that occur before a person's death. Applying an event study approach, we find that during the 6 years preceding their deaths, the assets of single decedents decline, relative to those of similar single survivors, by an additional $20,000 on average. Over the same time span, the assets of couples who lose a spouse fall, relative to those of similar surviving couples, by an additional $90,000 on average. Households experiencing a death also incur higher out-of-pocket medical spending and other end-of-life expenses. This elevated spending is sufficient to explain (in accounting terms) the asset declines observed for singles but falls short of explaining the declines observed for couples. Bequests from the dying spouse to non-spousal heirs such as children are more than sufficient to explain the remainder.

10.3386/w26879.abstractZh: 通过《健康与退休调查》的数据，我们记录了个人去世前资产的变化情况。采用事件研究法分析后发现，在去世前的6年间，单身人士的资产相对于类似的单身幸存者平均减少了20,000美元。在同一时期，失去配偶的夫妻的资产相对于类似的幸存夫妻平均减少了90,000美元。经历死亡的家庭还会产生更高的自付医疗费用和其他临终费用。这些增加的支出足以解释单身人士资产减少的现象，但无法完全解释夫妻资产减少的原因。去世配偶对子女等非配偶继承人的遗产捐赠足以弥补剩余的资产损失。

abstract.text: This paper forecasts the life-cycle treatment effects on health of a high-quality early childhood program. Our predictions combine microsimulation using non-experimental data with experimental data from a midlife long-term follow-up. The follow-up incorporated a full epidemiological exam. The program mainly benefits males and significantly reduces the prevalence of heart disease, stroke, cancer, and mortality across the life-cycle. For men, we estimate an average reduction of 3.8 disability-adjusted years (DALYs). The reduction in DALYs is relatively small for women. The gain in quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) is almost enough to offset all of the costs associated with program implementation for males and half of program costs for women.

10.3386/w26880.abstractZh: 本文预测了高质量早期儿童教育项目对健康的生命周期影响。我们的预测结合了使用非实验数据的微观模拟结果与来自中年长期随访的实验数据。随访过程中进行了全面的流行病学评估。该项目主要对男性有益，并显著降低了整个生命周期中心脏病、中风、癌症和死亡率的患病率。对于男性来说，我们估计平均减少了3.8个伤残调整生命年（DALYs）。而女性的DALYs减少幅度相对较小。对于男性而言，质量调整生命年（QALYs）的增加几乎足以抵消项目实施所涉及的全部成本，而对于女性来说，则足以抵消一半的项目成本。

abstract.text: We extend the canonical epidemiology model to study the interaction between economic decisions and epidemics. Our model implies that people cut back on consumption and work to reduce the chances of being infected. These decisions reduce the severity of the epidemic but exacerbate the size of the associated recession. The competitive equilibrium is not socially optimal because infected people do not fully internalize the effect of their economic decisions on the spread of the virus. In our benchmark model, the best simple containment policy increases the severity of the recession but saves roughly half a million lives in the United States.

10.3386/w26882.abstractZh: 我们将经典的流行病学模型扩展用于研究经济决策与疫情之间的相互作用。我们的模型表明，人们会削减消费和工作，以减少被感染的机会。这些决策虽然能减轻疫情的严重程度，但也会加剧经济衰退的幅度。竞争均衡并非社会最优解，因为被感染者并未完全意识到他们的经济决策对病毒传播的影响。在我们的基准模型中，最有效的简单遏制政策虽然会加剧经济衰退的严重程度，但大约能挽救50万人的生命。

abstract.text: A number of studies – including our own – find a mid-life dip in well-being. We review a psychology literature that claims that the evidence of a U-shape is "overblown" and if there is such a decline it is "trivial". We find remarkably strong and consistent evidence across countries and US states that statistically significant U-shapes exist with and without socio-economic controls. The US is somewhat of an outlier with evidence of an early uptick in the raw data with some variables – but not in others – that disappears when controls are included. We show that two of the studies cited by psychologists suggesting there are no U-shapes are in error; we use their data and find the opposite. The effects of the mid-life dip are comparable to major life events like losing a spouse, losing a job or getting cancer. They are clearly not inconsequential.

10.3386/w26888.abstractZh: 多项研究——包括我们自己的研究——发现中年时期的幸福感会出现下降。我们回顾了心理学文献，这些文献认为U形曲线的证据“被夸大了”，如果存在这种下降，那也是“微不足道的”。我们发现，无论是在社会经济控制下还是没有控制的情况下，不同国家和地区都存在统计学上显著的U形曲线。美国的情况有些特殊，原始数据显示出早期幸福感有所上升，但在某些变量上这种趋势消失了，而在其他变量上则没有。我们发现，心理学家引用的那些认为不存在U形曲线的研究是错误的；我们使用他们的数据后发现情况恰恰相反。中年时期幸福感下降的影响与重大生活事件如失去配偶、失业或患癌症等相当，显然并非微不足道。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effects of changes in states’ scope of practice laws (SOP) for advanced practice registered nurses (APRNs) on individual labor supply decisions. Restrictive SOP impose costs and other barriers to practice that may affect these decisions. Using survey data on APRNs, we analyze employment in nursing, work hours, part-time work status, multiple job holding, self-employment, wages, and migration. Results show that the level of SOP restrictions are not strong determinants of many labor market decisions, with a few exceptions. We find that hours worked and self-employment both increase when nurses practice in regulatory environments that are free from physician oversight requirements.

10.3386/w26896.abstractZh: 本文研究了州执业范围法（SOP）的变化对注册高级执业护士（APRNs）个人劳动供应决策的影响。限制性SOP会带来成本和其他实践障碍，这些都可能影响这些决策。通过针对APRNs的调查数据，我们分析了护理领域的就业情况、工作时间、兼职工作状况、多职工作、自主创业、工资以及迁移情况。结果显示，除了少数例外情况，SOP的限制程度并不是许多劳动力市场决策的决定性因素。我们发现，当护士在不受医生监管要求的监管环境中执业时，工作时间和自主创业都会增加。

abstract.text: We extend the baseline Susceptible-Exposed-Infectious-Recovered (SEIR) infectious disease epidemiology model to understand the role of testing and case-dependent quarantine. Our model nests the SEIR model. During a period of asymptomatic infection, testing can reveal infection that otherwise would only be revealed later when symptoms develop. Along with those displaying symptoms, such individuals are deemed known positive cases. Quarantine policy is case-dependent in that it can depend on whether a case is unknown, known positive, known negative, or recovered. Testing therefore makes possible the identification and quarantine of infected individuals and release of non-infected individuals. We fix a quarantine technology—a parameter determining the differential rate of transmission in quarantine—and compare simple testing and quarantine policies. We start with a baseline quarantine-only policy that replicates the rate at which individuals are entering quarantine in the US in March, 2020. We show that the total deaths that occur under this policy can occur under looser quarantine measures and a substantial increase in random testing of asymptomatic individuals. Testing at a higher rate in conjunction with targeted quarantine policies can (i) dampen the economic impact of the coronavirus and (ii) reduce peak symptomatic infections—relevant for hospital capacity constraints. Our model can be plugged into richer quantitative extensions of the SEIR model of the kind currently being used to forecast the effects of public health and economic policies.

10.3386/w26901.abstractZh: 我们将基础性的易感-暴露-感染-康复（SEIR）传染病流行病学模型扩展，以了解检测与病例依赖型隔离的作用。我们的模型嵌套了SEIR模型。在无症状感染期间，检测可以揭示原本只有在症状出现时才会被发现的感染情况。与有症状个体一样，这些个体也被视为已知阳性病例。隔离政策取决于病例的状态，可能取决于该病例是未知、已知阳性、已知阴性还是康复者。因此，检测使得识别并隔离感染者以及释放未感染者成为可能。我们设定了一种隔离技术——一个决定隔离期间传播差异率的参数——并比较了简单检测与隔离政策的效果。我们从仅基于隔离的基础政策开始，该政策复制了2020年3月美国个体进入隔离状态的速率。我们表明，在这种政策下发生的总死亡人数可以通过更宽松的隔离措施和大规模对无症状个体的检测来减少。更高频率的检测结合有针对性的隔离政策可以（i）减轻冠状病毒的经济影响；（ii）减少症状性感染的峰值——这对医院容量限制至关重要。我们的模型可以纳入更丰富的SEIR模型量化扩展，这些扩展目前被用于预测公共卫生和经济政策的效果。

abstract.text: We quantify the causal impact of human mobility restrictions, particularly the lockdown of the city of Wuhan on January 23, 2020, on the containment and delay of the spread of the Novel Coronavirus (2019-nCoV). We employ a set of difference-in-differences (DID) estimations to disentangle the lockdown effect on human mobility reductions from other confounding effects including panic effect, virus effect, and the Spring Festival effect. We find that the lockdown of Wuhan reduced inflow into Wuhan by 76.64%, outflows from Wuhan by 56.35%, and within-Wuhan movements by 54.15%. We also estimate the dynamic effects of up to 22 lagged population inflows from Wuhan and other Hubei cities, the epicenter of the 2019-nCoV outbreak, on the destination cities' new infection cases. We find, using simulations with these estimates, that the lockdown of the city of Wuhan on January 23, 2020 contributed significantly to reducing the total infection cases outside of Wuhan, even with the social distancing measures later imposed by other cities. We find that the COVID-19 cases would be 64.81% higher in the 347 Chinese cities outside Hubei province, and 52.64% higher in the 16 non-Wuhan cities inside Hubei, in the counterfactual world in which the city of Wuhan were not locked down from January 23, 2020. We also find that there were substantial undocumented infection cases in the early days of the 2019-nCoV outbreak in Wuhan and other cities of Hubei province, but over time, the gap between the officially reported cases and our estimated “actual” cases narrows significantly. We also find evidence that enhanced social distancing policies in the 63 Chinese cities outside Hubei province are effective in reducing the impact of population inflows from the epicenter cities in Hubei province on the spread of 2019-nCoV virus in the destination cities elsewhere.

10.3386/w26906.abstractZh: 我们量化了人类流动限制，特别是2020年1月23日武汉市的封锁，对遏制和延缓新型冠状病毒（2019-nCoV）传播的影响。我们采用差异中差异（DID）估计方法，将封锁对减少人类流动的影响与其他混杂因素区分开来，包括恐慌效应、病毒效应和春节效应。我们发现，武汉市的封锁使进入武汉的流量减少了76.64%，流出武汉的流量减少了56.35%，市内流动减少了54.15%。我们还估计了来自武汉和其他2019-nCoV疫情中心湖北省城市的人口流入动态效应，这些流入对目的城市的新感染病例产生了影响。通过模拟这些估计结果，我们发现，即使其他城市后来实施了社交距离措施，2020年1月23日武汉市封锁仍然显著减少了武汉以外的总感染病例。我们发现，在武汉以外的347个中国城市中，COVID-19病例数量将比没有实施封锁的情况高出64.81%，在湖北省内的16个非武汉城市中，病例数量将高出52.64%。我们还发现，在2019-nCoV疫情初期，武汉和其他湖北省城市存在大量未记录的感染病例，但随着时间的推移，官方报告的病例数量与我们估计的“实际”病例数量之间的差距显著缩小。我们还发现，湖北省以外的63个中国城市中，加强社交距离政策的实施，能够有效减少来自湖北省疫情中心城市的人员流入对其他地区2019-nCoV病毒传播的影响。

abstract.text: The development of nicotine replacement therapies and e-cigarettes emphasize and highlight that, in tobacco demand, nicotine is one of, if not, the primary object people want. This chapter presents a simple model of utility maximization that focuses specifically on nicotine as the object of interest. It yields a derived demand for a nicotine delivery technology and predictions researchers can use to account for patterns in consumption over the life-cycle of individuals and the market as a whole. The model is informed by available evidence about the neurological effects of nicotine and differences in the relative efficiency and associated physical costs of nicotine delivery devices, and genetic differences across individuals that partly explains variation in nicotine consumption. The analysis highlights that one of the key theoretical objects of interest is the price per unit of nicotine delivered to the brain. The limited empirical literature on e-cigarettes does not measure that price. All told, economists have much to offer in modeling and empirically studying demand for the new nicotine delivery products. In addition, a range of studies could look back, reconfigure prices and measured consumption, to better explain patterns in historical time-series data on consumption and substitution across different nicotine delivery devices.

10.3386/w26912.abstractZh: 尼古丁替代疗法和电子香烟的发展表明，在烟草需求中，尼古丁是人们的主要需求之一，甚至可以说是首要需求。本章提出了一个简单的效用最大化模型，专门针对尼古丁这一需求对象进行研究。该模型推导出尼古丁输送技术的需求，并提供了研究人员可用于解释个体生命周期及整个市场消费模式的数据。该模型基于现有关于尼古丁神经效应的研究、不同尼古丁输送设备之间的效率差异及相关物理成本，以及个体间的遗传差异，这些差异部分解释了尼古丁消费的差异。分析指出，其中一个关键的理论研究对象是输送至大脑的每单位尼古丁的价格。关于电子香烟的有限实证文献并未测量这一价格。总体而言，经济学家在建模和实证研究新的尼古丁输送产品需求方面具有丰富的资源。此外，一系列研究可以通过回顾、重新配置价格及测量消费数据，来更好地解释不同尼古丁输送设备在历史时间序列数据中的消费和替代模式。

abstract.text: We surveyed representative samples of Italian residents at three critical points in the COVID-19 pandemic, to test whether and how intentions to comply with social-isolation restrictions respond to the duration of their possible extension. Individuals reported being more likely to reduce, and less likely to increase, their self-isolation effort if negatively surprised by a given hypothetical extension (i.e., if the extension is longer than what they expected), whereas positive surprises had no impact. These results are consistent with reference-dependent preferences, with individual expectations serving as a reference point, and loss aversion. Our findings indicate that public authorities should carefully manage expectations about policy measures and account for behavioral reactions to deviations from previous announcements.

10.3386/w26916.abstractZh: 我们对意大利居民在COVID-19疫情的三个关键时期进行了代表性调查，以测试他们遵守社交隔离限制的意愿是否以及如何受到政策措施可能延长时间的影晌。个体报告称，如果预期的政策措施延长时间超过他们的预期，他们更有可能减少自我隔离的努力，而减少的可能性则大于增加自我隔离努力的可能性；相反，如果预期延长时间符合他们的预期，则没有任何影响。这些结果与参照依赖型偏好理论相符，即个体的预期起到了参考点的作用，同时也体现了损失厌恶心理。我们的研究结果表明，公共当局应谨慎管理人们对政策措施的预期，并考虑行为者对先前公告偏差的反应。

abstract.text: New York City has been rightly characterized as the epicenter of the coronavirus pandemic in the United States. Just one month after the first cases of coronavirus infection were reported in the city, the burden of infected individuals with serious complications of COVID-19 has already outstripped the capacity of many of the city’s hospitals. As in the case of most pandemics, scientists and public officials don’t have complete, accurate, real-time data on the path of new infections. Despite these data inadequacies, there already appears to be sufficient evidence to conclude that the curve in New York City is indeed flattening. The purpose of this report is to set forth the evidence for – and against – this preliminary but potentially important conclusion. Having examined the evidence, we then inquire: if the curve is indeed flattening, do we know what caused to it to level off?

10.3386/w26917.abstractZh: 纽约市被恰当地称为美国冠状病毒大流行的中心。在该市首次报告有冠状病毒感染病例仅一个月后，因COVID-19出现严重并发症的感染者数量就已经超过了许多医院的救治能力。与大多数大流行病一样，科学家和公共卫生官员并没有完整、准确、实时的新感染数据。尽管存在这些数据不足的问题，但已有足够的证据表明纽约市的感染曲线确实正在趋于平缓。本报告的目的是阐述支持或反对这一初步但可能重要的结论的证据。在审查了这些证据之后，我们进一步探讨：如果感染曲线确实在平缓，那么是什么原因导致它趋于平稳的呢？

abstract.text: Tobacco regulation has been a major component of health policy in the developed world since the UK’s Royal College of Physicians’ and the U.S. Surgeon General’s reports in the 1960s. Such regulation, which has intensified in the past two decades, includes cigarette taxation, place-based smoking bans in areas ranging from bars and restaurants to workplaces, and regulations designed to make tobacco products less desirable. More recently, the availability of alternative products, most notably e-cigarettes, has increased dramatically, and these products are just starting to be regulated. Despite an extensive body of research on tobacco regulations, there remains substantial debate regarding their effectiveness, and ultimately, their impact on economic welfare. We provide the first comprehensive review of the state of research in the economics of tobacco regulation in two decades.

10.3386/w26923.abstractZh: 自20世纪60年代英国皇家内科医学院和美国外科医生报告以来，烟草监管一直是发达国家健康政策的重要组成部分。过去二十年，这种监管措施日益加强，包括香烟征税、在酒吧、餐馆到工作场所等场所实施禁烟令，以及旨在降低烟草产品吸引力的法规。最近，替代产品，尤其是电子香烟的普及率急剧上升，这些产品才刚刚开始受到监管。尽管关于烟草监管的研究非常丰富，但关于其有效性的讨论仍然很多，最终，这些监管措施对经济福利的影响也仍然存在争议。我们首次对过去二十年烟草监管经济学领域的研究现状进行了全面回顾。

abstract.text: We study partisan differences in Americans’ response to the COVID-19 pandemic. Political leaders and media outlets on the right and left have sent divergent messages about the severity of the crisis, which could impact the extent to which Republicans and Democrats engage in social distancing and other efforts to reduce disease transmission. We develop a simple model of a pandemic response with heterogeneous agents that clarifies the causes and consequences of heterogeneous responses. We use location data from a large sample of smartphones to show that areas with more Republicans engaged in less social distancing, controlling for other factors including public policies, population density, and local COVID cases and deaths. We then present new survey evidence of significant gaps at the individual level between Republicans and Democrats in self-reported social distancing, beliefs about personal COVID risk, and beliefs about the future severity of the pandemic.

10.3386/w26946.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国人对COVID-19大流行的不同反应中的党派差异。左右两派的政治领袖和媒体在危机的严重程度问题上发表了不同的言论，这可能会影响共和党和民主党人在实施社交距离和其他减少疾病传播措施方面的参与度。我们建立了一个简单的疫情应对模型，该模型包含异质性代理人，以阐明不同反应的原因和后果。我们利用大量智能手机的位置数据表明，在控制其他因素（包括公共政策、人口密度以及当地COVID病例和死亡人数）的情况下，共和党人较少采取社交距离措施的地区，共和党人在社交距离方面的表现较差。随后，我们提供了新的调查数据，显示共和党和民主党人在自我报告的社交距离、对个人COVID风险的看法以及对疫情未来严重程度的看法方面存在显著差异。

abstract.text: Rationing of medical resources is a critical issue in the COVID-19 pandemic. Most existing triage protocols are based on a priority point system, in which a formula specifies the order in which the supply of a resource, such as a ventilator, is to be rationed for patients. A priority point system generates an identical priority ranking specifying claims on all units. Triage protocols in some states (e.g. Michigan) prioritize frontline health workers giving heavier weight to the ethical principle of instrumental value. Others (e.g. New York) do not, reasoning that if frontline workers obtain high enough priority, there is a risk that they obtain all units and none remain for the general community. This debate is pressing given substantial COVID-19 health risks for frontline workers. In this paper, we analyze the consequences of rationing medical resources through a reserve system. In a reserve system, resources are placed into multiple categories. Priorities guiding allocation of units can reflect different ethical values between these categories. A reserve system provides additional flexibility over a priority point system because it does not dictate a single priority order for the allocation of all units. It offers a middle-ground approach that balances competing objectives, such as in the medical worker debate. This flexibility requires attention to implementation, especially the processing order of reserve categories. We describe our model of a reserve system, characterize its potential outcomes, and examine distributional implications of particular reserve systems. We also discuss several practical considerations with triage protocol design.

10.3386/w26951.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情期间，医疗资源的配给是一个至关重要的问题。目前大多数分诊协议都基于优先级系统，即通过一个公式来确定分配资源（如呼吸机）的顺序。优先级系统会生成相同的优先级排序，以决定所有资源的分配顺序。一些州（例如密歇根州）优先考虑一线卫生工作者，并重视工具价值的伦理原则。而另一些州（例如纽约州）则不这样做，他们认为如果一线工作者获得足够的优先级，可能会导致他们获得所有资源，而普通民众则无法获得任何资源。鉴于一线工作者面临巨大的COVID-19健康风险，这一争论尤为紧迫。在本文中，我们分析了通过储备系统来分配医疗资源的后果。在储备系统中，资源被分为多个类别，指导资源分配的优先级可以反映这些类别之间的不同伦理价值观。与优先级系统相比，储备系统提供了更多的灵活性，因为它不规定所有资源的分配顺序。它提供了一种平衡不同目标的中介方法，就像在卫生工作者问题上的争论一样。这种灵活性要求我们在实施过程中特别注意，尤其是储备类别的处理顺序。我们描述了我们的储备系统模型，分析了其潜在结果，并探讨了特定储备系统的分配影响。我们还讨论了在分诊协议设计中需要考虑的几个实际问题。

abstract.text: New York City is the hot spot of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States. This paper merges information on the number of tests and the number of infections at the New York City zip code level with demographic and socioeconomic information from the decennial census and the American Community Surveys. People residing in poor or immigrant neighborhoods were less likely to be tested; but the likelihood that a test was positive was larger in those neighborhoods, as well as in neighborhoods with larger households or predominantly black populations. The rate of infection in the population depends on both the frequency of tests and on the fraction of positive tests among those tested. The non-randomness in testing across New York City neighborhoods indicates that the observed correlation between the rate of infection and the socioeconomic characteristics of a community tells an incomplete story of how the pandemic evolved in a congested urban setting.

10.3386/w26952.abstractZh: 纽约市是美国COVID-19疫情的中心。本文将纽约市邮政编码级别下的检测数量和感染数量信息，与十年一次的人口普查和美国社区调查中的人口统计和社会经济信息相结合。居住在贫困或移民社区的人接受检测的可能性较低；但在这些社区以及家庭规模较大或黑人人口占多数的社区，检测呈阳性的可能性更高。感染率取决于检测的频繁程度以及检测中阳性检测的比例。纽约市各社区检测的非随机性表明，感染率与社区社会经济特征之间的相关性并不能完全反映疫情在拥挤城市环境中的演变情况。

abstract.text: We construct text-based measures of the primary concerns listed firms associated with the spread of COVID-19 and other epidemic diseases. We identify which firms perceive to lose or gain from a given epidemic and textually decompose the epidemic's effect on the firm's demand and supply. We find that the effects of COVID-19 manifest as a simultaneous shock to demand and supply, with both shocks affecting firms' market valuations in equal measure on average. By contrast, demand-related impacts appear more important in accounting for the observed collapse in firm-level investment during the COVID-19 crisis.

10.3386/w26971.abstractZh: 我们构建了基于文本的指标，来衡量与COVID-19及其他流行病传播相关的企业主要关切。我们识别出哪些企业认为会在特定流行病中遭受损失或获得收益，并通过文本分析来分解该流行病对企业需求和供应的影响。研究发现，COVID-19的影响表现为对需求和供应的同时冲击，这两种冲击平均对企业的市场估值产生了同等程度的影响。相比之下，与需求相关的冲击在解释COVID-19危机期间企业投资水平下降现象中显得更为重要。

abstract.text: Leveraging unique administrative data and a sharp increase in benefit generosity in a difference-indifferences research design, we estimate the impact of workers’ compensation wage replacement benefits on individual behavior and program costs. We find that increased benefit generosity leads to longer income benefit durations and increased medical spending. Responses along these two margins are equally important drivers of increased program costs, collectively increasing program costs 1.4 times the mechanical increase in costs. Using these estimates and an estimate of the consumption drop among injured workers, our welfare calibrations suggest that a marginal increase in benefit generosity would not improve welfare.

10.3386/w26976.abstractZh: 通过利用独特的行政数据，并在差异无关性研究设计中大幅增加福利的慷慨程度，我们估算了工人赔偿工资替代福利对个人行为和项目成本的影响。我们发现，福利的慷慨程度增加会导致收入福利的持续时间延长以及医疗支出的增加。这两个方面的变化都是导致项目成本增加的同等重要因素，项目成本的增加幅度是机械性成本增加幅度的1.4倍。根据这些估算结果，以及受伤工人消费下降的估计值，我们的福利校准表明，福利的边际增加并不会改善福利状况。

abstract.text: We study the impact of new information on people’s perceptions of the risks of e-cigarettes. In September 2019 the U.S. experienced an outbreak of e-cigarette, or vaping, associated lung injuries (EVALI). The EVALI outbreak created an information shock, which was followed by additional new information in a later CDC recommendation. We use data on consumer risk perceptions from two sets of surveys conducted before (using HINTS survey data) and during the EVALI outbreak (using Google Survey data). The empirical model examines changes in risk perceptions during the early crisis period when the CDC was warning consumers that they should avoid all vaping products and during a later period when the message was refined and focused on a much narrower set of illegal vaping products that contain THC (the main psychoactive compound in marijuana). Our econometric results suggest that the immediate impact of the first information shock was to increase the fraction of respondents who perceived e-cigarettes as more harmful than smoking by about 16 percentage points. As the outbreak subsided and the CDC recommendation changed to emphasize the role of THC e-cigarette products, e-cigarette risk perceptions were partially revised downwards. Additional econometric results show that different demographic groups reacted somewhat differently to the information shock. In particular, we find that groups who had higher risk perceptions showed a weaker response to the first information shock but were more likely to later revise their risk perceptions downwards. We conclude the paper by discussing the public policy issues that stem from having risk perceptions of e-cigarettes relative to combustible cigarettes remain at these elevated levels where a substantial portion of consumers believe that e-cigarettes are more harmful than cigarettes.

10.3386/w26977.abstractZh: 我们研究了新信息对人们认为电子香烟风险认知的影响。2019年9月，美国爆发了与电子香烟或电子雾化产品相关的肺部损伤事件。这一事件引发了信息冲击，随后美国疾病控制与预防中心在后续建议中提供了更多新信息。我们使用了两组调查的数据来研究消费者风险认知的变化：一组是在电子香烟爆发前进行的调查（使用HINTS调查数据），另一组是在电子香烟爆发期间进行的调查（使用Google调查数据）。实证模型分析了危机初期风险认知的变化，当时疾病控制与预防中心警告消费者应避免使用所有电子雾化产品；而在后期，信息重点转向了含有THC（大麻中的主要精神活性化合物）的非法电子雾化产品。我们的计量经济学结果显示，第一次信息冲击的直接影响是使认为电子香烟比吸烟更有害的受访者比例增加了约16个百分点。随着疫情平息，疾病控制与预防中心的建议转向强调THC电子雾化产品的危害，电子香烟的风险认知有所下调。进一步的计量经济学分析表明，不同人口群体对信息冲击的反应有所不同。具体而言，我们发现风险认知较高的群体对第一次信息冲击的反应较弱，但后来更有可能下调其风险认知。最后，我们讨论了由于电子香烟相对于传统香烟的风险认知仍然处于较高水平，导致相当一部分消费者认为电子香烟比传统香烟更有害，这所带来的公共政策问题。

abstract.text: A large body of research documents that the 2010 dependent coverage mandate of the Affordable Care Act was responsible for significantly increasing health insurance coverage among young adults. No prior research has examined whether sexual minority young adults also benefitted from the dependent coverage mandate, despite previous studies showing lower health insurance coverage among sexual minorities and the fact that their higher likelihood of strained relationships with their parents might predict a lower ability to use parental coverage. Our estimates from the American Community Surveys using difference-in-differences and event study models show that men in same-sex couples age 21-25 were significantly more likely to have any health insurance after 2010 compared to the associated change for slightly older 27 to 31-year-old men in same-sex couples. This increase is concentrated among employer-sponsored insurance, and it is robust to permutations of time periods and age groups. Effects for women in same-sex couples and men in different-sex couples are smaller than the associated effects for men in same-sex couples. These findings confirm the broad effects of expanded dependent coverage and suggest that eliminating the federal dependent mandate could reduce health insurance coverage among young adult sexual minorities in same-sex couples.

10.3386/w26978.abstractZh: 大量研究文献表明，《平价医疗法案》在2010年实施的依赖者保险覆盖要求显著增加了年轻成年人的健康保险覆盖率。此前的研究并未探讨性少数群体年轻成年人是否也受益于这一要求，尽管先前的研究显示性少数群体的健康保险覆盖率较低，且他们与父母关系紧张的可能性较高，这可能意味着他们无法充分利用父母的保险覆盖。我们从美国社区调查中使用的差异比较模型和事件研究模型得出的估计结果显示，2010年后，21至25岁的同性伴侣中的男性拥有健康保险的可能性显著高于27至31岁的同性伴侣中的男性。这种增加主要集中在雇主赞助的保险上，并且这种影响在时间段和年龄组的排列组合中仍然成立。对于同性伴侣中的女性和异性伴侣中的男性来说，这种影响小于同性伴侣中男性所体现的影响。这些发现证实了扩大依赖者保险覆盖范围的广泛影响，并表明取消联邦依赖者保险要求可能会降低同性伴侣中年轻性少数群体的健康保险覆盖率。

abstract.text: We study the response of an economy to an unexpected epidemic. Households mitigate the spread of the disease by reducing consumption, reducing hours worked, and working from home. Working from home is subject to learning-by-doing and the capacity of the health care system is limited. A social planner worries about two externalities, an infection externality and a healthcare congestion externality. Private agents’ mitigation incentives are too weak and suﬀer from a fatalism bias with respect to future infection rates. The planner implements front-loaded mitigation policies and encourages working from home immediately. In our calibration, assuming a CFR of 1% and an initial infection rate of 0.1%, private mitigation reduces the cumulative death rate from 2.5% of the initially susceptible population to about 1.75%. The planner optimally imposes a drastic suppression policy and reduces the death rate to 0.15% at the cost of an initial drop in consumption of around 25%.

10.3386/w26984.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个经济体对意外疫情的反应。家庭通过减少消费、缩短工作时间以及在家工作来减缓疾病的传播。在家工作受到实践学习的限制，而医疗系统的能力也是有限的。社会规划者需要应对两个外部性：感染外部性和医疗拥堵外部性。私人主体的缓解动机过于薄弱，并且对未来感染率的预期存在宿命主义倾向。规划者实施了提前的缓解政策，并立即鼓励在家工作。在我们的校准中，假设感染率为1%，初始感染率为0.1%，私人缓解措施将累计死亡率从最初易感人群的2.5%降低到约1.75%。规划者最优地实施了严厉的抑制政策，将死亡率降低到0.15%，但代价是消费量在初期会下降约25%。

abstract.text: The outbreak of COVID-19 has significantly disrupted the economy. This paper attempts to quantify the macroeconomic impact of costly and deadly disasters in recent US history, and to translate these estimates into an analysis of the likely impact of COVID-19. A costly disaster series is constructed over the sample 1980:1-2020:04 and the dynamic impact of a disaster shock on economic activity and on uncertainty is studied using a VAR. While past natural disasters are local in nature and come and go quickly, COVID-19 is a global, multi-period event. We therefore study the dynamic responses to a sequence of large disaster shocks. Even in a fairly conservative case where COVID-19 is a 5-month shock with its magnitude calibrated by the cost of March 2020 Coronavirus relief packages, the shock is forecast to lead to a cumulative loss in industrial production of 20% and in service sector employment of nearly 39% or 55 million jobs over the next 12 months. For each month that a shock of a given magnitude is prolonged from the base case, heightened macro uncertainty persists for another month.

10.3386/w26987.abstractZh: COVID-19的爆发严重扰乱了经济。本文试图量化美国近代历史上那些代价高昂且致命的灾难对宏观经济的影响，并将这些估计结果转化为对COVID-19可能影响的分析。本文构建了一个涵盖1980:1至2020:04期间的代价高昂的灾难序列，并使用VAR模型研究了灾难冲击对经济活动和不确定性的动态影响。虽然过去的自然灾害具有局部性，且来去迅速，但COVID-19是一个全球性的、多时期的事件。因此，我们研究了对一系列重大灾难冲击的动态反应。即使在较为保守的情况下，假设COVID-19是一个持续5个月的冲击，其严重程度根据2020年3月的冠状病毒救助计划成本来估算，预计该冲击将在未来12个月内导致工业生产损失20%，服务行业就业减少近39%，即约5500万个就业岗位受到影响。对于从基准情况开始，冲击持续某一时间的每个月，宏观经济的不确定性将持续另一个月。

abstract.text: Recent evidence suggests that the short-term transition of the opioid crisis from prescription opioids to heroin can be attributed to the reformulation of OxyContin, which substantially reduced access to abusable prescription opioids. In this paper, we find that over a longer time horizon, reformulation stimulated illicit drug markets to grow and evolve. We compare overdose trajectories in areas more exposed to reformulation, defined as states with higher rates of non-medical OxyContin use before reformulation, to less exposed areas. More exposed areas experienced disproportionate increases in fatal overdoses involving synthetic opioids (fentanyl) and non-opioid substances like cocaine, suggesting that these new epidemics are related to the same factors driving the rise in heroin deaths. Instead of just short-term substitution from prescription opioid to heroin overdoses, the transition to illicit markets spurred by reformulation led to growth in the overall overdose rate to unprecedented levels.

10.3386/w26988.abstractZh: 最新证据表明，阿片类药物危机从处方阿片类药物向海洛因的短期转变，可以归因于奥施康定重新配方的改变，这一改变大大减少了可滥用的处方阿片类药物的获取途径。本文发现，在更长的时间范围内，这种重新配方行为刺激了非法毒品市场的增长和演变。我们比较了在更易受到重新配方影响的地区与较少受到影响的地区的过量用药情况。更易受到影响的地区出现了涉及合成阿片类药物（芬太尼）和非阿片类药物（如可卡因）的致命过量事件的增加，这表明这些新的流行病与导致海洛因死亡上升的相同因素有关。不仅仅是处方阿片类药物向海洛因过量用药的短期替代，由重新配方引发的非法市场增长也导致了整体过量用药率达到前所未有的水平。

abstract.text: In addition to its impact on public health, COVID-19 has had a major impact on the economy. To shed light on how COVID-19 is affecting small businesses – and on the likely impact of the recent stimulus bill, we conducted a survey of more than 5,800 small businesses. Several main themes emerge from the results. First, mass layoffs and closures have already occurred. In our sample, 43 percent of businesses are temporarily closed, and businesses have – on average – reduced their employee counts by 40 percent relative to January. Second, consistent with previous literature, we find that many small businesses are financially fragile. For example, the median business has more than $10,000 in monthly expenses and less than one month of cash on hand. Third, businesses have widely varying beliefs about the likely duration of COVID related disruptions. Fourth, the majority of businesses planned to seek funding through the CARES act. However, many anticipated problems with accessing the aid, such as bureaucratic hassles and difficulties establishing eligibility.

10.3386/w26989.abstractZh: 除了对公共健康的影响外，COVID-19还对经济产生了重大影响。为了了解COVID-19如何影响小型企业，以及近期刺激法案可能带来的影响，我们对5800多家小型企业进行了调查。调查结果揭示了几个主要问题。首先，大规模裁员和关闭现象已经出现。在我们的样本中，43%的企业暂时关闭，企业员工数量平均减少了40%，与1月份相比。其次，与以往的研究一致，我们发现许多小型企业在财务上非常脆弱。例如，大多数企业的月支出超过1万美元，而手头现金不足一个月。第三，企业对COVID相关中断的持续时间持有不同的看法。第四，大多数企业计划通过CARES法案寻求资金支持。然而，许多企业担心在获取援助时会遇到各种问题，如官僚程序繁琐以及难以确定是否符合援助条件。

abstract.text: We use aggregated data from Facebook to show that COVID-19 was more likely to spread between regions with stronger social network connections. Areas with more social ties to two early COVID-19 “hotspots” (Westchester County, NY, in the U.S. and Lodi province in Italy) generally had more confirmed COVID-19 cases as of the end of March. These relationships hold after controlling for geographic distance to the hotspots as well as for the income and population densities of the regions. As the pandemic progressed in the U.S., a county's social proximity to recent COVID- 19 cases predicts future outbreaks over and above physical proximity. These results suggest data from online social networks can be useful to epidemiologists and others hoping to forecast the spread of communicable diseases such as COVID-19.

10.3386/w26990.abstractZh: 我们利用Facebook的聚合数据表明，COVID-19在社交网络联系更紧密的地区更容易传播。在3月底时，与美国纽约州韦斯特切斯特县和意大利洛迪省这两个早期COVID-19“热点地区”社交联系更紧密的地区，确诊病例数量通常更多。即使在控制了与热点地区的地理距离以及这些地区的收入水平和人口密度后，这种关系仍然成立。随着美国疫情的发展，一个县与最近的COVID-19病例的社交接近程度，可以预测未来的疫情爆发情况，而不仅仅是物理上的接近程度。这些结果表明，来自在线社交网络的数据对流行病学家以及其他希望预测像COVID-19这样的传染病传播情况的人来说非常有用。

abstract.text: On March 19, 2020, California Governor Gavin Newsom issued Executive Order N-33-20 2020, which required all residents of the state of California to shelter in place for all but essential activities such as grocery shopping, retrieving prescriptions from a pharmacy, or caring for relatives. This shelter-in-place order (SIPO), the first such statewide order issued in the United States, was designed to reduce COVID-19 cases and mortality. While the White House Task Force on the Coronavirus has credited the State of California for taking early action to prevent a statewide COVID-19 outbreak, no study has examined its impact. This study is the first to estimate the effect of SIPO adoption on health. Using daily state-level coronavirus data and a synthetic control research design, we find that California’s statewide SIPO reduced COVID-19 cases by 125.5 to 219.7 per 100,000 population by April 20, one month following the order. We further find that California’s SIPO led to as many as 1,661 fewer COVID-19 deaths during this period. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that there were about 400 job losses per life saved during this short-run post-treatment period.

10.3386/w26992.abstractZh: 2020年3月19日，加利福尼亚州州长加文·纽森发布了第N-33-20号行政命令，要求该州所有居民在除购物、取药或照顾亲属等必要活动外，必须居家避静。这一居家避静令是美国首次在全州范围内实施的此类措施，旨在减少COVID-19病例和死亡率。虽然白宫冠状病毒工作组称赞加利福尼亚州采取了早期行动以防止全州范围的COVID-19疫情爆发，但尚无研究对其影响进行探讨。本研究首次估算了居家避静令实施对健康的效应。通过利用每日的州级冠状病毒数据以及合成控制研究设计，我们发现，在命令实施一个月后的4月20日，加利福尼亚州的居家避静令使每10万人口中的COVID-19病例减少了125.5至219.7例。此外，研究发现，在此期间，加利福尼亚州的居家避静令导致COVID-19死亡人数减少了1,661人。粗略计算表明，在这一短期治疗后期间，每挽救一条生命，大约有400个工作岗位得以保留。

abstract.text: Do consumers show a strong bias toward low deductible insurance plans, as many field studies imply? This paper reports on a controlled experiment intended to see whether subjects have a predisposition toward such plans and whether that preference is consistent when their default plan and premiums are changed. Subjects were presented with a scenario where they had to make a decision on whether to purchase a plan with a low deductible (LD) or high deductible (HD) when faced with an illness having a specified probability and cost. Participants had to choose between these plans in two rounds with the identical risk of an illness and specified premiums. If their default option was an LD plan in Round 1, then it was an HD plan in Round 2. The experiment did not show a strong bias toward low deductible health plans. Only slightly more than half of the respondents chose an LD plan even when it was optimal for them to do so. When faced with a default option that was switched in Round 2, 58% of the respondents chose the same plan as they did in Round 1, implying that some but not all subjects resisted the default option in their decision process. Subject choices were correlated with their responses to questions about risk aversion and a desire for peace of mind.

10.3386/w26994.abstractZh: 消费者是否像许多实地研究所暗示的那样，对低免赔额保险计划表现出强烈的偏好？本文报告了一项对照实验，旨在探讨受试者是否倾向于这类计划，以及当默认计划和保费发生变化时，这种偏好是否仍然持续。实验情境中，受试者需要决定在面临一定概率和成本的疾病时，是否购买低免赔额或高免赔额的保险计划。参与者需要在两轮选择中，在相同的疾病风险和指定保费条件下，选择这两种计划之一。如果第一轮选择的默认计划是低免赔额计划，那么第二轮选择的计划就会是高免赔额计划。实验并未显示出对低免赔额健康计划的强烈偏好。即使对于最理想的选择，也只有略多于一半的受访者选择了低免赔额计划。当第二轮选择的默认计划发生变化时，58%的受访者仍然选择了与第一轮相同的计划，这表明部分受试者在其决策过程中抵制了默认选项。受试者的选择与他们对于风险规避和寻求安心感的回答之间存在相关性。

abstract.text: There is an active debate about how to regulate electronic cigarettes, due to uncertainty about their health effects and whether they are primarily a quit aid or a gateway drug for combustible cigarettes. We model optimal e-cigarette regulation and estimate key parameters. Using tax changes and scanner data, we estimate relatively elastic demand. A demographic shift-share identification strategy suggests limited substitution between e-cigarettes and cigarettes. We field a new survey of public health experts, who report that vaping is more harmful than previously believed. In our model’s average Monte Carlo simulation, these results imply that optimal e-cigarette taxes are higher than recent norms. However, e-cigarette subsidies may be optimal if vaping is a stronger substitute for smoking and is safer than our experts report, or if consumers overestimate the health harms from vaping.

10.3386/w27000.abstractZh: 关于如何监管电子香烟，目前存在激烈的争论，因为人们对它们的健康影响以及它们究竟是戒烟辅助工具还是点燃香烟的入门工具存在不确定性。我们建立了电子香烟监管的最优模型，并估算了关键参数。通过税收变化以及扫描数据，我们发现需求具有相对弹性。人口统计变化分享识别策略表明，电子香烟与香烟之间的替代性有限。我们对公共卫生专家进行了新的调查，他们报告称，吸电子烟的危害比之前认为的更大。在我们的模型平均蒙特卡洛模拟中，这些结果表明，最优的电子香烟税收应高于当前的标准。然而，如果吸电子烟是比吸烟更有效的替代品，并且比专家报告的安全性更高，或者如果消费者高估了吸电子烟对健康的危害，那么对电子香烟提供补贴可能是最优的。

abstract.text: While economic theories indicate that market power by downstream ﬁrms can potentially counteract market power upstream, antitrust policy is opaque about whether to incorporate countervailing market power in merger analyses. We use detailed national claims data from the healthcare sector to evaluate whether countervailing insurer power does indeed limit hospitals’ exercise of market power. We estimate willingness-to-pay models to evaluate hospital market power across analysis areas. We ﬁnd that countervailing market power is important: a typical hospital merger would raise hospital prices 4.3% at the 25th percentile of insurer concentration but only 0.97% at the 75th percentile of insurer concentration.

10.3386/w27005.abstractZh: 虽然经济理论表明，下游企业的市场力量有可能抵消上游企业的市场力量，但反垄断政策对于是否在合并分析中考虑这种抵消性市场力量尚不明确。我们利用医疗领域的详细全国索赔数据，来评估抵消性保险公司力量是否确实限制了医院的市场力量行使。我们通过估计支付意愿模型来评估医院在不同分析领域的市场力量。我们发现，抵消性市场力量非常重要：在保险公司集中度处于第25百分位的情况下，典型的医院合并会导致医院价格上涨4.3%，而在保险公司集中度处于第75百分位的情况下，这一比例仅为0.97%。

abstract.text: This paper provides a critical review of models of the spread of the coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) epidemic that have been influential in recent policy decisions. There is tremendous opportunity for social scientists to advance the relevant literature as new and better data becomes available to bolster economic outcomes and save lives.

10.3386/w27007.abstractZh: 本文对近年来在政策决策中具有重要影响力的冠状病毒（SARS-CoV-2）疫情传播模型进行了批判性回顾。随着新的、更可靠的数据出现，社会科学家有巨大的机会推进相关研究，以更好地支持经济成果并挽救生命。

abstract.text: Even when, objectively speaking, death is on the line, partisan bias still colors beliefs about facts. We show that a higher share of Trump voters in a county is associated with lower perceptions of risk during the COVID-19 pandemic. As Trump voter share rises, individuals search less for information on the virus, and engage in less social distancing behavior, as measured by smartphone location patterns. These patterns persist in the face of state-level mandates to close schools and businesses or to “stay home,” and reverse only when conservative politicians are exposed and the White House releases federal social distancing guidelines.

10.3386/w27008.abstractZh: 即使从客观角度来看，死亡风险确实存在，党派偏见仍然影响着人们对事实的认知。我们发现，在COVID-19疫情期间，某个县的特朗普支持者比例越高，他们对风险的感知就越低。随着特朗普支持者比例的增加，人们搜索关于病毒的信息的频率降低，并且通过智能手机的位置数据来体现的社会距离行为也减少。这些现象在州政府要求关闭学校和企业或要求“居家”的情况下仍然存在，只有当保守派政客受到批评且白宫发布联邦社会距离指南时，这些现象才会逆转。

abstract.text: We analyze the externalities that arise when social and economic interactions transmit infectious diseases such as COVID-19. Individually rational agents do not internalize that they impose infection externalities upon others when the disease is transmitted. In an SIR model calibrated to capture the main features of COVID-19 in the US economy, we show that private agents perceive the cost an additional infection to be around $80k whereas the social cost including infection externalities is more than three times higher, around $286k. This misvaluation has stark implications for how society ultimately overcomes the disease: for a population of individually rational agents, the precautionary behavior by the susceptible flattens the curve of infections, but the disease is not overcome until herd immunity is acquired. The resulting economic cost is high; an initial sharp decline in aggregate output followed by a slow recovery over several years. By contrast, the socially optimal approach in our model focuses public policy measures on the infected in order to contain the disease and quickly eradicate it, which produces a much milder recession. If targeting the infected is impossible, the optimal policy in our model is still to aggressively contain and eliminate the disease, and the social cost of an extra infection rises to $586k.

10.3386/w27009.abstractZh: 我们分析了在社交和经济互动传播如COVID-19等传染病时产生的外部性。个体理性的行为者不会意识到他们在疾病传播过程中对他人造成了感染外部性。在一个经过校准以捕捉美国经济中COVID-19主要特征的SIR模型中，我们发现私人行为者认为额外感染的代价约为8万美元，而包括感染外部性在内的社会成本则高出三倍多，约为28.6万美元。这种误估对社会最终克服疾病的方式有着重要的影响：对于个体理性的行为者群体而言，易感人群的预防行为可以压低感染曲线，但直到获得群体免疫后，疾病才能被彻底控制。由此产生的经济成本很高；先是总产出出现急剧下降，随后在数年内缓慢恢复。相比之下，我们模型中的社会最优方法是将公共政策重点放在感染者身上，以控制疾病并迅速根除它，这样可以使经济衰退程度减轻许多。如果针对感染者是不可能的，我们模型中的最优政策仍然是积极控制并消除疾病，此时额外感染的的社会成本上升到58.6万美元。

abstract.text: Using the 2012-13 American Time Use Survey, I find that both who people spend time with and how they spend it affect their happiness, adjusted for numerous demographic and economic variables. Satisfaction among married individuals increases most with additional time spent with spouse. Among singles, satisfaction decreases most as more time is spent alone. Assuming that lock-downs constrain married people to spend time solely with their spouses, simulations show that their happiness may have been increased compared to before the lock-downs; but sufficiently large losses of work time and income reverse this inference. Simulations demonstrate clearly that, assuming lock-downs impose solitude on singles, their happiness was reduced, reductions that are made more severe by income and work losses.

10.3386/w27018.abstractZh: 通过2012-13年的美国时间使用调查数据，我发现人们与谁相处以及如何度过时间都会影响其幸福感，这一结论是在考虑了众多人口统计和经济变量之后得出的。已婚人士的满意度随着与配偶相处时间的增加而显著提升。而对于单身人士来说，随着独处时间的增加，满意度则显著下降。假设封锁措施迫使已婚人士只能与配偶相处，模拟结果显示，他们的幸福感可能比封锁措施实施前有所提高；但工作时间和收入的显著损失则使得这一推断变得不成立。模拟结果清楚地表明，如果封锁措施迫使单身人士陷入孤独状态，他们的幸福感将会下降，而且这种下降会因收入和工作的损失而变得更加严重。

abstract.text: New York City’s multipronged subway system was a major disseminator – if not the principal transmission vehicle – of coronavirus infection during the initial takeoff of the massive epidemic that became evident throughout the city during March 2020. The near shutoff of subway ridership in Manhattan – down by over 90 percent at the end of March – correlates strongly with the substantial increase in the doubling time of new cases in this borough. Subway lines with the largest drop in ridership during the second and third weeks of March had the lowest subsequent rates of infection in the zip codes traversed by their routes. Maps of subway station turnstile entries, superimposed upon zip code-level maps of reported coronavirus incidence, are strongly consistent with subway-facilitated disease propagation. Reciprocal seeding of infection appears to be the best explanation for the emergence of a single hotspot in Midtown West in Manhattan.

10.3386/w27021.abstractZh: 纽约市的地铁系统在2020年3月大规模疫情初期，不仅是新冠病毒传播的主要渠道，更是传播的主要载体。当时曼哈顿的地铁乘客数量几乎骤减，到3月底时减少了90%以上，这一情况与该行政区新病例的倍增时间显著延长密切相关。在3月第二周和第三周，乘客数量下降最严重的地铁线路，其沿线邮政编码区域的感染率也最低。将地铁站闸机入口的地图与按邮政编码划分的新冠病毒发病率地图叠加后，可以发现地铁系统在疾病传播中起到了重要作用。相互传染的现象似乎可以解释为什么曼哈顿中城西部会出现一个单一的高风险区域。

abstract.text: As a consequence of missing data on tests for infection and imperfect accuracy of tests, reported rates of population infection by the SARS CoV-2 virus are lower than actual rates of infection. Hence, reported rates of severe illness conditional on infection are higher than actual rates. Understanding the time path of the COVID-19 pandemic has been hampered by the absence of bounds on infection rates that are credible and informative. This paper explains the logical problem of bounding these rates and reports illustrative findings, using data from Illinois, New York, and Italy. We combine the data with assumptions on the infection rate in the untested population and on the accuracy of the tests that appear credible in the current context. We find that the infection rate might be substantially higher than reported. We also find that the infection fatality rate in Italy is substantially lower than reported.

10.3386/w27023.abstractZh: 由于缺乏关于感染检测的数据以及检测结果的准确性不足，因此根据SARS CoV-2病毒所报告的人口感染率低于实际感染率。因此，根据感染情况所报告的重症发生率高于实际发生率。由于缺乏可信且具有参考价值的感染率界限，对COVID-19大流行的演变过程的理解受到了阻碍。本文解释了界定这些感染率的逻辑问题，并基于伊利诺伊州、纽约州和意大利的数据提出了有说服力的发现。我们将这些数据与未经过检测的人群中的感染率假设以及在当前情况下被认为可信的检测准确性假设相结合。我们发现，感染率可能远高于报告的数据。此外，我们还发现意大利的感染死亡率远低于报告的数据。

abstract.text: This paper examines the determinants of social distancing during the COVID-19 epidemic. We classify state and local government actions, and we study multiple proxies for social distancing based on data from smart devices. Mobility fell substantially in all states, even ones that have not adopted major distancing mandates. There is little evidence, for example, that stay-at-home mandates induced distancing. In contrast, early and information-focused actions have had bigger effects. Event studies show that first case announcements, emergency declarations, and school closures reduced mobility by 1-5% after 5 days and 7-45% after 20 days. Between March 1 and April 11, average time spent at home grew from 9.1 hours to 13.9 hours. We find, for example, that without state emergency declarations, event study estimates imply that hours at home would have been 11.3 hours in April, suggesting that 55% of the growth comes from emergency declarations and 45% comes from secular (non-policy) trends. State and local government actions induced changes in mobility on top of a large response across all states to the prevailing knowledge of public health risks. Early state policies conveyed information about the epidemic, suggesting that even the policy response mainly operates through a voluntary channel.

10.3386/w27027.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在COVID-19疫情期间社会隔离行为的决定因素。我们分类了州和地方政府的相关措施，并基于智能设备的数据研究了多种社会隔离的替代指标。所有州的移动性都显著下降，即使那些没有实施严格隔离规定的州也是如此。例如，几乎没有证据表明居家令能够引发社会隔离。相反，早期且以信息为导向的措施产生了更大的效果。事件研究表明，首次病例公告、紧急状态宣布以及学校关闭措施在5天后使移动性减少了1-5%，在20天后减少了7-45%。从3月1日到4月11日，平均在家时间从9.1小时增加到13.9小时。例如，如果没有州级紧急状态宣布，根据事件研究的估计，4月份在家时间本应达到11.3小时，这表明55%的增长来自紧急状态宣布，45%来自长期趋势。州和地方政府的相关措施不仅改变了移动性，还促使所有州对公共卫生风险的认识产生了广泛反应。早期的州政策传达了有关疫情的信息，这表明政策响应主要是通过自愿渠道进行的。

abstract.text: We develop an analytically tractable method to estimate the fraction of unreported infections in epidemics with a known epicenter and estimate the number of unreported COVID-19 infections in the US during the first half of March 2020. Our method utilizes the covariation in initial reported infections across US regions and the number of travelers to these regions from the epicenter, along with the results of an early randomized testing study in Iceland. Using our estimates of the number of unreported infections, which are substantially larger than the number of reported infections, we also provide estimates for the infection fatality rate using data on reported COVID-19 fatalities from U.S. counties.

10.3386/w27028.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种分析上可行的方法，用于估计具有已知疫情中心的情况下未报告感染的比例，并估算2020年3月上半期美国未报告的COVID-19感染数量。我们的方法利用了美国各地区初始报告感染病例之间的共变关系，以及从疫情中心前往这些地区的旅行者数量，并结合了冰岛早期随机检测研究的结果。通过我们对未报告感染数量的估算（该数量远高于报告感染数量），我们还利用美国各县的COVID-19死亡病例数据，估算了感染死亡率。

abstract.text: Over the last two decades, there has been a surge of opioid-related overdose deaths resulting in a myriad of state policy responses. Researchers have evaluated the effectiveness of such policies using a wide-range of statistical models, each of which requires multiple design choices that can influence the accuracy and precision of the estimated policy effects. This simulation study used real-world data to compare model performance across a range of important statistical constructs to better understand which methods are appropriate for measuring the impacts of state-level opioid policies on opioid-related mortality. Our findings show that many commonly-used methods have very low statistical power to detect a significant policy effect (< 10%) when the policy effect size is small yet impactful (e.g., 5% reduction in opioid mortality). Many methods yielded high rates of Type I error, raising concerns of spurious conclusions about policy effectiveness. Finally, model performance was reduced when policy effectiveness had incremental, rather than instantaneous, onset. These findings highlight the limitations of existing statistical methods under scenarios that are likely to affect real-world policy studies. Given the necessity of identifying and implementing effective opioid-related policies, researchers and policymakers should be mindful of evaluation study statistical design.

10.3386/w27029.abstractZh: 在过去的二十年里，与阿片类药物相关的过量死亡事件激增，这引发了各州政策的广泛响应。研究人员使用多种统计模型来评估这些政策的有效性，而每种模型都需要进行多种设计选择，这些选择可能会影响对政策效果估计的准确性和精确度。这项模拟研究利用真实数据来比较不同统计模型的表现，以更好地了解哪些方法适合衡量州级阿片类药物政策对阿片类药物相关死亡率的影响。我们的研究发现，许多常用方法的统计功效非常低，无法检测到显著的政策效果（小于10%），即使政策效果的大小较小但具有影响力（例如，阿片类药物死亡率降低5%）。许多方法出现了较高的第一类错误率，这引发了关于政策效果的结论是否可靠的担忧。此外，当政策效果的出现是渐进性的而非瞬时性的时，模型的表现也会下降。这些发现凸显了现有统计方法在可能影响现实世界政策研究的情景下的局限性。鉴于识别和实施有效的阿片类药物相关政策的必要性，研究人员和政策制定者应当注意评估研究的统计设计。

abstract.text: In numerous high stakes markets skilled experts play a key role in facilitating consumer choice of complex products. New artificial intelligence (AI) technologies are increasingly being used to augment expert decisions. We study the role of technology and expertise in the market for health insurance, where consumer choices are widely known to be sub-optimal. Our analysis leverages the large-scale implementation of an AI-based decision support tool in a private Medicare exchange where consumers are randomized to skilled agents over time. We find that, prior to AI-based technology, skilled experts in this market exhibit the same type of inconsistent behavior found in previous studies of individual choices, costing consumers $1260 on average. The addition of AI-based decision support improves outcomes by $278 on average and substantially reduces heterogeneity in broker performance. Experts efficiently synthesize private information, incorporating AI-based recommendations along dimensions that are well suited to AI (e.g. total expected patient costs), but overruling AI-based recommendations along dimensions for which humans are better suited (e.g. specifics of doctor networks). As a result, switching plans, an ex-post measure of plan satisfaction, is meaningfully lower for agents making AI-based recommendations. While AI is a complement to skill on average, we find that it is a substitute across the skill distribution; lower quality agents provide better recommendations with AI than the top agents did without it. Overall productivity rises, with the introduction of decision support associated with a 21% reduction in call time for enrollment.

10.3386/w27038.abstractZh: 在许多高风险市场中，熟练的专家在促进消费者选择复杂产品方面发挥着关键作用。新的人工智能技术越来越多地被用于辅助专家决策。我们研究了在健康保险市场中，技术和专业知识的作用，该市场的消费者选择普遍被认为是不理想的。我们的分析利用了在私人医疗保险交易平台上大规模实施基于人工智能的决策支持工具的情况，消费者被随机分配到不同的熟练代理人手中。我们发现，在引入基于人工智能的技术之前，该市场中的熟练专家表现出与先前关于个体选择的研究中发现的相同类型的不一致行为，平均使消费者损失1260美元。引入基于人工智能的决策支持后，平均改善了278美元的结果，并显著减少了经纪人的表现差异。专家能够高效地整合私人信息，将基于人工智能的建议纳入适合人工智能的维度（例如，预期总患者成本），但在那些人类更擅长的维度上则推翻了基于人工智能的建议（例如，医生网络的具体信息）。因此，对于提供基于人工智能建议的代理人来说，计划更换的满意度指标明显较低。虽然人工智能平均而言是对技能的补充，但我们发现它在整个技能分布中起到了替代作用；质量较低的代理人提供的建议比没有人工智能的顶级代理人更好。整体生产力有所提高，引入决策支持后，注册时间减少了21%。

abstract.text: This paper considers a modification of the standard Susceptible-Infected-Recovered (SIR) model of epidemic that allows for different degrees of compulsory as well as voluntary social distancing. It is shown that the fraction of population that self-isolates varies with the perceived probability of contracting the disease. Implications of social distancing both on the epidemic and recession curves are investigated and their trade off is simulated under a number of different social distancing and economic participation scenarios. We show that mandating social distancing is very effective at flattening the epidemic curve, but is costly in terms of employment loss. However, if targeted towards individuals most likely to spread the infection, the employment loss can be somewhat reduced. We also show that voluntary self-isolation driven by individual’s perceived risk of becoming infected kicks in only towards the peak of the epidemic and has little or no impact on flattening the epidemic curve. Using available statistics and correcting for measurement errors, we estimate the rate of exposure to COVID-19 for 21 Chinese provinces and a selected number of countries. The exposure rates are generally small, but vary considerably between Hubei and other Chinese provinces as well as across countries. Strikingly, the exposure rate in Hubei province is around 40 times larger than the rates for other Chinese provinces, with the exposure rates for some European countries being 3-5 times larger than Hubei (the epicenter of the epidemic). The paper also provides country-specific estimates of the recovery rate, showing it to be about 21 days (a week longer than the 14 days typically assumed), and relatively homogeneous across Chinese provinces and for a selected number of countries.

10.3386/w27039.abstractZh: 本文对标准的易感者-感染者-康复者(SIR)模型进行了修改，该模型允许不同程度的强制性和自愿性社交隔离。研究表明，自我隔离的人口比例会随着感染疾病的感知概率而变化。本文探讨了社交隔离对疫情曲线和经济衰退曲线的影响，并在多种不同的社交隔离和经济参与情景下模拟了这种权衡。我们发现，强制实施社交隔离在平抑疫情曲线方面非常有效，但会导致就业损失。然而，如果针对那些最有可能传播感染的个体，就业损失可以有所减少。此外，由个体感知到的感染风险驱动的自愿自我隔离仅在疫情高峰期发挥作用，对平抑疫情曲线的影响很小或几乎没有。通过利用现有统计数据并纠正测量误差，我们估计了21个中国省份和若干国家的COVID-19暴露率。暴露率通常较低，但在湖北与其他中国省份之间以及不同国家之间差异显著。值得注意的是，湖北的暴露率约为其他中国省份的40倍，而一些欧洲国家的暴露率是湖北的3-5倍（湖北是疫情的中心）。本文还提供了各国特定的康复率估计，显示康复期约为21天（比通常假设的14天长一周），并且在中国各省和若干国家中相对一致。

abstract.text: What would a hypothetical one million US deaths in the Covid-19 epidemic mean for mortality of individuals at the population level? To put estimates of Covid-19 mortality into perspective, we estimate age-specific mortality for an epidemic claiming for illustrative purposes one million US lives, with results scalable over a broad range of deaths. We calculate the impact on period life expectancy (down 3 years) and remaining life-years (12.3 years per death), which for one million deaths can be valued at six to 10 trillion dollars. The age-patterns of Covid-19 mortality observed in other countries are remarkably similar and exhibit the typical rate of increase by age of normal mortality. The scenario of one million Covid-19 deaths is similar in scale to the decades-long HIV/AIDS and opioid-overdose epidemics but considerably smaller than the Spanish Flu of 1918. Unlike HIV/AIDS and opioid epidemics, the Covid-19 deaths will be concentrated in months rather than spread out over decades.

10.3386/w27043.abstractZh: 如果新冠疫情期间有100万美国人死亡，这对整个人口群体的死亡率意味着什么？为了更好地理解新冠死亡率的估计值，我们针对一个导致100万美国人死亡的疫情，计算了不同年龄段的死亡率。结果显示，这一疫情对人均预期寿命的影响为减少3年，每死亡一人会导致剩余寿命减少12.3年。对于100万死亡病例来说，这一损失的价值在6万亿到10万亿美元之间。其他国家观察到的新冠死亡率的年龄分布非常相似，呈现出与正常死亡率相同的随年龄增长而增加的趋势。100万新冠死亡病例的规模与持续数十年的艾滋病和阿片类药物过量流行病相当，但远小于1918年的西班牙流感。与艾滋病和阿片类药物过量流行病不同，新冠死亡病例将集中在几个月内，而不是在几十年间逐渐扩散。

abstract.text: To slow the spread of the COVID-19 virus, many countries shut down parts of the economy. Older individuals have the most to gain from slowing virus diffusion. Younger workers in sectors that are shuttered have most to lose. We build a model in which economic activity and disease progression are jointly determined. Individuals differ by age (young, retired), by sector (basic, luxury), and by health status. Disease transmission occurs in the workplace, through consumption, at home, and in hospitals. We study the optimal economic mitigation policy for a government that can redistribute through taxes and transfers, but where taxation distorts labor supply. We show that shutdowns are optimally milder in 2020 when taxes are distortionary, and when the government does not have access to debt. A harder but shorter shutdown is preferred when vaccines become available in the first half of 2021.

10.3386/w27046.abstractZh: 为了减缓COVID-19病毒的传播，许多国家关闭了部分经济领域。年龄较大的人群从减缓病毒扩散中获益最多，而那些被关闭的行业中的年轻工人则损失最大。我们建立了一个模型，在该模型中，经济活动和疾病进展共同决定了结果。个体因年龄（年轻、退休）、行业（基础、奢侈）以及健康状况而有所不同。疾病传播发生在工作场所、消费活动、家庭以及医院中。我们研究了政府通过税收和转移支付进行再分配时的最佳经济缓解政策，但税收会扭曲劳动力供应。研究表明，在2020年，当税收具有扭曲性且政府无法获得债务时，较为温和的关闭措施是最优选择。而当疫苗在2021年上半年问世时，更严格但时间更短的关闭措施则更为理想。

abstract.text: In this paper, we argue that endogenous shifts in private consumption behavior across sectors of the economy can act as a potent mitigation mechanism during an epidemic or when the economy is re-opened after a temporary lockdown. We introduce a SIR epidemiological model into a neoclassical production economy in which goods are distinguished by the degree to which they can be consumed at home rather than in a social, possibly contagious context. We demonstrate that within the model the “Swedish solution” of letting the epidemic play out without government intervention and allowing agents to shift their consumption behavior towards relatively safe sectors can lead to substantial mitigation of the economic and human costs of the COVID-19 crisis. We estimate the model on Swedish health data and then show that compared to a model in which sectors are assumed to be homogeneous in their infection risk, as in Eichenbaum, Rebelo, and Trabandt (2020), endogenous sectoral reallocation avoids more than 2/3 of the decline in aggregate output and consumption, and at the same time induces a dynamics of weekly death that accords very well with the matching and of the number of deaths within one year. Our analysis implies case fatality rates below 0.2 percent and a limit of less than 800 deaths per million for Sweden. We also characterize the allocation a social planner would choose that can dictate sectoral consumption patterns and demonstrate that the laissez-faire outcome with sectoral reallocation, while mitigating the economic and health crisis, still implies suboptimally many deaths and too massive a decline in economic activity.

10.3386/w27047.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出私人消费行为在经济各领域的内生性转移可以在疫情期间或经济在临时封锁后重新开放时起到有效的缓解作用。我们将SIR流行病学模型引入到新古典生产经济模型中，其中商品根据其可在家中消费的程度来区分，而不是在可能具有传染性的社交环境中消费。我们证明，在模型中，采用“瑞典解决方案”——即让疫情自然发展，不采取政府干预措施，并允许消费者将消费行为转向相对安全的领域——可以显著减轻COVID-19危机带来的经济和人类损失。我们基于瑞典的健康数据对模型进行了估算，结果表明，与Eichenbaum、Rebelo和Trabandt（2020）提出的假设各领域感染风险均质的模型相比，内生性的部门重新分配避免了超过三分之二的总产出和消费下降，同时使得每周的死亡人数与一年内的死亡人数相匹配。我们的分析表明，该模型的死亡率低于0.2%，瑞典的死亡人数限制在每百万人800人以下。我们还描述了社会规划者可能会选择的分配方案，该方案可以指导部门消费模式，并证明，尽管这种自由放任的结果通过部门重新分配缓解了经济和健康危机，但死亡人数仍然较多，经济活动的下降幅度也过大。

abstract.text: A key issue for the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic is whether non-pharmaceutical public-health interventions (NPIs) retard death rates. Good information about these effects comes from flu-related excess deaths in large U.S. cities during the second wave of the Great Influenza Pandemic, September 1918-February 1919. NPIs, as measured by an extension of Markel, et al. (2007), are in three categories: school closings, prohibitions on public gatherings, and quarantine/isolation. Although an increase in NPIs flattened the curve in the sense of reducing the ratio of peak to average death rates, the estimated effect on overall deaths is small and statistically insignificant. One possibility is that the NPIs were not more successful in curtailing overall mortality because the average duration of each type of NPI was only around one month. Another possibility is that NPIs mainly delay deaths rather than eliminating them.

10.3386/w27049.abstractZh: 当前COVID-19大流行的一个关键问题是，非药物性公共卫生干预措施是否能够减缓死亡率。关于这些影响的良好信息来自1918年9月至1919年2月大流感第二波期间美国大城市中流感相关的超额死亡情况。根据Markel等人（2007年）的研究，非药物性公共卫生干预措施分为三类：学校停课、禁止公共集会以及隔离措施。尽管这些干预措施在一定程度上降低了死亡率曲线，但其对总体死亡人数的影响较小，且统计上并不显著。一种可能性是，这些干预措施在遏制总体死亡率方面并不十分有效，因为每种干预措施的平均持续时间仅约为一个月。另一种可能性是，这些干预措施主要是延缓死亡，而非完全消除死亡。

abstract.text: The “shutdown” economy of April 2020 is compared to a normally functioning economy both in terms of market and nonmarket activities. Three novel methods and data indicate that the shutdown puts market production 25-28 percent below normal in the short run. At an annual rate, the shutdown is costing $7 trillion, or about $15,000 per household per quarter. Employment already fell 28 million by early April 2020. These costs indicate, among other things, the value of innovation in both health and general business sectors that can accelerate the time when normal activity resumes.

10.3386/w27060.abstractZh: 2020年4月的“停摆”经济与正常运作的经济在市场和非市场活动方面进行了比较。三种新的方法和数据表明，短期内市场生产量比正常水平低25-28%。以年度计算，这种停摆造成的损失为7万亿美元，相当于每个家庭每季度损失约15,000美元。到2020年4月初，就业人数已经减少了2800万。这些成本表明，在健康和商业领域，创新的重要性不容忽视，而创新可以加快恢复正常活动的进程。

abstract.text: This paper studies lockdown policy in a dynamic economy without government commitment. Lockdown imposes a cap on labor supply, which improves health prospects at the cost of economic output. A government would like to commit to the extent of future lockdowns in order to guarantee an economic outlook that supports efficient levels of investment into intermediate inputs. However, such a commitment is not credible since investments are sunk at the time when the government chooses a lockdown. As a result, lockdown under lack of commitment deviates from the optimal policy. Rules that limit a government’s lockdown discretion can improve social welfare, even in the presence of noncontractible information. Quantitatively, lack of commitment causes lockdown to be significantly more severe than is socially optimal. The output loss due to lack of commitment is greater for higher social discount rates, higher values of life, higher disease transmission rates, higher intermediate input shares, and longer vaccine arrival times.

10.3386/w27062.abstractZh: 本文研究了在没有政府承诺的动态经济环境中实施封锁政策的情况。封锁措施限制了劳动力供应，从而改善了健康状况，但代价是经济产出的下降。政府希望承诺在未来实施多少次封锁，以确保经济前景能够支持对中间投入的有效投资。然而，这种承诺并不可信，因为投资在政府决定实施封锁时就已经投入了。因此，在没有政府承诺的情况下实施封锁会偏离最优政策。限制政府封锁自由度的规则可以改善社会福利，即使存在不可契约的信息。从数量上看，缺乏承诺会导致封锁措施比社会最优方案更为严厉。在较高的社会折现率、更高的生命价值、更高的疾病传播率、更高的中间投入比例以及更长的疫苗等待时间的情况下，由于缺乏承诺而导致的产出损失会更大。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes a sequential approach to lifting interventions in the COVID-19 pandemic taking heterogeneity in the population into account. The population is heterogeneous in terms of the consequences of infection (need for hospitalization and critical care, and mortality) and in terms of labor force participation. Splitting the population in two groups by age, a less affected younger group that is more likely to work, and a more affected older group less likely to work, and lifting interventions sequentially (for the younger group first and the older group later on) can substantially reduce mortality, demands on the health care system, and the economic cost of interventions.

10.3386/w27063.abstractZh: 本文分析了在COVID-19疫情中采取的顺序性干预措施，同时考虑了人口的异质性。人口在感染后果方面存在差异，包括住院和重症监护的需求以及死亡率；在劳动力参与率方面也存在差异。通过将人口分为两组：一组是受感染较轻的年轻人群，他们更有可能工作；另一组是受感染较重的老年人群，他们不太可能工作。依次对这两组人群实施干预措施（先对年轻人群，后对老年人群）可以显著降低死亡率、医疗系统的负担以及干预措施的经济成本。

abstract.text: Emissions abatement alone cannot address the consequences of global warming for weather disasters. We model how society adapts to manage disaster risks to capital stock. Optimal adaptation—a mix of form-level efforts and public spending—varies as society learns about the adverse consequences of global warming for disaster arrivals. Taxes on capital are needed alongside those on carbon to achieve the first best. We apply our model to country-level control of flooding from tropical cyclones. Learning rationalizes empirical findings, including the responses of Tobin's q, equity risk premium, and risk-free rate to disaster arrivals. Adaptation is more valuable under learning than a counterfactual no-learning environment. Learning alters social-cost-of-carbon projections due to the interaction of uncertainty resolution and endogenous adaptive response.

10.3386/w27066.abstractZh: 单纯的减排措施无法解决全球变暖对天气灾害的影响。我们模拟了社会如何适应以管理对资本存量的灾害风险。最优的适应措施——包括形式层面的努力和公共支出——会随着社会逐渐了解全球变暖对灾害发生的影响而发生变化。除了对碳的征税之外，还需要对资本征税，以实现最佳效果。我们将模型应用于国家层面对热带气旋引发的洪水控制。学习过程有助于解释实证结果，包括托宾系数、股权风险溢价和无风险利率对灾害发生的反应。在缺乏学习的情况下，适应措施的价值更高。由于不确定性解决与内生性适应反应的相互作用，学习过程改变了社会对碳成本预测的看法。

abstract.text: Traveling beyond the immediate surroundings of one’s residence can lead to greater exposure to new ideas and information, jobs, and greater transmission of disease. In this paper, we document the geographic mobility of individuals in the U.S., and how this mobility varies across U.S. cities, regions, and income classes. Using geolocation data for ~1.7 million smartphone users over a 10-month period, we compute different measures of mobility, including the total distance traveled, the median daily distance traveled, the maximum distance traveled from one’s home, and the number of unique haunts visited. We find large differences across cities and income groups. For example, people in New York travel 38% fewer total kilometers and visit 14% fewer block-sized areas than people in Atlanta. And, individuals in the bottom income quartile travel 12% less overall and visit 13% fewer total locations than the top income quartile.

10.3386/w27072.abstractZh: 离开住所的周边环境，人们可能会接触到更多新的想法、信息、工作机会，以及疾病的传播。在本文中，我们记录了美国个人的地理流动性，以及这种流动性在美国不同城市、地区和经济阶层中的差异。通过利用约170万智能手机用户的10个月地理定位数据，我们计算了不同的流动性指标，包括总出行距离、日均出行距离、从住所出发的最大出行距离，以及访问的独特地点数量。我们发现不同城市和收入群体之间存在显著差异。例如，纽约人的总出行距离减少了38%，访问的街区面积也减少了14%。而处于最低收入阶层的人，总体出行距离减少了12%，访问的总地点数量也减少了13%。

abstract.text: How should the design of incentives vary with agent time preferences? We develop two predictions. First, “bundling” the payment function over time – specifically by making the payment for future effort increase in current effort – is more effective if individuals are impatient over effort. Second, increasing the frequency of payment is more effective if individuals are impatient over payment. We test the efficacy of time-bundling and payment frequency, and their interactions with impatience, using a randomized evaluation of an incentive program for exercise among diabetics in India. Consistent with our theoretical predictions, bundling payments over time meaningfully increases effort among the impatient relative to the patient. In contrast, increasing payment frequency has limited efficacy, suggesting limited impatience over payments. On average, incentives increase daily steps by 1,266 (13 minutes of brisk walking) and improve health.

10.3386/w27079.abstractZh: 激励设计应如何根据代理人的时间偏好进行调整？我们提出了两个预测。首先，将支付功能随时间“捆绑”——具体来说，通过使未来努力的支付随着当前努力的增加而增加——在个体对努力缺乏耐心的情况下更为有效。其次，如果个体对支付缺乏耐心，增加支付频率则更为有效。我们通过一项针对印度糖尿病患者的运动激励计划的随机评估，来测试时间捆绑和支付频率的有效性，以及它们与耐心程度之间的相互作用。与我们的理论预测一致，将支付随时间捆绑能够显著增加缺乏耐心的个体的努力程度，而相对患者而言则效果有限。相反，增加支付频率的效果有限，这表明个体对支付缺乏耐心的情况较少。平均而言，激励措施使每日步数增加了1,266步（相当于13分钟的快走），并改善了健康状况。

abstract.text: We conducted a large-scale survey covering 58 countries and over 100,000 respondents between late March and early April 2020 to study beliefs and attitudes towards citizens’ and governments’ responses to the COVID-19 pandemic. Most respondents reacted strongly to the crisis: they report engaging in social distancing and hygiene behaviors, and believe that strong policy measures, such as shop closures and curfews, are necessary. They also believe that their government and their country’s citizens are not doing enough and underestimate the degree to which others in their country support strong behavioral and policy responses to the pandemic. The perception of a weak government and public response is associated with higher levels of worries and depression. Using both cross-country panel data and an event-study, we additionally show that strong government reactions correct misperceptions, and reduce worries and depression. Our findings highlight that policy-makers not only need to consider how their decisions affect the spread of COVID-19, but also how such choices influence the mental health of their population.

10.3386/w27082.abstractZh: 我们在2020年3月底至4月初对58个国家超过100,000名受访者进行了大规模调查，以研究人们对公民和政府应对COVID-19疫情的看法和态度。大多数受访者对危机反应强烈：他们报告称采取了社交距离和卫生措施，并认为关闭商店和实施宵禁等强有力的政策措施是必要的。他们还认为政府和本国公民做得不够，并低估了本国其他人对采取强有力的行为和政策措施以应对疫情的支持程度。认为政府和公众反应薄弱的感知与更高的担忧和抑郁情绪相关。通过跨国面板数据和事件研究，我们还发现强有力的政府反应能够纠正误解，并减少担忧和抑郁情绪。我们的研究结果表明，政策制定者不仅需要考虑他们的决策如何影响COVID-19的传播，还需要考虑这些选择如何影响民众的心理健康。

abstract.text: Reductions in ambient pollution have been taken as an indisputable "silver lining" to the COVID-19 Pandemic. Indeed, worldwide economic contraction induced by COVID-19 lockdowns should generate global air quality improvements ceteris paribus, including to China's notoriously-poor air quality. We analyze China's official pollution monitor data and account for the large, recurrent improvement in air quality following Lunar New Year (LNY), which essentially coincided with lock-downs in 2020. With the important exception of NO2, China's air quality improvements in 2020 are smaller than we should expect near the pandemic's epicenter: Hubei province. Compared with LNY improvements experienced in 2018 and 2019 in Hubei, we see smaller improvements in SO2 while ozone concentrations increased in both relative and absolute terms (roughly doubling). Similar patterns are found for the six provinces neighboring Hubei. We conclude that COVID-19 had ambiguous impacts on China's pollution, with evidence of relative deterioration in air quality near the Pandemic's epicenter.

10.3386/w27086.abstractZh: 环境污染的减少被视为COVID-19大流行中的一个无可争议的“光明面”。事实上，由COVID-19封锁导致的全球经济收缩应该会在其他条件不变的情况下改善全球空气质量，包括中国那些历来空气质量较差的地区。我们分析了中国的官方污染监测数据，并考虑了农历新年之后空气质量显著改善的情况，这一变化基本上与2020年的封锁措施相吻合。除了NO2之外，中国在2020年的空气质量改善幅度低于我们在疫情中心地区所预期的：湖北省。与2018年和2019年湖北省在农历新年期间经历的空气质量改善相比，SO2的改善幅度较小，而臭氧浓度在相对和绝对意义上都有所增加（大约翻了一番）。与湖北省相邻的六个省份也出现了类似的趋势。我们得出结论，COVID-19对中国污染的影响具有两面性，疫情中心地区的空气质量有所恶化。

abstract.text: Shelter in place orders (SIPOs) require residents to remain home for all but essential activities such as purchasing food or medicine, caring for others, exercise, or traveling for employment deemed essential. Between March 19 and April 20, 2020, 40 states and the District of Columbia adopted SIPOs. This study explores the impact of SIPOs on health, with particular attention to heterogeneity in their impacts. First, using daily state-level social distancing data from SafeGraph and a difference-in-differences approach, we document that adoption of a SIPO was associated with a 5 to 10 percent increase in the rate at which state residents remained in their homes full-time. Then, using daily state-level coronavirus case data collected by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, we find that approximately three weeks following the adoption of a SIPO, cumulative COVID-19 cases fell by 44 percent. Event-study analyses confirm common COVID-19 case trends in the week prior to SIPO adoption and show that SIPO-induced case reductions grew larger over time. However, this average effect masks important heterogeneity across states — early adopters and high population density states appear to reap larger benefits from their SIPOs. Finally, we find that statewide SIPOs were associated with a reduction in coronavirus-related deaths, but estimated mortality effects were imprecisely estimated.

10.3386/w27091.abstractZh: 居家令要求居民在除购买食物或药品、照顾他人、锻炼或因工作需要出行等必要活动之外，均待在家中。2020年3月19日至4月20日期间，40个州和哥伦比亚特区实施了居家令。本研究探讨了居家令对健康的影响，特别关注其影响的差异性。首先，利用SafeGraph提供的每日州级社交距离数据以及差异-差异法，我们发现实施居家令后，州居民全时段待在家中的比例增加了5%至10%。其次，通过美国疾病控制与预防中心提供的每日州级冠状病毒病例数据，我们发现实施居家令后约三周内，累计COVID-19病例减少了44%。事件研究分析确认了实施居家令前一周内常见的COVID-19病例趋势，并表明由居家令引发的病例减少效果随时间逐渐增强。然而，这种平均效应掩盖了各州之间的重要差异——早期实施居家令的州以及人口密度较高的州似乎从居家令中获得了更大的好处。最后，我们发现全州范围的居家令与冠状病毒相关死亡人数的减少有关，但估计的死亡率效果并不精确。

abstract.text: Innovation policy involves trading off monopoly output and pricing in the short run in exchange for incentives for firms to develop new products in the future. While existing research demonstrates that expected profits fuel R&D investments, little is known about the novelty of the projects funded by these investments. Relying on data that describe the scientific approaches used by a large sample of experimental drug projects, we expand on this literature by examining the scientific novelty of pharmaceutical R&D investments following the creation of the Medicare Part D program. We find little evidence that the positive demand shock implied by this program prompted firms to undertake scientifically novel R&D activity, as measured by whether the specific scientific approach had been used before. However, we find some evidence that firms invested in products involving novel combinations of scientific approaches. These estimates can inform economists and policymakers assessing the tradeoffs associated with marginal changes in commercial returns from newly developed pharmaceutical products.

10.3386/w27093.abstractZh: 创新政策涉及在短期内权衡垄断产出和定价，以激励企业未来开发新产品。现有研究表明，预期利润能够推动研发投资，但关于这些投资所资助项目的创新性，目前知之甚少。基于描述大量实验性药物项目所采用科学方法的数据，我们进一步研究了Medicare Part D计划实施后的制药研发投资的科学创新性。我们发现，该计划所引发的积极需求冲击并未促使企业开展具有科学创新性的研发活动，具体表现为特定科学方法是否曾被使用过。不过，我们发现一些证据表明，企业确实投资于涉及多种科学方法组合的产品。这些研究结果可以为经济学家和政策制定者提供有关新开发的制药产品所带来的商业回报边际变化所带来的权衡的信息。

abstract.text: The 2020 CARES Act directed large cash payments to households. We analyze house-holds’ spending responses using high-frequency transaction data from a Fintech non-profit, exploring heterogeneity by income levels, recent income declines, and liquidity as well as linked survey responses about economic expectations. Households respond rapidly to the re-ceipt of stimulus payments, with spending increasing by $0.25-$0.40 per dollar of stimulus during the first weeks. Households with lower incomes, greater income drops, and lower lev-els of liquidity display stronger responses highlighting the importance of targeting. Liquidity plays the most important role, with no significant spending response for households with large checking account balances. Households that expect employment losses and benefit cuts dis-play weaker responses to the stimulus.
