Relative to the effects of previous economic stimulus programs in 2001 and 2008, we see faster effects, smaller increases in durables spending, larger increases in spending on food, and substantial increases in payments like rents, mortgages, and credit cards reflecting a short-term debt overhang. We formally show that these differences can make direct payments less effective in stimulating aggregate consumption.

10.3386/w27097.abstractZh: 2020年的CARES法案规定向家庭发放大额现金补贴。我们利用一家金融科技非营利组织提供的高频交易数据，分析家庭在收到补贴后的消费反应，同时考虑收入水平、近期收入下降情况、流动性等因素，以及相关调查中关于经济预期的反馈。家庭对补贴的接收反应迅速，在最初的几周内，每收到一美元补贴，家庭的开支会增加0.25至0.40美元。收入较低、收入下降幅度较大且流动性较低的家庭反应更为强烈，这凸显了精准定向发放补贴的重要性。流动性起着至关重要的作用，而拥有大量支票账户余额的家庭则没有显著的消费反应。预计将面临就业损失和福利削减的家庭对补贴的反应较弱。与2001年和2008年的经济刺激计划相比，此次刺激计划的效果更快，耐用消费品支出的增长较小，食品支出的增长较大，而租金、抵押贷款和信用卡等支出则大幅增加，反映出短期的债务压力。我们正式证明了这些差异可能导致直接补贴在刺激整体消费方面的效果减弱。

abstract.text: Emergency department visits are costly to providers and to patients. We use the Flint water crisis to test if an increase in office visits reduced avoidable emergency room visits. In September 2015, the city of Flint issued a lead advisory to its residents, alerting them of increased lead levels in their drinking water, resulting from the switch in water source from Lake Huron to the Flint River. Using Medicaid claims for 2013-2016, we find that this information shock increased the share of enrollees who had lead tests performed by 1.7 percentage points. Additionally, it increased office visits immediately following the information shock and led to a reduction of 4.9 preventable, non-emergent, and primary-care-treatable emergency room visits per 1000 eligible children (8.2%). This decrease is present in shifts from emergency room visits to office visits across several common conditions. Our analysis suggest that children were more likely to receive care from the same clinic following lead tests and that establishing care reduced the likelihood parents would take their children to emergency rooms for conditions treatable in an office setting. Our results are potentially applicable to any situation in which individuals are induced to seek more care in an office visit setting.

10.3386/w27098.abstractZh: 急诊科的就诊对医生和患者来说都是昂贵的负担。我们利用弗林特水危机作为案例，来检验增加门诊就诊是否会减少可避免的急诊就诊情况。2015年9月，弗林特市向居民发布了关于饮用水中铅含量升高的警告，这是由于水源从休伦湖改为弗林特河所致。通过2013-2016年的医疗补助索赔数据，我们发现这一信息冲击使接受铅含量检测的居民比例增加了1.7个百分点。此外，信息冲击后门诊就诊次数增加，导致每1000名符合条件的儿童中，可预防的非紧急且可由初级保健治疗的急诊就诊次数减少了4.9次（即8.2%）。这种减少在多种常见疾病的从急诊就诊到门诊就诊的转变中都有体现。我们的分析表明，儿童在接受铅含量检测后更有可能在同一诊所接受治疗，而建立这种治疗机制可以降低父母因孩子在门诊可治疗的疾病而将其送往急诊室的可能性。我们的研究结果可能适用于任何情况下，即当人们被诱导在门诊环境中寻求更多治疗的时候。

abstract.text: We study the impact of non-pharmaceutical policy interventions (NPIs) like “stay-at-home” orders on the spread of infectious disease. Local policies have little impact on the economy nor on local public health. Stay-at-home is only weakly associated with slower growth of Covid-19 cases. Reductions in observed “mobility” are not associated with slower growth of Covid-19 cases. Stay-at-home is associated with lower workplace and more residential activity, but common shocks matter much more. Moreover, job losses have been no higher in US states that implemented stay-at-home during the Covid-19 pandemic than in states that did not have stay-at-home. All of these results demonstrate that the Covid-19 pandemic is a common economic and public health shock. They also show that policy spillovers and behavioral responses are important. The tradeoff between the economy and public health in a pandemic depends strongly on what is happening elsewhere. This underscores the importance of coordinated economic and public health responses.

10.3386/w27099.abstractZh: 我们研究了非药物政策干预措施（如“居家令”）对传染病传播的影响。地方政策对经济和当地公共卫生的影响甚微。“居家令”与新冠病例增长速度的减缓关联度较低。观察到的“流动性”减少与新冠病例增长速度的减缓并无关联。“居家令”与工作场所活动减少以及更多居民活动有关，但共同冲击的影响更为显著。此外，在新冠疫情期间实施“居家令”的美国各州，失业人数并未高于未实施“居家令”的州。所有这些结果都表明，新冠大流行是一种常见的经济和公共卫生冲击。这些结果还表明，政策溢出效应和行为反应非常重要。大流行期间经济与公共卫生之间的权衡，在很大程度上取决于其他地区的状况。这进一步强调了协调一致的经济和公共卫生应对措施的重要性。

abstract.text: We construct a quantitative model of an economy hit by an epidemic. People differ by age and skill, and choose occupations and whether to commute to work or work from home, to maximize their income and minimize their fear of infection. Occupations differ by wage, infection risk, and the productivity loss when working from home. By setting the model parameters to replicate the progression of COVID-19 in South Korea and the United Kingdom, we obtain three key results. First, government-imposed lock-downs may not present a clear trade-off between GDP and public health, as commonly believed, even though its immediate effect is to reduce GDP and infections by forcing people to work from home. A premature lifting of the lock-down raises GDP temporarily, but infections rise over the next months to a level at which many people choose to work from home, where they are less productive, driven by the fear of infection. A longer lock-down eventually mitigates the GDP loss as well as flattens the infection curve. Second, if the UK had adopted South Korean policies, its GDP loss and infections would have been substantially smaller both in the short and the long run. This is not because Korea implemented policies sooner, but because aggressive testing and tracking more effectively reduce infections and disrupt the economy less than a blanket lock-down. Finally, low-skill workers and self-employed lose the most from the epidemic and also from the government policies. However, the policy of issuing “visas” to those who have antibodies will disproportionately benefit the low-skilled, by relieving them of the fear of infection and also by allowing them to get back to work.

10.3386/w27100.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个针对受疫情影响的经济的定量模型。人们因年龄和技能的不同而选择不同的职业，并决定是通勤上班还是在家工作，以最大化收入并降低感染风险。不同职业的薪酬、感染风险以及在家工作时的生产力损失各不相同。通过设定模型参数以模拟韩国和英国COVID-19疫情的发展过程，我们得到了三个关键结论。首先，政府实施的封锁措施可能不会像人们普遍认为的那样，在GDP和公共卫生之间产生明确的权衡，尽管其直接效果是通过强制人们在家工作来减少GDP和感染人数。过早解除封锁措施会暂时提升GDP，但在接下来的几个月里，感染人数会上升，以至于许多人选择在家工作，而他们的生产力会下降，这主要是由于对感染的恐惧。更长时间的封锁最终会减轻GDP的损失，并使感染曲线趋于平缓。其次，如果英国采纳了韩国的政策，其GDP损失和感染人数在短期和长期内都会大幅减少。这并不是因为韩国更早实施了政策，而是因为积极的检测和追踪措施能够更有效地减少感染，对经济的冲击也小于全面的封锁措施。最后，低技能工人和个体经营者从疫情和政府政策中遭受的损失最大。然而，向有抗体的人发放“签证”的政策将不成比例地惠及低技能人群，因为这不仅消除了他们对感染的恐惧，还使他们能够重返工作岗位。

abstract.text: We study targeted lockdowns in a multi-group SIR model where infection, hospitalization and fatality rates vary between groups—in particular between the “young”, “the middle-aged” and the “old”. Our model enables a tractable quantitative analysis of optimal policy. For baseline parameter values for the COVID-19 pandemic applied to the US, we find that optimal policies differentially targeting risk/age groups significantly outperform optimal uniform policies and most of the gains can be realized by having stricter lockdown policies on the oldest group. Intuitively, a strict and long lockdown for the most vulnerable group both reduces infections and enables less strict lockdowns for the lower-risk groups. We also study the impacts of group distancing, testing and contract tracing, the matching technology and the expected arrival time of a vaccine on optimal policies. Overall, targeted policies that are combined with measures that reduce interactions between groups and increase testing and isolation of the infected can minimize both economic losses and deaths in our model.

10.3386/w27102.abstractZh: 我们在一个多群体SIR模型中研究了有针对性的封锁措施，该模型中的感染率、住院率和死亡率在不同群体之间存在差异，尤其是“年轻人”、“中年人”和“老年人”之间。我们的模型能够对最优政策进行可行的定量分析。对于应用于美国的COVID-19大流行的基线参数值，我们发现，针对不同风险/年龄群体的最优政策显著优于统一的最优政策，而且大部分收益可以通过对最年长群体实施更严格的封锁措施来实现。直观地说，对最脆弱群体实施严格且长期的封锁可以减少感染，同时使低风险群体能够实施较为宽松的封锁措施。我们还研究了群体隔离、检测、接触者追踪、匹配技术以及疫苗预期到达时间对最优政策的影响。总体而言，结合减少群体间互动、增加检测和隔离措施的有针对性政策，可以在我们的模型中最小化经济损失和死亡人数。

abstract.text: We develop a SIR-based macroeconomic model to study the impact of testing/quarantining and social distancing/mask use on health and economic outcomes. These policies can dramatically reduce the costs of an epidemic. Absent testing/quarantining, the main effect of social distancing and mask use on health outcomes is to delay, rather than reduce, epidemic-related deaths. Social distancing and mask use reduce the severity of the epidemic-related recession but prolong its duration. There is an important synergy between social distancing and mask use and testing/quarantining. Social distancing and mask use buy time for testing and quarantining to come to the rescue. The benefits of testing/quarantining are even larger when people can get reinfected, either because the virus mutates or immunity is temporary.

10.3386/w27104.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个基于SIR模型的宏观经济模型，以研究检测/隔离以及社交距离/口罩使用对健康和经济结果的影响。这些政策可以显著降低疫情的成本。如果没有检测/隔离，社交距离和口罩使用对健康结果的主要影响是延缓而非减少与疫情相关的死亡。社交距离和口罩使用可以减轻与疫情相关的经济衰退的严重程度，但会延长其持续时间。社交距离和口罩使用与检测/隔离之间存在重要的协同效应。社交距离和口罩使用为检测与隔离提供了时间，从而起到救援作用。当人们再次感染时，检测/隔离的好处更加显著，这可能是因为病毒发生了变异，或者免疫力是暂时的。

abstract.text: We show that tax-induced increases in alcohol prices can lead to substantial substitution and avoidance behavior that limits reductions in alcohol consumption. Causal estimates are derived from a natural experiment in Illinois where spirits and wine taxes were raised sharply and unexpectedly in 2009. Beer taxes were increased by only a trivial amount. We construct representative and consistent measures of alcohol prices and sales from scanner data collected for hundreds of products in several thousand stores across the US. Using several differences-in-differences models, we show that alcohol excise taxes are instantly over-shifted by a factor of up to 1.5. Consumers react by switching to less expensive products and increase purchases of low-tax alcoholic beverages, thus all but offsetting any moderate, tax-induced reductions in total ethanol consumption. Our study highlights the importance of tax-induced substitution, the implications of differential tax increases by beverage group and the impacts on public health of alternative types of tax hikes whose main aims are to increase revenue.

10.3386/w27117.abstractZh: 我们指出，税收导致的酒精价格上升可能会引发显著的替代和规避行为，从而限制酒精消费量的减少。这些因果估计基于伊利诺伊州的一项自然实验得出，该实验中，2009年烈酒和葡萄酒的税收被突然且大幅度地提高，而啤酒的税收仅增加了微不足道的数额。我们基于在美国数千家商店中收集到的数百种产品的扫描数据，构建了具有代表性和一致性的酒精价格和销售数据。通过多种差异模型分析，我们发现酒精消费税的税率会立即上升1.5倍。消费者因此转向购买价格较低的产品，并增加了对低税酒精饮料的购买，从而几乎抵消了税收导致的乙醇总消费量的适度减少。我们的研究强调了税收引起的替代行为的重要性，不同饮料类别之间税收差异的影响，以及旨在增加税收收入的替代性税收措施对公共健康的影响。

abstract.text: Covid-19 is the single largest threat to global public health since the Spanish Influenza pandemic of 1918-20. Was the world better prepared in 2020 than it was in 1918? After a century of public health and basic science research, pandemic response and mortality outcomes should be better than in 1918-20. We ask whether mortality from historical pandemics has any predictive content for mortality in the ongoing Covid-19 pandemic. We find a strong persistence in public health performance in the early days of the Covid-19 pandemic. Places that performed poorly in terms of mortality in 1918 were more likely to have higher mortality today. This is true across countries and across a sample of US cities. Experience with SARS is associated with lower mortality today. Distrust of expert advice, lack of cooperation at many levels, over-confidence, and health care supply shortages have likely promoted higher mortality today as in the past.

10.3386/w27119.abstractZh: Covid-19是自1918-20年西班牙流感大流行以来对全球公共卫生最具威胁的疫情。2020年的世界是否比1918年更加做好准备？经过一个世纪的公共卫生和基础科学研究，疫情应对及死亡率结果应该比1918-20年要好。我们质疑历史上的大流行病对当前Covid-19疫情的死亡率是否具有预测意义。我们发现，在Covid-19疫情初期，公共卫生表现具有强烈的持续性。那些在1918年死亡率较高的地区，今天更有可能出现较高的死亡率。这一点在各国以及美国多个城市样本中均成立。与SARS的经验相比，今天的死亡率较低。对专家建议的不信任、多层面的缺乏合作、过度自信以及医疗供应短缺等因素，可能像过去一样导致今天的死亡率上升。

abstract.text: This paper studies how better access to public health insurance affects infant mortality during pandemics. Our analysis combines cross-state variation in mandated eligibility for Medicaid with two influenza pandemics – the 1957-58 “Asian Flu” Pandemic and the 1968-69 “Hong Kong Flu” Pandemic – that arrived shortly before and after the program's introduction. Exploiting heterogeneity in the underlying severity of these two shocks across counties, we find no relationship between Medicaid eligibility and pandemic infant mortality during the 1957-58 outbreak. In contrast during the 1968-1969 pandemic, which occurred after Medicaid implementation, we find that better access to insurance in high-eligibility states substantially reduced infant mortality. The reductions in pandemic infant mortality are too large to be attributable solely to new Medicaid recipients, suggesting that the expansion in health insurance coverage mitigated disease transmission among the broader population.

10.3386/w27120.abstractZh: 本文研究了更好的公共健康保险获取方式如何影响大流行期间的婴儿死亡率。我们的分析将各州在Medicaid资格要求上的差异与两次流感大流行联系起来——1957-58年的“亚洲流感”大流行和1968-69年的“香港流感”大流行——这两场大流行都发生在Medicaid制度实施前后不久。通过考察这两个冲击在不同县之间的严重程度差异，我们发现1957-58年的流感大流行期间，Medicaid资格与婴儿死亡率之间并无关联。相比之下，在Medicaid制度实施后的1968-1969年流感大流行期间，高资格州中更好的保险获取方式显著降低了婴儿死亡率。婴儿死亡率的降低幅度巨大，无法仅归因于新的Medicaid受益人，这表明健康保险覆盖范围的扩大有助于减缓疾病在更广泛人群中的传播。

abstract.text: I use a simple SIR model, augmented to include deaths, to elucidate how pandemic progression is affected by the control of contagion, and examine the key trade-offs that underlie policy design. I illustrate how the cost of reducing the "reproduction number" R0 depends on how it changes the infection rate, the total and incremental number of deaths, the duration of the pandemic, and the possibility and impact of a second wave. Reducing R0 reduces the number of deaths, but extends the duration (and hence economic cost) of the pandemic, and it increases the fraction of the population still susceptible at the end, raising the possibility of a second wave. The benefit of reducing R0 is largely lives saved, and the incremental number of lives saved rises as R0 is reduced. But using a VSL estimate to value those lives is problematic.

10.3386/w27121.abstractZh: 我采用了一个简单的SIR模型，并对其进行扩展以包含死亡人数，以此来阐明大流行进程如何受到传染控制的影响，并探讨政策设计背后的关键权衡。我说明了降低“繁殖数”R0的成本取决于它如何改变感染率、总死亡数和增量死亡数、大流行的持续时间，以及第二波疫情的可能性及其影响。降低R0可以减少死亡人数，但会延长大流行的持续时间（从而增加经济成本），并且会增加最终仍有易感人群的比例，增加了第二波疫情的可能性。降低R0的好处主要是挽救生命，随着R0的降低，挽救的生命数量也会增加。但是，使用VSL估计来评估这些生命的价值存在问题。

abstract.text: Social distancing via shelter-in-place strategies has emerged as the most effective way to combat Covid-19. In the United States, choices about such policies are made by individual states. Here we show that the policy choice made by one state influences the incentives that other states face to adopt similar policies: they can be viewed as strategic complements in a supermodular game. If they satisfy the condition of uniform strict increasing differences then following Heal and Kunreuther ([6]) we show that if enough states engage in social distancing, they will tip others to do the same and thus shift the Nash equilibrium with respect to the number of states engaging in social distancing.

10.3386/w27124.abstractZh: 通过居家隔离策略实施社交距离措施，已成为抗击新冠疫情最有效的方法。在美国，关于此类政策的决策由各州自行决定。本文指出，一个州所做出的政策选择会影响其他州采取类似政策的动机：这些政策可以被视为超模块博弈中的战略互补关系。如果各州满足“严格递增差异一致”的条件，那么根据Heal和Kunreuther的研究，当足够多的州实施社交距离措施时，它们将促使其他州也采取同样的措施，从而改变参与社交距离措施的州数量所对应的纳什均衡。

abstract.text: The United States, in 2018, implemented a nationwide requirement that chain restaurants disclose calorie information on their menus and menu boards. This law was motivated by concern that consumers underestimate the number of calories in restaurant food, but it remains unclear the extent to which this information disclosure affects consumer knowledge. This paper fills that gap by estimating the impact of information disclosure on consumer knowledge through a randomized controlled field experiment of calorie labels on the menus of a full-service restaurant. The results indicate that information disclosure significantly reduces the extent to which consumers underestimate the number of calories in restaurant food; the labels improve the accuracy of consumers’ post-meal estimates of the number of calories they ordered by 4.0 percent and reduces by 28.9% the probability of underestimating the calories in one’s meal by 50% or more, both of which are statistically significant. However, even after information disclosure, there remains considerable error in consumer beliefs about the calorie content of the restaurant food they ordered. Even among the treatment group who received calorie labels, the average absolute value of percent error in their report is 34.2%.

10.3386/w27126.abstractZh: 美国在2018年实施了全国性要求，要求连锁餐厅在菜单和菜单板上公开卡路里信息。这项法律的动机是担心消费者会低估餐厅食物的卡路里含量，但这些信息公开对消费者认知的影响程度仍不清楚。本文通过一项随机对照实地实验，评估了信息公开对消费者认知的影响。实验结果显示，信息公开显著减少了消费者低估餐厅食物卡路里含量的程度；标签使消费者餐后对所点食物的卡路里估计的准确率提高了4.0%，并将低估餐食卡路里的概率降低了28.9%，这两种情况都具有统计学意义。然而，即使经过信息公开后，消费者对其所点食物的卡路里含量仍存在相当大的认知误差。即使在接受卡路里标签的对照组中，他们报告的错误百分比平均值仍为34.2%。

abstract.text: The relationship between population health and measures of economic well-being and economic activity is a long standing topic in health economics (Preston, 1975; Cutler, Deaton, and Lleras-Muney, 2006; Ruhm, 2000). The conceptual issues in analyzing the complicated link between health and economic well-being are central to understanding the implications of the COVID-19 epidemic in the United States The public health shock of the epidemic has direct economic impacts, but the mitigation policies governments are using to control the spread of the virus may also damage economic activity. We estimate how state job market conditions respond to state COVID-19 infections and school closures, which are the earliest of the major mitigation policies. Mitigation policies and local epidemiological conditions explain some of the variation in unemployment patterns. However, the historically unprecedented increase in new UI claims during the weeks of March 15-21 and March 22-28 was largely across-the-board and occurred in all states. This suggests most of the economic disruption was driven by the health shock itself. Put differently, it appears that the labor market slowdown was due primarily to a nationwide response to evolving epidemiological conditions and that individual state policies and own epidemiologic situations have had a comparatively modest effect.

10.3386/w27127.abstractZh: 人口健康与经济福祉及经济活动指标之间的关系是健康经济学领域长期关注的话题（Preston, 1975; Cutler, Deaton, and Lleras-Muney, 2006; Ruhm, 2000）。分析健康与经济福祉之间复杂联系的概念性问题，对于理解COVID-19疫情在美国的影响至关重要。疫情带来的公共卫生冲击具有直接的经济影响，但政府为控制病毒传播而采取的缓解政策也可能损害经济活动。我们研究了各州就业市场状况如何响应各州的COVID-19感染情况以及学校关闭措施——这些是最早采取的缓解政策。缓解政策和地方流行病学状况解释了失业模式的一些差异。然而，在3月15日至21日以及3月22日至28日期间，新的失业救济申请数量出现了史无前例的激增，这一趋势几乎在所有州都普遍存在。这表明大部分经济破坏是由公共卫生冲击本身引起的。换句话说，劳动力市场放缓主要是由于全国范围内对流行病学状况变化的应对，而各州的政策和当地的流行病学状况对经济的负面影响相对较小。

abstract.text: We use data on deaths in New York City, Madrid, Stockholm, and other world cities as well as in various U.S. states and various countries and regions to estimate a standard epidemiological model of COVID-19. We allow for a time-varying contact rate in order to capture behavioral and policy-induced changes associated with social distancing. We simulate the model forward to consider possible futures for various countries, states, and cities, including the potential impact of herd immunity on re-opening. Our current baselinemortality rate (IFR) is assumed to be 1.0% but we recognize there is substantial uncertainty about this number. Our model fits the death data equally well with alternative mortality rates of 0.5% or 1.2%, so this parameter is unidentified in our data. However, its value matters enormously for the extent to which various places can relax social distancing without spurring a resurgence of deaths.

10.3386/w27128.abstractZh: 我们使用了纽约市、马德里、斯德哥尔摩以及其他世界城市，以及美国各州和各国的死亡数据，来估算COVID-19的标准流行病学模型。我们考虑了时间变化的接触率，以捕捉与社交距离相关的行为和政策因素。我们向前模拟了模型，以考虑各国、各州和城市的未来情况，包括群体免疫对重新开放可能产生的潜在影响。我们当前的基准死亡率假设为1.0%，但我们知道这个数值存在很大的不确定性。我们的模型在死亡数据上同样适用0.5%或1.2%的其他死亡率，因此这个参数在我们的数据中尚未确定。然而，这个数值对于不同地方在放松社交距离时避免死亡人数再次上升的程度至关重要。

abstract.text: This paper investigates if the impact of children on the labor market outcomes of women relative to men — child penalties — can be explained by the biological links between mother and child. We estimate child penalties in biological and adoptive families using event studies around the arrival of children and almost forty years of adoption data from Denmark. Short-run child penalties are slightly larger for biological mothers than for adoptive mothers, but their long-run child penalties are virtually identical and precisely estimated. This suggests that biology is not a key driver of child-related gender gaps.

10.3386/w27130.abstractZh: 本文探讨了儿童对女性劳动力市场结果的影响——即所谓的“儿童惩罚”——是否可以通过母亲与子女之间的生物学联系来解释。我们利用丹麦近四十年的收养数据，以及围绕儿童出生时的事件研究，来估算生物学家庭和收养家庭中的儿童惩罚。短期来看，生物学母亲所承受的儿童惩罚略高于收养母亲，但长期来看，两者的儿童惩罚几乎相同且估算精确。这表明生物学并非导致儿童相关性别差距的关键因素。

abstract.text: We make several contributions to understanding the socio-demographic divide in early labor market responses to the U.S. COVID-19 epidemic and its policies, benchmarked against two previous recessions. First, monthly Current Population Survey (CPS) data show greater declines in employment in April and May 2020 (relative to February) for Hispanics, younger workers, and those with high school degrees and some college. Between April and May, all the demographic subgroups considered regained some employment. Re-employment in May was broadly proportional to the employment drop that occurred through April, except for Blacks who experienced a smaller rebound. Further, we show that compared to the 2001 recession and the Great Recession, employment losses in the early COVID-19 recession were smaller for groups with very low or very high (vs. medium) education. Second, we show that job loss was larger in occupations that require more interpersonal contact and that cannot be performed remotely. Third, we find pre-COVID-19 sorting of workers into occupations and industries along demographic lines can explain a sizeable portion of the gender, race, and ethnic gaps in new unemployment. For example, while women did suffer more job losses than men, their disproportionate pre-epidemic sorting into remote work compatible occupations shielded women from what would have been even larger employment losses during the epidemic. However, there remain substantial gaps in employment losses across groups that cannot be explained by socio-economic differences. We find some larger gaps in labor market impacts when we consider the “employed but absent from work” measure present in the CPS, in addition to the more traditional employment and unemployment measures. We conclude with a discussion of policy lessons and future research needs implied by the disparities in early labor market losses from the COVID-19 crisis.

10.3386/w27132.abstractZh: 我们对理解早期劳动力市场对美国COVID-19疫情及其政策的社会人口学差异做出了几项贡献，这些分析以两次之前的经济衰退为基准。首先，每月的当前人口调查数据显示，2020年4月和5月，西班牙裔、年轻工人以及拥有高中或某些大学学位的人群就业下降幅度更大。在4月至5月期间，所有被考虑的人口子群体都恢复了一些就业。5月的重新就业幅度大致与4月发生的就业下降幅度成正比，但黑人群体的恢复幅度较小。此外，我们指出，与2001年的经济衰退和大衰退相比，早期COVID-19经济衰退期间，教育程度非常低或非常高的人群的就业损失较小。其次，我们发现，需要更多人际接触且无法远程工作的职业中，失业情况更为严重。第三，我们发现，在COVID-19之前，工人按照人口特征被分配到不同的职业和行业，这可以解释新失业人数在性别、种族和族裔方面的巨大差异。例如，虽然女性的失业损失比男性更严重，但她们在疫情前被分配到适合远程工作的职业，使得她们在疫情期间避免了更大的就业损失。然而，仍然存在一些无法用社会经济差异来解释的群体间就业损失差异。我们发现，当考虑到当前人口调查中的“就业但缺勤”指标时，劳动力市场的影响差异更大，除了传统的就业和失业指标之外。最后，我们讨论了由COVID-19危机导致的早期劳动力市场损失差异所蕴含的政策启示和未来研究需求。

abstract.text: Social interactions and social preferences play a central role in public health domains. In the face of a pandemic, individuals adjust their behavior, whereas in SIR models infection rates are typically exogenous. City-level data across countries suggest that mobility falls in response to fear, proxied by Google searches. Incorporating experimentally validated measures of social preferences at the regional level, we find that stringency measures matter less when individuals are more patient, altruistic, or exhibit less negative reciprocity. To account for these findings, we extend homogeneous and networked SIR models by endogenizing agents' social-activity intensity and incorporating social preferences. Our quantitative predictions markedly differ from those of the naïve SIR network model. We derive the planner's problem, and show that neglecting agents' endogenous response leads to misguided policy decisions of various non-pharmaceutical interventions. Any further mobility restrictions, beyond agents' restraint, result from aggregate externalities which are curtailed by social preferences.

10.3386/w27134.abstractZh: 社会互动和社会偏好在公共卫生领域发挥着核心作用。在疫情面前，个体会调整自己的行为，而在SIR模型中，感染率通常是外生的。各国城市级数据表明，由于恐惧，人们的流动性会下降，这可以通过谷歌搜索数据来反映。通过结合区域层面经过实验验证的社会偏好指标，我们发现，当个体更加耐心、利他或表现出较少的负面互惠行为时，严格的社会偏好措施的重要性会降低。为了解释这些发现，我们通过内生化代理人的社会活动强度并纳入社会偏好，对同质和联网的SIR模型进行了扩展。我们的定量预测与简单的SIR网络模型有很大不同。我们推导出了规划者的问题，并表明忽略代理人的内生反应会导致各种非药物干预措施的政策决策出现偏差。任何超出代理人自我约束的进一步流动性限制，都是由于社会偏好所限制的总体外在性所导致的。

abstract.text: We study the effects of a massive temporary U.S. paid sick leave (PSL) mandate that became effective April 1st, 2020 on self-quarantining, proxied by physical mobility behaviors gleaned from cellular devices. Such behaviors are critical for containment of infectious diseases. The national PSL policy was implemented in response to the COVID-19 global pandemic and mandated two weeks of fully compensated paid leave. We study the impact of this policy using difference-in-differences methods, leveraging pre-policy county-level differences in the share of ‘nonessential’ workers likely eligible for paid sick leave benefits. We find robust evidence that the policy increased the average number of hours at home and reduced the share of the individuals likely at work. Comparing the county with the lowest to highest policy exposure, we find that the average hours per day not at home, and at work decreased by 8.9% and 6.9% post-policy.

10.3386/w27138.abstractZh: 我们研究了2020年4月1日生效的美国大规模临时带薪病假政策对自我隔离行为的影响，这些行为是通过从移动设备获取的物理移动数据来近似测量的。这些行为对于控制传染病至关重要。该国家带薪病假政策是为了应对COVID-19全球大流行而实施的，要求员工享受两周的全额补偿带薪休假。我们使用差异-差异方法研究了这一政策的影响，利用政策实施前各县“非必要”员工可能享有带薪病假福利的比例差异。我们发现，该政策确实增加了员工在家平均时间，并减少了可能在上班的人比例。通过比较政策实施前和实施后各县的状况，我们发现员工在家和上班的平均时间分别减少了8.9%和6.9%。

abstract.text: We study how the differential timing of local lockdowns due to COVID-19 causally affects households’ spending and macroeconomic expectations at the local level using several waves of a customized survey with more than 10,000 respondents. About 50% of survey participants report income and wealth losses due to the corona virus, with the average losses being $5,293 and $33,482 respectively. Aggregate consumer spending dropped by 31 log percentage points with the largest drops in travel and clothing. We find that households living in counties that went into lockdown earlier expect the unemployment rate over the next twelve months to be 13 percentage points higher and continue to expect higher unemployment at horizons of three to five years. They also expect lower future inflation, report higher uncertainty, expect lower mortgage rates for up to 10 years, and have moved out of foreign stocks into liquid forms of savings. The imposition of lockdowns can account for much of the decline in employment in recent months as well as declines in consumer spending. While lockdowns have pronounced effects on local economic conditions and households’ expectations, they have little impact on approval ratings of Congress, the Fed, or the Treasury but lead to declines in the approval of the President.

10.3386/w27141.abstractZh: 我们研究了由于COVID-19导致的局部封锁时间差异如何在地方层面引起家庭支出和宏观经济预期的因果影响，使用了超过10,000名受访者的多轮定制调查。约50%的受访者报告因冠状病毒而遭受收入和财富损失，平均损失分别为5,293美元和33,482美元。总体消费支出下降了31个对数百分点，其中旅游和服装领域的下降幅度最大。我们发现，较早实施封锁的县居民预计未来十二个月的失业率将高出13个百分点，并且在三到五年的时间里继续预期更高的失业率。他们还预期未来通货膨胀率会较低，报告的不确定性较高，预计未来十年抵押贷款利率会较低，并且已经从外国股票转向了流动性较高的储蓄形式。封锁的实施可以解释最近几个月就业下降以及消费支出下降的大部分原因。虽然封锁对当地经济状况和家庭预期有显著影响，但对国会的支持率、美联储或财政部的支持率影响较小，但会导致对总统的支持率下降。

abstract.text: COVID-19 convalescent plasma (CCP) therapy is currently a leading treatment for COVID-19. At present, there is a shortage of CCP relative to demand. We develop and analyze a model of centralized CCP allocation that incorporates both donation and distribution. In order to increase CCP supply, we introduce a mechanism that utilizes two incentive schemes, respectively based on principles of “paying it backward” and “paying it forward.” Under the first scheme, CCP donors obtain treatment vouchers that can be transferred to patients of their choosing. Under the latter scheme, patients obtain priority for CCP therapy in exchange for a future pledge to donate CCP if possible. We show that in steady-state, both principles generally increase overall treatment rates for all patients—not just those who are voucher-prioritized or pledged to donate. Our results also hold under certain conditions if a fraction of CCP is reserved for patients who participate in clinical trials. Finally, we examine the implications of pooling blood types on the efficiency and equity of CCP distribution.

10.3386/w27143.abstractZh: COVID-19康复期血浆疗法目前是治疗COVID-19的主要方法之一。目前，血浆的供应相对于需求存在短缺。我们开发并分析了一个集中式血浆分配模型，该模型同时考虑了捐赠和分配环节。为了增加血浆的供应，我们引入了一种机制，该机制基于“反哺”和“传递善意”的原则，分别通过两种激励方案来实现。在第一种方案中，血浆捐赠者可以获得治疗券，这些券可以转赠给他们选择的病人。在第二种方案中，病人可以获得优先接受血浆治疗的资格，作为将来可能捐赠血浆的承诺交换。我们的研究表明，在稳态条件下，这两种原则通常都能提高所有病人的治疗率——而不仅仅是那些被优先分配治疗券或承诺捐赠血浆的病人。在某些条件下，如果一部分血浆被预留用于参与临床试验的病人，我们的结果仍然成立。最后，我们探讨了血液类型合并对血浆分配效率和公平性的影响。

abstract.text: Why are people living in poverty disproportionately affected by mental illness? We review the interdisciplinary evidence of the bi-directional causal relationship between poverty and common mental illnesses – depression and anxiety – and the underlying mechanisms. Research shows that mental illness reduces employment and therefore income and that psychological interventions generate economic gains. Similarly, negative economic shocks cause mental illness, and anti-poverty programs, such as cash transfers, improve mental health. A crucial step toward the design of effective policies is to better understand the mechanisms underlying these causal effects.

10.3386/w27157.abstractZh: 为什么生活在贫困中的人群更容易受到精神疾病的影响？我们回顾了关于贫困与常见精神疾病——抑郁和焦虑——之间双向因果关系的跨学科证据，以及其背后的机制。研究表明，精神疾病会降低就业率，从而影响收入；而心理干预则能够带来经济收益。同样，负面的经济冲击也会导致精神疾病，而诸如现金转移之类的反贫困计划则有助于改善心理健康。要制定有效的政策，关键在于更好地理解这些因果效应背后的机制。

abstract.text: We critically analyze the currently available status indicators of the COVID-19 epidemic so that state governors will have the guideposts necessary to decide whether to further loosen or instead retighten controls on social and economic activity. Overreliance on aggregate, state-level data in Wisconsin, we find, confounds the effects of the spring primary elections and the outbreak among meat packers. Relaxed testing standards in Los Angeles may have upwardly biased the observed trend in new infection rates. Reanalysis of New Jersey data, based upon the date an ultimately fatal case first became ill rather than the date of death, reveals that deaths have already peaked in that state. Evidence from Cook County, Illinois shows that trends in the percentage of positive tests can be wholly misleading. Trends on emergency department visits for influenza-like illness, advocated by the White House Guidelines, are unlikely to be informative. Data on hospital census counts in Orange County, California suggest that healthcare system-based indicators are likely to be more reliable and informative. An analysis of cumulative infections in San Antonio, Texas, shows how mathematical models intended to guide decisions on relaxation of social distancing are severely limited by untested assumptions. Universal coronavirus testing may not on its own solve difficult problems of data interpretation and causal inference.

10.3386/w27166.abstractZh: 我们对当前可用的COVID-19疫情指标进行了批判性分析，以便各州州长能够掌握必要的指导方针，以决定是进一步放松还是重新加强对社会和经济活动的管控。我们发现，威斯康星州过度依赖总体和州级数据，这混淆了春季初选和肉类包装商疫情的影响。洛杉矶放松检测标准可能导致新感染率的趋势出现偏差。对新泽西州数据的重新分析表明，基于最初发病日期而非死亡日期的数据，该州的死亡人数已经达到峰值。伊利诺伊州库克县的数据表明，阳性检测率的趋势可能具有误导性。白宫指南所推荐的流感样疾病急诊就诊趋势可能并不具有参考价值。加利福尼亚州奥兰治县的医院人口统计数据显示，基于医疗系统的指标可能更为可靠和具有参考价值。对德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市的累计感染情况分析表明，用于指导社交距离放松决策的数学模型受到未经验证的假设的严重限制。全面的冠状病毒检测本身可能无法解决数据解释和因果推断方面的难题。

abstract.text: We study physician agency and optimal payment policy in the context of an expensive medication used in dialysis care. Using Medicare claims data we estimate a structural model of treatment decisions, in which physicians differ in their altruism and marginal costs, and this heterogeneity is unobservable to the government. In a novel application of nonlinear pricing methods, we theoretically characterize the optimal unrestricted contract in this screening environment with multidimensional heterogeneity. We combine these results with the estimated model to construct the optimal contract and simulate counterfactual outcomes. The optimal contract is a flexible fee-for-service contract, which pays for reported treatments but uses variable marginal payments instead of constant reimbursement rates, resulting in substantial health improvements and reductions in costs. Our structural approach also yields important qualitative findings, such as rejecting the optimality of any linear contract, and may be employed more broadly to analyze a variety of applications.

10.3386/w27172.abstractZh: 我们研究了在透析护理中使用的昂贵药物背景下，医生代理行为及最优支付政策。利用Medicare索赔数据，我们构建了一个治疗决策的结构模型，其中医生的利他主义程度和边际成本存在差异，而这些差异对政府来说是不可观测的。在非线性定价方法的新应用中，我们理论上描述了在这种具有多维异质性的筛选环境下的最优无限制合同。我们将这些结果与估计模型相结合，构建最优合同并模拟反事实结果。最优合同是一种灵活的按服务收费合同，它支付报告的治疗费用，但采用可变边际支付而非固定的报销率，从而显著改善健康状况并降低成本。我们的结构方法还得出了一些重要的定性发现，例如任何线性合同都无法达到最优，这一方法可以更广泛地应用于分析各种应用场景。

abstract.text: There is growing concern that the COVID-19 pandemic may have severe, adverse effects on the health care sector, a sector of the economy that historically has been somewhat shielded from the business cycle. In this paper, we study one aspect of this issue by estimating the magnitude of the COVID-19 pandemic on use of outpatient health services. We use 2010-2020 data from the Outpatient Influenza-like Illness Surveillance Network (ILINet). Our findings indicate that the COVID-19 pandemic is associated with about a 67 percent decline in the total number of outpatient visits per provider by the week of April 12-18th, 2020 relative to the same week in prior years. Effects become apparent earlier in the pandemic for outpatient visits for non-flu symptoms, but we find negative effects on outpatient visits for flu symptoms as well.

10.3386/w27173.abstractZh: 人们越来越担心，COVID-19大流行可能对医疗保健行业产生严重的负面影响。该行业在历史上一直相对不受商业周期的影响。在本文中，我们通过估算COVID-19大流行对门诊医疗服务使用的影响来研究这一问题的一个方面。我们使用了2010年至2020年从门诊流感样疾病监测网络（ILINet）收集的数据。研究结果表明，截至2020年4月12日至18日这一周，与往年同期相比，门诊就诊次数减少了约67%。在大流行的早期阶段，非流感症状的门诊就诊次数出现了明显的下降，而对于流感症状的门诊就诊次数则也出现了负面影响。

abstract.text: We expand on earlier studies investigating the links between early health and later health by including different dimensions of early-life health and multiple life course outcomes consisting of the age of onset of serious cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) and multiple job-related health outcomes. The four dimensions of childhood health are mental, physical, self-rated general health and severe headaches or migraines. The data set we use includes 21 countries from the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe. We find that the different dimensions of childhood health have unique ties to later outcomes. For men, early mental health problems play a stronger role for life course job-related health outcomes, but early poor or fair general health is more strongly linked to the spike in onset of CVDs in their late 40s. For women, these links between childhood health dimensions and life course outcomes are less clear-cut than for men. The spike in onset of CVDs in their late 40s is driven by those with severe headaches or migraines while those with early physical health problems generally do better as captured by job-related outcomes. We also explore and control for possible mediating factors and assess the importance of omitted variables using a test proposed by Oster (2019).

10.3386/w27174.abstractZh: 我们进一步扩展了之前关于早期健康与后期健康之间联系的研究，纳入了早期生活健康的多个维度以及多个生命历程结果，包括严重心血管疾病发病年龄和多种与工作相关的健康结果。儿童健康的四个维度包括心理健康、身体健康、自我评估的整体健康状况以及严重头痛或偏头痛。我们使用的数据集来自欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查中的21个国家。研究发现，儿童健康的不同维度与后期结果之间存在独特的关联。对于男性而言，早期心理健康问题对生命历程中的与工作相关的健康结果有更强的影响，而早期较差或一般的总体健康状况则与40多岁后期严重心血管疾病的发病高峰有更强的关联。对于女性而言，儿童健康维度与生命历程结果之间的关联不如男性那么明确。40多岁后期严重心血管疾病的发病高峰是由那些患有严重头痛或偏头痛的人所驱动的，而早期身体健康问题的人通常在与工作相关的结果上表现更好。我们还探讨了可能的中介因素，并使用Oster（2019）提出的测试来评估遗漏变量的重要性。

abstract.text: In the midst of epidemics such as COVID-19, therapeutic candidates are unlikely to be able to complete the usual multiyear clinical trial and regulatory approval process within the course of an outbreak. We apply a Bayesian adaptive patient-centered model—which minimizes the expected harm of false positives and false negatives—to optimize the clinical trial development path during such outbreaks. When the epidemic is more infectious and fatal, the Bayesian-optimal sample size in the clinical trial is lower and the optimal statistical significance level is higher. For COVID-19 (assuming a static R ₀ – 2 and initial infection percentage of 0.1%), the optimal significance level is 7.1% for a clinical trial of a nonvaccine anti-infective therapeutic and 13.6% for that of a vaccine. For a dynamic R ₀ decreasing from 3 to 1.5, the corresponding values are 14.4% and 26.4%, respectively. Our results illustrate the importance of adapting the clinical trial design and the regulatory approval process to the specific parameters and stage of the epidemic.

10.3386/w27175.abstractZh: 在像COVID-19这样的疫情中，治疗候选药物不太可能在疫情爆发期间完成通常的多年临床试验和监管审批流程。我们采用贝叶斯自适应以患者为中心的模型——该模型能够最小化假阳性和假阴性的预期危害——来优化此类疫情期间的临床试验开发路径。当疫情更具传染性且致命性更高时，临床试验中的贝叶斯最优样本量较低，而最优统计显著性水平则较高。对于COVID-19（假设静态的R₀-2和初始感染率为0.1%），非疫苗抗感染治疗的临床试验最优显著性水平为7.1%，而疫苗治疗的则为13.6%。当动态R₀从3降至1.5时，相应的数值分别为14.4%和26.4%。我们的研究结果表明，需要根据疫情的具体参数和阶段来调整临床试验设计和监管审批流程。

abstract.text: A key driver in biopharmaceutical investment decisions is the probability of success of a drug development program. We estimate the probabilities of success (PoSs) of clinical trials for vaccines and other anti-infective therapeutics using 43,414 unique triplets of clinical trial, drug, and disease between January 1, 2000, and January 7, 2020, yielding 2,544 vaccine programs and 6,829 nonvaccine programs targeting infectious diseases. The overall estimated PoS for an industry-sponsored vaccine program is 39.6%, and 16.3% for an industry-sponsored anti-infective therapeutic. Among industry-sponsored vaccines programs, only 12 out of 27 disease categories have seen at least one approval, with the most successful being against monkeypox (100%), rotavirus (78.7%), and Japanese encephalitis (67.6%). The three infectious diseases with the highest PoSs for industry-sponsored nonvaccine therapeutics are smallpox (100%), cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection (31.8%), and onychomycosis (29.8%). Non-industry-sponsored vaccine and nonvaccine development programs have lower overall PoSs: 6.8% and 8.2%, respectively. Viruses involved in recent outbreaks—Middle East respiratory syndrome (MERS), severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS), Ebola, and Zika—have had a combined total of only 45 nonvaccine development programs initiated over the past two decades, and no approved therapy to date. These estimates offer guidance both to biopharma investors as well as to policymakers seeking to identify areas most likely to be underserved by private sector engagement and in need of public sector support.

10.3386/w27176.abstractZh: 在生物制药投资决策中，一个关键的驱动因素是药物开发项目的成功概率。我们利用2000年1月1日至2020年1月7日期间共43,414组临床试验、药物和疾病数据，估算了疫苗和其他抗感染治疗药物的临床试验成功概率。结果显示，针对传染病的行业赞助疫苗项目的总体成功概率为39.6%，而抗感染治疗药物的成功概率则为16.3%。在行业赞助的疫苗项目中，只有12个疾病类别至少有一次批准，其中最成功的包括猴痘（100%）、轮状病毒（78.7%）和日本脑炎（67.6%）。对于行业赞助的非疫苗治疗项目而言，天花（100%）、巨细胞病毒感染（31.8%）和甲癣（29.8%）这三种传染病的成功概率最高。非行业赞助的疫苗和非疫苗开发项目的整体成功概率较低，分别为6.8%和8.2%。最近爆发的疾病——中东呼吸综合征（MERS）、严重急性呼吸综合征（SARS）、埃博拉病毒和寨卡病毒——在过去二十年里仅有45个非疫苗开发项目启动，且至今没有获批的治疗方法。这些估算结果可以为生物制药投资者以及寻求确定私营部门可能未充分服务的领域并需要公共部门支持的政策制定者提供指导。

abstract.text: On April 7, 2020, Wisconsin held its presidential primary election, and news reports showed long lines of voters due to fewer polling locations. We use county-level variation in voting patterns and weekly county-level COVID test data to examine whether in-person voting increased COVID-19 cases. We ﬁnd a statistically signiﬁcant association between in-person voting density and the spread of COVID-19 two to three weeks after the election. In our main results, a 10% increase in in-person voters per polling location is associated with an 18.4% increase in the COVID-19 positive test rate two to three weeks later.

10.3386/w27187.abstractZh: 2020年4月7日，威斯康星州举行了总统初选，新闻报道显示由于投票站数量减少，选民队伍排得很长。我们利用县级的投票模式差异以及每周的县级COVID-19检测数据，来研究现场投票是否增加了COVID-19病例。我们发现，在选举后两到三周内，现场投票密度与COVID-19的传播之间存在统计学上的显著关联。我们的主要结论是，每个投票站现场投票人数增加10%，会导致两到三周后COVID-19阳性检测率增加18.4%。

abstract.text: Time-inconsistency may play a central role in explaining inter-temporal behavior, particularly among poor households. However, little is known about the distribution of time-inconsistent agents, and time-preference parameters are typically not identified in standard dynamic choice models. We formulate a dynamic discrete choice model in an unobservedly heterogeneous population of possibly time-inconsistent agents. We provide conditions under which all population type probabilities and preferences for both time-consistent and sophisticated agents are point-identified and sharp set-identification results for naïve and partially sophisticated agents. Estimating the model using data from a health intervention providing insecticide treated nets (ITNs) in rural Odisha, India, we find that about two-thirds of our sample comprises time-inconsistent agents and that both sophisticated and naïve agents are considerably present-biased. Counterfactuals show that the under-investment in ITNs attributable to present-bias leads to substantial costs that are about four times the price of an ITN.

10.3386/w27198.abstractZh: 时间不一致性可能在解释跨时期行为中扮演重要角色，尤其是在贫困家庭中。然而，关于时间不一致性个体的分布知之甚少，而在标准的动态选择模型中，时间偏好参数通常无法被确定。我们在一个可能包含时间不一致性个体的非同质人群中构建了一个动态离散选择模型。我们提出了所有人群类型的概率和偏好在时间和一致性以及复杂型个体上都是点确定的条件，并得出了对于朴素型和部分复杂型个体的设定识别结果。利用印度奥里萨邦农村地区一项提供杀虫剂处理蚊帐的健康干预数据，我们估计模型后发现，样本中的约三分之二为时间不一致性个体，而复杂型和朴素型个体都存在显著的选择偏差。反事实分析表明，由于选择偏差导致的杀虫剂蚊帐投资不足，所带来的成本约为蚊帐价格的四倍。

abstract.text: We propose an index of the adequacy of home environments for protection (HEP) from COVID-19, and we compare our index across developing countries using data for one million sampled households from the latest Demographic and Health Surveys. We find that prevailing WHO recommendations for protection posit unrealistic home environments. 90% of households have inadequate HEP by one or more dimensions considered. 40% do not have a formal health-care facility within 5km. A strong wealth effect is indicated within and between countries. Only 6% of the poorest 40% have an adequate HEP, and the proportion is virtually zero in sub-Saharan Africa.

10.3386/w27200.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于家庭环境对保护免受COVID-19影响的适宜性的指数，并使用最新的人口与健康调查数据，对发展中国家的一百万户家庭进行了比较。我们发现，世界卫生组织目前的保护建议所设想的家庭环境并不现实。90%的家庭在至少一个方面存在不足的防护条件。40%的家庭在5公里范围内没有正式的医疗保健设施。国家内部和国家之间都存在明显的财富差异。最贫困的40%人群中，只有6%的家庭具备足够的防护条件，而在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，这一比例几乎为零。

abstract.text: Researchers have focused on the contemporaneous relationship between cigarette taxes and smoking, while the longer-run effects of cigarette taxes have received little attention. Using individual-level panel data from 1970-2017, we estimate the effects of cigarette taxes experienced as a teenager on smoking later in life. We find that a one-dollar increase in the cigarette tax experienced between the ages of 12 and 17 is associated with substantial reductions in smoking participation and intensity among adults in their 20s through mid-60s. Among first-time mothers, it is associated with a reduction in the likelihood of smoking the year of giving birth.

10.3386/w27204.abstractZh: 研究人员主要关注香烟税与吸烟行为之间的即时关系，而香烟税对长期影响的关注却相对较少。我们利用1970年至2017年的个体层面面板数据，评估青少年时期所经历的香烟税对日后吸烟行为的影响。研究发现，在12至17岁期间香烟税每增加1美元，20多岁到60多岁的成年人吸烟参与率和吸烟强度都会显著下降。对于首次成为母亲的女性来说，这一变化还意味着她们在分娩当年吸烟的可能性会降低。

abstract.text: Market-based environmental policies are widely adopted on the basis of allocative efficiency. However, there is growing concern that market-induced spatial reallocation of pollution could widen existing pollution concentration gaps between disadvantaged and other communities. We examine how this \\environmental justice" (EJ) gap changed following the 2013 introduction of California's carbon market, the world's second largest and the most subjected to EJ critiques. We estimate that the program lowered GHG, PM2:5, PM10, and NOx emissions by 3-9% annually between 2012-2017 for sample industrial facilities regulated only by the carbon market. Using a pollution dispersal model to characterize resulting spatial changes in pollution concentrations, we find the program caused EJ gaps in PM2:5, PM10, and NOx from these facilities to narrow by 6-10% annually. We demonstrate that explicit modeling of pollution dispersal is critical for detecting these results.

10.3386/w27205.abstractZh: 基于市场的环境政策在分配效率的基础上被广泛采用。然而，人们越来越担心，市场导致的污染空间重新分配可能会加剧弱势社区与其他社区之间的污染浓度差距。我们研究了2013年加州碳市场引入后这种“环境正义”差距的变化情况。加州碳市场是世界上第二大碳市场，也最受环境正义批评的。我们估计，在2012年至2017年间，仅受碳市场监管的样本工业设施的温室气体、PM2:5、PM10和NOx排放量每年减少了3-9%。通过污染扩散模型来描述污染浓度的空间变化，我们发现这些设施造成的PM2:5、PM10和NOx的环境正义差距每年缩小了6-10%。我们证明，对污染扩散进行明确建模对于发现这些结果至关重要。

abstract.text: During a pandemic, an individual's choices can determine outcomes not only for the individual but also for the entire community. Beliefs, constraints and preferences may shape behavior. This paper documents demographic differences in behaviors, beliefs, constraints and risk preferences across gender, income and political affiliation lines during the new coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic. Our main analyses are based on data from an original nationally representative survey covering 5,500 adult respondents in the U.S. We find substantial gaps in behaviors and beliefs across gender, income and partisanship lines; in constraints across income levels; and in risk tolerance among men and women. Based on location data from a large sample of smartphones, we also document significant differences in mobility across demographics, which are consistent with our findings based on the survey data.

10.3386/w27211.abstractZh: 在疫情期间，个人的选择不仅会影响其自身的生活状况，也会对整个社区产生影响。信念、约束和偏好可能会塑造行为。本文记录了在新型冠状病毒疾病（COVID-19）疫情期间，不同性别、收入和政治立场的人群在行为、信念、约束和风险偏好方面的差异。我们的主要分析基于一项全国代表性调查的数据，该调查涵盖了美国5,500名成年受访者。我们发现，不同性别、收入和政治立场的人在行为及信念上存在显著差异；不同收入水平的人在约束方面也存在差异；男性和女性在风险容忍度方面也存在差异。此外，基于大量智能手机的位置数据，我们还发现不同人群在移动性方面的显著差异，这些差异与基于调查数据的发现一致。

abstract.text: Recent outbreaks of infectious pathogens such as Zika, Ebola, and COVID-19 have underscored the need for the dependable availability of vaccines against emerging infectious diseases (EIDs). The cost and risk of R&D programs and uniquely unpredictable demand for EID vaccines have discouraged vaccine developers, and government and nonprofit agencies have been unable to provide timely or sufficient incentives for their development and sustained supply. We analyze the economic returns of a portfolio of EID vaccine assets, and find that under realistic financing assumptions, the expected returns are significantly negative, implying that the private sector is unlikely to address this need without public-sector intervention. We have sized the financing deficit for this portfolio and analyze several potential solutions, including price increases, enhanced public-private partnerships, and subscription models through which individuals would pay annual fees to obtain access to a portfolio of vaccines in the event of an outbreak.

10.3386/w27212.abstractZh: 近期爆发的寨卡、埃博拉和COVID-19等传染性病原体事件，凸显了针对新发传染病（EIDs）的疫苗必须具备可靠供应的重要性。研发项目的成本和风险，以及EIDs疫苗需求的不确定性，使得疫苗开发者望而却步。政府和非营利机构也未能及时提供足够的激励措施来支持疫苗的研发和持续供应。我们对一系列EIDs疫苗资产的经济回报进行了分析，发现在实际融资假设下，预期回报显著为负，这意味着如果没有公共部门的干预，私营部门不太可能满足这一需求。我们估算了该投资组合的融资缺口，并分析了几种潜在的解决方案，包括提高价格、加强公私合作模式，以及通过订阅模式，让个人在疫情爆发时支付年度费用以获取疫苗。

abstract.text: By exploiting rich retrospective data on childhood immunization, socioeconomics, and health status in China (the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study), we assess the long-term effects of childhood vaccination on cognitive and educational outcomes in that country. To do so, we apply various techniques (e.g., propensity score and coarsened exact matching and correlated random effects) to different sets of conditioning variables and subsamples to estimate the average treatment on the treated effect of childhood vaccination. Our results confirm that vaccinations before the age of 15 have long-term positive and economically meaningful effects on nonhealth outcomes such as education and cognitive skills. These effects are relatively strong, with vaccinated individuals enjoying about one more year of schooling and performing substantially better later in life on several cognitive tests.

10.3386/w27217.abstractZh: 通过利用中国健康与退休纵向研究中的丰富回顾性数据，关于儿童免疫接种、社会经济状况以及健康状况的信息，我们评估了儿童疫苗接种对该国认知和教育成果的长期影响。为此，我们采用了多种技术（如倾向评分、粗略精确匹配和相关随机效应等），针对不同的条件变量和子样本，来估算儿童疫苗接种对受治疗效果的平均影响。我们的研究结果证实，15岁之前的疫苗接种对非健康结果如教育和认知技能具有长期且具有经济意义的积极影响。这些影响相当显著，接种疫苗的个体通常多接受一年的教育，并在以后的生活中在多项认知测试中的表现明显更好。

abstract.text: We develop a model of pandemic risk management and ﬁrm valuation. We introduce aggregate transmission shocks into an epidemic model and link valuations to infections via an asset-pricing framework with vaccines. Infections lower earnings growth but ﬁrms can mitigate damages. We estimate a large reproduction number R0 and transmission volatility for COVID-19. Using these estimates, we assess the accuracy of deterministic approximations based on R0. Our model generates predictions consistent with data: unexpected infection resurgence, non-monotonic mitigation policies, and higher price-to-earnings ratios during a pandemic. Valuations would be signiﬁcantly lower absent mitigation and a high vaccine arrival rate.

10.3386/w27218.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个关于疫情风险管理与企业估值模型。我们将总体传播冲击引入流行病模型，并通过一个包含疫苗的资产定价框架，将估值与感染情况联系起来。感染会降低企业的盈利增长，但企业能够减轻损失。我们对COVID-19的较大传播数R0和传播波动性进行了估算。利用这些估算值，我们评估了基于R0的确定性近似方法的准确性。我们的模型得出的预测与数据一致：出现了意外的感染反弹、非单调的缓解政策，以及疫情期间的更高市盈率。如果没有缓解措施和高效的疫苗普及，估值将会显著下降。

abstract.text: South Korea publicly disclosed detailed location information of individuals that tested positive for COVID-19. We quantify the effect of public disclosure on the transmission of the virus and economic losses in Seoul. The change in commuting patterns due to public disclosure lowers the number of cases by 200 thousand and the number of deaths by 7.7 thousand in Seoul over two years. Compared to a city-wide lock-down that results in the same number of cases over two years as the disclosure scenario, the economic cost of such a lockdown is almost four times higher.

10.3386/w27220.abstractZh: 韩国公开了检测出新冠病毒阳性的个人的详细位置信息。我们量化了这种公开信息对病毒传播和首尔经济损失的影响。由于公开信息，通勤模式发生了变化，在两年时间内，首尔的病例数减少了20万，死亡人数减少了7.7千人。与全城封锁相比，全城封锁在两年内的病例数相同，但经济成本几乎是后者的四倍。

abstract.text: Government programs are often offered on an optional basis to market participants. We explore the economics of such voluntary regulation in the context of a Medicare payment reform, in which one medical provider receives a single, predetermined payment for a sequence of related healthcare services, instead of separate service-specific payments. This “bundled payment” program was originally implemented as a 5-year randomized trial, with mandatory participation by hospitals assigned to the new payment model, but after two years participation was unexpectedly made voluntary for half of these hospitals. Using detailed claim-level data, we document that voluntary participation is more likely for hospitals who can increase revenue without changing behavior (“selection on levels”) and for hospitals that had large changes in behavior when participation was mandatory (“selection on slopes”). To assess outcomes under counterfactual regimes, we estimate a simple model of responsiveness to and selection into the program. We find that the current voluntary regime generates inefficient transfers to hospitals and reduces social welfare compared to the status quo, but that alternative (feasible) designs could substantially reduce these inefficient transfers. Our analysis highlights key design elements to consider under voluntary regulation.

10.3386/w27223.abstractZh: 政府项目通常是以自愿性的方式提供给市场参与者。我们探讨了在医疗保险支付改革背景下这种自愿性监管的经济学效应。在这种改革中，一个医疗服务提供者会获得一系列相关医疗服务的单一、预先确定的支付，而不是针对每项服务的单独支付。这种“捆绑支付”计划最初是通过为期5年的随机试验来实施的，医院必须参与新的支付模式。但两年后，有一半的医院选择自愿参与。通过详细的索赔数据，我们发现，那些能够在不改变行为的情况下增加收入的医院，以及那些在强制参与时行为发生显著变化的医院，更有可能自愿参与。为了评估在替代制度下的结果，我们建立了一个简单的模型来模拟对项目的响应和选择行为。我们发现，目前的自愿制度会导致医院之间的转移效率低下，并降低社会福利，但其他可行的设计方案可以显著减少这些低效的转移。我们的分析强调了在自愿监管下需要考虑的关键设计要素。

abstract.text: COVID-19 antibody tests have imperfect accuracy. There has been lack of clarity on the meaning of reported rates of false positives and false negatives. For risk assessment and clinical decision making, the rates of interest are the positive and negative predictive values of a test. Positive predictive value (PPV) is the chance that a person who tests positive has been infected. Negative predictive value (NPV) is the chance that someone who tests negative has not been infected. The medical literature regularly reports different statistics, sensitivity and specificity. Sensitivity is the chance that an infected person receives a positive test result. Specificity is the chance that a non-infected person receives a negative result. Knowledge of sensitivity and specificity permits one to predict the test result given a person’s true infection status. These predictions are not directly relevant to risk assessment or clinical decisions, where one knows a test result and wants to predict whether a person has been infected. Given estimates of sensitivity and specificity, PPV and NPV can be derived if one knows the prevalence of the disease, the rate of illness in the population. There is considerable uncertainty about the prevalence of COVID-19. This paper addresses the problem of inference on the PPV and NPV of COVID-19 antibody tests given estimates of sensitivity and specificity and credible bounds on prevalence. I explain the methodological problem, show how to estimate bounds on PPV and NPV, and apply the findings to some tests authorized by the FDA.

10.3386/w27226.abstractZh: COVID-19抗体检测的准确性并不完美。关于检测中假阳性和假阴性的发生率，目前尚无明确的定义。在风险评估和临床决策中，人们关注的是检测的阳性预测值、阴性预测值。阳性预测值是指检测呈阳性的人确实被感染的概率；阴性预测值则是指检测呈阴性的人未被感染的概率。医学文献中经常使用不同的统计指标，如敏感性和特异性。敏感性是指被感染的人获得阳性检测结果的概率；特异性则是指未感染的人获得阴性检测结果的概率。了解敏感性和特异性有助于预测一个人的感染状况。这些预测并不直接适用于风险评估或临床决策，因为在这些场景中，人们需要了解检测结果，并预测一个人是否被感染。如果已知疾病的流行率和人群中的发病率，就可以根据敏感性和特异性来推算阳性预测值和阴性预测值。然而，关于COVID-19的流行率存在相当大的不确定性。本文探讨了在已知敏感性和特异性估计值以及流行率可信区间的情况下，如何推断COVID-19抗体检测的阳性预测值和阴性预测值。我解释了该方法论问题，展示了如何估算阳性预测值和阴性预测值的界限，并将研究结果应用于一些获得FDA批准的检测项目。

abstract.text: One of the most common policy prescriptions to reduce the spread of COVID-19 has been to legally enforce social distancing through state or local shelter-in-place orders (SIPOs). This paper is the first to explore the comparative effectiveness of early county-level SIPOs versus later statewide mandates in curbing COVID-19 growth. We exploit the unique laboratory of Texas, a state in which the early adoption of local SIPOs by densely populated counties covered almost two-thirds of the state’s population prior to Texas’s adoption of a statewide SIPO on April 2, 2020. Using an event study framework, we document that countywide SIPO adoption is associated with a 14 percent increase in the percent of residents who remain at home full-time, a social distancing effect that is largest in urbanized and densely populated counties. Then, we find that in early adopting counties, COVID-19 case growth fell by 19 to 26 percentage points two-and-a-half weeks following adoption of a SIPO, a result robust to controls for county-level heterogeneity in outbreak timing, coronavirus testing, and border SIPO policies. This effect is driven nearly entirely by highly urbanized and densely populated counties. We find that approximately 90 percent of the curbed growth in COVID-19 cases in Texas came from the early adoption of SIPOs by urbanized counties, suggesting that the later statewide shelter-in-place mandate yielded relatively few health benefits.

10.3386/w27229.abstractZh: 减少COVID-19传播的常见政策措施之一是通过州或地方封锁令来强制实施社交距离。本文首次探讨了早期县级封锁令与后期全州封锁令在遏制COVID-19传播方面的效果差异。我们选取了德克萨斯州作为研究案例，该州在2020年4月2日实施全州封锁令之前，已有密集人口较多的县率先实施局部封锁令，覆盖了该州近三分之二的人口。通过事件研究框架分析，我们发现县级封锁令的实施使居民完全居家的时间比例增加了14%，这一社交距离效应在人口密集且城市化程度较高的县最为明显。此外，我们还发现，在较早实施封锁令的县，封锁令实施两周半后，COVID-19病例增长率下降了19至26个百分点，这一结果在控制了县际疫情爆发时间差异、冠状病毒检测情况以及边境封锁政策等因素后依然成立。这一效应主要由人口密集且城市化程度较高的县所驱动。我们发现在德克萨斯州，约90%的COVID-19病例增长得益于早期实施局部封锁令的县，这表明后期全州封锁令对公共卫生的益处相对较小。

abstract.text: This study quantifies the effect of state reopening policies on daily mobility, travel, and mixing behavior during the COVID-19 pandemic. We harness cell device signal data to examine the effects of the timing and pace of reopening plans in different states. We quantify the increase in mobility patterns during the reopening phase by a broad range of cell-device-based metrics. Soon (four days) after reopening, we observe a 6% to 8% mobility increase. In addition, we find that temperature and precipitation are strongly associated with increased mobility across counties. The mobility measures that reflect visits to a greater variety of locations responds the most to reopening policies, while total time in vs. outside the house remains unchanged. The largest increases in mobility occur in states that were late adopters of closure measures, suggesting that closure policies may have represented more of a binding constraint in those states. Together, these four observations provide an assessment of the extent to which people in the U.S. are resuming movement and physical proximity as the COVID-19 pandemic continues.

10.3386/w27235.abstractZh: 本研究量化了州政府重新开放政策对COVID-19疫情期间日常出行、旅行和社交行为的影响。我们利用移动设备信号数据来考察不同州重新开放计划的时机和节奏所带来的影响。我们通过一系列基于移动设备的指标来量化重新开放阶段出行模式的增加情况。重新开放后四天内，我们观察到出行量增加了6%至8%。此外，我们发现温度和降水量与各县的出行增加之间存在密切关联。反映更多地点访问的出行指标对重新开放政策的反应最为明显，而在家外和在家内的总时间则保持不变。出行量增长最明显的州是那些较晚采取封锁措施的州，这表明封锁政策在这些州可能更多地起到了约束作用。这四项观察结果共同反映了在COVID-19疫情持续期间，美国民众在多大程度上恢复了出行和身体接触。

abstract.text: This short note constructs Mobility Zones to facilitate the discussion on the geographic extent of individual mobility restrictions to control the spread of Covid-19. Mobility Zones are disjoint sets of counties where a given level of individual mobility directly or indirectly connects all counties within each set. I compute Mobility Zones for the United States and each state using smartphone-based mobility data between counties. The average area and population of Mobility Zones have slightly grown at the onset of the epidemic and have sharply shrunk afterward. Pre-Covid-19 Mobility Zones may be useful in calibrating quantitative studies of targeted restriction policies, or for policymakers deciding on the adoption of specific mobility measures. Two examples suggest the use of Mobility Zones to inform within-state differences and cross-state coordination in mobility restriction policies.

10.3386/w27236.abstractZh: 这篇简短的论文构建了“移动性区域”，以推动关于个人移动限制地理范围讨论，从而控制新冠病毒的传播。移动性区域是由若干县组成的独立集合，其中某个特定水平的个人移动直接或间接连接了该集合内的所有县。我利用基于智能手机的移动数据，计算了美国的各个州的移动性区域。在疫情初期，移动性区域的平均面积和人口略有增长，之后则急剧缩小。在新冠疫情之前，移动性区域可能有助于校准针对特定限制政策的定量研究，或帮助政策制定者决定采用何种具体的移动限制措施。两个例子表明，移动性区域可用于了解各州内部差异以及跨州在移动限制政策上的协调。

abstract.text: We test for and measure the effects of cable news in the US on regional differences in compliance with recommendations by health experts to practice social distancing during the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic. We use a quasi-experimental design to estimate the causal effect of Fox News viewership on stay-at-home behavior by using only the incremental local viewership due to the quasi-random assignment of channel positions in a local cable line-up. We find that a 10% increase in Fox News cable viewership (approximately 0:13 higher viewer rating points) leads to a 1.3 percentage point reduction in the propensity to stay at home. We find a persuasion rate of Fox News on non-compliance with stay-at-home behavior during the crisis of about 5:7% - 28:4% across our various social distancing metrics.

10.3386/w27237.abstractZh: 我们测试并衡量了有线电视新闻在美国对地区间遵守健康专家建议的社交距离措施的影响。在COVID-19疫情初期，我们采用准实验设计，仅通过局部有线电视节目编排中的随机分配来估计福克斯新闻观众数量对居家行为的影响。研究发现，福克斯新闻有线电视观众数量增加10%（约0:13的观众评分点）会导致居家倾向降低1.3个百分点。我们得出的结论是，在危机期间，福克斯新闻在非遵守居家行为方面的说服率为5:7%至28:4%。

abstract.text: We document the immediate and long-term effects of violent media. Specifically, we evaluate the effects of The Ultimate Fighter, a hit TV show that features fighters competing in violent mixed martial arts and which brought Ultimate Fighting Championship into the mainstream. We estimate the effect of early exposure to this show using panel data from police agencies across the United States and a strategy that uses network ratings prior to the show's premier as an instrumental variable. We show that early exposure significantly reduced crime: these effects are particularly evident for assault, began in the month the show premiered, and persisted for many years. These estimates do not reflect systematic differences across geographic areas in their trends in crime rates prior to 2005. To complement our main results, we also investigate the effects of "UFC Main Events," which air in bars and on Pay-Per-View. This analysis additionally suggests reductions in violence caused by viewership.

10.3386/w27240.abstractZh: 我们记录了暴力媒体对短期和长期的影響。具体而言，我们评估了《终极格斗冠军赛》这一热门电视节目的影响，该节目以格斗选手参加激烈的混合武术比赛为特色，并将终极格斗冠军赛推向了主流市场。我们通过来自美国各地警察机构的面板数据，并利用节目首播前的网络收视率作为工具变量，来估算早期接触该节目的效果。结果显示，早期接触该节目显著降低了犯罪率：这些影响在节目首播当月尤为明显，并持续了多年。这些估计结果并未反映出2005年之前不同地理区域犯罪率趋势的系统性差异。为了补充我们的主要研究结果，我们还调查了在酒吧和付费观看平台上播放的《终极格斗冠军赛》事件所带来的暴力减少效果。这项分析还表明，观众观看这些节目有助于降低暴力行为。

abstract.text: We use a five-age epidemiological model, combined with 66-sector economic accounting, to address a variety of questions concerning the economic reopening. We calibrate/estimate the model using contact survey data and data on weekly historical individual actions and non-pharmaceutical interventions in the weeks ending March 8 – May 16, 2020. Going forward, we model a decision-maker (governor) as following reopening guidelines like those proposed by the White House and the CDC. The sectoral accounting, combined with information on personal proximity and ability to work from home by sector, make it possible to construct a GDP-to-Risk index of which sectors provide the greatest increment in GDP per marginal increase in R0. Through simulations, we find that: a strong economic reopening is possible; a “smart” reopening, preferencing some sectors over others, makes only modest improvements over a broad reopening; and all this hinges on retaining strong restrictions on non-work social contacts. If non-work contacts – going to bars, shopping without social distancing and masks, large group gatherings, etc. – return only half-way to the pre-COVID-19 baseline, the current decline in deaths reverses leading to a second wave of business closures.

10.3386/w27244.abstractZh: 我们采用了一个包含五个发展阶段的流行病学模型，并结合了66个行业的经济核算数据，来探讨与经济重启相关的一系列问题。我们通过接触调查数据以及2020年3月8日至5月16日期间的每周个人行为数据和非药物干预措施数据来校准/估算该模型。未来，我们将决策者（政府官员）的行为模型设定为遵循白宫和疾控中心提出的重启指南。通过行业核算以及关于个人近距离接触能力和居家工作的信息，我们可以构建一个GDP与风险指数，从而确定哪些行业在R0值每上升一单位时能够带来最大的GDP增长。通过模拟发现：强有力的经济重启是可能的；“智能”重启，即优先考虑某些行业而非其他行业，虽然能带来适度的改善，但整体效果仍不如全面重启；而这一切都取决于是否继续对非工作社交活动实施严格的限制。如果非工作社交活动——如去酒吧、不保持社交距离和佩戴口罩购物、大规模聚会等——只能恢复到COVID-19疫情前的水平，那么目前死亡率的下降将会逆转，导致第二波企业关闭。

abstract.text: Little is known about how people’s beliefs concerning the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) influence their behavior. To shed light on this, we conduct an online experiment (n = 3,610) with US and UK residents. Participants are randomly allocated to a control group or to one of two treatment groups. The treatment groups are shown upperor lower-bound expert estimates of the infectiousness of the virus. We present three main empirical findings. First, individuals dramatically overestimate the dangerousness and infectiousness of COVID-19 relative to expert opinion. Second, providing people with expert information partially corrects their beliefs about the virus. Third, the more infectious people believe that COVID-19 is, the less willing they are to take protective measures, a finding we dub the “fatalism effect”. We develop a formal model that can explain the fatalism effect and discuss its implications for optimal policy during the pandemic.

10.3386/w27245.abstractZh: 关于人们对新型冠状病毒疾病2019（COVID-19）的认知如何影响其行为，目前了解甚少。为了探究这一问题，我们开展了一项在线实验，涉及3,610名美国和英国居民。参与者被随机分配到对照组或两个处理组之一。处理组分别被展示出关于病毒传染性的上限或下限专家估计值。我们得出了三个主要实证发现：首先，个人对COVID-19的危险性和传染性的高估程度远高于专家意见；其次，向人们提供专家信息可以部分纠正他们对病毒的认知；第三，人们认为COVID-19具有较高传染性的情况下，他们采取保护措施的意愿反而降低，这一发现我们称之为“宿命主义效应”。我们建立了一个正式模型来解释这一宿命主义效应，并讨论了其对疫情期间最优政策的影响。

abstract.text: We use dynamic panel data models to generate density forecasts for daily Covid-19 infections for a panel of countries/regions. At the core of our model is a specification that assumes that the growth rate of active infections can be represented by autoregressive fluctuations around a downward sloping deterministic trend function with a break. Our fully Bayesian approach allows us to flexibly estimate the cross-sectional distribution of heterogeneous coefficients and then implicitly use this distribution as prior to construct Bayes forecasts for the individual time series. According to our model, there is a lot of uncertainty about the evolution of infection rates, due to parameter uncertainty and the realization of future shocks. We find that over a one-week horizon the empirical coverage frequency of our interval forecasts is close to the nominal credible level. Weekly forecasts from our model are published at https://laurayuliu.com/covid19-panel-forecast/.

10.3386/w27248.abstractZh: 我们使用动态面板数据模型来生成各国/地区每日新冠感染率的预测。我们模型的核心假设是，活跃感染率的增长可以通过围绕一个向下倾斜的确定性趋势函数的自回归波动来表示，该趋势函数有一个转折点。我们的完全贝叶斯方法使我们能够灵活地估计异质系数的横截面分布，并随后将这些分布作为先验信息来构建个体时间序列的贝叶斯预测。根据我们的模型，由于参数不确定性和未来冲击的发生，感染率的演变存在很大的不确定性。我们发现，在一周的时间范围内，我们的区间预测的实际覆盖频率接近名义可信水平。我们模型的每周预测可以在https://laurayuliu.com/covid19-panel-forecast/查看。

abstract.text: COVID-19 may accelerate the automation of jobs, as employers invest in technology to adapt the production process to safeguard against current and potential future pandemics. We identify occupations that have high automation potential and also exhibit a high degree of risk of viral infection. We then examine regional variation in terms of which U.S. local labor markets are most at risk. Next, we outline the differential impact that COVID-19 may have on automatable jobs for different demographic groups. We find that occupations held by U.S. females with mid to low levels of wages and education are at highest risk. Using comparable data for 25 other countries, we find women in this demographic are also at highest risk internationally.

10.3386/w27249.abstractZh: COVID-19可能会加速就业的自动化进程，因为雇主投资于技术，以调整生产过程，从而防范当前及未来可能出现的疫情。我们识别出那些具有高度自动化潜力且病毒感染风险较高的职业。接着，我们分析了美国各地劳动力市场面临的风险程度。此外，我们还探讨了COVID-19对不同人口群体可自动化工作的不同影响。研究发现，收入水平和教育程度处于中等或较低水平的美国女性所从事的职业面临的风险最高。通过对比25个其他国家的数据，我们发现这一人口群体在国际上同样面临最高风险。

abstract.text: We rank counties in the United States of America with respect to population health. We utilize the five observable county health variables used to construct the University of Wisconsin Population Health Institute’s County Health Rankings (CHRs). Our method relies on a factor analysis model to directly compute weights for our rankings, incorporate county population sizes into the variances, and allow for spillovers of health stock across county lines. We find that demographic and economic variation explain a large portion of the variation in health rankings. We address the importance of uncertainty caused by imputation of missing data and show that the use of rankings leads to inherently greater uncertainty. Analyzing the health of counties both within and across state lines shows substantial degrees of disparity. We find some disagreement between our ranks and the CHRs, but we show that much can be learned by combining results from both methods.

10.3386/w27259.abstractZh: 我们根据人口健康状况对美国的各个县进行了排名。我们采用了威斯康星大学人口健康研究所使用的五个可观测的县健康变量来构建县健康排名体系。我们的方法依赖于因子分析模型，直接计算出排名的权重，将县人口规模纳入方差计算中，并允许健康状况在县际间的传递。我们发现，人口统计和经济因素在很大程度上解释了健康排名的差异。我们强调了因缺失数据而带来的不确定性，并表明使用排名方式会进一步增加不确定性。分析县内及跨州的健康状况时，我们发现存在相当大的差异。我们发现我们的排名与CHRs之间存在一些差异，但我们认为通过结合两种方法的结果，可以学到很多有价值的信息。

abstract.text: Unlike most countries, Korea did not implement a lockdown in its battle against COVID-19, instead successfully relying on testing and contact tracing. Only one region, Daegu-Gyeongbuk (DG), had a significant number of infections, traced to a religious sect. This allows us to estimate the causal effect of the outbreak on the labor market using difference-in-differences. We find that a one per thousand increase in infections causes a 2 to 3 percent drop in local employment. Non-causal estimates of this coefficient from the US and UK, which implemented large-scale lockdowns, range from 5 to 6 percent, suggesting that at most half of the job losses in the US and UK can be attributed to lockdowns. We also find that employment losses caused by local outbreaks in the absence of lockdowns are (i) mainly due to reduced hiring by small establishments, (ii) concentrated in the accommodation/food, education, real estate, and transportation industries, and (iii) worst for the economically vulnerable workers who are less educated, young, in low-wage occupations, and on temporary contracts, even controlling for industry effects. All these patterns are similar to what we observe in the US and UK: The unequal effects of COVID-19 are the same with or without lockdowns. Our finding suggests that the lifting of lockdowns in the US and UK may lead to only modest recoveries in employment unless COVID-19 infection rates fall.

10.3386/w27264.abstractZh: 与大多数国家不同，韩国在抗击COVID-19的过程中并未实施封锁措施，而是依靠检测和接触者追踪来应对疫情。只有大邱广域市有一个地区出现了大量感染病例，这些病例与某个宗教团体有关。这使我们能够使用差异差分模型来估计疫情对劳动力市场的因果影响。研究发现，每千例感染病例增加会导致当地就业减少2%到3%。美国和英国等实施大规模封锁的国家对此系数的非因果估计值在5%到6%之间，这表明美国和英国中最多只有一半的就业损失可以归因于封锁措施。我们还发现，在没有封锁的情况下，由地方疫情导致的就业损失主要源于小型企业的招聘减少，这些损失主要集中在住宿、食品、教育、房地产和交通等行业，且对经济条件较差、受教育程度较低、从事低薪职业以及签订临时合同的劳动者影响最大。所有这些现象都与美国和英国的情况相似：无论是否实施封锁，COVID-19对劳动力市场的影响都是不对称的。我们的研究结果表明，除非COVID-19的感染率下降，否则美国和英国在解除封锁后就业市场的恢复幅度可能只会是有限的。

abstract.text: Consumers often face an overwhelming amount of information when deciding between products, and one of the primary policymaking tools available to improve their informativeness is the framing of this information. We introduce a general theoretical approach that characterizes when one frame is revealed to provide robustly higher welfare than another. Because it is testable, adaptable, and both necessary and sufficient, our condition determines both whether frames are robustly welfare ranked in a particular data set and the overall proportion of data sets in which frames can be so ranked.

10.3386/w27265.abstractZh: 消费者在比较不同产品时，往往面临海量的信息。为了提高信息的有效性，一种主要的政策制定工具就是对这些信息进行框架化处理。我们提出了一种通用的理论方法，用于判断哪种框架化处理能够带来更显著的福利提升。由于这种方法具有可测试性、可适应性，并且是必要且充分的条件，因此它能够确定在特定数据集中哪些框架化处理在福利上具有优势，以及有多少数据集符合这种框架化处理的排序标准。

abstract.text: Using administrative data for Upper Austrian workers from 2003--2013, we show that an extension in unemployment insurance (UI) duration increases unemployment length and impacts worker physical and mental health. These effects vary by gender. Specifically, we find that women eligible for an additional 9 weeks of UI benefits fill fewer opioid and antidepressant prescriptions and experience a lower likelihood of filing a disability claim, as compared to non-eligible unemployed women. Moreover, estimates indicate within-household spillovers for young children. For men, we find that extending UI benefit duration increases the likelihood of a cardiac event and eventual disability retirement filing.

10.3386/w27267.abstractZh: 通过利用2003年至2013年上奥地利地区工人的行政数据，我们发现延长失业保险期限会增加失业时间，并对工人的身心健康产生影响。这些影响因性别而异。具体而言，我们发现，有资格额外获得9周失业保险福利的女性，其阿片类药物和抗抑郁药处方数量较少，申请残疾救济的可能性也较低，与非符合条件的失业女性相比。此外，估计结果显示，这一政策对家庭中的年幼儿童也有积极影响。对于男性来说，延长失业保险福利期限会增加心脏病发作的可能性，以及最终申请残疾退休的可能性。

abstract.text: Efforts to raise the productivity of the U.S. health care system have proceeded slowly. One potential explanation is the fragmentation of payment across insurers. Each insurer's efforts to improve care could influence how doctors practice medicine for other insurers, leading to unvalued externalities. We study these externalities by examining the unintended private insurance spillovers of a public insurer's intervention. In 2015, Medicare randomized warning letters to doctors to curtail overuse of antipsychotics. Even though the letters did not mention private insurance, they reduced prescribing to privately insured patients by 12%. The reduction to Medicare patients was 17%, and we cannot reject one-for-one spillovers. The results imply that physicians experience large costs to setting insurer-specific medical practice styles. If private insurers conducted a similar intervention with their own limited information, they would stem half as much prescribing as a social planner able and willing to better target the intervention. Our findings establish that insurers can affect health care well outside their direct purview, raising the question of how to match their private objectives with their scope of influence.

10.3386/w27270.abstractZh: 提高美国医疗保健系统生产力的努力进展缓慢。一个可能的解释是支付方式的分散性，即不同保险公司之间的支付体系相互独立。每个保险公司为改善医疗服务所做的努力可能会影响其他保险公司的医生执业方式，从而产生未被充分评估的外部影响。我们通过研究公共保险公司干预行为对私人保险公司的意外影响来探讨这些外部影响。2015年，医疗保险部门向医生发送了随机警告信，以限制抗精神病药物的过度使用。尽管这些信件并未提及私人保险，但它们使私人保险患者的处方量减少了12%。而医疗保险患者的处方量减少了17%，因此我们可以排除一对一的溢出效应。研究结果表明，医生在设定特定保险公司的医疗实践风格时会面临巨大成本。如果私人保险公司在有限的信息条件下进行类似的干预，其干预效果将仅为社会规划者能够且愿意进行更精准干预效果的一半。我们的研究表明，保险公司可以在其直接管辖范围之外对医疗保健产生影响，这引发了如何使他们的私人目标与其影响力范围相匹配的问题。

abstract.text: One-quarter of married, fertile-age women in Sub-Saharan Africa report not wanting a pregnancy and yet do not practice contraception. We collect detailed data on the subjective beliefs of married, adult women not wanting a pregnancy and estimate a structural model of contraceptive choices. Both our structural model and a validation exercise using an exogenous shock to beliefs show that correcting women’s beliefs about pregnancy risk absent contraception can increase use considerably. Our structural estimates further indicate that costly interventions like eliminating supply constraints would only modestly increase contraceptive use, while confirming the importance of partners’ preferences highlighted in related literature.

10.3386/w27271.abstractZh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，四分之一的已婚、生育年龄女性表示不希望怀孕，但却并未采取避孕措施。我们收集了关于这些已婚成年女性不希望怀孕的主观信念的详细数据，并构建了一个关于避孕选择的结构模型。我们的结构模型以及一项使用外部冲击来验证模型的有效性的实验表明，纠正女性对无避孕措施情况下怀孕风险的认知，可以显著增加避孕使用的频率。我们的结构模型估计还显示，像消除供应限制这样的昂贵干预措施，只能适度增加避孕使用的频率，同时进一步证实了相关文献中强调的伴侣偏好的重要性。

abstract.text: US antitrust authorities are only notified of large mergers, so most transactions could escape antitrust scrutiny. I study premerger notification exemptions in the dialysis industry. I find that, in sharp contrast to reportable mergers, exempt ones almost completely avoid enforcement. As a result, exempt mergers increase concentration and reduce healthcare quality, as measured by hospitalization and mortality rates. I then estimate a structural model to simulate the equilibrium response of demand, quality, and enforcement to the elimination of exemptions. I find that the benefits of eliminating exemptions in the dialysis industry far exceed the costs.

10.3386/w27274.abstractZh: 美国反垄断机构仅会收到关于大型合并的通知，因此大多数交易可能逃避反垄断审查。我研究了透析行业在合并前免于通知的情况。我发现，与需要上报的合并相比，免于通知的合并几乎完全避免了执法。因此，免于通知的合并加剧了企业集中度，并降低了医疗质量，这可以从住院率和死亡率来衡量。随后，我建立了一个结构模型来模拟需求、质量和执法对取消豁免措施的反应。我发现，取消透析行业豁免措施的好处远远超过其成本。

abstract.text: Voluntary social distancing plays a vital role in containing the spread of the disease during a pandemic. As a public good, it should be more commonplace in more homogeneous and altruistic societies. However, for healthy people, observing social distancing has private benefits, too. If sick individuals are more likely to stay home, healthy ones have fewer incentives to do so, especially if the asymptomatic transmission is perceived to be unlikely. Theoretically, we show that this interplay may lead to a stricter observance of social distancing in more diverse and less altruistic societies. Empirically, we find that, consistent with the model, the reduction in mobility following the first local case of COVID-19 was stronger in Russian cities with higher ethnic fractionalization and cities with higher levels of xenophobia. For identification, we predict the timing of the first case using pre-existing patterns of internal migration to Moscow. Using SafeGraph data on mobility patterns, we confirm that mobility reduction in the United States was also higher in counties with higher ethnic fractionalization. Our findings highlight the importance of strategic incentives of different population groups for the effectiveness of public policy.

10.3386/w27277.abstractZh: 在疫情期间，自愿保持社交距离在遏制疾病传播方面发挥着至关重要的作用。作为一种公共物品，它在更加同质化和利他主义的社会中应该更为普遍。然而，对于健康的人来说，遵守社交距离也有私人利益。如果患病者更有可能待在家里，那么健康的人就没有足够的动机这样做，尤其是当无症状传播被认为不太可能发生时。理论上，我们表明这种相互作用可能导致在更加多样化且利他主义程度较低的社会中，社交距离的遵守程度更加严格。实证上，我们发现，与模型预测一致，在俄罗斯城市中，种族分化程度较高以及仇外情绪较强的城市，在首次出现本地病例后，人们的流动性减少幅度更大。为了进行识别，我们根据莫斯科内部迁移的现有模式预测了首例病例出现的时间。利用SafeGraph关于流动性模式的数据，我们确认在美国，种族分化程度较高的县，人们的流动性减少幅度也更大。我们的发现强调了不同人口群体所拥有的战略性激励对公共政策效果的重要性。

abstract.text: Several high-profile news stories have linked post-September 11 (9/11) combat service to violent crime among veterans. Nevertheless, there is scant causal evidence for this claim. We exploit the administrative procedures by which U.S. Armed Forces senior commanders conditionally randomly assign active duty servicemen to overseas deployments to estimate the causal impact of modern warfare on crime. Using data from two national surveys and a unified framework, we find consistent evidence that post-9/11 combat service substantially increased the probability of crime commission among veterans. Combat increases the likelihood of property and violent crime, arrest, gang membership, trouble with police, and punishment under the Uniform Code of Military Justice. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that post-9/11 combat exposure generated approximately $26.7 billion in additional crime costs. Finally, we document descriptive evidence that Traumatic Brain Injury and Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) may be important mechanisms to explain post-9/11 combat-induced increases in crime.

10.3386/w27279.abstractZh: 一些备受关注的新闻报道将9/11事件后的战斗服役与退伍军人的暴力犯罪联系起来。然而，关于这一说法的因果证据却非常有限。我们通过美国武装部队高级指挥官有条件随机分配现役军人执行海外任务这一行政程序，来估算现代战争对犯罪的影响。利用两项全国性的调查数据和一个统一的框架，我们发现9/11事件后的战斗服役显著增加了退伍军人犯罪的可能性。战斗会增加财产犯罪、暴力犯罪、被捕、加入帮派、与警察发生冲突以及根据《军事司法统一法典》受到惩罚的风险。粗略计算表明，9/11事件后的战斗服役导致了约267亿美元的额外犯罪成本。最后，我们发现了一些描述性证据，表明创伤性脑损伤和创伤后应激障碍可能是解释9/11事件后战斗服役导致的犯罪增加的重要机制。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of the social distancing policies states adopted between March and April of 2020 in response to the COVID-19 epidemic. These actions, together with voluntary social distancing, appear to have reduced the rate of new COVID-19 cases and deaths, but raised concerns about the costs experienced by workers and businesses. Estimates from difference-in-difference models that leverage cross-state variation in the timing of business closures and stay-at-home mandates suggest that the employment rate fell by about 1.7 percentage points for every extra 10 days that a state experienced a stay-at-home mandate during the period March 12-April 12, 2020; select business closure laws were associated with similar employment effects. Our estimates imply that about 40% of the 12 percentage point decline in employment rates between January and April 2020 was due to a nationwide shock while about 60% was driven by state social distancing policies. The negative employment effects of state policies were larger for workers in "non-essential" industries, workers without a college degree, and early-career workers. Policy caused relatively modest changes in hours worked and earnings among those who remain employed.
