We find no concerning evidence of pre-trends in the monthly (low-frequency) CPS data, but use high-frequency data on work-related mobility measured from cellphones, job-loss-related internet searches, and initial unemployment claims to investigate the possibility that the large employment effects experienced in April could have occurred after the March CPS but but before policy adoption. In those analyses, we find pre-trends for some outcomes but not others. Thus we cannot fully rule out that some employment effects shortly predated the policies. As states relax business closures, ensuring gains in labor market activities in ways that continue to mitigate COVID-19 "surges" and public health risks will be key considerations to monitor.

10.3386/w27280.abstractZh: 本文探讨了2020年3月至4月期间各州为应对COVID-19疫情而采取的社会隔离政策的影响。这些措施，加上自愿性的社会隔离，似乎降低了新的COVID-19病例数和死亡人数，但也引发了关于工人和企业所承受成本的担忧。利用跨州差异模型进行的估计表明，在2020年3月12日至4月12日期间，如果某个州实施居家令的时间每增加10天，就业率就会下降约1.7个百分点；某些商业关闭法规也导致了类似的就业影响。我们的估计表明，2020年1月至4月期间就业率下降12个百分点中，约40%是由于全国性冲击造成的，而约60%则是由州级社会隔离政策引起的。对于“非必要”行业的工人、没有大学学位的工人以及早期职业生涯的工人来说，政策带来的就业负面影响更为严重。对于那些仍然在职的人来说，政策对工作时数和收入的影响相对较小。我们在月度CPS数据中未发现任何令人担忧的预趋势，但利用手机数据、与失业相关的互联网搜索以及最初的失业申请等高频数据，调查了4月份出现的巨大就业效应是否可能发生在3月份的CPS数据之后，但在政策实施之前。在这些分析中，我们发现某些结果存在预趋势，但其他结果则没有。因此，我们无法完全排除某些就业效应在政策实施之前就已经出现的可能性。随着各州放宽商业限制，确保劳动力市场活动有所改善，同时继续缓解COVID-19的疫情高峰和公共卫生风险，将是需要持续关注的关键点。

abstract.text: We provide an interim report on the Indian lockdown provoked by the covid-19 pandemic. The main topics — ranging from the philosophy of lockdown to the provision of relief measures — transcend the Indian case. A recurrent theme is the enormous visibility of covid-19 deaths worldwide, with Governments everywhere propelled to respect this visibility, developing countries perhaps even more so. In advanced economies, the cost of achieving this reduction in visible deaths is “merely” a dramatic reduction in overall economic activity, coupled with far-reaching measures to compensate those who bear such losses. But for India, a developing country with great sectoral and occupational vulnerabilities, this dramatic reduction is more than economic: it means lives lost. These lost lives, through violence, starvation, indebtedness and extreme stress (both psychological and physiological) are invisible. It is this conjunction of visibility and invisibility that drives the Indian response. The lockdown meets all international standards so far; the relief package none.

10.3386/w27282.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于印度因新冠疫情而实施的封锁措施的阶段性报告。主要议题涵盖了从封锁政策理念到救济措施提供等方面的内容，这些议题并非仅适用于印度的情况。一个反复出现的主题是，全球范围内新冠死亡人数的巨大数字，这使得各国政府不得不重视这一现实，尤其是发展中国家。在发达经济体中，实现这一死亡人数减少的目标，仅仅是导致整体经济活动大幅下降，同时还需要采取广泛的措施来补偿那些因此遭受损失的人。但对于印度这样一个具有严重行业及职业脆弱性的发展中国家来说，这种显著的经济损失不仅仅是经济层面的问题，更是生命损失。这些失去的生命，通过暴力、饥饿、债务以及极度的压力（无论是心理还是生理上的），都是不可见的。正是这种可见性与不可见性的结合，推动了印度的应对措施。到目前为止，印度的封锁措施符合所有国际标准；而救济计划则不然。

abstract.text: We examine how policymakers react to a pandemic with uncertainty around key epidemiological and economic policy parameters by embedding a macroeconomic SIR model in a robust control framework. Uncertainty about disease virulence and severity leads to stricter and more persistent quarantines, while uncertainty about the economic costs of mitigation leads to less stringent quarantines. On net, an uncertainty averse planner adopts stronger mitigation measures. Intuitively, the cost of underestimating the pandemic is out-of-control growth and permanent loss-of-life, while the cost of underestimating the economic consequences of quarantine is more transitory.

10.3386/w27289.abstractZh: 我们研究了政策制定者如何应对在关键流行病学和经济政策参数存在不确定性时的疫情应对方式，通过将宏观经济SIR模型嵌入到稳健的控制框架中来进行分析。对疾病毒力和严重性的不确定性会导致更严格且更持久的隔离措施，而对缓解措施经济成本的不确定性则会导致较宽松的隔离措施。总体而言，一个厌恶不确定性的决策者会采取更严格的缓解措施。直观上，低估疫情后果的成本会导致失控的增长和永久性的生命损失，而低估隔离措施经济后果的成本则更多是暂时的。

abstract.text: As the COVID-19 pandemic progresses, researchers are reporting findings of randomized trials comparing standard care with care augmented by experimental drugs. The trials have small sample sizes, so estimates of treatment effects are imprecise. Seeing imprecision, clinicians reading research articles may find it difficult to decide when to treat patients with experimental drugs. Whatever decision criterion one uses, there is always some probability that random variation in trial outcomes will lead to prescribing sub-optimal treatments. A conventional practice when comparing standard care and an innovation is to choose the innovation only if the estimated treatment effect is positive and statistically significant. This practice defers to standard care as the status quo. To evaluate decision criteria, we use the concept of near optimality, which jointly considers the probability and magnitude of decision errors. An appealing decision criterion from this perspective is the empirical success rule, which chooses the treatment with the highest observed average patient outcome in the trial. Considering the design of recent and ongoing COVID-19 trials, we show that the empirical success rule yields treatment results that are much closer to optimal than those generated by prevailing decision criteria based on hypothesis tests.

10.3386/w27293.abstractZh: 随着COVID-19大流行的持续，研究人员正在报告随机试验的结果，这些试验比较了标准治疗与通过实验性药物增强的治疗效果。这些试验的样本量较小，因此治疗效果的估计并不精确。鉴于这种不精确性，阅读研究文章的临床医生可能会难以决定何时使用实验性药物来治疗患者。无论采用何种决策标准，都存在随机变异导致处方治疗效果不佳的可能性。在比较标准治疗与创新疗法时，通常的做法是只有在估计的治疗效果为正且具有统计学显著性时才选择创新疗法。这种做法将标准治疗视为现状。为了评估决策标准，我们引入了“接近最优”的概念，该概念综合考虑了决策错误的概率和幅度。从这个角度来看，一个吸引人的决策标准是“经验性成功规则”，该规则选择在试验中观察到平均患者效果最高的治疗方法。考虑到最近和正在进行的COVID-19试验的设计，我们发现“经验性成功规则”所产生的治疗效果比基于假设检验的现有决策标准更为接近最优。

abstract.text: Reported mental health problems have risen dramatically among U.S. college students over time, as has treatment for these problems. An open question is how healthcare access affects diagnosis of mental illness and treatments such as prescription psychotropic medication use. We examine the effect of state-level Medicaid expansion following the 2014 implementation of the Affordable Care Act on the diagnosis of mental health conditions and psychotropic prescription drug use of a national sample of college students. We find that students from disadvantaged backgrounds are more likely to report being on public insurance after 2014 in expansion states relative to non-expansion states, while more advantaged students do not see this increase. Both diagnosis of common mental health conditions and psychotropic drug use increase following expansion for disadvantaged students relative to advantaged ones, which translates into an elimination of the pre-treatment gap in these outcomes by family background in expansion states. However, these changes are not associated with short-term improvements in measures of mental health status or academic outcomes.

10.3386/w27306.abstractZh: 据报道，美国大学生的心理健康问题随着时间而显著上升，相关治疗需求也相应增加。一个悬而未决的问题是，医疗保健的获取如何影响精神疾病的诊断以及处方精神药物的使用。我们研究了2014年《平价医疗法案》实施后的州级医疗补助扩展对全国大学生心理健康状况诊断和处方精神药物使用的影响。研究发现，2014年后，来自弱势背景的学生在扩展州更有可能使用公共保险，而非扩展州的学生则没有这种趋势。与优势背景的学生相比，弱势背景的学生在扩展州无论是常见心理健康状况的诊断还是精神药物的使用都有所增加，这意味着通过家庭背景造成的治疗前差异在扩展州得到了消除。然而，这些变化并未与心理健康状况或学业表现的短期改善相关联。

abstract.text: Recipients of means-tested program benefits must periodically document continued eligibility through a recertification process. We find evidence that the administrative burden associated with SNAP recertification leads to decreases in program participation. Cases assigned to later recertification interview dates, which leave less time to reschedule missed interviews, are over 20 percent less likely to recertify than cases assigned to interviews earlier in the month. Cases that fail recertification due to later assignments lose an average of $600 in benefits in the following year. These losses are highly skewed: many cases quickly re-enroll, while one quarter remain off SNAP for over a year post-recertification.

10.3386/w27311.abstractZh: 接受经济援助计划的受益人必须定期通过重新认证流程证明自己的资格持续有效。我们发现，与SNAP重新认证相关的行政负担会导致参与者减少。那些被安排在较晚时间进行重新认证面谈的个案，由于无法重新安排错过的时间，重新认证的可能性比那些在月初就进行面谈的个案低20%以上。由于时间安排不当而未能通过重新认证的个案，在接下来的一年中平均会失去600美元的经济援助。这些损失呈现出高度偏态分布：许多个案很快重新参与计划，而有一季度内仍有个案在重新认证后超过一年未能获得经济援助。

abstract.text: I use Current Population Survey Data from February and April 2020 to examine how individual workers have transitioned between labor-market states and which workers have been hurt most by the COVID-19 pandemic. I find not only large effects on workers becoming unemployed but also a decline in labor-force participation, an increase in absence from one’s job, and a decrease in hours worked. Generally, more vulnerable populations—racial and ethnic minorities, those born outside the U.S., women with children, the least educated, and workers with a disability—have experienced the largest declines in the likelihood of (full-time) work and work hours.

10.3386/w27315.abstractZh: 我使用了2020年2月和4月的当前人口调查数据，来研究个体劳动者在劳动力市场状态之间的转换情况，以及哪些劳动者受到了COVID-19大流行的最严重影响。我发现，不仅劳动者失业人数大幅增加，劳动力参与率也有所下降，缺勤率上升，工作小时数减少。总体而言，更脆弱的群体——种族和族裔少数群体、在美国以外出生的人员、有孩子的女性、受教育程度最低的人群以及残疾劳动者——在从事（全职）工作和工作小时数方面的下降幅度最大。

abstract.text: Policymakers have explicitly linked sustained reductions in COVID-19 case growth to reopening policies, including the lifting of shelter-in-place orders (SIPOs). This “hardwired” policy endogeneity creates challenges in isolating the causal effect of lifting a statewide SIPO on COVID-19. To overcome simultaneity bias, we exploit a unique natural experiment generated by the Wisconsin Supreme Court when it abolished Wisconsin’s “Safer at Home” order on separation-of-powers grounds. We capitalize on this sudden, dramatic, and largely unanticipated termination of a statewide SIPO to estimate its effect on social distancing and COVID-19 case growth. First, using anonymized smartphone data from SafeGraph Inc. and a synthetic control design, we find that SIPO termination had little impact on social distancing. Then, using data on COVID-19 case and mortality rates, we find no evidence that the Wisconsin Supreme Court decision impacted COVID-19 growth up to a month following the repeal. We conclude that the impacts of SIPOs are likely not symmetric across enactment and lifting of orders, and this asymmetry sheds new light on the potential mechanisms underlying the effectiveness of these orders.

10.3386/w27322.abstractZh: 政策制定者明确将持续减少COVID-19病例增长与重新开放政策联系起来，包括解除居家令。这种“硬编码”的政策内生性使得确定解除全州居家令对COVID-19的因果效应变得困难。为了克服同时性偏差，我们利用威斯康星州最高法院以权力分立为由废除“居家安全令”这一独特自然实验。我们利用这一突然、戏剧性且几乎未预料到的全州居家令终止事件，来估计其对社交距离和COVID-19病例增长的影响。首先，通过利用SafeGraph公司的匿名智能手机数据以及合成控制设计，我们发现居家令的终止对社交距离几乎没有影响。然后，通过使用COVID-19病例和死亡率的数据，我们发现威斯康星州最高法院的裁决在废除后一个月内并未对COVID-19的增长产生影响。我们得出结论，居家令的生效与解除可能对社会距离的影响并不对称，这种不对称性为理解这些命令有效性的潜在机制提供了新的视角。

abstract.text: Fewer births occur on major US holidays than would otherwise be expected. We use California data to study the nature and health implications of this birth date manipulation. We document 18% fewer births on the day of and just after a holiday. Cesarean sections account for roughly half of the decline. Using insights from the tax bunching and test score manipulation literature, we show that “missing” holiday births are displaced to a window of time 11 days before the holiday through 16 days after the holiday. Delivery type does not change over this window, consistent with a pure retiming of births rather than an increase in the use of procedures such as cesarean sections. Despite the change in timing, we find little evidence of any adverse health consequences for babies born around a holiday. Even among high-risk pregnancies, which are more likely to be retimed, we find a minimal impact of holiday-related birth timing manipulation on infant health. Finally, while some of the retiming seems to be driven by patients’ preferences, provider incentives appear to play a crucial role in holiday-related birth retiming. At Kaiser Permanente hospitals, where systemwide financial incentives discourage providers from electively timing births, the dip in births on holidays is less than for hospitals overall. This suggests that holiday retiming occurs more frequently among providers who face less of a disincentive to electively schedule births.

10.3386/w27326.abstractZh: 在美国的主要节假日期间，出生的婴儿数量比预期要少。我们利用加利福尼亚州的数据来研究这种出生日期调整的性质及其对健康的影响。我们发现，节假日当天及之后出生的婴儿数量减少了18%。其中，剖宫产手术约占这一减少数量的一半。通过借鉴税收捆绑和考试成绩操纵的相关理论，我们发现“缺失”的节假日出生时间被调整到了节假日前11天到后16天的时间段内。在这一时间段内，分娩方式没有发生变化，这表明出生时间的调整主要是对时间的重新安排，而非增加了剖宫产等手术的使用。尽管时间发生了调整，但我们发现，与节假日相关的出生时间调整对婴儿的健康几乎没有不良影响。即使在高风险妊娠中，这种出生时间的调整影响也相对较小。最后，虽然部分时间调整似乎是由患者偏好驱动的，但医疗服务提供者的动机在节假日出生时间调整中起着关键作用。在凯撒永久医院，由于系统内的经济激励措施阻止医疗服务提供者选择性地安排出生时间，节假日期间出生的婴儿数量减少幅度小于其他医院。这表明，在那些面临较少动机限制提供者的医院中，节假日出生时间的调整更为频繁。

abstract.text: We analyze the correlates of COVID-19 cases and deaths across US counties. We consider a wide range of correlates - population density, public transportation, age structure, nursing home residents, connectedness to source countries, etc. - finding that these variables are important predictors of variation in disease severity. Many of the effects are persistent - even increasing - through time. We also show that there are fewer deaths and cases in counties where Donald Trump received a high share of the vote in 2016, partly explaining the emerging political divide over lockdown and reopening policies, but that this correlation is reversed when controlling for shares of minority groups. The patterns we identify are meant to improve our understanding of the drivers of the spread of COVID-19, with an eye toward helping policymakers design responses that are sensitive to the specificities of different locations.

10.3386/w27329.abstractZh: 我们分析了美国各县中COVID-19病例和死亡人数的相关因素。我们考虑了多种相关因素，包括人口密度、公共交通、年龄结构、养老院居民、与来源国的联系等。研究发现，这些变量是疾病严重程度变化的重要预测因素。许多影响因素随时间持续存在，甚至有所加剧。我们还发现，在2016年唐纳德·特朗普获得较高投票比例的县，死亡和病例数量较少，这在一定程度上解释了关于封锁和重新开放政策的政治分歧。不过，当控制少数族裔的比例时，这种相关性会逆转。我们发现的这些模式有助于我们更好地理解COVID-19传播的驱动因素，从而帮助政策制定者设计出针对不同地区的特定应对措施。

abstract.text: In 1956, 52% of urban men and 42% of rural men smoked cigarettes. By 2010, the disparity had flipped: 24.7% of urban men and 30.6% of rural men smoked. Smoking remains the greatest preventable cause of mortality in the United States, and understanding the underlying causes of place-specific differences in behavior is crucial for policy aimed at reducing regional inequality. Using geocoded data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth, I estimate a dynamic model that captures smoking behavior, location decisions, and education over thirty years. Simulation of the estimated model demonstrates that selection on permanent unobserved variables that are correlated with smoking cessation, both in native populations and in those who migrate between rural and urban areas, explains 62.8$\\%$ of the urban/rural smoking disparity. Alternatively, differential tobacco control policies explain only 7.3% of the urban/rural smoking disparity, which suggests that equalizing cigarette taxes across regions may fail to bridge gaps in behavior and health. This paper emphasizes that rural smoking disparities are largely driven by who selects into rural communities.

10.3386/w27334.abstractZh: 在1956年，52%的城市男性和42%的农村男性吸烟。到2010年，这一比例发生了逆转：24.7%的城市男性和30.6%的农村男性吸烟。吸烟仍然是美国最大的可预防死亡原因，了解不同地区行为差异的根本原因对于制定减少地区不平等的政策至关重要。利用《全国青年纵向调查》中的地理编码数据，我建立了一个动态模型，该模型能够捕捉三十年来吸烟行为、地点选择和教育水平的变化。模型模拟结果显示，与戒烟相关的永久性未观测变量的选择，无论是对于本地人口还是那些在城乡之间迁移的人群，能够解释62.8%的城市与农村吸烟差异。相比之下，差异化的烟草控制政策只能解释7.3%的城市与农村吸烟差异，这表明在各地区间统一香烟税可能无法弥补行为和健康方面的差异。本文强调，农村地区的吸烟差异主要受到谁选择进入农村社区的影响。

abstract.text: The educational attainment of siblings is highly correlated. We test for a specific type of peer effect between siblings in educational attainment: genetic nurture. Specifically, we test whether a person’s educational attainment is correlated with their sibling’s polygenic score (PGS) for educational attainment, controlling for their own PGS for educational attainment. Models estimated using genetic data in the National Longitudinal Survey of Adolescent to Adult Health (Add Health) yield strong evidence of such genetic nurture between siblings, and this result is robust to alternative measures of educational attainment and different measures of polygenic score.

10.3386/w27336.abstractZh: siblings的教育成就之间存在高度相关性。我们研究了 siblings之间在教育成就上的一种特定类型的同伴效应：遗传影响。具体来说，我们检验了一个人的教育成就与其 siblings的多基因得分（PGS）之间是否存在相关性，同时控制了该人自身的教育成就多基因得分。使用《青少年至成人健康全国纵向调查》中的遗传数据建立的模型，证实了 siblings之间存在这种遗传影响，且这一结果在采用不同的教育成就衡量标准和多基因得分衡量标准时依然成立。

abstract.text: This note develops a framework for thinking about the following question: What is the maximum amount of consumption that a utilitarian welfare function would be willing to trade off to avoid the deaths associated with the pandemic? The answer depends crucially on the mortality rate associated with the coronavirus. If the mortality rate averages 0.81%, taken from the Imperial College London study, our answer is 41% of one year's consumption. If the mortality rate instead averages 0.44% across age groups, our answer is 28%.

10.3386/w27340.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于思考以下问题：一个功利主义福利函数愿意牺牲多少消费量来避免与疫情相关的死亡？答案在很大程度上取决于与冠状病毒相关的死亡率。如果根据伦敦帝国学院的研究，死亡率平均为0.81%，那么我们的答案是一年消费量的41%。如果不同年龄组的死亡率平均为0.44%，那么我们的答案就是28%。

abstract.text: In the U.S, after age 65, households face income and health risks and a large fraction of these risks are transitory. While consumption significantly responds to transitory income shocks, out-of-pocket medical expenses do not. In contrast, both consumption and out-of-pocket medical expenses respond to transitory health shocks. Thus, most U.S. elderly keep their out-of-pocket medical expenses close to a satiation point that varies with health. Consumption responds to health shocks mostly because adverse health shocks reduce the marginal utility of consumption. The effect of health on marginal utility changes the optimal transfers due to health shocks.

10.3386/w27348.abstractZh: 在美国，65岁以后，家庭面临收入和健康风险，而这些风险中有很大一部分是暂时的。虽然消费对暂时的收入冲击有显著反应，但自付医疗费用则没有这种反应。相比之下，消费和自付医疗费用都对暂时的健康冲击有反应。因此，大多数美国老年人将自付医疗费用保持在随健康状况变化的饱和点附近。消费对健康冲击的反应主要是因为不良健康冲击会降低消费的边际效用。健康对边际效用的影响改变了因健康冲击而产生的最优转移支付。

abstract.text: This paper develops a new framework for estimating the causal impacts on child skills and the mechanisms producing these impacts using data from a randomized control study of a widely evaluated early-childhood home visiting program. We show the feasibility of replicating the program at scale. We report estimates from standard procedures for reporting treatment effects as unweighted averages item scores and compare them with estimates adjusting for item difficulties. Such adjustments produce more interpretable estimates. We go beyond treatment effects and estimate individual-specific latent skills, comparing treatment and control skills and their impacts on test scores.

10.3386/w27356.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个新的框架，用于利用一项广泛评估的幼儿家访项目的随机对照研究数据，来估计对儿童技能的影响以及产生这些影响的机制。我们展示了在更大规模上复制该项目的可行性。我们报告了使用标准程序对治疗效果进行加权平均值处理的估计结果，并将其与调整了项目难度因素的估计结果进行了比较。这样的调整使得估计结果更具可解释性。我们不仅考虑了治疗效果，还估计了个体特定的潜在技能，比较了实验组和对照组在测试成绩上的影响。

abstract.text: Policies aimed at reducing the harmful effects of air pollution exposure typically focus on areas with high levels of pollution. However, if a population’s vulnerability to air pollution is imperfectly correlated with current pollution levels, then this approach to air quality regulation may not efficiently target pollution reduction efforts. We examine the geographic and socioeconomic determinants of vulnerability to dying from acute exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution. We find that there is substantial local and regional variability in the share of individuals who are vulnerable to pollution both at the county and ZIP code level. Vulnerability tends to be negatively related to health and socioeconomic status. Surprisingly, we find that vulnerability is also negatively related to an area’s average PM2.5 pollution level, suggesting that basing air quality regulation only on current pollution levels may fail to effectively target regions with the most to gain by reducing exposure.

10.3386/w27357.abstractZh: 旨在减少空气污染危害的政策通常集中在污染水平较高的地区。然而，如果人群对空气污染的脆弱性与当前污染水平之间的关联并不紧密，那么这种空气质量监管方式可能无法有效实现污染减排的目标。我们研究了因急性细颗粒物污染而死亡的脆弱性在地理和社会经济层面的决定因素。研究发现，在县和邮政编码级别上，存在显著的局部和区域差异，即不同地区面临污染风险的个体比例存在差异。脆弱性与健康状况和社会经济地位呈负相关。令人惊讶的是，我们还发现脆弱性与该地区细颗粒物污染的平均水平也呈负相关，这表明仅基于当前污染水平来制定空气质量监管政策，可能无法有效针对那些通过减少暴露能够获益最多的地区。

abstract.text: Using original data from two waves of a survey conducted in March and April 2020 in eight OECD countries (N = 21,649), we show that women are more likely to see COVID-19 as a very serious health problem, to agree with restraining public policy measures adopted in response to it, and to comply with them. Gender differences in attitudes and behavior are substantial in all countries, robust to controlling for a large set of sociodemographic, employment, psychological, and behavioral factors, and only partially mitigated for individuals who cohabit or have direct exposure to COVID-19. The results are not driven by differential social desirability bias. They carry important implications for the spread of the pandemic and may contribute to explain gender differences in vulnerability to it.

10.3386/w27359.abstractZh: 我们基于2020年3月和4月在八个经合组织国家进行的两轮调查的原始数据（样本量21,649人），发现女性更可能将COVID-19视为非常严重的健康问题，更可能同意为应对疫情而采取的公共政策措施，并且更可能遵守这些措施。在所有国家中，性别在态度和行为上的差异都非常显著，即使控制了大量社会人口统计、就业、心理和行为因素后，这种差异仍然存在。对于同居或直接接触过COVID-19的人，性别差异的显著性有所减弱。这些结果并非由不同的社会期望偏差所驱动。它们对疫情的传播具有重要意义，并可能有助于解释性别在疫情易感性上的差异。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic led to dramatic economic disruptions, including government-imposed restrictions that required millions of American businesses to temporarily close. We present three main facts about business decisions to reopen at the end of the lockdown, using a nation-wide survey of thousands of small businesses. First, the plurality of firms reopened within days of the end of legal restrictions, suggesting that the lockdowns were generally binding for businesses - although a sizable minority delayed their reopening. Second, decisions to delay reopenings were not driven by public health concerns. Instead, businesses in high-proximity sectors planned to reopen more slowly because of expectations of stricter regulation rather than concerns about public health. Third, pessimistic demand projections played the primary role in explaining delays among firms that could legally reopen. Owners expected demand to be one-third lower than before the crisis throughout the pandemic. Using experimentally induced shocks to perceived demand, we find that a 10% decline in expected demand results in a 1.5 percentage point (8%) increase in the likelihood that firms expected to remain closed for at least one month after being legally able to open.

10.3386/w27362.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情导致了严重的经济动荡，其中包括政府实施的限制措施，使得数百万美国企业不得不暂时关闭。我们通过对数千家小型企业的全国性调查，得出了关于企业在封锁结束后决定重新营业的三个主要事实。首先，大多数企业在法律限制解除后的几天内就重新营业了，这表明封锁措施对企业具有约束力——尽管有相当一部分企业推迟了重新营业的时间。其次，推迟重新营业的决定并非由公共卫生问题所驱动。相反，那些处于高风险行业的企业因为预期会有更严格的监管而推迟重新营业，而非出于对公共卫生的担忧。第三，悲观的需求预测在解释那些可以合法重新营业的企业延迟重新营业的原因中起到了主要作用。企业主预计在整个疫情期间，需求将比危机前降低三分之一。通过实验性地改变人们对需求的预期，我们发现，预期需求下降10%会导致企业有1.5个百分点（8%）的可能性在合法可以营业后至少继续关闭一个月。

abstract.text: Underuse of health systems and a lack of confidence in their quality contribute to high rates of mortality in the developing world. How individuals perceive health systems may be especially critical during epidemics, when they choose whether to cooperate with response efforts and frontline health workers. Can improving the perceived quality of healthcare promote community health and ultimately, help to contain epidemics? We leverage a field experiment to answer this question in the context of Sierra Leone and the 2014 West Africa Ebola crisis. Two years before the outbreak, we randomly assigned two accountability interventions to government-run health clinics – one focused on community monitoring and the other conferred non-financial awards to clinic staff. These interventions delivered immediate benefits under "normal" conditions. Even prior to the Ebola crisis, both interventions increased clinic utilization and satisfaction with healthcare, and community monitoring additionally improved child health, leading to 38 percent fewer deaths of children under five. Later, during the crisis, the interventions also increased reporting of Ebola cases by 62 percent, and significantly reduced Ebola-related deaths. Evidence on mechanisms suggests that the interventions improved confidence in the health system, encouraging patients to report Ebola symptoms and receive medical care. These results indicate that promoting accountability not only has the power to improve health systems during normal times, but can also make them more resilient to crises that emerge over the longer run.

10.3386/w27364.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，卫生系统的使用不足以及对其质量的信心不足是导致高死亡率的重要原因。在流行病期间，个人对卫生系统的看法可能尤为重要，因为他们需要决定是否配合应对工作和一线卫生工作者。能否提高人们对医疗保健质量的看法来促进社区健康，并最终帮助控制流行病？我们通过在塞拉利昂和2014年西非埃博拉危机背景下进行的一项实地实验来回答这个问题。在疫情爆发前两年，我们随机将两种问责措施应用于政府运营的卫生诊所——一种侧重于社区监测，另一种则是给予诊所工作人员非金钱奖励。这些措施在“正常”条件下立即产生了积极效果。甚至在埃博拉危机之前，这两种措施都增加了诊所的利用率和对医疗保健的满意度，而社区监测还改善了儿童健康，导致五岁以下儿童死亡人数减少了38%。在危机期间，这些措施还使埃博拉病例报告增加了62%，并显著减少了与埃博拉相关的死亡人数。相关证据表明，这些措施提高了人们对卫生系统的信心，促使患者报告埃博拉症状并接受医疗护理。这些结果表明，促进问责制不仅能够在正常时期改善卫生系统，还能使其在更长期的危机中更具韧性。

abstract.text: This paper provides a quick survey of results on the classic SIR model and variants allowing for heterogeneity in contact rates. It notes that calibrating the classic model to data generated by a heterogeneous model can lead to forecasts that are biased in several ways and to understatement of the forecast uncertainty. Among the biases are that we may underestimate how quickly herd immunity might be reached, underestimate differences across regions, and have biased estimates of the impact of endogenous and policy-driven social distancing.

10.3386/w27373.abstractZh: 本文对经典SIR模型及其变体在考虑接触率异质性时的研究结果进行了简要概述。文中指出，将经典模型校准到由异质模型生成的数据可能会导致预测出现多种偏差，并低估预测的不确定性。这些偏差包括：低估群体免疫达到的速度、低估不同地区的差异，以及错误地估计内生因素和政策驱动的社会隔离措施的影响。

abstract.text: We develop a heterogeneous-agents network-based model to analyze alternative policies during a pandemic outbreak, accounting for health and economic trade-offs within the same empirical framework. We leverage a variety of data sources, including data on individuals' mobility and encounters across metropolitan areas, health records, and measures of the possibility to be productively working from home. This combination of data sources allows us to build a framework in which the severity of a disease outbreak varies across locations and industries, and across individuals who differ by age, occupation, and preexisting health conditions. We use this framework to analyze the impact of different social distancing policies in the context of the COVID-19 outbreaks across US metropolitan areas. Our results highlight how outcomes vary across areas in relation to the underlying heterogeneity in population density, social network structures, population health, and employment characteristics. We find that policies by which individuals who can work from home continue to do so, or in which schools and firms alternate schedules across different groups of students and employees, can be effective in limiting the health and healthcare costs of the pandemic outbreak while also reducing employment losses.

10.3386/w27374.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个基于异构代理网络的模型，用于分析疫情爆发期间的多种政策选择，同时在同一实证框架内考虑健康与经济之间的权衡。我们利用了多种数据来源，包括个人在都市区域间的流动和接触数据、健康记录，以及在家工作可能性等指标。这种数据来源的结合使我们能够构建一个框架，在该框架中，疾病爆发的严重程度因地点和行业而异，且不同个体在年龄、职业和原有健康状况上也存在差异。我们利用这一框架分析了不同社交距离政策在美国都市区域范围内应对COVID-19疫情的影响。我们的研究结果揭示了，在不同地区，由于人口密度、社交网络结构、人口健康状况和就业特征等方面的差异，结果也会有所不同。我们发现，允许能够在家工作的人继续这样做，或者学校和企业在不同学生群体和员工群体之间交替安排时间，这些政策可以在限制疫情爆发的健康与医疗成本的同时，减少就业损失。

abstract.text: Disease spread is in part a function of individual behavior. We examine the factors predicting individual behavior during the Covid-19 pandemic in the United States using novel data collected by Belot et al. (2020). Among other factors, we show that people with lower income, less flexible work arrangements (e.g., an inability to tele-work) and lack of outside space at home are less likely to engage in behaviors, such as social distancing, that limit the spread of disease. We also find evidence that region, gender and beliefs predict behavior. Broadly, our findings align with typical relationships between health and socio-economic status. Moreover, they suggest that the burden of measures designed to stem the pandemic are unevenly distributed across socio-demographic groups in ways that affect behavior and thus potentially the spread of illness. Policies that assume otherwise are unlikely to be effective or sustainable.

10.3386/w27378.abstractZh: 疾病传播在一定程度上取决于个人行为。我们研究了在新冠疫情期间美国个人行为的预测因素，使用了Belot等人（2020年）收集的新数据。我们发现，收入较低、工作安排不够灵活（例如无法远程工作）以及家中缺乏户外空间的人，不太可能采取如保持社交距离等限制疾病传播的行为。我们还发现，地区、性别和信仰等因素也会影响行为。总体而言，我们的研究结果与健康与社会经济地位之间的典型关系相符。此外，这些研究结果表明，旨在遏制疫情的措施在不同社会人口群体中的分布并不均衡，这会影响行为，进而可能影响疾病的传播。如果假设情况与此不同，那么这些政策不太可能有效或可持续。

abstract.text: We analyze the effectiveness of preventive investments aimed at increasing agents' life expectancy, with a focus on influenza and COVID-19 mitigation. Maximizing overall life expectancy requires allocating resources across hazards so as to equalize investments' marginal effectiveness. Based on estimates for the marginal effectiveness of influenza vaccines, we determine the level of COVID-19 mitigation investments that would imply such equalization. Given current projections for COVID-19 mitigation costs, our results suggest that wide-spread influenza vaccination would be an effective life-preserving investment.

10.3386/w27382.abstractZh: 我们分析了旨在延长人类预期寿命的预防性投资的有效性，重点关注流感和COVID-19的防控。要最大化整体预期寿命，需要在各种风险之间分配资源，以均衡投资的边际效果。基于流感疫苗边际效果的估算，我们确定了能够实现这种均衡的COVID-19防控投资规模。根据当前对COVID-19防控成本的预测，我们的研究结果表明，广泛推行流感疫苗接种是一种有效的生命延长投资。

abstract.text: We correlate county-level COVID-19 death rates with key variables using both linear regression and negative binomial mixed models, although we focus on linear regression models. We include four sets of variables: socio-economic variables, county-level health variables, modes of commuting, and climate and pollution patterns. Our analysis studies daily death rates from April 4, 2020 to May 27, 2020. We estimate correlation patterns both across states, as well as within states. For both models, we find higher shares of African American residents in the county are correlated with higher death rates. However, when we restrict ourselves to correlation patterns within a given state, the statistical significance of the correlation of death rates with the share of African Americans, while remaining positive, wanes. We find similar results for the share of elderly in the county. We find that higher amounts of commuting via public transportation, relative to telecommuting, is correlated with higher death rates. The correlation between driving into work, relative to telecommuting, and death rates is also positive across both models, but statistically significant only when we look across states and counties. We also find that a higher share of people not working, and thus not commuting either because they are elderly, children or unemployed, is correlated with higher death rates. Counties with higher home values, higher summer temperatures, and lower winter temperatures have higher death rates. Contrary to past work, we do not find a correlation between pollution and death rates. Also importantly, we do not find that death rates are correlated with obesity rates, ICU beds per capita, or poverty rates. Finally, our model that looks within states yields estimates of how a given state's death rate compares to other states after controlling for the variables included in our model; this may be interpreted as a measure of how states are doing relative to others. We find that death rates in the Northeast are substantially higher compared to other states, even when we control for the four sets of variables above. Death rates are also statistically significantly higher in Michigan, Louisiana, Iowa, Indiana, and Colorado. California's death rate is the lowest across all states.

10.3386/w27391.abstractZh: 我们通过线性回归和负二项混合模型，将县级COVID-19死亡率与关键变量进行关联分析，但重点关注线性回归模型。我们纳入了四组变量：社会经济变量、县级健康变量、通勤方式，以及气候和污染模式。我们的分析涵盖了2020年4月4日至5月27日的每日死亡率数据。我们估计了各州内部以及州际间的关联模式。对于这两种模型，我们发现县内非裔美国人比例较高的地区，其死亡率也较高。然而，当我们将研究范围限制在特定州内时，死亡率与非裔美国人比例之间的关联在统计上不再显著。对于县内老年人口比例，我们也发现了类似的结果。我们发现，相对于远程办公，更多使用公共交通通勤与较高的死亡率相关。相对于远程办公，开车上班与死亡率之间的关联在两种模型中均为正相关，但仅在跨州和跨县分析时具有统计学意义。我们还发现，由于年龄较大、子女多或失业等原因而不工作的人群比例较高，其死亡率也较高。房价较高、夏季温度较高、冬季温度较低的县，其死亡率也较高。与以往的研究不同，我们没有发现污染与死亡率之间的关联。同样重要的是，我们没有发现死亡率与肥胖率、人均ICU床位数量或贫困率之间存在关联。最后，我们的模型通过内部状态分析，能够估算出在控制模型中包含的变量后，某个州的死亡率与其他州相比的情况；这可以被视为衡量各州相对状况的一个指标。我们发现，即使控制了上述四个变量，东北部的死亡率仍然远高于其他州。密歇根州、路易斯安那州、爱荷华州、印第安纳州和科罗拉多州的死亡率也明显更高。而加利福尼亚州的死亡率在所有州中是最低的。

abstract.text: Since social distancing is the primary strategy for slowing the spread of many diseases, understanding why U.S. counties respond differently to COVID-19 is critical for designing effective public policies. Using daily data from about 45 million mobile phones to measure social distancing we examine how counties responded to both local COVID-19 cases and statewide shelter-in-place orders. We find that social distancing increases more in response to cases and official orders in counties where individuals historically (1) engaged less in community activities and (2) demonstrated greater willingness to incur individual costs to contribute to social objectives. Our work highlights the importance of these two features of social capital—community engagement and individual commitment to societal institutions—in formulating public health policies.

10.3386/w27393.abstractZh: 由于社交距离措施是减缓许多疾病传播的主要策略，因此了解美国各县对COVID-19的不同反应对于制定有效的公共政策至关重要。我们利用约4500万部手机的每日数据来衡量社交距离情况，研究各县对当地COVID-19病例和全州范围的封锁令的反应。我们发现，在那些历史上（1）较少参与社区活动且（2）更愿意为社会目标付出个人代价的人所在的县，社交距离措施对病例和官方命令的反应更为强烈。我们的研究强调了社会资本这两个特征的重要性——社区参与和个人对社会制度的承诺——这对制定公共卫生政策至关重要。

abstract.text: This note seeks the socioeconomic roots of racial disparities in COVID-19 mortality, using county-level mortality, economic, and demographic data from 3,140 counties. For all minorities, the minority's population share is strongly correlated with total COVID-19 deaths. For Hispanic/Latino and Asian minorities those correlations are fragile, and largely disappear when we control for education, occupation, and commuting patterns. For African Americans and First Nations populations, the correlations are very robust. Surprisingly, for these two groups the racial disparity does not seem to be due to differences in income, poverty rates, education, occupational mix, or even access to healthcare insurance. A significant portion of the disparity can, however, be sourced to the use of public transit.

10.3386/w27407.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨COVID-19死亡率中种族差异的社会经济根源，通过对比3,140个县的县级死亡率、经济数据和人口数据来进行研究。对于所有少数族裔而言，少数族裔人口比例与总COVID-19死亡人数之间存在强烈相关性。对于西班牙裔/拉丁裔和亚裔少数族裔，这种相关性较为脆弱，在控制教育水平、职业类型及通勤模式后，这种相关性基本消失。而对于非裔美国人和第一民族人口，这种相关性则非常显著。令人惊讶的是，这两个群体的种族差异似乎并非由收入、贫困率、教育水平、职业构成或甚至医疗保险获取情况所导致。然而，这种差异的很大一部分可以归因于公共交通的使用情况。

abstract.text: Sparked by the killing of George Floyd in police custody, the 2020 Black Lives Matter (BLM) protests brought a new wave of attention to the issue of inequality within criminal justice. However, some policymakers warned that such protests should be curtailed due to public health risks of infectious disease contagion. The current study finds that this epidemiological argument rests on an incorrect counterfactual that ignores economic incentives for risk-avoiding behaviors. We use newly collected data on BLM protests and anonymized cell phone data from SafeGraph, Inc. to estimate the impacts of BLM protests on (i) stay-at-home behavior, and (ii) foot-traffic to restaurants/bars, retail establishments, and business service locations. Event-study analyses provide strong evidence that net stay-at-home behavior increased following protest onset, consistent with the hypothesis that non-protesters shifted their activity in response to the perceived heightened risk of contagion and protest-related violence. Moreover, we find that the types of activities that were averted by BLM protests were potentially riskier for disease spread than outdoor civil rights protests: restaurant and bar-going and retail shopping. These risk-avoiding responses to protests, coupled with mask-wearing by protesters, explain why BLM protests did not reignite community-level COVID-19 growth. Together, our findings highlight the pitfalls of ignoring general equilibrium effects in assessing the net economic impacts of civil rights protests.

10.3386/w27408.abstractZh: 在乔治·弗洛伊德在警方拘留期间被杀害的事件引发之后，2020年的“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动再次引起了人们对刑事司法体系内不平等问题的关注。然而，一些政策制定者警告说，由于传染病传播的公共卫生风险，这类抗议活动应该被限制。本研究发现，这种流行病学论点基于一个错误的反事实假设，该假设忽略了人们避免风险行为的经济动机。我们利用新收集到的“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动数据以及SafeGraph公司提供的匿名手机数据，来估算这些抗议活动对以下方面的影响：(i)居家行为；(ii)前往餐馆、酒吧、零售店和商业服务场所的交通流量。事件研究分析表明，抗议活动开始后，居家行为的净数量确实增加了，这与“非抗议者为了应对传染风险和抗议相关暴力而调整活动”的假设一致。此外，我们发现，与户外公民权利抗议活动相比，“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动所避免的活动类型，其传播疾病的风险更高：前往餐馆、酒吧和进行零售购物。这些对抗议活动的风险规避反应，加上抗议者佩戴口罩的行为，解释了为什么“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动没有再次引发社区层面的COVID-19疫情。总的来说，我们的研究结果揭示了在评估公民权利抗议活动的净经济影响时，忽略一般均衡效应的缺陷。

abstract.text: Media outlets often present diverging, even conﬂicting, perspectives on reality — not only informing, but potentially misinforming audiences. We study the extent to which misinformation broadcast on mass media at the early stages of the coronavirus pandemic inﬂuenced health outcomes. We ﬁrst document large diﬀerences in content between the two most popular cable news shows in the US, both on the same network, and in the adoption of preventative behaviors among viewers of these shows. Through both a selection-on-observables strategy and an instrumental variable approach, we ﬁnd that areas with greater exposure to the show downplaying the threat of COVID-19 experienced a greater number of cases and deaths. We assess magnitudes through an epidemiological model highlighting the role of externalities and provide evidence that contemporaneous information exposure is a key underlying mechanism.

10.3386/w27417.abstractZh: 媒体机构常常呈现不同甚至相互矛盾的现实观点——这不仅提供了信息，还可能误导受众。我们研究了在冠状病毒疫情初期，大众媒体上传播的错误信息对健康结果的影响程度。我们首先记录了美国同一频道上两家最受欢迎的有线电视新闻节目在内容上的巨大差异，以及观众在这些节目中采取预防行为的差异。通过观测选择和工具变量方法，我们发现，那些较多接触淡化COVID-19威胁的节目的地区，病例数和死亡人数更多。我们通过流行病学模型评估了这种影响的程度，强调了外部性的作用，并提供了证据，证明同时期的信息接触是这一影响的关键机制。

abstract.text: In the early phases of the COVID-19 epidemic labor markets exhibited considerable churn, which we relate to three primary findings. First, reopening policies generated asymmetrically large increases in reemployment of those out of work, compared to modest decreases in job loss among those employed. Second, most people who were reemployed appear to have returned to their previous employers, but the rate of reemployment decreases with time since job loss. Lastly, the groups that had the highest unemployment rates in April also tended to have the lowest reemployment rates, potentially making churn harmful to people and groups with more and/or longer job losses. Taken together, these estimates suggest that employment relationships are durable in the short run, but raise concerns that employment gains requiring new employment matches may not be as rapid and may be particularly slow for hard-hit groups including Hispanic and Black workers, youngest and oldest workers, and women.

10.3386/w27419.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情的早期阶段，劳动力市场出现了显著的变动，我们将这一现象归因于三个主要因素。首先，重新开放的政策导致失业者重新就业的情况显著增加，而就业者则出现了轻微的失业减少。其次，大多数重新就业的人似乎回到了之前的雇主处，但失业后的重新就业率随时间逐渐下降。最后，4月份失业率最高的群体往往也是重新就业率最低的群体，这可能对那些遭受更多或更长时间失业的人或群体造成不利影响。综合来看，这些估计表明，短期内就业关系具有稳定性，但令人担忧的是，需要重新匹配就业机会的就业增长可能不会那么迅速，尤其是对于受冲击严重的群体，如西班牙裔和黑人工人、最年轻和最年长的工人以及女性。

abstract.text: We assess the Covid-19 pandemic’s implications for state government sales and income tax revenues. We estimate that the economic declines implied by recent forecasts from the Congressional Budget Office will lead to a shortfall of roughly $106 billion in states’ sales and income tax revenues for the 2021 fiscal year. This is equivalent to 0.5 percent of GDP and 11.5 percent of our pre-Covid sales and income tax projection. Additional tax shortfalls from the second quarter of 2020 may amount to roughly $42 billion. We discuss how these revenue declines fit into several pieces of the broader economic context. These include other revenues (e.g., university tuition and fees) that are also at risk, as well as assets (e.g., pension plan holdings) that are at risk. Further dimensions of context include support enacted through several pieces of federal legislation, as well as spending needs necessitated by the public health crisis itself.

10.3386/w27426.abstractZh: 我们评估了新冠疫情对州政府销售税和所得税收入的影响。据估计，国会预算办公室最近的预测表明，2021财年各州的销售税和所得税收入将减少约1060亿美元。这相当于GDP的0.5%，以及我们新冠疫情前预测值的11.5%。2020年第二季度的额外税收缺口可能达到约420亿美元。我们探讨了这些收入下降如何与更广泛的经济背景相关联。这些背景包括其他面临风险的收入来源（如大学学费），以及存在风险的资产（如养老金计划持有资产）。此外，还包括通过多项联邦立法提供的支持，以及公共卫生危机本身所引发的支出需求。

abstract.text: We investigate how the coronavirus pandemic affected the demand for online food shopping services using data from the largest agri-food e-commerce platform in Taiwan. We find that an additional confirmed case of COVID-19 increased sales by 5.7% and the number of customers by 4.9%. The demand for grains, fresh fruit and vegetables, and frozen foods increased the most, which benefited small farms over agribusinesses. Online food shopping was highly responsive to COVID-19 media coverage and online content. Because Taiwan did not impose a stay-at-home order, the demand for online food shopping may be similar in other countries after they lift mobility restrictions.

10.3386/w27427.abstractZh: 我们研究了冠状病毒大流行如何影响在线食品购物服务的需求，使用了台湾最大的农业食品电子商务平台的数据。研究发现，新增一例COVID-19确诊病例使销售额增加了5.7%，客户数量增加了4.9%。谷物、新鲜水果和蔬菜以及冷冻食品的需求增长最为明显，这对小型农场比大型农业企业更有利。在线食品购物对COVID-19的媒体报道和在线内容反应非常迅速。由于台湾没有实施居家令，其他国家在解除移动限制后，在线食品购物需求可能会类似。

abstract.text: High and increasing hospital prices have led to calls for price regulation. If prices are high because of consolidation, regulating prices could enhance welfare. However, high prices could also reflect increased willingness to pay by privately insured consumers for clinical and non-clinical quality. If so, regulating prices could reduce quality. We present a model of strategic quality choice where hospitals make quality investments to increase private revenue. We confirm the model's predictions across numerous quality measures including patient satisfaction, hospital processes, risk adjusted mortality, the revealed preferences of current Medicare patients, technology adoption, physician quality, and ED wait times.

10.3386/w27440.abstractZh: 不断上涨的医院价格引发了价格监管的需求。如果价格之所以高是因为医院之间的合并，那么监管价格可能会提升福利。然而，高价格也可能反映出私人保险消费者对于临床和非临床服务的支付意愿增加。在这种情况下，监管价格可能会降低服务质量。我们提出了一个战略质量选择模型，其中医院通过质量投资来增加私人收入。我们通过多种质量指标验证了该模型的预测结果，包括患者满意度、医院流程、风险调整后的死亡率、当前医疗保险患者的偏好、技术采用、医生质量以及急诊室的等待时间。

abstract.text: We summarize some of the early effects and discuss possible future effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and recession on the employment outcomes of older workers in the United States. We start by discussing what we know about how older workers faired in prior recessions in the United States and how COVID-19 and this recession may differ. We then estimate some early effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and recession on employment and unemployment rates by age group and sex using Current Population Survey data. We calculate employment and unemployment rates multiple ways to account for the complicated employment situation and possible errors in survey enumeration. We find that while previous recessions, in some ways, did not affect employment outcomes for older workers as much, this recession disproportionately affected older workers of ages 65 and older. For example, we find that unemployment rates in April 2020 increased to 15.43% for those ages 65 and older, compared to 12.99% for those ages 25-44. We also find that COVID-19 and the recession disproportionately affected women, where women have reached higher unemployment rates than men, which was consistent for all age groups and unemployment rate measures we used.

10.3386/w27448.abstractZh: 我们总结了COVID-19大流行和经济衰退对美国老年工人就业结果的一些早期影响，并讨论了未来可能的影响。首先，我们回顾了美国以往经济衰退中老年工人的就业状况，以及COVID-19和此次经济衰退可能存在的差异。接着，我们使用当前人口调查数据，按年龄和性别划分，估算了COVID-19大流行和经济衰退对就业率和失业率的一些早期影响。我们通过多种方法来计算就业率和失业率，以考虑复杂的就业状况以及调查统计中的可能误差。研究发现，虽然以往的经济衰退在某些方面并未对老年工人的就业结果产生太大影响，但此次经济衰退对65岁及以上的老年工人影响尤为严重。例如，2020年4月，65岁及以上的老年工人失业率上升至15.43%，而25-44岁年龄段的失业率仅为12.99%。此外，我们还发现COVID-19和经济衰退对女性的影响尤为严重，女性的失业率高于男性，这一情况在我们使用的所有年龄组和失业率指标中都是一致的。

abstract.text: Group testing increases efficiency by pooling patient specimens and clearing the entire group with one negative test. Optimal grouping strategy is well studied in one-off testing scenarios with reasonably well-known prevalence rates and no correlations in risk. We discuss how the strategy changes in a pandemic environment with repeated testing, rapid local infection spread, and highly uncertain risk. First, repeated testing mechanically lowers prevalence at the time of the next test. This increases testing efficiency, such that increasing frequency by x times only increases expected tests by around √x rather than x. However, this calculation omits a further benefit of frequent testing: infected people are quickly removed from the population, which lowers prevalence and generates further eﬃciency. Accounting for this decline in intra-group spread, we show that increasing frequency can paradoxically reduce the total testing cost. Second, we show that group size and eﬃciency increases with intra-group risk correlation, which is expected in natural test groupings based on proximity. Third, because optimal groupings depend on uncertain risk and correlation, we show how better estimates from machine learning can drive large efficiency gains. We conclude that frequent group testing, aided by machine learning, is a promising and inexpensive surveillance strategy.

10.3386/w27457.abstractZh: 群体检测通过汇集患者样本，用一次阴性检测来清除整个群体，从而提高检测效率。在单次检测场景中，最优分组策略已经得到了充分研究，此时流行率较为明确，风险之间也没有相关性。我们讨论了在疫情大流行环境下，随着重复检测、局部感染迅速扩散以及风险高度不确定时，这种策略如何发生变化。首先，重复检测在下次检测时机械性地降低了流行率，从而提高了检测效率。也就是说，将检测频率提高x倍，预计检测次数仅会增加约√x倍，而不是x倍。然而，这一计算忽略了频繁检测的另一个好处：被感染的人会迅速从人群中移除，从而降低流行率，进一步提高检测效率。考虑到这种群体内部传播减少的情况，我们发现提高检测频率可能会降低总检测成本。其次，我们表明，随着群体内部风险相关性的增加，群体规模和检测效率也会提高，这在基于邻近性的自然检测分组中是预期之中的现象。第三，由于最优分组策略取决于不确定风险和相关性，我们展示了如何利用机器学习的更好估计来大幅提升检测效率。我们得出结论，在机器学习的辅助下，频繁进行群体检测是一种有前景且成本低廉的监测策略。

abstract.text: Measuring physician quality is fundamental to understanding healthcare productivity, yet patient sorting can confound attempts to estimate the types of physicians that improve survival. This paper aims to overcome selection bias by exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in the mix of physicians available to treat patients when they are admitted to the hospital via the emergency department. One innovation is the construction of proxy measures for the types of physicians available using 100% Medicare claims data. Physician characteristics considered include specialty training, medical school quality rankings, sex, years of experience, and patient volume. The main finding is that when heart failure patients enter the hospital when more cardiologists are available, they are more likely to be treated directly by a cardiologist, have more invasive procedures, and survive over the following year.

10.3386/w27458.abstractZh: 衡量医生质量对于理解医疗生产力至关重要，然而患者筛选可能会干扰对能够改善患者生存率的医生类型的估计。本文旨在通过利用急诊科收治患者时可供选择的医生类型的合理外生变异来克服选择偏差。一项创新之处在于使用100%的医疗保险索赔数据来构建医生类型的代理指标。考虑到的医生特征包括专业培训、医学院的排名、性别、经验年限以及患者数量。主要发现是，当心力衰竭患者进入医院时，如果有更多的心脏病专家可用，他们更有可能由心脏病专家直接治疗，接受更多的侵入性手术，并且在随后的一年中存活率更高。

abstract.text: Expert decisions often deviate from evidence-based guidelines. If experts are unaware of guidelines, dissemination may improve outcomes. If experts are aware of guidelines but continue to deviate, promoting stricter adherence has ambiguous effects on outcomes depending on whether experts have information not in guidelines. We study guidelines for anticoagulant use to prevent strokes among atrial fibrillation patients. By text-mining physician notes, we identify when physicians start using guidelines. After mentioning guidelines, physicians become more guideline-concordant, but adherence remains far from perfect. To evaluate whether nonadherence reflects physicians’ superior information, we combine observational data on treatment choices with machine learning estimates of heterogeneous treatment effects from eight randomized trials. Most departures from guidelines are not justified by measurable treatment effect heterogeneity. Promoting stricter adherence to guidelines could prevent 24% more strokes, producing much larger gains than broader guideline awareness.

10.3386/w27467.abstractZh: 专家的决策往往偏离基于证据的指南。如果专家不了解这些指南，推广这些指南可能会改善结果。如果专家虽然了解指南，但仍然偏离指南，那么促进更严格的遵守对结果的影响是不确定的，这取决于专家是否掌握了指南中未包含的信息。我们研究了针对心房颤动患者使用抗凝剂以预防中风的指南。通过文本挖掘医生的记录，我们确定了医生何时开始遵循这些指南。在提及指南后，医生的决策变得更加符合指南，但遵守程度仍然远非完美。为了评估不遵守指南是否反映了医生拥有更详细的信息，我们将治疗选择的观察数据与来自八项随机试验的机器学习估计的异质治疗效果相结合。大多数偏离指南的行为并没有得到可测量的治疗效果异质性的支持。促进更严格的遵守指南可以防止24%更多的中风发生，其效果比提高对指南的认识要显著得多。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of housing price changes on fertility and early-life child health in Denmark. Using rich population register data among women aged 20-44 who own a home, we find that for each 100,000 DKK increase in home prices (equivalent to $12,000), the likelihood of giving birth increases by 0.27 percentage points or 2.32%. These estimates are similar to findings from the US per dollar of home price change, which is surprising given the strong pro-natalist policies and generous government programs in Denmark. We also present the first estimates of the effect of home prices on infant health. Our findings indicate that housing price increases lead to better child health at birth in terms of low birth weight and prematurity, however most of these effects reflect changes in the composition of births. There is no evidence of an effect on health during the first five years of life. These findings are consistent with a lack of credit constraints among homeowner families and with both children and child health being normal goods that are similarly-valued in the US and Denmark.

10.3386/w27469.abstractZh: 我们估计了房价变化对丹麦生育率和儿童早期健康的影响。利用20-44岁拥有住房女性的丰富人口登记数据，我们发现，每10万丹麦克朗的房价上涨（相当于12,000美元），生育的可能性会增加0.27个百分点，即2.32%。这些估计结果与美国房价每美元变化的研究结果相似，这令人惊讶，因为丹麦拥有强有力的生育支持政策和慷慨的政府计划。我们还首次估算了房价对婴儿健康的影响。我们的研究发现表明，房价上涨会导致婴儿出生时健康状况改善，如低出生体重和早产现象减少，但大多数这些影响反映了出生结构的改变。没有证据表明房价变化会对婴儿生命的前五年健康产生影响。这些发现与房主家庭缺乏信贷约束的情况一致，同时表明在丹麦和美国，儿童及其健康都是价值相近的正常商品。

abstract.text: This paper studies how firms’ screening incentives in the labor market affect the optimal design of social insurance programs and quantitatively assesses the U.S. disability policies accounting for firms’ screening of the disabled. We develop an equilibrium search model where workers with different productivities have heterogeneous preferences over non-wage benefits and firms cannot offer an employment contract that explicitly depends on worker types. In this environment, firms may use contracts to screen out a certain type of workers, distorting employment rates and contracts in equilibrium. Therefore, the optimal structure of social insurance policies depends on firms’ screening incentives. We extend and structurally estimate this framework to quantitatively understand the inefficiencies arising from firms’ incentives to screen out disabled workers and examine the optimal joint design of disability insurance (DI) and various forms of firm subsidies. We find that hiring subsidies mitigate screening distortions; at the same time, they interact with DI by reducing the labor supply disincentives it generates. The optimal policy structure leads to a considerable welfare gain by simultaneously making firm subsidies and DI benefits more generous.

10.3386/w27478.abstractZh: 本文研究了企业在劳动力市场上的筛选激励如何影响社会保险计划的最优设计，并定量评估了美国的残疾政策，考虑了企业对残疾人的筛选行为。我们建立了一个均衡搜索模型，其中具有不同生产率的工人对非工资福利有着不同的偏好，而企业无法提供明确依赖于工人类型的雇佣合同。在这种环境下，企业可能会利用合同来筛选掉特定类型的工人，从而扭曲均衡状态下的就业率和合同安排。因此，社会保险政策的最优结构取决于企业的筛选激励。我们进一步扩展并结构性地估计了这一框架，以定量理解企业筛选残疾工人所带来的效率低下问题，并探讨残疾保险与各种形式的企业补贴的最优联合设计。我们发现，招聘补贴可以减轻筛选扭曲；同时，它们与残疾保险相互作用，减少了残疾保险产生的劳动力供应抑制效应。最优政策结构通过同时提高企业补贴和残疾保险福利，带来显著的福利增益。

abstract.text: Fears of immigrants as a threat to public health have a long and sordid history. At the turn of the 20th century, when millions of immigrants crowded into dense American cities, contemporaries blamed the high urban mortality penalty on the newest arrivals. Nativist sentiments eventually led to the implementation of restrictive quota acts in the 1920s, substantially curtailing immigration. We capture the "missing immigrants" induced by the quotas to estimate the effect of immigration on mortality. We find that cities with more missing immigrants experienced sharp declines in deaths from infectious diseases from the mid-1920s until the late 1930s. The blame for these negative mortality effects lies not with the immigrants, but on the living conditions they endured. We show that mortality declines were largest in cities where immigrants resided in the most crowded and squalid conditions and where public health resources were stretched the thinnest. Though immigrants did die from infectious diseases at higher rates than the US-born, the mortality decline we find is primarily driven by crowding not changes in population composition or contagion, as we show mortality improvements for both US- and foreign-born populations in more quota-affected cities.

10.3386/w27480.abstractZh: 对移民作为公共健康威胁的担忧有着悠久而肮脏的历史。在20世纪初，当数百万移民涌入美国密集的城市时，当时的人们将城市高死亡率归咎于新移民。本土主义情绪最终导致了20世纪20年代限制性配额法案的实施，大幅限制了移民流入。我们通过捕捉因配额政策而“消失的移民”来估算移民对死亡率的影响。研究发现，从20世纪20年代中期到30年代末，拥有更多“消失的移民”的城市，传染病死亡率显著下降。这些负面死亡率效应的责任并不在于移民，而在于他们所忍受的生活条件。我们发现，死亡率下降最显著的是那些移民居住条件最拥挤、公共卫生资源最紧张的城市。尽管移民死于传染病的比例高于美国本土居民，但我们发现的死亡率下降主要是由拥挤状况引起的，而非人口构成变化或传染病的影响。在受配额政策影响较大的城市中，无论是美国本土居民还是外国移民，死亡率都有所改善。

abstract.text: We study the effects of testing policy on voluntary social distancing and the spread of an infection. Agents decide their social activity level, which determines a social network over which the virus spreads. Testing enables the isolation of infected individuals, slowing down the infection. But greater testing also reduces voluntary social distancing or increases social activity, exacerbating the spread of the virus. We show that the effect of testing on infections is non-monotone. This non-monotonicity also implies that the optimal testing policy may leave some of the testing capacity of society unused.

10.3386/w27483.abstractZh: 我们研究了检测政策对自愿社交隔离和感染传播的影响。个体决定他们的社交活动水平，这决定了病毒传播的社交网络。检测可以隔离感染者，减缓感染传播。但更多的检测也会降低自愿社交隔离或减少社交活动，从而加剧病毒的传播。我们发现，检测对感染的影响是非单调的。这种非单调性也意味着，最优的检测政策可能会让部分检测能力闲置。

abstract.text: We study a unique all-payer data set spanning 38 states to examine the differences in inpatient reimbursement rates paid by traditional Medicare (TM), Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicaid, and private (under-65) insurers, and the differences in negotiated rates across the 60 largest private insurers. After controlling for enrollee and hospital mix, we find that private insurers pay 37 percent more than TM, and MA pays 10 percent more than TM for the five most common inpatient diagnoses. The correlation in risk-adjusted payments by private insurers and by TM at the same hospital for the same diagnosis is only 0.10. There is significant variation in negotiated prices within and across private payers. Among the five largest US insurers, the most expensive insurer negotiates prices that are 5-26 percent higher than the mean price for the 20 most common inpatient diagnoses. Additionally, we find a 10 percent increase in insurer market share corresponds to a 7 percent decrease in inpatient negotiated prices and a 10 percent decrease in the standard deviation of prices. This finding suggests that increased insurer market power allows payers to negotiate prospective payment contracts – rather than the more common fee-for-service payments – thereby offloading financial risk to providers.

10.3386/w27490.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个独特的全支付者数据集，涵盖了38个州，以考察传统医疗保险、医疗保险优势计划、医疗补助和私人保险公司（65岁以下）在住院费用报销率上的差异，以及60家最大的私人保险公司之间协商价格的差異。在控制了参保对象和医院类型后，我们发现私人保险公司支付的费用比传统医疗保险高出37%，而医疗保险优势计划支付的费用则比传统医疗保险高出10%，这适用于五种最常见的住院诊断。对于同一医院和同一诊断，私人保险公司与传统医疗保险在风险调整后的支付额之间的相关性仅为0.10。私人保险公司之间以及不同私人支付者之间的协商价格存在显著差异。在美国的五家最大保险公司中，价格最高的保险公司所协商的价格比20种最常见的住院诊断的平均价格高出5-26%。此外，我们发现，保险公司市场份额增加10%，住院费用协商价格就会下降7%，价格标准差也会下降10%。这一发现表明，保险公司市场力量的增强使得它们能够协商未来的支付合同，而不是采用更常见的按服务收费的方式，从而将财务风险转移给医疗服务提供者。

abstract.text: A central question for understanding behaviour during the Covid-19 pandemic, at both the individual and collective levels, is how people perceive the health and economic risks they face. We conducted a survey of over 1,500 Americans from May 6 – 13, 2020, to understand these risk perceptions. Here we report some preliminary results. Our most striking finding is that perceived personal health risks associated with Covid-19 fall sharply with age.

10.3386/w27494.abstractZh: 在理解新冠疫情期间个体和集体行为时，一个核心问题是人们如何感知他们所面临的健康和经济风险。我们在2020年5月6日至13日期间对1500多名美国人进行了调查，以了解这些风险感知情况。以下是部分初步结果。我们发现，与新冠相关的个人健康风险随年龄增长而显著下降。

abstract.text: During health crises, like COVID-19, individuals are inundated with messages promoting health-preserving behavior. Does additional light-touch messaging by a credible individual change behavior? Do the features of the message matter? To answer this, we conducted a large-scale messaging campaign in West Bengal, India. Twenty-five million individuals were sent an SMS containing a 2.5-minute clip, delivered by West Bengal native and 2019 Nobel laureate Abhijit Banerjee. All messages encouraged reporting symptoms to the local public health worker. In addition, each message emphasizes one health-preserving behavior (distancing or hygiene) and one motivation for action (effects on everyone or just on self). Further, some messages addressed concerns about ostracism of the infected. Messages were randomized at the PIN code level. As control, three million individuals received a message pointing them to government information. The campaign (i) doubled the reporting of health symptoms to the community health workers (p = 0.001 for fever, p = 0.024 for respiratory symptoms); (ii) decreased travel beyond one’s village in the last two days by 20% (p = 0.026) (on a basis of 37% in control) and increased estimated hand-washing when returning home by 7% (p = 0.044) (67.5% in control); (iii) spilled over to behaviors not mentioned in the message – mask-wearing was never mentioned but increased 2% (p = 0.042), while distancing and hygiene both increased in the sample where they were not mentioned by similar amounts as where they were mentioned; (iv) spilled over onto nonrecipients within the same community, with effects similar to those for individuals who received the messages.

10.3386/w27496.abstractZh: 在健康危机期间，如COVID-19，人们会收到大量倡导健康行为的信息。由可信人士发送的额外轻触式信息是否会改变行为？信息的特性是否重要？为了回答这个问题，我们在印度西孟加拉邦开展了一项大规模的信息传递活动。有2500万人收到了由西孟加拉邦本地人、2019年诺贝尔奖得主阿比吉特·班纳吉发送的短信，短信中包含2.5分钟的视频片段。所有信息都鼓励向当地公共卫生工作者报告症状。此外，每条信息都强调一种健康行为（保持距离或卫生）以及一种行动动机（对所有人产生影响还是仅对自己产生影响）。此外，一些信息还解决了人们对被感染者排斥的担忧。信息在PIN码级别进行了随机分配。作为对照组，有300万人收到了指向政府信息的消息。该活动使以下结果得以实现：(i) 向社区公共卫生工作者报告健康症状的比例翻了一番（发烧的p值为0.001，呼吸道症状的p值为0.024）；(ii) 过去两天内离开村庄的次数减少了20%（对照组为37%），并且回家后洗手的比例增加了7%（p值为0.044，对照组为67.5%）；(iii) 信息的影响还扩展到了未提及的行为——从未提及佩戴口罩，但增加了2%（p值为0.042），而保持距离和卫生在未被提及的样本中增加的比例与被提及的样本相似；(iv) 信息的影响还扩展到了同一社区内的非接收者，其效果与接收信息的人相似。

abstract.text: The outbreak of COVID-19 has called for swift action by governments, often involving the adoption of restrictive measures such as lockdowns. In this context, leaders have faced a trade-off between imposing stringent measures to limit the contagion, and minimizing the costs on their national economy, which could impact their electoral prospects. Leveraging on both the timing of elections and the constitutional term limits faced by leaders, we document how incumbents who can run for re-election implement less stringent restrictions when the election is closer in time. The effect is driven by measures more likely to have a negative economic impact. This shows how electoral concerns help explain the observed differences in the response to COVID-19 across different countries.

10.3386/w27498.abstractZh: COVID-19的爆发要求政府迅速采取行动，这通常涉及采取封锁等限制性措施。在这种情况下，领导人面临着一个权衡：在限制传染方面采取严厉措施，同时又要尽量减少对国民经济的负面影响，因为这可能会影响他们的选举前景。考虑到选举的时间以及领导人面临的宪法任期限制，我们发现那些可以连任的现任领导人会在选举临近时采取较为宽松的限制措施。这种效应是由那些更有可能产生负面经济影响的措施所驱动的。这表明，选举方面的考虑有助于解释不同国家在应对COVID-19方面的差异。

abstract.text: This is the first study to examine the effect of experiencing a widespread, deadly epidemic on voting behavior. Using data on elections to the U.S House of Representatives and leveraging cross-district variation in HIV/AIDS mortality during the period 1983-1987, we document the effects of the HIV/AIDS epidemic on votes received by Democratic and Republican candidates. Beginning with the 1994 elections, there is a strong, positive association between HIV/AIDS mortality and the vote share received by Democratic candidates. Congressional districts that bore the brunt of the HIV/AIDS epidemic also saw substantial increases in Democratic voter turnout and contributions made to Democratic candidates.

10.3386/w27504.abstractZh: 这是第一项研究探讨广泛且致命的流行病对投票行为影响的论文。通过研究美国众议院选举的数据，并利用1983年至1987年间HIV/AIDS死亡率的地区差异，我们记录了HIV/AIDS流行病对民主党和共和党候选人获得的选票的影响。从1994年的选举开始，HIV/AIDS死亡率与民主党候选人获得的选票份额之间存在强烈的正相关关系。在HIV/AIDS流行病最为严重的选区，民主党候选人的选民投票率和对民主党候选人的捐款也显著增加。

abstract.text: COVID-19 has created a dual set of stresses on health care systems worldwide: a rise in expensive intensive care services and a dramatic decline in elective services. The U.S. government has responded with both grant and loan programs to help health care providers weather the storm. But the optimal size and nature of such programs are hard to evaluate without an understanding of the ability of providers to make up their lost elective service revenues over time. In this paper, we study the closest relevant parallel to the reduction in elective services seen under COVID-19: hurricanes. We match information on hurricanes to data on Medicare hospital elective visits and charges from 1997-2013, comparing counties impacted by hurricanes to nearby unaffected counties. We find that the average hurricane reduces elective services by about 7% in the month it makes landfall. For the most severe hurricanes, we estimate a reduction of more than 20%. Services return to baseline fairly rapidly, but for severe hurricanes it takes a year or more to make up lost revenues. Projections based on variation in hurricane severity suggest that it will take over 3 years for providers to make up the lost revenue from COVID-19.

10.3386/w27505.abstractZh: COVID-19给全球医疗系统带来了双重压力：一方面，昂贵的重症监护服务需求增加；另一方面，选择性医疗服务大幅减少。美国政府通过拨款和贷款计划来协助医疗机构应对这一挑战。然而，如果不了解医疗机构能否在一段时间内弥补因选择性医疗服务减少而损失的收入，就很难评估这些计划的最佳规模和性质。在本文中，我们研究了与COVID-19期间选择性医疗服务减少情况最为相似的案例：飓风。我们将飓风信息与1997至2013年间医疗保险医院的选择性就诊数据进行了对比，比较了受飓风影响的县与未受影响的邻近县的情况。研究发现，平均而言，飓风登陆当月，选择性医疗服务会减少约7%。对于最严重的飓风，估计损失超过20%。医疗服务会很快恢复到正常水平，但对于严重的飓风，需要一年或更长时间才能弥补损失的收入。根据飓风强度的变化预测，医疗服务提供者需要超过3年的时间才能弥补因COVID-19而损失的收入。

abstract.text: Electronic cigarettes show potential to reduce the harms from smoking combustible tobacco, but there is uncertainty about the long-term health consequences. We replicate and extend the study by Bhatta and Glantz (20192), which reports longitudinal statistical associations between e-cigarette use and long-term respiratory disease. We are able to closely replicate their results. When we use a more flexible empirical specification, among respondents who had never smoked combustible tobacco, we find no evidence that current or former e-cigarette use is associated with respiratory disease. The statistical associations between e-cigarette use and respiratory disease are driven by e-cigarette users who are also current or former smokers of combustible tobacco. A striking feature of the data is that almost all e-cigarette users were either current or former smokers of combustible tobacco. We then discuss the potential for future applied econometric research to credibly identify the causal effects of e-cigarette use on health. Challenges include the potential selection biases that stem from the complex set of consumer choices to initiate and quit smoking combustible tobacco, use of e-cigarettes, and dual use of both products. We suggest using a variety of identification strategies to uncover the causal effects that use a variety of econometric methods.

10.3386/w27507.abstractZh: 电子香烟有潜力减少吸烟可燃烟草带来的危害，但关于其长期健康影响仍存在不确定性。我们复制并扩展了Bhatta和Glantz在2019年进行的研究，该研究报道了电子香烟使用与长期呼吸系统疾病之间的统计关联。我们能够紧密复制他们的研究结果。当我们使用更灵活的实证方法时，对于那些从未吸烟可燃烟草的受访者来说，我们没有发现当前或曾经使用电子香烟与呼吸系统疾病之间存在关联。电子香烟使用与呼吸系统疾病之间的统计关联，实际上是由那些同时也是当前或曾经吸烟可燃烟草的电子香烟使用者所驱动的。数据的一个显著特点是，几乎所有电子香烟使用者都是当前或曾经吸烟可燃烟草的吸烟者。因此，我们讨论了未来应用计量经济学研究来可信地识别电子香烟使用对健康影响的潜在可能性。面临的挑战包括由于消费者在启动和停止吸烟可燃烟草、使用电子香烟以及同时使用这两种产品时的复杂选择所导致的潜在选择偏差。我们建议采用多种识别策略，结合多种计量经济学方法来揭示这些因果效应。

abstract.text: We decompose changing gaps in life expectancy between rich and poor into differential changes in age-specific mortality rates and differences in “survivability”. Declining age-specific mortality rates increases life expectancy, but the gain is small if the likelihood of living to this age is small (ex ante survivability) or if the expected remaining lifetime is short (ex post survivability). Lower survivability of the poor explains half of the recent rise in life expectancy inequality in the US and the entire rise in Denmark. Cardiovascular mortality declines favored the poor, but differences in lifestyle-related survivability led inequality to rise.

10.3386/w27509.abstractZh: 我们将贫富之间预期寿命差距的变化分解为不同年龄段的死亡率差异以及“生存能力”的差异。降低特定年龄段的死亡率可以提高预期寿命，但如果达到该年龄的可能性较低（事前生存能力）或预期剩余寿命较短（事后生存能力），这种提升效果则较小。贫困群体的较低生存能力解释了美国近期预期寿命不平等加剧的一半原因，而丹麦的情况则完全是由生存能力差异导致的。心血管死亡率的下降对贫困群体更为有利，但生活方式相关的生存能力差异导致了不平等的加剧。

abstract.text: We examine whether the least educated population groups experienced the worst mortality trends during the 21st century by measuring changes in mortality across education quartiles. We document sharply differing gender patterns. Among women, mortality trends improved fairly monotonically with education. Conversely, male trends for the lowest three education quartiles were often similar. For both sexes, the gap in average mortality between the top 25 percent and the bottom 75 percent is growing. However, there are many groups for whom these average patterns are reversed – with better experiences for the less educated – or where the differences are statistically indistinguishable.

10.3386/w27512.abstractZh: 我们研究了在21世纪期间，受教育程度最低的人群是否经历了最糟糕的死亡率趋势，通过测量不同教育等级之间的死亡率变化来进行分析。我们发现性别方面的差异非常明显。在女性中，死亡率随着教育程度的提高而逐渐改善。相反，在受教育程度最低的三个教育等级中，男性的死亡率趋势往往相似。对于两性而言，收入最高的25%与收入最低的75%之间的平均死亡率差距正在扩大。然而，有许多群体的平均死亡率趋势是相反的——受教育程度较低的人群反而有更好的生存状况，或者这些差异在统计上无法区分。

abstract.text: We combine newly released individual data from the 1940 full-count census with death records and other information available in family trees to create the largest individual data to date to study the association between years of schooling and age at death. Conditional on surviving to age 35, one additional year of education is associated with roughly 0.4 more years of life for both men and women for cohorts born 1906-1915. This association is close to linear but exhibits strong credentialing effects, particularly for men, and is substantially smaller for cohorts born earlier. This association varies substantially by state of birth, but it is not smaller in states with higher levels of education or longevity. For men the association is stronger in places with greater incomes, higher quality of school, and larger investments in public health. Women also exhibit great heterogeneity in the association, but our measures of the childhood environment do not explain it.

10.3386/w27514.abstractZh: 我们将1940年全数人口普查中新发布的个人数据，与死亡记录以及家族树中可用的其他信息相结合，创建了迄今为止规模最大的个人数据，以研究受教育年限与死亡年龄之间的关联。在存活至35岁的前提下，对于1906-1915年出生的群体而言，每增加一年的教育程度，男女的寿命大约会延长0.4年。这种关联几乎是线性的，但表现出强烈的学历效应，尤其是在男性中更为明显；而对于更早出生的群体，这种关联则明显较小。这种关联在不同州的出生地存在显著差异，但在教育水平较高或寿命较长的州，这种关联并不减弱。对于男性来说，在收入较高、学校质量较好以及公共卫生投入较大的地区，这种关联更为明显。女性在这方面的关联也表现出很大的异质性，但我们对童年环境的测量并未能解释这一现象。

abstract.text: How effective are restrictions on mobility in limiting COVID-19 spread? Using zip code data across five U.S. cities, we estimate that total cases per capita decrease by 20% for every ten percentage point fall in mobility. Addressing endogeneity concerns, we instrument for travel by residential teleworkable and essential shares and find a 27% decline in cases per capita. Using panel data for NYC with week and zip code fixed effects, we estimate a decline of 17%. We find substantial spatial and temporal heterogeneity; east coast cities have stronger effects, with the largest for NYC in the pandemic’s early stages.

10.3386/w27519.abstractZh: 对流动性的限制在限制COVID-19传播方面有多有效？通过美国五个城市的邮政编码数据，我们估计，每降低十个百分点的流动性，人均病例数就会减少20%。为了解决内生性问题，我们通过居民可远程工作和必要工作的比例来工具变量处理出行情况，发现人均病例数减少了27%。利用纽约市的分组数据，并考虑周数和邮政编码的固定效应，我们估计病例数减少了17%。我们发现存在显著的时空异质性；东海岸城市的效应更为显著，其中纽约市在疫情初期的影响最大。

abstract.text: A large concern in U.S. opioid policy is whether supply side controls are effective at reducing the quantity of opioids prescribed, without harmful substitution. An unstudied way that policy targeted a major opioid through the federal Controlled Substance Act (CSA) was the August 2014 scheduling of tramadol products, the second most popular opioid medication at the time. Twelve states implemented the identical policy prior to federal action, providing a unique opportunity to compare effectiveness of the same opioid policy at state versus federal levels. This is important because many recent opioid policy interventions have only taken the form of state actions, while federal policy has largely been advisory. Seven weeks after tramadol's scheduling, the leading opioid form on the market, hydrocodone combination products, was move to the more restricted level II (no refills allowed) from level III in the CSA, allowing us to test a new question in the opioid literature: competitive spillover effects from regulations targeting one drug. Using weekly prescription data spanning 2007-2017, this study finds that tightening prescribing restrictions on one opioid leads to decreases in its use, but also causes some increases in prescriptions of close competitors, leading to no statistically detectable short-run reduction in total opioid prescriptions.

10.3386/w27520.abstractZh: 在美国的阿片类药物政策中，一个重要的关注点是：对供应方面的控制措施是否能够有效减少阿片类药物的处方量，同时避免有害的替代行为。2014年8月，联邦《管制物质法》对一种当时第二常用的阿片类药物——曲马多产品进行了管制，这是一项未经充分研究的政策手段。在联邦政府采取行动之前，有12个州实施了相同的政策，这为比较州级与联邦级阿片类药物政策的有效性提供了独特的机会。这一点非常重要，因为许多最近的阿片类药物政策干预措施仅局限于州级行动，而联邦政策则主要起到指导作用。在曲马多被纳入管制后的七周内，市场上最受欢迎的阿片类药物——氢可酮组合产品，从联邦《管制物质法》的III级管制状态被调整为II级管制状态，II级管制不允许续方。这一变化使得我们能够在阿片类药物文献中探讨一个新的问题：针对一种药物的监管措施是否会对其他药物产生竞争性的溢出效应。通过2007年至2017年的每周处方数据，本研究发现，对一种阿片类药物的处方限制加强会导致其使用量减少，但同时也会使得与其竞争的药物的处方量增加，从而在整个阿片类药物处方总量上并未出现可统计的短期减少。

abstract.text: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) deems large indoor gatherings without social distancing the “highest risk” activity for COVID-19 contagion. On June 20, 2020, President Donald J. Trump held his first mass campaign rally following the US coronavirus outbreak at the indoor Bank of Oklahoma (BOK) arena. In the weeks following the event, numerous high-profile national news outlets reported that the Trump rally was “more than likely” the cause of a coronavirus surge in Tulsa county based on time series data. This study is the first to rigorously explore the impacts of this event on social distancing and COVID-19 spread. First, using data from SafeGraph Inc, we show that while non-resident visits to census block groups hosting the Trump event grew by approximately 25 percent, there was no decline in net stay-at-home behavior in Tulsa county, reflecting important offsetting behavioral effects. Then, using data on COVID-19 cases and deaths from the CDC and a synthetic control design, we find little evidence that COVID-19 grew more rapidly in Tulsa County, its border counties, or in the state of Oklahoma than each’s estimated counterfactual during the five-week post-treatment period we observe. Difference-in-differences estimates further provide no evidence that COVID-19 rates grew faster in counties that drew relatively larger shares of residents to the event. We conclude that offsetting risk-related behavioral responses to the rally — including voluntary closures of restaurants and bars in downtown Tulsa, increases in stay-at-home behavior, displacement of usual activities of weekend inflows, and smaller-than-expected crowd attendance — may be important mechanisms.

10.3386/w27522.abstractZh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）认为，不进行社交距离的大规模室内集会是COVID-19传播“最高风险”的活动。2020年6月20日，美国总统唐纳德·J·特朗普在美国冠状病毒疫情爆发后，在俄克拉荷马银行的室内体育馆举行了首次大规模竞选集会。在事件发生的几周里，许多知名全国媒体报道称，根据时间序列数据，特朗普的集会很可能是塔尔萨县冠状病毒激增的原因。本研究首次严格探讨了这一事件对社会距离和COVID-19传播的影响。首先，利用SafeGraph公司的数据，我们发现尽管参加特朗普集会的非居民访问次数增加了约25%，但塔尔萨县的居家行为并未下降，这反映了重要的抵消性行为效应。然后，利用CDC提供的COVID-19病例和死亡数据，以及合成控制设计，我们发现几乎没有证据表明COVID-19在塔尔萨县、周边县或俄克拉荷马州的传播速度比我们观察到的五周后的对照时期更快。差异差异估计进一步表明，没有证据表明那些吸引更多居民参加集会的县的COVID-19发病率增长更快。我们得出结论，对集会的抵消性风险相关行为反应——包括塔尔萨市中心餐馆和酒吧的自愿关闭、居家行为的增加、周末人流的替代活动，以及比预期更小的观众人数——可能是重要的机制。

abstract.text: All redistributive and social insurance programs trade off the potential benefits of transfers with the disincentives these programs generate. We investigate this trade-off using newly collected lifetime data for 16,000 women who applied to the Mothers’ Pension Program, the first cash transfer program in the US. In the short-run cash transfers reduced geographic mobility and delayed marriage of recipients but did not affect who they married or where they moved to. In the long run transfers had no effect on work, marriage or fertility behaviors. They also did not improve the economic conditions of recipients or their longevity.

10.3386/w27523.abstractZh: 所有再分配和社会保险计划都在潜在的转移福利与这些计划带来的不利因素之间进行了权衡。我们通过新收集的16,000名女性终身数据来研究这种权衡，这些女性申请了美国首个现金转移计划——母亲养老金计划。短期内，现金转移减少了地理流动性，推迟了受助人的结婚年龄，但并未影响她们的婚姻选择或迁移方向。从长期来看，这些转移对受助人的工作、婚姻和生育行为没有影响。它们也没有改善受助人的经济状况或寿命。

abstract.text: In the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic, international testing efforts tended to target individuals whose symptoms and/or jobs placed them at a high presumed risk of infection. Testing regimes of this sort potentially result in a high proportion of cases going undetected. Quantifying this parameter, which we refer to as the undetected rate, is an important contribution to the analysis of the early spread of the SARS-CoV-2 virus. We show that partial identification techniques can credibly deal with the data problems that common COVID-19 testing programs induce (i.e. excluding quarantined individuals from testing and low participation in random screening programs). We use public data from two Icelandic testing regimes during the first month of the outbreak and estimate an identified interval for the undetected rate. Our main approach estimates that the undetected rate was between 89% and 93% before the medical system broadened its eligibility criteria and between 80% and 90% after.

10.3386/w27528.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情的早期阶段，国际检测工作往往针对那些因症状或职业而被认为有较高感染风险的人群。这种检测方式可能导致大量病例未被发现。量化这一参数，我们称之为“未检测率”，对于分析SARS-CoV-2病毒的早期传播非常重要。我们证明，部分识别技术能够合理地处理常见COVID-19检测程序所引发的数据问题（例如，将隔离人员排除在检测范围之外以及随机筛查程序的参与率较低）。我们利用冰岛在疫情爆发第一个月内的公共数据，估算了未检测率的估计区间。我们的主要研究表明，在医疗系统放宽资格标准之前，未检测率介于89%至93%之间；而在之后，这一比例则介于80%至90%之间。

abstract.text: We examine the role of state and local policies to encourage social distancing, including stay at home orders, public school closures, and restrictions on restaurants, entertainment, and large social gatherings. Outcomes come from cell phone records and include foot traffic in six industries (essential and nonessential retail, entertainment, hotel, restaurant, and business services) plus the fraction of cell phones that are home all day. Structural break models show mobility series at the national and state levels start to change dramatically in a short window from March 8-14, well before state or local restrictions of note are in place. In difference-in-difference models, declarations of state of emergency reduce foot traffic and increase social distancing. Stay at home restrictions explain a modest fraction of the change in behavior across outcomes. Industry-specific restrictions have large impacts. For example, restrictions on dining in restaurants reduce traffic in restaurants, hotels, and nonessential retail. Private, self-regulating behavior explains more than three-quarters of the decline in foot traffic in most industries. Restrictive regulation explains half the decline in foot traffic in essential retail and 75 percent of the increase in the fraction home all day. In this latter result, public school closings have a substantial effect.

10.3386/w27531.abstractZh: 我们研究了国家和地方政策在鼓励社交距离方面的作用，包括居家令、公立学校关闭以及对餐馆、娱乐场所和大型社交活动的限制。研究数据来自手机通话记录，涵盖了六个行业（包括必需和非必需零售、娱乐、酒店、餐馆以及商业服务）的步行流量，以及全天待在家中的手机比例。结构突变模型显示，从3月8日至14日这一短时间内，国家和州级别的出行模式开始发生显著变化，这远早于具体的州或地方限制措施的实施。在差异分解模型中，紧急状态的宣布减少了步行流量并促进了社交距离的实施。居家令对行为变化的解释力度有限。行业特定的限制措施则具有较大的影响。例如，对餐馆用餐的限制减少了餐馆、酒店和非必需零售业的流量。私人自我调节行为解释了大多数行业步行流量下降的超过四分之三的原因。限制性监管解释了必需零售行业步行流量下降的一半原因，以及全天待在家中的手机比例增加75%的原因。在后一种情况下，公立学校关闭产生了显著的影响。

abstract.text: Managing the outbreak of COVID-19 in India constitutes an unprecedented health emergency in one of the largest and most diverse nations in the world. On May 4, 2020, India started the process of releasing its population from a national lockdown during which extreme social distancing was implemented. We describe and simulate an adaptive control approach to exit this situation, while maintaining the epidemic under control. Adaptive control is a flexible counter-cyclical policy approach, whereby different areas release from lockdown in potentially different gradual ways, dependent on the local progression of the dis- ease. Because of these features, adaptive control requires the ability to decrease or increase social distancing in response to observed and projected dynamics of the disease outbreak. We show via simulation of a stochastic Susceptible-Infected-Recovered (SIR) model and of a synthetic intervention (SI) model that adaptive control performs at least as well as immediate and full release from lockdown starting May 4 and as full release from lockdown after a month (i.e., after May 31). The key insight is that adaptive response provides the option to increase or decrease socioeconomic activity depending on how it affects disease progression and this freedom allows it to do at least as well as most other policy alternatives. We also discuss the central challenge to any nuanced release policy, including adaptive control, specifically learning how specific policies translate into changes in contact rates and thus COVID-19's reproductive rate in real time.

10.3386/w27532.abstractZh: 在印度应对COVID-19疫情是一场前所未有的健康紧急事件，而印度是世界上最大、最多元化的国家之一。2020年5月4日，印度开始解除全国封锁，同时实施了严格的社交距离措施。我们描述并模拟了一种适应性控制方法，以在控制疫情的同时逐步解除封锁。适应性控制是一种灵活的逆周期政策手段，不同地区的封锁解除方式可能会有所不同，这取决于当地疫情的发展情况。由于这些特点，适应性控制需要能够根据疫情发展和预测动态调整社交距离措施。通过模拟随机易感-感染-康复（SIR）模型以及综合干预模型，我们发现适应性控制的效果至少与5月4日立即全面解除封锁或在一个月后（即5月31日之后）完全解除封锁的效果相当。关键之处在于，适应性响应提供了根据疫情发展调整社会经济活动的选项，这种灵活性使其至少与其他大多数政策选择相当。我们还讨论了任何细致入微的释放政策所面临的挑战，包括适应性控制，特别是如何实时将具体政策转化为接触率的变化，从而影响COVID-19的传染率。

abstract.text: The rapid rise in e-cigarette use rates among high school students in the United States is a significant source of public policy concern for many states. This paper is the first study to examine the impact of state tobacco control spending on the demand for vaping products by high school students. The findings from this study provide strong evidence that funding for state tobacco control programs is associated with reduced vaping among youth and young adults in the US. These findings could help to inform decision making about how states should allocate scarce public resources.

10.3386/w27539.abstractZh: 美国高中生使用电子香烟的比例迅速上升，这成为许多州公共政策关注的重要问题。本文是首次研究州级烟草控制支出对高中生对电子烟产品需求的影响。研究结果表明，州级烟草控制项目的资金投入与青少年和年轻成年人使用电子烟的减少之间存在关联。这些发现有助于指导各州如何分配有限的公共资源。

abstract.text: Without the opioid epidemic, American life expectancy would not have declined prior to 2020. In turn, the epidemic was sparked by the development and marketing of a new generation of prescription opioids and provider behavior is still helping to drive it. There is little relationship between the opioid crisis and contemporaneous measures of labor market opportunity.
