We further show how to use shock counterfactuals for valid finite-sample inference, and characterize the valid instruments that are asymptotically efficient. We apply this framework to address bias when estimating employment effects of market access growth from Chinese high-speed rail construction, and to boost power when estimating coverage effects of expanded Medicaid eligibility.

10.3386/w27845.abstractZh: 我们开发了新的工具，用于估计各种处理或工具变量的因果效应，这些工具能够根据已知的公式结合多种变异来源。例如，用于处理社会与交通网络中溢出效应的处理变量、用于政策资格评估的模拟工具变量，以及转换-分享工具变量。我们展示了如何利用某些但并非所有此类变量的外生冲击，同时避免遗漏变量偏差。我们的解决方案包括指定那些可能实际发生的反事实冲击，并调整冲击暴露的非随机性综合度量：即这些反事实情况下的平均处理（或工具）变量。我们还展示了如何利用反事实冲击进行有效的有限样本推断，并描述了在渐近效率下有效的工具变量。我们将这一框架应用于估计中国高铁建设对就业影响的偏差问题，以及提高估计扩大医疗补助资格对覆盖效果的影响的估计精度。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of criminalizing sex work, exploiting an event in which local officials unexpectedly criminalized sex work in one district in East Java, Indonesia, but not in neighboring districts. We collect data from female sex workers and their clients before and after the change. We find that criminalization increases sexually transmitted infections among female sex workers by 58 percent, measured by biological tests. This is driven by decreased condom access and use. We also find evidence that criminalization decreases earnings among women who left sex work due to criminalization, and decreases their ability to meet their children's school expenses while increasing the likelihood that children begin working to supplement household income. While criminalization has the potential to improve population STI outcomes if the market shrinks permanently, we show that five years post-criminalization the market has rebounded and the probability of STI transmission within the general population is likely to have increased.

10.3386/w27846.abstractZh: 我们研究了将性工作定为犯罪行为的影响，通过研究印度尼西亚东爪哇省一个地区突然将性工作定为犯罪，而邻近地区则未受影响的事件。我们收集了该地区女性性工作者及其客户在政策变更前后的数据。研究发现，由于犯罪行为的实施，女性性工作者的性传播感染率上升了58%，这一数据是通过生物检测得出的。这一变化主要是由于避孕套的获取和使用减少所致。我们还发现，由于犯罪行为的实施，那些放弃性工作的女性的收入下降，她们支付子女学费的能力也减弱，同时子女开始工作以补充家庭收入的可能性增加。虽然将性工作定为犯罪有可能改善人群中的性传播感染状况，但如果市场因此永久缩小，我们指出，在犯罪行为实施五年后，市场已经恢复，普通人群中的性传播感染传播概率可能反而增加了。

abstract.text: This paper develops a satellite account for the US health sector and measures productivity growth in health care for the elderly population between 1999 and 2012. We measure the change in medical spending and health outcomes for a comprehensive set of 80 conditions. Medical care has positive productivity growth over the time period, with aggregate productivity growth of 1.5% per year. However, there is significant heterogeneity in productivity growth. Care for cardiovascular disease has had very high productivity growth. In contrast, care for people with musculoskeletal conditions has been costly but has not led to improved outcomes.

10.3386/w27848.abstractZh: 本文为美国医疗部门开发了一个辅助核算体系，并测量了1999年至2012年间针对老年人口的医疗保健领域的生产率增长。我们针对80种综合状况，测量了医疗支出和健康结果的变化。在这段时间内，医疗保健领域实现了积极的生产率增长，年均增长率为1.5%。然而，生产率增长存在显著的异质性。针对心血管疾病的护理实现了非常高的生产率增长。相比之下，针对肌肉骨骼疾病的护理虽然成本较高，但并未带来更好的健康结果。

abstract.text: Social scientists often consider temporal stability when assessing the usefulness of a construct and its measures, but whether behavioral biases display such stability is relatively unknown. We estimate stability for 25 biases, in a nationally representative sample, using repeated elicitations three years apart. Bias level indicators are largely stable in the aggregate and within-person. Within-person intertemporal rank correlations imply moderate stability and increase dramatically when using other biases as instrumental variables. Additional results reinforce three key inferences: biases are stable, accounting for classical measurement error in bias elicitation data is important, and eliciting multiple measures of multiple biases is valuable.

10.3386/w27860.abstractZh: 社会科学家在评估某一概念及其测量工具的有效性时，通常会考虑其时间稳定性。然而，行为偏差是否表现出这种稳定性则相对未知。我们在全国代表性样本中，通过相隔三年的重复调查，对25种偏差的稳定性进行了估计。总体而言，偏差水平指标在群体内部和个体之间都相对稳定。个体间的时间序列排名相关性表明偏差具有中等程度的稳定性，而当使用其他偏差作为工具变量时，这种稳定性会显著增强。其他结果进一步支持了三个关键结论：偏差是稳定的；考虑偏差测量数据中的经典测量误差非常重要；同时测量多种偏差的多个指标是有价值的。

abstract.text: In June 2020, we surveyed 2,516 Americans regarding their preferences for both short- and long-term expansions to government-provided healthcare and unemployment insurance programs. We find that support for such programs is positively associated with (a) COVID-19 deaths and infections in the respondent’s county, (b) the pandemic-induced change in the unemployment rate in the respondent’s county, and (c) survey elicitations of the respondent’s perceptions of COVID-19’s consequences. These associations persist when controlling for pre-COVID-19 political ideology and demographics. These results suggest that real or perceived exposure to COVID-19’s consequences has influenced support for expansions to the U.S. safety-net system.

10.3386/w27865.abstractZh: 2020年6月，我们对2,516名美国人进行了调查，了解他们对政府提供的医疗保健和失业保险计划短期和长期扩展的偏好。研究发现，对这类计划的支持与以下因素呈正相关：(a)受访者所在县的COVID-19死亡和感染情况；(b)疫情导致的该县失业率变化；以及(c)受访者对COVID-19后果的看法。在控制COVID-19前的政治意识形态和人口统计特征后，这些关联仍然存在。这些结果表明，实际或感知到的COVID-19后果的影响，影响了人们对美国社会保障体系扩展的支持。

abstract.text: We provide a framework for large employers designing a menu of health plan offerings that differ on both financial and non-financial dimensions. Using detailed administrative data from Harvard University, we estimate a model of plan choice and utilization, and evaluate the benefits of cost sharing and plan variety. For this population of employed consumers, and a single plan with a generous out-of-pocket maximum and zero deductible, we find that modest cost sharing of approximately 30% maximizes average employee surplus. Further gains from offering choice are limited if based solely on financial characteristics, but can be meaningful if paired with differentiation along other dimensions where consumer preferences are correlated with efficient coverage levels.

10.3386/w27868.abstractZh: 我们为大型雇主提供了一个框架，帮助他们设计在财务和非财务维度上有所差异的健康计划方案。利用哈佛大学提供的详细行政数据，我们建立了一个关于计划选择和利用的模型，并评估了费用分担和计划多样性所带来的好处。对于这一就业消费者群体，如果只基于财务特征来提供单一计划，且该计划具有较高的自付最高限额且免赔额为零，那么大约30%的适度费用分担可以最大化平均员工收益。如果仅基于财务特征来提供选择，那么额外的收益是有限的；但如果与其他维度相结合，并且消费者偏好与有效的保障水平相关，那么选择多样性就能带来实际意义。

abstract.text: This paper documents two COVID-related risks, viral risk and employment risk, and their distributions across the Canadian population. The measurement of viral risk is based on the VSE COVID Risk/Reward Assessment Tool, created to assist policymakers in determining the impacts of economic shutdowns and re-openings over the course of the pandemic. We document that women are more concentrated in high viral risk occupations and that this is the source of their greater employment loss over the course of the pandemic so far. They were also less likely to maintain one form of contact with their former employers, reducing employment recovery rates. Low educated workers face the same virus risk rates as high educated workers but much higher employment losses. Based on a rough counterfactual exercise, this is largely accounted for by their lower likelihood of switching to working from home which, in turn, is related to living conditions such as living in crowded dwellings. For both women and the low educated, existing inequities in their occupational distributions and living situations have resulted in them bearing a disproportionate amount of the risk emerging from the pandemic. Assortative matching in couples has tended to exacerbate risk inequities.

10.3386/w27881.abstractZh: 本文记录了与COVID相关的两种风险：病毒风险与就业风险，以及它们在加拿大人口中的分布情况。病毒风险的衡量基于VSE COVID风险/收益评估工具，该工具旨在帮助政策制定者了解经济停摆和重新开放对疫情期间经济的影响。研究发现，女性更集中于高病毒风险的职业，这也是她们在疫情期间遭受更大就业损失的原因。她们也不太可能继续与以前的雇主保持联系，这降低了她们的就业恢复能力。低教育水平的工人面临与高教育水平工人相同的病毒风险，但遭受的就业损失要大得多。根据粗略的反事实分析，这主要是由于他们转向居家工作的可能性较低，而居家工作又与居住条件有关，如居住在拥挤的住宅中。对于女性和低教育水平的工人来说，现有的职业分布和居住状况的不平等导致她们承担了更多因疫情而产生的风险。在夫妻之间，同质匹配现象往往加剧了风险的不平等。

abstract.text: We compare and contrast the expected duration and number of infections and deaths averted among several designs for clinical trials of COVID-19 vaccine candidates, including traditional randomized clinical trials and adaptive and human challenge trials. Using epidemiological models calibrated to the current pandemic, we simulate the time course of each clinical trial design for 504 unique combinations of parameters, allowing us to determine which trial design is most effective for a given scenario. A human challenge trial provides maximal net benefits—averting an additional 1.1M infections and 8,000 deaths in the U.S. compared to the next best clinical trial design—if its set-up time is short or the pandemic spreads slowly. In most of the other cases, an adaptive trial provides greater net benefits.

10.3386/w27882.abstractZh: 我们比较了几种COVID-19疫苗候选药物的临床试验设计在预期感染持续时间和避免的死亡人数方面的效果，包括传统的随机临床试验以及适应性试验和人体挑战试验。利用针对当前疫情情况调整的流行病学模型，我们模拟了每种临床试验设计在504种不同参数组合下的时间进程，从而确定哪种试验设计在特定情况下最为有效。如果人体挑战试验的启动时间较短或疫情传播速度较慢，那么该试验能够带来最大的净效益——相比次优的临床试验设计，可额外避免110万例感染和8000例死亡。在大多数其他情况下，适应性试验能带来更大的净效益。

abstract.text: Many mental health disorders start in adolescence and appropriate initial treatment may improve trajectories. But what is appropriate treatment? We use a large national database of insurance claims to examine the impact of initial mental health treatment on the outcomes of adolescent children over the next two years, where treatment is either consistent with FDA guidelines, consistent with looser guidelines published by professional societies (“grey-area” prescribing), or inconsistent with any guidelines (“red-flag” prescribing). We find that red-flag prescribing increases self-harm, use of emergency rooms, and health care costs, suggesting that treatment guidelines effectively scale up good treatment in practice.

10.3386/w27890.abstractZh: 许多心理健康问题在青少年时期就开始出现，适当的初期治疗可能会改善其发展轨迹。但什么是适当的治疗呢？我们利用一个大型的全国保险索赔数据库，研究初期心理健康治疗对青少年儿童未来两年状况的影响。治疗方式分为三种：符合美国食品药品监督管理局指南的疗法、符合专业协会发布的更宽松指南的疗法（属于“灰色区域”处方），以及不符合任何指南的疗法（属于“红色警示”处方）。研究发现，红色警示处方会增加自伤行为、急诊就诊次数以及医疗成本，这表明治疗指南在实践中对良好治疗的有效推广起到了重要作用。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of mask mandates and other non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPI) on COVID-19 case growth in Canada, including regulations on businesses and gatherings, school closures, travel and self-isolation, and long-term care homes. We partially account for behavioral responses using Google mobility data. Our identification approach exploits variation in the timing of indoor face mask mandates staggered over two months in the 34 public health regions in Ontario, Canada's most populous province. We find that, in the first few weeks after implementation, mask mandates are associated with a reduction of 25 percent in the weekly number of new COVID-19 cases. Additional analysis with province-level data provides corroborating evidence. Counterfactual policy simulations suggest that mandating indoor masks nationwide in early July could have reduced the weekly number of new cases in Canada by 25 to 40 percent in mid-August, which translates into 700 to 1,100 fewer cases per week.

10.3386/w27891.abstractZh: 我们估算了口罩强制令及其他非药物干预措施对加拿大COVID-19病例增长的影响，这些措施包括对企业与集会活动的监管、学校关闭、旅行及自我隔离，以及长期护理机构的管控。我们利用谷歌移动数据部分考虑了行为反应的影响。我们的分析方法利用了加拿大人口最多的省份安大略省34个公共卫生区域在两个月内室内口罩强制令实施时间的差异。研究发现，在强制令实施后的最初几周，口罩强制令使每周新增COVID-19病例数减少了25%。进一步的省级数据分析也提供了类似的证据。反事实政策模拟表明，如果7月初全国范围内实施室内口罩强制令，到8月中旬，加拿大每周新增病例数可减少25%至40%，即每周减少700至1,100例病例。

abstract.text: Comparing median outcomes to gauge treatment effectiveness is widespread practice in clinical and other investigations. While common, such difference-in-median characterizations of effectiveness are but one way to summarize how outcome distributions compare. This paper explores properties of median treatment effects as indicators of treatment effectiveness. The paper's main focus is on decisionmaking based on median treatment effects and it proceeds by considering two paths a decisionmaker might follow. Along one, decisions are based on point-identified differences in medians alongside partially identified median differences; along the other decisions are based on point-identified differences in medians in conjunction with other point-identified parameters. On both paths familiar difference-in-median measures play some role yet in both the traditional standards are augmented with information that will often be relevant in assessing treatments' effectiveness. Implementing both approaches is shown to be straightforward. In addition to its analytical results the paper considers several policy contexts in which such considerations arise. While the paper is framed by recently reported findings on treatments for COVID-19 and uses several such studies to explore empirically some properties of median-treatment-effect measures of effectiveness, its results should be broadly applicable.

10.3386/w27895.abstractZh: 在临床及其他研究中，通过比较中位数结果来评估治疗效果是一种普遍的做法。虽然这种基于中位数差异来描述效果的方法很常见，但它只是总结结果分布差异的一种方式。本文探讨了作为治疗效果指标的中位治疗效应的特性。文章主要关注基于中位治疗效应的决策制定，并探讨了决策者在两种不同路径上的决策方式。在一种路径上，决策基于中位数的点识别差异以及部分识别的中位数差异；在另一种路径上，决策则基于中位数的点识别差异以及其他点识别参数的结合。在这两种路径上，常见的基于中位数差异的度量方法仍然发挥作用，但传统标准得到了补充，这些补充信息在评估治疗效果时往往具有相关性。实施这两种方法被证明是简单的。除了分析结果外，文章还考虑了在多种政策背景下出现此类考虑的情况。虽然文章以最近关于COVID-19治疗的研究为基础，并借助多项研究来实证探讨中位治疗效应度量方法的一些特性，但其结果应该具有广泛的适用性。

abstract.text: Estimates of the benefits of antifraud enforcement in health care typically focus on direct monetary damages. Deterrence effects are acknowledged but unquantified. We evaluate the impact of a Department of Justice investigation of hospitals accused of billing Medicare for unnecessary implantable cardiac defibrillator (ICD) procedures on their use. Using 100% inpatient and outpatient procedure data from Florida, we estimate that the investigation caused a 22% decline in unnecessary ICD implantations. The present value of savings nationally over a 10 year period is $2.7 billion, nearly 10 times larger than the $280 million in settlements the Department of Justice recovered from hospitals. The investigation had a large and long-lasting effect on physician behavior, indicating the utility of antifraud enforcement as a tool for reducing wasteful medical care.

10.3386/w27900.abstractZh: 关于反欺诈执法在医疗保健领域带来的益处的评估，通常侧重于直接的金钱损失。虽然威慑效应得到了认可，但并未进行量化分析。我们评估了司法部对涉嫌向医疗保险系统虚报不必要的植入式心脏除颤器（ICD）手术的医院进行调查的影响。利用佛罗里达州100%的住院和门诊手术数据，我们估计该调查导致不必要的ICD植入数量减少了22%。在10年时间内，全国因该调查而节省的成本为27亿美元，几乎是司法部从医院处获得的2.8亿美元和解金额的近10倍。该调查对医生的行为产生了巨大且持久的影响，这表明反欺诈执法作为减少浪费性医疗护理的手段具有实用价值。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of teenage driving on mortality and risky behaviors in the United States using a regression discontinuity design. We estimate that motor vehicle fatalities rise by 40% at the minimum legal driving age cutoff, implying a mortality risk per additional mile driven 6-9 times higher than the risk faced by adult drivers. We also find a stark 80% increase in female deaths from drug overdoses and carbon monoxide poisoning at the cutoff, caused by changes in both suicides and accidental deaths. Our analysis suggests driving regulations could be an effective tool to improve teenage health.

10.3386/w27933.abstractZh: 我们通过回归连续设计研究了青少年驾驶对美国死亡率和危险行为的影响。我们的估计表明，在最低法定驾驶年龄起点，机动车死亡人数增加了40%，这意味着每增加一英里驾驶，死亡风险是成年驾驶者的6-9倍。我们还发现，在这一年龄起点，女性因药物过量和一氧化碳中毒导致的死亡人数增加了80%，这主要是由于自杀和意外死亡的变化所致。我们的分析表明，驾驶法规可能是改善青少年健康的有效手段。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) not only changed the landscape of health insurance coverage in the United States, but also affected the relationship between working decisions and health insurance. In this paper, we estimate the impact of the ACA on the near-elderly (ages 60- 64) in the five years after the implementation of its key provisions in early 2014. We exploit variation across geographic areas in the pre-existing level of uninsurance and use 65-69 year olds, whose insurance coverage was unaffected by the ACA, as a within-region control group. Our findings indicate that the ACA increased health insurance coverage among the near elderly by 4.5 percentage points and reduced their labor force participation rate by 0.6 percentage points.

10.3386/w27936.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》不仅改变了美国健康保险覆盖的格局，还影响了工作决策与健康保险之间的关系。本文旨在评估《平价医疗法案》在2014年初关键条款实施后的五年内，对60-64岁近老年人群体的影响。我们通过分析各地区在原有未保险水平上的差异，并选取65-69岁且未受《平价医疗法案》影响的群体作为地区内部对照组。研究结果表明，《平价医疗法案》使近老年人群体的健康保险覆盖率增加了4.5个百分点，同时降低了0.6个百分点的劳动力参与率。

abstract.text: Thinking beyond Covid-19, there is a growing interest in what economic structures will be needed to face ongoing pandemics. In this paper we focus on the diagnostic problem and examine a new paradigm of voluntary self-testing by private individuals. People without symptoms face daily choices of either taking the risk of going out (to work and socialize), versus staying at home in self-isolation. Our theory shows that two types of people voluntary test themselves: those who otherwise would have self-isolated, and those who would have gone out indiscriminately. Our central insight is that the equilibrium infection risk falls when home-based testing becomes cheaper and easier to use, even if tests are not always accurate. Our results challenge the clinical mainstream view that diagnostic testing is a prerogative of the medical profession, and supports the notion that frequent self-testing is vital for an economy facing an ongoing pandemic.

10.3386/w27941.abstractZh: 除了新冠疫情之外，人们越来越关注在应对持续的大流行病时所需的经济结构。本文聚焦于诊断问题，并探讨了私人个体自愿自我检测的新模式。没有症状的人每天面临两种选择：要么冒险外出（上班和社交），要么在家自我隔离。我们的理论表明，有两种类型的人会自愿自我检测：那些本来会自我隔离的人，以及那些会不加选择地外出的人。我们的核心观点是，当家庭检测变得更便宜且更容易使用时，即使检测结果并不总是准确，均衡感染风险也会降低。我们的研究结果挑战了临床主流观点，即诊断检测是医疗行业的专属权利，并支持频繁自我检测对于面临持续大流行病的经济来说至关重要这一观点。

abstract.text: Academic Medical Centers (AMCs)—comprising medical schools, teaching hospitals, and research laboratories—play an important role in US biomedical innovation. The Balanced Budget Act of 1997 changed reimbursements for Medicare inpatient claims and subsidies for medical residents. We compare AMCs' relative exposure to the reform and how these differences affect their researchers' ability to attract NIH grant funding, as well as the quantity, impact, and content of their publications. We find that in response to the reform, research activity increases by approximately 6%, with larger effects observed for “translational” and clinical research. We find little effect on clinical outcomes.

10.3386/w27943.abstractZh: 学术医疗中心（AMCs）由医学院、教学医院和研究实验室组成，在美国生物医学创新中发挥着重要作用。1997年的《平衡预算法案》改变了医疗保险对住院患者的报销方式，并对医学住院医师提供了补贴。我们对比了这些中心在改革中的相对影响，以及这些差异如何影响研究人员吸引NIH资助的能力，以及他们的出版物数量、影响力和内容。研究发现，作为对改革的响应，研究活动增加了约6%，其中“转化医学”和临床研究的效应更为显著。然而，对临床结果的影响却很小。

abstract.text: One of the most important changes to the United States health care system over the last two decades is the emergence of pay-for-performance as a way to encourage hospitals and other providers to improve quality of care. Unlike fee-for-service, these value-based purchasing programs measure aspects of quality and financially reward hospitals that are outstanding or at least improving in their care. Prior research has shown that hospitals often improve more when the marginal financial incentives are larger. However, the exact relationship between marginal financial incentives and year-over-year improvement in measures remains unclear. In this study, we use national 20152018 data on approximately 2,700 hospitals to estimate how hospitals respond to pay-for-performance incentives in the Hospital Value-Based Purchasing (HVBP) Program. We show that this relationship is non-linear, has strong serial correlation, is somewhat similar for safety-net hospitals as non-safety-net hospitals, and is proportional to the size of the Medicare patient population.

10.3386/w27948.abstractZh: 过去二十年里，美国医疗保健体系发生的最重要的变革之一，就是引入了基于绩效的付费机制，以此来激励医院和其他医疗服务提供者提高护理质量。与传统的按服务收费模式不同，这种基于价值的采购机制能够衡量护理质量的各个方面，并对那些表现优异或至少在护理质量上有所提升的医院给予经济奖励。先前的研究表明，当边际经济激励较大时，医院的改进效果通常会更好。然而，边际经济激励与年度护理质量改进之间的具体关系仍不清楚。在这项研究中，我们利用了2015至2018年间约2700家医院的国家数据，来估算医院对基于绩效的付费激励的反应。我们发现，这种关系是非线性的，具有强烈的序列相关性，对于安全网医院和非安全网医院来说，这种关系大致相同，并且与Medicare患者群体的规模成正比。

abstract.text: We provide new evidence on the drivers of the early US coronavirus pandemic. We combine an epidemiological model of disease transmission with quasi-random variation arising from the timing of stay-at-home-orders to estimate the causal roles of policy interventions and voluntary social distancing. We then relate the residual variation in disease transmission rates to observable features of cities. We estimate significant impacts of policy and social distancing responses, but we show that the magnitude of policy effects is modest, and most social distancing is driven by voluntary responses. Moreover, we show that neither policy nor rates of voluntary social distancing explain a meaningful share of geographic variation. The most important predictors of which cities were hardest hit by the pandemic are exogenous characteristics such as population and density.

10.3386/w27965.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于美国早期冠状病毒疫情驱动因素的新证据。我们通过结合疾病传播的流行病学模型以及因居家令实施时间而产生的准随机变异，来估算政策干预和自愿社交距离措施的作用。随后，我们将疾病传播率的剩余变异与城市的可观测特征联系起来。我们估计了政策和社交距离措施产生的显著影响，但发现政策效果的大小较为有限，而大多数社交距离措施是由自愿行为驱动的。此外，我们指出，无论是政策还是自愿社交距离措施，都无法解释地理变异的显著部分。对于哪些城市受到疫情最严重的冲击，最重要的预测因素是诸如人口和密度等外部特征。

abstract.text: In 1966, Southern hospitals were barred from participating in Medicare unless they discontinued their longstanding practice of racial segregation. Using data from five Deep South states and exploiting county-level variation in Medicare certification dates, we find that gaining access to an ostensibly integrated hospital had no effect on Black postneonatal mortality. Similarly, there is little evidence that the campaign contributed to the trend towards in-hospital births among Southern Black mothers. These results are consistent with descriptions of the hospital desegregation campaign as producing only cosmetic changes and illustrate the limits of anti-discrimination policies imposed upon reluctant actors.

10.3386/w27970.abstractZh: 1966年，南方医院被禁止参与医疗保险计划，除非它们停止长期存在的种族隔离行为。通过收集五个南方州的 데이터，并利用县级医疗保险认证日期的差异，我们发现，能够使用看似融合的医院并不会对黑人新生儿后的死亡率产生影响。同样，也没有证据表明这项运动有助于南方黑人母亲在院内分娩的趋势。这些结果与将医院废除种族隔离运动描述为仅带来表面变化的描述一致，同时也揭示了强加给不愿配合的参与者的反歧视政策的局限性。

abstract.text: Major crises — from terrorist attacks to epidemic outbreaks — bring the trade-off between individual civil liberties and societal well-being into sharp relief. In this paper, we study how willing citizens are to restrict civil liberties to improve public health conditions in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic. We design and conduct representative surveys involving approximately 550,000 responses across 15 countries, including China and the United States, during many months of the COVID-19 pandemic, from March 2020 until January 2021. We document significant heterogeneity across countries and demographic groups in willingness to sacrifice rights for public welfare. Citizens disadvantaged by income, education, or race are less willing to sacrifice rights than their more advantaged peers in every country, as are those with prior experience in communist regimes. Leveraging naturally occurring variation as well as experimental approaches, we estimate that a one standard deviation increase in health security concerns increases willingness to sacrifice civil liberties by approximately 68%-83% of the difference between the average Chinese and U.S. citizen. Stated preferences correlate with observed behavior including demand for tracing apps, donations, and petitions.

10.3386/w27972.abstractZh: 重大危机——从恐怖袭击到疫情爆发——使得个人自由与社会福祉之间的权衡变得尤为突出。本文研究在COVID-19大流行背景下，公民愿意为改善公共健康状况而限制个人自由的程度。我们设计并实施了涵盖15个国家（包括中国和美国）的抽样调查，样本量约为550,000人，时间跨度从2020年3月持续到2021年1月。研究发现，不同国家及人口群体在牺牲权利以换取公共福利方面的意愿存在显著差异。在每一个国家中，收入、教育或种族条件较差的公民，以及有共产主义政权经验的人，都不如条件较好的同龄人愿意牺牲权利。通过利用自然发生的差异以及实验方法，我们估计，健康安全担忧程度增加一个标准差，公民愿意牺牲个人自由的程度将增加约68%至83%，这一差异相当于中国和美国公民平均水平的差异。这些偏好与观察到的行为相关，包括人们对追踪应用程序、捐款和请愿活动的需求。

abstract.text: Reports of pain differ markedly across socioeconomic groups and are correlated with outcomes such as functional limitations and disability insurance receipt. This paper examines the differential experience of pain by education. We focus on knee pain, the most common musculoskeletal complaint. Comparing clinical interpretation of knee x-rays of people with and without pain, there are few differences in presence or clinical severity of arthritis across education groups. In contrast, less educated people report more pain for any given objective measure of arthritis. After confirming that reported pain maps to objective measures like walking speed and range of motion, we test four theories for differential experience of pain: differences in obesity, physically demanding occupations, psychological factors, and medical treatment differences. We find that physical demands on the job and obesity each explain about one-third of the education gradient in knee pain. There is an interaction between the two; physical requirements on the job are associated with knee pain primarily in those who are obese. In contrast, psychological traits and access to medical care explain little of the difference in reported pain by education level. These findings imply that educational gradients in pain are likely to persist or even widen as the need for physically demanding occupations—like home health aides and personal service workers—grows in importance with the aging population, and the working population continues to be obese.

10.3386/w27974.abstractZh: 不同社会经济群体对疼痛的感知存在显著差异，且这种差异与功能限制和残疾保险领取等结果相关。本文探讨了教育水平对疼痛体验的影响。我们重点关注膝关节疼痛，这是最常见的肌肉骨骼问题。通过比较有疼痛和没有疼痛的人膝关节X光片的临床解读，发现不同教育水平群体在关节炎的存在或临床严重程度方面几乎没有差异。相反，受教育程度较低的人对于任何给定的关节炎客观测量指标，报告的疼痛程度更高。在确认报告的疼痛与行走速度和关节活动范围等客观测量指标相关后，我们测试了四种关于疼痛体验差异的理论：肥胖差异、高体力要求的职业、心理因素以及医疗治疗差异。我们发现，工作中的体力要求和肥胖分别解释了膝关节疼痛与教育水平梯度关系中的约三分之一。这两者之间存在交互作用：工作中的体力要求主要与肥胖人群相关的膝关节疼痛有关。相比之下，心理特征和医疗服务的获取对教育水平与疼痛报告之间的差异解释作用较小。这些发现表明，随着人口老龄化，对高体力要求职业的需求增加，以及工作人群持续肥胖，教育水平与疼痛之间的梯度可能会持续存在甚至扩大。

abstract.text: Some consumers lack the cash needed to pay for medical care. As a result, they either delay care until they can pay for it or they forgo the care altogether. To test for such a possibility, we study the distribution of monthly Social Security checks among Medicare Part D enrollees. When Social Security checks are distributed, prescription fills increase by 6-12 percent. In that sense, drug consumption of low-income Medicare recipients is "liquidity sensitive." We then study recipients who transition onto a program that eliminates copayments. When those recipients do not face copayments, their drug consumption becomes less liquidity sensitive. That finding implies that, beyond risk protection, generous insurance also provides recipients with the ability to consume healthcare when they need it rather than when they have cash. Further, we find that recipients whose drug consumption is most liquidity sensitive exhibit price elasticities of demand that are twice the size of the average elasticity, suggesting that more-generous insurance causes recipients both to re-time prescription filling and also to start filling prescriptions that they otherwise would not fill. We present a stylized model that uses this finding to call into question the conventional interpretation of demand-response to price as solely inefficient moral hazard.

10.3386/w27977.abstractZh: 一些消费者缺乏支付医疗费用所需的现金。因此，他们要么推迟就医，直到能够支付费用，要么完全放弃就医。为了验证这种可能性，我们研究了医疗保险D部分参保者每月社会保障支票的分配情况。当社会保障支票发放时，处方药的开销会增加6-12%。从这个意义上说，低收入医疗保险参保者的药物消费具有“流动性敏感性”。随后，我们研究了那些转为无需支付共付额计划的参保者。当这些参保者不再面临共付额时，他们的药物消费变得不那么具有流动性敏感性。这一发现表明，除了风险保护之外，慷慨的保险还使参保者在需要医疗时而不是在有现金时就能消费医疗服务。此外，我们发现，药物消费最具流动性敏感性的参保者，其需求的价格弹性是平均弹性的两倍，这表明更慷慨的保险不仅使参保者推迟处方药的开销，还促使他们开始购买原本不会购买的处方药。我们提出了一个模型化框架，利用这一发现来质疑对价格反应的需求被视为单纯低效的道德风险的传统解释。

abstract.text: There is a coming wave of novel genetic therapies aiming to treat rare pediatric disease. A large literature investigates the valuation of new treatments, but the valuation of treatments for rare pediatric illness raises a host of unique issues. In this paper, we review the challenges of applying both the standard economic model and standard approaches to estimating cost-effectiveness using the quality-adjusted life year (QALY) to this case. We argue that there are a large number of special issues that have only been partially addressed by past work and we conclude that more data and the development of new methods are vital as innovators, health technology assessment practitioners and policymakers confront the launch of these new drugs.

10.3386/w27978.abstractZh: 即将出现一波针对罕见儿科疾病的新型基因疗法。大量文献研究了新疗法的价值评估，但对于罕见儿科疾病的治疗方法的价值评估则涉及许多独特的问题。在本文中，我们回顾了在应用标准经济模型和标准方法来估算成本效益时遇到的挑战，其中使用了质量调整生命年（QALY）作为评估指标。我们认为，过去的研究仅部分解决了许多特殊问题，因此，作为创新者、健康技术评估从业者以及政策制定者，我们需要更多的数据和新方法的开发，以应对这些新药物的推出。

abstract.text: Influenza and air pollution each pose significant health risks with global economic consequences. Their shared etiological pathways present a case of compounding health risk via interacting externalities. Using instrumental variables based on changing wind direction, we show increased levels of contemporaneous pollution increase influenza hospitalizations. We exploit random variation in effectiveness of the influenza vaccine as an additional instrument to show vaccine protection neutralizes this relationship. Thus, pollution control and vaccination campaigns jointly provide greater returns than those implied by addressing either in isolation. We show the importance of this consideration in addressing observed gaps in influenza incidence by race.

10.3386/w27982.abstractZh: 流感和空气污染都带来严重的健康风险，并对全球经济产生负面影响。它们共同的病因途径表明，通过相互作用的外部性，健康风险会进一步加剧。通过基于风向变化的工具变量分析，我们发现污染水平上升会增加流感住院人数。我们进一步利用流感疫苗效果随时间的随机变化作为额外工具变量，证明疫苗的保护作用能够中和这种关系。因此，污染控制和疫苗接种活动联合实施，所带来的收益比单独采取其中任何一种措施都要大。我们强调了在解决不同种族间流感发病率差异问题时，考虑这些因素的重要性。

abstract.text: The recent lead-in-water crisis in Newark has renewed concerns about the crisis being a widespread problem in the nation. Using data on the exact home addresses of pregnant women residing in the city combined with information on the spatial boundary separating areas within the city serviced by two water treatment plants, we exploit an exogenous change in water chemistry that resulted in lead leaching into the tap water of one plant's service area, but not the other's, to identify a causal effect of prenatal lead exposure on fetal health. We find robust evidence of adverse health impacts, which has important policy implications in light of the substantial number of lead water pipes that remain in use as part of our aging infrastructure and the cost-benefit calculus of lead abatement interventions.

10.3386/w27996.abstractZh: 纽瓦克最近发生的自来水铅污染危机再次引发了人们对这一问题是否在全国范围内普遍存在的担忧。通过收集该市孕妇的确切家庭住址数据，并结合两个水处理厂服务区域之间的空间边界信息，我们发现一个水处理厂服务区的自来水中含有铅，而另一个水处理厂服务区则没有。这一外部因素的变化揭示了产前铅暴露对胎儿健康的负面影响。我们的研究发现了强有力的证据，表明铅污染对健康有严重的危害。考虑到我国老化基础设施中仍有大量使用铅制水管的现状，以及减少铅污染的成本效益问题，这一发现对政策制定具有重要意义。

abstract.text: The long-run costs and benefits of social insurance expansions may not be realized until a program has been in place through a cycle of boom, bust, and recovery. In the case of the Affordable Care Act (ACA), the arrival of the program's inaugural bust and recovery have been hastened by the COVID-19 pandemic. In this context, our analysis begins by developing two facts. First, during the pre-pandemic boom, we show that the ACA's effects had largely stabilized by 2016. Second, we develop a new fact involving variations in the ACA's effects across industries. Specifically, we show that the ACA’s effects differed dramatically across industries with lower versus higher levels of pre-ACA insurance coverage, and that this difference cannot be explained by differences in workers’ incomes or other observable characteristics, nor by geographic differences in pre-ACA uninsured rates. Finally, we set the stage for pre-committed analyses of the ACA's effects over the remainder of the current cycle of boom, bust, and recovery. In so doing, we seek to advance the use of pre-committed research designs in observational settings.

10.3386/w27999.abstractZh: 社会保险扩张的长期成本和收益可能只有在经历一轮繁荣、萧条和复苏之后才能显现。以《平价医疗法案》为例，该计划的首次萧条和复苏因COVID-19疫情而加速。在此背景下，我们的分析首先提出了两个事实。首先，在疫情前的繁荣时期，我们显示《平价医疗法案》的效果在2016年之前已经基本稳定。其次，我们发现了《平价医疗法案》在不同行业中的效果存在差异这一新事实。具体来说，我们发现《平价医疗法案》的效果在不同行业中存在显著差异，尤其是在《平价医疗法案》实施前保险覆盖率较低和较高的行业之间。这种差异无法用工人收入或其他可观测特征的差异来解释，也无法用《平价医疗法案》实施前未投保率的地理差异来解释。最后，我们为在当前繁荣、萧条和复苏的周期剩余时间内对《平价医疗法案》效果进行前瞻性分析奠定了基础。通过这样做，我们旨在推动在观察性研究中采用前瞻性研究设计的应用。

abstract.text: Insurance choices are often hard to rationalize by standard theory and frequently appear sub-optimal. A key reason may be that people are unable to map the cost-sharing features of plans to their distribution of financial consequences. We develop and experimentally test a decision aid that provides this mapping to simplify comparisons of plan options. In two experiments mirroring typical health insurance decisions, we find that when people choose plans using standard feature-based information, they violate dominance at high rates. Our distribution-based decision aid substantially reduces dominance violations, and also changes choice patterns in situations where there is no dominant option. Choice patterns under feature-based menus can be most easily rationalized by models of heuristic choices, such as minimizing premium or deductible. With the decision aid, though, significantly more people have choice patterns that are better explained by expected utility theory. We compare our distribution-based approach to an alternative of providing estimates of the expected value of costs, which is the most common decision-support available in most insurance markets. Providing expected values affects choices in a similar direction as our consequence-based approach, but in a more muted fashion, and is only about half as effective at reducing dominance violations.

10.3386/w28003.abstractZh: 保险选择往往难以用标准理论来合理化，且常常显得不够理想。一个关键原因可能是人们无法将保险计划的费用分摊特征与其财务后果的分布联系起来。我们开发了一种决策辅助工具，该工具能够提供这种映射，从而简化计划选择的比较。在两项反映典型健康保险决策的实验中，我们发现当人们使用基于标准的特征信息来选择保险计划时，他们违反支配性选择的情况非常普遍。我们的基于分布的决策辅助工具显著减少了这种违反现象，并且在不存在支配性选择的情况下，还能改变选择模式。在基于特征的菜单选择下，选择模式最容易用启发式选择模型来解释，比如最小化保费或免赔额。然而，使用决策辅助工具后，有更多的人选择模式可以用期望效用理论来解释。我们将基于分布的方法与另一种提供成本期望值估计的方法进行了比较，后者是大多数保险市场中常见的决策支持手段。提供期望值对选择的影响与我们的基于后果的方法类似，但程度较轻，并且减少支配性违反现象的效果仅约为前者的一半。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic in the US has been particularly devastating for nursing home residents. A key question is how have some nursing homes been able to effectively protect their residents, while others have not? Using data on the universe of US nursing homes, we examine whether establishment quality is predictive of COVID-19 mortality. Higher-quality nursing homes, as measured by inspection ratings, have substantially lower COVID-19 mortality. Quality does not predict the ability to prevent any COVID-19 resident or staff cases, but higher-quality establishments prevent the spread of resident infections conditional on having one. Preventing COVID-19 cases and deaths may come at some cost, as high-quality homes have substantially higher non-COVID deaths, a result consistent with high excess non-COVID mortality among the elderly since March. The positive correlation between establishment quality and non-COVID mortality is driven entirely by nursing homes located in counties with below-median COVID-19 case rates. As a result, high-quality homes in these counties have significantly more total deaths than their low-quality counterparts. The concentration of excess death in low-risk areas suggests that future suffering could be avoided with more nuanced guidelines, such as those recently suggested by CMS that outline a role for in-person visits in lower-risk areas.

10.3386/w28012.abstractZh: 美国的新冠疫情对养老院居民造成了特别严重的伤害。一个关键问题是，为什么有些养老院能够有效保护居民，而另一些养老院却做不到？通过对比美国所有养老院的统计数据，我们研究了养老院的质量是否能够预测新冠死亡率。根据检查评级衡量，质量较高的养老院新冠死亡率明显较低。质量并不能预测养老院能否防止任何居民或工作人员感染新冠，但质量较高的养老院能够在出现感染时防止其传播。然而，预防新冠病例和死亡可能会带来一些代价，因为质量较高的养老院的非新冠死亡人数明显更多，这一结果与自3月以来老年人非新冠死亡人数增加的情况一致。养老院质量与非新冠死亡人数之间的正相关关系，完全是由位于新冠病例率低于中位数的县内的养老院所驱动的。因此，这些县内质量较高的养老院的总死亡人数明显多于质量较低的养老院。低风险地区超额死亡人数的集中现象表明，通过更细致的指南，例如美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心最近提出的关于在低风险地区进行面对面访问的指南，可以避免未来的痛苦。

abstract.text: We develop a simple framework to measure the role of hospital allocation in racial disparities in health care and use it to study Black and white Medicare patients who are treated for heart attacks – a condition where virtually everyone receives care, hospital care is highly effective, and hospital quality has been validated. We report four facts. (1) Black patients receive care at lower-performing hospitals than white patients, even when they live in the same hospital market or ZIP code within a hospital market. (2) Over the past two decades, the gap in performance between hospitals treating Black and white patients shrank by over two-thirds. (3) This progress is due to more rapid performance improvement at hospitals that tended to treat Black patients, rather than faster reallocation of Black patients to better hospitals. (4) Hospital performance improvement is correlated with adoption of a high-return low-cost input, beta-blockers. Closing remaining disparities in allocation and harnessing the forces of performance improvement, including technology diffusion, may be novel levers to further reduce disparities.

10.3386/w28018.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个简单的框架，用于衡量医院分配在医疗健康领域种族差异中的作用，并利用该框架研究接受心脏病治疗的黑人和白人医疗保险患者——这种情况几乎人人都会遇到，医院治疗效果非常显著，且医院质量已经得到验证。我们报告了四个事实：(1) 即使黑人在同一医院市场或邮政编码范围内的医院接受治疗，他们也会在表现较差的医院接受治疗。(2) 在过去的二十年里，治疗黑人和白人患者的医院之间的表现差距缩小了三分之二以上。(3) 这一进步是由于那些倾向于治疗黑人的医院表现改善得更快，而不是黑人患者被更快地分配到更好的医院。(4) 医院表现的改善与采用高回报低成本药物——β阻滞剂——有关。消除剩余的分配差异，并利用包括技术扩散在内的表现改善力量，可能是进一步减少差异的新途径。

abstract.text: We assess the economic value of screening testing programs as a policy response to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic. We find that the fiscal, macroeconomic, and health benefits of rapid SARS-CoV-2 screening testing programs far exceed their costs, with the ratio of economic benefits to costs typically in the range of 4-15 (depending on program details), not counting the monetized value of lives saved. Unless the screening test is highly specific, however, the signal value of the screening test alone is low, leading to concerns about adherence. Confirmatory testing increases the net economic benefits of screening tests by reducing the number of healthy workers in quarantine and by increasing adherence to quarantine measures. The analysis is undertaken using a behavioral SIR model for the United States with 5 age groups, 66 economic sectors, screening and diagnostic testing, and partial adherence to instructions to quarantine or to isolate.

10.3386/w28031.abstractZh: 我们评估了筛查测试计划作为应对当前COVID-19疫情的政策措施的经济价值。研究发现，快速SARS-CoV-2筛查测试计划所带来的财政、宏观经济和健康效益远远超过其成本，经济效益与成本的比率通常在4到15之间（具体取决于测试计划细节），这还不包括因挽救生命而带来的货币价值。然而，除非筛查测试具有高度特异性，否则单独筛查测试的信号价值较低，这引发了人们对测试依从性的担忧。确认性测试通过减少需要隔离的健康工人数量以及提高对隔离措施的依从性，提升了筛查测试的净经济效益。该分析采用行为SIR模型对美国进行了研究，涵盖了5个年龄组、66个经济部门、筛查和诊断测试，以及部分人遵守隔离或自我隔离规定的行为。

abstract.text: We assess the complicated reality of monetary policy transmission through mortgage markets by synthesizing the existing literature on the role of refinancing in policy implementation. After briefly reviewing mortgage market institutions in the U.S. and documenting refinance activity over time, we summarize the links between refinancing and consumption, and describe the frictions impeding the refinancing channel. The paper draws heavily on research emerging from the experience of the financial crisis of 2008-09, as it highlights a combination of market, institutional, and policy-making factors that dulled the transmission mechanism. We conclude with a discussion of potential mortgage market innovations, and the applicability of lessons learned to the ongoing stresses induced by the COVID-19 pandemic.

10.3386/w28039.abstractZh: 我们通过综合现有文献，评估了货币政策通过抵押贷款市场传导的复杂现实，重点研究再融资在政策实施中的作用。在简要回顾了美国的抵押贷款市场机构结构并记录了再融资活动的时间变化后，我们总结了再融资与消费之间的联系，并描述了阻碍再融资渠道的摩擦因素。本文大量借鉴了2008-09年金融危机期间的研究经验，指出市场、制度和政策制定因素共同削弱了货币政策的传导机制。最后，我们讨论了潜在的抵押贷款市场创新，以及这些经验对当前COVID-19疫情引发的危机的适用性。

abstract.text: This study tests whether demand responds symmetrically to price increases and decreases—a seemingly obvious proposition under conventional demand theory that has not been rigorously tested. Exploiting rapid expansion in municipal subsidies for child healthcare in a difference-in-differences framework, we find evidence against it: when coinsurance, our price measure, increases from 0% to 30%, the demand response is more than twice that to a price decrease from 30% to 0%, a result consistent with loss aversion. This result indicates that, while economists and policymakers pay little attention, the price change direction matters, and that welfare analysis should incorporate this direction.

10.3386/w28057.abstractZh: 本研究旨在检验需求是否对价格上涨和下降的反应是对称的——这一在常规需求理论下看似显而易见的命题，却尚未得到严格验证。通过采用差异-差异框架，我们观察到市政儿童医疗保健补贴的快速扩张，发现了与之相悖的证据：当共同保险比例从0%增加到30%时，需求反应的增长幅度是价格从30%降至0%时的两倍以上，这一结果与损失厌恶心理一致。这一结果表明，尽管经济学家和政策制定者往往忽视这一点，但价格变化的方向确实具有重要意义，福利分析应考虑到这一方向。

abstract.text: At the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic, 13 states used elective procedure bans to explicitly restrict access to surgical abortions and an additional 20 states banned all elective procedures, without reference to abortion. In this paper, we study the effects of these state-level bans on visits to abortion clinics. Using a balanced panel of 757 abortion clinics, we find that clinics in states banning elective procedures experienced an 18% reduction in visits, and surgical abortion bans led to a further 9% reduction, entirely from fewer visits to clinics that provided surgical abortions. These restrictions resulted in approximately 18,000 fewer abortions in 2020 compared to 2019, leading to 8400 additional births. The effects of these bans on mobility were not confined to traditionally “red” states but also affected mobility to clinics in “blue” states.

10.3386/w28058.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情初期，有13个州通过禁止选择性手术来明确限制对手术流产的访问，另有20个州禁止了所有选择性手术，但未提及与流产相关的内容。本文研究了这些州级禁令对堕胎诊所访问量的影响。通过对比757家堕胎诊所的数据，我们发现禁止选择性手术的州内诊所的访问量减少了18%，而手术流产禁令则使访问量进一步减少了9%，这主要体现在提供手术流产服务的诊所的访问量减少上。这些限制措施导致2020年的流产数量比2019年减少了约18,000例，同时增加了8400例出生。这些禁令对流动性的影响不仅限于传统上被称为“红色州”的州，也影响了“蓝色州”内诊所的访问情况。

abstract.text: Proposals to create a national health care plan such as "Medicare for All" rely heavily on reducing the prices that insurers pay for health care. These changes affect physicians' short-run incentives for care provision and may also change health care providers' incentives to invest in capacity, thereby influencing the availability of care in the long term. We provide evidence on these responses using a major Medicare payment change combined with survey data on physicians' time use. We find evidence that physicians increase their time spent on capacity building when remuneration increases, and that they are subsequently more willing to accept new patients---especially those who may be the residual claimants on marginal capacity. These forces imply that short-run supply curves likely differ from long-run supply curves. Policymakers need to account for how major changes to payment incentives would influence the investments that determine health system capacity.

10.3386/w28062.abstractZh: 关于制定如“全民医保”这样的国家医疗计划的提议，很大程度上依赖于降低保险公司支付医疗服务的费用。这些变化会影响医生提供服务的短期激励，也可能改变医疗服务提供者投资基础设施的动机，从而长期影响医疗服务的可获得性。我们通过一项关于医疗支付制度改革与医生时间使用情况的调查数据，提供了关于这些影响的证据。我们发现，当报酬增加时，医生会增加用于基础设施建设的投入时间，并且他们随后更愿意接受新患者——尤其是那些可能成为边际产能剩余索赔者的患者。这些力量意味着短期供给曲线可能与长期供给曲线有所不同。政策制定者需要考虑重大的支付激励变化如何影响决定医疗系统基础设施建设的投资。

abstract.text: While the mechanism design paradigm emphasizes notions of efficiency based on agent preferences, policymakers often focus on alternative objectives. School districts emphasize educational achievement, and transplantation communities focus on patient survival. It is unclear whether choice-based mechanisms perform well when assessed based on these outcomes. This paper evaluates the assignment mechanism for allocating deceased donor kidneys on the basis of patient life-years from transplantation (LYFT).We examine the role of choice in increasing LYFT and compare realized assignments to benchmarks that remove choice. Our model combines choices and outcomes in order to study how selection affects LYFT. We show how to identify and estimate the model using instruments derived from the mechanism. The estimates suggest that the design in use selects patients with better post-transplant survival prospects and matches them well, resulting in an average LYFT of 9.29, which is 1.75 years more than a random assignment. However, the maximum aggregate LYFT is 14.08. Realizing the majority of the gains requires transplanting relatively healthy patients, who would have longer life expectancies even without a transplant. Therefore, a policymaker faces a dilemma between transplanting patients who are sicker and those for whom life will be extended the longest.

10.3386/w28064.abstractZh: 虽然机制设计范式强调基于代理人偏好的效率概念，但政策制定者往往关注其他目标。学区重视教育成就，而移植社区则关注患者的生存状况。目前尚不清楚基于选择的机制在根据这些结果进行评估时是否表现良好。本文基于患者的生命年数，评估了用于分配已故捐赠者肾脏的分配机制。我们研究了选择对增加生命年数的影响，并将实际分配结果与去除选择的基准进行了比较。我们的模型结合了选择和结果，以研究选择如何影响生命年数。我们展示了如何使用从机制中衍生出的工具来识别和估计模型。估计结果表明，当前使用的设计能够选择出具有更好移植后生存前景的患者，并将他们进行良好的匹配，从而使平均生命年数达到9.29年，比随机分配多出1.75年。然而，最大的总体生命年数仅为14.08年。要实现大部分收益，需要移植相对健康的患者，即使没有移植，这些患者的预期寿命也会更长。因此，政策制定者在移植病情更严重的患者与能够延长生命的患者之间面临着两难选择。

abstract.text: The United States has experienced an unprecedented crisis related to the misuse of and addiction to opioids. As of 2018, 128 Americans die each day of an opioid overdose, and total economic costs associated with opioid misuse are estimated to be more than $500 billion annually. The crisis has evolved in three phases, starting in the 1990s and continuing through 2010 with a massive increase in use of prescribed opioids associated with lax prescribing regulations and aggressive marketing eﬀorts by the pharmaceutical industry. A second phase included tightening restrictions on prescribed opioids, reformulation of some commonly misused prescription medications, and a shift to heroin consumption over the period 2010 to 2013. Since 2013, the third phase of the crisis has included a movement towards synthetic opioids, especially fentanyl, and a continued tightening of opioid prescribing regulations, along with the growth of both harm reduction and addiction treatment access policies. Economic research, using innovative frameworks, causal methods, and rich data, has added to our understanding of the causes and consequences of the crisis. This body of research also identiﬁes intended and unintended impacts of policies designed to address the crisis. Although there is general agreement that the causes of the crisis include a combination of supply- and demand-side factors, and interactions between them, there is less consensus regarding the relative importance of each. Studies show that regulations can reduce opioid prescribing but may have less impact on root causes of the crisis and, in some cases, have spillover eﬀects resulting in greater use of more harmful substances obtained in illicit markets, where regulation is less possible. There are eﬀective opioid use disorder treatments available, but access, stigma, and cost hurdles have stiﬂed utilization, resulting in a large degree of under-treatment in the U.S. How challenges brought about by the COVID-19 pandemic may intersect with the opioid crisis is unclear. Emerging areas for future research include understanding how societal and healthcare systems disruptions aﬀect opioid use, as well as which regulations and policies most eﬀectively reduce potentially inappropriate prescription opioid use and illicit opioid sources without unintended negative consequences.

10.3386/w28067.abstractZh: 美国正面临一场前所未有的危机，与阿片类药物的滥用和成瘾有关。截至2018年，每天有128名美国人因阿片类药物过量而死亡，与阿片类药物滥用相关的总经济成本估计每年超过5000亿美元。这场危机经历了三个阶段，从1990年代开始，一直持续到2010年，期间由于处方阿片类药物的滥用现象激增，加上制药行业的激烈营销活动，情况进一步恶化。第二阶段包括加强对处方阿片类药物的管制、重新配制一些常被滥用的处方药，以及从2010年到2013年期间转向海洛因消费。自2013年以来，危机的第三阶段表现为转向合成阿片类药物，尤其是芬太尼，同时继续加强阿片类药物处方的监管，并推动减少伤害和成瘾治疗政策的实施。利用创新框架、因果方法和丰富数据的经济研究，有助于我们更好地理解这场危机的原因和后果。这些研究还揭示了旨在应对危机的政策所带来的预期与非预期影响。尽管普遍认为危机的原因包括供应和需求方面的因素以及它们之间的相互作用，但关于这些因素的相对重要性，目前还没有达成共识。研究表明，监管措施可以减少阿片类药物的处方量，但对危机的根本原因的影响可能较小，在某些情况下，还会产生溢出效应，导致在监管较为薄弱的非法市场中使用更多有害物质。目前有有效的阿片类药物使用障碍治疗方法，但获取途径、社会污名以及高昂的成本等因素阻碍了这些疗法的应用，导致美国存在大量未得到治疗的病例。COVID-19大流行带来的挑战可能与阿片类药物危机产生交集，目前尚不清楚具体如何结合。未来研究的重点包括了解社会与医疗系统的中断如何影响阿片类药物的使用，以及哪些法规和政策能够最有效地减少不适当的处方阿片类药物使用以及非法阿片类药物的来源，同时避免产生意外的负面影响。

abstract.text: Around the world, policymakers and news reports warned that the COVID-19 pandemic, and attendant restrictions on individual mobility and commercial activity, could lead to a surge in domestic violence (DV). Some prominent initial studies of the effects of the pandemic showed evidence of greater DV incidence, but findings were inconsistent across locations and DV measures. This paper focuses on a single major city, Los Angeles, to measure the impact of the initial pandemic shutdown on three DV measures based on police data (911 calls, crime incidents, and arrests) as well as measures based on two non-police administrative sources (the county DV hotline and hospital records). After confirming the prior finding of an increase in DV calls to police during the shutdown, we also show that calls to the hotline increased. However, we find that DV crimes recorded by police and hospital visits by female assault (and DV) victims both decreased significantly, suggesting that the increase in calls came from higher reporting rates, possibly for verbal disputes. Arrests per population for DV crimes were unaffected by the shutdown, but a higher share of DV crimes led to arrests. This points against a decrease in the intensity of policing of DV crimes driving the lower crime rate. We conclude that the initial LA shutdown increased the rates at which people contacted authorities about domestic-related concerns, but decreased the overall incidence of physical DV crimes in the population.

10.3386/w28068.abstractZh: 全球范围内，政策制定者和新闻报道警告称，COVID-19疫情以及随之而来的个人流动和商业活动限制可能导致家庭暴力事件的激增。一些初步研究指出，疫情期间家庭暴力事件的发生率有所上升，但不同地区的研究结果并不一致，且所使用的家庭暴力衡量指标也有所不同。本文以洛杉矶为例，通过警方数据（911报警电话、犯罪事件和逮捕记录）以及两个非警方行政来源的数据（县家庭暴力热线电话和医院记录）来测量疫情初期关闭措施对三种家庭暴力衡量指标的影响。在确认了疫情关闭期间向警方报警的家庭暴力事件数量有所增加后，我们还发现向家庭暴力热线电话的报警数量也有所增加。然而，我们发现警方记录的家庭暴力犯罪和女性施暴受害者就诊数量均显著下降，这表明报警数量的增加可能是由于报案率提高所致，其中可能包括言语纠纷的报案。针对家庭暴力的犯罪逮捕率并未受到疫情关闭的影响，但更多类型的家庭暴力犯罪导致了逮捕。这些结果表明，家庭暴力犯罪的执法强度并未下降，从而解释了犯罪率下降的原因。我们得出结论，洛杉矶的初期关闭措施确实增加了人们因家庭相关问题向当局求助的频率，但总体上减少了家庭暴力犯罪的发生率。

abstract.text: Absent explicit quotas, incentives, reporting, or fiscal year-end motives, drug approvals around the world surge in December, at month-ends, and before respective major national holidays. Drugs approved before these informal deadlines are associated with significantly more adverse effects, including more hospitalizations, life-threatening incidents, and deaths – particularly, drugs most rushed through the approval process. These patterns are consistent with a model in which regulators rush to meet internal production benchmarks associated with salient calendar periods: this “desk-clearing” behavior results in more lax review, leading both to increased output and increased safety issues at particular—and predictable—periodicities over the year.

10.3386/w28071.abstractZh: 在没有明确的配额、激励措施、报告要求或财政年度末动机的情况下，全球范围内的药物审批在12月、月末以及各大国家节日之前激增。在这些非正式截止日期之前获得批准的药物，其不良副作用明显更多，包括更多的住院治疗、危及生命的事件和死亡——尤其是那些通过审批流程仓促完成的药物。这些模式与一种模型相符，即监管机构为了满足与重要日历时期相关的内部生产指标而匆忙审批。这种“清理办公桌”的行为导致了更宽松的审查，从而在一年中特定的、可预测的时间点，既增加了药物产量，也增加了安全问题。

abstract.text: This paper studies how the COVID-19 pandemic has affected labor demand using over 100 million posted jobs on one of the largest online platforms in China. Our data reveals that, due to the effects of the pandemic both in China and abroad, the number of newly posted jobs within the first 13 weeks after the Wuhan lockdown on January 23, 2020 was about one third lower than that of the same lunar calendar weeks in 2018 and 2019. Using econometric methods, we show that, via the global supply chain, COVID-19 cases abroad and in particular pandemic-control policies by foreign governments reduced new job creations in China by 11.7%. We also find that Chinese firms most exposed to international trade outperformed other firms at the beginning of the pandemic but underperformed during recovery as the Novel Coronavirus spread throughout the world.

10.3386/w28072.abstractZh: 本文研究了COVID-19大流行如何影响劳动力需求，通过中国最大的在线平台上的超过1亿份职位信息进行分析。数据显示，由于大流行的影响，自2020年1月23日武汉实施封锁后的前13周内，新发布的职位数量比2018年和2019年同期的农历周数减少了约三分之一。通过计量经济学方法分析发现，由于全球供应链的影响，国外COVID-19病例以及外国政府实施的大流行控制政策，导致中国的新增就业机会减少了11.7%。我们还发现，在疫情初期，中国企业在国际贸易方面表现较好，但在疫情恢复期间，随着新型冠状病毒在全球范围内传播，这些企业的表现却有所下滑。

abstract.text: This study investigated the effects of welfare reform in the 1990s, which represented a major policy shift that substantially and permanently retracted cash assistance to poor mothers in the U.S., on parenting. Using data on women from the 1979 cohort of the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth linked with information on their 10- to 14-year-old children from the Child Self-Administered and Self-Report surveys, we exploited variation in the implementation of welfare reform across states, over time, and across treatment and comparison groups to estimate the effects of welfare reform on parent-child activities and closeness of the mother-child relationship. We found that welfare reform had adverse effects on engagement in parent-child activities, children feeling close to their mothers, and mothers knowing their children’s whereabouts, with the effects generally concentrated among boys. These findings have implications for children’s development and contribute to a virtually non-existent literature on the effects of welfare reform on parenting and the small but growing economic literature on parenting. We found no evidence that the effects of welfare reform on parenting operated through the mother working more than full time, having multiple jobs, working in a service job, or having a non-standard work schedule.

10.3386/w28077.abstractZh: 本研究调查了20世纪90年代福利改革的影响，这一重大政策转变使得美国对贫困母亲的现金援助大幅且永久性地减少。我们利用1979年《全国青年纵向调查》中女性数据，以及《儿童自我管理和自我报告调查》中她们10至14岁孩子的信息，通过分析各州在实施福利改革过程中的差异，以及不同处理组和对照组之间的对比，来估算福利改革对亲子活动及母子关系亲密程度的影响。研究发现，福利改革对亲子活动的参与、孩子与母亲的亲密关系，以及母亲对孩子下落的了解等方面产生了负面影响，这些影响主要集中在男孩身上。这些发现对儿童发展具有重要意义，并补充了关于福利改革对育儿影响的几乎不存在的文献，以及关于育儿的少量但不断增长的经济文献。我们没有发现福利改革对育儿的影响是通过母亲从事兼职工作、多份工作、从事服务行业或拥有非标准工作时间等方式传递的。

abstract.text: Vaccines exert a positive externality, reducing spread of disease from the consumer to others, providing a rationale for subsidies. We study how optimal subsidies vary with disease characteristics by integrating a standard epidemiological model into a vaccine market with rational economic agents. In the steady-state equilibrium for an endemic disease, across market structures ranging from competition to monopoly, the marginal externality and optimal subsidy are non-monotonic in disease infectiousness, peaking for diseases that spread quickly but not so quickly as to drive all consumers to become vaccinated. Motivated by the Covid-19 pandemic, we adapt the analysis to study a vaccine campaign introduced at a point in time against an emerging epidemic. While the nonmonotonic pattern of the optimal subsidy persists, new findings emerge. Universal vaccination with a perfectly effective vaccine becomes a viable firm strategy: the marginal consumer is still willing to pay since those infected before vaccine rollout remain a source of transmission. We derive a simple condition under which vaccination exhibits increasing social returns, providing an argument for concentrating a capacity-constrained campaign in few regions. We discuss a variety of extensions and calibrations of the results to vaccines and other mitigation measures targeting existing diseases.

10.3386/w28085.abstractZh: 疫苗具有积极的外溢效应，能够减少疾病从消费者向其他人的传播，这为补贴提供了依据。我们研究了最优补贴如何随疾病特征而变化，通过将标准的流行病学模型整合到具有理性经济行为的疫苗市场中来进行研究。在地方性疾病的稳态均衡中，从竞争到垄断的各种市场结构下，边际外溢效应和最优补贴与疾病的传染性呈非单调关系，对于传播迅速但不足以促使所有消费者接种疫苗的疾病而言，这一效应达到峰值。受新冠疫情的启发，我们将分析扩展到针对新兴流行病的疫苗行动。尽管最优补贴的非单调模式仍然存在，但出现了新的发现：使用完全有效的疫苗进行全民接种成为一种可行的企业策略——因为疫苗推广前被感染的人仍然是传播的源头，因此边际消费者仍然愿意支付费用。我们推导出一个简单条件，即疫苗展现出递增的社会回报，这为将有限的疫苗资源集中在少数地区提供了依据。我们还讨论了将这一结果扩展到针对现有疾病的其他疫苗和缓解措施的各种可能性。

abstract.text: This paper presents a simple price-theory approach to Covid-19 lockdown and reopening policy. The key idea is to conceptualize R ≤ 1 as a constraint, allowing traditional economic and societal goals to be the policy objective, all within a simple static optimization framework. This approach yields two main insights. First, the R ≤ 1 constraint imposes a disease-transmission budget on society. Society should optimally spend this budget on the activities with the highest ratio of utility to disease-transmission risk, dropping activities with too low a ratio of utility to risk. Second, masks, tests, and other simple interventions increase activities' utility-to-risk ratios, and hence expand how much activity society can engage in and utility society can achieve while staying within the R ≤ 1 budget. A simple numerical example, based on estimates from the medical literature for R0 and the efficacy of facemasks and complementary measures, suggests the potential gains are enormous. Overall, the formulation provides economics language for a policy middle ground between society-wide lockdown and ignore-the-virus, and a new infectious threat response paradigm alongside “eradicate” and “minimize”.

10.3386/w28093.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于价格理论的简单方法，用于分析新冠疫情封锁与重新开放政策。其核心思想是将R ≤ 1视为一种约束条件，使得传统的经济和社会目标可以成为政策目标，而这一切都可以在一个简单的静态优化框架内实现。这种方法带来了两个主要启示：首先，R ≤ 1的约束条件对社会施加了疾病传播预算的限制。社会应当最优地将这些预算用于那些效用与疾病传播风险比率最高的活动，而减少那些效用与风险比率过低的活动的参与。其次，口罩、检测以及其他简单的干预措施能够提升活动的效用与风险比率，从而扩大社会可以参与的活动范围以及社会可以实现的效用水平，同时仍保持在R ≤ 1的预算范围内。基于医学文献中对R0以及口罩和其他补充措施有效性的估算，一个简单的数值例子表明，潜在的收益是巨大的。总体而言，这一理论为在全面封锁与无视病毒威胁之间找到政策平衡点提供了经济学语言，同时也为应对传染病威胁提供了一种新的范式，即“根除”与“最小化”之间的选择。

abstract.text: Starting from the assumption that improving well-being is the central consideration for public policies, we show how subjective well-being research can help, and already is helping, to choose public policies based on their consequences for all aspects of life. The core of the paper lies in examples where the methods we propose, often in systematic experimental contexts, have already been used to guide the evaluation and ranking of alternative policy options in public health, education, workplace training, and social welfare. The arrival of COVID-19 has increased the urgency for a well-being focus, since the policy decisions being faced by governments dealing with the pandemic require an approach much broader than provided by more typical policy evaluations in all disciplines, including especially the social context and the distribution of costs and consequences. A broader approach to policy design and choice is fully consistent with the underlying aims of epidemiology, with similar gains likely in other policy disciplines. A focus on subjective well-being as an umbrella measure of welfare might help to restore to economics the breadth of purpose and methods it had two centuries ago, when happiness was considered the appropriate goal for private actions and public policies.

10.3386/w28095.abstractZh: 基于改善福祉是公共政策核心考虑因素的假设，我们展示了主观幸福感研究如何帮助——并且已经在帮助——根据政策对生活的各个方面的影响来选择公共政策。本文的核心在于一些实例，其中我们提出的方法，通常在系统性的实验环境中，已经被用于指导在公共卫生、教育、工作场所培训和社会福利等领域的不同政策选项的评估和排序。COVID-19的爆发增加了关注福祉的紧迫性，因为政府在处理疫情时面临的决策需要一种比所有学科中典型的政策评估更为广泛的方法，尤其是在社会背景以及成本和后果分配方面。对政策设计和选择的更广泛方法完全符合流行病学的基本目标，在其他政策领域也可能获得类似的成果。将主观幸福感作为福利的综合性指标，可能有助于让经济学恢复两个世纪前那种目的和方法上的广度，那时幸福被视为私人行为和社会政策的适当目标。

abstract.text: We study the economic and psychological effects of a USD 1076 PPP unconditional cash transfer, a five-week psychotherapy program, and the combination of both interventions among 5,756 individuals in rural Kenya. One year after the interventions, cash transfer recipients had higher consumption, asset holdings, and revenue, as well as higher levels of psychological well-being than control households. In contrast, the psychotherapy program had no measurable effects on either psychological or economic outcomes, both for individuals with poor mental health at baseline and others. The effects of the combined treatment are similar to those of the cash transfer alone.

10.3386/w28106.abstractZh: 我们研究了在肯尼亚农村对5,756名个体实施的每项价值1076美元的购买力平价无条件现金转移、为期五周的心理治疗计划，以及这两种干预措施联合使用的经济和心理效应。干预措施实施一年后，接受现金转移的人群在消费、资产持有量和收入方面表现更好，心理幸福感也高于对照组家庭。相比之下，心理治疗计划对心理或经济结果都没有明显影响，无论这些个体在基线时是否有不良心理健康问题。联合治疗的效应与单独实施现金转移的效果相似。

abstract.text: We analyze the tone of COVID-19 related English-language news articles written since January 1, 2020. Ninety one percent of stories by U.S. major media outlets are negative in tone versus fifty four percent for non-U.S. major sources and sixty five percent for scientific journals. The negativity of the U.S. major media is notable even in areas with positive scientific developments including school re-openings and vaccine trials. Media negativity is unresponsive to changing trends in new COVID-19 cases or the political leanings of the audience. U.S. major media readers strongly prefer negative stories about COVID-19, and negative stories in general. Stories of increasing COVID-19 cases outnumber stories of decreasing cases by a factor of 5.5 even during periods when new cases are declining. Among U.S. major media outlets, stories discussing President Donald Trump and hydroxychloroquine are more numerous than all stories combined that cover companies and individual researchers working on COVID-19 vaccines.

10.3386/w28110.abstractZh: 我们分析了自2020年1月1日以来撰写的与COVID-19相关的英文新闻文章的语气。美国主要媒体机构91%的新闻文章语气消极，而非美国主要媒体机构的这一比例为54%，科学期刊的这一比例为65%。即使是在科学进展积极的领域，如学校重新开放和疫苗试验方面，美国主要媒体的消极态度仍然明显。媒体的消极态度并未对COVID-19新病例数量的变化或受众的政治倾向作出反应。美国主要媒体的读者强烈偏好关于COVID-19的消极报道，以及整体上的消极报道。在COVID-19病例数量上升的时期，关于病例数量下降的报道数量比病例数量上升的报道少5.5倍。在美国主要媒体机构中，讨论唐纳德·特朗普总统和羟氯喹的报道数量，超过了所有报道该公司和个人研究人员在研发COVID-19疫苗的相关报道的总和。

abstract.text: It is sometimes said that an effect of the COVID-19 pandemic will be heightened appreciation of the importance of scientific research and expertise. We test this hypothesis by examining how exposure to previous epidemics affected trust in science and scientists. Building on the “impressionable years hypothesis” that attitudes are durably formed during the ages 18 to 25, we focus on individuals exposed to epidemics in their country of residence at this particular stage of the life course. Combining data from a 2018 Wellcome Trust survey of more than 75,000 individuals in 138 countries with data on global epidemics since 1970, we show that such exposure has no impact on views of science as an endeavor but that it significantly reduces trust in scientists and in the benefits of their work. We also illustrate that the decline in trust is driven by the individuals with little previous training in science subjects. Finally, our evidence suggests that epidemic-induced distrust translates into lower compliance with health-related policies in the form of negative views towards vaccines and lower rates of child vaccination.

10.3386/w28112.abstractZh: 有观点认为，COVID-19大流行的一个影响是人们对科学研究和专业知识重要性的认识得到了提升。我们通过研究个人在生命历程中的特定阶段，是否曾经历过疫情，来检验这一假设。基于“易受影响年代假说”，即态度在18至25岁期间会形成，我们重点关注那些在生命历程中的这一特定阶段，曾在其国家经历过疫情的人。结合2018年Wellcome Trust对138个国家超过75,000人的调查数据，以及自1970年以来全球疫情的数据，我们发现这种经历对科学作为一种事业的态度没有影响，但显著降低了人们对科学家的信任，以及对他们工作成果的信任。此外，我们还发现，信任的下降主要出现在那些之前没有接受过科学训练的人群中。最后，我们的证据表明，由于疫情引发的不信任，人们在对疫苗的负面看法以及儿童疫苗接种率方面，对健康相关政策的遵守程度降低。

abstract.text: We investigated the effects of the timing of early prenatal care on infant health by exploiting a reform that required expectant mothers to initiate prenatal care during the first ten weeks of gestation to obtain a one-time monetary transfer paid after childbirth. Applying a difference-in-differences design to individual-level data on the population of births and fetal deaths, we identified small but statistically significant positive effects of the policy on neonatal health. We further provide suggestive evidence that improved maternal health-related knowledge and behaviors during pregnancy are plausible channels through which the reform might have affected fetal health.

10.3386/w28116.abstractZh: 我们通过一项改革来研究早期产前护理时机对婴儿健康的影响。该改革要求孕妇在妊娠前十周内开始接受产前护理，并在分娩后获得一次性现金补助。利用关于出生和胎儿死亡个体层面的数据，采用差异-差异设计方法进行分析，我们发现该政策对新生儿健康产生了虽微小但具有统计学意义的积极影响。此外，我们的研究还提供了一些线索，表明在怀孕期间提高孕妇的健康相关知识和行为可能是该改革影响胎儿健康的合理途径。

abstract.text: Policymakers everywhere are working to determine the set of restrictions that will effectively contain the spread of COVID-19 without excessively stifling economic activity. We show that publicly available data on human mobility — collected by Google, Facebook, and other providers — can be used to evaluate the effectiveness of non-pharmaceutical interventions and forecast the spread of COVID-19. This approach relies on simple and transparent statistical models, and involves minimal assumptions about disease dynamics. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach using local and regional data from China, France, Italy, South Korea, and the United States, as well as national data from 80 countries around the world.

10.3386/w28120.abstractZh: 世界各地的政策制定者正在努力确定能够有效遏制COVID-19传播的同时不过度抑制经济活动的限制措施。我们指出，通过谷歌、Facebook等机构收集的人类流动数据可以用来评估非药物干预措施的有效性，并预测COVID-19的传播情况。这种方法依赖于简单且透明的统计模型，对疾病动态的假设极少。我们通过中国、法国、意大利、韩国和美国的本地及区域数据，以及全球80个国家的国家数据，证明了这种方法的有效性。

abstract.text: Over the past four decades, more than 2,300 people have been the victims of mass shootings involving a firearm in the United States. Research shows that mass shootings have significant detrimental effects on the direct victims and their families. However, relatively little is known about the extent to which the impacts of these tragedies are transmitted into communities where they occur, and how they influence people beyond those directly affected. This study uses nationally representative data from the Gallup-Healthways survey to assess the spillover effects of mass shootings on community wellbeing and emotional health outcomes that capture community satisfaction, sense of safety, and levels of stress and worry. We leverage differences in the timing of mass shooting events across counties between 2008 and 2017. We find that mass shootings reduce both community wellbeing and emotional health. According to our results, a mass shooting is associated with a 27 percentage point decline in the likelihood of having excellent community wellbeing and a 13 percentage point decline in the likelihood of having excellent emotional health four weeks following the incident. The effects are stronger and longer lasting among individuals exposed to deadlier mass shootings. Furthermore, the reductions in wellbeing are greater for parents with children below age 18. Our findings suggest that mass shootings have significant societal costs and create negative spillover effects that extend beyond those immediately exposed.

10.3386/w28122.abstractZh: 在过去的四十年里，美国有超过2,300人成为枪击事件的受害者。研究表明，大规模枪击事件对直接受害者及其家庭产生了显著的负面影响。然而，关于这些悲剧的影响在多大程度上传播到发生这些事件的社区，以及它们如何影响那些未直接受影响的人的情况，我们知之甚少。本研究利用盖洛普-健康之路调查中的全国代表性数据，评估大规模枪击事件对社区福祉和情绪健康结果的溢出效应，这些结果包括社区满意度、安全感以及压力与担忧水平。我们利用了2008年至2017年间各县大规模枪击事件发生时间的差异来进行分析。研究发现，大规模枪击事件会降低社区的福祉和情绪健康水平。根据我们的研究结果，大规模枪击事件发生后四周，社区福祉的优良程度会下降27个百分点，情绪健康的优良程度则会下降13个百分点。对于那些遭遇更致命的大规模枪击事件的个体来说，这种影响更为严重且持续时间更长。此外，对于子女未满18岁的父母来说，福祉的下降幅度更大。我们的研究结果表明，大规模枪击事件不仅给个人带来损失，还会产生负面的社会影响，这些影响会超出直接受害者范围，波及更广泛的社区。

abstract.text: We provide an estimate of the value of a cure using the joint behavior of stock prices and a vaccine progress indicator during the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic. Our indicator is based on the chronology of stage-by-stage progress of individual vaccines and related news. We construct a general equilibrium regime-switching model of repeated pandemics and stages of vaccine progress wherein the representative agent withdraws labor and alters consumption endogenously to mitigate health risk. The value of a cure in the resulting asset-pricing framework is intimately linked to the relative labor supply across states. The observed stock market response to vaccine progress serves to identify this quantity, allowing us to use the model to estimate the economy-wide welfare gain that would be attributable to a cure. In our estimation, and with standard preference parameters, the value of the ability to end the pandemic is worth 5-15% of total wealth. This value rises substantially when there is uncertainty about the frequency and duration of pandemics. Agents place almost as much value on the ability to resolve the uncertainty as they do on the value of the cure itself. This effect is stronger – not weaker – when agents have a preference for later resolution of uncertainty. The policy implication is that understanding the fundamental biological and social determinants of future pandemics may be as important as resolving the immediate crisis.

10.3386/w28127.abstractZh: 我们利用股票价格与疫苗进展指标的联合行为，对治愈措施的价值进行了估算。我们的指标基于各疫苗进展阶段的时间顺序及相关新闻。我们构建了一个关于反复出现的大流行病和疫苗进展阶段的通用均衡机制模型，其中代表性代理人通过撤回劳动和内生性地调整消费来减轻健康风险。在由此产生的资产定价框架中，治愈措施的价值与各状态之间的相对劳动力供应密切相关。观察到的股市对疫苗进展的反应有助于确定这一数值，使我们能够利用该模型估算治愈措施所带来的整体经济福利提升。在我们的估算中，以标准偏好参数为基础，结束大流行的能力价值相当于总财富的5-15%。当对大流行的频率和持续时间存在不确定性时，这一数值会显著上升。代理人对解决不确定性的重视程度几乎与对治愈措施本身的价值一样高。当代理人更倾向于推迟解决不确定性时，这种效应更为明显，而非减弱。政策上的启示是，理解未来大流行的根本生物和社会决定因素可能与解决当前危机同样重要。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic has forced federal, state and local policymakers to respond by legislating, enacting, and enforcing social distancing policies. However, the impact of these policies on healthcare utilization in the United States has been largely unexplored. We examine the impact of county-level shelter in place ordinances on healthcare utilization using two unique datasets—employer-sponsored insurance for over 6 million people in the US and cell phone location data. We find that introduction of these policies was associated with reductions in the use of preventive care, elective care, and the number of weekly visits to physician offices and hospitals. However, controlling for county-level exposure to the COVID-19 pandemic reduces the impact of these policies. Our results imply that while social distancing policies do lead to reductions in healthcare utilization, much of these reductions would have occurred even in the absence of these policies.

10.3386/w28131.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情迫使联邦、州和地方政府决策者通过立法、制定和执行社交距离政策来应对。然而，这些政策对美国医疗服务的利用影响尚未得到充分研究。我们利用两个独特的数据集来研究县级居家令对医疗服务利用的影响：美国超过600万人的雇主赞助保险数据以及手机位置数据。研究发现，这些政策的实施与预防性护理、选择性护理以及每周前往医生诊所和医院的次数减少有关。然而，通过控制县级地区对COVID-19疫情的暴露情况，这些政策的影响得到了减弱。我们的结果表明，虽然社交距离政策确实导致了医疗服务利用的减少，但其中大部分减少现象即便在没有这些政策的情况下也会发生。

abstract.text: We combined smartphone mobility data with census track-based reports of positive case counts to study a coronavirus outbreak at the University of Wisconsin-Madison campus, where nearly three thousand students had become infected by the end of September 2020. We identified a cluster of twenty bars located at the epicenter of the outbreak, in close proximity to on-campus residence halls and off-campus housing. Smartphones originating from the two hardest hit residence halls (Sellery and Witte), where about one in five students were infected, were 2.95 times more likely to visit the 20-bar cluster than smartphones originating in two more distant, less affected residence halls (Ogg and Smith). By contrast, smartphones from Sellery-Witte were only 1.55 times more likely than those from Ogg-Smith to visit a group of 68 restaurants in the same area. Physical proximity thus had a much stronger influence on bar visitation than on restaurant visitation (rate ratio 1.91, 95% CI 1.29-2.85, p = 0.0007). In a separate analysis, we determined the per-capita rates of visitation to the 20-bar cluster and to the 68-restaurant comparison group by smartphones originating in each of 19 census tracts in the university area, and related these visitation rates to the per-capita incidence of newly positive coronavirus tests in each census tract. In a multivariate regression, the visitation rate to the bar cluster was a significant determinant of infection rates (elasticity 0.90, 95% CI 0.26-1.54, p = 0.009), while the restaurant visitation rate showed no such relationship. Researchers and public health professionals need to think more about the potential super-spreader effects of clusters and networks of places, rather than individual sites.

10.3386/w28132.abstractZh: 我们将智能手机移动数据与基于人口普查的阳性病例报告相结合，研究了威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校校园内的冠状病毒疫情。截至2020年9月底，近三千名学生被感染。我们发现，疫情的中心区域有一组二十家酒吧，这些酒吧距离校园内的宿舍和校外住房非常近。来自两个受影响最严重的宿舍（Sellery和Witte）的智能手机，访问这二十家酒吧的频率是来自另外两个较偏远、受影响较小的宿舍（Ogg和Smith）的智能手机的2.95倍。相比之下，来自Sellery-Witte的智能手机访问同一区域68家餐厅的频率仅比来自Ogg-Smith的智能手机高1.55倍。因此，地理位置对酒吧访问的影响远大于对餐厅访问的影响（比率比为1.91，95%置信区间为1.29-2.85，p=0.0007）。在另一项分析中，我们确定了来自大学区域内19个普查区的智能手机访问这二十家酒吧和68家餐厅的群体的人均频率，并将这些访问频率与每个普查区新出现的冠状病毒阳性测试人数相关联。在多元回归分析中，访问酒吧群体的频率是感染率的重要决定因素（弹性为0.90，95%置信区间为0.26-1.54，p=0.009），而餐厅访问频率则没有显示出这样的关系。研究人员和公共卫生专家需要更多地考虑群体和场所网络的潜在超级传播效应，而不仅仅是单个地点。

abstract.text: Contact tracing for COVID-19 is especially challenging because transmission often occurs in the absence of symptoms and because a purported 20% of cases cause 80% of infections, resulting in a small risk of infection for some contacts and a high risk for others. Here, we introduce risk-based quarantine, a system for contact tracing where each cluster (a group of individuals with a common source of exposure) is observed for symptoms when tracing begins, and clusters that do not display them are released from quarantine. We show that, under our assumptions, risk-based quarantine reduces the amount of quarantine time served by more than 30%, while achieving a reduction in transmission similar to standard contact tracing policies where all contacts are quarantined for two weeks. We compare our proposed risk-based quarantine approach against test-driven release policies, which fail to achieve a comparable level of transmission reduction due to the inability of tests to detect exposed people who are not yet infectious but will eventually become so. Additionally, test-based release policies are expensive, limiting their effectiveness in low-resource environments, whereas the costs imposed by risk-based quarantine are primarily in terms of labor and organization.

10.3386/w28135.abstractZh: 针对COVID-19的接触追踪尤其具有挑战性，因为传播往往在没有症状的情况下发生，而且据称有20%的病例导致了80%的感染，这使得某些接触者的感染风险较低，而其他人则面临较高的感染风险。在这里，我们介绍了基于风险的隔离措施，这是一种接触追踪系统，在追踪开始时，每个群体（具有共同暴露源的一组个体）的症状都会被观察，而那些没有症状的人群则会被解除隔离。根据我们的假设，基于风险的隔离措施可以将隔离时间减少30%以上，同时实现与标准接触追踪政策相似的传播减少效果，后者要求所有接触者进行两周的隔离。我们将我们提出的基于风险的隔离措施与以检测结果为依据的释放政策进行了比较，后者由于无法检测到尚未感染但最终会感染的暴露者，因此无法达到类似的传播减少效果。此外，基于检测的释放政策成本高昂，限制了其在资源匮乏环境中的有效性，而基于风险的隔离措施的成本主要体现在劳动力和组织管理方面。

abstract.text: We examine how 17 behavioral biases relate to each other, to other decision inputs, and to decision outputs. Most consumers exhibit multiple biases in our nationally representative panel data. There is substantial heterogeneity across consumers, even within similar demographic/skill groups. Biases are positively correlated within person, especially after adjusting for measurement error, and less correlated with other inputs—risk aversion, patience, cognitive skills, and personality traits—with some expected exceptions. Accounting for this correlation structure, we reduce our 29 decision inputs to eight common factors. Seven common factors load on at least two biases, six on clusters of theoretically related biases, and two or three are distinctly behavioral. All but one common factor is distinct from cognitive skills. Factor scores strongly conditionally correlate with decisions and outcomes in various domains. We discuss several potential implications of this taxonomy for various approaches to modeling influences of behavioral biases on decision making.

10.3386/w28138.abstractZh: 我们研究了17种行为偏差之间如何相互关联，以及它们与其他决策输入和决策结果之间的关系。在我们具有全国代表性的样本数据中，大多数消费者表现出多种偏差。即使在同一类人口统计或技能群体中，不同消费者的偏差也存在显著的异质性。这些偏差在个体内部呈正相关，尤其是在调整了测量误差之后；与其他输入因素——如风险厌恶、耐心、认知技能和人格特质——的关联程度较低，但也有一些预期的例外情况。考虑到这种相关性结构，我们将29个决策输入因素简化为8个共同因素。其中7个共同因素至少与两种偏差相关，6个共同因素与理论上的相关偏差群相关，还有2到3个因素明显属于行为范畴。除了一个共同因素外，其余因素都与认知技能无关。这些因素得分在不同领域中的决策结果中表现出强烈的条件相关性。我们讨论了这种分类方法对建模行为偏差对决策影响的各种方法的潜在影响。

abstract.text: For much of 2020, the COVID-19 epidemic upended social and economic life globally. In an effort to reduce COVID-19 risks in the U.S., state and local governments issued many recommendations and regulations to induce social distancing, adding to voluntary reductions in interpersonal contact. The responses to the epidemic helped contain spread, but also lead to high unintended societal costs. In the summer months, states took steps to revive the economy and lift social distancing regulations. However, as many epidemiologists expected, the scale of the epidemic has expanded very rapidly in the fall. In the week of October 14, the US generated around 57,000 new COVID-19 cases and 700 deaths each day. By November 15, the country was generating about 151,000 new cases and 1,200 deaths per day. These rapid increases in cases and deaths raise concerns about the capacity of local healthcare systems around the country. State governments are once again facing difficult choices about whether and how to use policies to address the spread of the virus. The incoming Biden-Harris administration faces an important challenge in trying to manage the epidemic as well as a large scale vaccination campaign. Although the epidemic is less than a year old, it has generated a huge volume of research by economists, epidemiologists, and others. This body of work may help inform policy decisions facing society in the coming months. In this paper, we make five broad contributions. First, we provide a concise review of economic and social science research on mobility patterns, labor market outcomes, consumer behavior, and population health during the first phase of the epidemic. Second, we sketch a simple microeconomic model that may be useful considering the determinants of social distancing and the role of different policy instruments in promoting distancing. Third, we present a simple typology of the policies that were used at the state and county levels during the closure and re-opening phases of the epidemic in the U.S.. Fourth, we review a collection of new data sources that have played an important role in monitoring and analyzing population behavior this year. Fifth, we present results from event study regressions that try to disentangle private vs. policy-induced changes in mobility patterns during the early part of the epidemic.

10.3386/w28139.abstractZh: 在2020年的大部分时间里，COVID-19疫情在全球范围内颠覆了社会和经济生活。为了降低美国的COVID-19风险，州和地方政府发布了许多建议和法规，以鼓励社交距离，从而进一步减少了人际接触。对疫情的反应有助于控制疫情的传播，但也导致了高昂的意外社会成本。夏季，各州采取措施振兴经济并解除社交距离限制。然而，正如许多流行病学家所预料的那样，秋季疫情规模迅速扩大。10月14日那一周，美国每天新增约57,000例COVID-19病例和700例死亡病例。到11月15日，该国每天新增约151,000例病例和1,200例死亡病例。这些病例和死亡人数的迅速增加引发了人们对全国当地医疗系统能力的担忧。州政府再次面临艰难的选择，即是否以及如何使用政策来应对病毒的传播。即将上任的拜登-哈里斯政府面临着管理疫情以及大规模疫苗接种活动的重大挑战。尽管疫情还不到一年，但经济学家、流行病学家和其他人士已经进行了大量研究。这些研究成果可能有助于为未来几个月的社会政策决策提供参考。在本文中，我们提出了五个方面的贡献。首先，我们对疫情初期关于流动模式、劳动力市场结果、消费者行为和人口健康方面的经济和社会科学研究进行了简要回顾。其次，我们构建了一个简单的微观经济模型，该模型有助于理解社会隔离的决定因素以及不同政策工具在促进隔离措施中的作用。第三，我们提出了一种简单的政策分类体系，涵盖了美国疫情封锁和重新开放阶段在州和县层面实施的政策。第四，我们回顾了今年在监测和分析人群行为方面发挥重要作用的一系列新数据来源。第五，我们通过事件研究回归分析，试图区分疫情早期私人因素与政策因素对出行模式的影响。

abstract.text: The growth of health care spending has been a longstanding policy concern. Over the years, several innovations have been proposed to lower levels of health care spending; however, their impact has been limited and not sustained over time. Costly new technology, while often an improvement to existing care, has been identified as a principal driver of health care spending growth. Recent literature has shown that high deductible health plans (HDHP) can have an immediate impact on levels of health care spending, but their medium- and long-run effects on spending growth remain unknown. In this paper, we use multiple-employer-group claims data from a large national insurer to (i) study whether HDHPs reduce the growth in spending over four years compared to lower deductible alternatives; and (ii) explore the mechanisms behind any reductions in growth by looking at whether HDHPs reduce the use of low- vs. high-value treatments. We find that HDHPs have a limited effect on spending growth, with a statistically significant reduction observed only for prescription drugs. HDHPs are not associated with significantly lower growth in spending on highly cost-effective medicines in a sample of drugs but do reduce spending growth for less cost-effective drugs.
