10.3386/w28155.abstractZh: 医疗支出的增长一直是一个长期的政策关注点。多年来，人们提出了多种创新措施来降低医疗支出水平，但这些措施的效果有限，且无法持续。虽然昂贵的新技术通常能改善现有的医疗服务，但它们也被认为是医疗支出增长的主要驱动因素。最近的文献表明，高免赔额健康计划能够立即影响医疗支出水平，但其对支出增长的长期影响仍不清楚。在本文中，我们利用一家大型全国保险公司的多雇主群体索赔数据，来研究：(i) 高免赔额健康计划是否能在四年时间内减少支出增长，与低免赔额方案相比；(ii) 通过研究高免赔额健康计划是否减少了低价值治疗与高价值治疗的使用，来探讨其减少支出增长的机制。我们发现，高免赔额健康计划对支出增长的影响有限，只有处方药的使用量出现了显著的减少。在部分药物中，高免赔额健康计划并未导致高成本效益药物的支出增长显著下降，但确实减少了低成本效益药物的支出增长。

abstract.text: The concentration of healthcare spending at the end of life is widely documented but poorly understood. To gain insight, we focus on patients newly diagnosed with cancer. They display the familiar pattern: even among cancer patients with similar initial prognoses, monthly spending in the year post diagnosis is over twice as high for those who die within the year than those who survive. This elevated spending on decedents is almost entirely driven by higher inpatient spending, particularly low-intensity admissions, which rise as the prognosis deteriorates. However, even for patients with very poor prognoses at the time of admission, most low-intensity admissions do not result in death, making it difficult to target spending reductions. We also find that among patients with the same cancer type and initial prognosis, end-of-life spending is substantially more elevated for younger patients compared to older patients, suggesting that treatment decisions are not exclusively present-focused. Taken together, these results provide a richer understanding of the sources of high end-of-life spending, without revealing any natural “remedies.”

10.3386/w28162.abstractZh: 关于临终阶段医疗支出的集中现象已有大量文献记载，但对其成因的理解却较为有限。为了深入了解这一现象，我们重点关注新诊断为癌症的患者。研究发现，即使是在初始预后相似的癌症患者中，诊断后一年内的月度医疗支出，对于在一年内去世的患者来说，是存活患者的两倍以上。这种针对逝者的高支出几乎完全由住院治疗的增加所驱动，尤其是低强度住院治疗的增加，这种趋势随着预后的恶化而加剧。然而，即使是在入院时预后非常差的患者中，大多数低强度住院治疗也不会导致死亡，因此很难针对性地减少相关支出。此外，研究发现，对于具有相同癌症类型和初始预后的患者，临终阶段的支出在年轻患者中明显高于老年患者，这表明治疗决策并不仅仅以生存结果为导向。综合这些研究结果，我们可以更全面地理解临终阶段高支出产生的原因，但并未发现任何自然的“解决方案”。

abstract.text: Racial, ethnic, and gender minorities face mental health disparities. While mental health care can help, minoritized groups could face discriminatory barriers in accessing it. Discrimination may be particularly pronounced in mental health care because providers have more discretion over accepting patients. Research documents discrimination broadly, including in access to health care, but there is limited empirical research on discrimination in access to mental health care. We provide the first experimental evidence, from a correspondence audit field experiment (“simulated patients” study), of the extent to which transgender and non-binary people, African Americans, and Hispanics face discrimination in access to mental health care appointments. We find significant discrimination against transgender or non-binary African Americans and Hispanics. We do not find evidence of discrimination against White transgender and non-binary prospective patients. We are mostly inconclusive as to if cisgender African Americans or Hispanics face discrimination, except we find evidence of discrimination against cisgender African American women.

10.3386/w28164.abstractZh: 种族、民族和性别少数群体在心理健康方面面临差异。虽然心理健康服务可以提供帮助，但少数群体在获取这些服务时可能会遇到歧视障碍。在心理健康服务领域，歧视可能尤为明显，因为服务提供者在接纳患者方面拥有更大的自主权。研究表明，歧视现象普遍存在，包括在获得医疗服务方面的歧视，但关于在获得心理健康服务方面歧视的实证研究相对较少。我们首次通过一项对应性审计实地实验（“模拟患者”研究）提供了实证证据，证明跨性别者和非二元性别者、非裔美国人和西班牙裔人在预约心理健康服务时面临歧视。我们发现，跨性别或非二元性别的非裔美国人和西班牙裔人面临显著歧视。我们没有发现对白人跨性别者和非二元性别者的歧视证据。关于顺性别非裔美国人或西班牙裔人是否面临歧视的问题，我们的研究结果并不明确，不过我们发现顺性别非裔美国女性面临歧视。

abstract.text: Missed clinic appointments present a significant burden to health care through disruption of care, inefficient use of staff time and wasted clinical resources. Short message service (SMS) appointment reminders show promise to improve clinics’ management through timely appointment cancellations and efficient re-scheduling, but evidence from large-scale interventions is missing. We study a nationwide SMS appointment reminder program in Chile for chronic disease patients at public primary care clinics. Using longitudinal clinic-level data we find that after two years the program increased clinics’ total number of visits per by 5.1% on average. The program did not change the number of visits by chronic patients eligible to receive the reminder, but it instead increased visits by other patients, ineligible to receive reminders in clinics that adopted the program by 7.4% on average. These results suggest that the appointment reminder systems increased clinics’ ability to care for more patients through timely cancellations and re-scheduling.

10.3386/w28166.abstractZh: 错过诊所预约会给医疗保健带来重大负担，包括护理中断、人员时间利用效率低下以及临床资源的浪费。短信预约提醒系统有望通过及时取消预约和高效重新安排预约来改善诊所的管理，但关于大规模干预效果的研究尚缺乏。我们研究了智利一项针对公共初级保健诊所中慢性病患者实施的全国性短信预约提醒计划。通过纵向诊所级数据分析发现，两年后该计划使诊所的总就诊次数平均增加了5.1%。该计划并未改变有资格接收提醒服务的慢性患者的就诊次数，反而使未具备资格的其他患者的就诊次数在采用该计划的诊所中平均增加了7.4%。这些结果表明，预约提醒系统通过及时取消和重新安排预约，提升了诊所照顾更多患者的能力。

abstract.text: Advance market commitments (AMCs) provide a mechanism to stimulate investment by suppliers of products to low-income countries. In an AMC, donors commit to a fund from which a specified subsidy is paid per unit purchased by low-income countries until the fund is exhausted, strengthening suppliers' incentives to invest in research, development, and capacity. Last decade saw the launch of a $1.5 billion pilot AMC to distribute pneumococcal vaccine to the developing world; in the current pandemic, variations on AMCs are being used to fund Covid-19 vaccines. This paper undertakes the first formal analysis of AMCs. We construct a model in which an altruistic donor negotiates on behalf of a low-income country with a vaccine supplier after the supplier has sunk investments. We use this model to explain the logic of an AMC—as a solution to a hold-up problem—and to analyze alternative design features under various economic conditions (cost uncertainty, supplier competition). A key finding is that optimal AMC design differs markedly depending on where the product is in its development cycle.

10.3386/w28168.abstractZh: 市场预先承诺机制为向低收入国家提供产品的供应商提供了刺激投资的机制。在市场中，捐助方承诺从某个基金中拨款，按照低收入国家每购买一单位产品支付一定的补贴，直至基金耗尽，从而增强供应商在研发和产能建设方面的投资动力。过去十年，一项价值15亿美元的试点市场预先承诺机制被启动，用于向发展中国家分发肺炎疫苗；在当前的大流行期间，市场预先承诺机制被用于资助新冠疫苗的研发。本文首次对市场预先承诺机制进行了正式分析。我们构建了一个模型，其中一位利他的捐助方代表低收入国家与疫苗供应商进行谈判，尤其是在供应商已投入大量资金之后。我们利用该模型来解释市场预先承诺机制作为解决延迟支付问题的逻辑，并分析在不同经济条件下（如成本不确定性和供应商竞争）该机制的替代设计特征。一个关键发现是，最优的市场预先承诺机制设计因产品所处的发展阶段而异。

abstract.text: The profitability of life insurance offerings is contingent on accurate projections and pricing of mortality risk. The COVID-19 pandemic created significant uncertainty, with dire mortality predictions from early forecasts resulting in widespread government intervention and greater individual precaution that reduced the projected death toll. We analyze how life insurance companies changed pricing and offerings in response to COVID-19 using monthly data on term life insurance policies from Compulife. We estimate event-study models that exploit well-established variation in the COVID-19 mortality rate based on age and underlying health status. Despite the increase in mortality risk and significant uncertainty, we find limited evidence that life insurance companies increased premiums or decreased policy offerings due to COVID-19.

10.3386/w28172.abstractZh: 人寿保险产品的盈利能力取决于对死亡风险的准确预测和定价。COVID-19疫情带来了巨大的不确定性，早期预测中严重的死亡人数预计导致政府广泛干预，同时个人也采取了更多的预防措施，从而降低了预计的死亡人数。我们使用Compulife提供的定期人寿保险政策的月度数据，分析人寿保险公司如何因COVID-19而调整定价和产品供应。我们建立了事件研究模型，利用基于年龄和基础健康状况的COVID-19死亡率的已知差异来进行分析。尽管死亡风险增加且不确定性显著，但我们发现几乎没有证据表明人寿保险公司因COVID-19而提高保费或减少产品供应。

abstract.text: Tobacco 21 (T-21) laws prohibit the sale of tobacco products to individuals under age 21. This study is the first to comprehensively examine the impacts of statewide T-21 laws on youth tobacco consumption, including spillovers to minor teens. Using data from the 2009-2019 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance Survey (BRFSS) and a difference-in-differences approach, we find that the enactment of a statewide T-21 law was associated with a 2.5 to 3.9 percentage-point decline in smoking participation among 18-to-20-year-olds. A causal interpretation of our estimates is supported by event-study analyses and falsification tests for young adults ages 21 and older. Next, using data from the 2009-2019 State Youth Risky Behavior Surveys (YRBS), we find that statewide T-21 laws reduced tobacco cigarette and electronic cigarette (e-cigarette) consumption among 18-year-old high school students. However, descriptive evidence suggests that the negative impact of T-21 laws on e-cigarette use among 18-year-olds may be partially blunted by an increase in borrowing e-cigarettes from others. Finally, we find that T-21 laws generate important spillovers including (i) a reduction in tobacco cigarette use among 16-to-17-year-olds, a group that relies heavily on the “social market” — including 18-year-old peers — to access tobacco, and (ii) reductions in both marijuana use and frequency of alcohol consumption among older teenagers.

10.3386/w28173.abstractZh: Tobacco 21（T-21）法律禁止向21岁以下的人销售烟草产品。本研究首次全面探讨了州级T-21法律对青少年烟草消费的影响，包括其对未成年青少年的溢出效应。通过2009-2019年行为风险因素监测调查的数据以及差异-差异方法分析，我们发现州级T-21法律的实施导致18至20岁青少年的吸烟参与率下降了2.5至3.9个百分点。对我们的估计结果进行因果解释得到了事件研究分析和21岁及以上年轻人的虚假测试的支持。接下来，通过2009-2019年州青少年危险行为调查的数据，我们发现州级T-21法律减少了18岁高中生的烟草香烟和电子香烟消费。然而，描述性证据表明，T-21法律对18岁青少年电子香烟使用的负面影响可能因从他人那里借用电子香烟而部分减弱。最后，我们发现T-21法律产生了重要的溢出效应，包括：(i) 16至17岁青少年中的烟草香烟使用减少，这一群体严重依赖“社交市场”——包括18岁的同龄人——来获取烟草；(ii) 较年长的青少年中的大麻使用和酒精消费频率减少。

abstract.text: We analyze the role of international trade and health coordination in times of a pandemic by building a two-economy, two-good trade model integrated into a micro-founded SIR model of infection dynamics. Uncoordinated governments with national mandates can adopt (i) containment policies to suppress infection spread domestically, and (ii) (import) tariffs to prevent infection coming from abroad. The efficient, i.e., coordinated, risk-sharing arrangement dynamically adjusts both policy instruments to share infection and economic risks internationally. However, in Nash equilibrium, uncoordinated trade policies robustly feature inefficiently high tariffs that peak with the pandemic in the foreign economy. This distorts terms of trade dynamics and magnifies the welfare costs of tariff wars during a pandemic due to lower levels of consumption and production as well as smaller gains via diversification of infection curves across economies.

10.3386/w28176.abstractZh: 我们通过分析一个包含两个经济体、两种商品的贸易模型，并将其整合到基于微观数据的感染动态模型中，来研究国际贸易与卫生协调在疫情时期的作用。缺乏协调的政府可以通过实施（i）国内封锁政策以抑制感染扩散，以及（ii）（进口）关税来防止来自国外的感染。高效、即协调的风险分担安排会动态调整这两种政策工具，以在国际层面上分担感染和经济风险。然而，在纳什均衡状态下，缺乏协调的贸易政策会导致效率极低的高关税，这些关税在疫情期间会在外国经济中达到峰值。这扭曲了贸易条件动态，并因消费和生产水平下降以及通过分散感染曲线来减少损失的效果减弱，从而加剧了疫情期间的关税战争带来的福利损失。

abstract.text: In March 2020, the International Comparison Project published its latest results, for the calendar year 2017. This round presents common-unit or purchasing-power-parity data for 137 countries on Gross Domestic Product and its components. We review a number of important issues, what is new, what is not new, and what the new data can and cannot do. Of great importance is the lack of news, that the results are broadly in line with earlier results from 2011. We consider the relationship between national accounts measures and health, particularly in light of the COVID-19 epidemic which may reduce global inequality, even as it increases inequality within countries. We emphasize things that GDP cannot do, some familiar—like its silence on distribution—and some less familiar—including its increasing detachment from national material wellbeing in a globalized world where international transfers of capital and property rights can have enormous effects on GDP, such as the 26 percent increase in Ireland’s GDP in 2015.

10.3386/w28177.abstractZh: 2020年3月，国际比较项目发布了2017年日历年的最新结果。这一轮数据提供了137个国家的国内生产总值及其组成部分的通用单位或购买力平价数据。我们回顾了一些重要问题，包括新内容、不新的内容，以及新数据能够或不能做到的事情。值得注意的是，这些结果与2011年的结果大体一致，没有新的变化。我们探讨了国民账户指标与健康之间的关系，特别是在COVID-19疫情背景下，虽然疫情可能减少全球不平等，但也会加剧国家内部的不平等。我们强调了GDP无法做到的事情，有些是众所周知的，比如它对分配问题的沉默；也有一些不太为人所知，包括在全球化世界中，由于国际资本和财产权的转移对GDP产生巨大影响，GDP与国民物质福祉之间的分离日益明显，例如2015年爱尔兰GDP增长了26%。

abstract.text: We measure organizational concentration—the distribution of a patient's healthcare across organizations—to examine how firm boundaries affect healthcare efficiency. First, when patients move to regions where outpatient visits are typically concentrated within a small set of firms, their healthcare utilization falls. Second, for patients whose PCPs exit the market, switching to a PCP with 1 standard deviation higher organizational concentration reduces utilization by 21%. This finding is robust to controlling for the spread of healthcare across providers. Increases in organizational concentration predict improvements in diabetes care and are not associated with greater use of emergency department or inpatient care.

10.3386/w28179.abstractZh: 我们测量了组织集中度——即患者医疗服务的分配情况——以研究企业边界如何影响医疗服务的效率。首先，当患者转移到门诊就诊通常集中在一小部分企业所在的地区时，他们的医疗服务利用率会下降。其次，对于那些初级保健医生退出市场的患者来说，更换到一个组织集中度高1个标准差的初级保健医生后，他们的医疗服务利用率降低了21%。这一发现在控制医疗服务在医疗服务提供者之间的分布后仍然成立。组织集中度的增加预示着糖尿病护理的改善，并且与急诊科或住院治疗的增加无关。

abstract.text: State and local governments throughout the United States attempted to mitigate the spread of Covid-19 using stay-at-home orders to limit social interactions and mobility. We study the economic impact of these orders and their optimal implementation in a fiscal union. Using an event study framework, we find that stay-at-home orders caused a 4 percentage point decrease in consumer spending and hours worked. These estimates suggest a $10 billion decrease in spending and $15 billion in lost earnings. We then develop an economic SIR model with multiple locations to study the optimal implementation of stay-at-home orders. From a national welfare perspective, the model suggests that it is optimal for locations with higher infection rates to set stricter mitigation policies. This occurs as a common, national policy is too restrictive for the economies of mildly infected areas and causes greater declines in consumption and hours worked than are optimal.

10.3386/w28182.abstractZh: 美国各地的州和地方政府试图通过实施居家令来减缓新冠病毒的传播，以限制社交互动和人员流动。我们研究了这些措施的经济影响以及在财政联盟框架下的最佳实施方式。通过事件研究框架的分析，我们发现居家令导致消费者支出和工作时间减少了4个百分点。这些估计表明，消费减少了100亿美元，收入损失了150亿美元。随后，我们建立了一个具有多个地点的经济SIR模型，以研究居家令的最佳实施方案。从国家福利的角度来看，该模型表明，感染率较高的地区应该采取更严格的缓解政策。这是因为，如果全国性的政策过于严格，可能会对轻度感染地区的经济造成更大的负面影响，导致消费和工作时间的减少超过最佳水平。

abstract.text: Many states’ scope of practice laws limit the ability of nurse practitioners to deliver care by requiring physician supervision of their practices and prescribing activities. A robust literature has evolved around examining the role of these scope of practice laws in various contexts, including labor market outcomes, healthcare access, healthcare prices, and the delivery of care for specific diseases. Unfortunately, these studies use different, and sometimes conflicting, measures of scope of practice laws, limiting their comparability and overall usefulness to policymakers and future researchers. We address this salient problem by providing a recommended coding of nurse practitioner scope of practice laws over a 24-year period based on actual statutory and regulatory language. Our classification of scope of practice laws solves an important problem within this growing literature and provides a solid legal foundation for researchers as they continue to investigate the effects of these laws.

10.3386/w28192.abstractZh: 许多州的执业范围法律限制了护士执业者提供护理服务的能力，这些法律要求护士的执业必须得到医生的监督，并规定其活动范围。关于这些执业范围法律在不同情境下的作用，已有大量研究，涉及劳动力市场结果、医疗服务的获取、医疗价格以及特定疾病的护理等方面。然而，这些研究使用不同的、有时甚至相互矛盾的执业范围法律衡量指标，这限制了它们的可比性，也影响了政策制定者和未来研究者的研究效果。我们为了解决这个问题，基于实际的法律法规，为24年期间的护士执业范围法律提供了推荐的分类方式。我们对执业范围法律的分类解决了这一领域日益增长的研究中的一个重要问题，并为研究人员继续研究这些法律的影响提供了坚实的法律基础。

abstract.text: We propose a dynamic production function of population health and mortality from birth onwards. Our parsimonious model provides an excellent fit for the mortality and survival curves for both primate and human populations since 1816. The model sheds light on the dynamics behind many phenomena documented in the literature, including (i) the existence and evolution of mortality gradients across socio-economic statuses, (ii) non-monotonic dynamic effects of in-utero shocks, (iii) persistent or “scarring” effects of wars and (iv) mortality displacement after large temporary shocks such as extreme weather.

10.3386/w28193.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个动态的生产函数，用于描述从出生开始的人口健康与死亡率变化。我们的简约模型能够很好地拟合自1816年以来灵长类动物和人类种群的死亡率和生存曲线。该模型揭示了文献中许多现象背后的动态机制，包括：(i) 不同社会经济地位下死亡率梯度的存在与演变；(ii) 子宫内冲击的非单调动态效应；(iii) 战争带来的持续性或“创伤性”影响；(iv) 极端天气等突发冲击后的死亡率变化。

abstract.text: At least one of every five marriages is consanguineous (between couples who are second cousins or closer) in the Middle East and North Africa, and the rate is higher than 50 percent in some parts of the world. Consanguineous marriage generates serious health problems for the offspring and constitutes an economic problem with its associated medical costs and the impact on human capital. The prevalence of consanguineous marriage and the resultant kinship networks can shape various dimensions of the society ranging from institutional structure to attitudes such as trust, individualism, and nepotism. Using data from Turkey and leveraging an education reform which increased mandatory schooling by three years, we find that the reform made women less likely to find consanguineous marriage as an acceptable practice, and that the reform reduced women’s propensity to marry a first cousin or a blood relative. Exposure to the reform altered women’s preferences in favor of personal autonomy. Women who are exposed to the reform are more likely to have met their husbands outside of family networks, they are less likely to get forced into marriage against their consent, and they are less likely to agree that only a son can ensure the continuation of the family blood line. These results indicate that educational attainment can alter behaviors and attitudes which may be rooted in culture.

10.3386/w28212.abstractZh: 在中东和北非地区，每五桩婚姻中至少有一桩是近亲婚姻（即发生在堂表亲或更近亲属之间的婚姻）。在某些地区，这一比例甚至超过50%。近亲婚姻会给后代带来严重的健康问题，同时也会造成经济上的负担，包括相关的医疗费用以及对人力资本的影响。近亲婚姻的普遍现象以及由此形成的亲属关系网络，会塑造社会的多个层面，从制度结构到诸如信任、个人主义以及裙带关系等观念。通过土耳其的数据以及一项将义务教育年限延长三年的教育改革，我们发现这项改革使得女性不太可能将近亲婚姻视为一种可接受的行为，同时也降低了女性与堂表亲或血缘亲属结婚的倾向。这项改革使得女性更倾向于追求个人自主权。接受该改革的女性更有可能在家族网络之外找到自己的丈夫，她们也不太可能被强迫结婚，同时她们也不太可能认为只有儿子才能确保家族血统的延续。这些结果表明，教育水平可以改变行为模式和观念，而这些因素可能根植于文化之中。

abstract.text: We use data from a large sample of adoptees born in Sweden to study to what extent the well-established association between parental educational attainments and adult health of the child generation can be attributed to pre- or post-birth factors, respectively. We find a significant association between the educational attainment of the adopting parents and child health outcomes as adults. These results suggest that growing up in a better-educated household has long-term effects on health outcomes. Our analysis of the mechanisms behind the results suggests that formation of human capital, and in particular cognitive and non-cognitive skills, may be important.

10.3386/w28214.abstractZh: 我们采用来自瑞典的大量收养家庭的数据，研究父母教育水平与子女成年后健康状况之间已确立的关联，在多大程度上可以归因于出生前的或出生后的因素。我们发现，收养父母的教育水平与子女成年后的健康结果之间存在显著关联。这些结果表明，成长在受教育程度较高的家庭中对健康结果有长期影响。我们对这些结果背后机制的分析表明，人力资本的形成，尤其是认知和非认知技能的形成，可能起着重要作用。

abstract.text: A growing literature points to children’s influence on parents’ behavior, including parental investments in children. Further, previous research has shown differential parental response by socioeconomic status to children's birth weight, cognitive ability, and school outcomes – all early life predictors of later socioeconomic success. This study considers an even earlier, more exogenous predictor of parental investments: offspring genotype. Specifically, we analyze (1) whether children’s genetic propensity towards educational success affects parenting during early childhood; and (2) whether parenting in response to children’s genetic propensity towards educational success is socially stratified. Using data from the Avon Longitudinal Survey of Parents and Children (N=7,738), we construct polygenic scores for educational attainment and regress cognitively stimulating parenting behavior during early childhood on these polygenic scores. We use a range of modeling strategies to address the concern that child’s genotype may be proxying unmeasured parent characteristics. Results show that parents provide more cognitive stimulation to children with higher education polygenic scores. This pattern varies by socioeconomic status with college-educated parents responding less to children’s genetic propensity towards educational success than non-college-educated parents do.

10.3386/w28217.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究指出，儿童对父母行为具有影响，包括父母对子女的投资。此外，先前的研究表明，不同社会经济地位的家庭对子女出生体重、认知能力和学校表现的反应存在差异——这些都是衡量后期社会经济成功的早期生命指标。本研究则关注一个更为早期且更外生的预测因素：后代的基因型。具体来说，我们分析了以下两个问题：（1）子女在教育上的遗传倾向是否会影响早期育儿行为；（2）子女在教育上的遗传倾向所引发的育儿行为是否存在社会分层现象。我们利用阿冯父母与子女纵向调查的数据（样本量7,738人），为教育成就构建多基因评分，并基于这些评分分析早期育儿行为中认知刺激因素的作用。我们采用多种建模策略来应对“子女的基因型可能代表未测量的父母特征”这一担忧。研究结果表明，父母对教育程度较高的子女提供的认知刺激更多。这一模式因社会经济地位而异，受过大学教育的父母对子女在教育上的遗传倾向的反应不如未受过大学教育的父母。

abstract.text: We show that social network exposure to COVID-19 cases shapes individuals’ beliefs and behaviors concerning the coronavirus. We use de-identified data from Facebook to document that individuals with friends in areas with worse COVID-19 outbreaks reduce their mobility more than otherwise similar individuals with friends in less affected areas. The effects are quantitatively large and long-lasting: a one standard deviation increase in friend-exposure to COVID-19 cases in March 2020 results in a 1.2 percentage point increase in the probability of staying home on a given day through at least the end of May 2020. As the pandemic progresses—and the characteristics of individuals with the highest friend-exposure vary— changes in friend-exposure continue to drive changes in social distancing behavior, ruling out many unobserved effects as drivers of our results. We also show that individuals with higher friend-exposure to COVID-19 are more likely to publicly post in support of social distancing measures and less likely to be members of groups advocating to "reopen" the economy. These findings suggest that friends can influence individuals’ beliefs about the risks of the disease and thereby induce them to engage in mitigating public health behavior.

10.3386/w28234.abstractZh: 我们指出，社交网络中对COVID-19病例的曝光程度会影响个人对冠状病毒的认知和行为。我们利用Facebook的去标识化数据发现，在COVID-19疫情较为严重的地区有朋友的人，其活动频率比在疫情较轻地区有朋友的人要低。这种影响是显著的且持久的：在2020年3月，朋友暴露于COVID-19病例的情况每增加一个标准差，人们在某一天至少待在家中的概率就会增加1.2个百分点，这一影响一直持续到2020年5月底。随着疫情的发展，以及那些有较高朋友暴露于COVID-19病例的人所具备的特征发生变化，朋友暴露程度的变化继续推动着社交距离行为的变化，从而排除了许多未被观察到的因素作为我们研究结果的驱动因素。我们还发现，那些有较高朋友暴露于COVID-19病例的人，更有可能公开支持社交距离措施，并且不太可能成为主张“重新开放经济”的团体成员。这些发现表明，朋友可以影响个人对疾病风险的认知，从而促使他们采取有助于公共健康的行动。

abstract.text: We study how short-term labor markets responded to an extraordinary demand shock during the COVID-19 pandemic. We use traveling nurse jobs - a market hospitals use to fill temporary staffing needs - to examine workers' willingness to move to places with larger demand shocks. We find a dramatic increase in market size during the pandemic, especially for those specialties central to COVID-19 care. The number of jobs increased far more than compensation, suggesting that labor supply to this fringe of the nursing market is quite elastic. To examine workers' willingness to move across different locations, we examine jobs in different locations on the same day, and find an even more elastic supply response. We show that part of this supply responsiveness comes from workers' willingness to travel longer distances for jobs when payment increases, suggesting that an integrated national market facilitates reallocating workers when demand surges. This implies that a simultaneous national demand spike might be harder for the market to accommodate rapidly.

10.3386/w28240.abstractZh: 我们研究了短期劳动力市场在COVID-19疫情期间对异常需求冲击的响应。我们以巡回护士的工作为例——这是医院用来满足临时人员需求的岗位——来考察工人是否愿意前往需求更大的地区。我们发现，在疫情期间，市场规模显著扩大，尤其是那些与COVID-19护理密切相关的专业领域。岗位数量的增长远远超过了薪酬的变化，这表明护理市场这一边缘领域的劳动力供应具有相当大的弹性。为了进一步了解工人在不同地点之间的迁移意愿，我们在同一天对不同地点的岗位进行了对比分析，发现供应响应的弹性更大。我们发现，这种供应响应的部分原因在于，当薪酬增加时，工人愿意长途跋涉去寻求更好的工作机会，这表明一个整合的国家市场有助于在需求激增时快速调整劳动力分配。这意味着，同时出现全国性的需求激增时，市场可能难以迅速适应。

abstract.text: We study how early career setbacks—in the form of worse initial job matches—have permanent labor and marriage market impacts differentially for males and females. We analyze the Danish physician labor market and exploit a randomized lottery that determines sorting into internships, which differ in the bundle of location and career opportunities they provide. Using administrative data for over fifteen years after the lottery experiment, we find that initial labor market sorting has important long-run effects on occupational choice and career trajectories for women only, which increases the gender earnings gap by 10-15 percent over the decades after graduation from medical school. We show that the differential gender sensitivity to setbacks is driven by women’s career-family trade-off, where women exhibit earlier and higher fertility and subsequently sort into more flexible but lower-paying jobs that facilitate their greater family responsibilities. Our findings have implications for policies aimed at gender equality, as they reveal how persistent gaps can arise even in settings with institutional equality of opportunity and they point to addressing family considerations and job flexibility as key channels.

10.3386/w28245.abstractZh: 我们研究了早期职业挫折——以初始工作匹配较差的形式出现——对男性和女性在劳动力市场和婚姻市场中的影响差异。我们分析了丹麦医生的劳动力市场，并利用一项随机抽签机制来决定实习机会的分配，这些实习机会在地理位置和职业机会方面存在差异。通过超过十五年的行政数据，我们发现初始劳动力市场排序对女性的职业选择和职业轨迹有长期影响，这导致女性在医学院毕业后的几十年里，性别收入差距增加了10-15%。我们发现，女性对挫折的不同性别敏感性是由职业与家庭的权衡所驱动的，女性表现出更早和更高的生育率，因此会选择更灵活但收入较低的工作，从而更好地应对家庭责任。我们的发现对旨在实现性别平等的政策具有启示意义，因为它们揭示了即使在机会平等的制度环境下，性别差距仍可能持续存在，并指出了考虑家庭因素和Job Flexibility是关键途径。

abstract.text: We study how ambient lead exposure impacts learning in elementary school by leveraging a natural experiment where a large national automotive racing organization switched from leaded to unleaded fuel. We find increased levels and duration of exposure to lead negatively affect academic performance, shift the entire academic performance distribution, and negatively impact both younger and older children. A single average race emitted more than 10 kilograms of lead — a quantity similar to the total annual emissions of an airport or the median lead-emitting industrial facility in the United States. The average treated student in our setting has an expected income reduction of $5,200 in present value terms. Avoiding said treatment has an effect size similar to improving teacher value added by one-fourth of a standard deviation, reducing class size by 3 students, or increasing school spending per pupil by $750. The marginal impacts of lead are larger in impoverished, non-white counties, and among students with greater duration of exposure, even after controlling for the total quantity of exposure.

10.3386/w28250.abstractZh: 我们研究了环境铅暴露对小学生学习的影响，通过一项自然实验来研究这一现象。该实验涉及一家大型全国性的汽车赛事组织从使用含铅燃料改为使用无铅燃料。研究发现，铅暴露的水平和持续时间增加会负面影响学业表现，改变整个学业表现的分布情况，并对年幼和年长的儿童都产生负面影响。一次平均比赛会排放超过10公斤的铅——这一数量相当于一个机场或美国中等规模的铅排放工业设施一年的总排放量。在我们的研究环境中，接受这种铅暴露的学生预期收入将减少5,200美元。避免这种暴露的影响大小相当于提高教师的教学价值增加四分之一的标准差，或减少3名学生的班级规模，或使每名学生的学校支出增加750美元。即使在控制了总暴露量的情况下，铅的边际影响在贫困的非白人县以及暴露时间较长的学生中更为显著。

abstract.text: Recent debates over health care reform, including in the context of the Military Health System (MHS) and Veterans Health Administration, highlight the dispute between public and private provision of health care services. Using novel data on childbirth claims from the MHS and drawing on the combination of plausibly exogenous patient moves and heterogeneity across bases in the availability of base hospitals, we identify the impact of receiving obstetrical care on versus off military bases. We find evidence that off-base care is associated with slightly greater resource intensity, but also notably better outcomes, suggesting marginal efficiency gains from care privatization.

10.3386/w28256.abstractZh: 近期关于医疗改革争议的讨论，包括军事健康系统和退伍军人健康管理局的议题，凸显了公共与私人提供医疗服务之间的分歧。我们利用军事健康系统关于分娩索赔的新数据，并结合患者迁移的可能性以及基础医院可用性的差异，研究接受产科护理与不在军事基地接受护理之间的影响。研究发现，不在军事基地接受护理虽然资源投入略高，但治疗效果明显更好，这表明医疗服务的私有化带来了边际性的效率提升。

abstract.text: We study the role of person-specific and place-specific factors in explaining geographic variation in emergency department (ED) utilization using detailed data on 150,000 patients who moved regions within Israel. We document that about half of the destination-origin differences in the average ED utilization rate across districts translates to the change (up or down) in movers’ propensity to visit the ED. In contrast, we find no change in the probability of having an unplanned hospital admission (that is, via the ED), implying that the entire change in ED use by movers is driven by ED visits that do not lead to hospital admission. Similar results are obtained in a complementary event study, which uses hospital entry as a source of variation. The results from both approaches suggest that supply-side variation in ED access affects only the less severe cases—for which close substitutes likely exist—and that variation across ED physicians in their propensity to admit patients is not explained by place-specific factors, such as differences in incentives, capacity, or diagnostic quality.

10.3386/w28266.abstractZh: 我们研究了个人特定因素和地点特定因素在解释急诊部门使用地理差异中的作用，使用了以色列境内150,000名患者详细的数据。我们发现，不同地区之间平均急诊使用率的变化大约有一半可以转化为患者前往急诊部门的倾向性变化。相反，我们发现非计划住院的概率没有变化，这意味着患者使用急诊部门的变化完全是由不会导致住院的急诊就诊所驱动的。在一项补充的事件研究中也获得了类似的结果，该研究以医院入院作为变异的来源。这两种方法的结果表明，急诊服务供应的差异只影响那些较轻微的情况——对于这些情况，可能存在近似的替代方案，而急诊医生在患者收治倾向上的差异并不能由地点特定因素来解释，如激励措施、容量或诊断质量的差异。

abstract.text: Numerous government policies have attempted to keep workers out of the workplace, on the assumption that this will lower transmission of COVID-19. We test that assumption, measuring the effect of aggregate workplace absence on US COVID deaths at the county level through August. Instrumenting with an index of how many local workers pre-pandemic can work from home, based on differences in county occupational mix, we find no effect of workplace absence until mid-May, then a sharply rising effect. By August, moving 10 percent of a county's workers from the workplace would lower deaths there by three quarters one month later.

10.3386/w28275.abstractZh: 许多政府政策试图将工人排除在工作场所之外，其假设是这样可以降低COVID-19的传播。我们通过测量截至8月份各县级别工作场所缺勤对美国COVID死亡人数影响的情况，来检验这一假设。我们依据各县的职业结构差异，创建了一个指标，以反映疫情前有多少当地工人能够在家工作。结果发现，直到5月中旬，工作场所缺勤并没有产生明显影响，之后其影响开始急剧上升。到了8月份，将一个县中10%的工人从工作场所转移出来，可以在一个月后降低该县的死亡人数达四分之三。

abstract.text: We formulate an economic time use model and add to it an epidemiological SIR block. In the event of an epidemic, households shift their leisure time from activities with a high degree of social interaction to activities with less, and also choose to work more from home. Our model highlights the different actions taken by young individuals, who are less severely affected by the disease, and by old individuals, who are more vulnerable. We calibrate our model to time use data from ATUS, employment data, epidemiological data, and estimates of the value of a statistical life. There are qualitative as well as quantitative differences between the competitive equilibrium and social planner allocation and, moreover, these depend critically on when a cure arrives. Due to the role played by social activities in people's welfare, simple indicators such as deaths and GDP are insuffcient for judging outcomes in our economy.

10.3386/w28282.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个经济时间使用模型，并为其添加了流行病学SIR模块。在疫情爆发时，家庭会将休闲时间从需要高度社交互动的活动转移到较少社交互动的活动上，同时更倾向于在家工作。我们的模型突出了年轻个体和社会规划者所采取的不同行动——年轻个体受疾病影响较小，而老年人则更为脆弱。我们根据ATUS的时间使用数据、就业数据、流行病学数据以及统计生命价值的估算来校准模型。竞争均衡与社会规划者的分配之间存在质与量的差异，而这些差异又严重依赖于治愈方法的到来。由于社交活动在人们福利中的重要作用，单纯的指标如死亡人数和GDP不足以评估我们经济中的结果。

abstract.text: The paper formalizes and tests the hypothesis that greater exposure to big shocks induces stronger societal responses for adaptation and protection from future big shocks. We find support for this hypothesis in various strands of the literature and in new empirical tests using cross-country data on deaths due to COVID-19 and deaths during World War 2. Countries with higher death rates in the war saw lower death rates in the first wave of the COVID pandemic, though the effect faded in the pandemic’s second wave. Our tests are robust to a wide range of model specifications and alternative assumptions.

10.3386/w28291.abstractZh: 本文对“面对重大冲击时，社会应对能力和保护能力会更强”这一假设进行了形式化验证。我们在多篇文献中发现了这一假设的支持，并通过使用关于COVID-19导致的死亡人数以及第二次世界大战期间死亡人数的跨国数据进行了新的实证测试。在第二次世界大战中死亡率较高的国家，在COVID-19疫情的第一波中死亡率较低，不过这一效应在疫情的第二波中逐渐减弱。我们的测试结果在多种模型设定和不同假设条件下仍然具有稳健性。

abstract.text: We use an event-study approach to examine changes in intergenerational financial transfers and informal care within families following wealth loss, job exit, widowhood, and health shocks. We find sharp reductions in parental giving to adult children following negative shocks to parents' wealth and earned income, particularly in low-wealth households. Parental giving also decreases with some health shocks and increases following spousal death. Meanwhile, children of low-wealth households increase financial transfers to their parents following adverse shocks and children in both high- and low-wealth households increase their provision of informal care to parents following a wide range of adverse shocks.

10.3386/w28295.abstractZh: 我们采用事件研究法，考察了在家庭财富减少、失业、丧偶和健康危机之后，代际财务转移和非正式照顾的变化。研究发现，在父母财富和收入受到负面冲击后，父母对成年子女的赠与明显减少，尤其是在财富较低的家庭中。某些健康危机也会导致父母的赠与减少，而在配偶去世之后，父母的赠与则会增加。同时，财富较低家庭的子女在遭遇不利冲击后，会增加对父母的财务转移；而无论是高财富家庭还是低财富家庭的子女，在遭遇各种不利冲击后，都会增加对父母的非正式照顾。

abstract.text: Weekly mortality through October 3 is partitioned into normal deaths, COVID, and nonCOVID excess deaths (NCEDs). Before March, the excess is negative for the elderly, likely due to the mild flu season. From March onward, excess deaths are approximately 250,000 of which about 17,000 appear to be a COVID undercount and 30,000 non-COVID. Deaths of despair (drug overdose, suicide, alcohol) in 2017 and 2018 are good predictors of the demographic groups with NCEDs in 2020. The NCEDs are disproportionately experienced by men aged 15-55, including men aged 15-25. Local data on opioid overdoses further support the hypothesis that the pandemic and recession were associated with a 10 to 60 percent increase in deaths of despair above already high pre-pandemic levels.

10.3386/w28303.abstractZh: 截至10月3日的每周死亡人数被分为正常死亡、COVID相关死亡和非COVID相关超额死亡。在3月之前，老年人的超额死亡数量为负，这可能是由于流感季节较为温和所致。从3月开始，超额死亡人数约为250,000人，其中约17,000人可能是COVID相关死亡人数的低估，另外30,000人是非COVID相关死亡。2017年和2018年的绝望性死亡（药物过量、自杀、酒精中毒）是预测2020年存在非COVID相关超额死亡人群的好指标。这些非COVID相关超额死亡主要出现在15-55岁的男性中，尤其是15-25岁的男性。关于阿片类药物过量的本地数据进一步支持了这样的假设：疫情和经济衰退导致绝望性死亡的数量比疫情爆发前高出10%到60%。

abstract.text: We adopt a time series approach to investigate the historical relation between unemployment, life expectancy, and mortality rates. We fit Vector-autoregressions for the overall US population and for groups identified based on gender and race. We use our results to assess the long-run effects of the COVID-19 economic recession on mortality and life expectancy. We estimate the size of the COVID-19-related unemployment shock to be between 2 and 5 times larger than the typical unemployment shock, depending on race and gender, resulting in a significant increase in mortality rates and drop in life expectancy. We also predict that the shock will disproportionately affect African-Americans and women, over a short horizon, while the effects for white men will unfold over longer horizons. These figures translate in more than 0.8 million additional deaths over the next 15 years.

10.3386/w28304.abstractZh: 我们采用时间序列方法，研究失业、预期寿命和死亡率之间的历史关系。我们对美国整体人口以及基于性别和种族划分的群体进行了向量自回归分析。利用我们的研究结果，评估了COVID-19经济衰退对死亡率和预期寿命的长期影响。我们估计，与典型失业冲击相比，与COVID-19相关的失业冲击的幅度在2到5倍之间，具体取决于种族和性别，这导致死亡率显著上升，预期寿命下降。我们还预测，在短期内，这种冲击将对非裔美国人和女性产生不成比例的影响，而白人男性的影响则会在更长的时期内显现。这些数字意味着在未来15年内，将有超过80万人的死亡人数增加。

abstract.text: We examine whether vertical integration of hospitals and skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) could lessen competition by foreclosing rival SNFs’ access to lucrative referrals. We find that it could: among integrated providers, a one percent increase in SNF reimbursement for a given patient discharged from the upstream hospital increases the self-referral rate to the hospital’s downstream SNF(s) by 1.8 percent. We find no evidence of offsetting benefits for patients and payers: these increased self-referrals have an imprecisely estimated zero effect on patient outcomes and Medicare spending.

10.3386/w28305.abstractZh: 我们研究医院和专业护理机构之间的垂直整合是否能够通过限制竞争对手获得有利转诊机会来减少竞争。研究发现，在整合的医疗服务提供者中，对于从上游医院出院的每位患者，护理机构报销金额增加1%，会导致患者向医院下游的护理机构进行自我转诊的比例增加1.8%。我们没有发现对患者和支付方有抵消效应的证据：这些增加的自我转诊对患者结果和医疗保险支出的影响并不明显。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of school shootings on the educational performance and long-term health consequences of students who survive them, highlighting the impact of indiscriminate, high-fatality incidents. Initially, we focus on test scores in the years following a shooting. We also examine whether exposure to a shooting affects chronic absenteeism, which may play a role in explaining any such effect, and school expenditures, which may counteract it. We analyze national, school-district level data and additional school-level data from Connecticut in this part of the analysis. In terms of effects on health status, we focus on its most extreme measure, mortality in the years following a shooting. In this part of the analysis, we analyze county-level data on mortality by cause. In all analyses, we treat the timing of these events as random, enabling us to identify causal effects. Our results indicate that indiscriminate, high-fatality school shootings, such as those that occurred at Sandy Hook and Columbine, have considerable adverse effects on students exposed to them. We cannot rule out substantive effects of other types of shootings with fewer or no fatalities.

10.3386/w28307.abstractZh: 本文探讨了校园枪击事件对学生学业表现和长期健康后果的影响，重点关注那些不分青红皂白、致死人数众多的事件所带来的影响。首先，我们关注枪击事件发生后的几年内学生的考试成绩。我们还研究枪击事件是否会影响学生的长期缺勤情况，这可能对解释这种影响起到一定作用；同时，我们也研究了学校支出情况，看它们是否能够抵消这种影响。在数据分析方面，我们使用了全国及学区级别的数据，以及康涅狄格州的学校级别数据。在健康状况方面，我们重点关注枪击事件发生后的几年内死亡率的变化。在数据分析中，我们还分析了按原因划分的县级死亡率数据。在所有分析中，我们将这些事件的发生时间视为随机事件，以便确定因果效应。我们的研究结果表明，像桑迪胡克和科伦拜这样的不分青红皂白、致死人数众多的校园枪击事件，对受影响的学生产生了相当大的负面影响。不过，我们也不能排除其他类型枪击事件所带来的影响，这些事件可能造成的死亡人数较少或没有死亡人数。

abstract.text: Equilibrium payoff bounds from reputation effects are derived for repeated games with imperfect public monitoring in which a long‐run player interacts frequently with a population of short‐run players and the monitoring technology scales with the length of the period of interaction. The bounds depend on the monitoring technology through the flow of information , a measure of signal informativeness per unit of time based on relative entropy. Examples are shown where, under complete information, the set of equilibrium payoffs of the long‐run player converges, as the period length tends to zero, to the set of static equilibrium payoffs, whereas when the game is perturbed by a small ex ante probability on commitment types, reputation effects remain powerful in the high‐frequency limit.

10.3982/ecta11965.abstractZh: 本文推导了在缺乏公共监控的重复博弈中，基于声誉效应的均衡收益界限。在这种博弈中，长期玩家会频繁地与短期玩家互动，而监控技术的规模则随着互动周期的长度而变化。这些界限取决于监控技术通过信息流传递的方式，即基于相对熵的每单位时间信号信息量的度量。通过实例表明，在完全信息条件下，随着周期长度趋于零，长期玩家的均衡收益集合会收敛到一组静态均衡收益；而当博弈受到关于承诺类型的微小先验概率的扰动时，声誉效应在高频极限下仍然具有强大的影响力。

abstract.text: The objective of this paper is to identify and estimate network formation models using observed data on network structure. We characterize network formation as a simultaneous‐move game, where the utility from forming a link depends on the structure of the network, thereby generating strategic interactions between links. With the prevalence of multiple equilibria, the parameters are not necessarily point identified. We leave the equilibrium selection unrestricted and propose a partial identification approach. We derive bounds on the probability of observing a subnetwork, where a subnetwork is the restriction of a network to a subset of the individuals. Unlike the standard bounds as in Ciliberto and Tamer (2009), these subnetwork bounds are computationally tractable in large networks provided we consider small subnetworks. We provide Monte Carlo evidence that bounds from small subnetworks are informative in large networks.

10.3982/ecta12558.abstractZh: 本文的目的是利用观察到的网络结构数据，识别并估计网络形成模型。我们将网络形成描述为一个同时移动博弈，形成链接所带来的效用取决于网络的结构，从而引发了链接之间的策略性互动。由于存在多种均衡状态，参数并不一定是点确定的。我们不对均衡选择进行限制，并提出了一种部分识别方法。我们推导了观察子网络概率的界限，其中子网络是对网络进行子集限制后的结果。与Ciliberto和Tamer（2009）提出的标准界限不同，这些子网络界限在大型网络中是计算上可行的，前提是我们考虑的是小型子网络。我们通过蒙特卡洛方法证明，在大型网络中，来自小型子网络的界限是具有信息量的。

abstract.text: Consider a researcher estimating the parameters of a regression function based on data for all 50 states in the United States or on data for all visits to a website. What is the interpretation of the estimated parameters and the standard errors? In practice, researchers typically assume that the sample is randomly drawn from a large population of interest and report standard errors that are designed to capture sampling variation. This is common even in applications where it is difficult to articulate what that population of interest is, and how it differs from the sample. In this article, we explore an alternative approach to inference, which is partly design‐based. In a design‐based setting, the values of some of the regressors can be manipulated, perhaps through a policy intervention. Design‐based uncertainty emanates from lack of knowledge about the values that the regression outcome would have taken under alternative interventions. We derive standard errors that account for design‐based uncertainty instead of, or in addition to, sampling‐based uncertainty. We show that our standard errors in general are smaller than the usual infinite‐population sampling‐based standard errors and provide conditions under which they coincide.

10.3982/ecta12675.abstractZh: 假设一位研究人员根据美国所有50个州的数据或网站所有访问数据来估计回归函数的参数。那么，这些估计参数及其标准误差的含义是什么？在实践中，研究人员通常假设样本是从一个大的感兴趣总体中随机抽出的，并报告标准误差，这些误差旨在反映抽样变异。即使是在难以明确界定感兴趣的总体及其与样本差异的应用中，这种情况也很常见。在本文中，我们探讨了一种基于设计的替代推断方法。在基于设计的情况下，某些回归变量的值可以通过政策干预等方式被操纵。基于设计的不确定性源于对在不同干预下回归结果可能取值的缺乏了解。我们推导出了一种标准误差，该误差考虑了基于设计的不确定性，或者除了基于抽样的不确定性之外还考虑了基于设计的不确定性。我们表明，我们的标准误差通常比通常的无限总体基于抽样的标准误差要小，并且提供了它们相一致的条件。

abstract.text: The correlation between productivity and competition is an oft observed but incompletely understood result. Some suggest that there is a treatment effect of competition on measured productivity, for example, through a reduction of managerial slack. Others argue that greater competition makes unproductive establishments exit by reallocating demand to their productive rivals, raising observed average productivity via selection. I study the ready‐mix concrete industry and offer three perspectives on this ambivalence. First, using a standard decomposition approach, I look for evidence of greater reallocation of demand to productive plants in more competitive markets. Second, I model the establishment exit decision and construct a semiparametric selection correction to quantify the empirical significance of treatment and selection. Finally, I use a grouped instrumental variable quantile regression to test the distributional predictions of the selection hypothesis. I find no evidence for greater selection or reallocation in more competitive markets; instead, all three results suggest that measured productivity responds directly to competition. Potential channels include specialization and managerial inputs.

10.3982/ecta12926.abstractZh: 生产力与竞争之间的相关性是一个常被观察到但尚未完全理解的现象。一些学者认为，竞争对衡量出的生产力有积极影响，例如通过减少管理层的闲置资源。另一些学者则认为，更激烈的竞争会导致非生产性企业退出市场，将需求重新分配到更具生产力的竞争对手身上，从而通过选择效应提升平均生产力。我研究了混合混凝土行业，并从三个角度探讨了这一矛盾现象。首先，采用标准的分解方法，我试图寻找在更具竞争性的市场中，需求被重新分配到更具生产力的工厂的证据。其次，我建立了企业退出决策的模型，并构建了一个半参数选择校正项，以量化处理和选择效应的实际意义。最后，我使用分组工具变量分位数回归方法来检验选择假设的分配效应。我没有发现在更具竞争性的市场中存在更大的选择或重新分配现象；相反，所有结果都表明，衡量出的生产力直接受到竞争的影响。潜在的渠道包括专业化和管理层投入。

abstract.text: We extend Kreps and Wilson's concept of sequential equilibrium to games with infinite sets of signals and actions. A strategy profile is a conditional ε ‐equilibrium if, for any of a player's positive probability signal events, his conditional expected utility is within ε of the best that he can achieve by deviating. With topologies on action sets, a conditional ε ‐equilibrium is full if strategies give every open set of actions positive probability. Such full conditional ε ‐equilibria need not be subgame perfect, so we consider a non‐topological approach. Perfect conditional ε ‐equilibria are defined by testing conditional ε ‐rationality along nets of small perturbations of the players' strategies and of nature's probability function that, for any action and for almost any state, make this action and state eventually (in the net) always have positive probability. Every perfect conditional ε ‐equilibrium is a subgame perfect ε ‐equilibrium, and, in finite games, limits of perfect conditional ε ‐equilibria as ε → 0 are sequential equilibrium strategy profiles. But limit strategies need not exist in infinite games so we consider instead the limit distributions over outcomes. We call such outcome distributions perfect conditional equilibrium distributions and establish their existence for a large class of regular projective games. Nature's perturbations can produce equilibria that seem unintuitive and so we augment the game with a net of permissible perturbations.

10.3982/ecta13426.abstractZh: 我们将Kreps和Wilson的序贯均衡概念扩展到具有无限信号集合和行动的游戏中。如果对于玩家任何具有正概率的信号事件，其条件期望效用与通过偏离所能获得的最佳效用相差不超过ε，则该策略组合是一个条件性ε均衡。在行动集合具有拓扑结构的情况下，如果策略使得每个开放的行动集合都具有正概率，则该条件性ε均衡是完整的。这样的完整条件性ε均衡不必是子游戏完美的，因此我们考虑一种非拓扑方法。完美条件性ε均衡是通过测试沿着玩家策略和自然概率函数的小幅度扰动网络的条件性ε理性来定义的，这些扰动对于几乎任何行动和状态，都能使得该行动和状态最终（在网络中）始终具有正概率。每个完美条件性ε均衡都是子游戏完美的ε均衡，在有限游戏中，随着ε趋近于0，完美条件性ε均衡的极限就是序贯均衡策略组合。但在无限游戏中，极限策略可能不存在，因此我们转而考虑结果上的极限分布。我们将这样的结果分布称为完美条件性均衡分布，并证明了对于一大类规则投影游戏，这种分布的存在性。自然发生的扰动可能会产生看似不合直觉的均衡，因此我们通过引入一系列允许扰动来扩展游戏。

abstract.text: This paper considers a class of generalized methods of moments (GMM) estimators for general dynamic panel models, allowing for weakly exogenous covariates and cross‐sectional dependence due to spatial lags, unspecified common shocks, and time‐varying interactive effects. We significantly expand the scope of the existing literature by allowing for endogenous time‐varying spatial weight matrices without imposing explicit structural assumptions on how the weights are formed. An important area of application is in social interaction and network models where our specification can accommodate data dependent network formation. We consider an exemplary social interaction model and show how identification of the interaction parameters is achieved through a combination of linear and quadratic moment conditions. For the general setup we develop an orthogonal forward differencing transformation to aid in the estimation of factor components while maintaining orthogonality of moment conditions. This is an important ingredient to a tractable asymptotic distribution of our estimators. In general, the asymptotic distribution of our estimators is found to be mixed normal due to random norming. However, the asymptotic distribution of our test statistics is still chi‐square.

10.3982/ecta13660.abstractZh: 本文探讨了适用于一般动态面板模型的广义矩估计方法，该方法能够处理弱外生协变量以及由于空间滞后、未指定的共同冲击和时间变化的互动效应导致的截面依赖性问题。我们通过允许内生性时间变化的空间权重矩阵，而不对权重的形成方式施加显式结构假设，显著扩展了现有文献的研究范围。在社会互动和网络模型的应用中，我们的模型可以适应数据依赖性的网络形成。我们以一个典型的社交互动模型为例，展示了如何通过结合线性和二次矩条件来识别互动参数。对于一般的模型设置，我们开发了一种正交前向差分变换方法，以帮助估计因子分量，同时保持矩条件的正交性。这是我们的估计量具有可解的渐近分布的重要条件。总体而言，由于随机标准化，我们的估计量的渐近分布被认为是混合正态分布。然而，我们的检验统计量的渐近分布仍然是卡方分布。

abstract.text: This research advances the hypothesis and establishes empirically that interpersonal population diversity, rather than fractionalization or polarization across ethnic groups, has been pivotal to the emergence, prevalence, recurrence, and severity of intrasocietal conflicts. Exploiting an exogenous source of variations in population diversity across nations and ethnic groups, as determined predominantly during the exodus of humans from Africa tens of thousands of years ago, the study demonstrates that population diversity, and its impact on the degree of diversity within ethnic groups, has contributed significantly to the risk and intensity of historical and contemporary civil conflicts. The findings arguably reflect the contribution of population diversity to the non-cohesivnesss of society, as reflected partly in the prevalence of mistrust, the divergence in preferences for public goods and redistributive policies, and the degree of fractionalization and polarization across ethnic, linguistic, and religious groups.

10.3982/ecta13734.abstractZh: 本研究进一步证实了以下假设：人际群体多样性，而非种族群体间的分化或两极分化，才是社会内部冲突出现、持续、复发及加剧的关键因素。通过利用数千年前人类从非洲迁徙过程中形成的国家与种族群体间人口多样性的外生变量，研究指出，人口多样性及其对种族群体内部多样性的影响，显著地增加了历史和当代民事冲突的风险和强度。研究结果表明，人口多样性对社会凝聚力的削弱起到了重要作用，这在一定程度上体现在不信任的普遍存在、对公共产品和再分配政策的偏好差异，以及种族、语言及宗教群体间的分化与两极分化上。

abstract.text: This paper examines the prices of basic staples in rural Mexico. We document that nonlinear pricing in the form of quantity discounts is common, that quantity discounts are sizable for basic staples, and that the well‐known conditional cash transfer program Progresa has significantly increased quantity discounts, although the program, as documented in previous studies, has not affected unit prices on average. To account for these patterns, we propose a model of price discrimination that nests those of Maskin and Riley (1984) and Jullien (2000), in which consumers differ in their tastes and, because of subsistence constraints, in their ability to pay for a good. We show that under mild conditions, a model in which consumers face heterogeneous subsistence or budget constraints is equivalent to one in which consumers have access to heterogeneous outside options. We rely on known results to characterize the equilibrium price schedule, which is nonlinear in quantity. We analyze the effect of nonlinear pricing on market participation as well as the impact of a market‐wide transfer, analogous to the Progresa one, when consumers are differentially constrained. We show that the model is structurally identified from data on prices and quantities from a single market under common assumptions. We estimate the model using data on three commonly consumed commodities from municipalities and localities in Mexico. Interestingly, we find that relative to linear pricing, nonlinear pricing is beneficial to a large number of households, including those consuming small quantities, mostly because of the higher degree of market participation that nonlinear pricing induces. We also show that the Progresa transfer has affected the slopes of the price schedules of the three commodities we study, which have become steeper as consistent with our model, leading to an increase in the intensity of price discrimination. Finally, we find that a reduced form of our model, in which the size of quantity discounts depends on the hazard rate of the distribution of quantities purchased in a village, accounts for the shift in price schedules induced by the program.

10.3982/ecta13918.abstractZh: 本文研究了墨西哥农村基本食品的价格情况。我们发现，以数量折扣形式出现的非线性定价现象较为常见，且基本食品的数量折扣幅度较大。著名的“Progresa”条件性现金转移计划显著增加了数量折扣，尽管该计划并未显著影响单位价格。为了解释这些现象，我们提出了一个价格歧视模型，该模型结合了Maskin和Riley（1984年）以及Jullien（2000年）的研究，其中消费者的偏好存在差异，且由于生存限制，他们的支付能力也有所不同。我们证明，在一定的条件下，消费者面临异质生存或预算限制的情况，等同于消费者能够选择不同外部选项的情境。我们依据已知结果来描述均衡价格表，该价格表在数量上呈现非线性特征。我们分析了非线性定价对市场参与的影响，以及类似“Progresa”计划的市场范围转移对消费者差异化约束的影响。我们证明，在常见假设下，该模型可以从单一市场的价格和数量数据中得到结构性识别。我们利用墨西哥某些市镇的三种常见消费品数据来估计该模型。有趣的是，我们发现与线性定价相比，非线性定价对大量家庭都有益处，尤其是那些消费量较小的家庭，主要是因为非线性定价能够提升市场参与程度。我们还发现，Progresa转移支付影响了我们研究的三种商品的价格表斜率，这些价格表斜率变得更加陡峭，这与我们的模型预测一致，从而增加了价格歧视的强度。最后，我们发现，我们模型的简化形式能够解释该计划引起的价格表变化，其中数量折扣的大小取决于村庄内购买数量分布的风险率。

abstract.text: We provide a tractable, quantitatively‐oriented theory of innovation and technology diffusion to explore the role of international trade in the process of development. We model innovation and diffusion as a process involving the combination of new ideas with insights from other industries or countries. We provide conditions under which each country's equilibrium frontier of knowledge converges to a Fréchet distribution, and derive a system of differential equations describing the evolution of the scale parameters of these distributions, that is, countries' stocks of knowledge. The model remains tractable with many asymmetric countries and generates a rich set of predictions about how the level and composition of trade affect countries' frontiers of knowledge. We use the framework to quantify the contribution of bilateral trade costs to long‐run changes in TFP and individual post‐war growth miracles. For our preferred calibration, we find that both gains from trade and the fraction of variation of TFP growth accounted for by changes in trade more than double relative to a model without diffusion.

10.3982/ecta14044.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个易于处理、以量化为导向的创新与技术扩散理论，以探讨国际贸易在发展过程中的作用。我们将创新与扩散过程建模为将新想法与其他行业或国家的见解相结合的过程。我们提出了条件，使得每个国家的知识均衡前沿收敛于Fréchet分布，并推导出了描述这些分布规模参数演变的微分方程体系，即各国的知识存量。该模型在存在多个不对称国家的情况下仍然具有可行性，并产生了关于贸易水平和构成如何影响国家知识前沿的丰富预测。我们利用这一框架来量化双边贸易成本对长期全要素生产率变化以及战后个体增长奇迹的贡献。根据我们优选的校准方式，我们发现，与没有扩散的模型相比，贸易带来的收益以及全要素生产率增长变化所占比重均增加了一倍多。

abstract.text: We propose a new theory of price rigidity based on firms' Knightian uncertainty about their competitive environment. This uncertainty has two key implications. First, firms learn about the shape of their demand function from past observations of quantities sold. This learning gives rise to kinks in the expected profit function at previously observed prices, making those prices both sticky and more likely to reoccur. Second, uncertainty about the relationship between aggregate and industry‐level inflation generates nominal rigidity. We prove the main insights analytically and quantify the effects of our mechanism. Our estimated quantitative model is consistent with a wide range of micro‐level pricing facts that are typically challenging to match jointly. It also implies significantly more persistent monetary non‐neutrality than in standard models, allowing it to generate large real effects from nominal shocks.

10.3982/ecta14234.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于企业对其竞争环境所面临的奈特式不确定性的价格刚性新理论。这种不确定性有两个关键影响。首先，企业通过过去销售量的观察来了解自身需求函数的形态。这种学习过程导致预期利润函数在先前观察到的价格点出现弯曲，使得这些价格既具有粘性，又更有可能再次出现。其次，对总体及行业层面通货膨胀之间关系的不确定性会导致名义上的刚性。我们通过分析证明了主要观点，并量化了我们机制的影响。我们估计的定量模型与许多微观层面的定价事实一致，而这些事实通常难以同时匹配。此外，该模型还意味着货币的非中性性比标准模型更为持久，从而能够从名义冲击中产生较大的实际效应。

abstract.text: Do new communication technologies, such as social media, alleviate the collective action problem? This paper provides evidence that penetration of VK, the dominant Russian online social network, led to more protest activity during a wave of protests in Russia in 2011. As a source of exogenous variation in network penetration, we use the information on the city of origin of the students who studied with the founder of VK, controlling for the city of origin of the students who studied at the same university several years earlier or later. We find that a 10% increase in VK penetration increased the probability of a protest by 4.6% and the number of protesters by 19%. Additional results suggest that social media induced protest activity by reducing the costs of coordination rather than by spreading information critical of the government. We observe that VK penetration increased pro‐governmental support, with no evidence of increased polarization. We also find that cities with higher fractionalization of network users between VK and Facebook experienced fewer protests, and the effect of VK on protests exhibits threshold behavior.

10.3982/ecta14281.abstractZh: 新的通信技术，如社交媒体，是否缓解了集体行动问题？本文提供了证据，表明俄罗斯主流在线社交网络VK的普及率在2011年俄罗斯抗议浪潮期间导致了更多的抗议活动。作为网络普及率外生变化的来源，我们使用了那些与VK创始人一起学习的学生所在城市的信息，同时控制了几年前或后来在同一所大学学习的学生所在城市的信息。我们发现，VK普及率增加10%会使抗议的概率增加4.6%，抗议人数增加19%。其他结果表明，社交媒体通过降低协调成本而非传播批评政府的信息来引发抗议活动。我们观察到，VK的普及率增加了对政府的支持，但没有证据表明两极分化加剧。我们还发现，网络用户中VK和Facebook使用比例差异较大的城市，抗议活动较少，而且VK对抗议活动的影响表现出阈值行为。

abstract.text: We study the pure‐strategy subgame‐perfect Nash equilibria of stochastic games with perfect monitoring, geometric discounting, and public randomization. We develop novel algorithms for computing equilibrium payoffs, in which we combine policy iteration when incentive constraints are slack with value iteration when incentive constraints bind. We also provide software implementations of our algorithms. Preliminary simulations indicate that they are significantly more efficient than existing methods. The theoretical results that underlie the algorithms also imply bounds on the computational complexity of equilibrium payoffs when there are two players. When there are more than two players, we show by example that the number of extreme equilibrium payoffs may be countably infinite.

10.3982/ecta14357.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有完美监控、几何贴现和公共随机化的随机游戏的纯策略子博弈完美纳什均衡。我们开发了计算均衡收益的新型算法，该算法在激励约束松弛时结合策略迭代，在激励约束生效时结合价值迭代。我们还提供了这些算法的软件实现。初步模拟表明，这些算法比现有方法效率更高。这些算法所基于的理论结果还给出了当有两个玩家时均衡收益的计算复杂度界限。当玩家数量超过两个时，我们通过例子表明极端均衡收益的数量可能是可数无限的。

abstract.text: Can digital information and communication technology foster mass political mobilization? We use a novel georeferenced data set for the entire African continent between 1998 and 2012 on the coverage of mobile phone signal together with georeferenced data from multiple sources on the occurrence of protests and on individual participation in protests to bring this argument to empirical scrutiny. We find that while mobile phones are instrumental to mass mobilization, this only happens during economic downturns, when reasons for grievance emerge and the cost of participation falls. The results are in line with insights from a network model with imperfect information and strategic complementarities in protest occurrence. Mobile phones make individuals more responsive to both changes in economic conditions—a mechanism that we ascribe to enhanced information —and to their neighbors' participation—a mechanism that we ascribe to enhanced coordination .

10.3982/ecta14392.abstractZh: 数字信息和通信技术能否促进大规模政治动员？我们使用了1998年至2012年间整个非洲大陆的地理参考数据集，该数据集包含了手机信号的覆盖情况，以及来自多个来源的关于抗议活动发生情况和个人参与情况的地理参考数据，以此来对这一论点进行实证分析。研究发现，虽然手机在大规模动员中起着重要作用，但这种情况只发生在经济衰退时期，即人们产生不满情绪且参与抗议的成本降低时。这些结果与一个信息不完全且抗议活动之间存在战略互补性的网络模型的见解一致。手机使得个人对经济状况的变化更加敏感——我们认为这是得益于信息的增加——同时也对邻居的参与更加敏感——我们认为这是得益于协调性的增强。

abstract.text: We theoretically and empirically study an incomplete information model of social learning. Agents initially guess the binary state of the world after observing a private signal. In subsequent rounds, agents observe their network neighbors' previous guesses before guessing again. Agents are drawn from a mixture of learning types—Bayesian, who face incomplete information about others' types, and DeGroot, who average their neighbors' previous period guesses and follow the majority. We study (1) learning features of both types of agents in our incomplete information model; (2) what network structures lead to failures of asymptotic learning; (3) whether realistic networks exhibit such structures. We conducted lab experiments with 665 subjects in Indian villages and 350 students from ITAM in Mexico. We perform a reduced‐form analysis and then structurally estimate the mixing parameter, finding the share of Bayesian agents to be 10% and 50% in the Indian‐villager and Mexican‐student samples, respectively.

10.3982/ecta14407.abstractZh: 我们从理论上和实证上研究了一个信息不完全的社会学习模型。代理人在观察到私人信号后，最初会猜测世界的二元状态。在后续轮次中，代理人在再次猜测之前，会观察其网络邻居之前的猜测结果。这些代理人属于两种学习类型的混合体——贝叶斯型，他们面对的是关于其他类型信息的不完全性；以及DeGroot型，他们会平均邻居在前一时期所做的猜测，并遵循多数意见。我们研究了：(1) 这两种类型代理人在信息不完全模型中的学习特征；(2) 哪些网络结构会导致渐进学习的失败；(3) 现实网络是否表现出这样的结构。我们在印度村庄进行了665名受试者的实验室实验，在墨西哥的ITAM学院则对350名学生进行了实验。我们通过简化形式分析，然后结构估计混合参数，发现贝叶斯型代理人在印度村民样本中的占比为10%，在墨西哥学生样本中的占比为50%。

abstract.text: In this paper, we develop a model that captures key components of the Roy model, a search model, compensating differentials, and human capital accumulation on‐the‐job. We establish which components of the model can be non‐parametrically identified and which ones cannot. We estimate the model and use it to assess the relative contribution of the different factors for overall wage inequality. We find that variation in premarket skills (the key feature of the Roy model) is the most important component to account for the majority of wage variation. We also demonstrate that there is substantial interaction between the other components, most notably, that the importance of the job match obtained by search frictions varies from around 4% to around 29%, depending on how we account for other components. Inequality due to preferences for non‐pecuniary aspects of the job (which leads to compensating differentials) and search are both very important for explaining other features of the data. Search is important for turnover, but so are preferences for non‐pecuniary aspects of jobs as one‐third of all choices between two jobs would have resulted in a different outcome if the worker only cared about wages.

10.3982/ecta14441.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们开发了一个模型，该模型涵盖了Roy模型的关键组成部分：搜索模型、补偿差异以及在职人力资本积累。我们确定了模型中哪些部分可以非参数化地识别，哪些则不能。我们对该模型进行了估计，并利用它来评估不同因素对整体工资不平等的相对贡献。我们发现，市场前技能的变化（Roy模型的核心特征）是解释大部分工资差异的最重要因素。我们还证明了其他组成部分之间存在显著的相互作用，尤其是，通过搜索摩擦获得的职位匹配的重要性从大约4%变化到大约29%，这取决于我们如何考虑其他组成部分。由于对工作的非金钱方面偏好而产生的不平等（导致补偿差异）以及搜索行为，对于解释数据的其他特征都非常重要。搜索行为对员工流动率有重要影响，但对非金钱方面偏好的偏好同样重要，因为如果工人只关心工资，那么三分之二的两种工作之间的选择结果将会有所不同。

abstract.text: We study the incidence of nonlinear labor income taxes in an economy with a continuum of endogenous wages. We derive in closed form the effects of reforming nonlinearly an arbitrary tax system, by showing that this problem can be formalized as an integral equation. Our tax incidence formulas are valid both when the underlying assignment of skills to tasks is fixed or endogenous. We show qualitatively and quantitatively that contrary to conventional wisdom, if the tax system is initially suboptimal and progressive, the general‐equilibrium “trickle‐down” forces may raise the benefits of increasing the marginal tax rates on high incomes. We finally derive a parsimonious characterization of optimal taxes.

10.3982/ecta14681.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有连续内生工资的经济体中非线性劳动所得税的征收情况。我们通过证明该问题可以形式化为一个积分方程，从而以封闭形式推导出对任意税收制度进行非线性改革的效果。我们的税收征收公式在技能分配固定或内生的情况下都是有效的。我们从定性和定量两个方面表明，与传统观点相反，如果税收制度最初是次优且累进的，那么一般均衡的“涓滴”效应可能会提高对高收入者征收边际税率的好处。最后，我们得出了一个关于最优税收的简洁描述。

abstract.text: The empirical observation that “large firms tend to export, whereas small firms do not” has transformed the way economists think about the determinants of international trade. Yet, it has had surprisingly little impact on how economists think about trade policy. Under very general conditions, we show that from the point of view of a country that unilaterally imposes trade taxes to maximize domestic welfare, the self‐selection of heterogeneous firms into exports calls for import subsidies on the least profitable foreign firms. In contrast, our analysis does not provide any rationale for export subsidies or taxes on the least profitable domestic firms.

10.3982/ecta14763.abstractZh: “大型企业倾向于出口，而小型企业则不然”这一经验观察改变了经济学家对国际贸易决定因素的思考方式。然而，这一发现对经济学家对贸易政策的看法影响甚微。在非常普遍的条件下，我们表明，对于一个单方面征收贸易税以最大化国内福利的国家而言，将不同性质的企业自我选择为出口企业意味着需要对利润最低的外国企业提供进口补贴。相比之下，我们的分析并未为出口补贴或对利润最低的国内企业征税提供任何理由。

abstract.text: We provide a systematic analysis of the properties of individual returns to wealth using 12 years of population data from Norway's administrative tax records. We document a number of novel results. First, individuals earn markedly different average returns on their net worth (a standard deviation of 22.1%) and on its components. Second, heterogeneity in returns does not arise merely from differences in the allocation of wealth between safe and risky assets: returns are heterogeneous even within narrow asset classes. Third, returns are positively correlated with wealth: moving from the 10th to the 90th percentile of the net worth distribution increases the return by 18 percentage points (and 10 percentage points if looking at net‐of‐tax returns). Fourth, individual wealth returns exhibit substantial persistence over time. We argue that while this persistence partly arises from stable differences in risk exposure and assets scale, it also reflects heterogeneity in sophistication and financial information, as well as entrepreneurial talent. Finally, wealth returns are correlated across generations. We discuss the implications of these findings for several strands of the wealth inequality debate.

10.3982/ecta14835.abstractZh: 我们利用挪威行政税务记录中的12年人口数据，对个人财富回报的特性进行了系统分析。我们发现了一些新颖的结果。首先，个人在其净资产上的平均回报存在显著差异（标准差为22.1%），而其各组成部分的回报也各不相同。其次，回报的异质性并非仅仅源于财富在安全资产与风险资产之间的分配差异：即使在狭窄的资产类别内部，回报也表现出异质性。第三，回报与财富呈正相关：从净资产分布的第10百分位到第90百分位，回报增加了18个百分点（如果考虑税后净回报，则增加10个百分点）。第四，个人财富回报随时间呈现出显著的持续性。我们认为，这种持续性部分源于风险敞口和资产规模的稳定差异，同时也反映了在金融信息复杂性和创业才能方面的异质性。最后，财富回报在不同世代间也存在相关性。我们讨论了这些发现对财富不平等问题讨论中几个方面的意义。

abstract.text: This paper considers the problem of forecasting a collection of short time series using cross‐sectional information in panel data. We construct point predictors using Tweedie's formula for the posterior mean of heterogeneous coefficients under a correlated random effects distribution. This formula utilizes cross‐sectional information to transform the unit‐specific (quasi) maximum likelihood estimator into an approximation of the posterior mean under a prior distribution that equals the population distribution of the random coefficients. We show that the risk of a predictor based on a nonparametric kernel estimate of the Tweedie correction is asymptotically equivalent to the risk of a predictor that treats the correlated random effects distribution as known (ratio optimality). Our empirical Bayes predictor performs well compared to various competitors in a Monte Carlo study. In an empirical application, we use the predictor to forecast revenues for a large panel of bank holding companies and compare forecasts that condition on actual and severely adverse macroeconomic conditions.

10.3982/ecta14952.abstractZh: 本文探讨了利用面板数据中的横截面信息来预测一系列短期时间序列的问题。我们采用Tweedie公式构建点预测器，该公式用于描述在相关随机效应分布下异质系数的后验均值。该公式利用横截面信息，将单位特定的（准）最大似然估计量转化为在等于随机系数总体分布的先验分布下的后验均值近似。我们证明，基于非参数核估计的Tweedie修正的预测器的风险，与将相关随机效应分布视为已知的预测器的风险在渐近意义上是等价的（比率最优性）。在蒙特卡洛研究中，我们的经验贝叶斯预测器与各种竞争模型相比表现良好。在实证应用中，我们使用该预测器来预测大量银行控股公司的收入，并比较了基于实际和严重不利宏观经济条件的预测结果。

abstract.text: In a cheap‐talk setting where the conflict of interest between sender and receiver is determined endogenously by the choice of parameters θ i for each agent i , conditions are provided that determine the sign of each agent's inverse demand for θ without assuming that the most informative equilibrium will necessarily be played in the cheap talk game. For two popular functional forms of payoffs, we derive analytically tractable approximations for agent i 's demand for θ . In an application where the θi 's are purchased on a competitive market, we provide conditions for a competitive equilibrium to feature maximal information transmission. In a principal–agent application where the agent's θ is set by the principal, our results show that information transmission will be partial. We consider extensions where: (1) the θ 's are acquired covertly rather than overtly and (2) the θ 's are traded after the sender has received the information.

10.3982/ecta14953.abstractZh: 在一种廉价交易的环境中，发送者和接收者之间的利益冲突是由每个代理人选择的参数θi内生决定的。在这种情况下，可以给出一些条件来确定每个代理人对θ的逆需求符号，而无需假设在廉价交易游戏中一定会出现最具信息量的均衡。对于两种常见的收益函数形式，我们推导出了代理人对θ需求的解析可近似模型。在一个代理人θ在竞争市场中购买的应用中，我们提出了一种竞争均衡能够实现最大信息传输的条件。在一种委托-代理应用中，代理人的θ由委托人设定，我们的结果表明信息传输将是部分性的。我们还考虑了以下扩展情况：(1) θ的获取是隐秘的而非公开的；(2) θ在发送者接收到信息之后进行交易。

abstract.text: We propose a model of preferences in which the effect of randomization on ambiguity depends on how the unknown probability law is determined. We adopt the framework of Anscombe and Aumann (1963) and relax the axioms. In the resulting representation of the individual's preference, the individual has a collection of sets of priors M . She believes that before she moves, nature has chosen an unknown scenario (a set of priors) from M , and from that scenario, nature will choose a prior after she moves. The representation illustrates how randomization may partially eliminate the effect of ambiguity.

10.3982/ecta15182.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个偏好模型，其中随机化对模糊性的影响取决于未知概率法则的确定方式。我们采用了Anscombe和Aumann（1963年）的框架，并放宽了相关公理。在个体偏好的表示中，个体拥有一系列先验集合M。她认为，在行动之前，自然从M中选定了一个未知的情境（一组先验），而在她行动之后，自然会从该情境中选择一个先验。这种表示方式说明了随机化如何部分消除模糊性的影响。

abstract.text: We study optimal transport networks in spatial equilibrium. We develop a framework consisting of a neoclassical trade model with labor mobility in which locations are arranged on a graph. Goods must be shipped through linked locations, and transport costs depend on congestion and on the infrastructure in each link, giving rise to an optimal transport problem in general equilibrium. The optimal transport network is the solution to a social planner's problem of building infrastructure in each link. We provide conditions such that this problem is globally convex, guaranteeing its numerical tractability. We also study cases with increasing returns to transport technologies in which global convexity fails. We apply the framework to assess optimal investments and inefficiencies in the road networks of European countries.

10.3982/ecta15213.abstractZh: 我们研究了空间均衡状态下的最优运输网络问题。我们构建了一个框架，该框架包含了一个具有劳动力流动性的新古典贸易模型，其中各个位置被安排在一个图上。货物必须通过相互连接的地点进行运输，运输成本取决于拥堵情况以及各连接点的基础设施状况，这就构成了一个一般均衡条件下的最优运输问题。最优运输网络是社会规划者构建各连接点基础设施问题的解。我们提出了一些条件，使得这个问题具有全局凸性，从而保证了其数值上的可解性。我们还研究了运输技术具有递增收益的情况，这种情况下全局凸性不再成立。我们将这一框架应用于评估欧洲国家道路网络中的最优投资情况以及存在的效率低下问题。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a class of games called revision games . In a revision game, players start with initially prepared actions, followed by a sequence of random revision opportunities until a predetermined deadline. In the course of revisions, players monitor each other's behavior. It is shown that players can cooperate and that their behavior under the optimal equilibrium is described by a simple differential equation. We present the necessary and sufficient conditions for cooperation to be sustained in revision games. We also present applications to the preopening activities in the stock exchange and to an electoral campaign.

10.3982/ecta15272.abstractZh: 本文提出了一类称为“修订游戏”的博弈。在修订游戏中，玩家最初拥有预先准备好的行动方案，随后会经历一系列随机的修订机会，直到预定的截止日期。在修订过程中，玩家会相互监控对方的行为。研究表明，玩家能够合作，而他们在最优均衡下的行为可以用一个简单的微分方程来描述。我们提出了确保修订游戏中合作得以持续的必要充分条件。此外，我们还展示了该理论在证券交易所的预开活动以及选举活动中的应用。

abstract.text: This paper develops a multi‐stage general‐equilibrium model of global value chains (GVCs) and studies the specialization of countries within GVCs in a world with barriers to international trade. With costly trade, the optimal location of production of a given stage in a GVC is not only a function of the marginal cost at which that stage can be produced in a given country, but is also shaped by the proximity of that location to the precedent and the subsequent desired locations of production. We show that, other things equal, it is optimal to locate relatively downstream stages of production in relatively central locations. We also develop and estimate a tractable, quantifiable version of our model that illustrates how changes in trade costs affect the extent to which various countries participate in domestic, regional, or global value chains, and traces the real income consequences of these changes.

10.3982/ecta15362.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个多阶段的一般均衡模型，用于研究全球价值链中各国的专业化现象，并探讨在存在国际贸易壁垒的世界中，各国在价值链中的生产定位问题。在存在高昂贸易成本的情况下，某一阶段的生产最优位置不仅取决于该阶段在某一国家内的边际成本，还受到该位置与之前和之后期望生产位置的距离的影响。研究表明，在其他条件相同的情况下，将生产中的下游阶段定位在相对中心的位置是最优的。我们还开发并估计了一个易于操作、可量化的模型版本，用以说明贸易成本的变化如何影响各国参与国内、区域或全球价值链的程度，并分析这些变化对实际收入的影响。

abstract.text: In this paper, we study the role of the transportation sector in world trade. We build a spatial model that centers on the interaction of the market for (oceanic) transportation services and the market for world trade in goods. The model delivers equilibrium trade flows, as well as equilibrium trade costs (shipping prices). Using detailed data on vessel movements and shipping prices, we document novel facts about shipping patterns; we then flexibly estimate our model. We use this setup to demonstrate that the transportation sector (i) attenuates differences in the comparative advantage across countries; (ii) generates network effects in trade costs; and (iii) dampens the impact of shocks on trade flows. These three mechanisms reveal a new role for geography in international trade that was previously concealed by the frequently‐used assumption of exogenous trade costs. Finally, we illustrate how our setup can be used for policy analysis by evaluating the impact of future and existing infrastructure projects (e.g., Northwest Passage, Panama Canal).

10.3982/ecta15455.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了交通运输部门在世界贸易中的作用。我们构建了一个空间模型，该模型以（海洋）运输服务市场与世界商品贸易市场的互动为核心。该模型能够预测均衡贸易流量以及均衡贸易成本（运输价格）。通过利用关于船舶运输和运输价格的详细数据，我们发现了关于运输模式的一些新现象；随后，我们灵活地调整了模型参数。利用这一模型，我们证明了交通运输部门能够：（i）缩小各国之间的比较优势差异；（ii）在贸易成本中产生网络效应；（iii）减轻冲击对贸易流量的影响。这三种机制揭示了地理因素在国际贸易中的新作用，而这一作用之前往往被外部贸易成本假设所掩盖。最后，我们通过评估未来和现有基础设施项目（如西北航道、巴拿马运河）的影响，说明了如何利用这一模型进行政策分析。

abstract.text: We study how aggregate economic conditions affect the timing of marriage, and particularly child marriage, in Sub‐Saharan Africa and in India. In both regions, substantial monetary or in‐kind transfers occur with marriage: bride price across Sub‐Saharan Africa and dowry in India. In a simple equilibrium model of the marriage market in which parents choose when their children marry, income shocks affect the age of marriage because marriage payments are a source of consumption smoothing, particularly for a woman's family. As predicted by our model, we show that droughts, which reduce annual crop yields by 10 to 15% and aggregate income by 4 to 5%, have opposite effects on the marriage behavior of a sample of 400,000 women in the two regions: in Sub‐Saharan Africa they increase the annual hazard into child marriage by 3%, while in India droughts reduce such a hazard by 4%. Changes in the age of marriage due to droughts are associated with changes in fertility, especially in Sub‐Saharan Africa, and with declines in observed marriage payments. Our results indicate that the age of marriage responds to short‐term changes in aggregate economic conditions and that marriage payments determine the sign of this response. This suggests that, in order to design successful policies to combat child marriage and improve investments in daughters' human capital, it is crucial to understand the economic role of marriage market institutions.

10.3982/ecta15505.abstractZh: 我们研究了总体经济条件如何影响婚姻的时机，特别是儿童婚姻的时机，在撒哈拉以南非洲和印度。在这两个地区，婚姻过程中都会发生大量的货币或实物转移：撒哈拉以南非洲地区有嫁妆，印度则有聘礼。在一个简单的婚姻市场均衡模型中，父母选择子女结婚的时机，收入冲击会影响结婚年龄，因为婚姻费用是一种消费平滑的手段，尤其是对女性家庭而言。正如我们的模型所预测的那样，我们发现干旱会导致结婚年龄发生变化：在撒哈拉以南非洲，干旱使每年结婚的风险增加3%；而在印度，干旱则使这种风险降低4%。由于干旱导致的结婚年龄变化与生育率的变化相关，尤其是在撒哈拉以南非洲，同时也会使婚姻费用下降。我们的结果表明，结婚年龄对短期经济条件的变化有反应，而婚姻费用则决定了这种反应的趋势。这表明，为了制定有效的政策来反对儿童婚姻并改善对女性人力资本的投资，了解婚姻市场制度的经济作用至关重要。

abstract.text: We introduce a new family of dynamic mechanisms that restricts sellers from using future distributional knowledge. Since the allocation and pricing of each auction period do not depend on the type distributions of future periods, we call this family of dynamic mechanisms non‐clairvoyant. We develop a framework (bank account mechanisms) for characterizing, designing, and proving lower bounds for dynamic mechanisms (clairvoyant or non‐clairvoyant). We use the same methods to compare the revenue extraction power of clairvoyant and non‐clairvoyant dynamic mechanisms.

10.3982/ecta15530.abstractZh: 我们引入了一类新的动态机制，这类机制限制卖家使用未来的分配信息。由于每个拍卖期的分配和定价并不依赖于未来时期的类型分布，我们将这类动态机制称为非洞察型动态机制。我们开发了一个框架（银行账户机制），用于描述、设计并证明动态机制（洞察型或非洞察型）的下限。我们使用相同的方法来比较洞察型和非洞察型动态机制的收入提取能力。

abstract.text: Markups vary systematically across firms and are a source of misallocation. This paper develops a tractable model of firm dynamics where firms' market power is endogenous and the distribution of markups emerges as an equilibrium outcome. Monopoly power is the result of a process of forward‐looking, risky accumulation: firms invest in productivity growth to increase markups in their existing products but are stochastically replaced by more efficient competitors. Creative destruction therefore has pro‐competitive effects because faster churn gives firms less time to accumulate market power. In an application to firm‐level data from Indonesia, the model predicts that, relative to the United States, misallocation is more severe and firms are substantially smaller. To explain these patterns, the model suggests an important role for frictions that prevent existing firms from entering new markets. Differences in entry costs for new firms are less important.

10.3982/ecta15565.abstractZh: 企业间的加价率存在系统性差异，这是资源配置不当的一个原因。本文提出了一个可行的企业动态模型，其中企业的市场力量是内生性的，加价率的分配成为均衡结果。垄断力量的形成是一个具有风险的前瞻性积累过程：企业投资于生产率的提升以增加现有产品的加价率，但随后会被更高效的竞争对手随机替代。因此，创造性破坏具有促进竞争的作用，因为更快的更替使得企业积累市场力量的时间减少。通过对印度尼西亚企业数据的应用，该模型预测，与美国相比，资源配置不当的情况更为严重，企业的规模也明显较小。为了解释这些现象，模型指出，阻碍现有企业进入新市场的摩擦因素起着重要作用。新企业的进入成本差异则相对不那么重要。

abstract.text: Two main classes of channels are studied as informational sources of financial contagion. One is a fundamental channel that is based on real and financial links between economies, and the second is a social learning channel that arises when agents base their decisions on noisy observations about the actions of others in foreign markets. Using global games, I present a two‐country model of financial contagion in which both channels can operate and I test its predictions experimentally. The experimental results show that subjects do not extract information optimally, which leads to two systematic biases that affect these channels directly. Base‐rate neglect leads subjects to underweight their prior, and thus weakens the fundamental channel. An overreaction bias strengthens the social learning channel, since subjects rely on information about the behavior of others, even when this information is irrelevant. These results have significant welfare effects rooted in the specific way in which these biases alter behavior.

10.3982/ecta15604.abstractZh: 本文研究了两类作为金融传染信息源的传播渠道。第一类是基于经济体之间实际和金融联系的基本渠道；第二类则是社会学习渠道，当个体根据关于外国市场其他参与者行为的噪声信息来做出决策时，就会形成这一渠道。通过全球博弈模型，我提出了一个包含这两种渠道的金融传染双国模型，并对其进行实验验证。实验结果表明，参与者并未最优地获取信息，这导致了两种系统性偏差，直接影响了这些渠道的功能。基础率忽略偏差导致参与者低估自身先验信息，从而削弱了基本渠道的效果。过度反应偏差则强化了社会学习渠道，因为即使这些信息无关紧要，参与者仍依赖于其他人的行为信息。这些结果对福利产生了显著影响，这些影响源于这些偏差对行为的具体影响方式。

abstract.text: We study a model of cheap talk with one substantive assumption: The sender's preferences are state independent. Our main observation is that such a sender gains credibility by degrading self‐serving information. Using this observation, we examine the sender's benefits from communication, assess the value of commitment, and explicitly solve for sender‐optimal equilibria in three examples. A key result is a geometric characterization of the value of cheap talk, described by the quasi concave envelope of the sender's value function.

10.3982/ecta15674.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个关于廉价交谈的模型，该模型有一个基本假设：发送者的偏好是状态独立的。我们的主要发现是，这样的发送者通过贬低自我服务的信息来获得可信度。基于这一发现，我们分析了发送者从沟通中获得的收益，评估了承诺的价值，并在三个例子中明确求解了发送者最优均衡。一个关键结果是，廉价交谈的价值可以用发送者价值函数的拟凹包络来几何化描述。

abstract.text: We consider social welfare functions that satisfy Arrow's classic axioms of independence of irrelevant alternatives and Pareto optimality when the outcome space is the convex hull of some finite set of alternatives. Individual and collective preferences are assumed to be continuous and convex, which guarantees the existence of maximal elements and the consistency of choice functions that return these elements, even without insisting on transitivity. We provide characterizations of both the domains of preferences and the social welfare functions that allow for anonymous Arrovian aggregation. The domains admit arbitrary preferences over alternatives, which completely determine an agent's preferences over all mixed outcomes.
