On these domains, Arrow's impossibility turns into a complete characterization of a unique social welfare function, which can be readily applied in settings involving divisible resources such as probability, time, or money.

10.3982/ecta15749.abstractZh: 我们考虑满足Arrow经典公理的社会福利函数，这些公理包括无关替代方案的独立性以及帕累托最优性。当结果空间是某些有限替代方案的凸包时，这些公理依然成立。假设个体和集体偏好是连续且凸的，这保证了最大元素的存在以及选择函数的一致性，即使不要求传递性。我们提供了偏好域和允许匿名Arrow聚合的社会福利函数的特征描述。这些偏好域允许对替代方案进行任意偏好设定，从而完全确定代理人对所有混合结果的偏好。在这些域上，Arrow的不可能性转化为唯一社会福利函数的完整特征描述，这一描述可以广泛应用于涉及可分割资源的场景，如概率、时间或金钱。

abstract.text: I study a mechanism design problem in which a designer allocates a single good to one of several agents, and the mechanism is followed by an aftermarket —a post‐mechanism game played between the agent who acquired the good and third‐party market participants. The designer has preferences over final outcomes, but she cannot design the aftermarket. However, she can influence its information structure by publicly disclosing information elicited from the agents by the mechanism. I introduce a class of allocation and disclosure rules, called cutoff rules , that disclose information about the buyer's type only by revealing information about the realization of a random threshold (cutoff) that she had to outbid to win the object. When there is a single agent in the mechanism, I show that the optimal cutoff mechanism offers full privacy to the agent. In contrast, when there are multiple agents, the optimal cutoff mechanism may disclose information about the winner's type; I provide sufficient conditions for optimality of simple designs. I also characterize aftermarkets for which restricting attention to cutoff mechanisms is without loss of generality in a subclass of all feasible mechanisms satisfying additional conditions.

10.3982/ecta15768.abstractZh: 我研究了一个机制设计问题，其中设计者将一个单一商品分配给几个代理人之一，随后会有一个售后市场——即代理人获得商品后与第三方市场参与者之间的博弈。设计者对最终结果有偏好，但她无法设计售后市场。然而，她可以通过公开披露机制中从代理人那里获取的信息来影响其信息结构。我引入了一类分配和披露规则，称为“截止规则”，这些规则仅通过揭示她为赢得商品而必须超过的随机阈值的信息来披露有关买家类型的信息。当机制中只有单个代理人时，我证明了最优的截止机制为代理人提供了完全隐私。相比之下，当有多个代理人时，最优的截止机制可能会披露有关获胜者类型的信息；我提供了简单设计最优性的充分条件。我还描述了在满足条件的所有可行机制中，仅限制截止机制而不损失一般性的售后市场。

abstract.text: We measure the impact of increasing integration between rural villages and outside labor markets. Seasonal flash floods cause exogenous and unpredictable loss of market access. We study the impact of new bridges that eliminate this risk. Identification exploits variation in riverbank characteristics that preclude bridge construction in some villages, despite similar need. We collect detailed annual household surveys over three years, and weekly telephone followups to study contemporaneous effects of flooding. Floods decrease labor market income by 18 percent when no bridge is present. Bridges eliminate this effect. The indirect effects on labor market choice, farm investment, and savings are quantitatively important and consistent with the predictions of a general equilibrium model in which farm investment is risky, and households manage labor market risk and agricultural risk simultaneously. In the calibrated model, the increase in consumption‐equivalent welfare is substantially larger than the increase in income due to the ability to mitigate risk.

10.3982/ecta15828.abstractZh: 我们研究了农村村庄与外部劳动力市场之间日益紧密的融合所带来的影响。季节性洪水会导致市场进入的不可预测性损失。我们研究了消除这种风险的新桥梁所带来的影响。研究利用河岸特征的差异来识别哪些村庄无法建设桥梁，尽管这些村庄同样需要桥梁。我们收集了三年的详细家庭调查数据，并通过每周电话调查来研究洪水对劳动力市场的影响。在没有桥梁的情况下，洪水会使劳动力市场的收入减少18%。而桥梁则消除了这一影响。对劳动力市场选择、农业投资以及储蓄的间接影响是显著的，并且与一般均衡模型的预测一致，该模型认为农业投资存在风险，而家庭需要同时管理劳动力市场和农业风险。在校准后的模型中，由于能够减轻风险，消费等效福利的增加幅度远远大于收入的增加幅度。

abstract.text: We develop a tractable model of endogenous production networks. Each one of a number of products can be produced by combining labor and an endogenous subset of the other products as inputs. Different combinations of inputs generate (prespecified) levels of productivity and various distortions may affect costs and prices. We establish the existence and uniqueness of an equilibrium and provide comparative static results on how prices and endogenous technology/input choices (and thus the production network) respond to changes in parameters. These results show that improvements in technology (or reductions in distortions) spread throughout the economy via input–output linkages and reduce all prices, and under reasonable restrictions on the menu of production technologies, also lead to a denser production network. Using a dynamic version of the model, we establish that the endogenous evolution of the production network could be a powerful force towards sustained economic growth. At the root of this result is the fact that the arrival of a few new products expands the set of technological possibilities of all existing industries by a large amount—that is, if there are n products, the arrival of one more new product increases the combinations of inputs that each existing product can use from 2 n −1 to 2 n , thus enabling significantly more pronounced cost reductions from choice of input combinations. These cost reductions then spread to other industries via lower input prices and incentivize them to also adopt additional inputs.

10.3982/ecta15899.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个可行性的内生生产网络模型。多种产品可以通过结合劳动力和其他产品作为投入来生产。不同的投入组合会产生（预先指定的）生产力水平，而各种扭曲因素可能会影响成本和价格。我们证明了均衡的存在性和唯一性，并提供了关于价格和内生技术/投入选择（以及生产网络）如何响应参数变化的比较静态结果。这些结果表明，技术的改进（或扭曲的减少）通过投入-产出联系在整个经济中传播，从而降低所有价格；在合理限制生产技术组合的前提下，还会导致生产网络的更加密集。使用模型的动态版本，我们证明生产网络的内生演化可以成为推动持续经济增长的强大力量。这一结果的基础在于，少数新产品的出现会大幅扩展所有现有行业的技术可能性——也就是说，如果有n种产品，又一种新产品的出现会将每种现有产品可以使用的投入组合从2^n-1增加到2^n，从而通过选择不同的投入组合实现更显著的成本降低。这些成本降低随后会通过降低投入价格激励其他行业也采用额外的投入。

abstract.text: Consider an extensive‐form mechanism, run by an auctioneer who communicates sequentially and privately with bidders. Suppose the auctioneer can deviate from the rules provided that no single bidder detects the deviation. A mechanism is credible if it is incentive‐compatible for the auctioneer to follow the rules. We study the optimal auctions in which only winners pay, under symmetric independent private values. The first‐price auction is the unique credible static mechanism. The ascending auction is the unique credible strategy‐proof mechanism.

10.3982/ecta15925.abstractZh: 考虑一种由拍卖师操作的广义机制，拍卖师与竞买者进行顺序且私密的沟通。假设拍卖师可以在没有单个竞买者察觉到偏差的情况下偏离规则。如果拍卖师遵守规则与激励相容，则该机制是可信的。我们研究了在对称独立私人价值下，仅胜出者支付的最优拍卖。第一价格拍卖是唯一的可信静态机制。升价拍卖是唯一的可信策略证明机制。

abstract.text: We study the role of financial frictions and firm heterogeneity in determining the investment channel of monetary policy. Empirically, we find that firms with low default risk—those with low debt burdens and high “distance to default”— are the most responsive to monetary shocks. We interpret these findings using a heterogeneous firm New Keynesian model with default risk. In our model, low‐risk firms are more responsive to monetary shocks because they face a flatter marginal cost curve for financing investment. The aggregate effect of monetary policy may therefore depend on the distribution of default risk, which varies over time.

10.3982/ecta15949.abstractZh: 我们研究了金融摩擦和企业异质性在决定货币政策投资渠道中的作用。实证研究表明，违约风险较低的企业——那些债务负担较低且“违约距离”较高的企业——对货币冲击的反应最为敏感。我们使用带有违约风险的非新凯恩斯模型来解释这些发现。在我们的模型中，低风险企业对货币冲击的反应更为敏感，因为它们面临的融资投资边际成本曲线更为平坦。因此，货币政策的总体效应可能取决于违约风险的分布，而这种风险会随时间变化。

abstract.text: We design a labor market experiment to compare demand‐ and supply‐side policies to tackle youth unemployment, a key issue in low‐income countries. The experiment tracks 1700 workers and 1500 firms over four years to compare the effect of offering workers either vocational training (VT) or firm‐provided training (FT) for six months in a common setting where youth unemployment is above 60%. Relative to control workers, we find that, averaged over three post‐intervention years, FT and VT workers: (i) enjoy large and similar upticks in sector‐specific skills, (ii) significantly improve their employment rates, and (iii) experience marked improvements in an index of labor market outcomes. These averages, however, mask differences in dynamics: FT gains materialize quickly but fade over time, while VT gains emerge slowly but are long‐lasting, leading VT worker employment and earning profiles to rise above those of FT workers. Estimating a job ladder model of worker search reveals the key reason for this: VT workers receive significantly higher rates of job offers when unemployed, thus hastening their movement back into work. This likely stems from the fact that the skills of VT workers are certified and therefore can be demonstrated to potential employers. Tackling youth unemployment by skilling youth using vocational training pre‐labor market entry therefore appears to be more effective than incentivizing firms through wage subsidies to hire and train young labor market entrants.

10.3982/ecta15959.abstractZh: 我们设计了一项劳动力市场实验，旨在比较需求侧和供给侧政策在解决低收入国家青年失业问题上的效果。该实验跟踪了1700名工人和1500家企业的四年数据，以比较在青年失业率超过60%的情况下，向工人提供为期六个月的职业培训或企业提供的培训所带来的影响。与对照组工人相比，我们发现，在干预后的三年时间里，接受培训或职业培训的工人：(i) 在特定领域的技能方面表现出显著且相似的提升；(ii) 就业率显著提高；(iii) 劳动力市场成果指标也有显著改善。然而，这些平均值掩盖了动态差异：接受培训工人的技能提升迅速但随时间减弱，而接受职业培训的工人则缓慢但持久地提升技能，导致其就业和收入状况优于接受培训的其他工人。通过构建工人求职模型，我们揭示了这一现象的关键原因：在失业状态下，接受职业培训的工人获得的就业机会明显更高，从而加快了他们重返工作岗位的速度。这可能是因为接受职业培训的工人的技能得到了认证，因此可以向潜在雇主展示。因此，通过职业培训来提升青年的技能，以解决青年失业问题，似乎比通过工资补贴激励企业雇佣和培训年轻劳动力更有效。

abstract.text: Oversubscribed treatments are often allocated using randomized waiting lists. Applicants are ranked randomly, and treatment offers are made following that ranking until all seats are filled. To estimate causal effects, researchers often compare applicants getting and not getting an offer. We show that those two groups are not statistically comparable. Therefore, the estimator arising from that comparison is inconsistent when the number of waitlists goes to infinity. We propose a new estimator, and show that it is consistent, provided the waitlists have at least two seats. Finally, we revisit an application, and we show that using our estimator can lead to a statistically significant difference with respect to the results obtained using the commonly used estimator.

10.3982/ecta16032.abstractZh: 超额供应的治疗项目通常通过随机等待列表来分配。申请者会被随机排序，并根据该排序顺序提供治疗机会，直到所有名额都被填满。为了估计因果效应，研究人员通常会比较获得治疗机会和未获得治疗机会的申请者。我们发现，这两组申请者在统计上不可比。因此，当等待列表的数量趋于无穷大时，基于这种比较的估计方法就不一致了。我们提出了一种新的估计方法，并证明只要等待列表至少有两个名额，该方法就是一致的。最后，我们重新审视了一个应用案例，并发现使用我们的估计方法可以带来统计学上显著的差异，相对于常用的估计方法而言。

abstract.text: Differences in regulated pharmaceutical prices within the European Economic Area create arbitrage opportunities that pharmacy retailers can access through parallel imports. For prescription drugs under patent, parallel trade affects the sharing of profits among an innovating pharmaceutical company, retailers, and parallel traders. We develop a structural model of demand and supply in which retailers can choose the set of goods to sell, thus foreclosing consumers' access to less profitable drugs. This allows retailers to bargain and obtain lower wholesale prices from the manufacturer and parallel trader. With detailed transaction data from Norway, we identify a demand model with unobserved choice sets using retail‐side conditions for optimal assortment decisions of pharmacies. We find that retailer incentives play a significant role in fostering parallel trade penetration and that banning parallel imports would benefit manufacturers as well as prevent pharmacies from foreclosing the manufacturer's product. Finally, in the case of the statin market in Norway, we show that it would be possible to decrease spending and increase profits of the original manufacturer through lump sum transfers associated with a lower reimbursement price, thus decreasing price differentiation across countries.

10.3982/ecta16039.abstractZh: 欧洲经济区内对药品价格的监管差异为药品零售商提供了套利机会，使他们能够通过平行进口来获取药品。对于处于专利保护下的处方药，平行贸易影响了创新制药公司、零售商和平行贸易商之间的利润分配。我们建立了一个供需结构模型，其中零售商可以选择销售哪些商品，从而阻止消费者购买利润较低的药品。这使得零售商能够与制造商和平行贸易商协商，获得更低的批发价格。通过利用挪威的详细交易数据，我们建立了一个包含未观测选择集的需求模型，并考虑了药店最优商品组合决策的条件。我们发现，零售商的激励措施在促进平行贸易的普及方面起着重要作用，而禁止平行进口则有利于制造商，同时还能防止药店拒绝销售制造商的产品。最后，以挪威的他汀类药物市场为例，我们表明，通过降低报销价格进行一次性转移支付，可以降低原制造商的支出并增加其利润，从而减少不同国家之间的价格差异。

abstract.text: We study games in which a network mediates strategic spillovers and externalities among the players. How does a planner optimally target interventions that change individuals' private returns to investment? We analyze this question by decomposing any intervention into orthogonal principal components , which are determined by the network and are ordered according to their associated eigenvalues. There is a close connection between the nature of spillovers and the representation of various principal components in the optimal intervention. In games of strategic complements (substitutes), interventions place more weight on the top (bottom) principal components, which reflect more global (local) network structure. For large budgets, optimal interventions are simple—they essentially involve only a single principal component.

10.3982/ecta16173.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种网络介导策略性溢出效应和外部性的博弈模型。规划者如何最优地选择能够改变个体投资私人回报的干预措施？我们通过将任何干预措施分解为正交的主成分来分析这个问题，这些主成分由网络决定，并根据其对应的特征值进行排序。溢出效应的性质与最优干预措施中各种主成分的表示方式之间存在密切关联。在策略性互补（替代）的博弈中，干预措施更重视那些反映更全局（局部）网络结构的最顶层（底层）主成分。对于较大的预算，最优干预措施非常简单——它们基本上只涉及一个主成分。

abstract.text: In this paper, we study how occupation (or industry) tradability shapes local labor‐market adjustment to immigration. Theoretically, we derive a simple condition under which the arrival of foreign‐born labor into a region crowds native‐born workers out of (or into) immigrant‐intensive jobs, thus lowering (or raising) relative wages in these occupations, and we explain why this process differs within tradable versus within nontradable activities. Using data for U.S. commuting zones over the period 1980–2012, we find—consistent with our theory—that a local influx of immigrants crowds out employment of native‐born workers in more relative to less immigrant‐intensive nontradable jobs, but has no such effect across tradable occupations. Further analysis of occupation labor payments is consistent with adjustment to immigration within tradables occurring more through changes in output (versus changes in prices) when compared to adjustment within nontradables, thereby confirming our model's theoretical mechanism. We then use the model to explore the quantitative consequences of counterfactual changes in U.S. immigration on real wages at the occupation and region level.

10.3982/ecta16196.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了职业（或行业）的可贸易性如何影响当地劳动力市场对移民的适应。理论上，我们推导出一个简单条件：外国出生的劳动力进入一个地区后，会排挤本地出生的工人从事移民密集型工作，从而降低这些职业的相对工资。我们解释了为什么这一过程在可贸易行业与非可贸易行业中有所不同。利用1980至2012年间美国通勤区的数据，我们发现——与我们的理论一致——本地移民的涌入更多地排挤了本地出生工人的非移民密集型工作，而在可贸易行业中则没有这种效应。对职业劳动支付情况的进一步分析表明，可贸易行业对移民的适应更多地通过产出变化来实现，而非价格变化，这进一步证实了我们模型的理论机制。最后，我们利用该模型探讨了美国移民数量发生反事实变化对职业和地区层面实际工资的定量影响。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes a procedure called Testing‐Based Forward Model Selection (TBFMS) in linear regression problems. This procedure inductively selects covariates that add predictive power into a working statistical model before estimating a final regression. The criterion for deciding which covariate to include next and when to stop including covariates is derived from a profile of traditional statistical hypothesis tests. This paper proves probabilistic bounds, which depend on the quality of the tests, for prediction error and the number of selected covariates. As an example, the bounds are then specialized to a case with heteroscedastic data, with tests constructed with the help of Huber–Eicker–White standard errors. Under the assumed regularity conditions, these tests lead to estimation convergence rates matching other common high‐dimensional estimators including Lasso.

10.3982/ecta16273.abstractZh: 本文分析了一种名为“基于检验的前向模型选择”的方法，该方法用于线性回归问题。该方法在估计最终回归模型之前，通过归纳方式选择能够增强预测能力的协变量。决定接下来要包括哪些协变量以及何时停止包含协变量的标准，源自于传统统计假设检验的轮廓。本文还证明了预测误差和所选协变量数量的概率界限，这些界限取决于检验的质量。以异方差数据为例，这些界限被专门应用于该情况，并且检验方法借助Huber–Eicker–White标准误差构建。在假设的规则条件下，这些检验得出的估计收敛速率与其他常见的高维估计方法（包括Lasso）相当。

abstract.text: We test the longstanding hypothesis that ethnic groups organized around “segmentary lineages” are more prone to conflict. Ethnographic accounts suggest that in such societies, which are characterized by strong allegiances to distant relatives, individuals are obligated to come to the aid of fellow lineage members when they become involved in conflicts. As a consequence, small disagreements often escalate into larger‐scale conflicts involving many individuals. We test for a link between segmentary lineage organization and conflict across ethnic groups in sub‐Saharan Africa. Using a number of estimation strategies, including a regression discontinuity design at ethnic boundaries, we find that segmentary lineage societies experience more conflicts, and particularly ones that are retaliatory, long in duration, and large in scale.

10.3982/ecta16327.abstractZh: 我们检验了长期存在的假设，即以“分段世系”为组织基础的族群更容易发生冲突。民族志研究表明，在这类社会中，人们强烈倾向于支持远亲，因此当某位成员卷入冲突时，他们有义务去帮助同属世系的同胞。结果往往是，小规模的争执往往会升级为涉及多人的大规模冲突。我们研究了分段世系组织与非洲次撒哈拉地区不同族群之间冲突之间的关系。通过多种估计方法，包括在族群边界处采用回归不连续设计，我们发现分段世系社会发生的冲突更为频繁，尤其是那些具有报复性、持续时间长且规模较大的冲突。

abstract.text: Theories of bounded rationality often assume a rich dataset of choices from many overlapping menus, limiting their practical applicability. In contrast, we study the problem of identifying the distribution of cognitive characteristics in a population of agents from a minimal dataset that consists of aggregate choice shares from a single menu, and includes no observable covariates of any kind. With homogeneous preferences, we find that “consideration capacity” and “consideration probability” distributions can both be recovered effectively if the menu is sufficiently large. This remains true generically when tastes are heterogeneous with a known distribution. When the taste distribution is unknown, we show that joint choice share data from three “occasions” are generically sufficient for full identification of the cognitive distribution, and also provide substantial information about tastes.

10.3982/ecta16382.abstractZh: 有限理性理论通常假设存在丰富的选择数据集，这些数据集来自多个重叠的选项菜单，这限制了它们的实际应用性。相比之下，我们研究的问题是，仅使用来自单一菜单的聚合选择份额这一最小数据集，来识别群体中认知特征的分布，并且不引入任何可观测的协变量。在偏好同质的情况下，我们发现，如果菜单足够丰富，那么“考虑能力”和“考虑概率”的分布都可以被有效恢复。当偏好具有已知分布且异质时，这一结论同样成立。当偏好分布未知时，我们证明，从三个“场合”中获得的联合选择份额数据通常足以完全识别认知特征的分布，并且还能提供关于偏好的大量信息。

abstract.text: Liver exchange has been practiced in small numbers, mainly to overcome blood‐type incompatibility between patients and their living donors. A donor can donate either his smaller left lobe or the larger right lobe, although the former option is safer. Despite its elevated risk, right‐lobe transplantation is often utilized due to size‐compatibility requirement with the patient. We model liver exchange as a market‐design problem, focusing on logistically simpler two‐way exchanges, and introduce an individually rational, Pareto‐efficient, and incentive‐compatible mechanism. Construction of this mechanism requires novel technical tools regarding bilateral exchanges under partial‐order‐induced preferences. Through simulations we show that not only can liver exchange increase the number of transplants by more than 30%, it can also increase the share of the safer left‐lobe transplants.

10.3982/ecta16400.abstractZh: 肝脏交换目前仅在少数情况下实施，主要是为了解决患者与其活体捐赠者之间的血型不兼容问题。捐赠者可以选择捐赠较小的左叶或较大的右叶，不过前者更为安全。尽管风险较高，但由于与患者的大小匹配要求，右叶移植仍然经常被采用。我们将肝脏交换建模为一个市场设计问题，重点关注逻辑上更为简单的双向交换过程，并引入了一种个体理性、帕累托有效且激励相容的机制。构建这一机制需要针对部分序偏好下的双边交换提出新的技术工具。通过模拟实验表明，肝脏交换不仅可以将移植数量增加30%以上，还能提高更安全的左叶移植的比例。

abstract.text: Using an analytically tractable heterogeneous agent New Keynesian model, we show that whether incomplete markets resolve New Keynesian “paradoxes” depends on the cyclicality of income risk. Incomplete markets reduce the effectiveness of forward guidance and multipliers in a liquidity trap only with procyclical risk. Countercyclical risk amplifies these “puzzles.” Procyclical risk permits determinacy under a peg; countercyclical risk may generate indeterminacy even under the Taylor principle. By affecting the cyclicality of risk, even “passive” fiscal policy influences the effects of monetary policy.

10.3982/ecta16409.abstractZh: 通过采用一个分析上可行的异质代理人新凯恩斯模型，我们证明了不完全市场是否能解决新凯恩斯主义的“悖论”，取决于收入风险的周期性特征。在不完全市场中，只有在顺周期性风险存在的情况下，前向指引和乘数效应才会降低在流动性陷阱中的有效性。逆周期性风险则会放大这些“难题”。顺周期性风险在固定汇率制度下允许确定性；而逆周期性风险即使在泰勒原则下也可能产生不确定性。通过影响风险的周期性特征，即使是“被动”的财政政策也能影响货币政策的效应。

abstract.text: We propose leave‐out estimators of quadratic forms designed for the study of linear models with unrestricted heteroscedasticity. Applications include analysis of variance and tests of linear restrictions in models with many regressors. An approximation algorithm is provided that enables accurate computation of the estimator in very large data sets. We study the large sample properties of our estimator allowing the number of regressors to grow in proportion to the number of observations. Consistency is established in a variety of settings where plug‐in methods and estimators predicated on homoscedasticity exhibit first‐order biases. For quadratic forms of increasing rank, the limiting distribution can be represented by a linear combination of normal and non‐central χ 2 random variables, with normality ensuing under strong identification. Standard error estimators are proposed that enable tests of linear restrictions and the construction of uniformly valid confidence intervals for quadratic forms of interest. We find in Italian social security records that leave‐out estimates of a variance decomposition in a two‐way fixed effects model of wage determination yield substantially different conclusions regarding the relative contribution of workers, firms, and worker‐firm sorting to wage inequality than conventional methods. Monte Carlo exercises corroborate the accuracy of our asymptotic approximations, with clear evidence of non‐normality emerging when worker mobility between blocks of firms is limited.

10.3982/ecta16410.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种用于研究具有无限制异方差性的线性模型的二次型省略估计量。该估计量的应用包括方差分析以及在许多回归变量模型中对线性约束的检验。我们提供了一种近似算法，使得在非常大的数据集中也能准确计算该估计量。我们研究了该估计量在大样本下的性质，允许回归变量的数量随着观测数量的增加而成比例增长。在多种情况下，我们证明了该估计量的一致性，而在那些基于同方差性假设的插入方法和估计量会出现一阶偏差的情况下，该估计量依然表现出良好的性能。对于秩逐渐增加的二次型，其极限分布可以表示为正态与非中心χ²随机变量的线性组合，并且在强识别条件下仍保持正态性。我们提出了标准误差估计量，这些估计量能够用于检验线性约束，并构建对感兴趣二次型具有一致有效性的置信区间。我们在意大利社会保障记录中发现，在双固定效应模型中省略对方差分解的估计，得出的关于工人、企业和工人-企业排序对工资不平等的相对贡献的结论，与传统方法相比有显著不同。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了我们的渐近近似的准确性，当工人在企业集团之间的流动性受到限制时，出现了非正态性的明显证据。

abstract.text: We study preferences over lotteries in which both the prize and the payment date are uncertain. In particular, a time lottery is one in which the prize is fixed but the date is random. With Expected Discounted Utility, individuals must be risk seeking over time lotteries (RSTL). In an incentivized experiment, however, we find that almost all subjects violate this property. Our main contributions are theoretical. We first show that within a very broad class of models, which includes many forms of nonexpected utility and time discounting, it is impossible to accommodate even a single violation of RSTL without also violating a property we termed Stochastic Impatience, a risky counterpart of standard Impatience. We then present two positive results. If one wishes to maintain Stochastic Impatience, violations of RSTL can be accommodated by keeping Independence within periods while relaxing it across periods. If, instead, one is willing to forego Stochastic Impatience, violations of RSTL can be accommodated with a simple generalization of Expected Discounted Utility, obtained by imposing only the behavioral postulates of Discounted Utility and Expected Utility.

10.3982/ecta16427.abstractZh: 我们研究了在奖品和支付日期都不确定的彩票偏好问题。特别是，时间彩票是指奖品是固定的，但支付日期是随机的。根据预期折扣效用理论，个体在时间彩票中必然寻求风险。然而，在一项激励性实验中，我们发现几乎所有参与者都违反了这一特性。我们的主要贡献是理论性的。首先，我们证明在非常广泛的模型类别中，包括许多非预期效用和时间折扣形式，即使只违反一次RSTL特性，也无法不违反我们称之为“随机不耐烦”的特性，这是标准不耐烦特性的风险对应物。然后，我们提出了两个积极的结果。如果希望保持随机不耐烦特性，可以通过在时期内部保持独立性，而在不同时期之间放宽这一特性来适应RSTL的违反。相反，如果愿意放弃随机不耐烦特性，可以通过对预期折扣效用进行简单的推广来适应RSTL的违反，只需遵循折扣效用和预期效用的行为假设即可。

abstract.text: We consider a large class of social learning models in which a group of agents face uncertainty regarding a state of the world, share the same utility function, observe private signals, and interact in a general dynamic setting. We introduce social learning equilibria, a static equilibrium concept that abstracts away from the details of the given extensive form, but nevertheless captures the corresponding asymptotic equilibrium behavior. We establish general conditions for agreement, herding, and information aggregation in equilibrium, highlighting a connection between agreement and information aggregation.

10.3982/ecta16465.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一大类社会学习模型，在这些模型中，一组代理人面临关于世界状态的不确定性，共享相同的效用函数，观察私人信号，并在一般动态环境中进行互动。我们引入了社会学习均衡，这是一种静态均衡概念，它抽象掉了给定扩展形式的细节，但仍然能够捕捉到相应的渐近均衡行为。我们为均衡状态下的一致性、群体行为和信息聚合建立了一般条件，并强调了一致性与信息聚合之间的联系。

abstract.text: This paper considers a Principal–Agent model with hidden action in which the Principal can monitor the Agent by acquiring independent signals conditional on effort at a constant marginal cost. The Principal aims to implement a target effort level at minimal cost. The main result of the paper is that the optimal information‐acquisition strategy is a two‐threshold policy and, consequently, the equilibrium contract specifies two possible wages for the Agent. This result provides a rationale for the frequently observed single‐bonus wage contracts .

10.3982/ecta16475.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个具有隐藏行为的主体-代理模型，其中主体可以通过在恒定边际成本下获取独立信号来监控代理的行为。主体的目标是以最低的成本实现目标努力水平。本文的主要结论是，最优的信息获取策略是一种双阈值策略，因此，均衡契约为代理规定了两种可能的工资水平。这一结论为常见的单一奖金工资契约提供了理论依据。

abstract.text: It is well understood that classical sample selection models are not semiparametrically identified without exclusion restrictions. Lee (2009) developed bounds for the parameters in a model that nests the semiparametric sample selection model. These bounds can be wide. In this paper, we investigate bounds that impose the full structure of a sample selection model with errors that are independent of the explanatory variables but have unknown distribution. The additional structure can significantly reduce the identified set for the parameters of interest. Specifically, we construct the identified set for the parameter vector of interest. It is a one‐dimensional line segment in the parameter space, and we demonstrate that this line segment can be short in practice. We show that the identified set is sharp when the model is correct and empty when there exist no parameter values that make the sample selection model consistent with the data. We also provide non‐sharp bounds under the assumption that the model is correct. These are easier to compute and associated with lower statistical uncertainty than the sharp bounds. Throughout the paper, we illustrate our approach by estimating a standard sample selection model for wages.

10.3982/ecta16481.abstractZh: 众所周知，传统的样本选择模型在没有排除限制的情况下无法实现半参数识别。Lee（2009）为嵌套在半参数样本选择模型中的模型参数提出了界限，这些界限可能相当宽泛。在本文中，我们研究了在样本选择模型中引入额外结构的界限，这些误差与解释变量独立，但分布未知。这种额外结构可以显著缩小感兴趣参数的识别集。具体来说，我们构建了感兴趣参数向量的识别集，该识别集是参数空间中的一条一维线段，并且我们证明在实际应用中这条线段可以较短。我们指出，当模型正确时，识别集是尖锐的；而当不存在使样本选择模型与数据一致的参数值时，识别集则为空。此外，在模型正确的假设下，我们还提供了非尖锐的界限，这些界限更容易计算，并且与尖锐界限相比，统计不确定性更低。在整篇论文中，我们通过估计工资样本选择模型的标准模型来说明我们的方法。

abstract.text: The presence of a westward‐moving frontier of settlement shaped early U.S. history. In 1893, the historian Frederick Jackson Turner famously argued that the American frontier fostered individualism. We investigate the “frontier thesis” and identify its long‐run implications for culture and politics. We track the frontier throughout the 1790–1890 period and construct a novel, county‐level measure of total frontier experience (TFE). Historically, frontier locations had distinctive demographics and greater individualism. Long after the closing of the frontier, counties with greater TFE exhibit more pervasive individualism and opposition to redistribution. This pattern cuts across known divides in the United States, including urban–rural and north–south. We provide evidence on the roots of frontier culture, identifying both selective migration and a causal effect of frontier exposure on individualism. Overall, our findings shed new light on the frontier's persistent legacy of rugged individualism.

10.3982/ecta16484.abstractZh: 向西移动的定居边界塑造了美国早期的历史。1893年，历史学家弗雷德里克·杰克逊·特纳提出，美国边界促进了个人主义的发展。我们探讨了这一“边界论”及其对文化和政治的长期影响。我们追踪了1790至1890年间边界的变化，并提出了一种新的县级衡量指标，用于衡量总边界体验。历史上，边界地区具有独特的人口结构，个人主义更为显著。即使在边界关闭很久之后，拥有更高总边界体验的县仍然表现出更为普遍的个人主义和对再分配的反抗。这种模式跨越了美国已知的城乡和南北差异。我们提供了关于边界文化根源的证据，揭示了选择性迁移以及边界经历对个人主义的影响。总体而言，我们的发现为边界地区持久的个人主义传统提供了新的见解。

abstract.text: Asymptotic bootstrap validity is usually understood as consistency of the distribution of a bootstrap statistic, conditional on the data, for the unconditional limit distribution of a statistic of interest. From this perspective, randomness of the limit bootstrap measure is regarded as a failure of the bootstrap. We show that such limiting randomness does not necessarily invalidate bootstrap inference if validity is understood as control over the frequency of correct inferences in large samples. We first establish sufficient conditions for asymptotic bootstrap validity in cases where the unconditional limit distribution of a statistic can be obtained by averaging a (random) limiting bootstrap distribution. Further, we provide results ensuring the asymptotic validity of the bootstrap as a tool for conditional inference, the leading case being that where a bootstrap distribution estimates consistently a conditional (and thus, random) limit distribution of a statistic. We apply our framework to several inference problems in econometrics, including linear models with possibly nonstationary regressors, CUSUM statistics, conditional Kolmogorov–Smirnov specification tests and tests for constancy of parameters in dynamic econometric models.

10.3982/ecta16557.abstractZh: 渐近自助法有效性通常理解为在给定数据条件下，感兴趣统计量的无条件极限分布的自助统计量分布的一致性。从这个角度来看，极限自助法测度的随机性被视为自助法的失败。我们表明，如果有效性被理解为在大样本中控制正确推断的频率，那么这种极限随机性并不必然使自助法推断无效。我们首先建立了在统计量无条件极限分布可以通过平均一个随机极限自助分布得到的情况下，渐近自助法有效性的充分条件。此外，我们提供了确保自助法作为条件推断工具在渐近意义上的有效性的结果，其中主要情况是自助分布能够一致地估计统计量的条件性（因此也是随机的）极限分布。我们将我们的框架应用于计量经济学中的几个推断问题，包括具有可能非平稳回归量的线性模型、CUSUM统计量、条件性Kolmogorov–Smirnov规格检验以及动态计量经济模型中参数恒定性的检验。

abstract.text: A patient player privately observes a persistent state and interacts with an infinite sequence of myopic uninformed players. The patient player is either a strategic type who maximizes his payoff or one of several commitment types who mechanically play the same action in every period. I focus on situations in which the uninformed player's best reply to a commitment action depends on the state and where the total probability of commitment types is sufficiently small. I show that the patient player's equilibrium payoff is bounded below his commitment payoff in some equilibria under some of his payoff functions. This is because he faces a trade‐off between building his reputation for commitment and signaling favorable information about the state. When players' stage‐game payoff functions are monotone‐supermodular , the patient player receives high payoffs in all states and in all equilibria. Under an additional condition on the state distribution, my reputation model yields a unique prediction on the patient player's equilibrium payoff and on‐path behavior.

10.3982/ecta16584.abstractZh: 一个谨慎的玩家私下观察一个持续存在的状态，并与无限序列的短视且信息不足的玩家进行互动。这个玩家要么是追求自身收益最大化的战略型玩家，要么是机械地在每个时期都采取相同行动的几种承诺型玩家之一。我重点关注这样一种情况：信息不足的玩家对承诺行为的最佳反应取决于当前状态，且承诺型玩家的总数足够少。我证明，在某些收益函数下，谨慎玩家的均衡收益低于其承诺型玩家的收益。这是因为他在建立承诺声誉与传递有关状态的积极信息之间面临着权衡。当玩家的阶段博弈收益函数是单调超模块型的，谨慎玩家在所有状态和所有均衡中都能获得高收益。在状态分布的额外条件下，我的声誉模型能够唯一地预测谨慎玩家的均衡收益以及其行为模式。

abstract.text: Treatment for depression is complex, requiring decisions that may involve trade-offs between exploiting treatments with the highest expected value and experimenting with treatments with higher possible payoffs. Using patient claims data, we show that among skilled doctors, using a broader portfolio of drugs predicts better patient outcomes, except in cases where doctors' decisions violate loose professional guidelines. We introduce a behavioral model of decision making guided by our empirical observations. The model's novel feature is that the trade-off between exploitation and experimentation depends on the doctor's diagnostic skill. The model predicts that higher diagnostic skill leads to greater diversity in drug choice and better matching of drugs to patients even among doctors with the same initial beliefs regarding drug effectiveness. Consistent with the finding that guideline violations predict poorer patient outcomes, simulations of the model suggest that increasing the number of possible drug choices can lower performance.

10.3982/ecta16591.abstractZh: 抑郁症的治疗过程非常复杂，需要做出一些权衡，比如如何在利用预期价值最高的治疗方法和尝试可能带来更高回报的治疗方法之间做出选择。通过患者索赔数据，我们发现，在熟练的医生中，使用更多种类的药物能够带来更好的患者治疗效果，除非医生的决策违反了宽松的专业准则。我们引入了一个基于实证观察的行为决策模型。该模型的一个创新之处在于，利用和尝试治疗方法之间的权衡取决于医生的诊断能力。模型预测，更高的诊断能力会导致药物选择的多样性增加，即使是在对药物效果持有相同初始信念的医生之间，也能实现更好的药物匹配。与“违反指南会导致患者治疗效果较差”这一发现一致，模型模拟表明，增加可能的药物选择数量可能会降低治疗效果。

abstract.text: Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT), the leading behavioral account of decisionmaking under uncertainty, avoids the dominance violations implicit in Prospect Theory (PT) by assuming that the probability weight applied to a given outcome depends on its ranking. We devise a simple and direct nonparametric method for measuring the change in relative probability weights resulting from a change in payoff ranks. We find no evidence that these weights are even modestly sensitive to ranks. Conventional calibrations of CPT preferences imply that the percentage change in probability weights should be an order of magnitude larger than we observe. It follows either that probability weighting is not rank‐dependent, or that the weighting function is nearly linear. Nonparametric measurement of the change in relative probability weights resulting from changes in probabilities rules out the second possibility. Additional tests nevertheless indicate that the dominance patterns predicted by PT do not arise. We reconcile these findings by positing a form of complexity aversion that generalizes the well‐known certainty effect.

10.3982/ecta16646.abstractZh: 累积前景理论（CPT）作为不确定性下决策行为理论的代表，避免了前景理论中的支配性违反现象。该理论假设给定结果的概率权重取决于其排名。我们提出了一种简单直接的非参数方法，用于测量由于收益排名变化而导致的相对概率权重的变化。研究发现，这些权重对排名的敏感性并不显著。传统上，对CPT偏好的校准表明概率权重的变化幅度应该比我们观察到的要大一个数量级。这暗示概率加权并不依赖于排名，或者加权函数几乎是线性的。然而，非参数方法对概率变化导致的相对概率权重变化的测量排除了后一种可能性。尽管如此，进一步的测试表明，前景理论所预测的支配性模式并未出现。我们通过提出一种复杂性厌恶理论来调和这些发现，该理论扩展了众所周知的确定性效应。

abstract.text: We prove the folk theorem for discounted repeated games with anonymous random matching. We allow non‐uniform matching, include asymmetric payoffs, and place no restrictions on the stage game other than full dimensionality. No record‐keeping or communication devices—including cheap talk communication and public randomization—are necessary.

10.3982/ecta16680.abstractZh: 我们证明了针对匿名随机匹配的折现重复博弈的民间定理。我们允许非均匀匹配，包含不对称收益，并且除了完全维度要求外，不对阶段博弈施加其他限制。无需记录保存或通信设备——包括廉价通信和公开随机化——即可实现该定理。

abstract.text: In this paper, we show that stable outcomes exist in matching environments with complementarities, such as social media platforms or markets for patent licenses. Our results apply to both nontransferable and transferable utility settings, and allow for multilateral agreements and those with externalities. In particular, we show that stable outcomes in these settings are characterized by the largest fixed point of a monotone operator, and so can be found using an algorithm; in the nontransferable utility case, this is a one‐sided deferred acceptance algorithm, rather than a Gale–Shapley algorithm. We also give a monotone comparative statics result as well as a comparative static on the effect of bundling contracts together. These illustrate the impact of design decisions, such as increased privacy protections on social media, or the use of antitrust law to disallow patent pools, on stable outcomes.

10.3982/ecta16686.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们证明了在具有互补性的匹配环境中，如社交媒体平台或专利许可市场，存在稳定的结果。我们的研究结果适用于不可转让和可转让的效用场景，并适用于多边协议以及存在外部性的情况。特别地，我们指出，在这些场景中，稳定结果的特性表现为单调算子的极大固定点，因此可以通过某种算法来寻找这些稳定结果；在不可转让效用的情况下，这种算法是一种单边延迟接受算法，而非Gale-Shapley算法。我们还得出了关于捆绑合同效应的单调比较静态结果。这些结果说明了设计决策的影响，例如增加社交媒体上的隐私保护，或使用反垄断法来禁止专利池，对稳定结果的影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the determinants of political polarization, a phenomenon of increasing relevance in Western democracies. How much of polarization is driven by divergence in the ideologies of politicians? How much is instead the result of changes in the capacity of parties to control their members? We use detailed internal information on party discipline in the context of the U.S. Congress—whip count data for 1977–1986—to identify and structurally estimate an economic model of legislative activity in which agenda selection, party discipline, and member votes are endogenous. The model delivers estimates of the ideological preferences of politicians, the extent of party control, and allows us to assess the effects of polarization through agenda setting (i.e., which alternatives to a status quo are strategically pursued). We find that parties account for approximately 40% of the political polarization in legislative voting over this time period, a critical inflection point in U.S. polarization. We also show that, absent party control, historically significant economic policies would have not passed or lost substantial support. Counterfactual exercises establish that party control is highly relevant for the probability of success of a given bill and that polarization in ideological preferences is more consequential for policy selection, resulting in different bills being pursued.

10.3982/ecta16756.abstractZh: 本文研究了政治两极分化的决定因素，这一现象在西方民主国家中日益突出。其中，有多少两极分化是由政客意识形态的差异所驱动的？又有多少是由于政党控制其成员的能力发生变化所导致的？我们利用了美国国会内部关于政党纪律的详细信息——1977年至1986年的党鞭统计数据——来识别并构建一种经济模型，该模型将议程选择、政党纪律和成员投票视为内生变量。该模型能够估算出政客的意识形态偏好、政党的控制程度，并帮助我们评估两极分化通过议程设置产生的影响（即，哪些替代方案会被战略性地追求以改变现状）。研究发现，在这段时间内，政党在立法投票中的影响力约占政治两极分化的40%，这在美国政治两极分化中是一个重要的转折点。此外，我们还发现，如果没有政党控制，历史上重要的经济政策可能无法通过或会失去大量支持。反事实分析表明，政党控制对于某项法案成功的概率具有高度相关性，而意识形态上的两极分化对政策选择的影响更为显著，从而导致不同的法案被提出。

abstract.text: We propose a way to formalize the relationship between descriptive analysis and structural estimation. A researcher reports an estimate ĉ of a structural quantity of interest c that is exactly or asymptotically unbiased under some base model. The researcher also reports descriptive statistics γ ˆ that estimate features γ of the distribution of the data that are related to c under the base model. A reader entertains a less restrictive model that is local to the base model, under which the estimate ĉ may be biased. We study the reduction in worst‐case bias from a restriction that requires the reader's model to respect the relationship between c and γ specified by the base model. Our main result shows that the proportional reduction in worst‐case bias depends only on a quantity we call the informativeness of γ ˆ for ĉ . Informativeness can be easily estimated even for complex models. We recommend that researchers report estimated informativeness alongside their descriptive analyses, and we illustrate with applications to three recent papers.

10.3982/ecta16768.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种将描述性分析与结构估计相结合的方法。研究者报告了一个结构量c的估计值ĉ，该估计值在某些基础模型下是精确或无偏的。研究者还报告了描述性统计数据γˆ，这些统计数据估计了在基础模型下与c相关的数据分布特征γ。读者会考虑一个相对于基础模型更为宽松的模型，在该模型下，估计值ĉ可能存在偏差。我们研究了通过要求读者的模型遵循基础模型所指定的c与γ之间的关系，来减少最坏情况下的偏差。我们的主要结果表明，最坏情况下偏差的比例减少仅取决于我们称之为γˆ对ĉ的信息量的一个量。即使对于复杂的模型，信息量也可以很容易地估计。我们建议研究者在描述性分析的同时报告估计的信息量，并通过三个最近的研究案例进行了说明。

abstract.text: This paper explores the role of civic culture in expanding fiscal capacity by developing a model based on reciprocal obligations: citizens pay their taxes and the state provides public goods. Civic culture evolves over time according to the relative payoff of civic‐minded and materialist citizens. A strong civic culture manifests itself as high tax revenues sustained by high levels of voluntary tax compliance and provision of public goods. This captures the idea of government as a reciprocal social contract between the state and its citizens. The paper highlights the role of political institutions and common interests in the emergence of civic culture.

10.3982/ecta16863.abstractZh: 本文探讨了公民文化在扩大财政能力中的作用，通过构建一个基于互惠义务的模型来进行分析：公民缴纳税款，而国家则提供公共产品。公民文化随着时间的推移而演变，这取决于具有公民意识与物质主义倾向的公民之间的相对收益。强大的公民文化表现为高额的税收收入，这得益于高水平的自愿纳税行为以及公共产品的提供。这体现了政府作为国家与公民之间互惠社会契约的角色。本文还强调了政治制度和共同利益在公民文化形成中的作用。

abstract.text: We exhibit a natural environment, social learning among heterogeneous agents, where even slight misperceptions can have a large negative impact on long‐run learning outcomes. We consider a population of agents who obtain information about the state of the world both from initial private signals and by observing a random sample of other agents' actions over time, where agents' actions depend not only on their beliefs about the state but also on their idiosyncratic types (e.g., tastes or risk attitudes). When agents are correct about the type distribution in the population, they learn the true state in the long run. By contrast, we show, first, that even arbitrarily small amounts of misperception about the type distribution can generate extreme breakdowns of information aggregation, where in the long run all agents incorrectly assign probability 1 to some fixed state of the world, regardless of the true underlying state. Second, any misperception of the type distribution leads long‐run beliefs and behavior to vary only coarsely with the state, and we provide systematic predictions for how the nature of misperception shapes these coarse long‐run outcomes. Third, we show that how fragile information aggregation is against misperception depends on the richness of agents' payoff‐relevant uncertainty; a design implication is that information aggregation can be improved by simplifying agents' learning environment. The key feature behind our findings is that agents' belief‐updating becomes “decoupled” from the true state over time. We point to other environments where this feature is present and leads to similar fragility results.

10.3982/ecta16981.abstractZh: 我们展示了一个自然的环境，其中异质代理人之间存在社会学习，即使是轻微的误解也可能对长期学习成果产生巨大负面影响。我们考虑了一个由代理人组成的群体，他们获取关于世界状态的信息，这些信息既来自初始的私人信号，也通过观察其他代理人随时间的行为来获得。代理人的行为不仅取决于他们对状态的信念，还取决于他们的独特特征（例如，偏好或风险态度）。当代理人对群体中的类型分布有正确的认识时，他们能够在长期内了解真实的状态。相反，我们首先证明，即使是关于类型分布的微小误解，也可能导致信息聚合的极端崩溃，在长期内，所有代理人都会错误地将概率1分配给某个固定的世界状态，而忽略了真实的底层状态。其次，任何关于类型分布的误解都会导致长期信念和行为仅与状态大致相关，我们为这种误解如何塑造这些粗略的长期结果提供了系统的预测。第三，我们表明，信息聚合对误解的脆弱性取决于代理人关于收益相关的不确定性的丰富程度；一个设计上的启示是，通过简化代理人的学习环境，可以改善信息聚合的效果。我们的研究发现的关键特征是，代理人的信念更新随着时间的推移变得与真实状态“分离”。我们指出其他也存在这种特征的环境，并且导致了类似的脆弱性结果。

abstract.text: New ways of doing things often get started through the actions of a few innovators, then diffuse rapidly as more and more people come into contact with prior adopters in their social network. Much of the literature focuses on the speed of diffusion as a function of the network topology. In practice, the topology may not be known with any precision, and it is constantly in flux as links are formed and severed. Here, we establish an upper bound on the expected waiting time until a given proportion of the population has adopted that holds independently of the network structure. Kreindler and Young (2014) demonstrated such a bound for regular networks when agents choose between two options: the innovation and the status quo. Our bound holds for directed and undirected networks of arbitrary size and degree distribution, and for multiple competing innovations with different payoffs.

10.3982/ecta17007.abstractZh: 新的做事方式往往由少数创新者开始，然后随着越来越多的人接触到他们社交网络中的早期采用者，这种方式会迅速传播。许多文献都关注了传播速度与网络拓扑结构之间的关系。实际上，网络拓扑结构可能并不容易精确确定，而且随着链接的创建和拆除，拓扑结构会不断变化。在这里，我们建立了一个关于预期等待时间的上界，该上界与网络结构无关。Kreindler和Young（2014）在代理面临两个选择时，即采用创新或维持现状时，证明了这样一个上界。我们的上界适用于有向和无向网络，无论其规模和度分布如何，也适用于多个具有不同回报的竞争性创新。

abstract.text: We study equilibria in multi‐asset and multi‐agent continuous‐time economies with asymmetric information and bounded rational noise traders. We establish the existence of two equilibria. First, a full communication equilibrium where the informed agents' signal is disclosed to the market and static policies are optimal. Second, a partial communication equilibrium where the signal disclosed is affine in the informed and noise traders' signals, and dynamic policies are optimal. Here, information asymmetry creates demand for two public funds, as well as a dark pool where private information trades can be implemented. Markets are endogenously complete and equilibrium returns have a three factor structure with stochastic factors and loadings. Results are valid for constant absolute risk averse investors, general vector diffusions for fundamentals, nonlinear terminal payoffs, and non‐Gaussian noise trading. Asset price dynamics and public information flows are endogenous, and rational expectations equilibria are special cases of the general results.

10.3982/ecta17038.abstractZh: 我们研究了在具有不对称信息且噪声交易者行为为有限理性条件下的多资产、多主体连续时间经济中的均衡问题。我们证明了两种均衡的存在性。第一种是完全沟通均衡，在这种均衡中，信息充分的代理人的信号会被公开给市场，静态策略是最优的。第二种是部分沟通均衡，在这种均衡中，公开的信号在信息充分的代理人与噪声交易者的信号之间是仿射的，动态策略是最优的。信息不对称导致了对两种公共基金的需求，同时也催生了一个暗盘市场，用于实现私人信息的交易。市场是内生完备的，均衡回报具有三因素结构，其中随机因素和权重是确定的。这些结果适用于绝对风险厌恶度数为常数的投资者、基本面的一般向量扩散模型、非线性终端收益情况以及非高斯噪声交易情况。资产价格动态和公共信息流动都是内生性的，理性预期均衡是一般结果的特例。

abstract.text: Weak contract enforcement may reduce the efficiency of production in developing countries. I study how contract enforcement affects efficiency in procurement auctions for the largest power projects in India. I gather data on bidding and ex post contract renegotiation and find that the renegotiation of contracts in response to cost shocks is widespread, despite that bidders are allowed to index their bids to future costs like the price of coal. To study heterogeneity in bidding strategies, I construct a new measure of firm connectedness, based on whether a firm has been awarded coal concessions by the Government. Connected firms choose to index less of the value of their bids to coal prices and, through this strategy, expose themselves to cost shocks to induce renegotiation. I use a structural model of bidding in a scoring auction to characterize equilibrium bidding when bidders are heterogeneous both in cost and in the payments they expect after renegotiation. The model estimates show that bidders offer power below cost due to the expected value of later renegotiation. The model is used to simulate bidding and efficiency with strict contract enforcement. Contract enforcement is found to be pro‐competitive. With no renegotiation, equilibrium bids would rise to cover cost, but markups relative to total contract value fall sharply. Production costs decline, due to projects being allocated to lower‐cost bidders over those who expect larger payments in renegotiation.

10.3982/ecta17041.abstractZh: 薄弱的合同执行可能会降低发展中国家的生产效率。我研究了合同执行对印度最大电力项目采购拍卖效率的影响。我收集了关于投标和事后合同重新谈判的数据，发现尽管投标者被允许将投标价格与未来成本（如煤炭价格）挂钩，但针对成本冲击重新谈判合同的情况却非常普遍。为了研究投标策略的异质性，我构建了一种新的企业关联性指标，该指标基于企业是否获得了政府授予的煤炭特许权。具有关联性的企业选择较少地将投标价格与煤炭价格挂钩，通过这种策略，它们会面临成本冲击，从而促使合同重新谈判。我使用了一个结构模型来描述在投标者成本和预期重新谈判后的支付金额都存在异质性时的均衡投标行为。模型估计结果显示，由于预期后续重新谈判的价值，投标者提供的电力价格低于成本。该模型还用于模拟在严格合同执行下的投标和效率情况。研究发现，合同执行具有促进竞争的作用。如果没有重新谈判，均衡投标价格将会上升以覆盖成本，但相对于总合同价值而言，价格虚高幅度会显著下降。由于项目被分配给成本较低的投标者，而不是那些预期在重新谈判中能获得更高支付金额的投标者，因此生产成本得以降低。

abstract.text: We propose a decomposition of the realized covariance matrix into components based on the signs of the underlying high‐frequency returns, and we derive the asymptotic properties of the resulting realized semicovariance measures as the sampling interval goes to zero. The first‐order asymptotic results highlight how the same‐sign and mixed‐sign components load differently on economic information related to stochastic correlation and jumps. The second‐order asymptotic results reveal the structure underlying the same‐sign semicovariances, as manifested in the form of co‐drifting and dynamic “leverage” effects. In line with this anatomy, we use data on a large cross‐section of individual stocks to empirically document distinct dynamic dependencies in the different realized semicovariance components. We show that the accuracy of portfolio return variance forecasts may be significantly improved by exploiting the information in realized semicovariances.

10.3982/ecta17056.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种将实现协方差矩阵分解为基于基础高频回报符号的组成部分的方法，并推导了随着采样间隔趋近于零时，所得到的实现半协方差度量指标的渐近性质。一阶渐近结果揭示了同符号和混合符号组成部分对与随机相关性和跳跃相关的经济信息的不同加载方式。二阶渐近结果揭示了同符号半协方差的结构，表现为共同漂移和动态“杠杆”效应。基于这一结构分析，我们使用大量个股的数据，实证验证了不同实现半协方差组成部分中存在的不同动态依赖性。我们表明，通过利用实现半协方差中的信息，可以显著改善投资组合回报方差预测的准确性。

abstract.text: We consider statistical inference in games. Each player obtains a small random sample of other players' actions, uses statistical inference to estimate their actions, and chooses an optimal action based on the estimate. In a sampling equilibrium with statistical inference (SESI), the sample is drawn from the distribution of players' actions based on this process. We characterize the set of SESIs in large two‐action games, and compare their predictions to those of Nash equilibrium, and for different sample sizes and statistical inference procedures. We then study applications to competitive markets, markets with network effects, monopoly pricing, and search and matching markets.

10.3982/ecta17105.abstractZh: 我们研究了博弈中的统计推断问题。每个玩家都会获得其他玩家行为的小样本数据，利用统计推断来估计其他玩家的行为，并基于这些估计选择最优行为。在具有统计推断的抽样均衡中，样本是从基于该过程的玩家行为分布中抽选出来的。我们描述了大型双行动博弈中这类均衡的集合，并比较了它们的预测结果与纳什均衡的预测结果，同时考虑了不同的样本大小和统计推断方法。随后，我们研究了这些均衡在竞争市场、具有网络效应的市场、垄断定价以及搜索与匹配市场中的应用。

abstract.text: This paper studies the robustness of an equilibrium to incomplete information in binary‐action supermodular games. Using a generalized version of belief operator, we explore the restrictions that prior beliefs impose on higher order beliefs. In particular, we obtain a nontrivial lower bound on the probability of a common belief event, uniform over type spaces, when the underlying game has a monotone potential. Conversely, when the game has no monotone potential, we construct a type space with an arbitrarily high probability event in which players never have common belief about that event. As an implication of these results, we show for generic binary‐action supermodular games that an action profile is robust to incomplete information if and only if it is a monotone potential maximizer. Our study offers new methodology and insight to the analysis of global game equilibrium selection.

10.3982/ecta17237.abstractZh: 本文研究了在二元行动超模博弈中，均衡对信息不完全性的鲁棒性。通过采用广义信念算子，我们探讨了先验信念对更高阶信念的约束作用。特别地，我们获得了一种非平凡的下界，用于描述在底层博弈具有单调势的情况下，共同信念事件的概率分布，该下界在类型空间上是一致的。相反地，当博弈没有单调势时，我们构造了一个类型空间，在该空间中，玩家永远不会对该事件有共同信念。作为这些结果的一个推论，我们证明了对于一般的二元行动超模博弈，一个行动配置对信息不完全性是鲁棒的，当且仅当它是一个单调势最大化者。我们的研究为全局博弈均衡选择的分析提供了新的方法和见解。

abstract.text: We study games of incomplete information as both the information structure and the extensive form vary. An analyst may know the payoff‐relevant data but not the players' private information, nor the extensive form that governs their play. Alternatively, a designer may be able to build a mechanism from these ingredients. We characterize all outcomes that can arise in an equilibrium of some extensive form with some information structure. We show how to specialize our main concept to capture the additional restrictions implied by extensive‐form refinements.

10.3982/ecta17260.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息不完全情况下的博弈，包括信息结构和扩展形式的变化。分析师可能了解与收益相关的数据，但不知道玩家的私人信息，也不了解支配他们行为的扩展形式。或者，设计者可能能够利用这些要素构建机制。我们描述了在某些信息结构下的扩展形式均衡中可能出现的所有结果。我们展示了如何进一步细化我们的主要概念，以涵盖扩展形式细化所带来的额外限制。

abstract.text: Savage (1954) provided the first axiomatic characterization of expected utility without relying on any given probabilities or utilities. It is the most famous preference axiomatization existing. This note shows that Savage's axiom P3 is implied by the other axioms, which reveals its redundancy. It is remarkable that this was not noticed before as Savage's axiomatization has been studied and taught by hundreds of researchers for more than six decades.

10.3982/ecta17428.abstractZh: Savage在1954年首次提出了期望效用的公理描述，而无需依赖任何给定的概率或效用值。这是目前最著名的偏好公理化理论。本文指出，Savage的公理P3实际上是由其他公理所蕴含的，这揭示了其冗余性。值得注意的是，这一事实之前并未被注意到，因为Savage的公理化理论已经被数百名研究者研究并教授了六十多年。

abstract.text: We study the behavior of the U.S. labor share over the past 90 years. We find that the observed decline of the labor share is entirely explained by the capitalization of intellectual property products in the national income and product accounts.

10.3982/ecta17477.abstractZh: 我们研究了过去90年美国劳动份额的变化情况。研究发现，劳动份额的下降完全可以通过国民收入与产品账户中知识产权产品的资本化来解释。

abstract.text: We investigate claims made in Giacomini and White (2006) and Diebold (2015) regarding the asymptotic normality of a test of equal predictive ability. A counterexample is provided in which, instead, the test statistic diverges with probability 1 under the null.

10.3982/ecta17523.abstractZh: 我们研究了Giacomini和White（2006）以及Diebold（2015）关于等预测能力检验的渐近正态性提出的观点。我们提供了一个反例，在该反例中，检验统计量在零假设下以概率1发散。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a valid bootstrap‐based distributional approximation for M ‐estimators exhibiting a Chernoff (1964)‐type limiting distribution. For estimators of this kind, the standard nonparametric bootstrap is inconsistent. The method proposed herein is based on the nonparametric bootstrap, but restores consistency by altering the shape of the criterion function defining the estimator whose distribution we seek to approximate. This modification leads to a generic and easy‐to‐implement resampling method for inference that is conceptually distinct from other available distributional approximations. We illustrate the applicability of our results with four examples in econometrics and machine learning.

10.3982/ecta17950.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于自助法的有效分布近似方法，适用于具有Chernoff（1964）型极限分布的M估计量。对于这类估计量，标准的非参数自助法并不适用。本文提出的方法基于非参数自助法，但通过改变定义估计量的标准函数的形状来恢复其一致性。这种修改使得该方法成为一种通用且易于实施的重采样方法，在概念上与其他现有的分布近似方法有所不同。我们通过四个经济学和机器学习领域的例子来说明我们结果的适用性。

abstract.text: Most of the literature that studies frictional search‐and‐matching models with heterogeneous agents and random search investigates steady state equilibria. Steady state equilibrium requires, in particular, that the flows of agents into and out of the population of unmatched agents balance. We investigate the structure of this balance condition, taking agents' matching behavior as given. Building on the “fundamental matching lemma” for quadratic search technologies in Shimer and Smith (2000), we establish existence, uniqueness, and comparative statics properties of the solution to the balance condition for any search technology satisfying minimal regularity conditions. Implications for the existence and structure of steady state equilibria in the Shimer–Smith model and extensions thereof are noted. These reinforce the point that much of the structure of search‐and‐matching models with quadratic search technologies carries over to more general search technologies.

10.3982/ecta8356.abstractZh: 大多数研究具有异质代理和随机搜索的摩擦性搜索与匹配模型的文献都关注稳态均衡。稳态均衡特别要求进入和离开未匹配代理群体的代理流量保持平衡。我们研究了这种平衡条件的结构，假设代理的匹配行为已经确定。基于Shimer和Smith（2000）提出的二次搜索技术的基本匹配引理，我们证明了任何满足最小正则性条件的搜索技术的解的存在性、唯一性以及比较静态性质。文中还指出了Shimer–Smith模型及其扩展中稳态均衡的存在性和结构的相关影响。这些研究进一步强调了，具有二次搜索技术的搜索与匹配模型的结构可以推广到更一般的搜索技术。
